games.name: Risk of Rain 2: Seekers of the Storm

names.en: Risk of Rain 2: Seekers of the Storm

games.short_description: An ancient threat awakens on Petrichor V. Master new Survivors, wield new items, and fight your way across uncharted regions. Ascend the levels of the Colossus in a race to confront The False Son. Defeat him and unlock the true power of his Soul!

descriptions.en: An ancient threat awakens on Petrichor V. Master new Survivors, wield new items, and fight your way across uncharted regions. Ascend the levels of the Colossus in a race to confront The False Son. Defeat him and unlock the true power of his Soul!

detailed_descriptions.en: Bring retribution to Petrichor V and forge a path to the Colossus to face an ancient threat! A Soul, born without purpose, locked away and forgotten. Her prison served as both sanctuary and shackle. Her fate: doomed by her flawless design. Millennia passed. Her desperation grew, and from the depths of her solitude, she brought another into the world she lost. Now, The False Son walks Petrichor V, bound by the betrayal of his forebearer and the corruption of a King’s blind ambition. Prepare for an expedition deep into Petrichor V’s lost regions! Ancient Lemurian temples and crashing waterfalls lead the way across new stages. Explore hidden caverns and take in the sulfurous smell of brimstone in the Helminth Hatchery. Fend off scores of Lemurians within their Reformed Altar, or drop into the lush green canopy of the Treeborn Colony. But the true threat towers overhead… Travel the path of the Colossus and ascend its levels in a race to confront The False Son. Defeat him and unlock the true power of his soul! Through her mastery of soul manipulation, Seeker can exact incredible damage on nearby monsters while simultaneously unleashing potent healing to sustain her teammates. This unique combination of brawling and healing defines Seeker as a Survivor. Players who learn to seamlessly flow between these roles will be rewarded with one of the most versatile Survivors to ever grace an escape pod. Once you reach a sufficiently tranquil state, you can even bring fallen allies back to life! Seeker’s presence can turn the tide of any battle, offering both devastation and salvation in equal measure. Embrace duality and lead your team to victory! Seeker is instantly unlocked for Seekers of the Storm owners. Chef has returned! But this isn’t your grandpa’s Chef bot. Years of combat have hard-boiled his soul and perfected his culinary abilities. The long legs of past Chefs have been swapped with a huge roller—perfect for flattening out a nice, tidy pie crust or steamrolling whatever helpless Lemurians were unfortunate enough to wake up this morning. Those years of primal culinary misadventures have trained Chef to have incredible control over his trusty cleavers. Hurl them at faraway enemies and call them back to slice and dice with twice the pain. Master the art of the cleaver and filet your way to victory. Players who cook up something truly delicious will unlock Chef! So, get ready to sauté your way through hordes, blend your combat skills with culinary precision, and serve up some justice… à la mode. Free The False Son from his shackles and wield his immense power! This construct, carved in the image of Providence, was forged with the corruption of a hollow king and the heart of a golden titan, making him a formidable rival even to Providence himself. The False Son excels as an immovable object. His massive scale, incredible health, and unmatched regeneration make him a particularly resilient Survivor. In close-range encounters, his hulking club can crush foes into submission. However, outside of clubbing range, fights become far more challenging. Strategically use line of sight to draw enemies in or pick them off with carefully thrown Lunar Spikes. Learn to close in on enemies quickly, and you’ll extract the most out of this imposing golem. Only one player is required to own Seekers of the Storm to enable the expansion for the whole lobby. Players without Seekers of the Storm will be unable to select the new Survivors or permanently unlock new items, logbooks, or other content.

games.name: Risk of Rain 2: Survivors of the Void

names.en: Risk of Rain 2: Survivors of the Void

games.short_description: Embrace The Void as it overtakes Petrichor V in Risk of Rain 2’s first-ever expansion! New survivors, monsters, stages, and a new class of items have arrived to help you kick the crabs back to their dimension.

descriptions.en: Embrace The Void as it overtakes Petrichor V in Risk of Rain 2’s first-ever expansion! New survivors, monsters, stages, and a new class of items have arrived to help you kick the crabs back to their dimension.

detailed_descriptions.en: The Gateway to The Void has opened! The corrupting power it contained has engulfed Petrichor V and plunged the planet into darkness. For millennia, The Void Creatures have grown dominant by taking artifacts from our realm to theirs. Now they look to add you to their collection. Bring your friends on the adventure! Only one player is required to own Survivors of the Void to enable the monsters, levels, and items to appear in-game for the whole lobby. Players without Survivors of the Void will be unable to select the two new survivors or permanently unlock new items, logbooks, or other content. Press your advantage on the high ground. Unleash devastating shots from across the map with Railgunner’s first-person scope. Time your reloads, aim for weak spots, and change the battlefield. Railgunner is the ultimate boss killer. Instead of cutting down hordes, she eliminates her target in one shot. Mastering Railgunner’s positioning and movement unleash her true potential. Throw down a Concussion Device to reach an overlook, or to get out of a challenging situation. Railgunner is instantly unlocked for owners of Survivors of the Void. Turn the corruption in your favor and harness the power of The Void. A corrupted commando is torn between controlling his new powers and being consumed by them. The Void Fiend is the second new survivor in Survivors of the Void. As the corruption overtakes you, abilities are twisted into more powerful attacks for a short time. Drown enemies with a flood of beams and missiles, and master new movement possibilities. Time your corruption, harness the void, unleash the Void Fiend. Unlock the Void Fiend by overcoming a new threat in Survivors of the Void. Corrupt familiar items and unlock new powers! Receiving one of the 14 Void Items permanently alters all normal versions of that item. Corruption brings power, but it also brings changes. You’ll find that many items now do the opposite of what they once did. The Void ukulele’s electrifying music targets single enemies instead of crowds. Some items do something completely different! Unlock 5 pieces of equipment, 4 lunar items, and 18 standard items in Survivors of the Void. More of Providence’s creatures are loose and they’re not thrilled by this threat to their world. The gelatinous Gup has returned, and he’s brought some new friends from the far reaches of Petrichor V. Beware this adorable orange abomination, tread too close and it’s likely to bounce you off a cliff. The most powerful creatures come from The Void. Your ability to reach The Void threatens them. That encroachment won't go unanswered. Constructs of hulking power and corrupted mind have been sent to capture you. Uncover the root of their strength, and if you can, take the fight to them. Unfamiliar places on Petrichor V have been discovered! Traverse new stages, uncover their secrets, and infiltrate The Void. Explore the beautiful waterfalls of Aphelian Sanctuary, take in the pungent odor of the Sulfur Pools, and enjoy accidental ice skating in Siphoned Forest.

More of Providence’s creatures are loose and they’re not thrilled by this threat to their world. The gelatinous Gup has returned, and he’s brought some new friends from the far reaches of Petrichor V. Beware this adorable orange abomination, tread too close and it’s likely to bounce you off a cliff.

The most powerful creatures come from The Void. Your ability to reach The Void threatens them. That encroachment won't go unanswered. Constructs of hulking power and corrupted mind have been sent to capture you. Uncover the root of their strength, and if you can, take the fight to them.





Unfamiliar places on Petrichor V have been discovered! Traverse new stages, uncover their secrets, and infiltrate The Void. Explore the beautiful waterfalls of Aphelian Sanctuary, take in the pungent odor of the Sulfur Pools, and enjoy accidental ice skating in Siphoned Forest.

games.name: Risk of Rain Returns
games.short_description: Carefully designed, beautifully remastered, and loaded with new ways to play—Risk of Rain is back and better than ever! Dive into the iconic roguelike full of unique loot combinations, enhanced with new Survivors, overhauled multiplayer, fan favorite content from Risk of Rain 2, and more!

descriptions.en: Carefully designed, beautifully remastered, and loaded with new ways to play—Risk of Rain is back and better than ever! Dive into the iconic roguelike full of unique loot combinations, enhanced with new Survivors, overhauled multiplayer, fan favorite content from Risk of Rain 2, and more!

detailed_descriptions.en: Carefully designed, beautifully remastered, and loaded with new ways to play—Risk of Rain is back and better than ever! Dive into the iconic roguelike full of unique loot combinations, entirely new Survivors, overhauled multiplayer, and more! Hone your skills and abilities, discover new Survivors, and dive into progressively stronger runs! Discover secrets of ancient design lying dormant beneath the surface of Petrichor V. Search under every log, stone, and Gup to find new ways to play! Many Survivors fled the mysterious attack on your ship. Slice, dice, and serve justice cold with the return of Chef, hold the front line and shield your team as Enforcer, or lay down a path of toxic sludge as everybody’s favorite purple monster: Acrid! Forge new paths to explore with 15 unique Survivors, each with new abilities to master. Two entirely new Survivors are making their debut in Risk of Rain Returns. Also introducing The Drifter! This resourceful brawler gathers scrap from conquered foes and can spawn items that temporarily empower teammates. She can also take them for herself and unleash an unbridled blaze of area-wide destruction. The Drifter is the perfect addition to any group of Survivors. Her ability to support the team while laying down her own brand of hurt will prove she’s more than just a stowaway. Drop to the surface solo or with your crew! Choose Survivors that complement each other’s strengths and weaknesses, or go wild and choose whoever has the largest guns (spoiler: it’s Loader). With up to four-player online and couch co-op, you’re not alone in this fight. Risk of Rain Returns features new and improved multiplayer services to ensure the only thing that gets between your crew’s survival are the ever-growing hordes on Petrichor V. Fight your way to the surface while uncovering precious cargo. These items serve as your redemption, helping you move faster, deal more damage, or jump a little higher. Still others empower you in more dramatic ways—like the rare Ukulele, which empowers your attacks with electrifying music. If explosions are what you’re after, hunt down the Brilliant Behemoth and watch as even your most mundane attacks erupt in a barrage of beautiful blasts. The magic comes in the unpredictable combinations you create. Exploding chain lightning is only the beginning of your frenetic masterpiece! The denizens of Petrichor V are as diverse as the many planets they once called home. As these monsters approached extinction on their own worlds, a mysterious force brought them to Petrichor V. The planet quickly grew to be a menagerie of the most dangerous monsters in the galaxy, and they’re not thrilled by interlopers (aka YOU). Variety is the spice of destruction. Select from more than 10 Artifacts that each mutate your run! Perhaps you’d like to start with a random equipment item that changes every time it’s used, or maybe you’d like to experience a rampant Imp invasion every 10 minutes. Play around with combinations of Artifacts and discover exciting new ways to play.

games.name: RoadCraft
games.short_description: As the leader of a company specialized in restoring sites devastated by natural disasters, use your construction machinery to restart the local industry. Clear debris and faulty equipment, rebuild roads and bridges damaged by weather, and much more!

descriptions.en: As the leader of a company specialized in restoring sites devastated by natural disasters, use your construction machinery to restart the local industry. Clear debris and faulty equipment, rebuild roads and bridges damaged by weather, and much more!

detailed_descriptions.en: As the leader of a company specialized in restoring sites devastated by natural disasters, use your construction machinery to restart the local industry. Clear debris and faulty equipment, rebuild roads and bridges damaged by weather, and much more! You run a disaster recovery company, specialized in restoring sites devastated by natural disasters. Numerous tasks await you and your heavy machinery as you work to restart the local industry: clearing debris, replacing faulty equipment, rebuilding roads and bridges damaged by bad weather, deploying resource convoys to produce new reconstruction materials, and much more! Experience a new generation of simulation with the brand new engine developed by Saber Interactive, the creators of MudRunner and SnowRunner . Handle each object with realistic physics, accounting for their mass and size. Interact with elements like sand, wood, and asphalt. Reshape the terrain and ease the movement of your vehicles thanks to your newly-built roads. Each machine has its own behavior. Use your bulldozer to clear obstructions, your heavy transporter to carry multiple vehicles, or your fixed or gantry cranes to lift containers and equipment. Reconnect a factory to the power grid with your cable layer, lay down hot asphalt with your paver, and flatten it with your roller to create your own roads. Unlock over 40 vehicles as you progress through the story-driven campaign. Visit your garage to customize your machines with your company’s logo and repaint them with your personalized colors. Disasters have caused chaos, cutting off access to many affected areas. You are the last hope to brave these extreme conditions. Whether in the mountains, the heart of the desert, or by the sea, your expertise is needed around the globe! Explore 8 unique maps, each 4 km², with their own biomes and buildings. Choose your itinerary through abandoned factories, submerged dams, or out-of-service solar fields. Search every corner to achieve your goals, and secure new contracts to earn additional funds and XP. Collect remnants of wood, steel, and cement and transform them into components in your recycling plants, every piece of debris can be used for reconstruction! Supply factories and sand quarries to produce resources in bulk. As the operations manager, guide your transport trucks by plotting their routes on the map and ensure no obstacles block their way! The world of RoadCraft offers a multitude of activities. Why not complete them with your friends? Set up a co-op session for up to 4 players. Divide tasks or focus together on a single objective. Combine your strengths and ingenuity to find solutions, even the most unexpected ones.

games.name: Rollout Inline
games.short_description: Rollout Inline is a brand new inline skating game created by a solo dev who is passionate about the sport. This game aims to scratch the itch for those who have been craving a new, modern, and intuitive inline skating game!

descriptions.en: Rollout Inline is a brand new inline skating game created by a solo dev who is passionate about the sport. This game aims to scratch the itch for those who have been craving a new, modern, and intuitive inline skating game!

detailed_descriptions.en: Overview Rollout Inline is a brand new inline skating game created by a solo dev who is passionate about the sport. It aims to scratch the itch for those who have been craving a new , modern , and intuitive inline skating game! Enjoy an immersive single-player experience that offers a simcade gameplay feel all about the sport of Inline skating. Whether you are a real-life blader or someone who enjoys extreme sports games, this one is for you! Built for Controllers Rollout Inline is built for controllers. While the core gameplay, such as steering and spinning, is on the left stick and jumping on the right stick , grinds and cess slides are performed with dual-stick controls , with each stick representing each foot. Feature Overview: Riding, Grinding, Cess Slides, Free Spinning & Flipping, Air Grabs, Toe/Heel Rolls, Handplants, Physics/Momentum-based Movement, Ragdoll, Balancing Mechanics (Optional), Multiple Maps, Intuitive Controls, Replay Editor, Original in-game Music/Radio, Challenges, Progression System, Difficulty Settings. Dual Stick Grinds This allows for a huge grind selection and all the creative freedom you could hope for while offering an intuitive gameplay feel! Alternative controls for spinning can be set up in the settings, unlocking even more control and freedom of movement for your skater! Customization Customize your character and skates in the in-game customization menu! Clothing items get unlocked by progressing in the game. You can freely customize your skates at any time - no unlocks needed! Challenges & Progression System Push your limits in various challenges and level up your maps while unlocking new clothing items to style your skater! Challenges will show up in every map, and once you complete a batch of challenges, your map level increases and a new set of challenges will appear, with each level increasing the difficulty! Challenges from an earlier level are always replayable. Multiple Maps Explore multiple maps with various challenges and features like massive gaps, long rails, vert ramps, pools, and more! 3 maps will be available on the day of the Early Access launch.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Overview

Rollout Inline is a brand new inline skating game created by a solo dev who is passionate about the sport. It aims to scratch the itch for those who have been craving a new, modern, and intuitive inline skating game!

Enjoy an immersive single-player experience that offers a simcade gameplay feel all about the sport of Inline skating. Whether you are a real-life blader or someone who enjoys extreme sports games, this one is for you!

Built for Controllers

Rollout Inline is built for controllers. While the core gameplay, such as steering and spinning, is on the left stick and jumping on the right stick, grinds and cess slides are performed with dual-stick controls, with each stick representing each foot.

Feature Overview:

Riding, Grinding, Cess Slides, Free Spinning & Flipping, Air Grabs, Toe/Heel Rolls, Handplants, Physics/Momentum-based Movement, Ragdoll, Balancing Mechanics (Optional), Multiple Maps, Intuitive Controls, Replay Editor, Original in-game Music/Radio, Challenges, Progression System, Difficulty Settings.

Dual Stick Grinds

This allows for a huge grind selection and all the creative freedom you could hope for while offering an intuitive gameplay feel! Alternative controls for spinning can be set up in the settings, unlocking even more control and freedom of movement for your skater!

Customization

Customize your character and skates in the in-game customization menu! Clothing items get unlocked by progressing in the game. You can freely customize your skates at any time - no unlocks needed!

Challenges & Progression System

Push your limits in various challenges and level up your maps while unlocking new clothing items to style your skater! Challenges will show up in every map, and once you complete a batch of challenges, your map level increases and a new set of challenges will appear, with each level increasing the difficulty! Challenges from an earlier level are always replayable.

Multiple Maps

Explore multiple maps with various challenges and features like massive gaps, long rails, vert ramps, pools, and more! 3 maps will be available on the day of the Early Access launch.

games.name: Romestead
games.short_description: Rome has fallen! Rebuild civilization in this action-adventure survival game for 1-8 players. Fight hordes of the walking dead, build settlements, restore the Roman gods... or kick back and farm with friends.

descriptions.en: Rome has fallen! Rebuild civilization in this action-adventure survival game for 1-8 players. Fight hordes of the walking dead, build settlements, restore the Roman gods... or kick back and farm with friends.

detailed_descriptions.en: Rome has fallen! Rebuild civilization in this action-adventure survival game for 1-8 players. Fight hordes of the walking dead, build settlements, restore the Roman gods... or kick back and farm with friends. In Romestead , the dead walk at night and the gods have gone silent. Explore, gather, build, and slowly turn a camp into a working settlement. Progression is biome-based: explore, gather resources, craft better gear, restore the gods through offerings and sacrifices, defeat bosses to unlock the next crafting tier, and take on the next biome. Or take your time. Decorate your settlement, experiment with automation, farm your crops, and hang out with friends. Features Survive Alone or With Friends The game scales in difficulty depending on how many players are in the world. While balanced for up to eight players, we’re not stopping you from inviting more. Physical Resource Management Romestead has a regular inventory system, but heavy resources are physical objects in the world. Pick up, carry, throw, and haul lumber and rocks, or build carts to bring resources back from the wild. An enemy closing in? Chuck a boulder in its face. Build Your Settlements Search the world for survivors to recruit as artisans, keep your people happy, and turn your towns into hubs for crafting, farming, and production. As you discover more biomes you can build more specialized settlements and even set up trade between them. Restore the Gods Crafting isn’t the only way to get stronger. Make offerings and sacrifices to restore the gods’ connection to the world and unlock their technologies, buffs, and upgrades. Find Your Role Build around melee, ranged combat, magic, farming, building, or exploration. Solo players will do a bit of everything, but in co-op your group can specialize: fight, gather, craft, farm, automate production, or keep the settlement growing. Explore, Fight, and Loot The world of Romestead is procedurally generated, but filled with handcrafted places, secrets, and dungeons. Dungeons range from short combat challenges to sprawling adventures with enemies and puzzles, and reward you with gear, trinkets, survivors, and more.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Rome has fallen!

Rebuild civilization in this action-adventure survival game for 1-8 players. Fight hordes of the walking dead, build settlements, restore the Roman gods... or kick back and farm with friends.

In Romestead, the dead walk at night and the gods have gone silent. Explore, gather, build, and slowly turn a camp into a working settlement.

Progression is biome-based: explore, gather resources, craft better gear, restore the gods through offerings and sacrifices, defeat bosses to unlock the next crafting tier, and take on the next biome.

Or take your time. Decorate your settlement, experiment with automation, farm your crops, and hang out with friends.

Features

  • Survive Alone or With Friends
    The game scales in difficulty depending on how many players are in the world. While balanced for up to eight players, we’re not stopping you from inviting more.

  • Physical Resource Management
    Romestead has a regular inventory system, but heavy resources are physical objects in the world. Pick up, carry, throw, and haul lumber and rocks, or build carts to bring resources back from the wild. An enemy closing in? Chuck a boulder in its face.

  • Build Your Settlements
    Search the world for survivors to recruit as artisans, keep your people happy, and turn your towns into hubs for crafting, farming, and production. As you discover more biomes you can build more specialized settlements and even set up trade between them.

  • Restore the Gods
    Crafting isn’t the only way to get stronger. Make offerings and sacrifices to restore the gods’ connection to the world and unlock their technologies, buffs, and upgrades.

  • Find Your Role
    Build around melee, ranged combat, magic, farming, building, or exploration. Solo players will do a bit of everything, but in co-op your group can specialize: fight, gather, craft, farm, automate production, or keep the settlement growing.

  • Explore, Fight, and Loot
    The world of Romestead is procedurally generated, but filled with handcrafted places, secrets, and dungeons. Dungeons range from short combat challenges to sprawling adventures with enemies and puzzles, and reward you with gear, trinkets, survivors, and more.

descriptions.en: POWERFUL enough for a developer SIMPLE enough for a child VERSATILE enough for any platform!RPG MAKER MV allows you to make the RPG of your dreams! This latest version includes a host of new featuresand export options for MacOSX, Android, and iPhone!
descriptions.zh-Hant: 功能強大，開發者的福音！簡便易用，孩童亦可上手！通用性強，各平台皆能相容！RPG MAKER MV可以讓你製作夢想中的RPG！最新版本已包含大量全新功能，並可匯出至MacOSX，Android以及iPhone！
descriptions.ja: 初心者から開発者まで満足いただける、RPGツクールの名作！RPGツクールMVはスマホやMacを含むマルチデバイス出力対応。作ったゲームを、スマホ上でタッチ操作で遊んでもらうことも可能です。
descriptions.ko: 개발자에게 강력한, 아이들에게도 초간단, 모든 플랫폼에 다양하게 적용 가능한 제작 툴! RPG Maker MV로 상상하던 RPG를 직접 제작해 보세요! 최신 버전에는 다양한 신기능과 MacOSX, 안드로이드, 아이폰 형식으로 저장 가능한 기능도 포함!

detailed_descriptions.en: POWERFUL enough for a developer SIMPLE enough for a child VERSATILE enough for any platform! For years, RPG Maker has been the easiest way to make your own Windows PC Roleplaying game. We have strived to give everyone, regardless of experience or skill level, the tools to make a game they could be proud of. Now, with RPG Maker MV, your game isn't just on Windows PC, its on the move. Make your game on your Windows or OS X PC, and then deploy it for iOS, Android, Windows, OS X, or even to play in a browser using HTML5! MAKE GAMES FOR THE PLATFORMS YOU WANT FROM ANY PC RPG Maker MV can run on both Windows and Mac OS X PCs. Users can also export games for the following platforms: Windows/EXE MacOSX/APP (Mac OSX 10.10 or better. Not supported: macOS Big Sur 11.0 and later.) Android/APK iOS/IPA HTML 5 for Web Browsers BUILD YOUR WORLD WITH AN IMPROVED MAP EDITOR RPG Maker MV uses a user-friendly​ map system to help you build the RPG world of your dreams. With an additional automated upper layer, mapping in MV is even easier than before. MAKE YOUR WORLD LIVE WITH A SIMPLE EVENT SYSTEM In RPG Maker MV, you use the simple, intuitive event system to bring your world to life. You can easily and quickly create NPCs for your characters to interact with, puzzles for them to solve, and quests for them to complete. GET STARTED IMMEDIATELY WITH BUILT-IN RESOURCES RPG Maker MV, like previous RPG Makers, comes with its own graphic and audio resources for you to use in your game. From sprites to battlers, from sound effects to music. MV comes with resources for both Fantasy and Sci-fi games, and you are easily able to add more. USE TWO DIFFERENT BATTLE MODES, RIGHT OUT OF THE BOX With a tick of a checkbox, you can switch between the classic Front View Battle to a Side View Battle system. USE A MOUSE OR TOUCH SCREEN TO PLAY YOUR GAMES Tired of playing RPG Maker games with your keyboard? With RPG Maker MV, your game will allow the player to play the game with a flick of their mouse, or using a touch screen. SEE YOUR GAME IN HIGHER RESOLUTION RPG Maker MV can show more than ever before. With a default 1.5x the resolution, sprites can show more emotion and the scenery can be more detailed than ever before. USE PLUGINS TO MAKE A FULLY CUSTOMIZED GAME Want to customize your game even FURTHER? Use plugins to change things the way YOU want them. You can get them from us, get them from other fans, or master JavaScript to make your own! With our new plugin manager, you can just drop in the .js file of a plugin, and then configure it directly in the editor.
detailed_descriptions.zh-Hant: 功能強大，開發者的福音！簡便易用，孩童亦可上手！通用性強，各平台皆能相容！ 多年來，RPG Maker 一直是在Windows PC平台製作RPG的最佳捷徑。我們力求讓每一個人——無論經驗豐富與否、水準或高或低——都能擁有這樣一個工具，製作出令自己驕傲的遊戲。如今，有了RPG Maker MV，您的遊戲不僅僅限於Windows PC ，而是遍地開花。在Windows 或是OS X 的PC上製作你的遊戲，然後開發出它的iOS、Android、Windows、OS X甚至是可以在流覽器上遊玩的HTML5版本！ 在任何一台PC上製作出你所希望的平台的遊戲 RPG Maker MV可以在Windows以及Mac OS X PC上運行。用戶亦可匯出其他平台的遊戲： Windows/EXE MacOSX/APP (Mac OSX 10.10 or better. Not supported: macOS Big Sur 11.0 and later.) Android/APK iOS/IPA 用於瀏覽器的HTML 5 用先進的地圖編輯器製作出你的世界 RPG Maker MV擁有親民的地圖編輯系統，幫助你製作出夢想中的RPG世界。有了自動化的上層框架，MV中的地圖編輯比以往更加方便了。 用簡單的事件系統令你的世界生動起來 在RPG Maker MV中，你可以使用直觀簡便的事件系統來給你的世界添加生氣與活力。你可以很方便地創造出與玩家互動的NPC、需要玩家解決的謎題，以及給玩家們準備的任務。 用内置的資源立刻開始工作 和以往的RPG Makers一樣，RPG Maker MV也擁有自己的圖像與聲音資源，供您在自己的遊戲中使用。無論是立繪還是敵人，無論是音效還是音樂。MV同時擁有幻想與科幻題材的資源，您也可以很方便地添加更多的資源。 使用兩種戰鬥模式，令人耳目一新 您只需輕輕打一個勾，便可以從傳統的正面視角戰鬥模式切換到全新的側面視角戰鬥模式。 使用滑鼠或是觸控螢幕來遊玩您的遊戲 厭倦了用鍵盤遊玩RPG Maker 遊戲了嗎？有了RPG Maker MV ，您可以使用滑鼠或是觸控螢幕來點擊遊玩。 用更高的解析度欣賞您的遊戲 RPG Maker MV可以為您展現更多精彩。有了預設的1.5的解析度後，立繪可以展現更多的感情，場景也會變得更加細膩。 使用外掛程式來製作一個嶄新的原創遊戲 希望您的遊戲變得更加有個性嗎？使用外掛程式可以隨您所欲地改變遊戲。您可以從我們、從其他用戶那裡獲取外掛程式，甚至使用JavaScript來自己製作外掛程式！有了新的外掛程式管理器，您可以將.js外掛程式檔放入，然後在編輯器中直接對其進行設置。
detailed_descriptions.ja: 初心者から開発者まで満足いただける、RPGツクールの名作 長年、もっともシンプルかつ簡単なRPG作成エンジンとしてたくさんの人々に愛されてきたRPGツクールシリーズ。初心者からベテラン開発者まで、経験やスキルに関わらず1人1人が自分だけのRPGを簡単に作ることができる・・・そんなツクールシリーズ一つがこの「RPG Maker MV」です。 RPGツクール初のMac/スマホ対応！ RPGツクール史上初、プレイゲームのマルチデバイス出力に対応、あらゆるデバイスでの公開が可能になりました。ウェブブラウザでプレイ可能なHTML5形式の出力を基本とし、それに加えて、Windows/exe形式、Mac/app形式、Android/apk形式、iOS/ipa形式、の4種類のパッケージングを可能に。もちろんスマホ向けにタッチ操作も可能です！ Windows/EXE MacOSX/APP※Mac OS X 10.10以降(macOS Big Sur 11.0以降は非対応) Android/APK iOS/IPA HTML 5 （ウェブブラウザ） 前作比200%以上増量の素材を同梱 「RPG Maker MV」では従来のフロントビュー戦闘に加えて、サイドビューでの戦闘が簡単に実装できます。最初から同梱されているバトル用のドット絵や、一枚絵のキャラクター、SE、ME、BGMの量は、なんとRPGツクール史上最大規模。買ったその日から、豊富な同梱素材だけで自分だけのRPGが作れてしまいます！ マップ作成機能を大幅に強化 リージョン編集モードへの切り替えがタイルパレットのタブで可能になり、いちいちマップを切り替えて編集する煩わしさが無くなりました。またリージョン最大数を63から255に変更。より詳細なリージョン編集が可能になります。 また、作成したマップを画像として保存することができるようになったので、マップの全景を確認やデザイン統一などが効率よく行えるようになります。 上級者も満足！スクリプトで高いカスタマイズ性を実現 スクリプトを使いこなせば、メニュー画面、戦闘システムの変更だけでなく、独自のイベント命令も作成可能です。上級者向けの機能ですが、極めれば、よりオリジナリティあるゲームを作れるようになることでしょう。本作からは、HTML5での出力に合わせ、扱い易いJavaScriptを採用。スクリプトを使用することで更に本格的なゲーム制作もできる奥の深さも持ちあわせている、それが「RPGツクール」なのです。
detailed_descriptions.ko: 개발자들에게 강력한, 아이들에게도 초간단, 모든 플랫폼에 다양하게 적용 가능한 제작 툴! 지금까지 RPG메이커는 자신만의 윈도우 PC 롤플레잉 게임 제작을 위해 가장 손쉬운 방법을 제시해 왔습니다. 이번 소프트웨어는 여러분의 경험이나 능력과 상관없는 게임 제작 툴 제작을 지원하기 위한 지금까지의 노력이 반영되어 있습니다. 이제부터 RPG Maker MV를 통해 여러분의 게임을 윈도우 PC 환경 외부로 확장시켜 보세요. 윈도우나 OSX 환경에서 게임을 제작하고, iOS, 안드로이드, 윈도우, OS X, HTML5 웹 브라우저에서 실행해 보세요! 어떤 컴퓨터라도 원하는 플랫폼으로 게임 제작 RPG Maker MV는 윈도우와 OS X 환경 모두 실행이 가능하며 사용자는 다음 플랫폼에 맞게 게임을 저장할 수 있습니다. 윈도우/EXE MacOSX/APP (Mac OSX 10.10 or better. Not supported: macOS Big Sur 11.0 and later.) 안드로이드/APK iOS/IPA 웹브라우저용 HTML 5 업그레이드된 맵 에디터로 자신만의 세계를 창조 RPG Maker MV의 유저 친화적 맵 시스템으로 여러분이 상상하던 RPG 세계를 제작해 보세요. 자동화된 상위 레이어 기능으로 이전보다 쉬운 맵핑이 가능합니다. 간단한 이벤트 시스템으로 ‘생동감’ 있는 세계를 창조 RPG메이커 MV에서 심플하고 쉬운 이벤트 시스템으로 생동감 넘치는 세계를 창조해 보세요. 캐릭터와 접촉할 NPC부터 풀어야 할 퍼즐, 완료할 퀘스트까지 간단하고 빠르게 제작 가능합니다. 내장 리소스로 지금 바로 게임 제작! 이전 RPG메이커와 마찬가지로 RPG Maker MV는 게임에 활용 가능한 기본 그래픽과 오디오 리소스를 포함하고 있습니다. 스프라이트, 배틀러, 효과음, 배경음 모두 다양하게 활용 가능합니다. MV에는 판타지와 Sci-Fi 게임을 위한 리소스가 기본 탑재, 유저가 원하는 리소스 추가도 가능합니다. 두 가지 전투 모드 중 선호 모드 선택! 체크 한 번으로 전투 시스템을 프런트뷰와 사이드뷰 중 원하는 방식으로 전환할 수 있습니다. 마우스나 터치 스크린을 이용한 조작 RPG메이커로 제작한 게임을 키보드로 조작하는데 질리셨나요? RPG Maker MV로 게임 조작 방식을 마우스나 터치스크린으로 설정 가능합니다. 고해상도 게임 디스플레이 RPG Maker MV는 이전보다 디테일한 화면을 표시 가능합니다. 1.5배 기본 해상도로 스프라이트에서 좀 더 세밀한 감성을 표출 가능하며, 배경을 좀 더 디테일하게 표현 가능합니다. 플러그인을 통해 완벽하게 커스터마이징 게임을 좀 더 완벽하게 커스터마이징하고 싶으신가요? 플러그인을 통해 여러분의 취향에 맞게 변경해 보세요. 다운로드하거나, 다른 유저에게 전수 받거나, 직접 자바스크립트를 배워 여러분만의 플러그인을 제작 가능합니다! 새로운 플러그인 관리자 기능으로 플러그인의 .js 파일을 이동시켜 에디터에서 바로 환경 설정이 가능합니다.

games.short_description: You want to create an RPG, but every game making tool you have found was either too complex or too limited? RPG Maker MZ empowers you with simple tools to create your RPG right out of the box, yet is customizable enough to make the exact RPG you want!

descriptions.en: You want to create an RPG, but every game making tool you have found was either too complex or too limited? RPG Maker MZ empowers you with simple tools to create your RPG right out of the box, yet is customizable enough to make the exact RPG you want!
descriptions.zh-Hant: 隆重推出 RPG Maker MZ！作為 RPG Maker 系列的最新版本，讓任何人都能輕鬆享受製作角色扮演遊戲的樂趣！ 除了使用更精進的創作環境和更強大的製作素材，您還可以利用全新的功能和改良的操作方式，製造出真正滿足玩家需求的遊戲。
descriptions.ja: 誰でも手軽にRPGが制作できるRPGツクールシリーズの最新作「RPGツクールMZ」が登場！新機能の追加や動作改善により、制作環境の向上や演出面の強化はもちろん、ゲームを遊ぶユーザーに対しても手厚いゲームが制作できるようになりました。
descriptions.ko: RPG Maker MZ를 소개합니다. RPG Maker 시리즈의 최신 버전으로 누구나 쉽게 RPG를 만들 수 있습니다! 새로운 기능과 동작 개선을 통해 제작 환경이 향상되고 더욱 강력한 연출 표현이 가능해져 플레이어가 진정으로 추구하는 게임을 제작할 수 있습니다.

detailed_descriptions.en: The RPG Maker Series' Newest Offering: RPG Maker MZ With new features and enhancements to older features, this RPG Maker is set to become the best RPG Maker to date! Map Editor With RPG Maker's map editor, you can create maps with ease. Pick the tiles you want to use, and “paint” them on to your maps. With powerful enhancements from the previous RPG Maker’s map editor, and a large collection of new tiles, you can build countless towns and dungeons for your players to explore!. ●Tile size can be selected from "16x16", "24x24", "32x32", and "48x48". The new tile resolution options facilitate the use of RPG Maker VX and VXAce tile sets (32x32) and custom assets. ● The Layer Function Returns! An incredibly missed feature from RPG Maker XP returns with MZ! Map layer control has returned. You can now select which of the four map layers you are drawing onto, or leave it on Automatic to keep the behavior from MV. This gives you more control to make your maps look the way you want to, as well as speeding up the map creation process: No more having to redo an entire tile because you messed up one layer or want to change the base layer! ●Shadow pen rectangle mode for wide-area manipulation Holding down the Shift key when selecting a shadow pen allows you to switch to rectangle mode, which manipulates a wide area. ● Map Trees can be Rearranged You can now rearrange the Maps in the editor Map Tree even on the same tree level, making it easier than ever to organize your project for maximum efficiency. Character Generator Not only can you use the included characters or import your own made completely from scratch, you can also create your own original characters using component pieces using the built in Character Generator! Combine hairs, eyes, clothes, accessories, and more. Recolor them to match your vision. ● Adjust Component Positioning You can now use the offset feature in the Character Generator to adjust the placement of generator pieces, giving you greater control over the look of your heroes, villains, and NPCs! ● Add New Color Palettes You can now go beyond the existing color palettes: add your own palettes for recoloring hair, clothes, and more! A Trove of Assets Included From face graphics, character sprites, to map chips, character generator components, music, and sound effects, and more, RPG Maker MZ boasts the largest collection of assets out of the box than any RPG Maker in the series history! ● Graphics Animations: 120 Battle Background 1: 51 Battle Background 2: 50 Character Sprites Sheets: 44 Character SV Battlers: 40 Face Graphic Sheets: 15 Character Busts: 120 Character Full Art: 120 Enemy Battlers: 105 Enemy SV Battlers: 105 Tileset Sheets: 31 Parallaxes: 21 Title Screens: 20 ● Sound BGM：48 BGS：29 ME：27 SE：345 ●Sample map data（dlc\RemakeMapResourcePackFolder） Sample map data of RPG Maker VXAce 117 Sample map data of RPG Maker MV 104 *See readme in the same folder for usage instructions Database The database is where the heart of your RPG Maker game resides. Here you store the information defining your characters, their skills, equipment, classes, but also their foes! Also in the database will be where you define many things about your game, like the names of stats, what conditions your characters can be afflicted with, battle animations, and more. ●Maximum number of major database entries can be changed to 9999 The maximum number of Actors,Classes, States, Skills, Items, Weapons, Armors, Enemies, Troops, and Common Events can now be set to 9999. This allows you to realize the game you want to create, such as a game with a wide variety of items. ●Copy and paste tileset settings Passage, Passage (4 dir), Ladder, Bush, Counter, Damage Floor, and Terrain Tag setting can now be copied and pasted to other tileset pages. This makes it easier to set up alternate tilesets. ● New Battle System Added! With RPG Maker MZ, in addition to the front and side-view options that existed in previous RPG Makers, we've added a brand new option! The Time Progress Battle System will unchain your game from traditional turns, allowing every character to act at their own speed based on their stats and conditions. Events The Event system covers all the many NPCs, treasure chests, puzzles and everything else your players will interact with in your game. Using a simple system of menus, you can create a complex series of events that will drive your game to its conclusion. All with no programming knowledge required! ● We have added an "Quick Setting" feature that allows you to specify coordinates from the preview screen in the picture (image) settings. This makes setting up images simple and intuitive. ● We have added a "Quick Access" that allows you to instantly access your favorite maps. This enables you to quickly find maps you frequently use. ● Switch to event mode to display the event list Selecting an event on the list will select the corresponding event on the map. You can also open the event editor directly from the list. ● More Powerful and Extensive Event Commands! Through the addition of elements including control characters for text displays, picture movement settings and status determination for buttons used during conditional branching, we've augmented and expanded event commands. ●Toggle Skip" to disable a specified range of event command With the execution selected, [Skip] is created by using the shortcut key Ctrl+/ or the context menu [Toggle Skip] operation. This is useful when searching for the cause of a bug or testing the direction, since the event commands contained in [Skip] to [End] are not executed. ● Preview Added for Movement Route Settings! When setting up events, now you can check movement routes using a preview. Animation ●Particle animation with enhanced 3D expression With RPG Maker MZ, our Animations function has been completely revamped. Easily create huge fireballs, dynamic sword slashes, or freezing winds for your characters to unleash… and suffer. Due to popular demand, we have now included support for particle effects using Effekseer*, an open source particle effect creation tool! With this new feature, you can create magnificent 2D and 3D animations without having to use clunky spritesheets, making it infinitely easier to make extremely dynamic battle animations! ●RPG Maker MV compatible animation editing function Cell animations prior to RPG Maker MZ can be set by selecting [Create MV-Compatible data] from the animation context menu. Plugins Sometimes, you want to go beyond what is easy to do with eventing alone. That is when Plugins come in! Plugins are bits of code that can change almost anything in your RPG Maker game. Learn to code enough to make some yourself, or find ones made by others to bolster your game. Adding an existing plugin can be as easy as plugging it in! ● Revamped Plug-in Commands It's now possible to select a plug-in name and command name from a pull-down menu rather than having to enter it from text. Additionally, you can easily pass parameters to the Plugin Command requires with a simple menu system. ● Plugin Management Made Even Easier Turn Plugins On/Off from the base Plugin Manager Screen, Easily find the plugin creator's website with the new URL field in the Edit Screen, and be sure that your plugins have all the requirements and are in the correct order with the new error messages. Playing a Game RPG Maker MZ makes it much easier for users to play games! ● Auto-save Function Added Auto-save and separate auto-save slots have been added to the default functionality of the Engine! This option can be turned on and off in the Editor for your game. ● Better UI For Mouse and Touchscreeens The UI has been completely revamped to more comfortable and more intuitive for mouse and touchscreen control! Other updated features ● Sub folder asset organization Subfolders created under audio, img, and plugins can now be referenced from the editor. This is a useful feature for material management. *Some plugins may behave differently when stored in a subfolder
detailed_descriptions.zh-Hant: 〇 RPG Maker 系列最新力作：RPG Maker MZ RPG製作大師系最新作的「RPG製作大師MZ」隆重登場！ 我們在這版本中加入了新的功能，並增強了那些在遊戲創作過程中發揮了關鍵作用的現有功能。正因如此精益求精，RPG Maker 才成為不斷超越自我的強大工具！ 地圖編輯器 有了 RPG Maker 的地圖編輯器，您就能像畫畫一樣製作地圖。 您可以使用此工具內建的地圖圖塊素材構建無數城鎮和地下城。 RPG Maker MZ 提供了更強大的地圖編輯功能，還為您準備了大量的新資源。 ●圖塊大小可以從'16'、'24'、'32'和'48'中選擇 圖塊尺寸指的是一個瓦片的一邊的長度（RPG制作大師MV和MZ的尺寸為48）。 設置的改變有利於引進RPG制作大師VX和VXAce瓷磚組（尺寸為32）和原始材料。 ● 圖層功能回歸！ 我們重新引入了曾經在 RPG Maker XP 之前使用的圖層功能。 通過使用多達四個級別的圖層，您可以對某個特定圖層之外的其他圖層進行編輯，並實現更複雜的構造。 我們還有一個自動確定圖層的功能，因此您仍然可以按照 RPG Maker MV 的方式來進行編輯。 ●陰影筆的矩形模式用於大範圍的操作 在選擇陰影筆時按住Shift鍵，可以切換到矩形模式，在一個寬廣的區域內操作。 ● 地圖樹可重新排列 現在您可以切換相同級別地圖的排列順序。 人物產生器 通過組合此工具內建的素材，即可在遊戲中設置您的原創角色。 除了結合素材外，您也可以使用此功能為您的角色產生無數種視覺圖案，還能改變顏色。 RPG Maker MZ 為您帶來更加強大的人物產生功能。 ● 調整組件位置 我們在人物產生功能中加入了偏移參數的設置，以方便調整組件位置。 ● 添加新的調色板 除現有調色板外，還能添加自選調色板，深度自定義頭髮和衣服的顏色。 內建豐富的資源 從主要角色的部件，到用於製作地圖的地圖圖塊，再到人物產生過程中使用的素材，統統包含在這座豐富的資料庫中。 RPG Maker MZ 擁有本產品系列史上最龐大的資源寶庫！ ● Graphics Animations: 120 Battle Background 1: 51 Battle Background 2: 50 Character Sprites Sheets: 44 Character SV Battlers: 40 Face Graphic Sheets: 15 Character Busts: 120 Character Full Art: 120 Enemy Battlers: 105 Enemy SV Battlers: 105 Tileset Sheets: 31 Parallaxes: 21 Title Screens: 20 ● Sound BGM: 48 BGS: 29 ME: 27 SE: 345 ●地圖數據樣本（dlc\RemakeMapResourcePack文件夾） RPG制作大師VXAce的地圖數據樣本 117 RPG制作大師MV的地圖數據樣本 104 使用說明見同一文件夾中的readme 資料庫 利用 RPG Maker 製作遊戲時，資料庫功能扮演著至關重要的角色。 您可以使用資料庫功能調整和測試與玩家角色及敵人相關的遊戲平衡，還能為職業、技能、道具和武器等區塊選擇詳細的設置。 在 RPG Maker MZ 中，我們對資料庫功能進行了增強和擴展。 ●主要數據庫條目的最大數量為9999 你現在可角色、職業、狀態、技能、物品、武器、防具、敵人、敵群、和共同事件的最大數量設置為9999。 這使你能夠實現你想要創建的遊戲，如具有廣泛項目的遊戲。 ●覆制和粘貼瓷磚組設置 關於通道設置、通道（四方向）、梯子、草木繁茂處、櫃台、有害地形、地板和地形標簽的信息現在可以覆制和粘貼到其他瓷磚組頁面。這有利於設置瓦片組的差異模式。 ● 追加全新戰鬥系統！ 在之前提供的正面視角和側面視角戰鬥系統的基礎上，我們還追加了以時間為基礎的戰鬥系統！ 通過在回合制系統中添加新的元素，我們拓寬了戰鬥方式，為您帶來更多樂趣。 事件 在 RPG Maker 中，您可以使用事件功能來實現人物的對話、地圖中的行動、寶箱的位置及其他視覺效果。 您能輕鬆設置經常使用的事件，也能複製事件並自由運用。 不需要任何編程知識就能設置事件，是否令人驚喜呢！ 試試用我們提供的大量不同事件類型來製作超有趣的遊戲吧。 我們在 RPG Maker MZ 中增強了事件功能。 ● 事件指令增強擴展！ 通過增加的素材，包括控制用於文本顯示的字符、圖片移動設置以及在條件分支時使用的按鈕的狀態確定，我們增強並擴展了事件指令。 ● 切換到事件模式，顯示事件列表 在列表中選擇一個事件，就會在地圖上選擇相應的事件。 你也可以從列表中直接打開事件編輯器。 ●'切換跳過'，在指定範圍內禁用事件指令。 在選擇了執行的情況下，通過使用快捷鍵Ctrl+/或上下文菜單中的[切換跳過]操作，可以創建[跳過]。 [跳過]到[結束]中包含的事件命令不被執行，這在尋找錯誤原因和測試方向時很有用。 ● 移動路徑設置預覽！ 現在，設置事件時，可以使用預覽功能來檢查移動路徑。 動畫 您可以使用動畫功能為戰鬥場景添加閃爍和衝擊等特效。 在 RPG Maker MZ 中，我們對動畫功能進行了改進！ ●具有增強的三維表現的粒子動畫 我們結合 Effekseer* 引入了以檔案為基礎的使用升級規範。Effekseer* 是一種能夠通過組合各種元件來製作特效的工具。 通過這種方式，我們擴大了製作範圍，您將得以盡情享受真正酷炫的 3D 粒子特效。 當然，您也可以使用 Effekseer 導入自己製作的 3D 粒子特效動畫。 以 .efkefc 格式保存在文件夾下的動畫資料，可以作為 Effekseer 項目資料使用，您可以在 Effekseer 中打開檔案來進行編輯。修改預設素材將變得更加簡單。 *Effekseer 是一個免費的開發工具，能夠為遊戲製作各種特效，包括爆炸特效和命中特效。製作出的特效可以輸出為 2D 動畫，也可以在遊戲中加載和複製為 3D 粒子特效。 ●RPG制作大師MV兼容的動畫編輯功能 在RPG制作大師MZ之前的單元格動畫可以通過從動畫上下文菜單中選擇 "MV兼容數據的創建"來設置。 插件 如果用戶有超出 RPG Maker 現有功能的需求或想法，希望製作更複雜的遊戲，可以使用插件功能來構建更加符合個人需求的作品。 在 RPG Maker MZ 中，我們加強了插件功能。 ● 優化插件指令 現在可以從下拉選單中選擇插件名稱和指令名稱。 ● 插件管理更加輕鬆 現在，您可以在插件註冊視窗中添加發行商的 URL，在選單上開啟/關閉 插件，並讀取顯示的插件警告消息。 玩遊戲 RPG Maker MZ 讓玩家玩遊戲時變得更加容易！ ● 增加自動存檔功能 我們添加了自動存檔欄位，以便與遊戲進度的存檔做區分。 ● 適合手機的 UI 改造 為了使遊戲適應手機平台，我們對 UI 進行了改進。 更新所增加的其他功能 ●子文件夾可以被引用 在audio,img,plugins下創建的子文件夾現在可以從編輯器中引用了。 這是材料管理的一個有用功能。 當存儲在子文件夾中時，一些插件可能會有不同的表現
detailed_descriptions.ja: 〇ツクールシリーズ最新作『RPGツクールMZ』 歴代のツクールシリーズのなかでも人気のRPGツクール。その最新作『RPGツクールMZ』がリリースしました！ 新機能の搭載や、これまでも皆様のゲーム制作で活躍していた機能の強化など、さらにパワーアップしたツクールとなっています。 マップエディタ RPGツクールのマップエディタで、絵を描くようにマップを制作をしましょう。 ツールに同梱されているマップチップ素材で多くの街やダンジョンをつくりだすことが可能です。 『RPGツクールMZ』ではマップエディタ機能が強化され、多くの新素材を同梱しています。 ●タイルサイズを「16」「24」「32」「48」から選択可能に タイルサイズとは1タイルの1辺の長さを指します（RPGツクールMV、MZは48サイズ）。 設定変更により、RPGツクールVX、VXAceのタイルセット（32サイズ）やオリジナル素材の導入が容易になりました。 ●レイヤー機能の追加！ RPGツクールXPまで採用されていたマップのレイヤー機能を追加しました！ 4段階のレイヤーを駆使することで、対象レイヤーを除いた編集や より複雑な構造を実現することも可能です。 また、レイヤー自動判定の機能もございますので『RPGツクールMV』と 同じように操作することもできます。 ●広範囲で操作できる影ペンの四角形モード 影ペンを選択時にShiftキーを押したままにすることで、広範囲を操作する四角形モードに切り替えることができます。 ●マップツリーの入れ替え可能 同じ階層にあるマップの並び順を入れ替えることができるようになりました。 キャラクター生成 ツールに同梱されている素材を組み合わせて、あなたのオリジナルキャラクターをゲームに登場させましょう。 素材の組み合わせだけではなくカラー変更も可能となるこの機能は無数のキャラクターパターンを生み出すことが可能です。 『RPGツクールMZ』ではキャラクター生成機能も強化されます。 ●パーツ位置調整が可能に！ キャラクター生成機能にオフセット機能が追加され、パーツの位置調整が できるようになりました。 ●カラーパレット追加可能！ 髪の毛の色や服の色を既存のカラーパレットだけではなく、 好きなカラーパレットを追加してさらにカスタマイズできるようになりました。 たっぷり同梱素材 主人公となるキャラクター素材やマップ制作用のマップチップ、キャラクタージェネレーター用素材がツールにたっぷり同梱されています。 『RPGツクールMZ』ではRPGツクール史上最大規模の素材を同梱！ ●音楽素材 BGM 48曲 / BGS 29曲 / ME 27曲 / SE 345曲 (いずれもogg形式ファイルのみ) ●画像素材 アニメーション 120 戦闘背景1 51 / 戦闘背景2 50 キャラクター 44 / 敵キャラクター 105 顔グラフィック 15 / バストアップ 120 / キャラクター全身 120 遠景 21 SV戦闘キャラ 40 / SV敵キャラ 105 システム 11 タイルセット 31 タイトル 20 ●サンプルマップデータ（dlc\RemakeMapResourcePackフォルダ） RPGツクールVXAceのサンプルマップデータ 117 RPGツクールMVのサンプルマップデータ 104 ※利用方法は同じフォルダのreadmeをご覧ください データベース RPGツクールでのゲーム制作に欠かせないデータベース機能。 データベース機能を利用することで、アクターや敵キャラクターのゲームバランス調整やテストを行ったり、職業・スキル・アイテム・武器等の細かな設定を行うことが可能です。 『RPGツクールMZ』ではデータベース機能の強化と拡張をおこなっています。 ●主要なデータベース項目の最大数を9999に アクター、職業、ステート、スキル、アイテム、武器、防具、敵キャラ、敵グループ、コモンイベントの最大数を9999まで設定できるようになりました。 アイテムが豊富なゲームなど、作りたいゲームを実現することができます。 ●タイルセット設定のコピー&ペースト 通行設定、通行（4方向）、梯子、茂み、カウンター、ダメージ床、地形タグの情報を他のタイルセットのページにコピー&ペーストできるようになりました。 これにより、タイルセットの差分パターンの設定が容易になりました。 ●戦闘システムの追加！ これまでの「フロントビューバトル」「サイドビューバトル」のシステムに加え、「タイムプログレスバトル」が搭載されました！ ターン制に新たな要素が加わることで戦闘の遊びの幅が広がります。 イベント RPGツクールではキャラクターの会話やマップ間の移動、宝箱の設置等をイベント機能を使って実現します。 多用するイベントは簡単設定が可能となっていたり、コピーして使うこともできます。 最も驚くのはイベントの設定にプログラミングの知識が不要であるということです。 数多く用意されているイベントパターンを組み合わせて、ゲームをよりおもしろくしましょう。 『RPGツクールMZ』では、イベント機能も強化されています。 ●ピクチャ（画像）の設定に、プレビュー画面から座標を指定する「簡単設定」を追加しました。 画像の設定が簡単・直感的に行えます。 ●お気に入りのマップに瞬時にアクセスする「クイックアクセスリスト」を追加しました。 頻繁に使うマップをすぐに探すことができます。 ● イベントモードに切り替えると、イベントリストが表示されるようにリスト上でイベントを選択すると、 マップ上の該当イベントが選択されます。また、リストから直接イベントエディタを開くことも可能です。 ●イベントコマンドの強化・拡張！ 文章表示の制御文字の追加や、ピクチャ移動設定の追加、 条件分岐時のボタンの状態判定の追加等、強化・拡張をおこないました。 ●指定範囲のイベントコマンドを無効化する「スキップの切り替え」 実行内容を選択した状態で、ショートカットキーのCtrl+/またはコンテキストメニュー［スキップの切り替え］操作により、 ［スキップ］を作成します。［スキップ］から［スキップ終了］の中に含まれるイベントコマンドは実行されないため、 バグの原因を探るときや、演出のテストに便利です。 ●移動ルート設定にプレビュー追加！ イベント設定時に移動ルートをプレビューで確認することができます。 アニメーション 戦闘シーンに華やかさや迫力を追加するエフェクト演出は、このアニメーション機能を使うことで実現することができます。 『RPGツクールMZ』ではアニメーション機能を刷新しました！ ●3D表現を強化したパーティクルアニメ―ション 様々なパーツを組み合わせることでエフェクトを制作できるツール「Effekseer」※によるファイルの使用を前提とした仕様に刷新しました。 これにより演出の幅が強化され、より豪華な「3Dパーティクルエフェクト」を楽しむことができます。 もちろん、 「Effekseer」を用いて自作した3Dパーティクルエフェクトアニメーションを取り込むことも可能です。 アニメーションデータの*.efkefcは「Effekseer」のプロジェクトデータになっており、「Effekseer」で開くことによりそのまま編集が可能ですので、 デフォルト素材の改変も簡単です。 ※「Effekseer」は、爆発演出やヒットエフェクトなどゲーム向けの様々なエフェクトを制作できるフリーでオープンソースなツールです。制作したエフェクトは2Dのアニメーションとして出力したり、3Dのパーティクルエフェクトとしてゲームに組み込んで再生できます。 ●RPGツクールMV互換のアニメーション編集機能 アニメーションのコンテキストメニューから「MV互換データの作成」を選択することでRPGツクールMZ以前のセルアニメーションが設定可能です。 プラグイン RPGツクールの既存機能では物足りない・・・よりハイレベルなゲームを作りたい・・・そんな人はプラグイン機能を使うことで、よりカスタマイズされたゲームを作成することができます。 『RPGツクールMZ』ではこのプラグイン機能をより強化しました。 ●プラグインコマンドの刷新 「プラグイン名」と「コマンド名」をプルダウンから選択できるようになりました。 ●管理のしやすさを強化！ プラグイン登録画面に配布元のURLを追加したり、リスト画面でON/OFFが 切り替えられるようになったり、プラグイン警告メッセージが表示されるようになりました。 ゲームプレイ 『RPGツクールMZ』ではユーザープレイがより快適になりました！ ●オートセーブ機能の追加 ゲームプレイのセールデータとは別にオートセーブの枠が追加されました。 ●スマートフォン向けUI改修 スマートフォンでのプレイをより快適にしていただくため、UIを改修しました。 その他アップデート ●サブフォルダが参照できるように audio,img,plugins配下に作成したサブフォルダをエディタから参照できるようになりました。素材の管理に便利な機能です。 detailed_descriptions.ko: 〇 RPG Maker 시리즈의 최신작: RPG Maker MZ 지금까지 게임 제작에서 핵심 역할을 한 기존 기능이 강화되고 거기에 새로운 기능이 추가되어 RPG Maker는 그 어느 때보다 더욱 강력해졌습니다! 맵 에디터 RPG Maker의 지도 에디터로 맵을 간편하게 제작할 수 있습니다. 사용하고 싶은 타일을 고르고 맵 위에 ‘칠하세요’. 기존 RPG Maker의 지도 에디터로부터 개선된 강력한 기능과 다양한 신규 타일 컬렉션으로 플레이어가 탐험할 수 있는 무수한 도시와 던전을 건설할 수 있습니다! ●타일 사이즈는 ‘16x16’, ‘24x24’, ‘32x32’, 그리고 ‘48x48’ 중에서 선택할 수 있습니다. 새로운 타일 해상도 옵션을 통해 RPG Maker VX와 VXAce 타일 세트(32x32), 그리고 커스텀 에셋을 사용할 수 있습니다. ● 레이어 기능의 부활! 이전 버전인 RPG Maker XP까지 있던 맵 레이어 기능이 다시 도입되었습니다. 4단계 레이어를 사용함으로써, 특정 레이어를 제외한 편집이나 보다 복잡한 구조를 구현할 수 있습니다. 또한 레이어를 자동으로 판단하는 기능도 포함하고 있어 RPG Maker MV와 같은 방식으로 맵을 처리할 수 있습니다. ●그림자 그리기 도구 직사각형 모드를 통한 광역 조작 그림자 그리기 도구 선택 시 Shift 키를 눌러 광역 조작이 가능한 직사각형 모드로 전환할 수 있습니다. ●맵 트리 재배열 가능 이제 같은 계층의 맵 정렬 순서를 바꿀 수 있습니다. 캐릭터 생성 이 툴에 포함된 리소스를 조합하여 자신만의 독창적인 캐릭터를 만들어보세요. 해당 기능을 사용하면 애셋을 조합하는 것 외에도 다양한 시각 패턴을 만들어 낼 수 있고 색상을 바꿀 수도 있습니다. RPG Maker MZ는 더욱 강력한 캐릭터 생성 기능을 제공합니다. ● 컴포넌트 배치 수정 캐릭터 생성 기능에 오프셋 기능이 추가되어 컴포넌트의 배치를 조정할 수 있습니다. ● 새로운 컬러 팔레트 추가 기존 컬러 팔레트보다 더 많은 색상이 팔레트에 추가되어 이제 머리와 옷 색 등을 커스터마이징할 수 있습니다. 어마어마한 양의 애셋 주인공을 위한 애셋부터 맵 생성에 사용되는 칩과 캐릭터 생성에 적용되는 리소스까지, 이 툴에는 방대한 데이터가 들어있습니다. RPG Maker MZ는 시리즈 역사상 가장 많은 애셋을 포함하고 있습니다! ● Graphics Animations: 120 Battle Background 1: 51 Battle Background 2: 50 Character Sprites Sheets: 44 Character SV Battlers: 40 Face Graphic Sheets: 15 Character Busts: 120 Character Full Art: 120 Enemy Battlers: 105 Enemy SV Battlers: 105 Tileset Sheets: 31 Parallaxes: 21 Title Screens: 20 ● Sound BGM : 48 BGS : 29 ME : 27 SE : 345 ●샘플 맵 데이터（dlc\RemakeMapResourcePack 폴더） RPG Maker VXAce 117 샘플 맵 데이터 RPG Maker MV 104 샘플 맵 데이터 *동일한 폴더의 readme에서 사용 설명을 확인할 수 있습니다 데이터베이스 RPG Maker로 게임을 제작할 때 데이터베이스는 핵심적인 역할을 합니다. 데이터베이스 기능을 사용하면 플레이어 캐릭터와 적에 관련된 게임 밸런스를 조정하고 테스트할 수 있으며 직업, 스킬, 아이템, 무기 등에 상세 설정을 적용할 수 있습니다. RPG Maker MZ의 데이터베이스 기능은 강화되고 확장되었습니다. ●주요 데이터베이스 항목의 최대 수를 9999로 변경 가능 액터, 직업, 스탯, 스킬, 아이템, 무기, 방어구, 적 캐릭터, 적 군단, 공통 이벤트의 최대 수를 9999로 설정할 수 있습니다. 이 기능으로 폭넓은 아이템을 포함한 게임과 같은 원하는 게임을 구현할 수 있습니다. ●타일셋 복사 붙여 넣기 설정 통행, 통행(4개 방향), 사다리, 수풀, 카운터, 피해입는 바닥, 지형 태그 설정을 다른 타일셋 페이지에 복사 및 붙여 넣기할 수 있습니다. 이 기능으로 대체 타일셋을 더 간편하게 설정할 수 있습니다. ●새로운 전투 시스템 추가! 기존에 제공된 프론트 뷰와 사이드 뷰 배틀 시스템뿐 아니라 새로운 시간 기반 배틀 시스템도 추가됐습니다! 턴제 기반 시스템에 새로운 요소를 추가하면서 전투의 폭이 넓어졌습니다. 테스트 플레이 RPG Maker는 게임 제작 중에도 동작 확인을 매우 쉽게 할 수 있는 테스트 플레이 기능을 갖추고 있습니다. 게임을 테스트하기 위해서 매번 다른 플랫폼에 설치할 필요가 없습니다. 이벤트 RPG 만들기에서는 이벤트 기능을 사용해서 캐릭터의 대화나 맵 간 이동, 보물 상자 배치 및 기타 시각물을 묘사할 수 있습니다. 자주 사용하는 이벤트를 쉽게 설정하고 자유롭게 복사해서 사용할 수 있습니다. 가장 놀라운 것은 이벤트 설정에 프로그래밍 지식이 필요 없다는 것입니다. 제공된 다양한 이벤트들을 조합하여 더욱더 재미있는 게임을 만들어보세요. RPG Maker MZ에서는 이벤트 기능이 보강되었습니다. ● 보다 강력하고 다양한 이벤트 커맨드! 문자 표시로 캐릭터를 조종하는 것을 포함해, 사진 이동 설정과 조건부 분기에 사용되는 버튼의 상태 결정 등의 기능이 추가되어 이벤트 커맨드가 강화되고 확장되었습니다. ● 이동 경로 설정을 위한 미리 보기 추가! 이벤트 설정 시 미리 보기를 통해서 이동 경로를 확인할 수 있습니다. 애니메이션 애니메이션 기능을 활용하면 전투 장면에 화려함과 박진감을 성공적으로 연출할 수 있습니다. RPG Maker MZ의 애니메이션 기능이 개편되었습니다! 다양한 컴포넌트를 조합해 각종 시각 효과를 만들 수 있는 Effekseer* 툴과 함께 사용하기에 적합한 사양으로 업그레이드되었습니다. 활용 가능한 연출의 폭이 강화되고 보다 화려한 3D 파티클 효과를 표현할 수 있습니다. 물론 Effekseer로 제작한 3D 효과를 불러올 수도 있습니다. .efkefc확장자로 저장된 애니메이션 데이터는 Effekseer 프로젝트 데이터로 사용할 수 있으며 Effekseer에서 불러와 바로 수정할 수 있습니다. 기본 애셋도 동일한 방법으로 수정할 수 있습니다. * Effekseer는 폭발 효과와 타격 효과 등 게임 전용 여러 효과를 제작할 수 있는 무료 오픈 소스 툴입니다. 제작한 효과는 2D 애니메이션으로 출력하거나 3D 파티클 효과로 게임에 이식 및 재생산할 수 있습니 플러그인 RPG Maker에서 제공하는 기능이 부족하다고 느껴지시거나 좀 더 높은 수준의 게임을 제작하고 싶으신가요? 플러그인 기능을 활용하여 더욱더 커스터마이징된 게임을 제작하실 수 있습니다. RPG MakerMZ에서는 플러그인 기능이 더욱 강화되었습니다. ● 변경된 플러그인 커맨드 이제 드롭다운 메뉴에서 플러그인 이름과 명령 이름을 선택할 수 있습니다. ● 더욱 편리한 플러그인 관리 이제 플러그인 등록 화면에서 배포자의 URL을 추가하거나 목록 화면에서 플러그인을 ON/OFF하거나 표시된 플러그인 경고 메시지를 확인할 수 있습니다. 게임 플레이 RPG Maker MZ MZ에서는 더 쾌적하게 플레이하실 수 있습니다! ● 자동 저장 기능 추가 기존의 세이브 데이터와는 별도의 자동 저장 공간이 추가되었습니다. ● 스마트폰용 UI 개선 스마트 폰에서 더 편리하게 플레이하실 수 있도록 UI를 개선했습니다. 기타 업데이트된 기능 ●하위 폴더 에셋 체계화 에디터에서 오디오, 이미지, 플러그인에 생성된 하위 폴더를 참조할 수 있습니다. 재료 관리에 유용한 기능입니다. *일부 플러그인은 하위 폴더에 저장 시 다르게 작동할 수 있습니다

games.name: RuneScape: Dragonwilds
games.short_description: On RuneScape's forgotten continent of Ashenfall, dragons have awoken. Gather, build, skill and craft in this co-operative survival adventure. Only by mastering survival and uncovering ancient secrets can you hope to face the ferocious Dragon Queen.

descriptions.en: On RuneScape's forgotten continent of Ashenfall, dragons have awoken. Gather, build, skill and craft in this co-operative survival adventure. Only by mastering survival and uncovering ancient secrets can you hope to face the ferocious Dragon Queen.

detailed_descriptions.en: Embark on quests, level your skills and explore a beautiful hand-crafted world. This all-new adventure blends high-fantasy and iconic RuneScape lore on a brand new continent. RPG systems reward you with unique abilities and spells as you progress through each skill. Battle legendary RuneScape creatures like Zogres, challenge Black Knights and the entirely new and fearsome Garou, all set to a sweeping soundtrack of reorchestrated RuneScape classics and hours of brand new music. Locate them, throw down the gauntlet and carve your path to the Dragon Queen herself. Your progress will be under constant threat from the looming shadow of the Dragons, as you arm yourself and prepare to rise to face them. Follow the trail of destruction and uncover the mysteries of the continent to learn not just how to confront the dragons, but how to overcome them. Prepare potions, craft gear and push yourself to do battle with the most powerful force on the continent. The smart money's on the dragon. But we do love an underdog! Summon a spectral axe to fell trees in an instant! Blink away from danger in a cloud of magic. Turn bones into... peaches? The Anima-rich landscape of Ashenfall offers you a power unlike any other. Conjure a tornado of fish from a lake! Explode ore veins with a snap of your fingers! Journey through the vibrant regions of Ashenfall, discover why wild magic spills from the fractured lands and harness that power to survive! Like all RuneScape games, community is at the heart of everything we do. We've shaped our entire roadmap based on player feedback, leading us to launch dedicated servers earlier than planned, introduce new combat and new quest content. Working together we're continuing to develop RuneScape: Dragonwilds. Whether you're adventuring with friends or going it alone, every opinion matters, and it's up to you to help us shape the future of our game. RuneScape: Dragonwilds started Alpha testing in late 2024, and is launching into Early Access in Spring 2025. From here, our humble team of heroes is developing the project with player feedback at the very core. This Steam Early Access game is currently not a finished game and may or may not change significantly over the course of development. To learn more about Steam Early Access, please visit the Steam Early Access FAQs.

games.name: Sandustry
games.short_description: Explore and mine fully destructible worlds. Automate increasingly complex production chains. Delve deep to uncover an ancient civilization’s powerful secrets and learn to love the sand in this factory game where every pixel is a valuable resource.

descriptions.en: Explore and mine fully destructible worlds. Automate increasingly complex production chains. Delve deep to uncover an ancient civilization’s powerful secrets and learn to love the sand in this factory game where every pixel is a valuable resource.

detailed_descriptions.en: Sandustry is a factory automation game where every pixel is a resource waiting to be mined, mixed, processed, or destroyed. Explore a vast and fully-destructible open world as you seek out powerful artifacts left behind by an ancient civilization. You’ve arrived on a vast unexplored planet filled with diverse biomes and beautiful landscapes – time to bring the fires of industry! From humble beginnings sifting gold from sand, you will quickly build a growing factory, unlocking powerful new technologies and production chains as you assess the viability of the planet for further industrialization. Countless options lie before you – will you focus on developing more advanced processing and logistical capabilities across your rapidly-expanding factory? Will you take advantage of local wildlife to aid with your mission? Or will you prioritize the hunt for artifacts, spending valuable resources to unlock access to their boons? And hey, there’s no faster way to mine than with the help of a rocket launcher, right? Build a beacon of industry and automation starting with nothing more than the trusty conveyor belt, incorporating filters, drones, pipes, pumps, and a myriad of other parts as you harness nature itself to do your bidding. From individual grains of sand and flakes of snow to seeds, spores, and chips of ice, every pixel in Sandustry is a physical entity with its own properties. Discover countless chemical and physical reactions and exploit them to develop your production chains, building a pixel-perfect factory to optimize every step, or embracing chaotic webworks of conveyor belts and lifts as long as they get the job done – but be warned, sand is coarse, rough, and it gets everywhere, which introduces a new layer of complexity. The resources in Sandustry react to each other and the world around them – ice melts into water when heated, which turns to steam and rises if brought to a boil (only to come back down as rain if you let it reach the skies). Sand absorbs water around it, slowly depleting limited reservoirs to provide the wet sand that can be sifted for gold, while watered seeds bloom into flowers that can be ignited with fire to produce vital resources. Deep beneath the planet’s surface lie countless mysteries for you to explore. Find clever ways to overcome the challenges left behind by an ancient civilization to uncover vaults of great knowledge and power. Nothing punches through a thick wall of ice like a freshly purchased flamethrower, but perhaps you can find a way to redirect some lava instead? Built with modding in mind, Sandustry lets you explore everything from visual tweaks and hand-crafted maps to entirely new buildings and processes that you can integrate into your production chains. Dedicated modding tools make it easy to customize your experience, share your ideas with the world, and even overhaul the whole game! As you delve deeper into the planets of Sandustry and expand your industrial capabilities, the challenges will grow, but so too will your ways to overcome them. With fully destructible worlds where every pixel is a resource to be harnessed, your options are limitless.

Or will you prioritize the hunt for artifacts, spending valuable resources to unlock access to their boons? And hey, there’s no faster way to mine than with the help of a rocket launcher, right? Build a beacon of industry and automation starting with nothing more than the trusty conveyor belt, incorporating filters, drones, pipes, pumps, and a myriad of other parts as you harness nature itself to do your bidding.

From individual grains of sand and flakes of snow to seeds, spores, and chips of ice, every pixel in Sandustry is a physical entity with its own properties. Discover countless chemical and physical reactions and exploit them to develop your production chains, building a pixel-perfect factory to optimize every step, or embracing chaotic webworks of conveyor belts and lifts as long as they get the job done – but be warned, sand is coarse, rough, and it gets everywhere, which introduces a new layer of complexity. The resources in Sandustry react to each other and the world around them – ice melts into water when heated, which turns to steam and rises if brought to a boil (only to come back down as rain if you let it reach the skies). Sand absorbs water around it, slowly depleting limited reservoirs to provide the wet sand that can be sifted for gold, while watered seeds bloom into flowers that can be ignited with fire to produce vital resources.

Deep beneath the planet’s surface lie countless mysteries for you to explore. Find clever ways to overcome the challenges left behind by an ancient civilization to uncover vaults of great knowledge and power. Nothing punches through a thick wall of ice like a freshly purchased flamethrower, but perhaps you can find a way to redirect some lava instead? 

Built with modding in mind, Sandustry lets you explore everything from visual tweaks and hand-crafted maps to entirely new buildings and processes that you can integrate into your production chains. Dedicated modding tools make it easy to customize your experience, share your ideas with the world, and even overhaul the whole game!

As you delve deeper into the planets of Sandustry and expand your industrial capabilities, the challenges will grow, but so too will your ways to overcome them. With fully destructible worlds where every pixel is a resource to be harnessed, your options are limitless.

games.name: SCUM
games.short_description: Welcome to SCUM, a ruthless open-world survival game where deep character customization defines the prisoner you become. Loot, craft, hunt, build, and fight to outlast a hostile island where every choice can change your fate. Stay alive. Stay dangerous. Become harder to kill.

descriptions.en: Welcome to SCUM, a ruthless open-world survival game where deep character customization defines the prisoner you become. Loot, craft, hunt, build, and fight to outlast a hostile island where every choice can change your fate. Stay alive. Stay dangerous. Become harder to kill.

detailed_descriptions.en: Welcome to SCUM, a ruthless open-world survival game where prisoners are dropped onto a vast, hostile island and forced to survive by any means necessary. Every decision shapes who you become and how long you last. Scavenge, loot, craft, hunt, build and fight for every advantage as you adapt to a world that wants you dead. Stay alive. Stay dangerous. Become something harder to kill. A Survival Game With Teeth SCUM is built on deep, interconnected survival systems that give every choice weight. Your health, survival skills, metabolism, and fatigue are all shaped by an intricate progression system that defines how long you last. But you’re not alone out here. Former contestants re-animated as Puppets shamble across the land, mutated experiments twisted into monsters lurk in the dark, and every other player has the same goal as you: Survive long enough to leave a mark. Risk-taking, high-stakes and tragedy all make for a great show. In SCUM your actions directly shape how you are perceived through the world’s reputation system. Team-up or go it alone. SCUM gives you the systems, what you do with them is up to you. The Island You're trapped on a vast and dangerous island built for opportunity and discovery, so scavenge what you need and craft what you don’t have. SCUM’s 225㎢ map is inspired by all aspects of Croatian territory. Sprawling across beautiful Adriatic coastline, lush forests and harsh freezing mountain sides. Explore high-security military zones and hidden corners of the island, all offering something worth claiming or something worth fearing. The prisoners who look beyond the next meal may begin to understand what’s really going on here, if they live long enough. If you can survive here, you can survive anywhere. Do you have what it takes? Key Features Massive open world with diverse and dangerous environments Deep character customization, metabolism and survival simulation systems Complex crafting, looting and base building PvP and PvE with no fixed progression path Persistent character development and skill growth A live-broadcast survival premise with real attitude Ongoing development with expanding systems and world depth

games.name: Sengoku Dynasty
games.short_description: Sengoku Dynasty is the ultimate feudal Japan experience: build villages, grow your community, and shape the open world through combat or economy. The choice is yours alone - or that of up to 4 players in multiplayer co-op!

detailed_descriptions.en: Build a life, cultivate your community and start a dynasty in a region once devastated by famine and war. Play solo or in co-op multiplayer and explore a beautiful open world. Gather resources, craft, hunt and build, then automate your village production to survive and grow. Become a great leader either through combat or by building your economy. Experience the beauty of nature and take part in ancient rituals to uncover the mysteries of the divine. Sengoku Dynasty offers an immersive insight to life in medieval Japan: Choose your path as a Leader, Craftsman, Warrior, or Monk and embark on an epic journey. OPEN WORLD VILLAGE BUILDER Take full advantage of the vast world. Begin with a single house, build workshops, forges, taverns and then expand your settlements into multiple flourishing communities throughout the valley. BECOME A TRUE DAIMYO Unify the war-torn land of Nata Valley. Rogue Samurai and bandit clans have filled the power vacuum and threaten the existence of your peaceful villagers. Liberate new territories and repair infrastructure to explore areas rich in vital resources and open the door to even greater challenges. FROM HANDCRAFTING TO AUTOMATION Craft tools, weapons, meals or medicine, and cultivate the land. Then learn how to give jobs and tools to your villagers and see your economy and choices grow exponentially. MASTER AN INTRICATE COMBAT SYSTEM Skill or grind – it’s up to you: Choose your favorite weapon from sticks and spears to masterfully crafted Katanas (swords) and Yumi (bows). By mastering combos, dashes, blocks and parries you can conquer the world. DYNASTY MANAGEMENT Create a prosperous dynasty for generations to come. Oversee the growth and development of your villages. Get married and ensure your legacy continues through your successor. PLAY SOLO AND CO-OP Forge your own path or join forces with your friends to create bigger villages, divide responsibilities and tasks, gather more resources and complete quests and progress together. CUSTOMIZE EVERYTHING Enjoy Sengoku period the way you like. With different game modes and tons of settings, you can optimize the game for yourself – build with one click or disable the whole combat system if you like!

games.name: Shadows of Doubt
games.short_description: Take on the role of a private investigator in this immersive detective simulator. Solve murders and other crimes in a procedurally generated and persistent city where every NPC lives and breathes their own independent lives. Find the killer quickly… or they will kill again!

descriptions.en: Take on the role of a private investigator in this immersive detective simulator. Solve murders and other crimes in a procedurally generated and persistent city where every NPC lives and breathes their own independent lives. Find the killer quickly… or they will kill again!

detailed_descriptions.en: A procedurally-generated sandbox stealth game with a whole city of secrets at your fingertips! Shadows of Doubt is set in an alternate reality in the hyper-industrialized 1980s. Think like a detective and use a variety of gadgets as a private intelligence investigator, gathering evidence and making money by solving cases, finding and selling information and more. Play your own way in a fully simulated world with hundreds of citizens. Discover, meet and tail individual citizens, each with their own name, job, apartment and daily routine, in unique, procedurally-generated cities. Each case has different culprits, clues and experiences for you to test your investigative skills. Explore anywhere in the city! Every nook of every trashy bar, every place of work, every seedy hotel room… This dystopia is your oyster. Break into apartments, rifle through secret documents or hack security systems - even a discarded receipt can be the key to cracking a case. Trace the receipt back to an individual location, scour CCTV footage and match the time up to the receipt to find out who it belonged to! The entire world is fully simulated . Each citizen has an apartment, job, daily routine, favorite things to do, places to go, and people to interact with. They live out their lives independently, in a world that moves on with or without you— uncover this knowledge and use it to your advantage! Become a private investigator in a truly unique detective experience. Think like a detective to solve the cases around you: check call histories, find passwords, read private emails, speak to persons of interest, watch CCTV footage and more to retrieve evidence and build your case. Store information on your investigation board and link evidence together as you piece together the ful picture. Features Become a private investigator and track down a serial killer in a fully-simulated sci-fi city. Think like a detective and use a variety of gadgets to gather evidence and solve cases in this truly unique detective experience. Meet individual citizens, each with their own name, job, apartment and daily routine, in unique, procedurally-generated cities. Take on new cases to earn cash, purchase new gadgets and equipment, and customise your apartment. Gather evidence to build your case - scan fingerprints, check call histories, read private emails, watch CCTV, and find key pieces of evidence to gather information and accuse your suspect. Play your own way - pick locks, break down doors, sabotage security systems and bribe citizens for information, or stick to the law and play by the book. There are multiple ways to approach each case. Explore every room in every building, and talk to every citizen. Lose yourself in a detailed sci-fi noir world.

descriptions.ko: 시대를 진보 또는 존속시키는 지도자가 되어 제국을 이끌어 보세요. 시드 마이어의 문명® VII에서 여러분의 신념을 실현하세요.

detailed_descriptions.en: Will your civilization evolve with the Ages or stand the Test of Time? In Sid Meier's Civilization® VII , every strategic decision shapes your empire's unique lineage. Rule as legendary leaders from throughout history and strive for unique victories by choosing how your civilization changes or persists across each Age of human advancement. Grow your territory with new Settlements and architectural Wonders, spur advancement with technological breakthroughs, and conquer or cooperate with your competition as you explore and expand into the world's far, unknown reaches. Pursue prosperity in an immersive solo experience or play with others in online multiplayer.* Whether you follow a path rooted in history or chart your own way forward, build something you believe in with Civilization VII . EVOLVE WITH EACH AGE OR STAND THE TEST OF TIME Lead your empire through distinct Ages of human history. Across the Antiquity, Exploration, and Modern Ages, choose whether to lead one Time-Tested civilization from start to finish, have it strategically evolve to flourish with a new identity in the next Age, or split the difference through hybridization. As accomplishing scientific, cultural, militaristic, and economic milestones within each Age unlocks advantages in the next, you'll decide how and when your empire's identity and strategy develop. CHART YOUR OWN PATH TO VICTORY Shape your empire's unique story by pursuing a wide range of distinct Triumphs, attribute-based objectives that offer a player-driven experience. As each new Age expands the game's scope, it also brings opportunities to borrow elements from other civs, unlock new bonuses, and achieve Victory in myriad new and exciting ways. Order Commanders to move armies as one, engage enemies with revamped combat mechanics, equip swappable leader bonuses across campaigns with Mementos, and much more. PLAY AS VISIONARY LEADERS OF PROGRESS Embody illustrious leaders with one of Civilization's most diverse rosters yet, from traditional heads of state known for militaristic might or political prowess to visionaries who made lasting impacts on philosophy, science, human rights, and more. Your chosen leader will endure across the Ages, with a unique ability that can help reinforce or pivot your strategy from one Age into the next. For the first time in franchise history, leader selection is separate from your civilization, giving you the freedom to create all-new strategies by mixing and matching gameplay bonuses. EXPLORE A WORLD VIVIDLY BROUGHT TO LIFE Make your mark on a gorgeously detailed world! Your empire comes to life with a diverse range of cultural styles, represented across building architecture and Unit design. Traverse navigable rivers, explore the map's undiscovered reaches, and extend your borders with new Cities or specialized Towns. As your lavishly rendered territory expands, all of your scenic vistas, vibrant metropolises, and fledgling frontier territories will connect seamlessly across the ever-changing landscape. TEST YOUR STRATEGIC METTLE IN MULTIPLAYER Compete against other players online and prove your prowess as a great leader.* Multiplayer matches can be epic multi-Age campaigns or take place in a single Age, and cross-play is supported between PC and consoles, so you can play together with friends wherever they are. *Online play and features (including progression bonuses) require an Internet connection and 2K Account (minimum age varies). Up to five players supported in the Antiquity & Exploration Ages. Up to eight players supported in the Modern Age. Map size restrictions may apply to certain cross-play multiplayer games. Terms apply.
detailed_descriptions.zh-Hant: 你的文明將隨時代演進而昇華，還是能經得起時間的考驗？ 在《席德·梅爾的文明帝國®VII》中，你的每一個策略決策都將形塑帝國獨一無二的傳承脈絡。化身歷史上赫赫有名的傳奇領袖，在人類文明進步的各個時代中，選擇讓你的文明更迭蛻變或持之以恆，藉此開創偉業，追求獨一無二的勝利。 透過建立新聚落與修築建築奇觀來擴張疆域；藉由技術突破催化文明進步。當你探索並向世界遙遠未知的角落擴張時，你可以選擇征服競爭對手，亦或是與之攜手合作。你可以沉浸在引人入勝的單人體驗中追求繁榮，也能在線上多人模式中與他人同場競技。* 無論是遵循歷史足跡，還是開闢屬於自己的前進道路，都可以在《文明帝國VII》中實踐你的信念。 隨時代更迭演進，或禁得起時間考驗 帶領你的帝國跨越人類歷史中各個獨特的時代。在「古典時代」、「探索時代」與「現代」中，你可以選擇始終如一地領導同一個禁得起時間考驗的文明；或是採取策略性演進，在進入下一時代時換上新身分以獲取繁榮；亦或是融合兩者特點進行混搭。隨著你在各個時代達成科學、文化、軍事和經濟里程碑，將能解鎖下一時代的優勢。你的帝國身分與策略該如何發展、何時發展，全由你一手掌握。 開闢屬於你的勝利之路 透過追求多樣化的「凱旋挑戰」來編織帝國的獨特故事，這些基於屬性的目標將提供由玩家主導的遊戲體驗。隨著每個新時代擴展遊戲範疇，你也將獲得借鑒其他文明元素、解鎖新加成，並以無數新穎有趣的方式奪取勝利的機會。你可以指派「指揮官」統一調度大軍移動、利用翻新的戰鬥機制與敵人交戰、透過「紀念物」在不同戰役中裝備可更換的領袖加成，以及體驗更多豐富內容。 化身為推動進步的高瞻遠矚領袖 本作帶來《文明帝國》系列史上最豐富多樣的領袖陣容，無論是以軍事長才或政治手腕揚名的傳統國家元首，還是在哲學、科學、人權等方面留下深遠影響的夢想家領導者，眾多優秀人選任你挑選！你選擇的領袖將跨越時代長存，其獨特能力可幫助你加固現有策略，或是在進入下個時代時進行轉型。此外，這也是系列史上首次將領袖選擇與文明脫鉤，讓你能自由地透過混搭遊戲加成，創造出全新的策略組合。 探索栩栩如生的鮮活世界 在鉅細靡遺的遊戲世界中留下你的印記！展現豐富多樣文化風格的建築結構和單位設計，讓你的帝國充滿生氣。你可以穿越可航行的河流，探索地圖上的未知疆域，並透過建立新「城市」或專業化「城鎮」來擴張國境。隨著你精心規劃的領土不斷擴張，壯麗的自然景觀、活力四射的大都會以及新興的邊境領土，都將在不斷變化的地貌上無縫銜接。 考驗你策略實力的多人模式 對抗其他線上玩家，證明你有實力成為偉大領袖。*多人對戰可以是橫跨數個時代的史詩戰役，也可以只限單一時代，並且支援PC與主機間的跨平台遊玩，讓你可以和任何平台上的朋友一起遊戲。 *線上遊玩和相關功能（包括進度加成）需有網際網路連線和2K帳號（最低年齡限制視情況而異）。古典時代及探索時代最多支援五名玩家。現代最多支援八名玩家。特定跨平台多人遊戲可能會有地圖尺寸限制。需遵守適用條款。
detailed_descriptions.ja: あなたの文明は時代とともに進化を遂げるか、それとも時の試練に耐え抜くことができるでしょうか？ 『シドマイヤーズ シヴィライゼーション® VII』では、あなたの戦略次第で国家の独自の文化を生み出します。 歴史に名を残す伝説的な指導者の一人となって国家を導き、文明をどのように変化させるか選択して、固有の勝利を目指すか、歴史の物語を作り上げましょう。 新たな居住地や世界遺産の建造で領土を拡大し、技術革新で進歩を促しましょう。そして、遥か遠くの世界の未知の領域を探索・拡張しながら、競合する国を征服するか、それとも協力するかを選びましょう。没入感のあるソロプレイで繁栄を追い求めたり、オンラインで他のプレイヤーとマルチプレイで競合したり、様々な遊び方でゲームを楽しむことができます。* 史実に根ざした道を進むか、自ら新たな道を切り拓くか。『シヴィライゼーション VII』で、あなたが信じるものを築き上げましょう。 時代とともに進化するか、時の試練に耐え抜くか 人類史の様々な「時代」を通して、自らの国家を導こう。古代、探検の時代、現代にわたり、1つの文明を最初から最後まで導くか、戦略的に進化させて次の時代に新たなアイデンティティを確立するか、あるいはハイブリッド化によってその中間を目指すかを選択できます。各時代で科学、文化、軍事、経済のマイルストーンを達成すると、次の時代では優位に立つことができます。国家のアイデンティティと戦略をいつ、どのように発展させるかは、プレイヤー次第です。 勝利への道を自ら切り拓く プレイヤー主導の体験をもたらす属性ベースの目標やさまざまな「成功」を追求し、国家の独自のストーリーを構築しましょう。新しい時代を迎えるとゲームの規模は更に大きくなり、他の文明の要素の取り込みや、新しいボーナスの解除、無数の新しく刺激的な方法で勝利を達成するチャンスがもたらされます。司令官に命じて軍隊を一体として指揮できる他、刷新された戦闘メカニズムによる敵との交戦、遠征を通じて付け替え可能な指導者ボーナス「記念品」の装備といった、楽しみ方は多岐にわたります。 先見の明がある指導者になる！ 指導者のラインナップは 「シドマイヤーズ シヴィライゼーション」史上最多。強大な軍事力や政治力を誇る伝統的な国家元首から、哲学や科学、人権などで後世まで影響を残した先進的な指導者までそろっています。お好みの指導者を選んで輝かしい功績を残しましょう。選択した指導者は時代を超えて存続し、その固有のアビリティは、ある時代から次の時代へと戦略を強化したり転換したりするのに シリーズ史上初、文明と切り離して指導者を選択できるようになったことで、異なるボーナスを組み合わせて、かつてない戦略を練る自由が生まれました。 リアルに表現された世界を探索せよ！ リアルに作り込まれた世界で歴史を切り拓きましょう！建築物やユニットに多様な文化のスタイルが反映され、国家の描写がさらにリアルになりました。 航行可能な河川を渡って、マップの未踏の地を探索し、新たな都市や専業化された町で領土を拡大しましょう。美しく描写された領土が拡大するにつれ、美しい景色、活気ある大都市、そして誕生したばかりのフロンティアが、絶えず変化する風景の中でシームレスにつながっていきます。 マルチプレイで戦略力を試そう！ オンラインで他のプレイヤーと対戦し、偉大なる指導者としての力を知らしめましょう。* マルチプレイヤーマッチでは、複数の時代にまたがり大規模にキャンペーンを開催することも、単一の時代で行うことも可能です。PCとコンソールのクロスプレイにも対応しているので、どこにいても友達と一緒につながりながらプレイすることができます。 *オンラインプレイと機能（進行ボーナスを含む）には、インターネット接続と2Kアカウント（対象年齢は地域により異なります）が必要です。 「古代」および「探検の時代」では、最大5人のプレイヤーに対応します。「現代」では、最大8人のプレイヤーに対応します。特定のクロスプレイのマルチプレイヤーゲームでは、マップサイズに制限が適用される場合があります。 利用規約が適用されます。
detailed_descriptions.ko: 문명은 시대와 함께 발전하는가, 아니면 시간의 시험 속에서 존속하는가? 시드 마이어의 문명® VII 에서는 모든 전략적 결정이 제국의 고유한 혈통을 결정짓습니다. 역사 속 전설적인 지도자가 되어 나라를 통치하고, 인류의 진보를 이룩한 각 시대에서 문명을 어떻게 바꾸고 지속시킬지를 선택하여 여러분만의 특별한 승리를 쟁취해 보세요. 새로운 정착지와 경이로운 건축물을 건설하여 영토를 확장하고, 기술 혁신을 통해 문명 발전을 이룩해 보세요. 미지의 땅을 탐험하고 영역을 확장해 나가는 과정에서 경쟁자들과 협력하거나 그들을 정복하세요. 몰입도 높은 싱글 플레이 또는 다른 사람들과 함께 하는 온라인 멀티플레이를 통해 문명의 번영을 향해 나아가 보세요. * 역사에 근거한 길을 따르든 자신만의 새로운 길을 개척하든, 문명 VII 을 통해 여러분만의 가치를 직접 실현해 보세요. 시대에 따라 진보하거나, 혹은 시간의 시험을 견뎌내거나 인류 역사를 장식한 각 시대를 거치며 여러분만의 제국을 통치해 보세요. 고대 시대를 거쳐 대항해 시대와 근대 시대까지, 시간의 시험을 이겨낸 하나의 문명을 처음부터 끝까지 이끌지, 다음 시대에 새로운 정체성으로 번영할 수 있도록 전략적으로 진보시킬지, 아니면 이 둘을 합친 절충안을 찾을지는 여러분의 선택에 달려 있습니다. 각 시대에서 과학, 문화, 군사, 경제 부문의 이정표를 달성하면 잠겨 있던 다음 시대의 어드밴티지가 열리므로, 제국의 정체성과 전략이 나아가는 방식과 시기를 결정할 수 있게 됩니다. 승리를 향한 여러분만의 길을 개척해 가세요 개별 플레이어에 기반한 경험을 제공하는 속성 기반 목표로써 여러 유형의 대성공을 추진해 나가면서 여러분이 통치하는 제국만의 특별한 이야기를 만들어 보세요. 각각의 새로운 시대가 열리면서 게임 범위가 확장되면 이를 통해 다른 문명의 요소를 도입하고 잠겨 있던 새로운 보너스 획득 기회를 얻을 수 있으며, 수많은 새롭고 흥미로운 방법으로 승리할 기회도 열립니다. 사령관들에게 명령하여 각 군대를 하나로 모아 움직이도록 하고, 새로운 전투 시스템으로 적과 교전하며, 기념물을 통해 캠페인 전반에 교체 가능한 지도자 보너스를 장착하는 등의 활동을 추진해 보세요. 진보를 향해 나아가는 선구적인 지도자가 되어 보세요 군사력이나 정치력으로 이름을 알린 보수적인 국가 원수부터 철학, 과학, 인권 등의 분야에서 시대를 초월한 영향을 끼친 선구자까지 문명 역사상 가장 다채로운 사람들 중 한명과 함께 저명한 지도자로서 활약해 보세요. 여러분이 선택한 지도자는 시대가 바뀌어도 유지되며, 한 시대에서 다음 시대로 넘어갈 때 전략을 강화하거나 전환하는 데 필요한 고유의 능력을 갖추게 됩니다. 시리즈 출시 이래 처음으로 문명과 지도자를 각각 따로 선택할 수 있게 되어, 이제 게임플레이 보너스 조합을 통해 완전히 새로운 전략을 자유롭게 구상할 수 있게 되었습니다. 실제처럼 생동감 넘치는 세계를 탐험하세요 놀라울 정도로 섬세하게 구현된 세상에 여러분의 발자취를 남겨 보세요! 여러분의 제국은 다채로운 건축 양식과 유닛 디자인으로 방대하고 다양한 문화적 양식을 뽐내며 마치 실제처럼 생생하게 구현됩니다. 항해 가능한 강을 횡단하고, 지도에서도 찾을 수 없는 미지의 땅을 탐험하고, 새로운 도시나 특화 마을로 국경을 확장하세요. 여러분의 풍요로운 영토가 확장되면, 모든 아름다운 경관, 활기찬 대도시, 새로운 개척지가 변화무쌍한 풍경 속에서 자연스럽게 연결됩니다. 멀티플레이를 통해 여러분의 전략적 결단력을 시험해 보세요 온라인에서 다른 플레이어와의 경쟁을 통해 훌륭한 리더로서의 자질을 증명하세요. * 멀티플레이 매치는 여러 시대를 관통하는 장대한 캠페인으로 진행할 수도 있고 하나의 시대에서만 진행할 수도 있습니다. 이외에 PC와 콘솔을 넘나드는 크로스 플레이도 가능하므로 어디서든 친구들과 함께 게임을 즐기실 수 있습니다. *온라인 플레이 및 기능(진척도 보너스 포함)을 이용하려면 인터넷 연결과 2K 계정(최소 연령은 달라질 수 있음)이 필요합니다. 고대 시대와 대항해 시대에서는 최대 5명의 플레이어까지 지원됩니다. '근대 시대'에서는 최대 8명의 플레이어까지 지원됩니다. 일부 크로스플레이 멀티플레이 게임에는 지도 크기 제한이 적용될 수 있습니다. 약관이 적용됩니다.
