games.name: American Truck Simulator - Texas
games.short_description: Get your lasso ready and embark on your Texas-sized adventure. Hope y'all will like your visit to the Lone Star State.

descriptions.en: Get your lasso ready and embark on your Texas-sized adventure. Hope y'all will like your visit to the Lone Star State.
descriptions.zh-Hant: 嗨，得克萨斯州！为孤星之州准备好你的“套索”，将它添加至愿望单。这也许不是你的第一次牛仔竞技。
descriptions.ja: 投げ縄を用意して、テキサス規模の冒険に出かけましょう。ローンスター州への訪問を楽しんでいただけることを願っています。
descriptions.ko: 올가미를 준비하고 텍사스 크기의 모험을 시작하세요. 여러분이 론스타주를 방문하는 것을 좋아하시기를 바랍니다.

detailed_descriptions.en: Howdy, partners! Hope y'all will like your visit to the Lone Star State, Texas. This place ain't full of cowboys anymore but the spirit lives on, especially in ranches you can find all 'round. We also got a lot of cattle and other livestock so your truckin' adventures will be lively . Texas has a lot to offer, as our biggest map DLC for American Truck Simulator, it'll take you a while to see it all. In fact, we recommend you take your time to explore the lone star state which features: Discover 30 explorable cities including Dallas, Fort Worth, Houston, Austin, San Antonio, El Paso & Galveston. Enjoy trucking through 50 scenic towns (settlements) Drive across 20,000 miles of the states road network Deliver to over 200 realistic industry depots including industries unique to Texas state (Offshore Shipyard, Cotton Ginning Plant, Glass Plant & Space Industries) Visit and see famous Landmarks including Starbay, El Capitan, Route 66, USS Lexington, Corpus Christi bridge, and the Salt Flats. Fuel up & rest in 60 unique truck stops and 30 dedicated rest areas Get your lasso ready and embark on your Texas-sized adventure. This probably ain’t your first rodeo, right, partner?
detailed_descriptions.zh-Hant: 嗨，伙计！希望你喜欢在孤星之州——得克萨斯州的旅程。这里虽不再遍布牛仔，但他们的精神犹存，特别是当你在牧场上就会发现。这儿还有许多牛和其他牲畜，因此你们的货运探险之旅将会生动有趣。 我们还热爱音乐。真的，真的热爱音乐。看看奥斯汀，那里正是世界现场音乐之都。派对开始了。看看远处，你会发现有着相关信息的城市。没错，我们说的就是休斯敦。尽情享受你的旅程吧。 准备好你的“套索”，关注我们并将得克萨斯州添加至愿望单，抓住所有的最新消息吧。这也许不是你的第一次牛仔竞技。
detailed_descriptions.ja: こんにちは、パートナーの皆さん! ローンスター州テキサスへの訪問が皆さんにとって楽しいものになることを祈っています。この場所にはもうカウボーイはいませんが、その精神は生き続けています。特に、周囲にある牧場にはその精神が息づいています。牛やその他の家畜もたくさんいるので、トラック運転の冒険は活気に満ちています。 テキサスには見どころがたくさんあります。American Truck Simulator の最大のマップ DLC なので、すべてを見るにはしばらく時間がかかります。実際、ローンスター州をゆっくりと探索することをおすすめします。特徴は次のとおりです。 ダラス、フォートワース、ヒューストン、オースティン、サンアントニオ、エルパソ、ガルベストンを含む 30 の探索可能な都市を発見してください。 50 の風光明媚な町 (集落) でのトラック運転を楽しむ 州の道路網 32,000 キロをドライブ テキサス州特有の産業 (沖合造船所、綿繰り工場、ガラス工場、宇宙産業) を含む 200 以上のリアルな産業拠点に配送 スターベイ、エルキャピタン、ルート 66、USS レキシントン、コーパスクリスティ橋、ソルトフラッツなどの有名なランドマークを訪れて見ましょう。 60 のユニークなトラックストップと 30 の専用休憩所で燃料補給と休憩 投げ縄を用意して、テキサス規模の冒険に出かけましょう。これはおそらく初めてのロデオではないですよね、パートナー?
detailed_descriptions.ko: 안녕하세요, 파트너 여러분! 텍사스의 론스타주를 방문해서 마음에 드셨으면 좋겠습니다. 이곳은 더 이상 카우보이로 가득하지 않지만, 특히 곳곳에서 찾을 수 있는 목장에서 그 정신은 살아 있습니다. 또한 많은 소와 다른 가축도 있으므로 트럭 운전 모험이 활기차게 진행될 것입니다. 텍사스에서는 제공할 것이 많습니다. American Truck Simulator의 가장 큰 맵 DLC이기 때문에 모든 것을 보려면 시간이 좀 걸릴 것입니다. 사실, 론스타주를 탐험할 시간을 내어 다음을 탐험하는 것이 좋습니다. 댈러스, 포트워스, 휴스턴, 오스틴, 샌안토니오, 엘파소, 갤버스터을 포함한 30개의 탐험 가능한 도시를 발견하세요. 50개의 경치 좋은 마을(정착지)을 통과하는 트럭 운전을 즐기세요 32,000킬로미터의 주 도로망을 주행하세요 텍사스주에서만 볼 수 있는 산업(해상 조선소, 면화 조면 공장, 유리 공장 및 우주 산업)을 포함하여 200개가 넘는 현실적인 산업 창고에 배송하세요 스타베이, 엘 캐피탄, 루트 66, USS 렉싱턴, 코퍼스 크리스티 다리 및 솔트 플랫을 포함한 유명한 랜드마크를 방문하세요. 60개의 독특한 트럭 정류장과 30개의 전용 휴게소에서 연료를 채우고 휴식을 취하세요 올가미를 준비하고 텍사스 규모의 모험을 시작하세요. 아마 이게 당신의 첫 로데오는 아닐 거예요, 그렇죠?

games.name: American Truck Simulator - Utah
games.short_description: Visit the great Salt Lake City, tourist-favorite Moab or historic St. George cities and see how rich the local architecture and lifestyle are. Venture into crude-oil digging sites in remote areas away from the urban noise and enjoy the challenges hauling crude oil has to offer!

descriptions.en: Visit the great Salt Lake City, tourist-favorite Moab or historic St. George cities and see how rich the local architecture and lifestyle are. Venture into crude-oil digging sites in remote areas away from the urban noise and enjoy the challenges hauling crude oil has to offer!
descriptions.zh-Hant: 欢迎来到“蜂窝之州” - 犹他州。参观盐湖城、游客最喜爱的摩押或历史古城 - 圣乔治，看看当地建筑与生活方式有多么的丰富。冒险进入远离城市喧嚣的原油开采地，体验运输原油的挑战！
descriptions.ja: 「蜂の巣の州」ユタ州へようこそ。素晴らしいソルトレイクシティ、観光客に人気のモアブ、歴史的なセントジョージの都市を訪れて、地元の建築とライフスタイルの豊かさを体験してください。
descriptions.ko: '벌집주' 유타에 오신 것을 환영합니다. 위대한 솔트레이크 시티, 관광객이 가장 좋아하는 모압 또는 역사적인 세인트 조지시를 방문하여 현지 건축과 라이프스타일이 얼마나 풍부한지 살펴보세요.

detailed_descriptions.en: Welcome to "Beehive State" Utah. Visit the great Salt Lake City, tourist-favorite Moab or historic St. George cities and see how rich the local architecture and lifestyle are. Venture into crude-oil digging sites in remote areas away from the urban noise and enjoy the challenges hauling crude oil has to offer! A completely new approach to creation of rock and other natural formations. Our tool and asset library has been vastly improved in this regard and offers best-to-date representation of real references. Expansion of existing industries via new company docks or cargoes. You can look forward to visiting agricultural stores, improved car dealers, a new feed mill, heavy machinery service or a set of new warehouses! Utah is the 13th-largest state in the U.S and is home to over 3 million residents. The state is a center of transportation, education, information technology, mining, and a major tourist destination for its many famous and beautiful National Parks. Features 3.500 miles of road network 10 major cities (Salt Lake City, St. George, Moab) New quarries and mines including the largest open excavation Kennecott Copper Mine Expanded oil industry (oil mining sites, oil storage sites) Improved agriculture production chain (country stores, feedmills) Famous landmark sites: Great Salt Lake, Monument Valley, Virgin River Canyon Over 260 recognizable natural and man-made landmarks 12 well-known truck stops New and improved process of landscape creation Utah achievements to unlock
detailed_descriptions.zh-Hant: 欢迎来到“蜂窝之州” - 犹他州。参观盐湖城、游客最喜爱的摩押或历史古城 - 圣乔治，看看当地建筑与生活方式有多么的丰富。冒险进入远离城市喧嚣的原油开采地，体验运输原油的挑战！ 一个全新的用以创建岩石和其它自然结构的方式。我们的工具和资产库在这方面得到巨大的提升，并为玩家们提供现有最好的对现实的重现。通过新的公司货场和货物来扩展游戏内的现有产业。大家可以期待见到农产品商店、经改善的车辆经销商、新的饲料厂、重型机械服务站和一套新的仓库！ 犹他州是美国面积第十三大的州，也是三百多万居民的家园。犹他州还是交通运输、教育、信息科技、采矿业中心，更因其拥有许多著名且优美的国家公园而成为重要的旅游目的地。 特性 3,500英里的路网 10座主要城市（盐湖城、圣乔治、摩押） 新的采石场和矿场，其中包括最大的、露天的肯尼科特铜矿 扩展石油产业（石油开采地、石油储存地） 改善农业生产链（乡村商店、饲料厂） 著名地标：大盐湖、纪念碑谷、维珍河峡谷 逾260个可认出的自然与人造地标 12座出名的卡车停靠站 新的、经改善的景色生成过程 犹他州成就有待解锁 该地图扩展中包含的城市
detailed_descriptions.ja: 「蜂の巣の州」ユタ州へようこそ。素晴らしいソルトレイクシティ、観光客に人気のモアブ、歴史的なセントジョージの都市を訪れて、地元の建築とライフスタイルの豊かさを体験してください。都会の喧騒から離れた遠隔地の原油採掘現場に足を踏み入れ、原油を運ぶ難しさを体験してください! 岩やその他の自然の形成に対するまったく新しいアプローチ。この点で、当社のツールと資産ライブラリは大幅に改善され、実際の参照を最新の最高の形で表現しています。新しい会社のドックや貨物による既存の産業の拡大。農業用品店、改良された自動車ディーラー、新しい飼料工場、重機サービス、または一連の新しい倉庫を訪れることができます! ユタ州は米国で 13 番目に大きい州で、300 万人以上の住民が住んでいます。州は交通、教育、情報技術、鉱業の中心地であり、多くの有名で美しい国立公園がある主要な観光地です。 特徴 5,600 キロの道路網 10 の主要都市 (ソルトレイクシティ、セントジョージ、モアブ) 最大の露天掘りであるケネコット銅山を含む新しい採石場と鉱山 拡大した石油産業 (石油採掘現場、石油貯蔵所) 改善された農業生産チェーン (田舎の店、飼料工場) 有名なランドマークの場所: グレートソルトレイク、モニュメントバレー、ヴァージンリバーキャニオン 260 を超える認識可能な自然および人工のランドマーク 12 の有名なトラックストップ 新しく改善された景観作成プロセス ロック解除できるユタ州の実績
detailed_descriptions.ko: '벌집주' 유타에 오신 것을 환영합니다. 솔트레이크 시티, 관광객이 가장 좋아하는 모압, 역사적인 세인트 조지시를 방문하여 현지 건축물과 라이프스타일이 얼마나 풍부한지 확인하세요. 도시 소음에서 멀리 떨어진 외딴 지역의 원유 채굴 현장으로 모험을 떠나 원유 운반이 제공하는 도전을 즐겨보세요! 암석 및 기타 자연 지형을 만드는 완전히 새로운 접근 방식입니다. 이와 관련하여 도구 및 자산 라이브러리가 크게 개선되었으며 실제 참조에 대한 최신 표현을 제공합니다. 새로운 회사 부두 또는 화물을 통한 기존 산업에 대한 확장팩입니다. 농산물 매장, 개선된 자동차 딜러, 새로운 사료 공장, 중장비 서비스 또는 새로운 창고를 방문할 수 있습니다! 유타는 미국에서 13번째로 큰 주이며 300만 명 이상의 주민이 거주합니다. 이 주는 교통, 교육, 정보 기술, 광산의 중심지이며 유명하고 아름다운 많은 국립 공원으로 인해 주요 관광지입니다. 특징 5,600킬로미터의 도로망 10개 주요 도시(솔트레이크 시티, 세인트 조지, 모압) 새로운 채석장과 광산(가장 큰 노천 굴착 케네콧 구리 광산 포함) 확장된 석유 산업(석유 채굴장, 석유 저장장) 개선된 농업 생산 체인(시골 잡화점, 사료 공장) 유명 랜드마크 장소: 그레이트솔트호, 모뉴먼트 밸리, 버진 리버 캐년 260개 이상의 알아볼 수 있는 자연 및 인공 랜드마크 12개의 잘 알려진 트럭 정류장 새롭고 개선된 조경 조성 프로세스 잠금 해제할 수 있는 유타 업적

games.name: American Truck Simulator - Washington
games.short_description: Experience the natural beauty of the "Evergreen State" Washington, from its Pacific Coast beaches to snowcapped mountain ranges and bustling cities such as Seattle and Spokane. Washington is covered by large amounts of forestland, alongside many other diverse biomes.

descriptions.en: Experience the natural beauty of the "Evergreen State" Washington, from its Pacific Coast beaches to snowcapped mountain ranges and bustling cities such as Seattle and Spokane. Washington is covered by large amounts of forestland, alongside many other diverse biomes.
descriptions.zh-Hant: 饱览“常青州”——华盛顿州的自然美景，从其太平洋沿岸海滩，到白雪皑皑的山脉和如西雅图、斯波坎这样的繁华城市。华盛顿州被大量林地覆盖，同时还有多样的生物群落。
descriptions.ja: 太平洋沿岸のビーチから雪を頂いた山脈、シアトルやスポケーンなどの賑やかな都市まで、「常緑の州」ワシントンの自然の美しさを体験してください。ワシントン州は広大な森林地帯に覆われており、その他にもさまざまな生物群系が広がっています。
descriptions.ko: 태평양 연안 해변부터 눈 덮인 산맥과 시애틀, 스포캔과 같은 번화한 도시에 이르기까지 '에버그린주' 워싱턴의 자연의 아름다움을 경험하세요. 워싱턴은 많은 다른 다양한 생물군과 함께 방대한 양의 삼림으로 덮여 있습니다.

detailed_descriptions.en: Experience the natural beauty of the "Evergreen State" Washington, from its Pacific Coast beaches to snowcapped mountain ranges and bustling cities such as Seattle and Spokane. Washington is covered by large amounts of forestland, alongside many other diverse biomes. It is also home to some of America's largest industries and businesses, and is the leading producer of many fruits and vegetables. Washington is one of the USA's most Northwestern states, and with a population of 7.5 million, it is the 13th most populous state. Drivers will be able to experience the state's thick forests, coastal views, winding rivers, farms, and stretching mountain ranges. Features 3,800 miles of dense road network 16 brand new cities (Vancouver, Longview, Aberdeen, Olympia, Tacoma, Seattle, Everett, Port Angeles, Bellingham, Omak, Wenatchee, Yakima, Kennewick, Grand Coulee, Spokane, Colville) More than 20 landmark bridges 10 original truckstops Keystone-Port Townsend Ferry Everett swing bridge Grand Coulee dam Washington's iconic mountains (Mount St. Helens and Mt. Rainier) Challenging logging cliff road Dynamic speed limits and LED signs Large and realistic ports (Seattle, Tacoma, Everett) Many unique junctions Distinct company docks for new cargoes: yacht builders, vast farms, material storages... Washington-specific achievements to unlock Cities included in the expansion
detailed_descriptions.zh-Hant: 饱览“常青州”——华盛顿州的自然美景，从其太平洋沿岸海滩，到白雪皑皑的山脉和如西雅图、斯波坎这样的繁华城市。华盛顿州被大量林地覆盖，同时还有多样的生物群落。其也是美国一些最大型的产业与商业的所在地，更是很多水果、蔬菜的主要产地。 华盛顿州斯美国西北部其中一个最大的州，其人口达750万人，是人口第十三大州。驾驶员们将能够看到该州的茂密森林、海滨景致、蜿蜒河流、乡村农场和绵延不绝的山脉。 内容 长达3,800英里的密集路网 16座全新的城市（温哥华、朗维尤、阿伯丁、奥林匹亚、塔科马、西雅图、埃弗雷特、安吉利斯港、贝灵汉、奥马克、韦纳奇、雅基马、肯纳威克、大古力、斯波坎、科尔维尔） 20余座地标性桥梁 10座原创的卡车停靠站 基斯通港的汤森渡口 埃弗里特的平旋桥 大古力水坝 华盛顿州标志性的山脉（圣海伦火山、瑞尼尔山） 具有挑战性的伐木悬崖道 动态限速及LED交通标志 大而逼真的港口（西雅图、塔科马、埃弗雷特） 许多独特的交叉路口 多种公司货场：游艇制造厂、大型农场、材料仓库... 华盛顿州的专有成就-有待解锁
detailed_descriptions.ja: 太平洋沿岸のビーチから雪を頂いた山脈、シアトルやスポケーンなどの賑やかな都市まで、「常緑の州」ワシントンの自然の美しさを体験してください。ワシントン州は広大な森林地帯に覆われており、その他にもさまざまな生物群系が広がっています。また、アメリカ最大の産業や企業の拠点でもあり、多くの果物や野菜の主要生産地でもあります。 ワシントン州は、アメリカで最も北西部にある州の 1 つで、人口は 750 万人で、13 番目に人口の多い州です。運転手は、州の深い森、海岸の景色、曲がりくねった川、農場、広がる山脈を体験できます。 特徴 6,100 キロの密集した道路網 16 の新しい都市 (バンクーバー、ロングビュー、アバディーン、オリンピア、タコマ、シアトル、エバレット、ポートエンジェルス、ベリンガム、オマック、ウェナチー、ヤキマ、ケネウィック、グランドクーリー、スポケーン、コルビル) 20 を超えるランドマークブリッジ 10 のオリジナルトラックストップ キーストーン - ポートタウンゼントフェリー エバレットスイングブリッジ グランドクーリーダム ワシントンの象徴的な山々 (セントヘレンズ山とレーニア山) 挑戦的な伐採崖の道 ダイナミックな速度制限と LED 標識 大きくてリアルな港 (シアトル、タコマ、エバレット) 多くのユニークなジャンクション 新しい貨物用の独特な会社のドック: ヨットビルダー、広大な農場、資材保管庫... ロック解除できるワシントン固有の実績
detailed_descriptions.ko: 태평양 연안 해변부터 눈 덮인 산맥과 시애틀, 스포캔과 같은 번화한 도시에 이르기까지 '에버그린주' 워싱턴의 자연의 아름다움을 경험하세요. 워싱턴은 다양한 생물군과 함께 방대한 양의 삼림으로 덮여 있습니다. 또한 미국에서 가장 큰 산업과 사업체가 있는 곳이며, 많은 과일과 채소의 주요 생산지입니다. 워싱턴은 미국에서 가장 북서쪽에 있는 주 중 하나이며, 인구는 750만 명으로 13번째로 인구가 많은 주입니다. 운전자는 주의 울창한 숲, 해안 전망, 구불구불한 강, 농장, 뻗어 있는 산맥을 경험할 수 있습니다. 특징 6,100킬로미터의 조밀한 도로망 16개의 새로운 도시(밴쿠버, 롱뷰, 애버딘, 올림피아, 타코마, 시애틀, 에버렛, 포트 앤젤레스, 벨링햄, 오막, 웨나치, 야키마, 케네윅, 그랑 쿨리, 스포캔, 콜빌) 20개 이상의 랜드마크 다리 10개의 오리지널 트럭 휴게소 키스톤-포트 타운젠드 페리 에버렛 스윙 브리지 그랑 쿨리 댐 워싱턴의 상징적인 산(세인트 헬렌스 산과 레이니어 산) 도전적인 벌목 절벽 도로 동적 속도 제한 및 LED 표지판 크고 사실적인 항구(시애틀, 타코마, 에버렛) 독특한 교차로 다수 새로운 화물을 위한 고유한 회사 부두: 요트 제작자, 광대한 농장, 자재 창고... 워싱턴 관련 업적 잠금 해제

games.short_description: Say howdy to the Equality State, Wyoming. Whether you fancy the beautiful architecture or the general feel of rich history, you will feel like at home in Wyoming. Cowboys, trains, and wide-open natural spaces await you.

descriptions.en: Say howdy to the Equality State, Wyoming. Whether you fancy the beautiful architecture or the general feel of rich history, you will feel like at home in Wyoming. Cowboys, trains, and wide-open natural spaces await you.
descriptions.zh-Hant: 迎接平等之州——怀俄明州。从白雪覆盖的屹立山脉到世界著名的国家公园，“大怀俄明州”拥有狂野自然之美。无论是喜欢美丽的建筑，还是浓厚的历史文化感受，你在怀俄明州都会倍感亲切。牛仔、火车和开阔的自然空间等待着你。
descriptions.ja: 「平等の州」ワイオミング州へようこそ。美しい建築物や豊かな歴史の雰囲気を好まれる方でも、ワイオミング州ではまるで自宅にいるかのようにくつろげます。カウボーイ、列車、広々とした自然空間があなたを待っています。
descriptions.ko: 평등의 주, 와이오밍에 인사하세요. 아름다운 건축물을 좋아하든 풍부한 역사의 전반적인 느낌을 좋아하든, 와이오밍에서는 집에 있는 것 같은 기분을 느낄 수 있을 것입니다. 카우보이, 기차, 탁 트인 자연 공간이 여러분을 기다립니다.

detailed_descriptions.en: Say howdy to the Equality State, Wyoming. From towering, snow-capped mountain ranges to world-famous national parks, "Big Wyoming" is a state of rugged natural beauty. Witness the Devils Tower. Haul through the cities along the I-80. Export livestock from the massive agricultural sector. Explore the Magic City of the Plains, Cheyenne. Go on a road trip to a part of the legendary Yellowstone National Park. Whether you fancy the beautiful architecture or the general feel of rich history, you will feel like at home in Wyoming. Cowboys, trains, and wide-open natural spaces await you. This is what you can do and see in Wyoming Deliver to and from 11 cities and discover 14 settlements Discover and deliver to Wyoming's important industries like coal & soda ash, farms & agriculture, railyards, and more! Haul livestock cargo to our new cattle auction houses Drive on the Highway to Heaven Haul cargo on the I-80, the second-longest Interstate highway in the United States See wildlife unique to Wyoming including bison Visit landmarks like Devils Tower National Monument and part of the Yellowstone National Park and get bird's-eye views with many new viewpoints Admire accurate representations of cities like Cheyenne, Casper, Jackson, Sheridan, and more! Visit and take a rest at famous Wyoming rest stops & gas stations Unlock Wyoming-specific Steam achievements Cities included in the map expansion Nature Wyoming may be one of the least populated states in the U.S, but that doesn't mean that it lacks spectacular places to visit and see. Home to some of the country's most breathtaking national parks, Wyoming is best known for its red-walled gorges, hot springs, historic prairie towns, pioneer history, and historical attractions. Wyoming designated the American bison as the official state mammal in 1985, and to this day you can still find large herds of them grazing across the prairies and protected land which is designated for the conservation of wild bison since their decline across the US. Located in the west of Wyoming, the Bridger-Teton National Forest, best known for the four W's - Wildlife, Waterfalls, Wilderness, and Wild and Scenic Rivers, is the largest intact ecosystem in the lower 48 United States and a must-visit location for any traveler. Devils Tower is a famous butte with hundreds of vertical cracks and a total height of 5,112 ft (1,558 m), which makes it an extremely distinctive feature in the area full of prairies. This natural wonder is much better experienced by seeing the "bigger" picture with everything around; therefore the closest possible point will be the visitor’s center and in front of the gate at the entrance to the park. But do not weep, because there will be a nearby farm and an interactive viewpoint below the tower, in which the most attentive may find something very interesting. Industries The agriculture industry is one of the state's largest contributors to the local economy. While crops, fruits, and vegetables make up a large percentage of this industry, the production of beef is the largest part of Wyoming's agriculture sector. Many of the cattle are usually sold and exported around the world from Livestock auction houses, which will be one of the new industries arriving to Wyoming. Another form of logistics that is prominent across the state is the railroad. Contribute to the maintenance of the locomotives that serve the railways as you deliver important rail parts to and from the rail supply depot, as well as delivering and picking up cargo from the freight trains that arrive daily. Chemical plants and quarries will also be other locations where drivers can pick up and deliver various parts and materials from. These loading points are always located on the edge of the refinery or quarry to keep drivers safely away from the active mining areas. Road network Legend says that a certain trucker (we’re all feeling proud here right?) decided one day to take a picture while driving on Interstate 80, as he was approaching an area near Fort Bridger known as "The Three Sisters". The image made it seem as if the road over the crest was never-ending and ever since then, people commonly referred to this area as the "Highway to Heaven". Time to get back to earth now and mention numerous new road signs which will include speed limit signs, freeway and highway signs, tourist signs, and dynamic message gantries! Speaking of road gantries there’s also a very interesting new visual - gantries with traffic lights at crossroads. These are not exactly a common occurrence, that is why you should always be prepared to take a picture just so you can take it with you "spiritually" wherever you go. You will also be able to cross several colorful bridges, and if open space is not for you, be sure not to miss the I-80’s Twin Tunnel near Rock Springs. So, get behind the wheel and discover Wyoming!
detailed_descriptions.zh-Hant: 迎接平等之州——怀俄明州。从白雪覆盖的屹立山脉到世界著名的国家公园，“大怀俄明州”拥有狂野自然之美。见识魔鬼塔，运货穿越 I-80 沿路城市，从规模庞大的农业区运出家畜，探索魅力的平原之城夏延，再来一场前往传奇的黄石国家公园（部分）的公路旅行。 无论是喜欢美丽的建筑，还是浓厚的历史文化感受，你在怀俄明州都会倍感亲切。牛仔、火车和开阔的自然空间等待着你。 这是你可以在怀俄明州打卡的事情 运送货物至10座城市或从那运出，并探索14处定居地 了解及参与怀俄明州重要产业的货运运输，例如煤炭与苏打粉、农业与畜牧业、铁路站及更多！ 运输家畜货物至新的牛拍卖行 驾车行驶在通往天堂的高速公路 在美国第二长的州际高速公路 I-80 运送货物 领略包含野牛在内的怀俄明州的独特野性 参观魔鬼塔国家纪念区、部分的黄石国家公园等地标景点，并通过许多新的观光点获得鸟瞰视角 欣赏夏延、卡斯珀、杰克逊、谢里登等城市的真实呈现！ 前往著名的怀俄明州休息站与加油站休息 解锁怀俄明州 Steam 成就 自然 怀俄明州也许是美国人口密度最小的州之一，但并不意味着这里就没有值得参观游览的地方。作为全国最令人震撼的国家公园的所在地，怀俄明州以其红壁峡谷、温泉、历史悠久的大草原村镇、拓荒者历史及其他历史事物而闻名。 在1985年，怀俄明州正式将美洲野牛作为官方动物。时至今日，人们仍可以在大草原，以及自全美野牛数量下降后而专门设立的保护区看到成群的野牛。 坐落于怀俄明州西部的布里杰-蒂顿国家森林，以“四个W” - 野生生物（Wildlife）、瀑布（Waterfalls）、荒野（Wilderness）和优美的天然河流（Wild and Scenic Rivers）著称，是美国48个本土州之中最大的未被破坏的生态系统，也是游客们必去的地方。 魔鬼塔是一个拥有数百条垂直裂缝的著名地垛，其总高度为5,112英尺（1,558米），成为整个北美大草原地区异常独特的一处。这个自然奇迹的景观更适合以“大场景”带上周围环境来体验。因此，能够最靠近的位置是游客中心和公园入口的大门前。不过别伤心，在魔鬼塔山脚下有一个邻近的农场和可交互的观光点，最细心的人也许会在这里发现一些十分有趣的事物。 产业 农业是怀俄明州当地经济最大的贡献力量之一。作物、水果和蔬菜占据了该产业的大部分，其中牛肉产品是该州农业的大头，牛肉生产是当地农业部门最大的一部分。牛通常从家畜拍卖行出售并出口至世界各地，而这将成为怀俄明州的新产业之一。 铁路运输是怀俄明州的重要物流形式。为火车头的维护工作做出贡献，在铁路补给站运送重要的铁路部件，以及运货至每天抵达的货运列车或从列车运出货物。 化工厂、采石场也将成为驾驶员们可以接取和运送各种部件与材料的地方。这些货物装载点都会分布在精炼厂或采石场的边缘，确保驾驶员与采矿工作区保持安全的距离。 路网 传说有一位卡车司机（我们都为此感到自豪，对吗？）一天驾车行驶在80州际公路时决定拍摄一张照片，因为他正在接近一个被称为“三姐妹”的布里杰堡的地方。那张照片里跨越山顶的公路看起来就像是永远没有尽头，自那以后，人们都把这个地方称作“通往天堂的高速公路”。 哎呀，现在是时候回到地面了，来说说许多新的道路标志，其中包括限速标志、高速公路和公路标志、游客标志及动态信息路标架！提到路标架，这也将会有一个非常有趣的新情景 - 在交叉路口带有交通信号灯的路标架。这其实不是普遍存在的设备，因此无论到哪里，大家都要时刻“留心”，准备好给它拍一张照片。 大家还将能够驶过几座缤纷多彩的桥梁。如果开放空间不是你的口味，那就别错过罗克斯普林斯附近 I-80 公路的双隧道。那么，现在就坐上驾驶位，去探索怀俄明州吧！
detailed_descriptions.ja: 「平等の州」ワイオミング州へようこそ。そびえ立つ雪を頂いた山脈から世界的に有名な国立公園まで、「ビッグワイオミング」は荒々しい自然の美しさにあふれた州です。デビルズタワーを目の当たりにしてください。I-80 沿いの都市を通り抜けましょう。大規模な農業セクターから家畜を輸出してください。平原の魔法の都市、シャイアンを探索してください。伝説のイエローストーン国立公園の一部までドライブ旅行に出かけてください。 美しい建築物や豊かな歴史の雰囲気を好まれる方でも、ワイオミング州ではまるで自宅にいるかのようにくつろげます。カウボーイ、列車、広々とした自然空間があなたを待っています。 ワイオミング州でできること、見るべきもの 11 の都市に配送し、14 の集落を発見 石炭やソーダ灰、農場や農業、鉄道操車場など、ワイオミング州の重要な産業を発見し、配送しましょう! 新しい牛の競売場に家畜の貨物を運ぶ 天国へのハイウェイをドライブ アメリカで 2 番目に長い州間高速道路である I-80 で貨物を運ぶ バイソンなど、ワイオミング州特有の野生動物を見る デビルズタワー国定公園やイエローストーン国立公園の一部などのランドマークを訪れ、多くの新しい視点から鳥瞰図を眺める シャイアン、キャスパー、ジャクソン、シェリダンなどの都市の正確な描写を鑑賞しましょう! ワイオミング州の有名な休憩所やガソリンスタンドを訪れて休憩します ワイオミング州固有の実績をロック解除しましょう
detailed_descriptions.ko: 평등의 주, 와이오밍에 인사하세요. 우뚝 솟은 눈 덮인 산맥에서 세계적으로 유명한 국립공원에 이르기까지 '빅 와이오밍'은 험난한 자연의 아름다움을 지닌 주입니다. 데빌스 타워를 감상하세요. games.name: Ammossum
games.short_description: Build an endlessly upgradable weapon! Evolve projectiles into unstoppable firepower in this action roguelike. Fight through hordes of infected beasts, hunt down the source of the plague, and feel the thrill of bloody shootouts filled with bullets, explosions, and acid. Can you survive the madness?

descriptions.en: Build an endlessly upgradable weapon! Evolve projectiles into unstoppable firepower in this action roguelike. Fight through hordes of infected beasts, hunt down the source of the plague, and feel the thrill of bloody shootouts filled with bullets, explosions, and acid. Can you survive the madness?

detailed_descriptions.en: The world is falling apart, and your family has been taken from you. The infected swarm the railroads, the plague spreads, and the only way forward is through fire and chaos. Keep the train moving, search for answers, and face the truth waiting at the end of the line. Why settle for ordinary guns when you can craft pure chaos? Combine and evolve your projectiles—nest them within each other, fuse them into devastating combos, and fill the battlefield with nonstop explosions. The possibilities are endless, and so is the firepower! Your train isn’t just a ride—it’s part of your build. Each railcar adds unique bonuses, from economy to battlefield control. Pick the right upgrades, mix the synergies, and fine-tune your setup to turn every fight in your favor. Every run brings discoveries. Unlock weapons, find hidden mechanics, and expand your arsenal with each attempt. The more you play, the stronger—and wilder—your options become. Experiment, and push your limits with each new attempt—because no two runs are the same!

games.name: Amnesia: The Bunker
games.short_description: Amnesia: The Bunker is a first-person horror game set in a WW1 bunker. A relentless, AI-driven monster stalks you. Survival depends on finding tools, crafting items, and keeping the lights on.

descriptions.en: Amnesia: The Bunker is a first-person horror game set in a WW1 bunker. A relentless, AI-driven monster stalks you. Survival depends on finding tools, crafting items, and keeping the lights on.

detailed_descriptions.en: Amnesia: The Bunker is a first-person horror game from the makers of SOMA and Amnesia. Left all alone in a desolate WW1 bunker with only one bullet remaining in the barrel, it’s up to you to face the oppressing terrors in the dark. Keep the lights on at all costs, persevere, and make your way out alive. A truly intense horror experience. RISING TENSION Immerse yourself in the multiple ways of tackling survival. In the shoes of the French soldier Henri Clément, you are armed with a revolver gun, a noisy dynamo flashlight, and other scarce supplies to scavenge and craft along the way. With randomization and unpredictable behavior, no play-through is the same. Hunted by an ever-present threat reacting to your every move and sound, you must adapt your play-style to face hell. Every decision will change the outcome of how the game responds. Actions bear consequences. ESCAPING THE NIGHTMARE Solve things your own way in a semi-open world. You must explore and experiment to make your way out. Figure out what’s going on down here - what has happened to the other soldiers? Where have all the officers gone? What diabolical nightmare lurks underneath this hellscape? Unravel the mysteries of the Bunker and get to know the nooks and crannies of this cruel sandbox to up your odds of survival. FEATURES Dynamic and ever-present monster that reacts to player actions. Constant tension - Time is not on your side. Tactile and physics based interactions with the world. Scavenge for resources and craft tools to aid your survival. Multiple solutions to problem solving in a non-linear open world.

detailed_descriptions.en: The last remaining memories fade away into darkness. Your mind is a mess and only a feeling of being hunted remains. You must escape. Awake... Amnesia: The Dark Descent, a first person survival horror. A game about immersion, discovery and living through a nightmare. An experience that will chill you to the core. You stumble through the narrow corridors as the distant cry is heard. It is getting closer. Explore... Amnesia: The Dark Descent puts you in the shoes of Daniel as he wakes up in a desolate castle, barely remembering anything about his past. Exploring the eerie pathways, you must also take part of Daniel's troubled memories. The horror does not only come from the outside, but from the inside as well. A disturbing odyssey into the dark corners of the human mind awaits. A sound of dragging feet? Or is your mind playing tricks on you? Experience... By using a fully physically simulated world, cutting edge 3D graphics and a dynamic sound system, the game pulls no punches when trying to immerse you. Once the game starts, you will be in control from the beginning to the end. There are no cut-scenes or time-jumps, whatever happens will happen to you first hand. Something emerges out of the darkness. It's approaching. Fast. Survive... Amnesia: The Dark Descent throws you headfirst into a dangerous world where danger can lurk behind every corner. Your only means of defense are hiding, running or using your wits. Do you have what it takes to survive?

descriptions.en: As highly qualified goose parents, work together to bring your little egg home safely. Every crack makes it harder to control, every mistake more hilarious. A co-op physics game for 2 or 4 players about teamwork, clumsiness and honking. HONK!

detailed_descriptions.en: Two geese. One fragile egg. Infinite chaos. Work together to carry it through unpredictable challenges without breaking it, every crack makes it harder, every mistake more hilarious. A co-op physics game about teamwork, clumsiness, and the unstoppable power of honking. Cracks = Chaos With every crack , the egg becomes harder to control and easier to lose. Each impact makes it wobblier, bouncier, and far more unpredictable. Handle it carefully, or watch it explode in a glorious mess . Not all is lost When the egg slips away , you can still recover it. Every fall is a chance to try again. Fragile, cracked, but never truly broken. Teamwork at its finest Pick up your useless partner, throw them back on track, and pretend you didn’t almost drop them on purpose. FEATURES One egg, endless chaos – Keep it safe (or try) through unpredictable physics and tricky obstacles. Cracks that change everything – Each hit makes the egg weaker and the game harder. Teamwork and betrayal – Lift, toss, honk, and sometimes sabotage your partner. Physics-fueled fun – Clumsy controls and goose energy combine for hilarious moments. A true test of patience – Rage, laugh, and celebrate every inch of progress.

games.name: Ancestors: The Humankind Odyssey
games.short_description: Survive your evolution in Neogene Africa starting 10 million years ago. Ancestors: The Humankind Odyssey is a third-person open world survival game where you Explore, Expand, and Evolve to advance your clan to the next generation in the exciting new adventure from Panache Digital Games.

descriptions.en: Survive your evolution in Neogene Africa starting 10 million years ago. Ancestors: The Humankind Odyssey is a third-person open world survival game where you Explore, Expand, and Evolve to advance your clan to the next generation in the exciting new adventure from Panache Digital Games.

detailed_descriptions.en: Ancestors: The Humankind Odyssey is a third-person open world survival game where you Explore, Expand, and Evolve to advance your clan to the next generation in this exhilarating new adventure from Panache Digital Games. Embark on the most incredible odyssey known to humankind: human evolution. Spanning from 10 million to 2 million years ago, begin your journey, before us, in Neogene period Africa. Explore a beautiful yet ruthless world, from swinging through tree branches in the jungle to stalking prey across the golden savannah grasslands. Decide what attributes to learn and hone in order to pass down knowledge to future generations, from crafting tools to enhancing evasive tactics against predators. Just like real life, make sure to eat, drink, and sleep to stay alive and have the energy to face any danger that may come your way. Grow your clan and find strength in numbers as you progress through critical evolutionary stages of human evolution. Your choices will write your clan’s story and determine if you can survive your evolution. Explore Ruthless Africa Explore the never-before-experienced world of Neogene Africa starting 10 million years ago at the dawn of humankind. From the tops of tree canopies overlooking lush jungles to the golden grasslands of the savannah, traverse a beautiful yet unforgiving landscape. For every breath-taking view, beware of the weather, predators, and other dangers that threaten your survival. Expand Your Territory and Grow Your Clan Increase your chances of survival by uniting new members of your species and giving birth to future generations. Control different clan members, form bonds to create families, and work together to intimidate predators during expeditions. Conquer fear as you explore unknown locations in order to expand your territory. Evolve Through Multiple Generations See the physical and intellectual evolution of the first hominids as you explore, learn, and survive. Spanning from 10 million to 2 million years ago, play as one of the first hominids and evolve over the course of millions of years during key stages in human evolution. Make crucial discoveries and hone physical abilities that will be passed down to future generations such as Ardipithecus ramidus and Australopithecus. Choose How You Survive Evolution was not written in stone. Your decisions shape how you will overcome obstacles, increase your species, and what knowledge will pass on to future generations. Focus on specific attributes or choose a more balanced approach to survival. Your clan’s ability to survive will be directly impacted by your choices, making each player’s experience unique.

games.name: Angels Fall First
games.short_description: From commanding the battle standing on the bridge of your flagship all the way down to tactical infantry firefights - AFF brings together all the combat you ever loved in a rich science fiction setting. Boarding, pilotable capital ships, deep weapon customization and full Bot support included!

descriptions.en: From commanding the battle standing on the bridge of your flagship all the way down to tactical infantry firefights - AFF brings together all the combat you ever loved in a rich science fiction setting. Boarding, pilotable capital ships, deep weapon customization and full Bot support included!

detailed_descriptions.en: Angels Fall First is a first person combined-arms sci-fi wargame. AFF focuses on team-oriented tactical gameplay and objective-based scenarios with a high degree of replayability, featuring: Wide selection of weapons and tools, ground vehicles and spacecraft to fight with. Diverse combat opportunities - assume point to clear a building, hunt with a frigate wolfpack as a lineship captain, issue orders from the bridge of your battleship. Fully operational and pilotable capital ships with playable interiors. Unique combination of spaceship and infantry combat - board spacestations, shipyards and vessels to capture or destroy them from the inside. Dogfighting using space interceptors and bombers, launched from capital ships and stations. Gameplay mechanics designed as a mix of modern elements (customization, loadouts, persistence) and inspirations from classic shooters (frantic, fast-paced firefights). Commander mode for issuing orders to your squadmates and teammates. Full AI support - all scenarios can be played both offline and online identically, supporting up to 64 players or bots filling in for the players if required. Rich science fiction universe setting. Another space game? Well, we've been doing this a long time - AFF has been a rich universe of fiction and art since 2005. We made a Homeworld mod, and kept building from there. Work started on an Unreal Tournament 2004 mod, but was then ported over to UT3 in 2007, culminating in a 3rd place grand prize in 2009's MakeSomethingUnreal contest. Angels Fall First as a standalone game is, for us, a mission to enable the player to do as much as possible in a vast environment - whilst still retaining the focussed, fun experience of match based FPS games. Way back in the back-whens, we loved Tie Fighter. A little later on, we loved Battlefield. We waited patiently for the game which would inevitably unite the vast scale and spacefights with the close and personal firefights and thunderous vehicle battles... But it never really appeared. Many games came close, but there was always some part missing. You couldn’t get out of your spaceship, you couldn’t get into your spaceship, you had big spaceships but you couldn’t run around in them, you could run around in your big spaceship but you couldn’t fly it and so on and so forth and gahd damMIT! Where was our spacefight groundfight game? So, we set ourselves to work. AFF exists because it MUST exist. Only in AFF can you spawn in your crew quarters, run to the bay watching the space fight out of the windows, launch a dropship, fight through the defenders to the enemy flagship, breach the hull, run and gun your way to the bridge and SHOOT THE ENEMY CAPTAIN IN THE BACK OF THE NECK. Calm Down! Ok. But it's this slightly twitchy passion which has driven us to create such a monster. We grew old making this, and we got grumpy watching everyone else release their cool games or whatever. We're from a time when games were about blowing stuff up for points and glory and now FINALLY we want to go out there and share this crazy passion with all of you!

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Angels Fall First is a first person combined-arms sci-fi wargame.

AFF focuses on team-oriented tactical gameplay and objective-based scenarios with a high degree of replayability, featuring:

  • Wide selection of weapons and tools, ground vehicles and spacecraft to fight with.
  • Diverse combat opportunities - assume point to clear a building, hunt with a frigate wolfpack as a lineship captain, issue orders from the bridge of your battleship.
  • Fully operational and pilotable capital ships with playable interiors.
  • Unique combination of spaceship and infantry combat - board spacestations, shipyards and vessels to capture or destroy them from the inside.
  • Dogfighting using space interceptors and bombers, launched from capital ships and stations.
  • Gameplay mechanics designed as a mix of modern elements (customization, loadouts, persistence) and inspirations from classic shooters (frantic, fast-paced firefights).
  • Commander mode for issuing orders to your squadmates and teammates.
  • Full AI support - all scenarios can be played both offline and online identically, supporting up to 64 players or bots filling in for the players if required.
  • Rich science fiction universe setting.



Another space game?

Well, we've been doing this a long time - AFF has been a rich universe of fiction and art since 2005. We made a Homeworld mod, and kept building from there. Work started on an Unreal Tournament 2004 mod, but was then ported over to UT3 in 2007, culminating in a 3rd place grand prize in 2009's MakeSomethingUnreal contest.

Angels Fall First as a standalone game is, for us, a mission to enable the player to do as much as possible in a vast environment - whilst still retaining the focussed, fun experience of match based FPS games.

Way back in the back-whens, we loved Tie Fighter. A little later on, we loved Battlefield. We waited patiently for the game which would inevitably unite the vast scale and spacefights with the close and personal firefights and thunderous vehicle battles...

But it never really appeared. Many games came close, but there was always some part missing. You couldn’t get out of your spaceship, you couldn’t get into your spaceship, you had big spaceships but you couldn’t run around in them, you could run around in your big spaceship but you couldn’t fly it and so on and so forth and gahd damMIT! Where was our spacefight groundfight game?

So, we set ourselves to work. AFF exists because it MUST exist. Only in AFF can you spawn in your crew quarters, run to the bay watching the space fight out of the windows, launch a dropship, fight through the defenders to the enemy flagship, breach the hull, run and gun your way to the bridge and SHOOT THE ENEMY CAPTAIN IN THE BACK OF THE NECK.

Calm Down!

Ok. But it's this slightly twitchy passion which has driven us to create such a monster. We grew old making this, and we got grumpy watching everyone else release their cool games or whatever. We're from a time when games were about blowing stuff up for points and glory and now FINALLY we want to go out there and share this crazy passion with all of you!

Crash through the caffeine-fuelled fever dream of Shit City, putting the boot to a menacing menagerie of merciless gangsters. Unleash the world's deadliest feet on a colourful cast of anthropomorphic enemies. Clearing out slums, sewers, and skyscrapers as you grab new weapons, unlock new sneakers, and upgrade your powers in absurd and wonderful ways. Kick and shoot your way to the exit as you leave behind a smouldering trail of shattered doors, broken bones, and crumpled energy drinks. Fast-Paced Ass Kicking Action Shit City is a disease and your foot is the cure. Lace up a capricious collection of formidable footwear to fight through a diverse series of deranged city districts. Vibrant Visuals, Relentless Beats Enjoy a concussive, bass-thumping soundtrack as you stampede through a feverish criminal underworld. An assault on all your senses. Including common sense. Run. Kick. Repeat Are you the god of style, speed or power? Discover secrets and unlocks that encourage replayability - and learn to tackle levels in new creative, ridiculous and devastating ways. Master The Foot Become one with the toes and be quick on the trigger. Your skills must surpass human comprehension if you are to prevail and learn the secret of the Anger Foot.

games.short_description: Welcome back to the heartwarming world of Animal Shelter 2! Provide a loving home for every four-legged friend in need – play with them, pet them, even dress them up! Get to know them and find them a loving family. Play with your friends and manage your shelter together in co-op!

descriptions.en: Welcome back to the heartwarming world of Animal Shelter 2! Provide a loving home for every four-legged friend in need – play with them, pet them, even dress them up! Get to know them and find them a loving family. Play with your friends and manage your shelter together in co-op!

detailed_descriptions.en: Our four-legged friends need your help! Animal Shelter Simulator 2 comes with more animals that need your help. You will need to provide them with a clean, safe environment, as well as food and water and, most importantly, lots of love. Thankfully, you won’t be alone this time! Grow your shelter with new employees! Managing a whole shelter by yourself is a tough job! Good thing you’ve got the help of skilled workers that can take on some of the responsibilities. Remember – managing people is not easy either! Play with your friends in co-op with up to 6 players! Everything is always more fun with friends! Invite your friends to work on your shelter and find the perfect homes for your animals together! Emote, interact and have fun, all the while being surrounded by beautiful scenery and cute animals. Help animals find their forever homes! The adoption process requires a lot of patience. It is important to pick the correct pet for the right person, and vice versa! In Animal Shelter Simulator 2, the potential adopters will be able to visit the shelter and see the pets for themselves before they make up their mind about them. Remember that a lot of things can impact the chance of an adoption: the animal’s traits, their current state, and even the state of the shelter itself! Maintain the shelter and enjoy its beauty! Your shelter is located in a picturesque little town surrounded by the forest and mountains. Make sure that it fits right in among the beautiful scenery – keep it clean and upgrade its features regularly! Enjoy the view of it both during the day and at night! Meet your new furry friends Pet them, play with them, even dress them up! The Animal Shelter is back and its residents are full of life and always eager to interact with you. Make sure that all their needs are met and that they are healthy, and they will repay you with lots of love!

games.short_description: Shape the Roman Empire in this genre-defining strategic builder game. Build cities while expanding your influence through Roman provinces. Govern using your economic prowess, diplomatic skills, or military might.

descriptions.en: Shape the Roman Empire in this genre-defining strategic builder game. Build cities while expanding your influence through Roman provinces. Govern using your economic prowess, diplomatic skills, or military might.

detailed_descriptions.en: As governor, how you build and govern will shape your story, your citizens’ destiny, and your provinces’ future. Will you cooperate with other governors or prove your military prowess by challenging your rivals? The cost of peace is yours to decide. EXPERIENCE THE PREMIER BUILDER Build your provinces with unmatched detail, flexibility, and scale. Watch kids chase dogs through the streets or thousands cheer in the arena. Build upon the land that you see, from the beautiful heartland of Latium to the mysterious Celtic wetlands of Albion… where no civilized Roman wants to be. BECOME A ROMAN GOVERNOR Design the cities of your dreams at the peak of the Roman Empire as you balance your people's needs with the relentless demands of the emperor. Forge alliances across the empire or showcase your might with strategic land battles and naval combat. You may even defy the emperor himself – but not without consequences. CHOOSE THE FATE OF YOUR PROVINCES Every decision you make as governor matters. Will you honor local Celtic culture or enforce Roman traditions? Grow your provinces through diplomacy and commerce or conquer through military strength. Your choices will shape not only the future of your citizens and your provinces, but your own story as well.

descriptions.en: Anno 1800™ – Lead the Industrial Revolution! Welcome to the dawn of the Industrial Age. The path you choose will define your world. Are you an innovator or an exploiter? A conqueror or a liberator? How the world remembers your name is up to you.
descriptions.zh-Hant: 《美麗新世界 1800》 - 引領工業革命！ 迎接工業時代的黎明。你選擇的路線將造就你的世界。你想成為革新者或剝削者？征服者或解放者？你在世上留下的名聲完全取決於你。

descriptions.ko: Anno 1800™ – 산업 혁명을 주도하라! 바야흐로 산업화가 태동하는 시대입니다. 당신이 어떤 길을 선택하는가에 따라 세계는 달라집니다. 혁신에 매진할 것인가, 아니면 노동자를 착취할 것인가? 정복을 추구할 것인가, 아니면 자유를 중시할 것인가? 격변하는 시기에 어떻게 세상에 이름을 떨치고 싶은지 스스로 결정하십시오

detailed_descriptions.en: Anno 1800™ – Lead the Industrial Revolution! Welcome to the dawn of the Industrial Age. The path you choose will define your world. Are you an innovator or an exploiter? A conqueror or a liberator? How the world remembers your name is up to you. In Anno 1800, players will take charge of their own fortune as they navigate the rapidly evolving technological landscape and malicious political arena of the 19th century in their quest to build an empire that will reach from the smog-filled cities of Europe to the teeming jungles of South America. Combining beloved features with innovative gameplay, Anno 1800 is the beginning of a new era for the Anno franchise as players leave their mark on a crucial moment in human history. Welcome to the 19th century, a time of industrialization, diplomacy, and discovery. Rich with technological innovations, conspiracies, and changing allegiances, this era presents the perfect setting for classic Anno gameplay. Anno 1800 provides players ample opportunity to prove their skills as a ruler as they create huge metropolises, plan efficient logistic networks, settle an exotic new continent, send out expeditions around the globe, and dominate their opponents by diplomacy, trade, or warfare. Anno 1800 combines beloved features from 20 years of Anno history. It delivers a rich city-building experience, including a story-based campaign, a highly customizable sandbox mode, and the classic Anno multiplayer experience. Anno 1800 will see the return of beloved features such as individual AI opponents, shippable trade goods, randomly generated maps, multi-session gameplay, items, and more. To bring this pivotal historical era to life, Anno 1800 introduces many all-new features to the franchise’s rich tradition. Expeditions allow players to send crews of specialists across the globe as they seek fame and fortune, while the new workforce feature makes managing your factories more demanding and realistic than ever. Finally, players will settle South America as they lay claim to the black gold powering this new age of industry. Leading prosperous metropolises requires you to adapt your strategy to new situations. Fulfil the needs of your inhabitants by establishing numerous production chains, deal with other AI rulers sharing your world, and rise to prosperity by building a profitable network of trade routes.
detailed_descriptions.zh-Hant: 《美麗新世界 1800》 - 引領工業革命！ 迎接工業時代的黎明。你選擇的路線將造就你的世界。你想成為革新者或剝削者？征服者或解放者？你在世上留下的名聲完全取決於你。 在《美麗新世界 1800》裡，玩家將掌握自己的命運，遊走於 19 世紀快速進步的科技領域和險惡的政治競技場，並設法建立起版圖東起歐洲煙霧瀰漫的城市、西至南美茂密叢林的龐大帝國。 《美麗新世界 1800》結合了廣受喜愛的遊戲元素以及創新的遊戲內容，除了替《美麗新世界》系列開闢全新時代，還能讓玩家在人類歷史上的重要時刻留下自己的印記。 新時代的黎明 歡迎來到 19 世紀這個工業化、外交活絡且發明眾多的時代。這個充滿科技創新、陰謀詭計以及爾虞我詐的時代，是讓《美麗新世界》經典遊戲機制大放異彩的絕佳舞台。《美麗新世界 1800》提供玩家豐富的機會展現他們的治理手腕，他們將可建立大都會、規劃有效率的物流網路、殖民海外新大陸、派遠征隊前往世界各地，以及透過外交、貿易或戰爭手段征服他們的對手。 經典《美麗新世界》遊戲體驗 《美麗新世界 1800》結合了 20 多年來深受玩家喜愛的《美麗新世界》遊戲特色，例如獨特的電腦對手、可運送的貿易貨物、隨機產生的地圖、多段式遊戲玩法等等。此外，還有豐富的城市建造體驗，包括有故事的戰役、自訂自由度高的沙盒模式，以及經典的《美麗新世界》多人遊戲體驗。 新時代、新特色 為了栩栩如生呈現這個重要的歷史時代，建立在本系列豐富傳統之上的《美麗新世界 1800》導入了許多全新特色。遠征隊允許玩家派出由專家組成的隊伍到全球各地尋求名聲與財富，而新的勞動力特色則可讓玩家依照需求更實際地管理自己的工廠。最後，玩家將可以殖民南美洲，奪取支持這個工業新時代的黑金。 選擇你的勝利策略 作為繁榮昌盛大都會的領導者，你必須依據各種新局面調整策略：建立多條生產鏈滿足居民需求、與共享世界的其他電腦統治者打交道，以及建立可獲利的貿易路線網創造繁榮。
detailed_descriptions.ja: Anno 1800™ - 新世紀の開拓者たれ！ 産業化時代の幕開へようこそ。あなたの選択によってこの世界の未来が左右されます。あなたは発明家それとも探検家ですか？征服者ですか？それとも自由主義者ですか？どのような形で歴史に残るかはあなた次第です。 Anno 1800 でプレイヤーは煙に包まれたヨーロッパから緑が生い茂る南アフリカにかけて産業王国を築き上げるべく、産業発展そして政治的社会の変化が著しい環境の中資産を管理します。 新しい時代の幕開け 技術革新、新大陸の発見、社会秩序の変革など歴史上最大規模の変革が起こったこの時代。あなたの想像力で新しい世界を作り上げよう。これらのあらゆる要素がAnnoには用意されています。産業革命期の世界中を駆け巡り、あなた自身の物語を紡いでください。 Anno1800ではプレイヤーは巨大な都市を作り出し、物流を管理し、世界各地に探検隊を送り出し、外交、貿易、戦争を通して未開の地を占領します。無数のチャレンジによってプレイヤーは腕を試されるのです。 クラシックな体験 Anno1880は20年にわたるAnnoシリーズの集大成です。個々のAI、ランダム生成のマップ、マルチセッションのゲームプレイなどの素晴らしい要素が本作に結集しました。これによってストーリーベースのキャンペーン、自在にカスタマイズ可能なサンドボックスモード、そしてマルチプレイヤーモードを含む充実した都市づくりを楽しむことができるのです。 新しい時代にふさわしい新しい機能 この革新的な時代を再現するために、Anno1800では過去作の機能に加えて、多くの新機能が導入されます。探検機能では専門家のクルーを未開の地に派遣し富を拡大し、労働力機能では工場の管理が今まで以上にリアルに実行することが可能です。石油が社会を支える産業の新時代に開発最終の地、南アフリカを植民地としましょう。 勝利を勝ち取るには戦略を 大都市の発展を先導するにはシチュエーションごとの適応能力が求められます。あなたの世界を共有するAI指導者に注意しながら、新しい生産ラインを作り住居者の要求を満たし、貿易流通を拡大して発展を加速するのです。
detailed_descriptions.ko: Anno 1800™ – 산업 혁명을 주도하라! 바야흐로 산업화가 태동하는 시대입니다. 당신이 어떤 길을 선택하는가에 따라 세계는 달라집니다. 혁신에 매진할 것인가, 아니면 노동자를 착취할 것인가? 정복을 추구할 것인가, 아니면 자유를 중시할 것인가? 격변하는 시기에 어떻게 세상에 이름을 떨치고 싶은지 스스로 결정하십시오 Anno 1800에서는 플레이어는 기술력이 빠르게 진화하고 첨예한 정치적 긴장이 발발하던 19세기를 헤쳐나가며 자신의 운명을 개척해야 합니다. 뿌연 스모그로 뒤덮인 유럽 도시로부터 비옥한 남미 정글까지 제국을 건설하기 위한 퀘스트를 이어나가십시오 팬들의 사랑을 받던 기능들과 혁신적인 게임플레이를 결합한 Anno 1800는 Anno 시리즈에 새로운 장을 열어줄 것입니다. 인류 역사를 그려나가는 이 시리즈에 여러분의 자취를 남겨 주십시오. 새로운 시대의 여명 산업화, 외교, 탐험의 시대인 19세기에 오신 걸 환영합니다. 기술력이 놀랍게 진보하고 음모가 판을 치면서 오늘의 동지가 내일의 적이 되는 이 시기는 Anno 시리즈의 핵심 게임플레이에 최적의 설정을 제공합니다. Anno 1800에서 다양한 기회를 통해 통치자로서 능력을 마음껏 발휘해 보십시오. 대도시를 건설하고, 효율적인 유통망을 구축하고, 이국적인 신대륙에 정착하고, 전세계로 원정대를 보내고, 외교와 무역, 때로는 전쟁까지 불사하며 적들을 제압할 수 있습니다. 전통적인 ANNO 게임플레이 Anno 1800에서는 20년간 지속된 Anno 시리즈에서 사랑받던 기능들을 즐길 수 있습니다. 깊이있는 도시 건설 체험에 더하여 스토리를 따라가는 캠페인, 세밀하게 커스터마이징할 수 있는 샌드박스 모드, 전통적인 멀티플레이도 제공합니다. 대적하는 개별 AI, 선적할 수 있는 무역 상품, 무작위로 생성되는 맵, 멀티세션 게임플레이, 다양한 아이템 등 팬 여러분들께 익숙한 기능들이 돌아옵니다. 새로운 장을 여는 특별한 기능 역사적으로 큰 전환점이 되었던 시기를 구현하기 위해 Anno 1800에서는 새로운 기능들을 추가했습니다. 전세계로 특별한 임무를 띤 원정대를 보내서 명성과 부를 쌓고, 노동력 관리 기능으로 공장을 훨씬 현실적으로 운영하여 이윤을 추구해 보십시오. 게다가 남미 지역에 정착하여 석유 소유권을 차지하면 산업화 시대에서 세력을 한층 강화할 수 있습니다. 승리하기 위한 최적의 전략 선택 대도시가 번창하도록 이끌려면 새로운 상황에 맞는 전략을 도입해야 합니다. 무수한 생산 라인을 건설하고, 다른 AI 통치자들과 협상을 벌이고, 이윤을 창출하는 무역로를 개척해서 경제적 기반을 탄탄히 하여 거주자들이 안정적으로 삶을 꾸려나갈 수 있도록 해 주십시오.

games.name: ANNO: Mutationem
games.short_description: ANNO: Mutationem is an action-adventure game with RPG elements set in a cyberpunk world, featuring a unique mix of pixelated 2D & 3D graphic style with a rich, dark and bizarre plot.

descriptions.en: ANNO: Mutationem is an action-adventure game with RPG elements set in a cyberpunk world, featuring a unique mix of pixelated 2D & 3D graphic style with a rich, dark and bizarre plot.

detailed_descriptions.en: Welcome to the neon-covered, 2D-meets-3D Cyberpunk world of ANNO: Mutationem. In this Action-Adventure game with RPG elements you become Ann: a highly-skilled combat-trained lone wolf on a personal mission in the giant Metropolis, full of sinister mega-corporations, mysterious fringe groups and creatures more bizarre than words can express. Explore and discover This is a world full of surprises waiting for you to find out! While going thru the main story you can chat with a Cyborg corgi, take on a part-time bartender job, hunt down vicious criminals reveal the true face of a trending V-streamer! By exploring diverse locations such as neon Noctis Town, an off-shore cargo ship and huge underground structures, players are free to go as they please and act as they want. Showing new perspective Unique 2D-to-3D gameplay, seamless switching between 2D Action n' Platforming and 3D Exploration to interact with the world and its inhabitants. Let's dive into pixel gaming from another perspective! Ann kicks Ass Ann will slash, shoot, combo, grenade-throw & ground-pound her way through hordes of enemies and huge bosses. From great swords to double blades, from pistols to rocket launchers and uppercuts, time to become the one-girl army you always knew you had in you. Try to finish the jigsaw A grand story, befitting a rich and dark cyberpunk décor, featuring our main hero Ann Flores and her trusty hyper hacker side-kick Ayane on a personal mission to find out where her missing brother has gone to. Little do the two know just what they will unravel… Please arm yourself to teeth Collect, buy or craft items & upgrade Ann's stats, skills and gear. Use chips to modify any kind of weapon you find. Equip Ann and make her combat-ready for all enemies (both humanoid and not…) that are about to head her way.

games.name: Anomalous Coffee Machine 2
games.short_description: In this game, meet a mysterious girl who demands you use an "Anomalous Coffee Machine". Type any word to create a drink, then choose who drinks: her or you. Some cups whisper, some scream, some change what you are. She watches quietly, like she already knows what you’ll choose. Now it's your turn!

descriptions.en: In this game, meet a mysterious girl who demands you use an "Anomalous Coffee Machine". Type any word to create a drink, then choose who drinks: her or you. Some cups whisper, some scream, some change what you are. She watches quietly, like she already knows what you’ll choose. Now it's your turn!

detailed_descriptions.en: Anomalous Coffee Machine 2 is a strange interactive visual novel and fictional simulation where you stand across from a mysterious girl and an unassuming coffee vending machine capable of producing anything you type, no matter how impossible it seems. She doesn’t tell you who she is, why she's there, or what's the deal with the coffee machine. All she asks is that you type a word—any word—and press the button. The machine will respond. It always does. Type in "coffee" , and you’ll receive exactly that. Type "blood" —yeah, sure. Type "saliva" —You probably shouldn’t, but it can do that too. Type "death"? You can try. HOW TO PLAY Gameplay is simple: Type a word. A cup appears. Choose who drinks: the girl, or you. Something happens. Or doesn’t. Or waits. She reacts differently depending on what you give her. Sometimes she smiles. Sometimes she winces. Sometimes she vanishes, only to return changed. Sometimes she doesn’t come back at all. And if you choose to drink, the machine reacts to you instead. Don’t expect a fair trade. There are no instructions. No quests. No markers to follow. You’re not told what the machine is or what it wants. You’re left to experiment. Test words. Try feelings. Push the machine. Break it. Or let it break you.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Anomalous Coffee Machine 2 is a strange interactive visual novel and fictional simulation where you stand across from a mysterious girl and an unassuming coffee vending machine capable of producing anything you type, no matter how impossible it seems.

She doesn’t tell you who she is, why she's there, or what's the deal with the coffee machine. All she asks is that you type a word—any word—and press the button. The machine will respond. It always does.

Type in "coffee", and you’ll receive exactly that.
Type "blood"—yeah, sure.
Type "saliva"—You probably shouldn’t, but it can do that too.
Type "death"? You can try.

HOW TO PLAY

Gameplay is simple:

  • Type a word.

  • A cup appears.

  • Choose who drinks: the girl, or you.

  • Something happens. Or doesn’t. Or waits.

She reacts differently depending on what you give her. Sometimes she smiles. Sometimes she winces. Sometimes she vanishes, only to return changed. Sometimes she doesn’t come back at all. And if you choose to drink, the machine reacts to you instead. Don’t expect a fair trade.

There are no instructions. No quests. No markers to follow. You’re not told what the machine is or what it wants. You’re left to experiment. Test words. Try feelings. Push the machine. Break it. Or let it break you.

games.name: Anomaly Company
games.short_description: You and your crew are sent in to assess reality in this 4-player co-op horror game. Memorize the environment. Spot disturbing anomalies. Decide if the timeline is safe. One bad call—and you’re forced to start over.

descriptions.en: You and your crew are sent in to assess reality in this 4-player co-op horror game. Memorize the environment. Spot disturbing anomalies. Decide if the timeline is safe. One bad call—and you’re forced to start over.

detailed_descriptions.en: WELCOME TO THE COMPANY, CREW MEMBER... READY TO PURGE SOME ANOMALIES? In Anomaly Company you and your crew are sent in to assess reality in this 4-player co-op horror game . Set in realistic, liminal environments, you must memorize your surroundings and spot disturbing anomalies . Decide if the timeline is safe. One bad call—and you’re forced to start over. ARE YOU PREPARED TO CONTAIN THE ANOMALOUS TIMELINES? GAMEPLAY 1–4 Player Online Co-Op Play solo or with up to 4 players online in a cooperative horror experience. Communicate using voice chat or text chat to analyze environments, share observations, and argue over whether an anomaly is present. Your Job as a Crew member Each level begins in a stable state. Memorize the environment, then watch closely as subtle changes, disturbing anomalies, and terrifying events may occur. Decide whether the timeline is safe or must be purged to progress. A SOLO DEV PROJECT I’m a solo developer working on Anomaly Company entirely by myself. Every feature, update, and fix is made by me. Because of this, development can be slower than that of a typical game studio—but it also means the game is built with care, passion, and close attention to player feedback . THINGS YOU CAN DO IN ANOMALY COMPANY 1–4 Player Online Co-Op Co-Op Horror Gameplay High Replayability Voice Chat & Text Chat Realistic & Liminal Environments Disturbing Anomalies & Jumpscares Observation-Based Gameplay Unique maps , each with a unique setting and loads of anomalies ENTER A WORLD THAT FEELS UNCOMFORTABLY REAL EXPERIENCE THE TERRORS OF THE ASYLUM, WHILE YOU UNRAVEL ITS INSANITY FACE ABSURD ANOMALIES, CHAOS, AND UNPREDICTABLE HORRORS FOLLOW PROTOCOL. TRUST YOUR CREW. MAKE THE COMPANY PROUD. You work for the Anomaly Company . Trust your memory. Question reality.

WELCOME TO THE COMPANY, CREW MEMBER... READY TO PURGE SOME ANOMALIES?

In Anomaly Company you and your crew are sent in to assess reality in this 4-player co-op horror game. Set in realistic, liminal environments, you must memorize your surroundings and spot disturbing anomalies. Decide if the timeline is safe. One bad call—and you’re forced to start over.

ARE YOU PREPARED TO CONTAIN THE ANOMALOUS TIMELINES?

GAMEPLAY

  • 1–4 Player Online Co-Op
    Play solo or with up to 4 players online in a cooperative horror experience. Communicate using voice chat or text chat to analyze environments, share observations, and argue over whether an anomaly is present.

  • Your Job as a Crew member
    Each level begins in a stable state. Memorize the environment, then watch closely as subtle changes, disturbing anomalies, and terrifying events may occur. Decide whether the timeline is safe or must be purged to progress.

A SOLO DEV PROJECT

I’m a solo developer working on Anomaly Company entirely by myself. Every feature, update, and fix is made by me. Because of this, development can be slower than that of a typical game studio—but it also means the game is built with care, passion, and close attention to player feedback.

In a world filled with anomalies, you will encounter various enemies and vice president bosses, each with their own unique anomaly power. The best part is, the rogue-like structure lets you experiment with all options. Try out different powers and progress with the one that best suits your style! games.short_description: Hack Into God

descriptions.en: Hack Into God

detailed_descriptions.en: This is the latest work by STEINS;GATE creator Chiyomaru Shikura, in collaboration with returning staff from the Science Adventure Series. 2037. Nakano, Tokyo. Pollon Takaoka and his best friend Cross Yumikawa make a living as a pro hackers wherever they can; wherever hasn't been affected by the "Sad Morning" disaster that occurred February 6th, 2036. One day, Pollon declares he is going to "elope," despite the fact that he is single. However, he meets a mysterious girl called Momo in a place no one is supposed to be... Suddenly, mysterious assailants appear and chase after Momo. During the escape, Pollon receives the "Save & Load" app which allows him to save data and start over just like a video game. Little does he realize this is only the beginning... The mysterious, genius hacker "Cicada 3301" who organizes a series of "Quests" that seem impossible to solve. The "Gaia Institute" that reactivated the earth simulation which was supposed to be frozen. The thugs from Vatican's "513 Holy Office," working behind the scenes... Pollon is thrown into numerous plots as a result of his encounter with Momo, and faces a major event that shakes the world. What truth awaits you when you use hacking, saving, and loading? Hack the myriad branches of reality and "load" the ending that saves the world! This is the story of the hackers who will rewrite the future. About the gameplay ANONYMOUS;CODE is a visual novel where cooperation between you, the Player, and Pollon is the key to success. Advise Pollon on when to Save and Load. Your choices and Pollon's actions determine the outcome of the story. Use the Hacking Trigger, an interactive scenario-branching system. Instead of a conventional story system, the Player uses their own judgment and the Hacking Trigger command to help Pollon decide when to Load and change the future. Controller Support: Developer's Recommended Configuration This game has partial controller support, the developer recommends the Gamepad template.

games.short_description: Apewar is an online tactical and action FPS/TPS monkey war game adapted from real life. Build your monkey team and fight against your enemies. By playing in a coordinated way, you can have fun and win with a good strategy. Monkeys are strong together!

descriptions.en: Apewar is an online tactical and action FPS/TPS monkey war game adapted from real life. Build your monkey team and fight against your enemies. By playing in a coordinated way, you can have fun and win with a good strategy. Monkeys are strong together!

detailed_descriptions.en: Apewar is an online tactical and action FPS/TPS monkey war game adapted from real life. Build your monkey team and fight against your enemies. Defend the bananas! By playing the game in a coordinated way, you can have fun and win with a good strategy. You can have fun moments in the game with many map options. Remember the saying: Monkeys are strong together! Get support from artificial intelligence bots while building your team in the game. Place bot players on your team to strengthen your army. Find and drive and control a number of vehicles only in certain areas of the maps. You can crush the monkeys in the enemy team with your vehicle. You can taste the realism in the game. For example, if you stay too long in the sea, you will drown and die. The game has Free for All, Team Deathmatch and a Grab Banana mode. The most entertaining one among these modes is that both teams are trying to reach. You have limited time to seize these bananas and take them to your area. Since these bananas are located in the area of the map where there is the most combat and action, you may be shot and killed by the enemies while you pick up the banana and transport it to your area! The Gombe Chimpanzee War is a series of violent conflicts between two chimpanzee communities in Gombe National Park, Tanzania, that lasted from 1974 to 1978. Researcher Jane Goodall, director of the Gombe Stream Research Center, wrote in her memoir “Through a Window: My Thirty Years with the Chimpanzees of Gombe”: “For several years I struggled to face this new reality. Most of the time I woke up at night because of scary images coming to my mind. Satan [one of the monkeys] clasped his hand under his chin to drink the blood gushing from a large wound on the Sniff's face... Old Rodolf, who was mostly kind and calm, slammed Godi's slumped body with a four-pound stone. . Jomeo rips a piece of meat from Dé's thigh... Figan repeatedly attacks and hits the scarred, trembling body of Goliath, one of his childhood heroes... »

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Apewar is an online tactical and action FPS/TPS monkey war game adapted from real life. Build your monkey team and fight against your enemies. Defend the bananas! By playing the game in a coordinated way, you can have fun and win with a good strategy. You can have fun moments in the game with many map options. Remember the saying: Monkeys are strong together!

Get support from artificial intelligence bots while building your team in the game. Place bot players on your team to strengthen your army. Find and drive and control a number of vehicles only in certain areas of the maps. You can crush the monkeys in the enemy team with your vehicle. You can taste the realism in the game. For example, if you stay too long in the sea, you will drown and die.

The game has Free for All, Team Deathmatch and a Grab Banana mode. The most entertaining one among these modes is that both teams are trying to reach. You have limited time to seize these bananas and take them to your area. Since these bananas are located in the area of the map where there is the most combat and action, you may be shot and killed by the enemies while you pick up the banana and transport it to your area!

The Gombe Chimpanzee War is a series of violent conflicts between two chimpanzee communities in Gombe National Park, Tanzania, that lasted from 1974 to 1978. Researcher Jane Goodall, director of the Gombe Stream Research Center, wrote in her memoir “Through a Window: My Thirty Years with the Chimpanzees of Gombe”: “For several years I struggled to face this new reality. Most of the time I woke up at night because of scary images coming to my mind. Satan [one of the monkeys] clasped his hand under his chin to drink the blood gushing from a large wound on the Sniff's face... Old Rodolf, who was mostly kind and calm, slammed Godi's slumped body with a four-pound stone. . Jomeo rips a piece of meat from Dé's thigh... Figan repeatedly attacks and hits the scarred, trembling body of Goliath, one of his childhood heroes... »

games.name: Apocalypse Express
games.short_description: Conduct, upgrade and repair your train through endless waves of enemies in a post-apocalyptic setting. In this action management roguelike, the player decides to embark on a journey through the wasteland looking to fulfill the dream of seeing the remains of the outside world.

descriptions.en: Conduct, upgrade and repair your train through endless waves of enemies in a post-apocalyptic setting. In this action management roguelike, the player decides to embark on a journey through the wasteland looking to fulfill the dream of seeing the remains of the outside world.

detailed_descriptions.en: Apocalypse Express is an action management Roguelike in which the player conducts, upgrades and repairs different parts of the train through endless waves of enemies in a post-apocalyptic setting. Departing the darkness of their lifelong shelter, the player decides to embark on a journey through the wasteland looking to fulfill the dream of seeing the outside world with their own eyes, charting out a map around the few remaining memories of the past world. Manage the Chaos Be prepared for some nail-biting tension as you try to keep your train running while balancing putting out fires, collecting resources and dispatching enemies. You won't always be able to take care of every part of the Train so be ready to think fast and smart as things will not go as planned. Modules Modules are the foundation of your Build. Fill up your Wagons with various modules each giving you unique abilities. There are Modules for every type of Wastelander. Go full offense by building up an arsenal of cannons, rocket launchers and turrets, obliterating everything in your path. Take the more defensive approach and create an indestructible machine built around disabling enemies, deflecting shots and extinguishing fires, keeping your train healthy and running even through the harshest conditions. Or experiment with other combinations, perhaps go with a speedy train that gets you to your destination faster or even create a completely autonomous system that does all the work for you. Your slots are limited, so choose wisely. Upgrades Once you've assembled your perfect combination of modules it's time to make them shine. Each module can be upgraded in dozens of interesting ways, either by making them more powerful or introducing completely new abilities. Relics Relics are the final piece of the puzzle, you can only have a few of them but relics often bring powerful and impactful effects that can be the backbone of some amazing builds! Mix and match them to find the best combination to create the perfect Train.

games.name: Apocalypter
games.short_description: Apocalypter is a post-apocalyptic, driving, survival, fps, open-world game. Fight, help, trade with different factions. Find different cars and customize them. Scavenge, loot and survive the procedurally generated, open world of Apocalypter.

descriptions.en: Apocalypter is a post-apocalyptic, driving, survival, fps, open-world game. Fight, help, trade with different factions. Find different cars and customize them. Scavenge, loot and survive the procedurally generated, open world of Apocalypter.

detailed_descriptions.en: Try to survive in this savage post-apocalyptic world with your customized cars . You must fight , help or trade to stay alive. Eliminate all the warlords and attach their trophies to your car. Find different cars and customize them with Apocalypter's unique customization system. Scavenge , loot and build your perfect car to survive the procedurally generated , open world of Apocalypter. Car customization Any kind of car part can be installed to any car, no limitations . Install better suspension, engine, radiator . Cosmetic parts such as steering wheel, gear lever, seats etc. Move and rotate engine, exhaust or radiator to you liking with the part adjuster tool. Install roof rack, crates and boxes for more storage . Combat Many different melee and ranged weapons, guns with different stats and calibers. Enemies also use these weapons and randomly drop their ammo, weapons or healing items . Equip body armor , bandage or first aid kit . Survival Eat the bugs, dogfood and mystery meats . Make you car into a moving base , by using portable maggot farms, dew collectors, weed and tobacco plants. Butcher animals, mutants and cook their meat. Exploration Explore the infinite, procedurally generated world. Use your compass and landmarks to navigate . Follow roads for easier navigation, but don't get attached to them, sometimes they lead to nowhere. Find abandoned buildings , wrecks , caves , faction camps and bases . Trade or fight with different factions . Trade Sell items that you looted and don't need. Buy various items from traders. Merchants have randomized items that they sell and buy. Currency in Apocalypter is rusted nuts , collect them and use them to buy items you need. Character upgrade Upgrade your character with body armor , backpack , flashlight and binocular for better survivability. Features: Post-apocalyptic world Customizable cars Lot's of car parts that can be installed to any car Different melee and ranged weapons Factions Many different enemy types, mutants Boss fights Scavenge, loot, survive Butchering, cooking Character upgrades (body armor, backpack, flashlight etc) Trading, buy/sell Open world Procedurally generated random world Day/Night cycle Partial Controller Support (driving only) Steering wheel support Demo note: The Demo is an outdated version of the game with much less content, only one car, one boss, and only one save slot.

games.name: Approximately Up
games.short_description: Build, crash, rebuild! Explore new planets in co-op multiplayer with your fully modular spaceship made from whatever bolts together long enough to fly. Mount giant thrusters, annoying cables, and everything in between. Complete wild missions, face the dangers of space and argue with your crew!

descriptions.en: Build, crash, rebuild! Explore new planets in co-op multiplayer with your fully modular spaceship made from whatever bolts together long enough to fly. Mount giant thrusters, annoying cables, and everything in between. Complete wild missions, face the dangers of space and argue with your crew!

detailed_descriptions.en: Approximately Up is your best chance to experience spaceflight in whatever you and your crew (singleplayer or co-op multiplayer with up to 4 players ) can bolt together! Build epic spaceships or barely flying trashcans — it’s entirely up to you. Control your creation from a first-person view right from the deck of your ship . Complete challenging objectives, hunt achievements, face the dangers of space, and collect new components to expand your current spacecraft — or build hundreds of new ones. One is never enough! Build spaceships! Everything begins with a single piece of frame and grows into a massive, complex ship built from thousands of components. Create automated systems, experiment with different input controllers, sensors, and meters — connect them to whatever you need, and let the magic (or chaos) happen! Once it looks ready (or not), hit launch and see what happens! Complete challenging objectives! Experimental power sources that need to be delivered to a station on another planet — causing unexpected power outages mid-flight? Some strange energy crystal charging up like a ticking time bomb? Or maybe it’s just a massive, ridiculously heavy submarine this time? Can your spaceship handle that? Explore the new planets! Is the planet covered in oceans? What’s hiding beneath that thick atmosphere? Can you see the surface through those massive clouds? Everything’s waiting for you to find out! Explore 15 unique planets , each with its own look, feel, and dynamic soundtrack that changes in real time as you explore and make new discoveries! Blame each other! Who forgot to connect that cable? Who mounted the thruster backward? Who forgot the solar panels? Or the door-opening button? Is the radar working? How about the batteries? Enjoy the hilarious chaos in co-op multiplayer with up to 4 players — and find out once and for all... WHOSE FAULT WAS IT?! So how does it works? You start on Earth and slowly explore a system of 15 planets , each with its own size, gravity, atmosphere, temperature, and challenges that make every world feel different. Most planets have one or more Planet Stations , which work as checkpoints and garages where you can build ships and start new missions. When you land on a station, it unlocks permanently and becomes a new place you can launch from. To reach these planets, you build your own modular spaceships and experiment with different parts - electric engines, fuel engines, mixed fuels, solar panels, heat-resistant frames, and more. By completing missions like delivering components between planets, you earn new ship parts that let you create better and more advanced designs. All flights are fully first-person from inside your craft, and because distances are huge, your ship design really matters - some trips will take only minutes , while others can turn into long journeys if your ship is weak. The whole game is about exploring planets, upgrading your ships, unlocking new stations, and trying to make it to your destination without crashing. Note: Demo currently supports English only. Additional languages will be available in the full release.

games.name: Aquapark Tycoon
games.short_description: Build the ultimate waterpark paradise in this classic tycoon simulation game! Design & customize water slides, pools, and saunas to fulfill your guests' needs. Combine creativity, strategy, and management to make a splash in the world of water parks and become the ultimate Aquapark Tycoon!

descriptions.en: Build the ultimate waterpark paradise in this classic tycoon simulation game! Design & customize water slides, pools, and saunas to fulfill your guests' needs. Combine creativity, strategy, and management to make a splash in the world of water parks and become the ultimate Aquapark Tycoon!

detailed_descriptions.en: Dive into the thrilling world of Aquapark Tycoon! Create the ultimate pool paradise from the ground up in this classic tycoon simulation game that offers endless creativity and challenges, whether you're a seasoned waterpark magnate or a newbie pool start-up. Combine creativity, strategy, and management, and make a splash in the world of waterparks to become the ultimate Aquapark Tycoon! Slide Building Use your creativity and engineer the wildest water slides the world has ever seen! From towering spirals to adrenaline-pumping speed chutes, you design every twist, turn, and splash. Customize slides to cater to all thrill levels, ensuring guests of all ages have the time of their lives. But make sure your guests won't fly off into the stratosphere. Pool Building Design beautiful pools that serve as the heart of your waterpark. From action-packed wave pools to luxurious wellness oases, your pools will be the place where memories are made. Tailor each pool's shape, depth, temperature, water, and attractions to create a diverse environment that satisfies all your guests' needs. Sauna Building Make your park a place for cozy relaxation and luxury with special sauna facilities. Customize temperature settings, scents, aesthetics, and amenities to provide a top-tier wellness experience, and satisfy guests seeking a peaceful retreat from the excitement. Define your park's own infusion schedule, using a wide range of essential oils and aromas. Each infusion & aroma offers different benefits and attracts guests with different tastes. Co-op Gameplay Enjoy the fun with friends in Aquapark Tycoon’s co-op gameplay mode! Join forces with other tycoons to build and manage the most extravagant waterpark the world has ever seen. Strategize together and divide management duties to optimize your park's success. Share your builds on the Steam Workshop for everyone else to enjoy, or use Workshop builds in your park. Guests' Needs & Preferences Keep an eye on the desires and needs of your guests. Whether they're looking for thrill, sports, relaxation, or wellness options, your ability to meet their expectations determines your park's success. Take in their feedback and adapt your park to build an enjoyable park for a wide range of guests, from thrill-seeking kids to adventurous seniors. Make sure everyone finds their favorite spot, whether it's the kiddie pool, the extreme slides, or the pool bar in a calming thermal pool. Park Management Oversee every aspect of your park's operation, and shape the future of your aquatic wonderland. Use indoor and outdoor areas to your advantage to be prepared for different weather conditions and seasons. Define different areas to optimize your park layout for maximum enjoyment and efficiency, ensuring every guest leaves with a smile. Staff Management Hire and manage a team of professionals to keep your park running smoothly. From lifeguards who oversee the safety of your guests, entertaining sauna masters performing fun infusions, to maintenance workers taking care of the behind-the-scenes stuff, each staff member plays an important role in creating a safe and enjoyable environment for all. Diverse Scenarios Embark on a journey through a variety of scenarios that test your creativity and management skills. Each scenario offers unique objectives and constraints. Be it an easy outdoor park in a summer land where it's always sunny and beautiful, or challenging swinging seasons that sway your guests' preferences, where summer's heat drives guests outside into cool refreshing pools, and low temperatures in winter turn the cozy warmth of your saunas into your guests' favorite retreat. You’ll need to be on top of your game to keep your park afloat and your guests happy.
