games.short_description: THE OLD WEST, 1864. In order to save their family, the McCall brothers will kill anyone who stands between them and the legendary Gold of Juarez.

descriptions.en: THE OLD WEST, 1864. In order to save their family, the McCall brothers will kill anyone who stands between them and the legendary Gold of Juarez.

detailed_descriptions.en: THE OLD WEST, 1864. In order to save their family, the McCall brothers will kill anyone who stands between them and the legendary Gold of Juarez. But when the allure of money and women tests their bond, will the blood they share prove to be thicker than water? Become a Gunslinger — Harness an array of weapons, from various revolvers to heavy-caliber cannons and machine guns. Every accurate shot increases your concentration, which allows you to unleash deadly shooting modes when outnumbered — and even deadlier ones when the brothers work together. Brothers in Arms — Choose to embody Ray or Thomas, each with a distinctive gameplay style (close- or long-range), specific abilities (lasso, dynamite, etc.) and arsenal of deadly weapons (dual guns, long-range carbine, etc.). Take advantage of their strengths and you just might survive some of the fiercest fights imaginable. Immersive Western Experience — Explore vast natural landscapes of the untamed mythical Old West on foot, horseback, in wagons and canoes. Visit iconic settings full of outlaws. The McCall brothers face a renegade Apache chief, a greedy Mexican bandit, a vindictive colonel — and those are just a few of the underhanded villains standing in the brothers’ way. Please note that as of August 2016, the online features for this game are no longer supported. The Multiplayer mode / Co-op mode will no longer be accessible.

Become the West’s finest Choose the specific gun-fighting skills you want to develop and acquire new shooting abilities to become the West’s finest gunslinger. games.name: Call of the Elder Gods
games.short_description: Journey to the far corners of the Earth and unearth ancient horrors in this Lovecraftian narrative puzzle adventure and sequel to 2020’s critically acclaimed Call of the Sea.

descriptions.en: Journey to the far corners of the Earth and unearth ancient horrors in this Lovecraftian narrative puzzle adventure and sequel to 2020’s critically acclaimed Call of the Sea.

detailed_descriptions.en: All is not well at Miskatonic University. Professor Harry Everhart tries to ignore the shadows flitting at the corners of his vision, while student Evangeline Drayton is haunted with impossible dreams of an artifact uncovered a decade ago. In their search for answers, the pair will uncover revelations more ancient than anyone could have imagined. Shocking Secrets Call of the Sea’s object and observation-based puzzles return with new depth. Scour richly-rendered environments for clues. Swap between Harry and Evangeline to solve complex, multi-part problems across time and space. Choose your own difficulty level with toggle-able hints, icons, and journal entries Dizzying Marvels Harry and Evangeline’s journey takes them from the firelit libraries of a New England mansion to the red sands of the Australian outback, through frozen wastelands and otherworldly cities out of time, all stunningly rendered in Unreal Engine 5 and featuring a soundtrack by multi-award-winning returning composer Eduardo De La Iglesia. A Shadow Out of Time Follow Harry Everhart and Evangeline Drayton as they search for the truth about their missing loved ones and come face-to-face with beings beyond their understanding. Inspired by H P Lovecraft's 'The Shadow out of Time', Call of the Elder Gods features a fully voice-acted story of grief, family, and sanity, starring returning talents Yuri Lowenthal (Spider-Man, Arcane, Final Fantasy VII Rebirth) and Cissy Jones (Firewatch, Starfield, Baldur’s Gate III).

detailed_descriptions.en: It is 1934, in the far reaches of the South Pacific. Norah has crossed the ocean following the trail of her missing husband’s expedition and finds herself on a lush island paradise - a nameless, forgotten place, dotted with the remnants of a lost civilization. What strange secrets does it hold, and what might Norah unearth in her quest for the truth? Explore and investigate a stunning tropical island, brimming with fantastic sights, lost ruins, and occult mysteries. Investigate the clues left by a previous voyage, piece together what happened, and solve a variety of clever puzzles. Experience a charming character study of a woman on her quest to discover the truth of the disappearance of her husband and to find out who she really is. Norah is fully voiced by Cissy Jones (Firewatch, The Walking Dead: Season 1, Baldur’s Gate III). Immerse yourself in a story-driven adventure full of emotion, suspense, and surreal surprises.

detailed_descriptions.en: Call of the Wild: The Angler is an open world fishing game that delivers the challenge of the catch and the freedom to explore. Play solo or with up to 11 friends and experience the thrill of finding and fighting Legendary fish species. Key features: • Find and fight a wide variety of fish species with behaviors influenced by various factors such as time of day, location, and your actions. • Immerse yourself in authentic fish fights. Relax and unwind in realistic natural settings inspired by some of the world’s most beautiful real-life locations. • Master different varieties of fishing techniques, including float fishing, lure spinning, and bottom fishing. • Choose from a wide range of rods, reels, tackles, and lures. Choose whether to fish in the morning, day, evening, or night.

detailed_descriptions.en: Call to Arms offers an innovative mix of real-time strategy and 3rd, as well as 1st person controls. Set in the time of modern warfare, the game offers realistically modeled vehicles and heavy weaponry, as well as dozens of firearms and customizations. Command your troops to victory or fight by yourself in the 3rd or 1st person action mode. Conquer rural areas, factories, railway stations and towns during intense missions and use the environment to your advantage. Cover is everywhere, and almost everything can be destroyed. An unseen amount of challenges are awaiting you in exciting, yet competitive online combat supported by Steamworks! Real-Time Strategy Control several dozen units and place your squads in cover, flank your enemies and support your allies while advancing to the next key objective. Plant claymores, fortifiy FOBs, or set up mortar positions. There is an endless amount of options to choose in the RTS mode of Call to Arms. 1st/3rd Person Controls Not only can you defeat your enemies as a commander, but also by taking over any of your individual soldiers. You can control them in 3rd person view, as well as first person. The game has no limits! Tanks Take over one of your vehicles at any time and join the heat of combat during intense tank warfare! Call to Arms offers you the ability to control every single unit to the last bit, including the type of ammunition you can use to take out enemy targets. Helicopters If you need that little bit of extra fire power, then hop into a helicopter and support your allies in online matches with some serious air support that leaves no room for escape!

names.en: Call to Arms - Gates of Hell: Airborne

games.short_description: Re-live the legendary operations of the 82nd and 101st US airborne divisions. This DLC offers a new immersive single-player format which takes you from the first para drops in Normandy through Market Garden, the battle of the Bulge and the crossing of the Elbe River.

descriptions.en: Re-live the legendary operations of the 82nd and 101st US airborne divisions. This DLC offers a new immersive single-player format which takes you from the first para drops in Normandy through Market Garden, the battle of the Bulge and the crossing of the Elbe River.

detailed_descriptions.en: A Spectacular US Airborne Operations DLC for Call to Arms - Gates of Hell: Ostfront. This DLC brings you a superbly detailed storyline, following the US airborne operations in western Europe in an exciting and immersive new format. It features some of the most iconic battles fought by US paratroopers from the 82nd and 101st airborne divisions in World War 2. Action Re-live the adrenaline-packed battles that helped decide the outcome of the war. Step into the boots of the 82nd and 101st airborne divisions and fight your way through France, Belgium, the Netherlands, and Germany. Jump into action over St. Mère-Église, fight for Brécourt Manor, take part in Operation Market Garden. Defend Bastogne during the harsh winter of 1944-45 and push on into Germany to the crossing of the Elbe river. Every historical scene adds to an unforgettable journey, paying tribute to some of the bravest men to see action in the entirety of WWII, men whose names have been added to the roster of characters in the missions. New Single Player format In this DLC you will experience a new feel to single-player missions. Crafted with the feedback of the community in mind, we have created deep, immersive, and complex missions that have a huge appeal to lovers of cinematic and action-packed single-player. You can expect novel or upgraded features such as complex secret objectives, and more. Content of this DLC The Airborne DLC contains the following new content: 12 single-player missions for the US 101st and 82nd Airborne divisions (these missions can be played in Co-Op as well) Over 100 new environment models for the key locations featured in the missions, including an assortment of map assets for the Netherlands 9 new vehicles: C-47 Skytrain 2cm Flakvierling 38 10.5cm LeFH 18/40 Sd.Kfz 7/1 (2cm Flakvierling) Goatley Boat Bedford OYD Universal Carrier Mk.II Sherman III (Late) Sherman VC We would like to dedicate this DLC to our friend Trevor Hackbardt. Trevor's enthusiasm, humor and kindness left an indelible mark on our team. We will continue to celebrate his legacy in the game he helped create.

This DLC brings you a superbly detailed storyline, following the US airborne operations in western Europe in an exciting and immersive new format.

It features some of the most iconic battles fought by US paratroopers from the 82nd and 101st airborne divisions in World War 2.

Action

Re-live the adrenaline-packed battles that helped decide the outcome of the war. Step into the boots of the 82nd and 101st airborne divisions and fight your way through France, Belgium, the Netherlands, and Germany.

Jump into action over St. Mère-Église, fight for Brécourt Manor, take part in Operation Market Garden. Defend Bastogne during the harsh winter of 1944-45 and push on into Germany to the crossing of the Elbe river.

Every historical scene adds to an unforgettable journey, paying tribute to some of the bravest men to see action in the entirety of WWII, men whose names have been added to the roster of characters in the missions.

New Single Player format

In this DLC you will experience a new feel to single-player missions.

Crafted with the feedback of the community in mind, we have created deep, immersive, and complex missions that have a huge appeal to lovers of cinematic and action-packed single-player.

You can expect novel or upgraded features such as complex secret objectives, and more.

Content of this DLC

The Airborne DLC contains the following new content:

  • 12 single-player missions for the US 101st and 82nd Airborne divisions (these missions can be played in Co-Op as well)

  • Over 100 new environment models for the key locations featured in the missions, including an assortment of map assets for the Netherlands

  • 9 new vehicles:

  • C-47 Skytrain
  • 2cm Flakvierling 38
  • 10.5cm LeFH 18/40
  • Sd.Kfz 7/1 (2cm Flakvierling)
  • Goatley Boat

  • Sherman III (Late)
  • Sherman VC


We would like to dedicate this DLC to our friend Trevor Hackbardt. Trevor's enthusiasm, humor and kindness left an indelible mark on our team. We will continue to celebrate his legacy in the game he helped create.

detailed_descriptions.en: From the early war “Blitzkrieg” in France to the final fights in Germany, this DLC offers the Commonwealth faction on the Western front. Re- live the British Empire’s Finest Hour in spectacular historical detail, in both multiplayer and singleplayer! It features English, Scottish, Canadian and Polish forces, all with their own specific uniforms, equipment, voice acting and special perks. A massive amount of multiplayer and singleplayer content makes this our largest DLC to date. Singleplayer Two singleplayer campaigns are included, each with a new level of cinematics, gameplay and detail. The Commonwealth campaign consists of 7 scripted missions and 3 skirmishes, portraying the British Expeditionary Force in the first desperate days of “Fall Gelb” in the West, followed by the action on D-Day capturing Pegasus bridge and the offensive action around Caen. This is followed by action - packed missions for Operation Market Garden and the paradrops in Germany - you will be there from the first to the last day of the war on the Western front! The German campaign consists of 5 scripted missions and 1 skirmish. This campaign depicts what would later be called “Blitzkrieg”; starting with the first chaotic but victorious days in France, fighting and surrounding the French and British armies as Rommel’s 7th Panzer (“ghost”) division, followed by missions later in the war defending the Atlantikwall and several counterattacks in Normandy and during Operation Market Garden. The grim struggle for control of the Scheldt estuary rounds out the war in the German campaign. Multiplayer “Finest Hour” also introduces the Commonwealth in early, mid and late war periods, with 4 doctrines for each period and 20 brand new Western front MP maps, plus all of the new weapons, vehicles and tanks. Conquest For conquest, 25 Western front maps are included. These use a new and unique set of assets, created to give you a good impression of the battlefields in the Netherlands, Flanders, Northern France and elsewhere. The German conquest arsenal has been expanded for this DLC as well, to complement the equipment you would expect to find on any early war battlefield where these nations went head to head. Visuals Finest Hour introduces a completely new set of visuals with hundreds of highly detailed environment models; we’ve even added bagpipes! There is added glossiness to the textures for higher fidelity, and we've manufactured over a thousand environmental assets, reinforcing the feel of authenticity for the locations and countries you fight in. Content of the DLC This DLC is our largest to date and contains the following: Large asset collections for the Netherlands and Flanders with over 1000 assets in total. 170 new vehicles for the Commonwealth and Germany Over 500 human models and over 100 equipment items for the Commonwealth The Commonwealth faction for conquest and multiplayer in early, mid and late war A singleplayer campaign for the Commonwealth featuring 7 storyline missions and 3 skirmishes A singleplayer campaign for Germany featuring 5 storyline missions and 1 skirmish 20 new multiplayer maps 25 new conquest maps

games.name: Call to Arms - Gates of Hell: Liberation

names.en: Call to Arms - Gates of Hell: Liberation

games.short_description: “Soldiers, Sailors, and Airmen of the Allied Expeditionary Force: you are about to embark upon the Great Crusade!” This DLC introduces the western front action in 1944, featuring the US faction, as well as German western front content.

descriptions.en: “Soldiers, Sailors, and Airmen of the Allied Expeditionary Force: you are about to embark upon the Great Crusade!” This DLC introduces the western front action in 1944, featuring the US faction, as well as German western front content.

detailed_descriptions.en: “Soldiers, Sailors, and Airmen of the Allied Expeditionary Force: you are about to embark upon the Great Crusade!” This DLC introduces the western front action in 1944, featuring the US faction, as well as German western front content. Be among the first to scale the Atlantic wall and fight your way through the Bocage. Be the spearhead that breaks the stalemate in the battle of the Bulge. Re-live the rush to the Rhine bridge, on the road into the heart of Germany! Or, fight for the Wehrmacht and be the one that leads the counterattacks, the one that stops the breakout. In other words; be the one that defends “Fortress Europe” facing all the classic dilemmas that come with it. Single Player The single player campaigns focus on four legendary western front units: the “Liberation” campaign has the 2nd Rangers and the 3rd Armored Division on the US side. Beside 6 single player missions, this DLC also offers 4 skirmishes for the US faction, which are part of the campaign storyline. In all of the missions, you will find yourself in intense battles on iconic battlegrounds, recreated to the last detail; get a taste of the bitter fighting against fanatical opposition, liberating western Europe step by hellish step. The action will be intense and the immersion will be up there! The German campaign, “Festung Europa”, has the 3rd Fallschirmjäger division and 116th Panzer division on the German side in 6 intense and compelling missions. Be the one that commands the Wehrmacht forces on the western front from Normandy to the last battles in the Ruhr pocket. In the German campaign you will enjoy a lot of new content as well! Multiplayer “Liberation” adds the USA to multiplayer with 20 brand new western front MP maps, and all of the new weapons, vehicles and tanks; it also adds a new German late war doctrine. Conquest For conquest, 25 western front maps are included. These, like other maps, use the unique set of assets we have created to immerse you in the western front atmosphere. Visuals Liberation pushes the boundary of the visuals of the Gates of Hell universe to a new standard, with hundreds of highly detailed environment models, improved destruction for buildings and beautiful environments. To ensure the historical accuracy of our content, we have collaborated with WW2 Armor in Florida, who provided us with vast amounts of valuable documentation and knowledge. Content The Liberation DLC contains: 10 US single player missions, including 4 US skirmishes 6 German single player missions 150+ new US and German vehicles, cannon, ships, aircraft and tanks 50 new small arms 500+ new humanskins 20 new MP maps 25 new DCG (Conquest) maps 500+ new editor assets for the western European theater.

games.name: Call to Arms - Gates of Hell: Ostfront

names.en: Call to Arms - Gates of Hell: Ostfront

games.short_description: Call to Arms - Gates of Hell is a realistic RTS/ RTT game that offers endless replay value. Command all types of troops in historical singleplayer, dynamic campaign, PvP and PvE battles. Are you ready for some serious immersion in World War 2?

descriptions.en: Call to Arms - Gates of Hell is a realistic RTS/ RTT game that offers endless replay value. Command all types of troops in historical singleplayer, dynamic campaign, PvP and PvE battles. Are you ready for some serious immersion in World War 2?

detailed_descriptions.en: Call to Arms - Gates of Hell: Ostfront features the Eastern Front and its “Great Patriotic War” fought between the USSR and Germany. This RTS will take you from June 1941 until the end of the war in May 1945. Call to Arms - Gates of Hell: Ostfront offers a choice of game modes including Singleplayer, dynamic campaign, PvE, PvP and co-op. With its instantly switchable views, there’s something for every type of player. First person gunner views for all vehicles, third person views for vehicles and infantry, classic top-down direct control of a single unit or classic RTS top-down; they are all available and instantly switchable. Conquest (dynamic campaign) mode offers singleplayer and co-op modes to play with your friends. Both modes allow you to compose your own army group, research new units and strategically advance in different paths to dominate the battlefield. The dynamic campaign can range from short to unlimited campaign lengths. PvP/PvE offers a wide variety of maps from 1v1 to 4v4, and the use of “Doctrines”. These allow you to choose your own special units that fit your individual playstyle. The stage of the war (Early/Mid/Late) can be selected, to experience the evolution of equipment and vehicles as the conflict progressed. Single player campaigns take place at historical locations, painstakingly recreated and immersive as hell. Call to Arms - Gates of Hell: Ostfront offers: 12 historical singleplayer missions that can also be played in co-op with friends. 30 PvE and PvP maps PvE Dynamic campaigns in which you develop your own army and fight an ever- changing war across a big collection of maps PvP multiplayer offers doctrines to specialize your armies Instantly switchable 3rd person/ direct control view mode for infantry Instantly switchable 1st person/ 3rd person / direct control view mode for vehicles Over 250 vehicles and 100 heavy weapons at your disposal Air support mechanics and off-map artillery support Realistically armored vehicles with accurate armor layouts, historical ammo loadouts and fully modeled internal components The most realistic armor penetration and ammunition mechanics of any RTS out there Land mines, magnetic mines, obstacle-laying, foxhole-building, bayonets, smokescreens, medics and countless other game mechanics Authentic sound design and visuals A full in- game editor plus modding/ workshop support

Conquest (dynamic campaign) mode offers singleplayer and co-op modes to play with your friends. Both modes allow you to compose your own army group, research new units and strategically advance in different paths to dominate the battlefield. PvP/PvE offers a wide variety of maps from 1v1 to 4v4, and the use of “Doctrines”. These allow you to choose your own special units that fit your individual playstyle. Call to Arms - Gates of Hell: Ostfront offers:

names.en: Call to Arms - Gates of Hell: Scorched Earth

games.short_description: The “Scorched Earth” expansion redefines the Eastern Front with a stunning arsenal for multiplayer, plus brand new single player content to complete the most brutal theater of the war. From the Siege of Sevastopol to the very last offensives of WWII in the east.

descriptions.en: The “Scorched Earth” expansion redefines the Eastern Front with a stunning arsenal for multiplayer, plus brand new single player content to complete the most brutal theater of the war. From the Siege of Sevastopol to the very last offensives of WWII in the east.

detailed_descriptions.en: The “Scorched Earth” expansion redefines the Eastern Front with a stunning arsenal for multiplayer, plus brand new single player content to complete the most brutal theater of the war. From the Siege of Sevastopol to the very last offensives of WWII in the east. This expansion offers content for every type of player, immersing you in historical battles and forgotten episodes of the war. Marvel at the exact recreations of real locations with their stunning visuals, lots of new assets and unique new units, including some of the biggest weaponry used in the conflict. Scorched Earth contains 4 all- new USSR single player missions 4 all- new German single player missions 6 new unique multiplayer doctrines for USSR and Germany (one for each nation and time period) 25 new units New buildings New aerial reconnaissance units Single player missions For the German campaign, we added the brutal siege of Sevastopol and the legendary Battle of Narva, as well as the less known but equally important episodes of the Eastern Front. These include the anti-partisan operations in Yugoslavia and Operation Spring Awakening, the last German offensive operation of WWII. For the Soviet campaign, the time has come to relive the desperate fighting in Stalingrad as well as the most famous tank battle of the war: Kursk. Lead the 1st Ukranian front in the liberation of Kyiv, and push the Red Army all the way into the homeland of the Third Reich, including the dramatic capture of Königsberg. New units This DLC opens access to new doctrines for multiplayer for USSR and Germany. We have implemented some of the lesser known, yet unique vehicles of the conflict, such as the infamous 600mm “Karl Gerät” siege mortar. The Support Doctrine The new units of the DLC are also available in multiplayer. They are part of the doctrines for Germany and the USSR. These new doctrines provide you with the ability to support your team with extra key units, and the ability to reinforce your logistical warfare as a way to overwhelm the enemy. The “Support” doctrines include reconnaissance aircraft to spot for your team, plus a variety of artillery and logistics support units to plug holes in your line and turn the tide in times of need.

detailed_descriptions.en: The Talvisota expansion for CtA - GoH offers Finland and the unique northern fighting between 1939 and 1945, including a vast array of weaponry and unique game mechanics. The return of classic skirmishes also expands the Eastern Front with huge, replayable battles including a menacing, revamped AI. Finland possessed specialized weapons and infantry, as well as a unique arsenal of modified and captured vehicles. Specialized engineers can deploy and upgrade a vast array of fortifications. The cunning use of searchlights, aviation and exotic units will prove Finland once more capable of winning battles. descriptions.en: Lead a platoon of WWII tanks in this immersive TPP and FPP game. Engage in realistic, tactical combat across historic battlefields. Play through campaign or challenge yourself in skirmish mode as either German or US forces.

detailed_descriptions.en: Command a platoon of WWII tanks in this TPP and FPP game. Engage in tactical, realistic battles across historic battlefields. Play through a full campaign or test your skills in skirmish mode, fighting as either German or US forces. As a German commander in 1944, your mission is to push back the advancing enemy forces in France. descriptions.en: A strategy game with a new kind of enemy, Calyx puts you in charge of a space mining outpost, locked in battle against powerful plant-aliens. Build your base, gather resources, assemble your forces, and take on the Calyx. With only an out-of-date AI for company, can you survive?

detailed_descriptions.en: A combination RTS and base builder with a brand new kind of enemy, the Calyx are a group of powerful plant-aliens that, left unchecked, quickly spread to control swathes of the map. As the only remaining occupant of an Avaris Corporation deep-space mining vessel, you’ve arrived in orbit around a barren-looking planet. While you’re trying to get over being frozen for more than a century, you’re dropped to the surface as the ship’s AI outlines your Ore mining targets. Build a power network, set up Harvesters and refine Ore before sending it to orbit for Credits. Build walls and turrets to protect your base. Deploy tanks and artillery to push the Calyx back before it gets too strong. Balance your base’s energy requirements carefully to avoid vital defences being down on power. Secure rare deposits to improve your mining and military capacity. Connect to booster buildings for additional power, mining and healing buffs. Will you establish a strong defence, or attack the Calyx before it spreads too far? Dig in and build a massive force, or adopt a mobile and nimble strategy? There are many ways to defeat the different varieties of Calyx. Start your base wherever you like, experiment and develop your styles of play, and learn to cope with different scenarios. Protect Data Archives to gain Research Points, and use the tech tree to unlock and upgrade more advanced units and buildings. Unlock the Inferno flamethrower and watch the Calyx burn! Build the Unit Workshop and manufacture the Goliath, a massive, multi turret tank, and boost its speed with hover technology. Unlock Orbital technologies and fire a devastating laser beam from orbit. Protect and power communication arrays to access the corporation’s deep space network. Scan the Calyx roots to learn more about how these hostile lifeforms function. Discover new and dangerous Calyx variants as you battle to gain control of the planet and try to find a way home! Take on the Early Access campaign: Tutorial plus 16 maps 5 difficulty levels Tech Tree Earn Research Points and unlock new technologies Upgrade units and buildings Take on 5 species of Calyx Watch out for the evil Liquidator AI! Replay with Skirmish mode: 7 maps 5 difficulty levels Set the number of Calyx roots Choose starting resources Configure available Ore fields Choose your tech level and generate a layout Share the seed with friends so you can play the same challenge Calyx is an Early Access release, and we’d love to hear your thoughts to help shape future development. Please jump into the Discussion Forum, or join our Discord and let us know what you think!

games.name: Captain of Industry
games.short_description: Build an industrial empire on a remote island. Mine resources, reshape terrain with excavators, grow food, construct factories, lay train tracks, and trade with the outside world. Research 100+ technologies to advance from basic metal smelting all the way to nuclear power and space flight.

descriptions.en: Build an industrial empire on a remote island. Mine resources, reshape terrain with excavators, grow food, construct factories, lay train tracks, and trade with the outside world. Research 100+ technologies to advance from basic metal smelting all the way to nuclear power and space flight.

detailed_descriptions.en: Your journey begins on a remote island with a small crew of workers and a ship full of supplies. Mine raw materials, reshape the fully dynamic terrain, grow crops, build factories, and research new technologies. Expand across the island, lay rail networks, trade with distant settlements, and work your way up to nuclear power and space flight. Mine resources and shape the land The entire terrain is fully dynamic. Every mountain can be flattened, every valley filled, and even the ocean can be reclaimed to expand the available land. Create open-pit mines to reach deep ore deposits, or dump excess rock into the ocean to expand your shoreline. Build ramps and slopes so your vehicles can reach any elevation. Build your factory Start simple with iron smelting, concrete mixing, and food processing. As you research new technologies, expand into oil refining, electronics, computing, and eventually rocket and space station components. Manage waste and pollution before they affect your people's health. Move products with trucks, trains, belts, and pipes Trucks handle general logistics automatically, delivering products where they are needed most. Lay conveyor belts and pipes for high-throughput direct connections between machines. Build a rail network to move bulk cargo across long distances. Use amphibious vehicles and bridges to reach other islands. Feed and protect your people Grow crops on farms and process them into food or industrial products. Supply fertilizers to boost yields and build greenhouses to grow more advanced crops. Your population needs housing, clean water, electricity, healthcare, and household goods. Keep them happy and healthy, and they will reward you with Unity, a resource that lets you speed up construction, enact powerful edicts, and claim resources on the world map. Neglect waste management or let pollution build up, and diseases will spread. Explore, trade, and become self-sufficient Send your ship out to explore the world map. Discover new islands with resources to import, refugees to rescue, and allied settlements to trade with. Establish shipping contracts for recurring exchanges, or negotiate quick trades when you need something fast. Your ultimate goal is full self-sufficiency: launch rockets, build a space station, and mine asteroids for rare resources that make your colony independent indefinitely. Your tools Copy and paste parts of your factory, or save entire layouts as blueprints to reuse and share. Use planning mode to lay out designs before committing resources. Design your own island in the map editor and play it or share it with others. Or switch to sandbox mode where all buildings and resources are free, perfect for experimenting and learning.

Create open-pit mines to reach deep ore deposits, or dump excess rock into the ocean to expand your shoreline. Build ramps and slopes so your vehicles can reach any elevation.

Build your factory

Start simple with iron smelting, concrete mixing, and food processing. As you research new technologies, expand into oil refining, electronics, computing, and eventually rocket and space station components. Manage waste and pollution before they affect your people's health.

Move products with trucks, trains, belts, and pipes

Trucks handle general logistics automatically, delivering products where they are needed most. Lay conveyor belts and pipes for high-throughput direct connections between machines. Build a rail network to move bulk cargo across long distances. Use amphibious vehicles and bridges to reach other islands.

Grow crops on farms and process them into food or industrial products. Supply fertilizers to boost yields and build greenhouses to grow more advanced crops. Your population needs housing, clean water, electricity, healthcare, and household goods. Neglect waste management or let pollution build up, and diseases will spread.

Send your ship out to explore the world map. Discover new islands with resources to import, refugees to rescue, and allied settlements to trade with. games.name: Captain of Industry - Trains expanded
games.short_description: This DLC expands your train experience with electrified train tracks, five new locomotives, and a specialized infrastructure for rail transportation of molten materials.

descriptions.en: This DLC expands your train experience with electrified train tracks, five new locomotives, and a specialized infrastructure for rail transportation of molten materials.

detailed_descriptions.en: Supercharge your train logistics network with the power of electricity, or even nuclear energy. Modernize your railway fleet with five new high-tech locomotives, build electrified rail infrastructure, and transport molten resources with specialized wagons. New to the game? Trains are already part of the base game. This DLC adds advanced, late-game locomotives and infrastructure. You can enjoy the game without it and add it at any time, including to an existing save file. You will typically reach this content after about 30-50 in-game hours. New content Expand your depot with five new locomotives, each filling a different strategic role: Electric locomotive (tiers 1 & 2) - No refueling needed as long as the track is electrified. Electrified track costs more to build and requires extra vertical clearance for the overhead wires, but once in place your trains run without interruption. Fire-less steam locomotive (tier 1) - Runs on pressurized steam alone, making it the simplest locomotive to fuel. However, its low power and limited range mean it is best suited for short shuttle routes. Gas turbine locomotive (tier 2) - A jet engine on rails! The fastest and one of the most powerful locomotives in the game, but its fuel gas consumption is heavy. Pair it with an optional tender wagon to extend its range. Nuclear locomotive (tier 3) - A massive three-car unit that can run for years on a single load of uranium fuel rods, delivering immense pulling power. The ultimate feat of engineering, arriving with a dedicated refueling station. Molten materials wagon and station - Optimize your supply chain for molten materials by separating production and consumption with rail transportation in between. Bonus Content Owners of the Supporter's Edition DLC will also receive the exclusive Captain's Locomotive!

descriptions.en: Captain Wayne is an intense, fast-action Retro Shooter about a sailor with a SHOTGUN for an ARM!! With a cartoony, hand-drawn art style and gory gameplay, you'll have to mow down enemies through 8 action-packed locales to take back what's yours. ARE YOU READY TO RAISE ANCHOR?

detailed_descriptions.en: Witness an elaborately hand-drawn, action-packed epic inspired by the FPS greats! Make use of the many devastating weapons in Wayne’s arsenal and achieve maximum destruction! Explore dangerous locales through 8 humongous areas all across Orca Isle! HALF GAME, HALF CARTOON! Delight in the Captain’s depth-defying tale in CAMPAIGN MODE as you view tons of animated cutscenes exploring his adventure. Experience a high-octane soundtrack that emphasizes AGGRESSION and CHAOS! Go for the gold in our ENDLESS MODE – how long can you survive the onslaught? The hot pink-wearing, fish-chomping, cigar-huffing Captain Wayne refuses to let anything stand between him and his gory conquest to rob and humiliate every rich asshole around the globe. After losing his arm in a terrible encounter with the legendary Vampire Whale , Wayne replaced it with his trusty shotgun, The Captain's Ol' Reliable , and sailed with it across the seven-and-a-half seas in his vessel, the S.S. Salty . When an unexpected run-in with a group of evil mercenaries leaves him marooned on Orca Isle with his ship stolen, Wayne starts doing what he does best: annihilating everyone responsible. Equipped with a double barreled shotgun for an arm, countless explosives, and a bad attitude, you’ll have to go toe-to-toe with The Killer Whales , the most ruthless mercenaries in all the seven-and-a-half seas. DO YOU HAVE WHAT IT TAKES TO EMBODY THE CAPTAIN? Let’s find out. games.name: Capy Castaway
games.short_description: Capy Castaway is a cozy exploration adventure where a capybara pup and a clever crow solve puzzles, help lost animals, and explore a mysterious island after a devastating flood. Play solo or with a friend in this relaxing narrative adventure about curiosity, friendship, and finding your way home.

descriptions.en: Capy Castaway is a cozy exploration adventure where a capybara pup and a clever crow solve puzzles, help lost animals, and explore a mysterious island after a devastating flood. Play solo or with a friend in this relaxing narrative adventure about curiosity, friendship, and finding your way home.

detailed_descriptions.en: Capy Castaway is a cozy narrative exploration adventure where a capybara pup and a clever crow solve puzzles, help animal friends, and explore a mysterious island. Play solo or together in a heartwarming story about friendship and home. A Tale of Friendship & Belonging After a flood sweeps several zoo animals far from home, a young capybara pup named Capy washes ashore on the mysterious Castaway Island where all sorts of objects, trinkets, and even other animals have become lost to time and space. Here, Capy meets Corvi , a clever and chatty crow who becomes their voice, guide, and self-appointed “cool older sibling.” Together, they explore the island, befriend its colourful Castaways, lend a helping paw and wing, and uncover the story hidden beneath the island’s quiet surface. Through exploration, kindness, and a little (or a lot of) mischief, Capy and Corvi slowly discover that the meaning of “home” may be bigger than they imagined. Inspired by real memories and places from Toronto , Capy Castaway’s world blends cozy nostalgia with playful wonder. Play as the Cutest Dynamic Duo Meet Capy , a curious capybara pup with a nose for discovery, and Corvi , a mischievous young crow who always has something to say. Capy can sniff, dig, and swim (and not to mention make sandcastles, eat snacks, and play music), while Corvi can fly, fetch items, and carry Capy to new, unreachable places! Be playful, interact with everything and everyone, and approach each challenge in your own creative way. Your choices will shape the story, open new paths, and unlock multiple possible endings filled with emotions, surprises, and little moments of delight Help or Don't, Your Choices Matter Locals and fellow zoo Castaways can be found throughout your adventure, so you can also help out these lost animals or… don’t? Give relationship advice, help friends find closure, search for lost items, or simply goof around. The way you play is up to you! But be careful; your decisions matter, shaping both the story and the ending scenes based on how you interact with everyone on Castaway Island. A Cozy Adventure for 1 or 2 Players Play solo and control both characters, or share the journey with a friend in co-op mode! A special kind of camaraderie (and chaos) is unlocked when another player joins the journey with new ways to play and explore. Capy Castaway is designed to be low-stress and welcoming for everyone, from longtime gamers to partners, families, or kids discovering adventure games for the very first time! Meeting old and new friends alike, this heartwarming, narrative-driven adventure will transport players to a place that is both unknown and nostalgic as they explore a world inspired by memories of Toronto.

games.name: Car Dealer Simulator
games.short_description: Uncover a goldmine in the used car market! Sniff out deals, buy low, modify, and sell high. Your journey from amateur grease monkey to car dealer magnate awaits. How fast will you rise in this lucrative venture?

descriptions.en: Uncover a goldmine in the used car market! Sniff out deals, buy low, modify, and sell high. Your journey from amateur grease monkey to car dealer magnate awaits. How fast will you rise in this lucrative venture?

detailed_descriptions.en: Turn your dream of selling used cars into reality! In Car Dealer Simulator, you’ll learn the ins and outs of running a business from its quirky owner, Little Sam. He’s not great at keeping things in order, so your task is to buy low, fix up, and sell high. Over time, as you master your initial challenges, you’ll have the chance to take over the business, and then… Everything will be in your hands! Build a business that fulfills your customers’ automotive fantasies. From budget-friendly cars to top-tier rides, seize opportunities, hire the best, provide excellent service, and maximize profits. Grow your company day by day. The key to achieving high profits lies in negotiating when buying old cars. Look for great deals, and during price haggling, stay firm and professional. Not all purchased cars are in working condition, so you’ll need to transport them using one of two types of tow trucks. Every car requires diagnostics and preparation before being sold. Mechanical repairs, bodywork, painting, and small touch-ups will significantly increase the selling price. Presenting a car to the customer requires a few tricks. Washing, good photos, and an engaging advertisement will be your allies. Highlight the car’s strengths in your listing, but remember—every car has its hidden flaws. Customers buy with their eyes, so use the shine of the paint, a full tank, and quality photos to your advantage. Your profits will allow you to continually grow your company. Upgrade tools, repair zones, and your customer service office. Hire employees to boost efficiency. Manage your finances wisely and maintain your company’s reputation. But stay vigilant—competition, and even your “helpful neighbors,” never rest. Protect what you’ve tirelessly built from potential threats.

detailed_descriptions.en: Car Mechanic Simulator 2021 - Drag Racing DLC is the BIG content you were waiting for! This DLC is introducing something completely new to the world of Car Mechanic. Game Modes Challenge yourself at parallel races with AI in several game modes: - Practice - Exam your car and configure your opponent - change his engine, tires and tuning values. - Quick Race - Pick a class and race with randomized car setups. - Single Race - Check your build and reaction time with opponent matched to your rating. - Championships - Challenge your vehicle in a series of races. Bet who will win, and grab a big prize at the end. All this on four distances: 1/8 , 1/4 , 1/2 and 1 mile . Drag Rating Each car now has a " Drag Rating " index that assigns it to a particular racing category. Remember that any change in the tuning of a car, later requires checking it on the Dyno to calculate the new index. Manual transmission / ECS / TCS With this DLC we are introducing Manual Transmission. In Drag Racing it is mandatory to use manual transmission. In the rest of the tracks you can choose between automatic and manual. You can also disable ECS and TCS if you wish. (AT/MT in game options, ECS/TCS in rebind) Additional tuning To make your car even more capable of going fast, we expand the capability to tune engines . - ECU Tuning - We give you three Stages of ECU. They may be not the cheapest way to tune your car, but you can push your build to the limits. - Carburetor Tuning - For classic engines, we introduce carburetor tuning. Crank the power of every carburetor. Stats After each run, detailed statistics of drag times are presented, as well as general data like 0-60 times, 0-100 times, etc. Bets Are you good at betting ? You can bet on the results of the championship races. Another way to make some cash. Cars We also add 4 more fast vehicles you might like to try: Arezzo Cortona - Italian Classic Engine: V12 DOHC ARZ Power: 520HP Torque: 489Nm Bolt Reptilia R6 - American Powerhouse Engine: V8 OHV CGM M1D / V8 OHV CGM-SC M1D Power: 490HP / 680 HP Torque: 627Nm / 840Nm Hammerdal Strale S - Nordic Hypercar Engine: V8 DOHC AXK-TRS M / V8 DOHC AXK-SCRS M Power: 910HP / 1014HP Torque: 1065Nm / 1010Nm Mayen T8 - German Sports Car Engine: V10 OHV MT8 Power: 525HP Torque: 542Nm Engines To complete the package, new tuning parts for 6 new engines! V12 DOHC ARZ V8 OHV CGM M1D V8 OHV CGM-SC M1D V8 DOHC AXK-TRS M V8 DOHC AXK-SCRS M V10 OHV MT8

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Car Mechanic Simulator 2021 - Drag Racing DLC is the BIG content you were waiting for!
This DLC is introducing something completely new to the world of Car Mechanic.

Game Modes

Challenge yourself at parallel races with AI in several game modes:
-Practice - Exam your car and configure your opponent - change his engine, tires and tuning values.
-Quick Race - Pick a class and race with randomized car setups.
-Single Race - Check your build and reaction time with opponent matched to your rating.
-Championships - Challenge your vehicle in a series of races. Bet who will win, and grab a big prize at the end.


All this on four distances: 1/8, 1/4, 1/2 and 1 mile.

Drag Rating

Each car now has a "Drag Rating" index that assigns it to a particular racing category. Remember that any change in the tuning of a car, later requires checking it on the Dyno to calculate the new index.

Manual transmission / ECS / TCS

With this DLC we are introducing Manual Transmission. In Drag Racing it is mandatory to use manual transmission. In the rest of the tracks you can choose between automatic and manual. You can also disable ECS and TCS if you wish. (AT/MT in game options, ECS/TCS in rebind)

Additional tuning

To make your car even more capable of going fast, we expand the capability to tune engines.

-ECU Tuning - We give you three Stages of ECU. They may be not the cheapest way to tune your car, but you can push your build to the limits.

-Carburetor Tuning - For classic engines, we introduce carburetor tuning. Crank the power of every carburetor.

Stats

After each run, detailed statistics of drag times are presented, as well as general data like 0-60 times, 0-100 times, etc.

Bets

Are you good at betting? You can bet on the results of the championship races. Another way to make some cash.

Cars

We also add 4 more fast vehicles you might like to try:


Arezzo Cortona - Italian Classic
Engine: V12 DOHC ARZ
Power: 520HP
Torque: 489Nm


Bolt Reptilia R6 - American Powerhouse
Engine: V8 OHV CGM M1D / V8 OHV CGM-SC M1D
Power: 490HP / 680 HP
Torque: 627Nm / 840Nm


Hammerdal Strale S - Nordic Hypercar
Engine: V8 DOHC AXK-TRS M / V8 DOHC AXK-SCRS M
Power: 910HP / 1014HP
Torque: 1065Nm / 1010Nm


Mayen T8 - German Sports Car
Engine: V10 OHV MT8
Power: 525HP
Torque: 542Nm

Engines

To complete the package, new tuning parts for 6 new engines!
  • V12 DOHC ARZ
  • V8 OHV CGM M1D
  • V8 OHV CGM-SC M1D
  • V8 DOHC AXK-TRS M
  • V8 DOHC AXK-SCRS M
  • V10 OHV MT8

detailed_descriptions.en: Build a local car wash into a massive detailing empire! Master advanced cleaning techniques with vibrant active foams, beat the clock for extra tips, and buy or lease new properties. Play it clean or risk everything with high-paying shady deals and secret backroom plantations. THE SATISFYING ART OF DETAILING A multi-million dollar business always starts with a single blast of high-pressure water. There is a satisfying, therapeutic beauty in watching layers of caked road dirt instantly vanish under a master touch. Perfecting the core cleaning loop at a modest local car wash builds the foundation for total city dominance. Transforming everyday vehicles into spotless, gleaming showroom masterpieces is where the true addiction begins. VIBRANT FOAMS AND TICKING CLOCKS Standard rinses belong in the past. Slathering cars in thick layers of pink, blue, or premium white active foam melts away tough grime before heavy-duty pressure washers deliver the final finish. Detailing can be handled at a relaxed, therapeutic pace, but completing tutorials unlocks intense time-constraint challenges. Blasting away randomized grime under a strict clock rewards flawless, high-speed optimization with large cash multipliers and bonus tips. THE REWARD OF A PERFECT JOB Flawless execution unlocks the ultimate perk: climbing into the driver’s seat of a freshly detailed, gleaming machine for a well-deserved spin. Hearing the engine roar to life after a perfect clean delivers pure satisfaction before handing back the keys. Tracking daily success through financial performance stats provides the capital needed for real estate expansion. Reinvested profits buy, clean, furnish, sell, or lease a massive commercial network of secondary car wash locations for passive daily income. SHADY BACKROOMS AND PLAZA DISTRACTIONS When legitimate washing isn’t enough, high-stakes alternative paths await in the shadows. Accepting optional underground packages from sketchy clients or converting secondary properties into secret plant plantations offers rapid black-market capital at an increased risk. When management stress boils over under the dynamic day-and-night cycle and random event cards, the surrounding plaza offers the perfect escape. Chaotic physics-based mini-games let detailers blow off steam by shooting at flying targets with a toy pistol, mastering trash-bag basketball, or collecting runaway shopping carts in full-driving mode. KEY FEATURES Advanced Detailing Mastery Enjoy 14 cleaning mechanics! Clean car bodies, squeegee windows, scrub floor mats on specialized grates, and apply premium tire dressing wax. Chemical Arsenal Upgrade to 3 distinct types of pressure washers and deploy thick white, blue, or pink active foams. The Ticking Clock Choose between a relaxed, therapeutic simulation or intense time-attack challenges for massive tip multipliers. Unique Contracts Handle orders, intense, timed challenges, high-paying, shady deliveries, and massive, multi-step mega jobs. Underground Hustles Safely store, hold, and transport mysterious contraband packages for sketchy clients to earn rapid revenue. Real Estate Monopoly Rent, buy, clean, furnish, sell, or lease out secondary facilities for passive daily income. Backroom Operations Run a secret, high-profit plant plantation inside newly acquired properties to rapidly boost capital. A Living Sandbox Navigate a complete Day/Night system, random event cards, and post-shift financial performance statistics. Plaza Mini-Games Take a break to shoot flying targets, throw trash bags, or jump into driving mode to collect runaway shopping carts.

games.name: Caravan SandWitch
games.short_description: Embark on a journey across vast landscapes in Caravan SandWitch, a captivating narrative-driven exploration adventure.

descriptions.en: Embark on a journey across vast landscapes in Caravan SandWitch, a captivating narrative-driven exploration adventure.

detailed_descriptions.en: In Caravan SandWitch, embark on a journey across a Sci-Fi Provence-like world, driven by a mystery through your missing sister that unfolds with each step you take. Interact with the communities on Cigalo, help them with their tasks and meet new people along the way. Take your time to explore the world, whether in your van or on foot. Life is simple: no combat, no death, no timer, just you, your van, and the world. Explore a Provence-like World Equipped with your van and an array of essential tools, you set out on a quest to find your missing sister. Upgrade your van throughout your adventure and explorations to open up new passages and ruins. From navigating treacherous terrain to uncovering ancient ruins, every step of your journey brings you closer to unraveling the truth behind your sister's disappearance. A hopeful Post-Apocalypse From a green planet to a desertic one due to human activities and sur-exploitation; discover on Cigalo the impact of humans and its population through your road trip. Meet the Reinetos, an old aboriginal species, the Robots left behind after the planet exploitation, the humans who stayed after everyone left for another planet, and the mysterious SandWitch. All of them live peacefully in Cigalo and help each other in this unwelcome environment. Meet a diverse cast of characters As you interact with the diverse characters you meet along the way, you'll come to understand that your community is your home. Help everyone and contribute your piece to the edifice, enabling everyone to live in harmony in an environment hostile to all civilizations due to over-exploitation. A Game developed for All Plane Toast made huge importance to create a game in which everyone can feel included, representing their vision of a world where communities help each other to overcome the environmental consequences of our world. Caravan SandWitch is written with an inclusive script, that represents a real community with its people and representation. Accessibility options are available.

detailed_descriptions.en: Card-en-Ciel is a JRPG take on roguelike deckbuilders, with a full story, over 300 cards each with unique characters, 50 full vocal songs, and a 6x3 playfield for strategic depth. Each battle will earn you new allies to add to your deck, powering up to take on the boss and advance the story. Freely roam around dungeons and battle the enemies you choose. You'll take control of Neon, a self-professed detective who specializes in crimes in full-dive VR games. When an in-development game is suddenly overrun by countless characters from other games old and new, Neon has to delve into virtual dungeons to stop them. Each of the over 300 cards you'll collect features a unique character from those games. They come alive with full English and Japanese voice acting, talking with their friends and foes and reacting in battle. Recruit powerful Muse cards who begin performing when you meet their conditions, activating unique effects to enable your most degenerate combos. Each Muse sings a different song, created with respect to the era and genre you would expect from their original game, with 50 vocal songs in total. Full content available day 1: Over 10 story dungeons, each with different cards to add to your deck and collect 10 extra difficulty levels, with new rule twists in addition to stronger enemies Special "Grand Battle Dungeons" that allow you to construct a deck to challenge with Over 50 random events featuring various game characters, real and imagined Daily and weekly dungeon challenges with online leaderboards Real-time online head-to-head battles

games.name: Cards Everywhere!
games.short_description: Cards Everywhere! is a cozy organizing game where you sort through 2,000 scattered cards, collect over 1,500 unique ones, and place them in your collection album. Discover dozens of unique sets and unlock helpful abilities as your collection grows.

descriptions.en: Cards Everywhere! is a cozy organizing game where you sort through 2,000 scattered cards, collect over 1,500 unique ones, and place them in your collection album. Discover dozens of unique sets and unlock helpful abilities as your collection grows.

detailed_descriptions.en: CARDS. CARDS EVERYWHERE. Thousands of cards are scattered across the room - and every one of them belongs somewhere. Explore the mess, pick up cards, discover which collection they belong to, and place them into the correct spots in your album. With over 1,500 unique cards spread across dozens of different sets, there is always something new waiting underneath the pile. BUILD YOUR COLLECTION Every card you find brings your album one step closer to completion. Discover completely different themed sets, fill empty slots one by one, complete pages, and slowly turn an empty album into a huge collection. Some cards will be easy to spot. Others might be hiding right in front of you. COMPLETE TASKS AND PAGES TO GET BETTER Completing a page doesn't just feel satisfying - it also makes you a better collector. Earn upgrade points for every finished album page and use them to unlock and improve abilities that make collecting faster, smoother, and more satisfying. But not everything can be bought. Complete special tasks - such as finishing specific collections - to unlock unique abilities and permanent bonuses. Carry more cards. See more. Use magic to find what you need. Deal with duplicates more efficiently. The more your collection grows, the more tools you gain to tackle the chaos around you. WHAT ABOUT THE DUPLICATES? Not every card you find belongs in the album. Duplicates have their own place: a special box where you decide how they should be organized. Sort them by color? Go for it. Group them by theme? Absolutely. Carefully build perfect little stacks? Sure. Or don't organize them at all and simply throw them in. That's fine too. As you progress, you can unlock abilities that make dealing with duplicates faster - so whether you enjoy arranging every last card or just want them out of the way, you can play your way. A LITTLE STORY BETWEEN THE CARDS Someone was here before you. Scattered throughout the room are letters left behind by Mira Finch, The Wandering Collector , and the mysterious Grand Collector . Find them as you explore and slowly discover their relationship, their history - and how exactly you became part of it. The story is there for those who want to find it. The cards aren't going to sort themselves either way. ONE CARD AT A TIME. A floor covered in cards. An album waiting to be filled. Dozens of collections to discover. And a lot of sorting ahead of you. Welcome to Cards Everywhere!

games.short_description: Cargo Hunters is a single-player extraction shooter where you control a humanoid robot scavenging the remains of humanity on an abandoned, dystopian Earth.

descriptions.en: Cargo Hunters is a single-player extraction shooter where you control a humanoid robot scavenging the remains of humanity on an abandoned, dystopian Earth.

detailed_descriptions.en: We have lost everything. Somehow we keep on moving. Cargo Hunters is a third-person extraction PvE shooter in which you control a remote-controlled humanoid robot to scavenge resources on a decaying Earth. Collect and lose loot. Build your shelter. Face challenges. Battle enemies. Fall. Rise. Survive no matter how you define survival. A forgotten home. After the global temperature rise, mankind faced the emergence of superviruses released from the melting Antarctic ice. Within a few years, they wiped out everything that moved, grew, or breathed. Those with wealth or power escaped the dying Earth, fleeing to [classified] during the 'Second Exodus' colonization program in [classified]. Just before the first outbreak. Now they’re paying a ton of money to get their shiny, useless memorabilia back. Escape before it's too late. It’s all about you and how you get the job done. Brute force, sneak, steal, craft, buy, find. Do what you will. But once you lose, you lose everything you’ve found. So think carefully. Equip pragmatically. Carrying capacity, weight, noise, condition—everything matters. The world’s dead. The loot isn’t. You already have a human-shaped body. So wear human clothes or armor. Use their weapons. Add replaceable limbs. Dismember the fallen. Harvest their body parts. Recycle what’s unnecessary. That is the daily routine. Choose your weapons wisely. A lot of firearms brings a lot of trouble (and fun). Different specs, ballistics, conditions, ammo types, modifications, and handling. So it’s up to you: what do you prefer? Blunt force, maybe? Huh. So welcome home, hunter. Let’s begin our aimless, ever-changing, merciless journey together. This cruel no-man’s homeland awaits. But for whom?

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
We have lost everything. Somehow we keep on moving.

Cargo Hunters is a third-person extraction PvE shooter in which you control a remote-controlled humanoid robot to scavenge resources on a decaying Earth.

Collect and lose loot. Build your shelter. Face challenges. Battle enemies. Fall. Rise. Survive no matter how you define survival.

A forgotten home.

After the global temperature rise, mankind faced the emergence of superviruses released from the melting Antarctic ice. Within a few years, they wiped out everything that moved, grew, or breathed.

Those with wealth or power escaped the dying Earth, fleeing to [classified] during the 'Second Exodus' colonization program in [classified]. Just before the first outbreak. Now they’re paying a ton of money to get their shiny, useless memorabilia back.

Escape before it's too late.

It’s all about you and how you get the job done. Brute force, sneak, steal, craft, buy, find. Do what you will.

But once you lose, you lose everything you’ve found. So think carefully. Equip pragmatically.

Carrying capacity, weight, noise, condition—everything matters.

The world’s dead. The loot isn’t.

You already have a human-shaped body. So wear human clothes or armor. Use their weapons. Add replaceable limbs. Dismember the fallen. Harvest their body parts. Recycle what’s unnecessary. That is the daily routine.

Choose your weapons wisely.

A lot of firearms brings a lot of trouble (and fun). Different specs, ballistics, conditions, ammo types, modifications, and handling.

So it’s up to you: what do you prefer? Blunt force, maybe? Huh.

So welcome home, hunter.

Let’s begin our aimless, ever-changing, merciless journey together. This cruel no-man’s homeland awaits. 

But for whom?

games.name: Caribbean Legend
games.short_description: An open-world RPG, set in the Golden Age of Caribbean piracy. Embark on a 200-hour-long adventure, plunder cities and ships, explore the unknown, discover treasures, forge friendships, earn bounties on your head, and charm the ladies on your path to ultimate freedom!

descriptions.en: An open-world RPG, set in the Golden Age of Caribbean piracy. Embark on a 200-hour-long adventure, plunder cities and ships, explore the unknown, discover treasures, forge friendships, earn bounties on your head, and charm the ladies on your path to ultimate freedom!
descriptions.zh-Hant: 开放世界 RPG，重返海盗黄金时代的加勒比——在这里，野心没有上限，梦想皆可成真。 目前提供中文测试版，由「千里共婵娟（sht8694）」与「挖洞的猴子（Monkey Hole）」合作完成，后续将随更新逐步完善。
descriptions.ja: カリブ海賊黄金時代を舞台にしたオープンワールドRPG。200時間の冒険に出発し、都市と船を略奪し、未知を探索し、宝を発見し、友情を築き、懸賞金を稼ぎ、究極の自由への道で女性たちを魅了しよう！
descriptions.ko: 카리브해 해적의 황금시대를 배경으로 한 오픈월드 RPG. 200시간의 모험을 시작하고, 도시와 선박을 약탈하며, 미지의 세계를 탐험하고, 보물을 발견하고, 우정을 쌓고, 현상금을 모으며, 절대적인 자유를 향한 길에서 여성들을 매혹시키세요!

detailed_descriptions.en: Inspired by Sea Dogs series and Sid Meier's Pirates! Welcome to the Caribbean in 1654 AD, a place teeming with opportunities and mysteries. Assume the role of Charles de Maure, a young French noble who embarked on a journey to the New World to assist his brother. What initially appeared to be a simple family matter quickly evolves into a lifelong adventure. Immerse yourself in the tale of a noble brat who rises to become the most influential figure in the Caribbean. Riches, titles, power, and romance – the ultimate booty awaits, and it's up to you to seize it all. Embark on a 200-hour-long journey. Undertake hundreds of quests. Freeplay, rush through the story, or combine both - you're the Captain, and your ship will sail where you command. Experience a historical narrative with a touch of mystique. Explore romantic interests and companions. Choose from various career options, from general-governor to pirate baron. The Caribbean Sea – a realm of dozens of islands and cities, a grand archipelago shrouded in mystery and secrets. From the summits of Indian pyramids to the ocean depths, unique rewards, quests, and curiosities await. This open world is your sandbox, you are free to explore it and shape your legend as you see fit. Your decisions determine where to go, what to do, and who to take with you. Subdue the New World or it will destroy you! Discover dozens of islands and settlements. Build your very own colony. Explore caves, pyramids, jungles, Indian tribes, and lost cities. Visit taverns, brothels, shipyards, churches, forts, and many other points of interest. Engage in treasure hunting and gambling. Experience dynamic weather and the serene turquoise sea. Owning a warship is a privilege, a symbol of status and luxury. You are among the very few who can afford such grandeur. Begin your journey with a simple sloop and work your way up to commanding a ship of the line or even a fleet of these formidable vessels, ready to plunder cities at your whim. No one will stand in your way. Tired from leading massive armadas and the responsibility? Take command of a fast Frigate or Corvette and just free roam the Caribbean. In moments of tranquility at sea, relish the stunning views, embrace the sense of exploration, or navigate in the heart of a storm. Command dozens of ships representing the glory of the Age of Sail. Customize, paint, upgrade, and repair your vessel. Engage in unforgiving yet enjoyable naval combat. Experience intense boarding action, from the upper deck to the captain's cabin. Collect unique vessels to rule the seas. Manage booty distribution, morale, and the threat of mutinies. Assemble a formidable team of officers. Captains are most vulnerable when they set foot on land. Surviving naval combat can be challenging, but at least you won't die alone – your crew will stand with you till the very end. Land battles are different: dishonest, ruthless and risky for you and those who you hold dear. Bring your companions with you, poison your weapons, study the terrain, craft deadly items, and confront thugs, soldiers, pirates, and rivals head-on. Tailor your character's build – become a heavy swordsman, a nimble rogue, a master sharpshooter, or a silver-tongued diplomat. Equip yourself and your companions with a wide array of swords, axes, rapiers, armor, muskets, and pistols. Craft amulets, ammo, potions, and always be prepared for battle. Seek out challenges – the more you fight, the stronger both you and your character become. Command military operations from raiding to sieges.
detailed_descriptions.zh-Hant: 灵感来源于《Sea Dogs》系列和《Sid Meier's Pirates》！ 欢迎来到公元1654年的加勒比——一个充满机遇与神秘的世界。扮演年轻的法国贵族查尔斯·德·莫尔（Charles de Maure），为援助兄长踏上新世界之旅。原本看似简单的家务事，迅速演变为一场终生难忘的冒险。 沉浸于这位贵族少年的传奇——他将崛起为加勒比最具影响力的人物。 财富、头衔、权力与浪漫——终极战利品正等待你去夺取。 踏上长达200小时的航海征程。 完成数百项任务。 自由畅玩、迅速推进剧情或两者兼得——你是船长，你的船将按你的指令航行。 体验带有神秘色彩的历史叙事。 探索浪漫邂逅与同伴关系。 从总督到海盗男爵，多种职业任君选择。 加勒比海由数十座岛屿和城镇组成，宛如笼罩在神秘与秘密中的浩瀚群岛。从印第安人金字塔顶端到海底深处，独特的奖励、任务与奇观正等你探索。 这个开放世界就是你的沙盒，你可以随心探索，书写属于你的传奇。 你的决策决定航向、行动与同伴。征服新世界，否则它将反噬于你！ 发现数十座岛屿与定居点。 建立属于自己的殖民地。 探索洞窟、金字塔、丛林、土著部落与失落之城。 造访酒馆、妓院、造船厂、教堂、要塞及其他趣味点。 参与寻宝与赌博活动。 体验动态天气与宁静碧绿的海面。 拥有战舰是一种特权，象征着身份与奢华。 你是少数能够承担此等荣耀的存在。旅程从简易平底船开启，进阶至指挥战列舰，甚至一支舰队，随心所欲掠夺沿岸城市。无人能阻挡你的脚步。厌倦了领导庞大舰队和沉重责任？指挥快速护卫舰或轻型舰，自由驰骋加勒比。在海上静谧时，领略壮阔风景，感受探索乐趣，或勇闯风暴腹地。 指挥数十艘象征帆船时代荣耀的舰船。 定制、涂装、升级并维修你的船只。 参与无情却热血沸腾的海战。 体验从上层甲板到船长舱的激烈登船战。 收集独特舰船，称霸海洋。 管理战利品分配、船员士气与叛变威胁。 组建一支强悍的军官团队。 船长一旦踏上陆地便最为脆弱。海战虽艰难，但你的船员将与你生死与共，至少你不会孤身作战。陆战迥然不同：卑劣、残酷、危机四伏，威胁着你和你所珍视的人。 携伴同行、毒化武器、研判地形、打造致命道具，直面恶徒、士兵、海盗与宿敌。 定制角色天赋——成为重装剑士、敏捷游侠、神枪手或口才出众的外交官。 为你和同伴装备各式武器：剑、斧、细剑、护甲、火绳枪与手枪。 打造护符、弹药与药剂，时刻准备战斗。 迎接挑战：战斗愈多，角色愈强大。 指挥从突袭到围城的军事行动。
detailed_descriptions.ja: Sea Dogsシリーズとシド・マイヤーズ パイレーツ！からインスピレーションを得ています 1654年のカリブ海へようこそ。機会と謎に満ちた場所です。兄弟を助けるために新世界へ旅立った若いフランス貴族シャルル・ド・モールの役割を引き受けます。最初は単純な家族の問題のように見えたものが、すぐに生涯にわたる冒険に発展します。 カリブ海で最も影響力のある人物になる甘やかされた貴族の物語に没頭してください。 富、称号、権力、そしてロマンス - 究極の戦利品が待っており、すべてを手に入れるのはあなた次第です。 200時間の旅に出発しましょう。 数百のクエストを完了しましょう。 自由にプレイし、ストーリーを駆け抜けるか、両方を組み合わせましょう - あなたが船長であり、船はあなたが命令する場所に航海します。 神秘的なタッチを加えた歴史的な物語を体験しましょう。 恋愛関係と仲間を探索しましょう。 総督から海賊男爵まで、さまざまなキャリアオプションから選択しましょう。 カリブ海 - 数十の島と都市の王国、謎と秘密に包まれた大きな群島。インディアンピラミッドの頂上から海の深部まで、ユニークな報酬、クエスト、そして好奇心をそそるものが待っています。 このオープンワールドはあなたのサンドボックスであり、自由に探索し、思い通りに伝説を形作ることができます。 あなたの決定がどこに行くか、何をするか、誰を連れて行くかを決定します。新世界を征服するか、それとも破壊されるかです！ 数十の島と集落を発見しましょう。 自分だけのコロニーを建設しましょう。 洞窟、ピラミッド、ジャングル、インディアンの部族、失われた都市を探索しましょう。 酒場、売春宿、造船所、教会、要塞、その他多くの興味深い場所を訪れましょう。 宝探しとギャンブルに参加しましょう。 ダイナミックな天候と穏やかなターコイズ色の海を体験しましょう。 軍艦を所有することは特権、ステータス、そして贅沢の象徴です。 あなたはそのような壮大さを手に入れることができる数少ない一人です。シンプルなスループで旅を始め、戦列艦や、好きなように都市を略奪する準備ができたこれらの恐るべき船の艦隊を指揮するまで働きましょう。誰もあなたの邪魔をしません。大規模な艦隊の指揮と責任に疲れましたか？高速フリゲートやコルベットの指揮を取り、単純にカリブ海を自由に探索しましょう。海での静かなひとときに、息をのむような景色を楽しみ、探索の感覚を受け入れ、または嵐の中心を航海しましょう。 帆船時代の栄光を表す数十の船を指揮しましょう。 カスタマイズし、塗装し、アップグレードし、船を修理しましょう。 情け容赦ないが楽しい海戦に参加しましょう。 上甲板から船長室まで、激しい白兵戦アクションを体験しましょう。 海を支配するためにユニークな船を集めましょう。 戦利品の分配、士気、反乱の脅威を管理しましょう。 恐るべき士官チームを組み立てましょう。 船長は陸に足を踏み入れたときに最も脆弱になります。海戦で生き残ることは困難かもしれませんが、少なくとも一人で死ぬことはありません - あなたの乗組員は最後まであなたと共にいるでしょう。陸戦は異なります：不正で、無慈悲で、あなたとあなたが愛する人々にとって危険です。 仲間を連れて行き、武器に毒を塗り、地形を研究し、致命的なアイテムを作り、悪党、兵士、海賊、ライバルと正面から対峙しましょう。 キャラクターのビルドを調整しましょう - 重装剣士、敏捷なローグ、マスターシャープシューター、または銀舌の外交官になりましょう。 剣、斧、レイピア、鎧、マスケット、ピストルの幅広い選択肢で自分と仲間を装備しましょう。 アミュレット、弾薬、ポーションを作成し、常に戦闘に備えましょう。 挑戦を求めましょう - より多く戦うほど、あなたとキャラクターの両方がより強くなります。 襲撃から包囲まで軍事作戦を指揮しましょう。
detailed_descriptions.ko: Sea Dogs 시리즈와 시드 마이어의 파이럿츠!에서 영감을 받았습니다 기회와 신비로 가득한 1654년 카리브해에 오신 것을 환영합니다. 형을 도우러 신대륙으로 떠난 젊은 프랑스 귀족 샤를 드 모르의 역할을 맡으세요. 처음에는 단순한 가족 문제로 보였던 것이 빠르게 평생의 모험으로 발전합니다. 카리브해에서 가장 영향력 있는 인물이 되는 응석받이 귀족의 이야기에 빠져보세요. 부, 지위, 권력, 그리고 로맨스 – 궁극의 전리품이 기다리고 있으며, 모든 것을 차지하는 것은 당신에게 달려 있습니다. 200시간의 여정을 시작하세요. 수백 개의 퀘스트를 완료하세요. 자유롭게 플레이하거나, 스토리를 빠르게 진행하거나, 둘 다 결합하세요 - 당신이 선장이며, 당신의 배는 당신이 명령하는 곳으로 항해합니다. 신비로운 터치가 가미된 역사적 서사를 경험하세요. 로맨틱한 관심사와 동료들을 탐험하세요. 총독부터 해적 남작까지 다양한 경력 옵션 중에서 선택하세요. 카리브해 – 수십 개의 섬과 도시들의 왕국, 신비와 비밀에 싸인 거대한 군도입니다. 인디언 피라미드의 정상부터 바다 깊은 곳까지 독특한 보상, 퀘스트, 그리고 호기심을 자극하는 것들이 기다리고 있습니다. 이 오픈 월드는 당신의 놀이터이며, 원하는 대로 자유롭게 탐험하고 전설을 만들어갈 수 있습니다. 당신의 결정이 어디로 갈지, 무엇을 할지, 누구를 데려갈지를 결정합니다. 신대륙을 정복하지 않으면 당신이 파멸할 것입니다! 수십 개의 섬과 정착지를 발견하세요. 자신만의 식민지를 건설하세요. 동굴, 피라미드, 정글, 인디언 부족, 잃어버린 도시들을 탐험하세요. 술집, 매춘굴, 조선소, 교회, 요새 및 기타 많은 흥미로운 장소들을 방문하세요. 보물 사냥과 도박에 참여하세요. 역동적인 날씨와 고요한 터키석 바다를 경험하세요. 군함을 소유하는 것은 특권이자 지위의 상징이며 사치입니다. 당신은 그러한 위대함을 감당할 수 있는 소수 중 하나입니다. 간단한 슬루프로 여정을 시작하여 전열함이나 심지어 이런 강력한 함선들의 함대를 지휘하는 단계까지 올라가세요. 마음대로 도시들을 약탈할 준비를 갖추세요. 아무도 당신의 길을 막지 못할 것입니다. 거대한 함대를 이끌고 책임을 지는 것에 지쳤나요? 빠른 프리깃이나 코르벳의 지휘를 맡고 단순히 카리브해를 자유롭게 탐험하세요. 바다에서의 평온한 순간에는 숨막히는 경치를 즐기고, 탐험의 감각을 받아들이거나, 폭풍의 중심에서 항해하세요. 범선 시대의 영광을 대표하는 수십 척의 선박을 지휘하세요. 커스터마이즈하고, 페인팅하고, 업그레이드하고, 선박을 수리하세요. 무자비하지만 재미있는 해전에 참여하세요. 상부 갑판부터 선장실까지 치열한 백병전 액션을 경험하세요. 바다를 지배하기 위해 독특한 선박들을 수집하세요. 전리품 분배, 사기, 반란의 위협을 관리하세요. 강력한 장교 팀을 구성하세요. 선장들은 육지에 발을 딛을 때 가장 취약해집니다. 해전에서 생존하는 것은 도전적일 수 있지만, 적어도 혼자 죽지는 않습니다 – 당신의 선원들이 끝까지 함께할 것입니다. 육상 전투는 다릅니다: 부정직하고, 무자비하며, 당신과 당신이 사랑하는 사람들에게 위험합니다. 동료들을 데려가고, 무기에 독을 바르고, 지형을 연구하고, 치명적인 아이템을 만들고, 악한, 군인, 해적, 라이벌들과 정면 대결하세요. 캐릭터의 빌드를 맞춤화하세요 – 중무장 검사, 민첩한 도적, 마스터 저격수, 또는 은혀의 외교관이 되세요. 검, 도끼, 레이피어, 갑옷, 머스킷, 피스톨의 광범위한 선택으로 자신과 동료들을 무장시키세요. 부적, 탄약, 물약을 만들고 항상 전투에 대비하세요. 도전을 추구하세요 – 더 많이 싸울수록 당신과 캐릭터 모두 더 강해집니다. 습격부터 포위까지 군사 작전을 지휘하세요.

detailed_descriptions.en: Based on Age of Pirates 2: City of Abandoned Ships version 1.3.2 AT by BlackMark Studio (C). A unique genre blending naval combat, land exploration, and open-world global map. Think Sid Meier's Pirates! meets Bannerlord. You are the captain and owner of your own ship—the finest fate one could hope for in the 17th century Caribbean. Pledge your service to colonial powers, engage in trade, plunder merchant convoys, explore uncharted islands, conquer settlements, hunt for buried treasure, meet historical figures, recruit a crew of loyal companions, and command a fleet of legendary vessels. Step into the role of Peter Blood, a skilled physician whose life takes an unexpected turn after being wrongfully accused of treason and sold into slavery. From these humble beginnings, you'll forge your path to freedom and perhaps become the most feared or respected figure in the Caribbean. Or create your own character and freely explore the world of the Golden Age of Pirates. Sixty of hours of content: Multiple characters and nations to choose from Female protagonist option Open-world sandbox without restrictions Modern controls and Caribbean Legend engine Letters of marque, sieges, and colony conquest Historical events and personalities Over 20 major side quests—from ancient curses to gubernatorial conspiracies Hundreds of procedural missions and assignments Dozens of ships, hundreds of items, and unique weaponry Romance storylines and companions Naval and land-based combat Enhanced world map Explore native ruins and urban dungeons Trade, treasure hunting, and piracy on your path to wealth and glory

games.name: CARIMARA: Beneath the forlorn limbs
games.short_description: A mute little thing with borrowed magic. A house that murmurs back. Ask wrong, and you might wake something that remembers your name.

descriptions.en: A mute little thing with borrowed magic. A house that murmurs back. Ask wrong, and you might wake something that remembers your name.

detailed_descriptions.en: I had a blast creating this little game. It's a short experience, and I hope the secrets and little surprises I hid in it will stay with you for a long time! - Bastinus Rex You are the Carimara. Small, mute, sorcerous. Born of moss and mirrorlight, skilled only in the art of asking. Wandering a house stitched from grief and riddles; you don't speak, you don’t chant, you don’t fight. You hold the house by its dead hands and conjure questions from dust, from bone, from whatever’s left behind. Be careful not to press too far, or wake you might, what's sealed afar. You Are Mute, But You Have A Gift Of Conjuring Questions You speak through cards with glyphs long lost, in halls where kindness hides its cost. Some smile, some sneer, some simply stare, but all who watch know you are there. Every Object Is A Memory Within these walls, let silence guide, where cards bloom from what things once hide. Ask gently now, with ghostly touch. Some secrets crack when pressed too much. A Stillness Dressed In Dust And Flame Candlelight flickers on furniture worn, in rooms where silence was weathered and torn. It waits in the gloom with a breath held tight, a hush that has lingered far past the night. A Tale In Threads Of Quiet Dread No blades to swing, no foes to fight. Just riddles wrapped in candlelight. For those who seek what lies askew, where stories murmur back to you.

games.name: Carmen Sandiego
games.short_description: The scarlet super thief Carmen Sandiego is back! Adorn Carmen’s signature red hat and play as the vigilante herself to navigate a world of espionage, utilizing high-tech gadgets, and ultimately capturing VILE.

descriptions.en: The scarlet super thief Carmen Sandiego is back! Adorn Carmen’s signature red hat and play as the vigilante herself to navigate a world of espionage, utilizing high-tech gadgets, and ultimately capturing VILE.

detailed_descriptions.en: VILE is back on the scene, and for once, ACME and Carmen Sandiego have a common enemy. In a rare and temporary alliance, the world’s greatest thief must track down the syndicate before they can pull off their next big heist. Rookie gumshoes and seasoned detectives are invited to put their sleuthing skills to the test whether it’s in the narrative driven main campaign or the classic mode ‘The Acme Files’. IT TAKES A THIEF TO CATCH A THIEF Carmen Sandiego, the elusive master thief, has temporarily aligned herself with ACME. Her intimate knowledge of VILE’s operations and her unparalleled skills in espionage make her an invaluable, albeit risky, ally. TRAVEL THE GLOBE From the bustling streets of Rio de Janeiro to the majestic landmarks of Tokyo, embark on a whirlwind tour of the world's most iconic destinations. With stunning visuals and immersive environments, every location comes to life, inviting you to explore, discover, and unravel the secrets that lie within. GEAR UP GUMSHOE A great thief is only as good as her tools. Glide across rooftops, grapple between buildings, and switch between night vision, UV, and thermal to track suspects and find hidden clues. SOLVE CAPERS Use quick thinking and detective skills to decode messages, crack safes, and outwit VILE operatives before they disappear. Every choice impacts your mission, so act fast! CAPTURE VILE Use clues, interviews, and the ACME CrimeNet Database to profile and identify VILE operatives. But remember, a warrant is essential before making any arrests! Will you crack the case and bring VILE to justice, or will they evade capture?
