games.name: D-topia
games.short_description: Step into the world of D-topia in this gentle-paced puzzle adventure. In D-topia, life is curated by artificial intelligence to maximize happiness. As the newest Facilitator, it’s up to you to solve puzzles to keep the D-topia residents happy and the facility running.

descriptions.en: Step into the world of D-topia in this gentle-paced puzzle adventure. In D-topia, life is curated by artificial intelligence to maximize happiness. As the newest Facilitator, it’s up to you to solve puzzles to keep the D-topia residents happy and the facility running.

detailed_descriptions.en: Step into a future where happiness is curated by artificial intelligence, in this gentle-paced puzzle adventure. The Utopia Project was created in the interest of maximizing human happiness and comfort. As the newest residential Facilitator at D-topia, your role is to resolve issues around the residential community. Tackle fun logic-based puzzles to resolve mechanical issues and keep the facilities running smoothly and meet the many vibrant residents, each with their own unique story and personal struggle. But what happens when problems go beyond the mechanical? How will your choices impact the wellbeing of the residents, and the future of humanity? In a world of curated happiness, what does it mean to find purpose? Features A Gentle-Paced, Reflective Adventure: Unwind in a calm, yet thought-provoking journey to discover what happiness truly means. Clever, Integrated Puzzles: Tackle satisfying logic puzzles that connect to the heart of this gentle-paced adventure. Meet D-topia’s Residents: Gain their trust, discover their stories, and shape their futures in unexpected ways. Your Choices Matter: Guide this artificial intelligence-managed utopia toward joy or despair through your decisions. Step Into Two Worlds: Move between the bright, public reality and the hidden “Block Side” to fix glitches and uncover secrets.

games.name: D.E.C.A.Y.
games.short_description: Survive 365 days to earn absolute freedom. Become the operator of a remote D.E.C.A.Y. bunker, explore the scorched sectors of the United States with your robot companion, gather resources, and maintain the Atlas network in hardcore VR, where order is a matter of choice.

descriptions.en: Survive 365 days to earn absolute freedom. Become the operator of a remote D.E.C.A.Y. bunker, explore the scorched sectors of the United States with your robot companion, gather resources, and maintain the Atlas network in hardcore VR, where order is a matter of choice.

detailed_descriptions.en: The world collapsed after a nuclear war. Cities were reduced to ruins, roads vanished beneath the ash, and the territory of the former United States was divided into scorched, deadly sectors. From the ruins of the old world emerged D.E.C.A.Y. - the Department of Environmental Control and Yield . Officially, it is an agency responsible for distributing what remains of vital supplies. In reality, it is a cynical, ruthless, and final force struggling to maintain control over a dying planet. You are the operator of a remote bunker designated “Facility 16”. You signed a contract with the organization for exactly 365 days. One year of autonomous service under total isolation and extreme risk in exchange for a single reward - absolute freedom. Provided, of course, that you survive long enough to receive your final settlement. Key Features: Your bunker is your fortress and your workplace. Maintain life-support systems, repair equipment at workbenches, calibrate the neuro-sensory modules of your personal PDA, and keep track of your supplies. Every new 24-hour cycle changes the balance of threats and available resources on the surface. The sky is under your control. Your primary duty is to maintain the A.C.C.S. “Atlas” surface network. These massive installations sustain a radiation and thermal shield over the region, preventing the sun from scorching the surface. Monitor the power grid from the bunker’s main terminal, venture outside, locate expensive nuclear batteries, and perform “hot” replacements. Remember: the shutdown of even a single node immediately redistributes the load, causing neighboring Atlas units to drain several times faster. A loyal mechanical companion. You have access to a specialized search bot capable of accompanying you on the surface and assisting during dangerous expeditions. Only its built-in sensors and manipulators can detect emissions from the rifts, scan them, and safely extract valuable post-nuclear modifiers. Protect the bot while it works - without it, you may return to the bunker empty-handed. The treasures and curses of the rifts. The crystalline modifiers recovered by your bot provide powerful advantages, but many also carry dangerous side effects. Install a stable “Amber Heart” in your suit to slightly increase your health, or risk using the blazing “Death Stone,” capable of devastating your body’s protective systems. You can also surrender the dangerous mineral to the Department, which uses its destructive energy to manufacture heavy special-purpose ammunition. Wasteland politics. Not everyone agrees with the Department’s methods. Beyond the sealed bunker doors, you will face raiders, feral mutants, and soldiers of the high-tech faction known as “Legacy.” When their heavily armored enforcers, the “Judges,” arrive in your sector, you will need to use your entire tactical arsenal to survive. Hardcore VR immersion. Experience realistic environmental interaction and authentic shooting physics. The game features 32 weapons - from assault and sniper rifles to pistols, heavy fire axes, and baseball bats. Discover deeply detailed weapon mechanics: for example, the heavy M88 “Hunter” carbine requires you to manually rotate the bolt handle and pull it back after every powerful shot. As you complete more directives, one thing becomes increasingly clear: the orders issued by your superiors do not always match the reality on the ground. Eventually, you will have to decide whose contracts to accept and what order truly means to you. You have no squad. No permanent support. No safe zones. There is only you... Your search bot... Your bunker... And the countdown to freedom...

games.name: DAEMON X MACHINA
games.short_description: Pilot your fully customizable Arsenal mech and join your fellow mercenaries in defending humanity from the corrupted machines and gigantic robots in this post-apocalyptic action game!

descriptions.en: Pilot your fully customizable Arsenal mech and join your fellow mercenaries in defending humanity from the corrupted machines and gigantic robots in this post-apocalyptic action game!

detailed_descriptions.en: "Welcome to your battlefield." You are an Outer, a new breed of human being that appeared in the aftermath of the Moonfall calamity. As a mercenary for the Orbital organization, you are on the front line of a desperate war for humanity's survival against the Immortals—corrupted AIs that have rebelled against their human creators. Piloting a fully customizable mech known as an Arsenal, you must team up with mercenaries like yourself and complete missions to defeat the Immortals once and for all. But be careful—in a war fought by mercenaries, today's allies can become tomorrow's enemies. From the visionary minds of Kenichiro Tsukuda and trailblazing mech designer Shoji Kawamori comes a new generation of high-speed mech action combat. GAME FEATURES Soar across the battlefield and engage in frenetic, high-stakes mech combat against corrupted machines and gargantuan Colossal Immortals. Fully customize your Arsenal mech with a variety of weapons and parts to your exact specifications. Salvage defeated enemies for parts and weapons, which you can use on the fly on the battlefield. Customize your player avatar with a variety of cosmetic options. Go under the knife and receive extensive body modifications to learn new skills at the cost of your human appearance. Team up with players in online Co-op Mode to destroy bosses, or take on Exploration Missions together to map Immortal bases and unlock powerful gear. Battle other players in 1 vs. 1 or 2 vs. 2 Versus Mode and climb the leaderboard rankings to become the top mercenary.

games.name: Daemon X Machina: Titanic Scion

names.zh-Hant: 機甲戰魔 神話之裔

games.short_description: Feel the exhilaration of fast-paced combat in your fully customized armored suit as you freely explore a deadly and dangerous world on land or in the air. Take on titanic boss battles with alone or with up to two other friends in online co-op!

descriptions.en: Feel the exhilaration of fast-paced combat in your fully customized armored suit as you freely explore a deadly and dangerous world on land or in the air. Take on titanic boss battles with alone or with up to two other friends in online co-op!
descriptions.zh-Hant: 《機甲戰魔 神話之裔》是一款機甲動作遊戲，玩家將穿上名為「兵裝機甲」的機甲戰衣，在地面與空中自由馳騁，展開激戰。駕駛個性化兵裝機甲，搭載各式各樣的裝備，在戰場上縱橫馳騁，盡享自由戰鬥快感。透過全方位機動作戰，體驗前所未有的酣暢淋漓的戰鬥！
descriptions.ja: 『デモンエクスマキナ タイタニックサイオン』は、自分好みにカスタマイズした「アーセナル」と呼ばれるアーマースーツを身に纏い、地上と空中を自在に駆けながら戦うメカアクションゲームです。
descriptions.ko: "DAEMON X MACHINA TITANIC SCION"은 "아스널"이라 불리는 아머 슈트를 착용하고 지상과 공중을 자유자재로 누비며 싸우는 메카 액션 게임입니다.다양한 장비를 자유롭게 커스터마이징한 아스널로 필드를 누비는 해방감과 입체적인 액션이 만들어내는 상쾌한 배틀을 즐길 수 있습니다.

detailed_descriptions.en: Become the ultimate high-tech warrior in an action-packed new entry in the Daemon X Machina series. Fly into battle in your customized Arsenal, unleashing a variety of attacks tailored to your playstyle. Feel the exhilaration of fast-paced combat as you freely explore a deadly and dangerous open world on land or in the air. After taking down your foes, collect their weapons and equipment, and upgrade your skills to expand your options on the battlefield. Suit up for a dark sci-fi story where you can face the titanic boss battles alone or with up to two other players online. New and veteran Daemon X Machina players alike will find a worthy adventure in the latest from Marvelous First Studio. A Titanic Evolution Daemon X Machina’s high-octane armored action debuts on a new generation of platforms, bringing with it an epic sci-fi adventure, gameplay that’s accessible to newcomers, and an expanded scope sure to satisfy returning fans. Together You Can Make a Difference Cooperative multiplayer means you never truly fight alone. Team up with friends online to tackle the epic story and boss battles together. Build a Better You Now a nimble suit of armor, your Arsenal can be fully customized both in design and in loadout, with the ability to craft or salvage new elements. Beautiful and Deadly Explore an alien planet in your Arsenal as you battle against mechanical and organic enemies. Trek through the vast open world on foot, fly through the skies, or when all else fails, gallop on horseback across plains, swamps, mountains, and more.
detailed_descriptions.zh-Hant: 新的抗爭就此揭開序幕。 《機甲戰魔》系列最新作登場。 自由組合多樣化裝備，身披親手打造的兵裝機甲，投身槍聲與怒吼交織的戰場，體驗精彩刺激的機甲動作遊戲！ 駕駛個性化自訂機體，在地面與空中戰場中疾馳，享受縱橫戰場的解放快感。 運用多樣兵裝，全力殲滅敵人，體驗暢快淋漓的爽快戰鬥！ 本作支援多人連線模式，可與其他玩家並肩作戰，共同挑戰劇情任務、Boss戰等多種玩法。 無論是系列老玩家，還是初次加入的新手，都能依照自己的風格，盡情享受《機甲戰魔》系列最新作的戰鬥樂趣。 在不朽機甲肆虐的戰場上盡情馳騁！ 遼闊無垠的戰場上，各類任務等待你的挑戰，不朽機甲的威脅步步逼近。 執行任務、探索戰場、收集裝備——一切行動皆由你決定。 身披兵裝機甲，隨心所欲地馳騁於這片戰場之上。 多樣兵裝與全方位戰鬥帶來暢快淋漓的戰鬥體驗 本作戰鬥方式豐富多樣。你可以使用刀刃等近戰武器，憑藉機動性進行靈活攻擊； 也可以運用飛彈、電磁炮等重型武器從正面突破；還有機會獲取擊敗敵人的裝備即時換裝，繼續投入戰鬥。 巧妙運用各種兵裝，體驗身穿機甲戰衣時帶來的爽快感，縱橫戰場，殲滅敵人！ 從300種以上的裝備中，打造只屬於你的專屬兵裝機甲！ 外部裝甲「兵裝機甲」可根據不同的裝甲組合，改變機動性、防禦力及擅長的武器類型，進而影響整體機體性能。 透過自由搭配5種裝甲部位、最多6種武裝，以及賦予特殊效果的附件，你可以打造最符合自己戰鬥風格的專屬機體！
detailed_descriptions.ja: 新たな闘争がここに。 「DAEMON X MACHINA」シリーズ最新作登場 多様な装備を組み合わせて作り上げたアーセナルを身に纏い、 銃声と咆哮が響き渡る戦場に飛び込むメカアクションゲーム。 自分好みにカスタマイズした機体で、地上と空中に広がるフィールドを、シームレスに駆け巡る解放感。 多彩な兵装を駆使して敵を撃破していく爽快感が楽しめる。 他プレイヤーと共に、ストーリーやボスバトルなど多彩な協力プレイが楽しめるオンラインモードにも対応。 前作を遊んだプレイヤーも、今作から始めるプレイヤーも、自分のスタイルで戦える「DAEMON X MACHINA」シリーズ最新作。 イモータルが跋扈する広大なフィールドを、思うがままに駆け巡れ シームレスに広がるフィールドには、様々なオーダーと迫りくるイモータルの脅威が待ち受ける。 オーダーの遂行、フィールド探索、装備収集――何をするかはあなた次第。 アーセナルを身に纏い、思うがままに駆け巡れ。 多彩な兵装と立体的なアクションが織りなす、爽快感あふれるバトル ブレードなどの近接装備で機動力を活かして攻める。 ミサイルやレールガンなどの重火器で正面突破する。 時には、倒した敵の装備をリアルタイムで換装して戦うなど戦い方は様々。 多彩な兵装を駆使して、縦横無尽に敵を駆逐していくアーマースーツならではの爽快感が楽しめる。 300種類以上の装備から作る、あなただけのアーセナル 外部装甲「アーセナル」は、アーマー部位の組み合わせによって機動力や防御力など機体性能が変わる。 5つのアーマー部位、最大6つの武装、そして特殊効果を付与するアタッチメントを組み合わせることであなたのバトルスタイルにあった機体を作ることができる。
detailed_descriptions.ko: 새로운 전쟁이 여기에서。 「DAEMON X MACHINA」시리즈 최신작 등장。 다양한 장비를 조합하여 만들어낸 아스널을 장착하고, 총성과 포효로 가득한 전장 속에 몸을 던지는 메카닉 액션 게임입니다. 자신만의 스타일로 자유롭게 커스터마이징한 기체를 타고, 지상과 공중을 넘나들며 펼쳐지는 필드를 누비도록 완전한 해방감. 거기에 더해, 다양한 병기를 구사하여 적을 격파하는 상쾌감까지 즐길 수 있습니다. 다른 플레이어와 함께 스토리나 보스 배틀 등 다채로운 협력 플레이를 즐길 수 있는 온라인 모드도 지원합니다. 전작을 플레이했던 유저도, 이번 작품부터 시작하는 유저도 자신의 스타일로 싸울 수 있는 "DAEMON X MACHINA" 시리즈의 최신작입니다. 이모탈이 지배하는 필드를 자유롭게 누벼라 끊임없이 펼쳐진 필드에는 다양한 오더와 몰려오는 이모탈의 위협이 당신을 기다리고 있다.오더의 달성, 필드의 탐색, 장비 수집 등 무엇을 할 것인지는 당신의 손에 달렸다. 아스널을 장착하고 자유롭게 필드를 누비자. 다양한 병기과 입체적인 액션이 만들어내는 상쾌감 넘치는 배틀 블레이드와 같은 근접 장비로 기동성을 살려 공격하거나, 미사일이나 레일건 등의 중화기로 정면 돌파, 때로는 쓰러뜨린 적의 장비를 실시간으로 장착하여 싸우는 등 전투 방식이 다양하다. 다양한 병기를 구사하여 종횡무진으로 적들을 구축하러 가는 아머 슈트만의 상쾌감도 즐길 수 있다. 300종류 이상의 장비로 구현하는 나만의 아스널 외부 장갑 [아스널]은 아머의 조합에 따라 기동력이나 방어력 등 기체 성능이 달라진다. 5개의 아머 부위와 최대 6개의 무장, 그리고 특수 효과를 부여하는 어태치먼트를 조합하여 자신만의 배틀 스타일에 맞는 기체를 만들 수 있다.

games.name: Dagger Directive
games.short_description: Dagger Directive is a tactical FPS that allows you to approach each mission in your own way. Select equipment, decide the time of day, then move methodically to complete your mission. Enjoy the modern mechanics and old school graphics as you fight across a variety of missions and environments.

descriptions.en: Dagger Directive is a tactical FPS that allows you to approach each mission in your own way. Select equipment, decide the time of day, then move methodically to complete your mission. Enjoy the modern mechanics and old school graphics as you fight across a variety of missions and environments.

detailed_descriptions.en: You are a member of Task Force Dagger , an elite international special forces unit. Your missions take you across the globe—through frozen coasts, dense jungles, and war-torn cities. In Dagger Directive , tactical freedom is everything: pick your loadout, choose the time of day, and decide whether to strike hard and fast or move like a ghost. Every mission is yours to shape. Fight across three full campaigns , each set in a distinct region with its own atmosphere, enemies, and tactical challenges. Disrupt an eco-terrorist operation in the frigid Bering Sea. Battle organized crime across the volatile South Pacific. Crush an extremist uprising in Eastern Europe. Each mission offers a different tactical sandbox, with objectives you can approach from multiple angles. Gear up from a robust arsenal of 25+ weapons , each customizable with a wide range of attachments. Whether you're breaching doors with an underbarrel shotgun, clearing angles with suppressed SMGs, or picking off targets at extreme range, the armory has you covered. Supplement your firepower with drones, tripwires, grenades, and mines , and experiment with combinations that suit your style. Dagger Directive blends modern game feel with grounded mechanics. Every bullet and piece of shrapnel has weight, velocity, and trajectory—simulated in real time. Adjust your scope for distance, lead moving targets, and respect the chaos of ricochets. Even grenades scatter deadly fragments that obey real physics. This isn’t just spray and pray—it’s precision under pressure. Each mission takes place in a large open area with multiple entry points, dense foliage, and tactical verticality. Control the environment by shooting out lights, hiding in tall grass, or stalking through shadows. Select the time of day before each op—just don’t forget your NVGs if you’re going in after dark. The battlefield is a tool, if you know how to use it. EARLY ACCESS CONTENT The Early Access version of Dagger Directive is already packed with depth and variety: A 15-mission campaign that spans all three global theaters, offering replayability through multiple tactical approaches. Full co-op multiplayer , so you and your squad can coordinate, flank, and execute missions together. Over 25 weapons , dozens of attachments, and a wide variety of tactical gear—already giving you the tools to play your way. A broad range of tactical equipment including deployable drones, anti-personnel mines, and multiple grenade types, adding layers of strategic options. COMING IN FUTURE UPDATES Post-launch development will expand both depth and customization: A mission editor with full Steam Workshop support , allowing players to build and share their own operations. An expanded tutorial system that dives deeper into advanced weapons, tools, and stealth mechanics. A powerful Free Play Mode , where players can spawn enemies, allies, vehicles, and gear to experiment or create their own combat scenarios. Modding support for weapons and gear , empowering the community to add entirely new content to the sandbox.

games.name: Danganronpa 2: Goodbye Despair
games.short_description: Jabberwock Island—You and your classmates were ready for fun in the sun until Monokuma returned to restart his murderous game! Trapped in a kill-or-be-killed situation, your only hope rests in solving the island’s mysteries.

descriptions.en: Jabberwock Island—You and your classmates were ready for fun in the sun until Monokuma returned to restart his murderous game! Trapped in a kill-or-be-killed situation, your only hope rests in solving the island’s mysteries.

detailed_descriptions.en: Jabberwock Island – once a popular tourist destination, this now uninhabited island remains oddly pristine. You and your classmates at the elite Hope's Peak Academy have been brought to this island by your super-cute teacher for a “lovey-dovey, heart-throbbing school trip.” Everyone seems to be having fun in the sun...until Monokuma returns to restart his murderous game! Trapped on this island of mutual killing, your only hope of escape rests in solving the island’s mysteries. But be warned—sometimes the truth can be its own despair... Key Features Deadly Island Vibes: Murder is the only means of escape when you’re trapped on this island paradise. As your fellow classmates start dropping like coconuts, you’ll need to delve into each murderous incident, forage for clues, and interview your classmates to reveal the opportunity, motive, and means behind each killer case! Tribal Council: You’ll go head-to-head in all new minigames with the other students during the Class Trial, shooting down their false truths and using your evidence to uncover what really happened. But watch out! If a student is unconvinced, they'll challenge you to a one-on-one Rebuttal Showdown and force you to defend your argument! Survival of the Keenest: Match up your evidence with your fellow classmates’ arguments and determine who’s really telling the truth. Once you’ve got a suspect in your sights, turn up that tropical heat in a variety of timing and reflex-based game systems to reveal the ultimate truth and escape with your life! Steam Features: Supports Steam Achievements and Steam Cloud with plans to add Steam Trading Cards

games.short_description: Komaru Naegi has been imprisoned inside a mysterious apartment for over a year. Her rescue is derailed when hundreds of Monokumas suddenly attack. She teams up with Toko Fukawa to survive the rampaging Monokumas, escape the crafty Monokuma Kids, and uncover the secrets of the city.

descriptions.en: Komaru Naegi has been imprisoned inside a mysterious apartment for over a year. Her rescue is derailed when hundreds of Monokumas suddenly attack. She teams up with Toko Fukawa to survive the rampaging Monokumas, escape the crafty Monokuma Kids, and uncover the secrets of the city.

detailed_descriptions.en: Komaru Naegi, little sister to Makoto Naegi, has been imprisoned inside a mysterious apartment for over a year. One day, she is rescued by Byakuya Togami of Future Foundation, but the rescue is derailed by a sudden attack of hundreds of Monokumas. Komaru soon discovers that the city has been taken over by a group of children calling themselves the Warriors of Hope. Their leader, Monaca, declares that the city will be the site of a “children's paradise,” and to accomplish this, all the adults will be exterminated. Komaru teams up with Toko Fukawa to try to survive the rampaging Monokumas, escape the crafty Monokuma Kids, and uncover the secrets of the city. Key Features Third Person Shooter Action Sequences: Use Future Foundation's Hacking Gun to have a fighting chance against the hordes of Monokumasas you traverse Towa City. Riddles and Puzzles: The MonokumaKids will challenge more than just your trigger finger; you'll need your smarts to survive as well. There's a lot to discover in the city, with a number of familiar faces and mysteries to unravel! Tons of Different Types of Ammo: Tackle challenges with multiple kinds of Truth Bullets, such as Paralyze and Link. Upgrade your firepower with special Bling Bullet modifiers. Steam Features: Supports Steam Achievements, Steam Cloud and Steam Trading Cards

games.name: Danganronpa S: Ultimate Summer Camp
games.short_description: With an all-star dream lineup of characters from each Danganronpa game, gather Hope Fragments at a tropical resort. Explore Jabberwock Island and develop your Dangan characters. Gather money through battle and upgrade your equipment, then defeat bosses and move on to the next island!

descriptions.en: With an all-star dream lineup of characters from each Danganronpa game, gather Hope Fragments at a tropical resort. Explore Jabberwock Island and develop your Dangan characters. Gather money through battle and upgrade your equipment, then defeat bosses and move on to the next island!

detailed_descriptions.en: DANGANRONPA S: ULTIMATE SUMMER CAMP is now on Steam! Summary Danganronpa S: Ultimate Summer Camp is a massively enhanced version of Ultimate Talent Development Plan, the boardgame from Danganronpa V3: Killing Harmony. The stage is set at the tropical resort of Jabberwock Island, and players improve their characters via the "Development (Boardgame)," "Battle," and so on. Danganronpa S: Ultimate Summer Camp is the dream crossover of Danganronpa characters with over 1,000 event scenes, and offers new swimsuit outfits for all characters. Also, players can now collect collab illustrations drawn for merchandise in the Mono Mono Machine! ・Game features Development (Boardgame) The main part of the game in which players will develop their character over 50 days (50 turns) of summer camp on Jabberwock Island. Roll a die to determine how many spaces to move. An event will be triggered depending on which square the character lands on. Each character has various stats, including level. detailed_descriptions.en: Hope's Peak Academy is home to Japan's best and brightest high school students—the beacons of hope for the future. But that hope suddenly dies when Makoto Naegi and his classmates find themselves imprisoned in the school, cut off from the outside world and subject to the whims of a strange, murderous little bear named Monokuma. He pits the students against each other, promising freedom to anyone who can murder a fellow classmate and get away with it. It's up to you to find out who Monokuma really is, and why you've been taken from the world you once knew. But be careful what you wish for—sometimes there’s nothing more deadly than the truth... Key Features Daily Life, Deadly Life: Trapped in a school-turned-prison, students are murdering each other one by one. You’ll have to investigate each incident, search for clues, and talk to your classmates to try and get to the bottom of each brutal case! Mock Trial: The nefarious Monokuma serves as judge, jury, and executioner as you engage in deadly wordplay, going back and forth with suspects, dissecting their statements and firing their words back at them to expose their lies! Popularity Contest: Sway classmates to your side in each investigation, squeezing information from them to figure out who did it. And when you do, turn up the heat in a variety of timing and reflex-based game systems to uncover the truth and save your skin! Steam Features: Supports Steam Achievements, Steam Cloud and Steam Trading Cards.

games.name: Dark Deity
games.short_description: Step into the world of Terrazael and lead soon-to-be legendary heroes in a quest to restore a land fractured by broken oaths, reckless wars, and untamed magic. Fight back in turn-based battles, manage character relationships, collect dangerous artifacts, and hopefully restore the world...

descriptions.en: Step into the world of Terrazael and lead soon-to-be legendary heroes in a quest to restore a land fractured by broken oaths, reckless wars, and untamed magic. Fight back in turn-based battles, manage character relationships, collect dangerous artifacts, and hopefully restore the world...

detailed_descriptions.en: Terrazael. A world torn apart by oathbreakers, warmongers, and wielders of forbidden arcane secrets. A world on its last strand of hope brought to its knees by a Calamity centuries ago that tore down its mighty civilizations. Petty kings rule in place of grand emperors of old that wage fruitless, ill-advised wars picking over ancient ruins like glorified scavengers. Lead a team of four students in the Brookstead Military Academy, who are shut down on the mysterious orders of King Varic. The ruler of the Kingdom of Delia is preparing to break a millennium-old treaty and Brookstead students make for fine cannon fodder... However, these four soldiers are destined for more than just acting as unwilling meat for another grinder. They may not know it yet, but they will make their mark on history. Lead soldiers into the fray across a world torn apart by endless war and magical cataclysms. Fight through hand-crafted, turn-based combat scenarios spread out across 28 chapters, as rookies become veterans. Test your tactical mettle. Maneuver, attack, break through, and - maybe - turn the tide of the war. Engineer the rise of legends, from a pile of raw conscripts to a band of mythical heroes. Carefully nurture your squad to ensure survival through long bouts to make a difference in a seemingly hopeless world. Assemble the squad from 30 playable characters, with their own background, personality, and motivations, then train them and pick from 54 distinct classes, with their own iconic attacks and skills. Outfit each team with hundreds of weapons and spells, from simple blades and missiles to ancient, eldritch artifacts that produce world-ending magic. Defeat doesn’t mean permadeath, but there is a price to pay: Every time a warrior falls, it means a grave wound, a stat penalty, and weakening your squad. Hope is a rare commodity in a world ruined by Calamity, good thing these heroes are filled to the brim. Defy the fates and make a difference as the head of this unlikely band of heroes. Watch characters bond together on the battlefield and their relationships evolve through 400 individual conversations. Remember: Any hero can make a difference - if they live long enough.

games.name: Dark Deity 2
games.short_description: Verroa is a peaceful continent on the brink of war as the Asverellian Empire seeks to expand - at your homeland’s expense. Command unlikely heroes, fight challenging turn-based battles, and watch hardship forge iron into steel. Dark Deity is back, bigger and better than before!

descriptions.en: Verroa is a peaceful continent on the brink of war as the Asverellian Empire seeks to expand - at your homeland’s expense. Command unlikely heroes, fight challenging turn-based battles, and watch hardship forge iron into steel. Dark Deity is back, bigger and better than before!

detailed_descriptions.en: Dark Deity is back! A quarter of a century has passed, as Irving and the Eternal Order carefully rebuilt Verroa to protect it against a future war. Their efforts will be put to the test far too soon as a new threat looms on the horizon. The neighboring Holy Asverellian Empire needs new lands to grow, and the fractious, fragile Verroa seems ripe for the taking. All that stands in its way is the Order and twenty scrappy heroes-to-be. Take command of the Eternal Delegation, led by Irving’s descendants. Gwyn and Riordian will have to navigate the treacherous politics of Verroa, and weave a web of alliances to turn the tide of the coming war. Your decisions will determine the shape of these alliances and define your army. Coupled with the help of a giant pool of customizations, no two playthroughs will ever feel the same. Put simply, Dark Deity 2 is about playing your way, all the way. Turn-based tactical combat is at the heart of Dark Deity 2. Your 20 heroes have access to 45 branching classes, each with its own powerful abilities, passive effects, and its own tactical niche… …that’s until you start experimenting with skills, abilities, and gear that can completely change the way a unit performs in the field and upend your tactics in a good way.. Heroes will bond as they fight seemingly impossible odds. Hardship forges the strongest bonds…but can also destroy friendships and wreak havoc. Will you be able to walk the line between the two? A desperate defense against an overwhelming foe. A land in the grasp of war fever, panic, and factional strife. A traitor around every corner. To have a chance at winning the war, you’ll need to make some difficult choices. Verroa is torn apart by factions, and many of these factions are fractured in turn. Decide who to support and who to throw to the wolves - but weigh each option carefully. After all, your choices may drastically change the coming battles… Every choice can fundamentally change the way you play the game. No two playthroughs are the same and what goes right in one game can go terribly wrong in the other. No playthroughs are the same, but you can push Dark Deity 2 even further. Inspired by the many community-made randomizers for popular RPGs, Dark Deity 2 features a built-in comprehensive randomizer and campaign customization suite from launch. Random recruitment order, custom difficulty runs with stat, aptitude, xp, gold sliders, and more are available, allowing for near-limitless replayability!

Right after breaking in, the power cuts out and you realize something isn’t right. You’re trapped inside the building you came to rob… and you’re not alone. A monster has taken over the place and you’re its next prey. Will you manage to escape? Will you survive this apocalyptic night? PLAN. BREAK. STEAL. Complete 12+ mission objectives : steal precious artifacts, destroy evidence, blow up the building, escape with the jackpot and more. Steal valuable loot , complete your contracts, and score big! COOPERATE. SURVIVE. ESCAPE. 8 unique monsters , each with their own abilities, strengths and weaknesses. Dynamic co-op gameplay : solve puzzles and minigames, deactivate lasers and security cameras, share (or steal) the loot. Be stealthy and aware of your surroundings: every bad step can attract the monsters. Survive together … or use your friends to get out alive. PLAY. EARN. games.short_description: Hunt the monsters that swarm the Dark Hunting Ground, collect the spoils, develop your skills freely and wisely and fight to become the strongest hunter!

descriptions.en: Hunt the monsters that swarm the Dark Hunting Ground, collect the spoils, develop your skills freely and wisely and fight to become the strongest hunter!

detailed_descriptions.en: Dark Hunting Ground A minimalist pixel-action RPG built around loot and power. As a new member of the Hunter's Association, you'll hunt monsters and face the creeping threat of the Void. Grow stronger with every battle—gathering loot, leveling up, and forging your build—until you're ready to confront the source of the corruption itself. Straight to the Point No bloated story. No filler. Just clean, streamlined combat and build-focused progression. Deep Builds, Minimalist Design Master complex, multi-layered builds where synergy is everything. Smart combinations and dimensional layering are key to becoming a true hunter. Loot, Optimized Go from hands-on farming to fully automated looting as you refine your systems. The grind evolves—your power does too. Descend into the Void The further you go, the harder it gets. Face ever-stronger Void Lords, test the limits of your build, and push into the endless depths. Core Features Minimalist Story - No filler. No lengthy plot-lines. Jump straight into combat and building your hunter. Endless Skill Combination - Mix and match across six archetypes—Warrior, Assassin, Scholar, Ranger, Summoner, and Guardian. Experiment with 18 core skills and their unique variants to forge your own playstyle. True Skill Customization - Every skill can be socketed with 7 Slates, drastically reshaping its form and effect. Layered Progression - Unlock deeper systems as you progress: talents, flasks, the Dark Tree, the Chaos Atlas, and Cognition. Endless Loot - 80 unique relics, 60 distinct Slates, and 35 Abyssal Eyes to combine into your ultimate build. Boss Hunts - Face five distinct bosses, each growing stronger as difficulty rises. Scaling Difficulty - The deeper you go, the harder it gets—unlocking new challenges and rewards with every tier. Custom Hunting Ground - Design your own hunting grounds with 13 different cores. Create endless hunts and test your limits. Automation, Your Way - From hands-on combat to fully automated farming, refine your systems and let the loot flow. Loot & Crafting - Every drop is randomized. Use the deterministic crafting system to perfect your gear piece by piece. Loot Filters & Auto-Pickup - Your trusty companion auto-loots everything. Customize filters to scrap junk and stash valuables. The Abyss - Survive endless waves in confined arenas. Tailor the difficulty and modifiers for bigger risks—and greater rewards. Build Presets - Save multiple builds and swap instantly without recreating your character. Training Dummy - Test your damage and survivability in a safe environment. Challenges - Experience the true dark hunting grounds in Cruel and Expert difficulty modes, racking your brains to face all possible threats. Player-Friendly Options - Customize keybinds, skip reward screens, and adjust skill effect transparency—everything designed to ensure a seamless and fun experience for you.

As a new member of the Hunter's Association, you'll hunt monsters and face the creeping threat of the Void. Grow stronger with every battle—gathering loot, leveling up, and forging your build—until you're ready to confront the source of the corruption itself.

Straight to the Point

No bloated story. No filler. Just clean, streamlined combat and build-focused progression.

Deep Builds, Minimalist Design

Master complex, multi-layered builds where synergy is everything. Smart combinations and dimensional layering are key to becoming a true hunter.

Loot, Optimized

Go from hands-on farming to fully automated looting as you refine your systems. The grind evolves—your power does too.

Descend into the Void

The further you go, the harder it gets. Face ever-stronger Void Lords, test the limits of your build, and push into the endless depths.

Core Features

  • Minimalist Story - No filler. No lengthy plot-lines. Jump straight into combat and building your hunter.
  • Endless Skill Combination - Mix and match across six archetypes—Warrior, Assassin, Scholar, Ranger, Summoner, and Guardian. Experiment with 18 core skills and their unique variants to forge your own playstyle.
  • True Skill Customization - Every skill can be socketed with 7 Slates, drastically reshaping its form and effect.
  • Layered Progression - Unlock deeper systems as you progress: talents, flasks, the Dark Tree, the Chaos Atlas, and Cognition.
  • Endless Loot - 80 unique relics, 60 distinct Slates, and 35 Abyssal Eyes to combine into your ultimate build.
  • Boss Hunts - Face five distinct bosses, each growing stronger as difficulty rises.
  • Scaling Difficulty - The deeper you go, the harder it gets—unlocking new challenges and rewards with every tier.
  • Custom Hunting Ground - Design your own hunting grounds with 13 different cores. Create endless hunts and test your limits.
  • Automation, Your Way - From hands-on combat to fully automated farming, refine your systems and let the loot flow.
  • Loot & Crafting - Every drop is randomized. Use the deterministic crafting system to perfect your gear piece by piece.
  • Loot Filters & Auto-Pickup - Your trusty companion auto-loots everything. Customize filters to scrap junk and stash valuables.
  • The Abyss - Survive endless waves in confined arenas. Tailor the difficulty and modifiers for bigger risks—and greater rewards.
  • Build Presets - Save multiple builds and swap instantly without recreating your character.
  • Training Dummy - Test your damage and survivability in a safe environment.
  • Challenges - Experience the true dark hunting grounds in Cruel and Expert difficulty modes, racking your brains to face all possible threats.
  • Player-Friendly Options - Customize keybinds, skip reward screens, and adjust skill effect transparency—everything designed to ensure a seamless and fun experience for you.

games.short_description: In a dying multiverse, the Phantom Train is your last hope. Traverse a post-apocalyptic, cyberpunk world of nightmarish creatures. Experience dynamic shifts between top-down and third-person views, deep customization, and epic battles across universes in this action roguelike survival game.

descriptions.en: In a dying multiverse, the Phantom Train is your last hope. Traverse a post-apocalyptic, cyberpunk world of nightmarish creatures. Experience dynamic shifts between top-down and third-person views, deep customization, and epic battles across universes in this action roguelike survival game.
descriptions.zh-Hant: 在濒临灭亡的多元宇宙中，幻影列车是你最后的希望。穿越一个充满梦魇怪物的后末日赛博朋克世界，在这款动作 Roguelike 生存游戏中，体验俯视与第三人称视角之间的动态切换、深度自定义系统，以及横跨多个时空的震撼战斗。

detailed_descriptions.en: Dark Light: Survivor is a roguelike survival game where you play as one of the last humans, journeying through a shattered multiverse in search of the fabled Elysium. The Dark Void has unleashed horrific creatures that decimated humanity and fractured the multiverse. Amidst this chaos, a legend speaks of an Elysium untouched by the darkness. The remnants of humanity have uncovered celestial quantum technology, using it to construct the Phantom Train, capable of traversing the multiverse. As a Dark Hunter, you are aboard the Phantom Train, hoping to reach Elysium. In each universe, you must collect energy to power the train for the next leap. Prepare yourself to face increasingly terrifying and powerful creatures, for the journey is perilous, and Elysium remains elusive. FEATURES Dynamic Perspective Shifts: Swap between top down and third person view at any time. Command the battlefield from above or move in close for immersive combat, precise aiming, and devastating headshots. Roguelike Progression Every run is a fight for survival. Gather resources, unlock permanent upgrades, discover powerful new weapons and items, and push deeper into increasingly brutal worlds. Distinct Biomes Cross three deadly worlds, a ruined town consumed by demons and cybernetic horrors, cursed castle ruins swallowed by the Dark Void, and a frozen battlefield where giant insect beasts roam among the wreckage of ancient warships. Artifacts and Skills Master 3 unique classes, each with distinct skills, strengths, and upgrade paths. Unlock Artifacts, earn permanent bonuses, and build your loadout with new starting weapons and abilities every run. Pixel Mode & Cinematic Graphics: Switch between cinematic 4K visuals and a nostalgic Pixel Mode that evokes classic indie games. Pixel Mode isn’t just a visual change.
detailed_descriptions.zh-Hant: 《Dark Light: Survivor》是一款 Roguelike 生存游戏。你将扮演人类最后的幸存者之一，穿越破碎的多元宇宙，寻找传说中的极乐之地 Elysium。 黑暗虚空释放出骇人的怪物，几乎毁灭了人类，并撕裂了整个多元宇宙。在这片混乱之中，流传着一个传说：有一处名为 Elysium 的净土，从未被黑暗侵蚀。 人类残存的势力发现了天体量子科技，并利用它建造出能够穿梭多元宇宙的“幻影列车”。 作为一名 Dark Hunter，你正身处这辆幻影列车之上，怀抱着抵达 Elysium 的希望前行。在每一个宇宙中，你都必须收集能量，为列车的下一次跃迁提供动力。做好准备，迎接越来越可怕、越来越强大的怪物。这段旅程危机四伏，而 Elysium 依旧遥不可及。 游戏特色 • 动态视角切换： 可随时在俯视视角与第三人称视角之间切换。既可从上方掌控战场全局，也可贴近战斗，体验更具沉浸感的近距离交锋、精准瞄准与致命爆头。 • 肉鸽（Roguelike) 成长机制： 每一局都是一场生死之战。收集资源，解锁永久升级，发现更强大的武器与道具，并不断深入愈发残酷的世界。 • 独特生态区域： 穿越三个致命世界：被恶魔与机械怪物吞噬的废墟小镇，被黑暗虚空侵蚀的诅咒城堡遗迹，以及巨型虫兽游荡于古代战舰残骸之间的冰封战场。 • 神器与技能： 掌握 3 个独特职业，每个职业都拥有不同的技能、优势与成长路线。解锁神器，获得永久加成，并在每一局中用全新的初始武器与能力打造属于你的战斗构筑。 • 像素模式与电影级画质： 在电影级 4K 画面与唤起经典独立游戏情怀的像素模式之间自由切换。像素模式不只是视觉上的变化。

names.en: DARK SOULS™ II: Scholar of the First Sin

games.short_description: DARK SOULS™ II: Scholar of the First Sin brings the franchise’s renowned obscurity & gripping gameplay to a new level. Join the dark journey and experience overwhelming enemy encounters, diabolical hazards, and unrelenting challenge.

descriptions.en: DARK SOULS™ II: Scholar of the First Sin brings the franchise’s renowned obscurity & gripping gameplay to a new level. Join the dark journey and experience overwhelming enemy encounters, diabolical hazards, and unrelenting challenge.

detailed_descriptions.en: Gamers are in for a big surprise in DARK SOULS™ II: Scholar of the First Sin. An unforgettable journey awaits you in a breathtaking world where each dark corner and unexpected encounter will test your resolve. Go beyond what you thought was possible and discover incredible challenge and intense emotional reward. Whether you’ve previously played DARK SOULS™ II, or are new to the award-winning franchise, you are in for an entirely different experience with this exclusive, “Director’s Cut” version of the game. - The definitive edition of DARK SOULS™ II. DARK SOULS™ II: Scholar of the First Sin includes all the DARK SOULS™ II content released to-date in one package and much more! - A brand new experience and challenge. Enemy placement has been overhauled, resulting in a completely different play dynamic than experienced before. The safe zones that some players remembered are no longer safe! A new NPC invader called Forlorn will also play a key role in changing the gameplay experience. Hardened players will have to forget everything they thought they knew about DARK SOULS™ II. - Online play has been enhanced with the addition of a special item to regulate souls acquired in battle - it’s now possible to match up more consistently online. The number of players who can participate in an online session has also been increased, from 4 to 6 people, completely changing the online play dynamic. DARK SOULS™ II: Scholar of the First Sin brings the franchise’s renowned obscurity & gripping gameplay to a new level. Join the dark journey and experience overwhelming enemy encounters, diabolical hazards, and unrelenting challenge.

Whether you’ve previously played DARK SOULS™ II, or are new to the award-winning franchise, you are in for an entirely different experience with this exclusive, “Director’s Cut” version of the game.

- The definitive edition of DARK SOULS™ II. DARK SOULS™ II: Scholar of the First Sin includes all the DARK SOULS™ II content released to-date in one package and much more!

The number of players who can participate in an online session has also been increased, from 4 to 6 people, completely changing the online play dynamic.

DARK SOULS™ II: Scholar of the First Sin brings the franchise’s renowned obscurity & gripping gameplay to a new level. Join the dark journey and experience overwhelming enemy encounters, diabolical hazards, and unrelenting challenge.

Stuart Chatwood previously composed music appearing on the soundtracks for eight Prince of Persia games developed by Ubisoft: Prince of Persia: The Sands of Time (2003), Warrior Within (2004), The Two Thrones (2005), Battles of Prince of Persia (2005), Revelations (2005), Rival Swords (2007), Prince of Persia (2008), and The Fallen King (2008). He also is well-known as the bass guitar and keyboard player for the Canadian rock band 'The Tea Party'. The Tea Party are known for fusing together musical styles of both the Eastern and Western worlds, in what they call "Moroccan roll".

names.ko: Darkest Dungeon® II: Infernal Supporter Pack

games.short_description: Show your love for Darkest Dungeon II by adopting this Infernal Supporter Pack! The pack is a collection of cosmetic items for players who want to help bolster the work we've done to add many free updates to the game. (Such as Kingdoms!)

descriptions.en: Show your love for Darkest Dungeon II by adopting this Infernal Supporter Pack! The pack is a collection of cosmetic items for players who want to help bolster the work we've done to add many free updates to the game. (Such as Kingdoms!)
descriptions.zh-Hant: 購買 Infernal Supporter Pack（地獄支持者禮包），展示你對《黑暗地牢2》的熱愛！此禮包內含多項裝飾性道具，專為希望支持我們持續推出免費更新（譬如王國模式）的玩家設計。
descriptions.ja: Darkest Dungeon IIへの愛を形に、業火のサポーターパックを手に入れましょう！このパックは、数々の無料アップデート（たとえば王国！）の実現を支えてくれたプレイヤーへの感謝を込めた、コスメティックアイテムの詰め合わせです。
descriptions.ko: Infernal Supporter Pack을 소장하여 Darkest Dungeon II에 대한 애정을 보여 주세요! 이 팩에는 플레이어 여러분이 사용할 수 있는 다양한 꾸미기 아이템이 포함되어 있으며, 지금까지처럼 앞으로도 무료 업데이트 (예: 왕국 모드!)를 계속 추가하는 데 도움이 됩니다.

detailed_descriptions.en: “Take up these goods, and imbue them with purpose.” Show your love for Darkest Dungeon II by adopting this Infernal Supporter Pack! The pack is a collection of cosmetic items for players who want to help bolster the work we've done to add many free updates to the game. (Such as Kingdoms!) The Infernal Supporter Pack contains: Infernal weapon kits with special inkfire visual effects. Arm your heroes with implements tainted by the spreading stain. Infernal hero palettes with additional inkfire visual effects. Heed the call of the void and outfit your heroes in gear fit for overcoming the most severe of challenges. 4 exclusive stagecoach skins themed around Catacombs and Kingdoms enemy factions. Cover your coach in dripping slime or quivering sacks of eggs! The above items are visible tokens of our heartfelt gratitude, but know that any support you choose to give means even more!
detailed_descriptions.zh-Hant: 「取用這些物品，賦予它們意義。」 購買 Infernal Supporter Pack（地獄支持者禮包），展示你對《黑暗地牢2》的熱愛！此禮包內含多項裝飾性道具，專為希望支持我們持續推出免費更新（譬如王國模式）的玩家設計。 Infernal Supporter Pack（地獄支持者禮包）內含： 帶有墨焰特效的地獄武器組合。為英雄裝備被邪穢玷汙的利器。 地獄英雄造型配色，搭配額外墨焰特效。響應虛空之召喚，為英雄身披盔甲，面對極限挑戰。 4款獨家馬車造型，靈感來自古墓與王國模式的敵人陣營。讓馬車覆滿黏液或顫抖的卵囊！ 我們希望藉由以上物品聊表寸心，但玩家所給予的支持遠非物質所能表達！
detailed_descriptions.ja: 「この品々を手に取り、目的を与えるのだ。」 Darkest Dungeon IIへの愛を形に、業火のサポーターパックを手に入れましょう！このパックは、数々の無料アップデート（たとえば王国！）の実現を支えてくれたプレイヤーへの感謝を込めた、コスメティックアイテムの詰め合わせです。 業火のサポーターパックには、以下が含まれます： 特殊なインクファイア視覚エフェクトをまとった業火の武器キット。拡散する汚れをまとった武器で英雄たちを武装させよう。 インクファイアの追加エフェクトが施された業火の英雄パレット。虚無の呼び声に応え、極限の試練に打ち勝つにふさわしい装いで英雄たちを整えよ。 地価墓地と王国の敵派閥をテーマにした、駅馬車用スキン4種が登場。滴る粘液で覆うもよし、うごめく卵嚢で装うのあり！ これらのアイテムは、心からの感謝を形にしたささやかな証にすぎません。それでも、皆から寄せられるどんな支援も、我々にとっては計り知れないほど大きな意味を持っているのです！
detailed_descriptions.ko: “이 물건들을 가져가 사명을 불어 넣어 주게.” Infernal Supporter Pack을 소장하여 Darkest Dungeon II에 대한 애정을 보여 주세요! 이 팩에는 플레이어 여러분이 사용할 수 있는 다양한 꾸미기 아이템이 포함되어 있으며, 지금까지처럼 앞으로도 무료 업데이트 (예: 왕국 모드!)를 계속 추가하는 데 도움이 됩니다. Infernal Supporter Pack 콘텐츠: 먹불 시각 효과가 추가되는 지옥불 무기 세트가 포함되어 있습니다. 퍼져나가는 오염에 더럽혀진 무기로 영웅들을 무장시키세요. 먹불 시각 효과가 추가되는 지옥불 팔레트가 포함되어 있습니다. 공허의 부름에 귀를 기울이고 가장 혹독한 도전을 이겨낼 수 있는 장비를 영웅들에게 입혀 보세요. 지하 묘지와 왕국에 등장하는 적 테마의 4가지 한정 역마차 스킨이 포함되어 있습니다. 마차를 흘러내리는 점액이나 꿈틀거리는 알 주머니로 뒤덮어 보세요! 위 콘텐츠는 저희의 진심 어린 감사 표시이며, 여러분이 선택해 주신 지원은 더 큰 의미가 있다는 것을 알아주세요!

games.name: Darkest Dungeon® II: Inhuman Bondage
games.short_description: Plunge your stagecoach into the long-forgotten Catacombs beneath the Kingdom and face a corrosive, oozing threat! Uncover powerful items in this new mini-region, and gain access to The Abomination, a fearsome new playable hero with unique battle mechanics.

descriptions.en: Plunge your stagecoach into the long-forgotten Catacombs beneath the Kingdom and face a corrosive, oozing threat! Uncover powerful items in this new mini-region, and gain access to The Abomination, a fearsome new playable hero with unique battle mechanics.
descriptions.zh-Hant: 駕駛馬車深入王國地下被遺忘已久的墓穴，迎戰腐蝕性的黏液威脅！在全新小地區中發現強力道具並解鎖變形怪人，這位可怕的新英雄角色具有獨特的戰鬥機制。
descriptions.ja: 王国の地下にある長年忘れ去られていた地下墓地へ駅馬車を進め、そこに待つ毒にまみれた脅威と戦おう！この新たな小地域では強力なアイテムが見つかる。さらに、ユニークな戦闘システムを持つ強力な新英雄「忌まわしき者」をアンロックする。
descriptions.ko: 오래 전 망각 속으로 사라졌던 왕국의 지하 묘지로 원정을 떠나, 산성 독액을 뿜어내는 적들에게 맞서세요! 이번에 새로 추가되는 소규모 지역에서 강력한 아이템을 발견하고 무시무시한 신규 영웅, 괴인의 독특한 전투 방식도 활용해 보세요.

detailed_descriptions.en: “Ancient sepulchers oozing with the gelatinous night-soil of a thousand corpses.” Plunge your stagecoach into the long-forgotten Catacombs beneath the Kingdom and face a corrosive, oozing threat! Features: New mini region - The Catacombs, a high risk, high reward region playable on both Confessions and Kingdoms game modes New slime-sodden enemy faction unique to the Catacombs New playable hero: The Abomination The Abomination comes complete with unique trinkets, signature items, and a fully voiced backstory including playable flashback encounters This DLC introduces a new Sluice-sized bonus region to Darkest Dungeon II, along with a fresh faction of enemies. Fight through these putrescent piles of slime to obtain unique combat items and trinkets to modify your heroes and gain the upper hand. Helping you to explore the Catacombs uncharted regions is The Abomination. Unleash the beast within! The Abomination makes his return to the Darkest Dungeon series. This reclusive alchemist comes with a unique battle mechanic, allowing him to transform into a fearsome monstrosity - at the risk of spiraling stress!
detailed_descriptions.zh-Hant: 「古老墓穴中滲出成千上萬具屍體所留下的黏稠腐液。」 駕駛馬車深入王國地下被遺忘已久的墓穴，迎戰腐蝕性的黏液威脅！在全新小地區中發現強力道具並解鎖變形怪人，這位可怕的新角色具有獨特的戰鬥機制。 特色： 全新小地區：地下墓穴。玩家可在「告解」和「王國」兩種模式下遊玩此高風險高回報的地區 地下墓穴獨有的黏液敵人陣營 全新英雄角色：變形怪人 變形怪人擁有獨特飾品、標誌性物品，並配有完整配音的背景故事，包括可遊玩的回憶片段 此資料片為《黑暗地牢2》新增了和暗渠一樣大的額外地區，以及一個全新敵人陣營。擊敗成群結隊的黏液敵人，獲得獨特戰鬥物品和飾品，強化英雄並佔得上風。全新英雄變形怪人將幫助你探索未知的地下墓穴。 釋放你內心的野獸吧！變形怪人重返《黑暗地牢》系列。這位深居簡出的鍊金術士具有獨特的戰鬥機制，能化身可怕的怪物，但同時心理壓力也會飆升！
detailed_descriptions.ja: 「何千もの死体のし尿にまみれた古代からの墓地だ。」 王国の地下にある長年忘れ去られていた地下墓地へ駅馬車を進め、そこに待つ毒にまみれた脅威と戦おう！ 内容： 新しい小地域 - 「地下墓地」ハイリスクハイリターンな地域で、懺悔モードと王国モードの両方で出現 地下墓地でしか出現しない、スライムまみれの新しい敵派閥 新たな英雄：忌まわしき者 -忌まわしき者には、ユニークな装身具、刻銘アイテム、フル音声付きバックストーリー（過去の戦いをプレイ可能）を完備 このDLCでは、水路のような大きさの新しいボーナス地域と新規の敵派閥がDarkest Dungeon IIに追加される。腐敗しきったスライムとの戦いを制し、ユニークな戦闘アイテムや装身具を手に入れて、英雄を強化し、優位に立とう。地下墓地のまだ見ぬ地域の探検を手助けするのは「忌まわしき者」という英雄だ。 内なる獣を解き放て！忌まわしき者がDarkest Dungeonシリーズに復活だ。この人の目を避ける錬金術師は、ユニークな戦闘システムを持っている。なんと、ストレスの急上昇と引き換えに、恐ろしい怪物へと変身できるのだ！
detailed_descriptions.ko: “옛 무덤은 일천 구의 시신이 묻힌 끈적하고 시커먼 흙으로 뒤덮여 있으니.” 오래 전 망각 속으로 사라졌던 왕국의 지하 묘지로 원정을 떠나, 산성 독액을 뿜어내는 적들에게 맞서세요! 특징: 신규 소규모 지역 - 이번에 추가되는 지하 묘지는 위험도가 높지만 보상도 상당한 지역으로, 고해와 왕국 게임 모드 모두에서 플레이 가능합니다. 지하 묘지에서는 점액으로 뒤덮인 새로운 적들이 등장합니다. 신규 플레이 가능 영웅: 괴인 괴인은 고유 장신구, 상징 아이템, 그리고 직접 플레이 가능한 회상 조우가 포함된 완전 더빙 배경 스토리를 갖추고 있습니다. 이번 DLC는 Darkest Dungeon II에 시궁창과 같은 소규모 보너스 지역과 함께 새로운 적 세력을 추가합니다. 이 끈적끈적한 점액 더미를 헤쳐나가 독특한 전투 아이템과 장신구를 획득하여 영웅들을 강화하고 적들에게 우위를 점하세요. 또한 지하 묘지라는 미지의 영역을 탐험하는 데 도움을 주고자, 괴인이 새로 참전합니다. 내면의 야수를 풀어 놓으세요! 괴인이 Darkest Dungeon 시리즈에 다시 돌아왔습니다. 이 은둔형 연금술사는 고유한 전투 방식을 통해 무시무시한 괴물로 변신할 수 있지만, 자칫 스트레스가 극에 달할 위험이 있으니 주의하세요!

games.short_description: A fearless fencer, a lost knight. One waits at the crossroads for redemption, the other, adrift in the sprawling wilds of the Kingdom. Master the ruthless Duelist, battle through barricades, and seek clues that will lead you to...the last of the Crusaders.

descriptions.en: A fearless fencer, a lost knight. One waits at the crossroads for redemption, the other, adrift in the sprawling wilds of the Kingdom. Master the ruthless Duelist, battle through barricades, and seek clues that will lead you to...the last of the Crusaders.
descriptions.zh-Hant: 一位无所畏惧的剑客，一名迷途失落的骑士。 其中一位在十字路口之中等候救赎，另一位则在王国的无垠荒野之上徘徊。驾驭那精准无情的决斗家吧，冲破桎梏、寻踪追迹，直至你最终寻得那位……最后的十字军。
descriptions.ja: 恐れ知らずのレイピア使い、そして迷える騎士。 ある者は贖罪のために十字路にたたずみ、またある者は王国に果てしなく広がる荒野を放浪する。この冷酷なる決闘士を使いこなし、バリケードを突破して戦いに挑み、最後のクルセイダーにつながる手がかりを探し求めよ。
descriptions.ko: 두려움 없는 승부사와 길 잃은 기사. 하나는 교차로에서 구원을 기다리고, 다른 하나는 왕국에 펼쳐진 혼란 속을 떠돌고 있습니다. 무자비한 결투가의 숙련된 솜씨로 방책을 뚫고 전투를 벌이면서... 최후의 성전사로 이어지는 실마리를 따라가 보세요.

detailed_descriptions.en: Features: Two New Playable heroes: The Duelist & The Crusader Both new heroes are complete with unique trinkets, signature items, and fully voiced backstories including playable flashback encounters New Roaming mini-boss: The Warlord The Duelist is a disciplined and deadly combatant who can tactically switch between Defensive and Aggressive stances. A formidable presence in any lineup, she is able to ignore enemy defenses, and strike back with Riposte. Her pursuit of perfection means she will demand the best of her team and command them to victory by wiping out cooldown times and providing both offensive and defensive buffs. The Duelist is able to move between ranks with ease, attacking from both the front and back ranks, dispatching her enemies with ruthless efficiency. The Crusader has returned! This battle hardened knight is fueled by a radiant Holy fire and will Smite his foes where they stand. The Crusader is a well rounded front rank hero who can withstand punishing blows, support his team with healing and stress recovery, and rend his opponents with his righteous blade.
detailed_descriptions.zh-Hant: 特色： 两位全新可玩英雄：决斗家与十字军 两位新英雄都配有其独特饰品与招牌物品，并且都具有完整配音的背景故事，其中也包括了可游玩的往昔遭遇。 新的游荡头目 督军 决斗家严于律己、精准致命，善于根据战况在攻守架势之间灵活转换。她在任何阵容中都坚实可靠，既能忽视防御直击要害，又能用反击来以牙还牙。对完美的追求让她要求自己的队友们必须全力以赴；她能够通过减少技能冷却、提供攻防增益来引领团队夺取胜利。决斗家能在战斗中灵活移动，无论身处前排还是后排，都能以迅雷不及掩耳之势击溃敌人。 十字军重返战场！这位身经百战的骑士心怀光耀圣火，用他的惩击来将敌人就地正法。十字军是一位能力全面的前排英雄，不仅能够承受最沉重的攻击，还能为队友提供治疗与减压，并将敌人斩于他的正义之剑下。
detailed_descriptions.ja: 内容： 新しい二人の英雄：決闘士＆クルセイダー どちらの新英雄にも、ユニークな装身具、刻銘アイテム、フル音声付きバックストーリー（過去の戦いをプレイ可能）を完備 新しい徘徊型のミニボス「ウォーロード」 戦術に合わせて守勢と攻勢を切り替えできる決闘士は、冷静沈着かつ命知らずのファイター。あらゆる布陣にて活躍する存在で、敵の防御を無視し、「応酬」攻撃を行える。完璧主義の彼女は、仲間にも全力の戦いを求め、クールダウン時間を解消し、攻守両方のバフを与えることでチームを勝利に導く。また、隊列間を容易に移動でき、前衛後衛のどちらからでも攻撃を行い、容赦なき効率性をもって敵を始末してみせる。 クルセイダーが帰ってきた！この百戦錬磨の騎士は光り輝く聖炎を原動力とし、待ち受ける敵どもに「強打」攻撃を放つ。クルセイダーは体力やストレスを回復させて仲間を助け、正義の刃で敵を引き裂き、痛烈な一撃に耐えることができる、万能な前衛ランクの英雄。
detailed_descriptions.ko: 특징 신규 플레이 가능 영웅 2명: 결투가와 성전사 두 신규 영웅 모두 고유 장신구, 상징 아이템, 그리고 직접 플레이 가능한 회상 조우가 포함된 완전 더빙 배경 스토리를 갖추고 있습니다. 신규 배회 미니 보스 전쟁군주 결투가는 방어와 공격 태세를 전술적으로 전환할 수 있는 절도 있고 치명적인 전투원입니다. 덕분에 어떤 위치에서든 강력한 존재감을 발휘하며 적의 방어를 무시하고 반격을 가할 수 있습니다. 또한 항상 완벽을 추구하기에 동료들에게도 최선의 실력을 요구하면서 재사용 대기 시간을 없애고 공격 및 방어 버프를 제공하여 승리를 이끌어냅니다. 이처럼 결투가는 전열과 후열을 쉽게 오가며 공격할 수 있으며 무자비할 정도로 효율적으로 적을 처치할 수 있습니다. 성전사가 돌아왔습니다! 전투로 단련된 이 기사는 눈부시고 성스러운 불길로부터 힘을 얻으며 적들이 서 있는 곳이면 어디든 달려가 공격합니다. 성전사는 강력한 공격을 견뎌내고, 치유와 스트레스 회복으로 아군을 지원하며, 정의의 검으로 적을 제압할 수 있는 다재다능한 최전방 영웅입니다.

darkest dungeon® ii: the binding blade darkest dungeon® ii: the binding blade darkest dungeon® ii: the binding blade darkest dungeon® ii: the binding blade darkest dungeon® ii: the binding blade a fearless fencer, a lost knight. one waits at the crossroads for redemption, the other, adrift in the sprawling wilds of the kingdom. master the ruthless duelist, battle through barricades, and seek clues that will lead you to...the last of the crusaders. 一位无所畏惧的剑客，一名迷途失落的骑士。 其中一位在十字路口之中等候救赎，另一位则在王国的无垠荒野之上徘徊。驾驭那精准无情的决斗家吧，冲破桎梏、寻踪追迹，直至你最终寻得那位……最后的十字军。 恐れ知らずのレイピア使い、そして迷える騎士。 ある者は贖罪のために十字路にたたずみ、またある者は王国に果てしなく広がる荒野を放浪する。この冷酷なる決闘士を使いこなし、バリケードを突破して戦いに挑み、最後のクルセイダーにつながる手がかりを探し求めよ。 두려움 없는 승부사와 길 잃은 기사. 하나는 교차로에서 구원을 기다리고, 다른 하나는 왕국에 펼쳐진 혼란 속을 떠돌고 있습니다. 무자비한 결투가의 숙련된 솜씨로 방책을 뚫고 전투를 벌이면서... 최후의 성전사로 이어지는 실마리를 따라가 보세요. indie rpg strategy single-player downloadable content steam achievements steam trading cards steam workshop partial controller support steam cloud family sharing english french italian german czech polish portuguese-brazil russian spanish-latin japanese korean schinese ukrainian very positive mostly positive

games.short_description: The Color of Madness DLC opens the Farmstead region which has become the site of a fallen comet! What madness awaits those who venture forward to find the out fate of The Miller and his farmhands? Battle your way towards the crash site and venture between time and space to find what lies at the epicenter of this new creeping crystalline...

descriptions.en: The Color of Madness DLC opens the Farmstead region which has become the site of a fallen comet! What madness awaits those who venture forward to find the out fate of The Miller and his farmhands? Battle your way towards the crash site and venture between time and space to find what lies at the epicenter of this new creeping crystalline...
descriptions.zh-Hant: Color of Madness 扩展包解锁了“农庄”区域，这是一处彗星坠毁地点！有什么疯狂的事情在等着前往农庄探究磨坊主及其工人命运的勇士？一路闯向坠毁地点，在时空中求索，查明这场可怕水晶畸变的中心潜伏着什么东西。
descriptions.ko: The Color of Madness DLC에서는 혜성이 떨어진 농장 지역이 개방됩니다! 농장주와 일꾼들의 운명을 확인하려는 자들을 기다리고 있는 광기는 무엇일까요? 새롭게 등장한 수정 이탈자들의 뒤에 숨어있는 진실을 확인하기 위해선 전투를 통해 혜성 추락 지점까지 길을 열고 시간과 공간 사이로 모험을 떠나십시오!

detailed_descriptions.en: Some hateful shard of alien origin has streaked through the night sky, crashing into the old Miller’s farm on the outskirts of the Hamlet! Those unfortunate enough to witness the Comet’s arrival have been blinded by what they can only describe as a shifting, ephemeral hue of damnably abrasive intensity. There has been no word from the farm in a fortnight, save for the unearthly groaning that echoes from the ruin of the mill… “When men shake hands with time, time crushes them like tumblers; little pieces of glass.” ― Abu al-Ala al-Ma'arri Features: New region: The Farmstead! Endless Quest: Survive as long as you can while getting lost in time and space, confronted by unending waves of enemies new and old, pushing ever closer to the crash site of the Comet. Twisted new trinkets, available for purchase from the Jeweler. Put your gold away—he trades only in Comet Shards! All-New Enemy Faction: The Miller and his loyal workmen have become eerie husks of their former selves. 3 new bosses - The Miller, The Thing From the Stars, and the Comet itself! New Curios help keep your party in fighting shape as you face the endless hordes! Expand your Hamlet with 4 new District buildings and reap their benefits. New Quirks, with unique and powerful effects! Our biggest soundtrack addition yet from Stuart Chatwood
detailed_descriptions.zh-Hant: 可恶的外星碎片划破夜空，撞上了小镇郊区磨坊主的农场！那些不幸目睹彗星坠毁的人们，已经被一种变幻不定的强腐蚀色调所蒙蔽。两个星期以来，农场没有传出任何消息，只有磨坊废墟低沉的呻吟声在夜空中回荡…… “当人们试图拥抱时间时，时间会像滚筒一样将他们压碎，碎成一块块玻璃渣子。” ——阿布·阿拉·麦阿里 特点： 新区域：农庄 无尽任务：在时空迷失之后尽可能地存活下去，一边应对不断来袭的新老敌人，一边逐渐靠近彗星坠毁地点。 反常的新饰品，可从珠宝商那购买。把你的金子收起来，他只要彗星碎片！ 全新的敌人派系：磨坊主和他忠诚的工人已经变成了行尸走肉。 3 个新 Boss：磨坊主、星空怪，以及彗星本身！ 新的奇物帮助你的团队对抗无尽的敌人！ 用 4 个新的区域建筑扩建你的小镇，并收取它们的收益。 具有独特、强大效果的新特质！ 最大规模的配音新增
detailed_descriptions.ko: 증오로 가득 찬 외계의 근원 파편 일부가 밤하늘을 가르고 영지 외곽에 있는 농장주의 오래된 농장을 덮쳤습니다! 혜성의 추락을 목격한 불행한 이들은 서술할 수 없는 그 끔찍하고 변화무쌍한 색채에 눈이 멀었습니다. 2주가 지나도록 폐허가 된 농장에선 들리는 것은 섬뜩한 신음소리 뿐이었습니다... “인간이 시간에 악수를 청할 때, 시간은 인간을 깨진 유리컵처럼 깨뜨린다.” ― 아부 알-알라 알-마'아리 특징 새로운 지역: 농장! 무한 퀘스트: 시간과 공간 사이에서 길을 잃은 채, 끝나지 않는 적의 무리를 상대하고 혜성의 추락 지점으로 전진하며 최대한 오래 살아남으십시오. 보석상에게서 구매할 수 있는 뒤틀린 새 장신구. 골드는 치우십시오. 오직 혜성 파편만 취급합니다! 완전히 새로운 적 세력: 농장주와 그의 충실한 일꾼들은 과거 자신의 껍질을 뒤집어쓴 섬뜩한 존재가 되었습니다. 3마리의 새로운 보스 - 농장주, 별에서 떨어진 괴물과 혜성 그 자체! 끝없이 쏟아지는 적들을 상대로 싸우는 데 도움을 주는 새로운 골동품! 새로운 4개의 구역 건물로 영지를 확장하고 이익을 거두십시오. 고유의 강력한 효과를 지닌 새로운 기벽! 스튜어트 채트우드의 대규모 사운드트랙 에디션

games.name: Darkest Dungeon®: The Crimson Court
games.short_description: The Crimson Court enhances any Darkest Dungeon campaign with the addition of a new storyline and dungeon, new hero class, new monsters, new bosses, the Fanatic wandering miniboss, set trinkets for every hero, and new buildings to upgrade your Hamlet!

descriptions.en: The Crimson Court enhances any Darkest Dungeon campaign with the addition of a new storyline and dungeon, new hero class, new monsters, new bosses, the Fanatic wandering miniboss, set trinkets for every hero, and new buildings to upgrade your Hamlet!
descriptions.zh-Hant: Darkest Dungeon®: The Crimson Court 是 Red Hook Studios 屡获殊荣的阴森哥特式 RPG 游戏的第一个扩展包。Crimson Court 是在 Darkest Dungeon 内容基础上的一个平行战役，为玩家提供全新挑战以及多个难度级别。Crimson Court 是在 Darkest Dungeon 内容基础上的一个平行战役，为玩家提供全新挑战以及多个难度级别。故事背景会以同样的过场动画形式呈现给大家，带大家走进先祖的早期生活。
descriptions.ja: 『Darkest Dungeon®: The Crimson Court』は、Red Hook Studiosが手掛け、さまざまな賞を受賞したローグライクダークファンタジーRPG『Darkest Dungeon』の第1弾目となる拡張パックです。新ヒーローだけでなく、強力なトリンケット、街のイベント、村の拡張／アップグレードも実装！
descriptions.ko: Darkest Dungeon®: The Crimson Court 레드훅에서 제작한 어두운 분위기의 유명 RPG 수상작 다키스트 던전의 첫 번째 확장팩입니다. 크림슨 코트는 다키스트 던전의 메인 콘텐츠와 병행하는 캠페인으로 모든 난이도에서 새로운 도전과 변화를 체험할 수 있습니다. 이야기의 배경을 통해 선조의 젊은 시절을 일부 조명하며 이는 게임 내에서 경험한 컷신 방식으로 제공될 것입니다.

detailed_descriptions.en: "THE BLOOD...I MUST HAVE THE BLOOD!" Darkest Dungeon®: The Crimson Court is the first expansion for the award-winning grim and gothic RPG by Red Hook Studios. Crimson Court is a parallel campaign experienced alongside the main Darkest Dungeon content that will provide you with new challenges and variation at every difficulty level. The narrative grounding sheds some light on the Ancestor’s early days, and will be presented in the same style of cut-scenes you’ve seen elsewhere in the game. The DLC is designed to be played alongside an existing campaign, or as a brand new one--your choice! The events and features will unlock over the course of play. Features: A new hero class. “Awash in blood and delusion, they bear the burden of a thousand lifetimes.” A new dungeon region: The Courtyard A full faction of new deadly foes 5 new Bosses with some of the most complex and devious mechanics yet. A new wandering boss: The Fanatic Districts: 10 new buildings to upgrade your Hamlet Massive, sprawling maps with locked doors, prisoner rooms, and progress saves Lore-driven trinket sets for all heroes - with set bonuses! As the Crimson Curse spreads unrelentingly over the estate, parties will battle new enemies in familiar regions, as well as setting foot in a completely new sprawling environment: the Courtyard. There, amidst unique curios, traps and obstacles, a complete faction of new blood-crazed foes lie in wait, overseen by three distinct boss encounters. These slavering enemies and epic encounters will introduce new combat mechanics, testing the limits of your favorite strategies. As the infestation grows and your roster begins to sicken, the Fanatic will emerge to roam the hallways, confusing friend and foe alike in his zealous quest to exterminate the Curse. The odds are not completely stacked against you, however! A new playable hero class will be added alongside powerful new trinkets, town events, and a fresh way to expand and upgrade your Hamlet.
detailed_descriptions.zh-Hant: “血！我必须要喝血！” Darkest Dungeon®: The Crimson Court 是 Red Hook Studios 屡获殊荣的阴森哥特式 RPG 游戏的第一个扩展包。Crimson Court 是在 Darkest Dungeon 内容基础上的一个平行战役，为玩家提供全新挑战以及多个难度级别。Crimson Court 是在 Darkest Dungeon 内容基础上的一个平行战役，为玩家提供全新挑战以及多个难度级别。故事背景会以同样的过场动画形式呈现给大家，带大家走进先祖的早期生活。 特点： 全新英雄职业：苦修者 全新地牢区域：庭院 全新的敌人派系 5 个新 Boss，采用最复杂、最迂回的机制设计而成 全新游荡 Boss：狂信者 区域：10 种新建筑用以升级你的城镇 庞大而不规则的地图，标有锁着的门、囚犯室和进度保存点 所有英雄新增饰品套装，并带套装属性 随着猩红诅咒在领地里无情地蔓延，各方将在熟悉的区域与新的敌人展开战斗，并踏足一个全新的不规则环境：庭院。独特的奇物、陷阱和障碍之中，埋伏着一个全新派系的嗜血怪物，由 3 个不同类型的 Boss 统领。这些奴隶般的敌人和史诗般的 Boss 遭遇战将引入新的战斗机制，挑战玩家战略的极限。 随着怪物侵扰的加剧加上你的英雄开始生病，狂信者将会出现在通道上，狂热地试图消除诅咒，让朋友和敌人不禁同样感到困惑。 然而你并不是完全没有胜算！一个新的英雄职业将加入你的阵营，随之而来的还有新的饰品、城镇事件以及一种扩张、升级小镇的新途径。
detailed_descriptions.ja: 「血だ！血が欲しい！」 『Darkest Dungeon®: The Crimson Court』は、Red Hook Studiosが手掛け、さまざまな賞を受賞したローグライクダークファンタジーRPG『Darkest Dungeon』の第1弾目となる拡張パックです。『The Crimson Court』では、本体に収録されているコンテンツと平行で繰り広げられるストーリーが展開され、いずれの難易度でも新たな挑戦やコンテンツを楽しむことができます。アンセスターの若かりし頃にも光を当てており、本編と同様のスタイルのカットシーンも描写されます。 本DLCは、本編の物語と平行して進めることを前提に作られていますが、どの順番でプレイするかは君次第です！新たなイベントや機能は、ゲームを進めるにつれてアンロックされていきます。 特徴： 新ヒーロー 「血と妄想に染まり、やつらは千回生まれ変わっても重荷を背負い続ける。」 新ダンジョンエリア ：呪われた庭園 新種類の 強靭な敵 かつて無いほどに厄介な新ボス5体 エリア内を彷徨うボス： ファナティック 区画： 村をアップグレードするための施設10種類 複数回に分けて攻略する、鍵のかかったドア・牢獄などをフィーチャーした 非常に広大なマップ 全ヒーロー向けに、古くからの言い伝えを持つトリンケットを追加。 さらにセット効果も実装！ 代々受け継がれし領地に止めどなく拡がる「赤の呪い」。ヒーローたちはその地で新たな敵と戦闘を繰り広げ、さらには広大な新マップ「呪われた庭園」へと足を踏み入れる。そこにあるのはお宝だけではない――トラップや困難、さらには遠くからこちらを見つめる、血に飢えた新種のボス3体が我々を待ち受けているのだ。奴らはこれまでにない戦い方を見せつけてくる。君もまた、これまでにない戦い方で挑まざるを得ないだろう。 侵食が続き仲間たちの元気が失われると、ついにはファナティックが廊下を徘徊し始め、赤の呪いを解除するという堅固な意思を以て味方や敵すべてを混乱に陥れるだろう。 だが、まだ勝算はある！――我々はヒーローだけでなく、強力なトリンケット、街のイベント、そして村を拡張／アップグレードする方法をも新たに得たのだから。
detailed_descriptions.ko: "피를... 내겐 피가 필요하다!" Darkest Dungeon®: The Crimson Court 레드훅에서 제작한 어두운 분위기의 유명 RPG 수상작 다키스트 던전의 첫 번째 확장팩입니다. 크림슨 코트는 다키스트 던전의 메인 콘텐츠와 병행하는 캠페인으로 모든 난이도에서 새로운 도전과 변화를 체험할 수 있습니다. 이야기의 배경을 통해 선조의 젊은 시절을 일부 조명하며 이는 게임 내에서 경험한 컷신 방식으로 제공될 것입니다. 특징 새로운 영웅 클래스: 고행자! 새로운 던전 지역: 코트야드 새롭고 치명적인 적 세력 더욱 복잡해지고 교활해진 5마리의 신규 보스. 방황하는 신규 보스: 광신도 구역: 마을을 업그레이드할 수 있는 10개의 신규 건물 잠긴 문과 감옥을 포함하고 진행 상황이 저장되는 방대하게 뻗어 나간 던전 모든 영웅을 위한 전승 세트 장신구와 세트 보너스! 전례 없는 핏빛 저주가 무자비하게 영지를 뒤덮었기 때문에 파티는 익숙한 지형에서 새로운 적과 만나 싸우고 새롭게 탄생한 코트야드라는 환경에 발을 내딛게 될 것입니다. 코트야드에서는 고유한 골동품, 함정, 장애물, 피에 미친 새로운 적들과 세 구역을 감독하는 보스 인카운터가 기다리고 있습니다. 군침 흘리는 적들과 서사적 인카운터는 새로운 전투 시스템으로 당신이 가장 좋아하던 전략을 한계까지 시험할 것입니다. 감염률이 증가하고 영웅들이 병에 걸리기 시작하면 적과 아군을 혼동하는 광신도는 열정적으로 저주를 박멸하기 위해 복도를 방황합니다. 그러나 당신에게만 상황이 불리한 것은 아닙니다! 강력한 신규 장신구, 마음 이벤트 영지를 업그레이드할 수 있는 신선한 방법과 함께 새로운 영웅 클래스가 추가됩니다.

games.name: Darkest Dungeon®: The Shieldbreaker
games.short_description: The Shieldbreaker DLC brings an all new recruitable hero into Darkest Dungeon. She is a powerful tactical combatant, able to pierce armor, break guards, and poison foes. The DLC also includes several new monsters and a new consumable item type: the Aegis Scale!

descriptions.en: The Shieldbreaker DLC brings an all new recruitable hero into Darkest Dungeon. She is a powerful tactical combatant, able to pierce armor, break guards, and poison foes. The DLC also includes several new monsters and a new consumable item type: the Aegis Scale!
descriptions.zh-Hant: 在Shieldbreaker DLC中，极暗地牢添加了一位全新的可雇佣英雄。她是一名强大的策略战士，能够穿透护甲、削弱守卫以及毒杀敌人。此DLC还包含一些新的怪物和新的消耗品：御盾鳞片！
descriptions.ja: 本DLC「盾を破りし者」では、『Darkest Dungeon』で新しいヒーローを雇用できるようになります。アーマーを貫通させたり、ガードを打ち破ったり、敵を毒状態にしたりなど、彼女は戦術性が高く非常にパワフル。さらに、モンスター数体と消費アイテム「庇護の鱗」も実装されています！
descriptions.ko: 쉴드브레이커 DLC는 다키스트 던전에 새로운 영웅을 추가합니다. 쉴드브레이커는 강력한 전술을 사용하는 여전사로 갑옷을 뚫고 가드를 무너뜨리며 적을 중독시킵니다. DLC에는 신규 괴물과 소모 아이템, 이지스 비늘도 포함되어 있습니다!

detailed_descriptions.en: “And all around is the desert; a corner of the mournful kingdom of sand.” -Pierre Loti Hailing from the distant windswept dunes of the east, the Shieldbreaker arrives in the Hamlet! Deadly as a viper, her iron will has been forged in the heat of the blazing desert sun. Though outwardly demure, her emancipation from the barren wastes came at a price so terrible, it haunts her dreams even now... Features: New hero class: the Shieldbreaker Dynamic, tactical skill set for the Shieldbreaker featuring all new combat mechanics including: Armor Piercing, Guard Break, and Stealth Shieldbreaker class-specific trinkets, including a set. 3 New Monsters - frightful illusions from the Shieldbreaker's origin, now slithering forward to infest the Estate New Consumable Item - Aegis Scale, providing a last bastion of protection for when a hero truly needs it. The Shieldbreaker is a powerful ally in the fight to reclaim the Estate and banish the evil that squats in the Darkest Dungeon. A highly-tactical hero with solid damage dealing capability, she truly excels when countering monsters with high protection and those who guard their allies. Her movement, speed, and targeted abilities make her a valuable ally for dismantling intractable monster groups. Though relatively low health, the Shieldbreaker is yet highly survivable in short bursts thanks to her Aegis shield.
detailed_descriptions.zh-Hant: “四周都是沙漠，是悲哀的沙地王国的一隅。” -皮埃尔·洛蒂 破盾者从遥远的东部风之沙丘落下，来到了哈姆雷特镇！她的剑在强烈的沙漠日光下锻造而成，而且如毒蛇般致命。她尽管拥有端庄的外表，但她从贫瘠荒地中的解放使她付出了可怕的代价，并至今仍在她的睡梦中出现折磨着她…… 特点： 新英雄职业：破盾者 为破盾者设置的动态战略性技能带来了新的战斗技巧，包括：护甲穿刺、防御突破和潜行 破盾者的角色专用饰品，包括一套绝杀套装 3个新怪物——源自破盾者本体的可怕幻影，蜿蜒滑行在领地出没 新的消耗品——御盾鳞片，在英雄需要时提供最后的防护堡垒。 破盾者在夺回领地，及驱逐盘踞在极暗地牢的恶魔之战斗中，是一位强大的盟友。她是一名高战略性英雄，拥有稳定的输出伤害，尤其精通于打击高防护性以及保护盟友的怪物。破盾者的移动、速度和定向技能使她成为了分解棘手怪物团体的珍贵盟友。尽管生命值相对较低，她在御盾鳞片的保护下具有高生存力，能够进行短期爆发攻击。
detailed_descriptions.ja: 「そして辺りを見渡すと、砂漠――悲しげな砂の王国の一角だった。」 ピエール・ロティ 風がヒューと吹き荒れる、遠く東の彼方にある砂丘より生まれし「盾を破りし者」が、ついに村へと足を踏み入れたのだ！鉄のような彼女の意思をそうたらしめたのは、灼熱のように暑い砂漠の太陽だった。外見は寡黙そうに見えるが、その荒廃した地から自身を解放するためにはとてつもない代償を必要としたのだ。そして今でもなお、それは彼女の夢を蝕んでいる……。 特徴： 新ヒーロー：盾を破りし者 「防衛貫通」や「ガード無効」、「潜伏」など新たな戦闘スタイルを取り入れ、ダイナミックかつ戦術性のあるスキルを実現 盾を破りし者専用のトリンケット（セット効果あり） 新モンスター3体：盾を破りし者を苦しめる最凶の幻影たち。徐々に領地を侵食し始めている 消費アイテム：庇護の鱗――ヒーローが真にそれを必要とした時に出現する最後の砦 領地を奪還し、ダーケストダンジョンに身を潜める悪魔を排除するのに強力な助けとなる「盾を破りし者」。戦術性の高いヒーローとなっており、強力で正確な攻撃を繰り出す力を持つ。そして彼女が真に優れているのは、高い防御力を備えるモンスターや、仲間を守るモンスターへのカウンター攻撃だ。その動き、そのスピード、その正確さによって、非常に厄介なモンスターの隊列を乱すのに重宝する存在で、たとえ体力が低くなっても、庇護の盾のおかげで少しの間生きながらえることが可能となっている。
detailed_descriptions.ko: “슬픔에 빠진 모래 왕국의 한구석이 전부 사막이로다.” - 피에르 로티 모래에 뒤덮인 극동 출신 쉴드브레이커가 영지에 도착했습니다! 독사처럼 치명적인 그녀의 강철 의지는 타오르는 사막의 태양으로 단련되었습니다. 겉으론 평온하지만, 척박한 황무지에서 탈출하기 위해 치른 대가는 끔찍했고 아직도 꿈속에서 그녀를 괴롭힙니다... 특징 * 새로운 영웅 클래스: 쉴드브레이커 * 쉴드브레이커의 역동적이고 전술적인 스킬셋은 새로운 전투 메커니즘을 포함합니다: 갑옷 관통, 방어 파괴, 은신 * 전승 세트를 포함한 쉴드브레이커 전용 장신구 * 3마리의 신규 괴물 - 쉴드브레이커의 고향에서 온 공포의 환영이 이제 영지를 침범하려 합니다 * 신규 소모 아이템 - 이지스 비늘, 방어가 절실하게 필요한 영웅에게 최후의 보루를 제공합니다. 쉴드브레이커는 영지를 되찾고 다키스트 던전에 자리 잡은 악을 추방하기 위해 싸우는 강력한 동료입니다. 뛰어난 전략성으로 꾸준한 피해를 주는 쉴드브레이커는 높은 방어력으로 동료를 보호하는 괴물의 천적입니다. 움직임, 속도, 특화된 능력으로 그녀는 상대하기 어려운 괴물 무리를 무찌르는 데 큰 도움이 될 수 있었습니다. 비교적 체력이 낮은 쉴드브레이커는 이지스 비늘 덕분에 짧은 지속시간 동안 높은 생존능력을 확보할 수 있습니다.

games.name: Darksiders Genesis
games.short_description: DARKSIDERS: GENESIS gives players their first look at the world of DARKSIDERS before the events of the original game. Furthermore, it introduces the fourth and last horseman STRIFE, as well as Co-op gameplay for the first time in the history of the franchise.

descriptions.en: DARKSIDERS: GENESIS gives players their first look at the world of DARKSIDERS before the events of the original game. Furthermore, it introduces the fourth and last horseman STRIFE, as well as Co-op gameplay for the first time in the history of the franchise.

detailed_descriptions.en: From the dawn of creation, THE COUNCIL has maintained the Balance across existence. Carrying out their orders are THE HORSEMEN, Nephilim (powerful beings spawned from the unnatural union of angels and demons) who have pledged themselves to the Council and been granted immense power. However, this power came at a tragic cost: the Horsemen were ordered to use their newfound strength to wipe out the rest of their kind. What followed was a bloody battle on Eden where the Horsemen, obeying the will of the Council, annihilated the Nephilim. Still reeling from the events on Eden, WAR and STRIFE have been given a new assignment -- LUCIFER, the enigmatic and deceptive demon king, has been plotting to upset the Balance by granting power to master demons throughout Hell. Sit in awe of Darksiders signature art style – expansive post-apocalyptic environments that take the player from the heights of heaven to the depths of hell, dilapidated by war and decay and overrun by nature.

games.name: Darkwater
games.short_description: Darkwater is a cooperative extraction horror game for 1-4 players. Command a submarine trapped under the ice of an alien planet. Battle enemy vessels and deep sea abominations as you hunt for resources. Do what it takes to survive.

descriptions.en: Darkwater is a cooperative extraction horror game for 1-4 players. Command a submarine trapped under the ice of an alien planet. Battle enemy vessels and deep sea abominations as you hunt for resources. Do what it takes to survive.

detailed_descriptions.en: Darkwater is a cooperative extraction horror game for 1-4 players. Take command of your own custom submarine and survive the icy depths of an alien moon. Play solo or enlist your own submariner crew. Up to 4 players can team up and survive an onslaught of deep-sea threats. Face down enemy submarines in naval warfare and dock your vessel to abandoned outposts in order to scavenge for supplies. A devastating disease has struck an alien planet. The government has frozen the surface of the ocean in response. You and your crew are trapped below the ice. Source fuel and travel from outpost to outpost in a desperate bid for survival Uncover snippets of information relating to a greater truth Plan and strategize every step of the way as you fight against the relentless adversity of a desperate world Resources are scarce. Discover and explore dilapidated underwater facilities on foot and strip them for all they’re worth. Be prepared to deal with what lurks below. Face down a variety of unpredictable enemies including infected divers, deep-sea angler fish and alien crabs. Even the odds using a wide range of weaponry including sledgehammers, blow torches, pistols and shotguns. Make sure you and your team have enough room to carry back the fuel canisters critical to your survival - teamwork is key to ensuring you live to see another day. Take direct control of onboard systems for piloting, weapons and sonar. Upgrade your submarine. Expand your deck, invest in different cabins, negotiate with rival vessels, but be ready for war. Utilize a variety of powerful torpedoes, harpoons, decoy mines and depth charges to gain the upper hand in sub-to-sub combat Board enemy vessels using a manned torpedo to deliver the ultimate in-person surprise Invest in unique rooms for your submarine that help with hacking, stealth and other strategic options

descriptions.zh-Hant: 和达尔文一起踏上冒险。他是一只可爱与机智兼备的章鱼，被带离了海洋且困在一个神秘的巨大工业中心里。在这款引人入胜的平台冒险游戏里，运用他独特的天赋与能力，帮他克服重重危机和陷阱。
descriptions.ja: 海から引き離され、謎の工業地帯に閉じ込められたダーウィンの冒険が始まる。高い知能を持つダーウィンと共に難解なパズルを解き、泳ぎやカモフラージュといったタコの性質を活かし、様々な罠や脅威をくぐり抜けるアクションアドベンチャーゲーム！

detailed_descriptions.en: Embark on a grand adventure worthy of a true animated movie with Darwin, an octopus as charming as he is clever, ripped from the ocean and trapped in a massive and mysterious industrial complex. With his extraordinary intelligence and incredible abilities – swimming, camouflage, and many other fascinating skills – help him overcome the most formidable traps and dangers in this captivating platformer, adventure, and puzzle game. In the peaceful vastness of the ocean, Darwin, a young octopus, explores the deep sea… until a strange beam of light pierces the abyss and pulls him toward the surface. Thrust out of his aquatic world, he wakes up disoriented in the middle of a gigantic junkyard, backed by a foreboding factory. But something is wrong. Between the threatening machines, strange holding tanks, and the mysterious and dangerous creatures and characters that inhabit the place, Darwin realizes he is in danger. To return to the ocean, Darwin will have to outsmart, evolve, and reveal to the players through his journey the mysteries of a conspiracy that goes beyond anything one could have imagined… and which could very well seal the fate of humanity! Main Gameplay Features: A grand adventure worthy of an animated movie With rich artistic direction and a vibrant world, Darwin’s Paradox immerses you in a visual and emotional epic where every detail reveals more of its incredible story. Original gameplay The game offers a perfect balance between platforming sequences and moments of puzzle-solving: Swim, hide, infiltrate, jump, and use the extraordinary abilities of an octopus to advance in your adventure, escape perilous situations, or solve the many puzzles in the game. A living and interactive world Discover sprawling levels with a unique and polished artistic direction, filled with puzzles, dangers, and surprising creatures and characters. An immersive and poignant narrative Between humor, emotion, and suspense, Darwin takes you on a memorable odyssey.
detailed_descriptions.zh-Hant: 和达尔文一起踏上一场堪比动画电影的宏大冒险！达尔文是一只聪明可爱的章鱼，被什么人从海洋家乡中强行带走，困在了这座巨大而神秘的工业建筑之中。在这款集平台跳跃、冒险和解密要素于一体的游戏中，你要利用达尔文过人的智慧和独特的能力——游泳、伪装、还有更多精彩技能——帮他突破重重险阻。 故事开始于和平广阔的大海中。年轻的章鱼达尔文本在自在地探索深海，但一道诡异的光束划破了深渊，将他吸向了水面。达尔文醒过来时，发现自己身处一座巨大的废弃工厂，四周堆满了工业垃圾。 但明显有什么地方不对。工厂里四处都是充满威胁的机械、神秘的培育缸、以及住在这里的各种危险的生物和角色。达尔文很快便意识到，自己正身处险境。想要重返大海故乡，达尔文必须要利用智慧，不断进化，克服困难。在这段历险中，玩家也会逐步揭开这背后暗藏的足以撼动人类命运的惊天阴谋！ 游戏主要特色： 堪比动画电影的宏大冒险： Darwin's Paradox拥有丰富的美术风格和鲜活的世界，带领玩家体验视觉与情感的史诗，其中每一处细节都让这个不可思议的故事更加完整。 原创玩法： 这款游戏完美的平衡了平台游戏的节奏感和精彩的解谜时刻。游泳，躲藏，潜入，跳跃，利用章鱼的超凡能力在冒险中前进，逃离危险的境地，解开游戏里诸多谜题。 鲜活的互动世界： 探索复杂的关卡，体验独特而精致的美术风格。每一关中都充满了谜题、危险以及惊艳的生物与角色。 令人身临其境的悲情故事： 达尔文带你踏上难忘的漫长旅途，品味其中的幽默、激情和悬疑。
detailed_descriptions.ja: 海から引き離され、謎の工業地帯に閉じ込められたダーウィンの冒険が始まる。 高い知能を持つダーウィンと共に難解なパズルを解き、泳ぎやカモフラージュといったタコの性質を活かし、 様々な罠や脅威をくぐり抜けるアクションアドベンチャーゲーム！ 平和な大海原で過ごしていた若きタコ、ダーウィン。 ある日彼は深海を探検していたが、突然奇妙な光が深淵を貫き、彼は海面へと引き上げられる。 目を覚ました時には彼は、不気味な工場が立ち並ぶ巨大なジャンクヤードに放り出されていた。 しかし、そこは何かがおかしい。 不思議な機械や奇妙な貯蔵タンクに謎めいた危険な生物たちが生息していた。 身の危機を察知したダーウィンは、海に戻るために敵を出し抜きつつ、彼自身の進化を成し遂げていく。 そしてダーウィンは、故郷への旅を通して、人類の運命を左右する壮大な謎を解き明かす！ ゲームの特徴： アニメーション映画を彷彿とさせる壮大な冒険： 芸術的な演出と活気に満ちた世界観、そして細部まで描かれたストーリがあなたの心を掴む！ ゲームプレイ： アクションとパズルの絶妙なバランス。ジャンプや泳ぎで冒険を進め、タコのカモフラージュ能力を生かして 潜入し、危険な状況を脱出しよう！ 現実感が溢れる演出： 地形を生かして難解なパズルを解き、奇妙な生物やキャラクターから切り抜けるスリルに満ちた展開。芸術的な演出も満載！ 没入感のある物語： ユーモア、感動、サスペンスに包まれたストーリー！忘れられない冒険に旅立とう！

games.name: Data Center
games.short_description: Build, cable, and automate. Assemble racks, servers, and switches, connect enough capacity for each app, earn money from processed data, and unlock gear and bigger customers with XP and reputation. Follow colored data packets as your center comes to life.

descriptions.en: Build, cable, and automate. Assemble racks, servers, and switches, connect enough capacity for each app, earn money from processed data, and unlock gear and bigger customers with XP and reputation. Follow colored data packets as your center comes to life.

detailed_descriptions.en: Build, cable, and grow a living data center from the ground up. Start with bare floors, buy racks, servers, and switches, then physically place and stack your hardware the way you want. Run Ethernet between ports to shape your network by hand and watch data spring to life: every customer’s traffic appears as colored packet-balls rolling along your cables, revealing bottlenecks, idle links, and beautifully tuned throughput at a glance. Customers arrive with app requirements and capacity targets. It’s your job to connect enough servers to each customer app, balance load across racks and switches, and keep the data flowing. As you successfully process customer data you earn money to expand, XP to unlock more capable devices, and reputation to attract bigger, more demanding clients. Hardware ages, too—servers and switches have end-of-life and can break—so design for uptime: keep services reachable even if devices on the path die, swap out failing gear, and build redundancy with servers that can use multiple network connections. Tinker for perfect layouts or move fast to hit deadlines; either way, this is a tactile builder where every cable matters and every improvement is visible. No complex command lines—just the satisfying click of ports, the hum of stacked servers, and a vibrant river of packets proving your design works, even under failure. Key features Hands-on data center building: buy racks, servers, and switches; stack hardware and route Ethernet by hand. Visual networking: see packets as colored balls per customer, making flow, congestion, and capacity instantly readable. Customer-driven goals: connect enough servers to each app to meet requirements and keep contracts running. Progression that rewards good design: process data to earn money, gain XP to unlock new devices, and build reputation to attract new customers. Reliability and maintenance: devices have lifespans and can fail—plan replacements, manage downtime risk, and keep services online. Redundancy that matters: give servers redundant connections and create alternate paths so traffic stays reachable when a switch or link dies. Evolve your layout: upgrade hardware, recable to remove bottlenecks, and scale your floor from scrappy beginnings to a bustling operation. Immediate feedback: every placement, failure, connection, and upgrade changes how packets move—optimize by watching the network breathe. Build it your way, wire it your way, and grow from a single rack to a reputation that attracts the biggest clients—all powered by a network you can literally see working, surviving hiccups and hardware end-of-life along the way.
