games.name: EVERSPACE™ 2 - Supporter Pack
games.short_description: The EVERSPACE 2 Supporter Pack opens up new cosmetic options for series megafans to customize ships.

descriptions.en: The EVERSPACE 2 Supporter Pack opens up new cosmetic options for series megafans to customize ships.

detailed_descriptions.en: The EVERSPACE 2 Supporter Pack is filled with fun, customizable options for our megafans. From our crowdfunded beginnings, EVERSPACE fans have taken us to the stars and beyond. We can only make games and DLC so quickly, so we’re offering a VERY optional way for space game enthusiasts to support the team making one of their favorite games. This DLC pack includes: Cybernetic Glow Lighting Inspired by a film ending in “-ron” and a bug from our Unreal Engine 5 migration, the entirety of Cluster 34 will absolutely sit up and take notice with this new emissive light setup installed on your ship. The color of these new ship lights can be adjusted in the customization menu. Adjustable Ship Skins Nothing says speed like a “go-faster” stripe. 34 resizeable liveries grant a variety of shapes and patterns for ships, allowing even greater customization. No vinyl anime waifu wraps here. Yet. New Engine Effects Leave friends and enemies in your dust… in style! Show off with 12 fancy new thruster and booster exhaust types that won’t change how fast you’re going, only how good you look in flight. Ship Decals Want to appear as if your ship is the hottest sponsored* racer in Cluster 34? Customize your ride with 13 new decals that can be placed on multiple points of your spacecraft! *Decals offer no in-game reward. Paid company sponsorship may or may not exist in the DMZ. Intangible Heartfelt Thanks and Gratitude Our thanks is there in so many ways, but none that you’d notice. We’ve vacuumed out the crumbs from your ship’s cockpit, installed a slightly more comfortable seat cushion, cleaned the Home Base ice cream machine (this may have been the first time that’s ever happened), polished HIVE’s AI core with the good stuff, swapped out air filters for pine scented ones, and made the world a better place. Mainly, just know that the team is deeply appreciative of your support. Important note: Everything in this pack is simply cosmetic and has no effect on gameplay. Purchasing this DLC is purely to show your support for the team behind the EVERSPACE games and help us continue development on EVERSPACE 2 content as we set our sights on the future of the series.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
The EVERSPACE 2 Supporter Pack is filled with fun, customizable options for our megafans. From our crowdfunded beginnings, EVERSPACE fans have taken us to the stars and beyond. We can only make games and DLC so quickly, so we’re offering a VERY optional way for space game enthusiasts to support the team making one of their favorite games.

This DLC pack includes:

Cybernetic Glow Lighting

Inspired by a film ending in “-ron” and a bug from our Unreal Engine 5 migration, the entirety of Cluster 34 will absolutely sit up and take notice with this new emissive light setup installed on your ship. The color of these new ship lights can be adjusted in the customization menu.


Adjustable Ship Skins

Nothing says speed like a “go-faster” stripe. 34 resizeable liveries grant a variety of shapes and patterns for ships, allowing even greater customization. No vinyl anime waifu wraps here. Yet.


New Engine Effects

Leave friends and enemies in your dust… in style! Show off with 12 fancy new thruster and booster exhaust types that won’t change how fast you’re going, only how good you look in flight.


Ship Decals

Want to appear as if your ship is the hottest sponsored* racer in Cluster 34? Customize your ride with 13 new decals that can be placed on multiple points of your spacecraft!

*Decals offer no in-game reward. Paid company sponsorship may or may not exist in the DMZ.

Intangible Heartfelt Thanks and Gratitude

Our thanks is there in so many ways, but none that you’d notice. We’ve vacuumed out the crumbs from your ship’s cockpit, installed a slightly more comfortable seat cushion, cleaned the Home Base ice cream machine (this may have been the first time that’s ever happened), polished HIVE’s AI core with the good stuff, swapped out air filters for pine scented ones, and made the world a better place. Mainly, just know that the team is deeply appreciative of your support.

Important note: Everything in this pack is simply cosmetic and has no effect on gameplay. Purchasing this DLC is purely to show your support for the team behind the EVERSPACE games and help us continue development on EVERSPACE 2 content as we set our sights on the future of the series.

games.name: EVERSPACE™ 2 - Wrath of the Ancients
games.short_description: The Ancients have awakened! Their wrath has laid waste to human settlements in Cluster 34, and the path of destruction leads to the Okkar Homeworlds. Take flight in this massive expansion DLC as the Cluster readies for war once again in EVERSPACE 2: Wrath of the Ancients.

descriptions.en: The Ancients have awakened! Their wrath has laid waste to human settlements in Cluster 34, and the path of destruction leads to the Okkar Homeworlds. Take flight in this massive expansion DLC as the Cluster readies for war once again in EVERSPACE 2: Wrath of the Ancients.

detailed_descriptions.en: The Ancients have awakened! Their wrath has laid waste to human settlements in Cluster 34, destabilizing factions in power and stranding survivors. Among the Okkar, a growing number argue that if the Ancients reject Humankind, so should they. With the uneasy peace threatened, venture into the Okkar Homeworlds to discover the truth behind the threat... before war reignites the DMZ. EVERSPACE 2: Wrath of the Ancients offers space pilots an all-new adventure set after the events of EVERSPACE 2, as well as new mid-game side quests exploring the Okkar civilization and homeworlds. Take flight to battle against Ancient and alien enemies while tracking down the source of these threats to Colonial space. This full-sized expansion is packed with new star systems to explore, allies to meet, and powerful new weapons to destroy enemy ships. The massive main story campaign will take pilots through four new star systems, each packed with locations filled with secrets and side missions to uncover. Distant star systems bring new threats—battle challenging enemies and bosses in a never-been-seen before Okkar Ship class. The new Wraith Okkar fighter uses rare technology to consume fragments of defeated enemies to activate special abilities. This high-risk, high-reward ship is deadly in the hands of a skilled pilot. EVERSPACE 2: Wrath of the Ancients features: Adventure through an exciting post-game storyline expanding the EVERSPACE universe Journey through several new major side quests exploring Okkar civilization and their homeworlds, accessible from midway through the main campaign Take flight in the new flyable Wraith Okkar ship class Meet an expanded cast of new and returning characters Challenge new enemy types and bosses Explore four new and expanded existing star systems including the Okkar homeworlds Discover dozens of new locations filled with secrets and new puzzle types Power up your ships with new weapons and gear Break limits with new upgradable Okkar equipment Collect rare resources and crafting blueprints Space out to an expanded soundtrack adding new exploration, travel, and battle music

Capture the vast floating islands and venture into this expansive realm where the sky meets the sea and each horizon promises new adventures and undiscovered mysteries. games.name: Everything is Crab: The Animal Evolution Roguelite

names.en: Everything is Crab: The Animal Evolution Roguelite
names.zh-Hant: 萬物皆可蟹：動物演化Roguelite遊戲 | Everything is Crab
names.ja: Everything is Crab: 生物進化ローグライト
names.ko: 에브리씽 이즈 크랩: 동물 진화 로그라이트 | Everything is Crab

games.short_description: The Animal Evolution Roguelite. Hunt, Flee, Scavenge and Thrive in a living ecosystem. Choose from 125+ Evolutions and Specialisations for unique creature combinations in every run. Adapt to survive the natural curve in order to beat carcinisation... or get Darwin'd trying!

descriptions.en: The Animal Evolution Roguelite. Hunt, Flee, Scavenge and Thrive in a living ecosystem. Choose from 125+ Evolutions and Specialisations for unique creature combinations in every run. Adapt to survive the natural curve in order to beat carcinisation... or get Darwin'd trying!
descriptions.zh-Hant: 動物演化Roguelite遊戲 狩獵、逃亡、覓食，並在生生不息的生態圈中發展成長。有超過125種進化及專精選項，讓你在每回合中挑選、創造各種獨特的組合。為了生存，適應環境來打破蟹化理論……又或者是在嘗試的過程中，被達爾文宣告淘汰！
descriptions.ja: 生物進化ローグライト。 生命力あふれる生態系の中で、狩り、逃げ、あさり、そして生き残れ。125種類以上の進化と特化から選択し、プレイごとにユニークな生物の組み合わせを作り出そう。自然の摂理に適応し、「カニ化」の運命に打ち勝て……さもなくば、進化の藻屑と消えるのみ！
descriptions.ko: 동물 진화 로그라이트. 살아 숨쉬는 생태계에서 사냥하고, 도망치고, 시체를 먹어치우며 번성하세요. 125가지 이상의 진화와 특성화를 선택하여 매 판마다 독특한 조합의 생물을 만들어 보세요. 자연의 섭리에서 살아남고 '게화'를 극복하기 위해 적응하세요... 아니면 도전하다가 '다윈행'하고 도태되든지요!

detailed_descriptions.en: Set in a living ecosystem , 'Everything is Crab' is a cute, challenging, highly replayable action roguelite . Make animal inspired evolutionary choices to concoct your own unique creature every run, both mechanically and visually. It's Spore meets Modern Roguelites As everybody knows, eventually, every organism ends up evolving into a crab. Right? Well, except for you. Choose your own evolutionary path and strategy to thrive and defeat convergent evolution. Take that, science! Over 125 abilities combine to create a plethora of different builds and playstyles: Become a wily trickster, a ferocious predator, a gregarious leader, a nimble nomad, or take on any number of other survival strategies. Legs! Claws! Pincers! Wings! More Legs! Fur! Tail! Scales! Tentacles! I SAID MORE LEGS!!! Build your formidable, visually awkward chimera or get Darwin'd in the process. 125+ evolution based abilities Endless possibilities and visual combinations Strategy-defining evolutions Many viable survival strategies and playstyles A living, thriving ecosystem Many different critters with their own goals and strategies, each of them with several stages of evolution Four distinct biomes with different rules, climate events, points of interest, flora and fauna Night and day cycle A variety of bosses that may (or may not) appear with each run Huge meta-progression layer Difficulties system (if you dare!) Genetics (starting Characters), which can be combined to create endless starting character combinations Challenge Scenarios to push your adaptation skills to the limit More evolutions Endless runs Prove your survival skills to unlock Endless runs, ditch the timer, and outlast the apocalypse! Track your findings, meta-progression and achievements in the Codex Have a Crabby day!
detailed_descriptions.zh-Hant: 動物演化Roguelite遊戲 以一個生機勃勃的生態圈為背景，《萬物皆可蟹》是一款可愛又具挑戰性，讓人忍不住一玩再玩的動作Roguelite遊戲。在每一個回合裡，你都能透過以動物為啟發的進化選擇，打造出外觀和戰鬥機制都專屬於你的獨特生物！ 當《孢子》(Spore) 遇上現代版Roguelite 戰勝蟹化理論 大家都知道：萬物終將成為蟹。對吧？ 但，你是例外。選擇你的進化路徑和策略，進化成長並戰勝趨同演化的理論。接招吧，生物學家們！ 進化。適應。克服困境 超過125種技能選擇，創造出多種不同的角色建構與玩法：成為詭計多端的騙術師、兇殘的捕食者、群居動物的領導者、來去自如的游牧者，或者發展出其他各式各樣的生存策略。 腿！爪子！螯！翅膀！再一條腿！毛皮！尾巴！鱗片！觸手！給、我、更、多、條、腿！！！ 打造你外型奇特又強大的奇美拉，否則只能等著被達爾文收拾。 遊戲特色 超過125種進化型技能 無數多種的可能性及外觀組合 決定策略走向的進化選項 各種可運用的生存策略及玩法 一個生機盎然、蓬勃發展的生態系統 各式各樣的生物具有不同目標及策略，每一種都有多段進化 四種截然不同的生物群系，各具有不一樣的規則、氣象事件、興趣點以及動植物 晝夜循環 每回合可能會（也可能不會）出現各種不同的首領 豐富的局外成長系統 難度調整系統（你有膽的話！） 利用基因（初始角色）組合，打造無限可能的初始配置。 挑戰不同場景，將你的適應能力發揮到極致 更多進化 在圖鑑中查看你的蒐藏、局外成長以及成就 無盡模式 用你的生存技巧來證明自己並解鎖無盡模式、擺脫時間束縛，在末日中挑戰生存極限！ 蟹在就開始盡情遊玩吧！
detailed_descriptions.ja: 生物進化ローグライト。 生きている生態系を舞台にした「Everything is Crab」は、キュートで挑戦的、そしてリプレイ性の高いアクションローグライトだ。動物にインスパイアされた進化を選択し、メカニズム的にも視覚的にも、自分だけのユニークなクリーチャーをプレイするごとに作り上げよう。 まさに『Spore』と現代のローグライトが融合した作品だ。 カニ化を打ち破れ 誰もが知っている通り、結局のところ、すべての生物はカニへと進化する。だろ？ ……まあ、君を除いては。自分だけの進化の道と戦略を選んで繁栄し、収斂進化（しゅうれんしんか）を打ち負かせ。科学の常識を覆してやれ！ 進化せよ。適応せよ。乗り越えよ 125種類以上のアビリティを組み合わせて、無数のビルドやプレイスタイルを生み出そう。狡猾なトリックスター、凶暴な捕食者、社交的なリーダー、俊敏な放浪者、あるいは独自の生存戦略を編み出せ。 脚だ！爪！ 鋏！ 翼！ もっと脚を！ 毛皮！ 尻尾！ 鱗！ 触手！ 言っただろう、もっと脚だ！！！ 強力で、見た目はちょっと不格好なキメラを作り上げるか、その過程で自然淘汰されるか。 主な特徴 125種類以上の進化アビリティ 無限の可能性とビジュアルの組み合わせ 戦略を左右する進化要素 多彩な生存戦略とプレイスタイル 生命力あふれる、繁栄した生態系 独自の目的や戦略、複数の進化段階を持つ多様な生物たち ルール、気候イベント、注目ポイント、動植物が異なる4つの個性的なバイオーム 昼夜のサイクル プレイごとに登場する可能性のある（あるいは登場しない）多様なボス 奥深いメタ成長要素 難易度システム（勇気があるなら挑戦せよ！） 遺伝子（初期キャラクター）を組み合わせて生み出す、無限の初期キャラクターのバリエーション 適応能力の限界を試すチャレンジシナリオ さらなる進化要素 発見、メタ成長、実績を記録する図鑑 エンドレスラン 己のサバイバル能力を証明して「エンドレスラン」をアンロックしろ！ 制限時間（タイマー）をかなぐり捨て、大絶滅を生き延びるのだ！ 素敵なカニ日和を！
detailed_descriptions.ko: 동물 진화 로그라이트 살아 숨쉬는 생태계를 배경으로 한 '에브리씽 이즈 크랩'은 귀엽고, 도전 정신을 자극하며, 중독성 강한 액션 로그라이트 게임입니다. 동물에게서 영감을 받아 진화 방식을 선택하면서 매번 특징과 외형 모두 독특한 나만의 생명체를 만들어 보세요. '스포어'와 최신 로그라이트 게임의 만남 게화를 극복하라 모두 알고 계신 사실이겠지만, 모든 유기체는 궁극적으로는 게로 진화하게 되어 있습니다. 그렇죠? 글쎄요, 당신만 빼면요. 수렴 진화에 맞서 자신만의 진화 경로와 전략을 선택해 번성하세요. 덤빌 테면 덤벼 봐, 과학! 진화하고, 적응하고, 극복하세요 125가지 이상의 능력을 조합해 수많은 빌드와 플레이 스타일을 만드세요. 교활한 사기꾼, 포악한 포식자, 사교적인 리더, 민첩한 유목민이 되거나 수많은 생존 전략을 구사해 보세요. 다리! 발톱! 집게! 날개! 다리 더 많이! 털! 꼬리! 비늘! 촉수! 다리 좀 더 많이 달라고 했잖아요!!! 무시무시하면서 기괴한 외형을 갖춘 키메라를 만드세요. 그러지 못하면 중간에 '다윈행'하면서 도태될 겁니다. 특징 125가지 이상의 진화 기반 능력 끝없는 가능성과 외형의 조합 전략을 결정짓는 핵심적인 진화 요소들 다양하고 실용적인 생존 전략과 플레이 스타일 살아 움직이며 번성하는 생태계 각기 다른 목표와 전략, 여러 진화 단계를 갖춘 다양한 생물들 규칙, 기후 이벤트, 주요 지점, 동식물이 각기 다른 4개의 고유한 생물군계 낮과 밤의 순환 매 판 무작위로 등장할 수도(혹은 등장하지 않을 수도) 있는 다양한 보스들 방대한 메타 성장 시스템 난이도 시스템 (자신 있다면 도전하세요!) 무한한 조합이 가능한 유전학(시작 캐릭터) 시스템 적응력을 한계까지 시험하는 챌린지 시나리오 더 많은 진화 백과사전에서 발견한 내용, 메타 성장 및 업적을 확인하세요 무한 런 생존 기술을 증명하여 무한 런을 잠금 해제하세요. 타이머 같은 건 잊어버리고, 종말의 세계에서 끝까지 살아남으세요! 게 같은 하루 되세요!

games.name: Evil Genius 2: World Domination
games.short_description: A satirical spy-fi lair builder where YOU are the criminal mastermind! Construct your base, train your minions, defend your operations from the Forces of Justice, and achieve global domination!

descriptions.en: A satirical spy-fi lair builder where YOU are the criminal mastermind! Construct your base, train your minions, defend your operations from the Forces of Justice, and achieve global domination!

detailed_descriptions.en: The World Is JUST Enough! Evil Genius 2 is a satirical spy-fi lair builder, where players take control of an Evil Genius and set their plans for world domination in motion. When it feels this good to be bad, the Forces of Justice don’t stand a chance! Build your own unique evil lair and cover operation, Train a force of criminal minions, Defend your Lair from the Forces of Justice, and Dominate the world with a Doomsday Device in this direct sequel to the 2004 cult classic! Cruel Constructions! Every villain needs an island lair, so pick your paradise and put your own sinister stamp on it! Shape the internal structure of your hazardous hideaway to fit your play-style, and construct wonderfully wicked devices for your minions to put to use. Atrocious Anti-Heroes! Competence isn’t going to cut it when you’re running an evil operation. As you expand and train your minion workforce, you can create new specialists to help further your evil plans! Need something a little more…intimidating? Recruit powerful Henchmen that complement your play style; every mastermind needs a right hand…or several, in fact! Dastardly Devices! The Forces of Justice are annoyingly punctual, so supplement your brute force by researching and developing a series of trap networks! Send those do-gooders spinning with a Pinball Bumper, or put the chomp on them with the Venus Spy-Trap. While one trap is good, more is…evil-er. Combo your traps to banish intruders for good! Nefarious Plots! Carry out evil schemes to further your plot to build a Doomsday Device and dominate the world! Sell the British Royal Family, Kidnap the Governor of Maine, and literally BAKE ALASKA. With hundreds of potential objectives, variety is the spice of strife. Gifs are taken from pre-release footage

games.name: Evil School
games.short_description: This game is an FMV about anti-bullying. A teenage girl mysteriously disappeared, and the truth was buried by power for eight years. Now, you return to this place of evil with a bloodstained list. The moment of slay & judgment has arrived...

descriptions.en: This game is an FMV about anti-bullying. A teenage girl mysteriously disappeared, and the truth was buried by power for eight years. Now, you return to this place of evil with a bloodstained list. The moment of slay & judgment has arrived...

detailed_descriptions.en: The first revenge-themed game focusing on the theme of anti-bullying in schools, its storyline spans 10 years. With nearly 500 minutes of gameplay, over 100 branching storylines, and 42 endings, we've painted a cruel and dark picture of school life. In the game, every choice can lead you to drastically different truths and consequences—reversals upon reversals. You think you're close to the truth, but you may be stepping deeper into a more complex situation. After a year of preparation, we've dedicated ourselves to presenting you with our sincere vision: Creating a Realistic School We invested in the setup and production of dozens of school scenes, creating over 100GB of art assets. Filming and preparation took over two months, recreating grand scenes such as the "Auditorium," "School Gate," "School History Museum," and "Stadium" on a real university campus. Top-Tier Cast The creative team traveled to Hengdian, Beijing, and Guangzhou for casting over six months. The 14 lead actors include veteran actors like Zhang Xinhua and Min Zheng, as well as new faces from short dramas and television series. We consistently insist on using only popular actors, investing the entire budget in their talent. Furthermore, this production features over 50 featured extras, and the teachers and students throughout the campus are all carefully arranged, with a total of over 1000 performers (including extras). Led by theatrical release creators, a production team of over 100 people The production team consists of over 100 people, with theatrical-level creative team, three-camera shooting, and over 20TB of footage. We invested 3-7 times more than the industry average, solely to create a realistic campus and recreate an exceptionally compelling story. A young life tragically ends on campus, the truth buried for eight years. Now, you return holding a blood-stained list—the time for judgment has come. Face the past and carry out your verdict. Story Background 2018, at a high School. Girl Gu Panyu was imprisoned in an iron cage in the equipment room for three days by bullies, but on Monday, she "safely" walked out of the school gate under surveillance and vanished without a trace. Eight years later, when everyone had long forgotten the disappearance, Gu Panqing, the younger sister, identified her perpetrators—Li Manting and Zhang Yao—through a notebook filled with the blood and tears of bullying. She initially wanted to find her sister, but little did she know that the truth she uncovered would be far more cruel than death itself. Game Features You are not a bystander, but the mastermind Track down clues, eavesdrop on secrets, and plot murder. You are no longer a bystander in the story, but the mastermind behind revenge. Personally plan flawless trials, slay the evils in your carefully woven trap, and bring death to them. Tense suspense atmosphere, immersive story experience A realistic school environment, unique streetscapes, and meticulously designed props bring you a cinematic visual immersion. A progressively unfolding plot, the exhilarating feeling of revenge A chapter-based hunting mechanism allows you to systematically eliminate the criminals on your list. From identifying your target to carrying out the trial, experience the exhilarating thrill of revenge. Multiple Branching Paths & Multiple Endings A complex web of branching storylines leads to multiple destinies. Every small choice you make will trigger a butterfly effect, completely rewriting the course of the story. When the obsession with revenge clashes fiercely with the bonds of emotion within you, what will you choose? Streaming or making videos on TikTok, YouTube, etc. is permitted and welcome. The scope: Chapter 1 (Full); Chapter 2-6 (under 2 mins for each).

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
The first revenge-themed game focusing on the theme of anti-bullying in schools, its storyline spans 10 years. With nearly 500 minutes of gameplay, over 100 branching storylines, and 42 endings, we've painted a cruel and dark picture of school life. In the game, every choice can lead you to drastically different truths and consequences—reversals upon reversals. You think you're close to the truth, but you may be stepping deeper into a more complex situation.

After a year of preparation, we've dedicated ourselves to presenting you with our sincere vision:

Creating a Realistic School

  • We invested in the setup and production of dozens of school scenes, creating over 100GB of art assets. Filming and preparation took over two months, recreating grand scenes such as the "Auditorium," "School Gate," "School History Museum," and "Stadium" on a real university campus.

Top-Tier Cast

  • The creative team traveled to Hengdian, Beijing, and Guangzhou for casting over six months. The 14 lead actors include veteran actors like Zhang Xinhua and Min Zheng, as well as new faces from short dramas and television series. We consistently insist on using only popular actors, investing the entire budget in their talent. Furthermore, this production features over 50 featured extras, and the teachers and students throughout the campus are all carefully arranged, with a total of over 1000 performers (including extras).

Led by theatrical release creators, a production team of over 100 people

  • The production team consists of over 100 people, with theatrical-level creative team, three-camera shooting, and over 20TB of footage. We invested 3-7 times more than the industry average, solely to create a realistic campus and recreate an exceptionally compelling story.

A young life tragically ends on campus, the truth buried for eight years. Now, you return holding a blood-stained list—the time for judgment has come. Face the past and carry out your verdict.

Story Background

2018, at a high School. Girl Gu Panyu was imprisoned in an iron cage in the equipment room for three days by bullies, but on Monday, she "safely" walked out of the school gate under surveillance and vanished without a trace.

Eight years later, when everyone had long forgotten the disappearance, Gu Panqing, the younger sister, identified her perpetrators—Li Manting and Zhang Yao—through a notebook filled with the blood and tears of bullying. She initially wanted to find her sister, but little did she know that the truth she uncovered would be far more cruel than death itself.

Game Features

  • You are not a bystander, but the mastermind

    Track down clues, eavesdrop on secrets, and plot murder. You are no longer a bystander in the story, but the mastermind behind revenge. Personally plan flawless trials, slay the evils in your carefully woven trap, and bring death to them.

  • Tense suspense atmosphere, immersive story experience

    A realistic school environment, unique streetscapes, and meticulously designed props bring you a cinematic visual immersion.

  • A progressively unfolding plot, the exhilarating feeling of revenge

    A chapter-based hunting mechanism allows you to systematically eliminate the criminals on your list. From identifying your target to carrying out the trial, experience the exhilarating thrill of revenge.

  • Multiple Branching Paths & Multiple Endings

    A complex web of branching storylines leads to multiple destinies. Every small choice you make will trigger a butterfly effect, completely rewriting the course of the story. When the obsession with revenge clashes fiercely with the bonds of emotion within you, what will you choose?

Streaming or making videos on TikTok, YouTube, etc. is permitted and welcome.

The scope: Chapter 1 (Full); Chapter 2-6 (under 2 mins for each).

games.name: Ex Sanguis
games.short_description: Bleed the world back to life in a series of tactical, turn-based bloodbaths! Lead your STILLAE, elite warriors in the fight to save a dying world from the forces of STASIS. Slay foes, kick them back on the timeline, and trigger chain events where elegance and blood flow as one.

descriptions.en: Bleed the world back to life in a series of tactical, turn-based bloodbaths! Lead your STILLAE, elite warriors in the fight to save a dying world from the forces of STASIS. Slay foes, kick them back on the timeline, and trigger chain events where elegance and blood flow as one.

detailed_descriptions.en: From the Sanguis of the Mater, the Stillae are born. Elite warriors who bare the last of their divinity's hope, you will lead them in a battle to save a dying world. Fight in tactical combat against the forces of Stasis and restore the flow of life! Your perfect plan Plan your next moves with dynamic turn-based combat, strategically triggering epic chains of events across the battlefield: Use Timeline Effects to speed up, delay or swap time position to impact turn order and outsmart your enemies. Play with your surroundings that can explode, ignite enemies, or block sight... changing the outcome of the battles. Leverage spatial effects like knock-backs, forced facings, flanking bonuses, and damage-over-time to dominate every encounter. Unlock a vast arsenal of abilities, each offering powerful synergies and deep build customization. Take on risks and progress Choose your own path and difficulty as you progress through the map. Take on high-risk, high-reward missions, head straight for boss encounters, or slow down to gather resources to increase your chance of success. All missions contribute to gradual progress and reflect the type of experience you decide. A Roguelite loop adapted to turn-based combat With each return, each playthrough, you carve new strength from failure and victory alike, unlocking forgotten powers and braving ever darker depths, where your greatest enemies await. The further away you venture toward the outer rim of the map, the harder the standard Missions become. Regain memories and customize your Stillae for the next round by changing their loadouts and names. A Crimson Rebellion In a world drained by the Purge, blood is defiance. Each drop of it paints the world in reds and blacks, as a reminder that life fights back. This is not just violence, it's a vivid rebellion in a pale, colorless world against those who would see it in Stasis forever.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
From the Sanguis of the Mater, the Stillae are born. Elite warriors who bare the last of their divinity's hope, you will lead them in a battle to save a dying world. Fight in tactical combat against the forces of Stasis and restore the flow of life!

Your perfect plan

Plan your next moves with dynamic turn-based combat, strategically triggering epic chains of events across the battlefield:

  • Use Timeline Effects to speed up, delay or swap time position to impact turn order and outsmart your enemies.

  • Play with your surroundings that can explode, ignite enemies, or block sight... changing the outcome of the battles.

  • Leverage spatial effects like knock-backs, forced facings, flanking bonuses, and damage-over-time to dominate every encounter.

  • Unlock a vast arsenal of abilities, each offering powerful synergies and deep build customization.

Take on risks and progress

  • Choose your own path and difficulty as you progress through the map.

  • Take on high-risk, high-reward missions, head straight for boss encounters, or slow down to gather resources to increase your chance of success.

  • All missions contribute to gradual progress and reflect the type of experience you decide.

A Roguelite loop adapted to turn-based combat

  • With each return, each playthrough, you carve new strength from failure and victory alike, unlocking forgotten powers and braving ever darker depths, where your greatest enemies await.

  • The further away you venture toward the outer rim of the map, the harder the standard Missions become.

  • Regain memories and customize your Stillae for the next round by changing their loadouts and names.

A Crimson Rebellion

In a world drained by the Purge, blood is defiance. Each drop of it paints the world in reds and blacks, as a reminder that life fights back. This is not just violence, it's a vivid rebellion in a pale, colorless world against those who would see it in Stasis forever.

detailed_descriptions.en: Ex-Zodiac is a fast-paced rail shooter with a stylized look reminiscent of early 90's 3D games. Join protagonist Kyuu as she fights to free the worlds of the Sanzaru Star System, overrun by the intergalactic terrorist organization known as Zodiac . FEATURING: - A retro, colourful, low-poly visual style - 11 main levels and 6 bonus levels currently (more than 12 will be available after full release) - Major bosses at the end of each level, each piloted by a member of the Zodiac - A 16-bit style soundtrack by +TEK combining FM and wavetable synthesis - Barrel rolls CONTROLS: This game plays best using an Xinput compatible analogue controller (Xbox, PS4 etc), however digital devices can be used too, such as a D-pad or keyboard (analogue is definitely the way to go, though!). The controls are also re-mappable. CREDITS: Code, Design, Art, Sound Effects: Ben Hickling (MNKY) Music: +TEK Published by Pixeljam

detailed_descriptions.en: The year is 1997. You used to be a hacker, but now you have the phage. You made a deal: one hack, one dose. There’s nothing left to lose… except your life. EXAPUNKS is the latest open-ended puzzle game from Zachtronics, the creators of Opus Magnum, SHENZHEN I/O, TIS-100, and more. READ ZINES - Learn to hack from TRASH WORLD NEWS, the underground computer magazine. Tutorials, hacking tips, secret information, searing commentary— TRASH WORLD NEWS has you covered. WRITE VIRUSES - Program your EXAs (EXecution Agents) to tear through networks, replicate themselves, trash files, terminate other EXAs— and leave without a trace. HACK EVERYTHING - Hack banks, universities, factories, TV stations, highway signs, game consoles, the government... oh yeah, and your own body. SLACK OFF - Play ПАСЬЯНС, if you hack the server where it’s stored. Or play HACK*MATCH, if you hack the region lock on your Sawayama WonderDisc. Or create your own homebrew games for the TEC Redshift… if you hack the development kit. TAKE DOWN YOUR FRIENDS - Compete with your friends by running your programs directly against theirs in all-out hacker battles. Make every cycle count. CREATE YOUR OWN PUZZLES - Create your own networks to hack, and share them with the world on Steam Workshop.

games.name: Exark
games.short_description: Exark is a run-based engine builder where you command a gigantic ark-ship. Construct buildings, hire crew with unique skills, and exploit powerful synergies to survive your voyage to the rim of the world.

descriptions.en: Exark is a run-based engine builder where you command a gigantic ark-ship. Construct buildings, hire crew with unique skills, and exploit powerful synergies to survive your voyage to the rim of the world.

detailed_descriptions.en: The world-machine is broken. The sun has become a baleful orb of radiation. The Celestial Bureaucracy is in disarray. You, the Captain-General of a great ark, must lead your people rimwards, away from the gaze of the green sun. Optimize Your Production Survive your voyage by maximising your production of valuable resources: Food fuels your buildings, and stockpiles increase their cycle speed. Production allows you to construct more buildings on your ever-expanding ark. Inspiration enables you to hire crew members with unique skills to improve your buildings. ... or buy buildings and hire crew members outright by spending Gold at the dockside markets. Choose Your Great House Pick between a range of Great Houses, each with their own unique ark, buildings and crewmates. Command House Arioch's golden flagship, the Diurnal Ark, and harness the expertise of their engineers and artisans - or choose House Mnesis, whose ark, the titanic Shepherd Moon, is a motherlode of precious raw materials. Exploit the Houses' specialities, mitigate their shortcomings, and lead them to a safe refuge on the rim. Key Features Explore a vibrant world , with diverse biomes and settlements. Command 4 unique Great Houses , each requiring a different strategy to reach victory. Build your ultimate engine with over 100 buildings and specialized crew members. Play at your own pace with pause and time acceleration. Multiple routes to victory , either focusing on peaceful production or blasting your enemies into submission.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
The world-machine is broken. The sun has become a baleful orb of radiation. The Celestial Bureaucracy is in disarray. You, the Captain-General of a great ark, must lead your people rimwards, away from the gaze of the green sun.

Optimize Your Production

Survive your voyage by maximising your production of valuable resources:

  • Food fuels your buildings, and stockpiles increase their cycle speed.

  • Production allows you to construct more buildings on your ever-expanding ark.

  • Inspiration enables you to hire crew members with unique skills to improve your buildings.

  • ... or buy buildings and hire crew members outright by spending Gold at the dockside markets.

Choose Your Great House

Pick between a range of Great Houses, each with their own unique ark, buildings and crewmates. Command House Arioch's golden flagship, the Diurnal Ark, and harness the expertise of their engineers and artisans - or choose House Mnesis, whose ark, the titanic Shepherd Moon, is a motherlode of precious raw materials.

Exploit the Houses' specialities, mitigate their shortcomings, and lead them to a safe refuge on the rim.

Key Features

  • Explore a vibrant world, with diverse biomes and settlements.

  • Command 4 unique Great Houses, each requiring a different strategy to reach victory.

  • Build your ultimate engine with over 100 buildings and specialized crew members.

  • Play at your own pace with pause and time acceleration.

  • Multiple routes to victory, either focusing on peaceful production or blasting your enemies into submission.

descriptions.en: Exo Rally Championship is the galaxy’s most dangerous off-road racing event - remote, unexplored, extreme exoplanetary rally. Master a brutally realistic racing simulation and fight for every second gained on your quest to become a champion.

detailed_descriptions.en: Exo Rally Championship is the galaxy’s most dangerous off-road racing event. Welcome to the final frontier of racing - remote, unexplored, extreme exoplanetary rally. Take the wheel of advanced RCS thruster-enhanced rovers and master a brutally realistic racing simulation. Conquer unforgiving and inhospitable alien landscapes, speeding between waypoints on procedurally generated stages filled with hardware-breaking weather and terrain challenges. Dive into a career mode inspired by Earth's legendary rally events, and customize, tune, and repair your rover to optimize performance in the face of diverse environments. Push the boundaries of speed and control as you tackle the most intense off-road rallying event in the galaxy. Embark on a journey from the underdog to the champion, rising through the ranks and competing against the best teams for the ultimate Exo Rally Championship title. Build custom rally stages across massive alien landscapes in the Stage Editor, spanning up to 10 km²! Place your own checkpoints and carve out new routes and challenges for yourself and other players, and compete in online asynchronous rally events. Players race the same brutal stages on their own schedule, no shared start time or live lobby required. Run your stages and chase the online leaderboards! FEATURES Wild, untamed planets, fierce weather, hardware breaking temperatures and winds, otherworldly terrain formations and no roads in sight Hardcore off-road physics simulation, realistic tire models, drive-trains, suspension and damage Fuel-limited RCS-style thrusters for jumping, landing, air control and more to help manage treacherous and ‘truly off-road’ environments. Procedurally generated planets and stages mean no playthrough is the same A rich career mode based on real-world rally, Baja, and Dakar events Progress through rover classes, rising from back-of-the-pack strugglers to compete with the best of the best for the Exo Rally Championship title A deep management layer that allows you to customize, tune, and repair your rover Share seeds with friends to generate the same stages and compete for the best times Online Rally events let you race the same brutal stages asynchronously on your own schedule and compete for the fastest times The Stage Editor allows you to place checkpoints to create and share custom rally stages across massive alien landscapes spanning up to 10 km²

games.name: Exoprimal
games.short_description: Exoprimal is an online, team-based action game that pits humanity's cutting-edge exosuit technology against history's most ferocious beasts – dinosaurs.​​

descriptions.en: Exoprimal is an online, team-based action game that pits humanity's cutting-edge exosuit technology against history's most ferocious beasts – dinosaurs.​​

detailed_descriptions.en: 【GAME DETAILS】 Exoprimal is an online, team-based action game that pits humanity's cutting-edge exosuit technology against history's most ferocious beasts – dinosaurs. Exosuits are grouped into different roles, and players will pilot these exosuits to hold firm against overwhelming dinosaur swarms in online-only, team-based action game modes. 【STORY】 The year is 2040… Sudden dinosaur outbreaks have engulfed the globe in a crisis that threatens humanity's very existence. Yet all hope is not lost. The corporation Aibius has developed a hyper-advanced AI called Leviathan that can predict the location of future outbreaks. This technology, along with Aibius's revolutionary powered suits, or exosuits, gives humanity a fighting chance to stem the tide of the saurian swarms. Exosuit pilots, otherwise known as exofighters, are in high demand. Take the exofighter aptitude test and join the ranks of Aibius's heroic pilots in their fight to stave off the extinction of the human race. 【EXOSUITS】 Exosuits are cutting-edge powered suits developed to combat the dinosaur threat. Based on their range of abilities, exosuits are primarily categorized into one of three roles: assault, tank, and support. Exofighters can change exosuits at any time, even during battle, by performing a suit change. Take advantage of this flexibility to alter your team composition on the fly and complete your objectives. ROLES ASSAULT Assault exosuits focus on dealing damage to enemies with close, medium, or long-range attacks. Although exact loadouts differ, each assault exosuit is equipped with weapons and abilities tailored to its effective combat range. Use the best weapon for the situation and eradicate whatever stands in your way. TANK Tank exosuits specialize in protecting their allies by drawing enemy attacks and absorbing damage. Whether they're holding back a massive horde or stopping relentless dinosaur attacks, tank exosuits will form your team's first line of defense. SUPPORT Support exosuits use a variety of abilities to ensure the team's survival. While the ability to repair allied exosuits is most common, support exosuits are also equipped with a range of buffing and debuffing abilities. Support exosuits use these abilities to improve a team's combat effectiveness and accomplish objectives even faster. RIGS Rigs are additional pieces of equipment for exosuits. Rigs grant exosuits additional abilities, but only one may be equipped at a time. For example, the Zephyr exosuit excels at close quarters combat but has trouble with foes that attack from long-distance. Equipping it with the Cannon rig will enable Zephyr to use a long-range laser. Or, equip Roadblock with the Aid rig to provide healing and create a formidable front line of defense. Players can experiment with different combinations of rigs and exosuits to find their ideal playstyle. Both rigs and exosuits can be changed at any time. 【DINO SURVIVAL】 In Dino Survival, two squads of five race to complete objectives. Teams must follow Leviathan's directives and complete the mission before their rivals to win. Some situations pit players against one another in direct combat, and others require players to band together with their rivals to take down a major foe. In Dino Survival, the missions change based on players' progression through the game. The experience will be different with each match, even in matches with familiar surroundings and objectives. Players can unlock story sequences by playing Dino Survival and also earn rewards such as experience points to increase player and exosuit levels. DINOSAURS Dinosaurs, once the most fearsome and powerful creatures in the animal kingdom, are no longer history. However, traveling through spacetime via the vortexes has mutated these beasts and ramped up their ferocity to all-new heights. Humanity must rely on its ingenuity and its most powerful weapons – exosuits – to respond to this crisis. NEOSAURS Neosaurs are mutated dinosaurs with unusual appearances and abilities. Dinosaurs are imbued with a highly unstable energy when they cross through the vortex barrier after passing through spacetime. This energy is responsible for the ferocious transformation many dinosaurs undergo. Neosaurs possess an extremely high concentration of this energy, granting them unusual appearances, abilities, and attacks.

Rigs are additional pieces of equipment for exosuits.
Rigs grant exosuits additional abilities, but only one may be equipped at a time.
For example, the Zephyr exosuit excels at close quarters combat but has trouble with foes that attack from long-distance. Equipping it with the Cannon rig will enable Zephyr to use a long-range laser.
Or, equip Roadblock with the Aid rig to provide healing and create a formidable front line of defense.
Players can experiment with different combinations of rigs and exosuits to find their ideal playstyle.
Both rigs and exosuits can be changed at any time.

【DINO SURVIVAL】

In Dino Survival, two squads of five race to complete objectives.
Teams must follow Leviathan's directives and complete the mission before their rivals to win.
Some situations pit players against one another in direct combat, and others require players to band together with their rivals to take down a major foe.
In Dino Survival, the missions change based on players' progression through the game. The experience will be different with each match, even in matches with familiar surroundings and objectives.
Players can unlock story sequences by playing Dino Survival and also earn rewards such as experience points to increase player and exosuit levels.

DINOSAURS
Dinosaurs, once the most fearsome and powerful creatures in the animal kingdom, are no longer history.
However, traveling through spacetime via the vortexes has mutated these beasts and ramped up their ferocity to all-new heights.
Humanity must rely on its ingenuity and its most powerful weapons – exosuits – to respond to this crisis.



NEOSAURS
Neosaurs are mutated dinosaurs with unusual appearances and abilities.
Dinosaurs are imbued with a highly unstable energy when they cross through the vortex barrier after passing through spacetime.
This energy is responsible for the ferocious transformation many dinosaurs undergo.
Neosaurs possess an extremely high concentration of this energy, granting them unusual appearances, abilities, and attacks.

games.name: Exotica 2: Pet Shop Simulator
games.short_description: Exotica 2: Pet Shop Simulator is a cozy management game where you design and run your own exotic pet shop. Care for over 70 animals, raise babies, breed rare color variants, customize your store, and manage customers and staff.

descriptions.en: Exotica 2: Pet Shop Simulator is a cozy management game where you design and run your own exotic pet shop. Care for over 70 animals, raise babies, breed rare color variants, customize your store, and manage customers and staff.

detailed_descriptions.en: Step into Exotica 2: Pet Shop Simulator, where your shop buzzes with life, and every animal is a treasure waiting to be discovered. Grow your business by choosing which creatures to buy, breed, and sell, then reinvest your earnings to watch your cozy store flourish at your own rhythm. Enjoy a warm, sim-lite adventure where running your pet shop is all about gentle progress, delightful animal encounters, and business growth without any pressure or confusing systems. Run a Real Pet Shop Business Begin with a humble shop and shape its future with every decision you make. Choose your animals, plan your breeding, and set your prices as you welcome customers and watch your profits grow. Each step forward feels satisfying and unrushed, letting your business blossom in its own time. Animals - The Heart of Your Shop Animals are the soul of your shop. Nurture them from tiny babies, discover new breeds, and share your favorites with eager customers. As you grow, you meet over 70 unique species, including rare and eye-catching variants that make your store truly special. Pick animals up, hold them, carry them around the shop, and place them in habitats! Breeding & Hatching Breeding is a natural part of your journey. Pair animals, hatch eggs, and discover rare color or pattern variants over time. Some animals become more special as they grow, giving you exciting moments of discovery and long-term goals. Build and Customize Your Store Shape your pet shop into a space that feels truly yours. Arrange walls, floors, and decorations, tweak lighting and signs, and fill every corner with personality. Watch as your animals explore their surroundings, bringing your unique vision to life. Customers, Staff, and Automation Customers have different personalities and don’t always accept your suggestions. Handle sales yourself, or hire employees to handle daily tasks such as cashiering, animal care, cleaning, and stock transfers. Each employee has strengths and weaknesses, letting you automate routine work and focus on growth. Game Features: Build and run your own exotic pet shop while growing a lively business. Design your shop freely by shaping the layout, structures, and decorations. Customize your shop with a wide range of textures and lighting options. Unlock over 70 animal species, from cats and dogs to reptiles, birds, and fish. Watch animals roam freely around your shop, bringing it to life. Breed animals in real time and discover rare color or pattern variations. Feed animals, clean habitats, maintain spaces, and provide enrichment. Manage aquariums easily with automatic water filling and draining. Meet customers with different personalities and reactions. Use the cash register, handle payments, and review purchase summaries. Hire employees with unique strengths, weaknesses, and animal phobias. Earn star points to unlock new animals, items, and objects.

Embargo Interaction: Embargo your enemies with a new diplomatic interaction, preventing them from trading with you if they have generated enough world tension. detailed_descriptions.en: Build the industrial and research foundation to survive the world’s greatest conflict In Hearts of Iron IV: Götterdämmerung . In this expansion, players can write new histories of Germany, Austria, Hungary, Belgium, and Congo. Pursue exciting new research and military options, opening new paths for devastating new weapons and dramatic raids on strategic targets. Features of Hearts of Iron IV: Götterdämmerung include: German Focus Tree : Revised national focuses and alternate historical paths for one of the most played nations in Hearts of Iron IV . These political paths include new monarchist content, a restored democratic Germany and an alternate communist path. More character driven events add flavour to the war’s central player. Austrian Focus Tree: New alternate histories for Austria free of German control, as well as content for surrounding countries that were once part of the Habsburg Empire. There is also a historical path for AI controlled Austria. Hungarian Focus Tree: Rebuild the nation, using technology to overcome manpower shortages. Reform the Austro-Hungarian Empire and forge a powerful, unified faction. Belgian Focus Tree: Resist or welcome German supremacy. Draw on the natural wealth of the Congo and build potential for an African government-in-exile. Congo Focus Tree: Collaborate with Belgium to grow your economy and harness natural resources. Support the Allies or time your independence to follow a Communist, Democratic, or Monarchist path. Special Projects: Build scientific facilities to pursue advanced research in special projects, assigning scientists to further your war effort. Special projects include nuclear physics, advanced aircraft, rocketry, advanced tanks and artillery, naval engineering and electronics. Raids: Attack important enemy targets with carefully planned strikes. Enemy ports, industrial structures, research facilities and special resource collection areas are potential targets for bombing strikes, commando raids or paratroop attacks. And more: Added Landmarks and Dams that are visible on the map. New changes to the use and effectiveness of atomic warfare.

games.short_description: The Second World War’s hardest fighting was on the Eastern Front of Europe. Rival regimes threw men and machines into a bitter struggle through sun and snow, marsh and steppe, and, in the end, the Soviet Union emerged victorious as one of the most powerful nations on earth.

descriptions.en: The Second World War’s hardest fighting was on the Eastern Front of Europe. Rival regimes threw men and machines into a bitter struggle through sun and snow, marsh and steppe, and, in the end, the Soviet Union emerged victorious as one of the most powerful nations on earth.

detailed_descriptions.en: The Second World War’s hardest fighting was on the Eastern Front of Europe. No Step Back is the newest expansion for Hearts of Iron IV, Paradox Interactive’s grand strategy wargame about the world crisis of the 1930s and World War II. This expansion adds greater detail for many nations in Eastern Europe, unique game systems to reflect Soviet politics, and many improvements to the military aspect of the game. Features of Hearts of Iron IV: No Step Back include: New Soviet National Focuses: Communist Soviet rulers must also deal with a government system full of distrust and betrayal but players can lift up party opposition to the powerful leader, or even pursue a reactionary path of restored monarchy. New Polish National Focuses: Write a new history of Poland, with options to reform the government, entrench the military rulers, or support a popular pro-Soviet uprising. New Baltic National Focuses: Shared alternate history paths for Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania, as well as unique paths for each. Army Officer Corps: Build a general staff, drawing on the talents and expertise of available officers to take advantage of changes in technology and tactics. Army Spirits: Emphasize certain characteristics of your military arms, adding general bonuses to certain units types or even aiding division design. Supply System Updates: Scorched Earth tactics, floating harbors and special supply units added to the logistics system. Tank Designer: Design your own armored force using modules prioritizing speed, gun power, armor or even production cost. Railway Guns: Commission the grandest, most prestigious of artillery pieces, uniquely designed to deal with entrenched foes, and fortified positions.

games.name: Expeditions: Rome
games.short_description: Determine the destiny of Rome as you conquer foreign lands and navigate political intrigue in this turn-based RPG. Directly fight with your party of Praetorians, guide your legion to victory, and choose your own path in a story where every decision matters. How will you shape the future of Rome?

descriptions.en: Determine the destiny of Rome as you conquer foreign lands and navigate political intrigue in this turn-based RPG. Directly fight with your party of Praetorians, guide your legion to victory, and choose your own path in a story where every decision matters. How will you shape the future of Rome?

detailed_descriptions.en: The future of Rome is in your hands: what will your legacy be? Take on the role of a young Legatus whose father was murdered by an unknown political opponent, forcing you to escape Rome and take refuge in the military campaign to subdue a Greek rebellion. Step by step, you increase your military prowess, strengthen yourself in the forge of combat, and become the Legatus everyone learns to both respect, and to fear. In Expeditions: Rome, you exert the will of Rome through your actions across the world stage, from the bright blue coasts of Greece to the deep forests of Gaul. Decide how people will view you, and Rome. Will you strike with an iron fist, or speak with a silver tongue? Will you embrace the political heritage of the Republic, or carve your own path as you navigate the complex politics of the Roman Senate? Every choice matters as you decide the fate of your legion, your close companions, and of Rome itself. Create your own Roman Legatus! Customize your character’s look, gender, class, and skills to match your playstyle and role-playing fantasy Engage in tactical turn-based combat powered by an extensive skill-based action system where every weapon changes your potency on the battlefield Adventure with 5 unique companions discovering their extensive backstories and unique personalities Explore a beautifully realized, colorful world across many different environments, including North Africa, Greece, Gaul, and Rome herself Experience a historically inspired story of political intrigue and personal drama through a fully voiced narrative where choices matter and consequences are far-reaching Level-up each character and select from a variety of skills and passive abilities to explore a wide range of tactical options Loot, Craft, and Equip a variety of weapons, armors, and tactical items to customize your game even further, providing a tremendous range of tactical options for each character Lead your legion on 3 extensive war campaigns across Greece, North Africa, and Gaul. Recruit legionaries, improve your warcamp, conquer regions, exploit resources, and defend your territories as you lead your legion to victory

games.name: Expeditions: Samurai
games.short_description: The sun rises on another civil war, as you land in Japan aboard a battered Dutch ship. Thrust into command of its motley crew, you must navigate the politics of Sengoku-era Japan using stealth, diplomacy, or violence in this party-based RPG where every choice matters.

descriptions.en: The sun rises on another civil war, as you land in Japan aboard a battered Dutch ship. Thrust into command of its motley crew, you must navigate the politics of Sengoku-era Japan using stealth, diplomacy, or violence in this party-based RPG where every choice matters.

detailed_descriptions.en: Expeditions: Samurai is an expansive roleplaying game set in our world during real historical events , with an intricate, branching story and a vibrant cast of characters . At every turn, you will be faced with life-or-death choices that will challenge your resolve. Create the character you want to be and choose your own path through history. Even the smallest of your decisions can have far-reaching consequences for yourself, your crew, and - in many cases - the people of Japan. In the year 1600 , the navigator William Adams arrived in Japan. He would soon become the first European granted the title of "Samurai". In Expeditions: Samurai, William Adams never leaves England; you will beat Adams to the punch and sail to Japan aboard the Dutch frigate De Albatros . You arrive in Japan as the newly elected leader of a motley crew of privateers and are quickly swept up in an ongoing civil war that is nearing its climax. Navigate the politics, intrigue, and drama of feudal Japan as you and your crew catch the attention of powerful warlords whose struggle will determine the future of the nation. Every crewmate has their own story to uncover - if you manage to earn their trust . Build your relationship with each companion into a meaningful friendship, a lifelong rivalry, or possibly even a new love . Outnumbered but never outgunned, engage your enemies on your own terms in a fast and freeing turn-based combat system where movement, attacks, and interruptions can all play out simultaneously. Use stealth and clever gadgets to toy with your opponents. Split up your team to position them in real-time and set up devastating ambushes. Utilize a vast array of weapons and abilities to maintain the upper hand - from mainstays of the pirate arsenal to iconic Japanese weapons. Craft your own items and experiment with different loadouts to survive deadly and diverse enemies. For the first time ever in an Expeditions game, experience the tense combat and deeply branching narrative of Expeditions: Samurai in drop-in/drop-out co-op . Play in single-player as your own Captain Flynn, or invite your friend and play as a pair of twins. In co-op, talking to characters at the same time lets you wrestle for control of important decisions or compete for a companion's affections. Coordinate sneak attacks or clever combat maneuvers ; throw a distracting firecracker at just the right time to let your partner sneak past a sentry, or execute a flawlessly timed double stealth takedown .

detailed_descriptions.en: The boffins down at the Exploding Kittens® Emporium have made an incredible discovery. It turns out, if you add kitty chaos to meowing mayhem, you get CAT-ASTROPHIC CARNAGE. (Side effects include dreadful feline-based puns. Bear with us.) Now you too can experience ungodly levels of pandemonium with the Explosive Expansions Pass! This epic pass grants Exploding Kittens® 2 Superfans access to three huge expansions. Layer even more havoc upon the bedlam already available in the base game – why yes, we ARE running out of synonyms for “chaos” at this stage! Imploding Kittens Expansion: The Imploding Kittens Expansion introduces a new level of strategy and peril to the game. Imploding Kitten Card: Unlike the Exploding Kittens, this card doesn’t eliminate you immediately. Instead, it’s placed back into the deck face up, creating a ticking time bomb that all players must avoid. When drawn again, it causes instant elimination. New Card Types: Discover new strategies with cards like ‘Reverse’, which changes the direction of play, and ‘Alter the Future’, allowing players to peek at and rearrange the top three cards of the deck. Streaking Kittens Expansion: The Streaking Kittens Expansion adds an awesome new ability to the game – holding onto an Exploding Kitten card! Streaking Kitten Card: With this daring card in hand, when you draw an Exploding Kitten card, you can hold it in your hand without going up in flames! But if someone steals it from you, they won’t be so lucky… New Decks: Discover the Streaking Kittens deck, or ramp up the risk with the Danger Mode deck! Alternatively, chain up a ridiculous number of Attack cards with the Attack of the Attacks deck. Barking Kittens Expansion: Rounding out the Explosive Expansions Pass is the Barking Kittens Expansion! Add a sneaky game of chicken to your next match… Barking Kitten Card: When you play this card, whoever is holding the other Barking Kitten card explodes! But if no one has its counterpart yet…you just made yourself a target… Even More Decks: An incredible eleven new decks! From decks built around seeing the future to decks rigged with unnecessarily aggressive cards, this expansion delivers epic matches by the fistful! INCLUDES: IMPLODING KITTENS EXPANSION – Adds new cards, mechanics and increases the player limit. STREAKING KITTENS EXPANSION – Adds new cards, mechanics and three decks. BARKING KITTENS EXPANSION – Adds new cards, mechanics and eleven decks. Get ready for CAT-ASTROPHIC CARNAGE with the Explosive Expansions Pass today!

games.name: EXSTETRA
games.short_description: The only way to save the world is a kiss——. 《EXSTETRA》 is a fantasy RPG set in “Amazia,” a Tokyo fused with another world and burdened with a doomed fate, where you rise as the chosen savior, a “Prisma,” to confront the threat of the world’s destruction.

descriptions.en: The only way to save the world is a kiss——. 《EXSTETRA》 is a fantasy RPG set in “Amazia,” a Tokyo fused with another world and burdened with a doomed fate, where you rise as the chosen savior, a “Prisma,” to confront the threat of the world’s destruction.

detailed_descriptions.en: A fantasy RPG where a kiss saves the world. EXSTETRA is set in “Amazea,” a Tokyo fused with another world and fated for destruction. It tells the story of Ryoma, a high school student who rises as the chosen savior, a “Prisma,” to confront the coming end of the world. Along the way, Ryoma discovers candidates to become “Prisma Knights,” who share the same destiny of saving the world. By awakening them with his kiss, he sets out on an adventure together with his companions. ◆ STORY ◆ Just kiss—— Kiss is the only way to save two worlds destined for ruin. Set in Amazia, a land fused with another world and fated for destruction, this is the story of Ryouma, who becomes the chosen savior, a “Prisma,” and throws himself into a battle to save two worlds from the brink of annihilation. Find the companions who have also been drawn into Amazia from the real world, and awaken their power as Prisma Knights through a kiss. The only way to save the world is a kiss—— ◆ WORLD ◆ The story takes place in “Amazia,” a Tokyo fused with another world and is burdened with a doomed fate. This beautiful yet decadent world is brought to life through the artwork by tokyogenso. Witness for yourself the transformed city such as Shibuya and Akihabara, now merged with another world. ◆ DUNGEON ◆ Across the districts of Tokyo fused with another world, labyrinths unlike anything in the real world await. Inside the dungeons, various exploration elements await you, including battles against monsters, gimmicks blocking your path, treasure chests to discover, and materials and items to gather. Collect equipment and items, strengthen your party, and aim for the deepest reaches of each labyrinth. ◆ BATTLE ◆ The only way to save the world is a kiss——! Fight against the world’s destruction together with the Prisma Knights. Battles in this title use a turn-based command battle system. Form a party of up to four characters, choose their front-row and back-row positions, and select the skills they use in battle. Build your strategy around enemy traits and the flow of battle, and enjoy highly tactical combat. The auto-battle function also allows you to progress through battles at a faster pace. ・EXS（Special Attacks） As the savior “Prisma,” the protagonist is the only one capable of absorbing “EXS,” the source of power in this world, by defeating enemies. The EXS he absorbs can be shared with his allies, the Prisma Knights, through a kiss, awakening their power. detailed_descriptions_html.en:
A fantasy RPG where a kiss saves the world.

EXSTETRA is set in “Amazea,” a Tokyo fused with another world and fated for destruction.

It tells the story of Ryoma, a high school student who rises as the chosen savior, a “Prisma,” to confront the coming end of the world.

Along the way, Ryoma discovers candidates to become “Prisma Knights,” who share the same destiny of saving the world. By awakening them with his kiss, he sets out on an adventure together with his companions.

◆ STORY ◆

Just kiss——

Kiss is the only way to save two worlds destined for ruin.

Set in Amazia, a land fused with another world and fated for destruction, this is the story of Ryouma, who becomes the chosen savior, a “Prisma,” and throws himself into a battle to save two worlds from the brink of annihilation.

Find the companions who have also been drawn into Amazia from the real world, and awaken their power as Prisma Knights through a kiss.

The only way to save the world is a kiss——

◆ WORLD ◆

The story takes place in “Amazia,” a Tokyo fused with another world and is burdened with a doomed fate.

This beautiful yet decadent world is brought to life through the artwork by tokyogenso.

Witness for yourself the transformed city such as Shibuya and Akihabara, now merged with another world.

◆ DUNGEON ◆

Across the districts of Tokyo fused with another world, labyrinths unlike anything in the real world await.

Inside the dungeons, various exploration elements await you, including battles against monsters, gimmicks blocking your path, treasure chests to discover, and materials and items to gather.

Collect equipment and items, strengthen your party, and aim for the deepest reaches of each labyrinth.

◆ BATTLE ◆

The only way to save the world is a kiss——!
Fight against the world’s destruction together with the Prisma Knights.

Battles in this title use a turn-based command battle system.
Form a party of up to four characters, choose their front-row and back-row positions, and select the skills they use in battle.
Build your strategy around enemy traits and the flow of battle, and enjoy highly tactical combat.

The auto-battle function also allows you to progress through battles at a faster pace.

・EXS（Special Attacks）

As the savior “Prisma,” the protagonist is the only one capable of absorbing “EXS,” the source of power in this world, by defeating enemies.

The EXS he absorbs can be shared with his allies, the Prisma Knights, through a kiss, awakening their power.

Release EXS through a kiss with your companions and unleash powerful special attacks known as “EXS Arts.”

・Party Formation and Affection

Up to four members can participate in battle.
Your formation, including companions waiting in reserve, plays an important role depending on the situation.

Your relationships with companions can also affect battle, so deepen your bonds not only with your favorite Prisma Knights, but with a variety of allies.

・Enchanting

By combining skills found on weapons, armor, and accessories, you can greatly expand your battle options, including attacks and support effects.

Gather materials, refine your skill setup, and challenge powerful enemies with your own strategy.

*This product was developed based on 《EXSTETRA》, originally released in 2013. Some specifications differ from the original version.

games.name: EZ2ON REBOOT : R
games.short_description: EZ2ON REBOOT : R – The latest entry in the beloved rhythm-action franchise is now released on Steam! Revisit the huge collection of classics with remastered audiovisual. Catch up with the freshest new songs and experiences.

descriptions.en: EZ2ON REBOOT : R – The latest entry in the beloved rhythm-action franchise is now released on Steam! Revisit the huge collection of classics with remastered audiovisual. Catch up with the freshest new songs and experiences.

detailed_descriptions.en: A rhythm-action game for everyone. 『EZ2ON REBOOT : R』 is a vertical rhythm-action game. Become a live performer of various songs. You have to press the key to complete the sound. The base game includes over 250 songs, the biggest in terms of volume in the franchise history. From old-time classics to unconventional twists on the existing genre, EZ2ON covers a broad range of musical tastes. ◆ Rhythm-action for everyone EZ2ON is designed to be an accessible rhythm-action game to the core. Anyone can easily adapt, groove to the music, and enjoy the gameplay. Why not give it a shot? Intuitive yet diverse styles of four key modes, 4K · 5K · 6K · 8K, are available. And each key mode provides four different difficulties per song, assisting the players in improving their skills. Does this kind of game feel a bit overwhelming? Or, are you familiar with other rhythm-action games? Start with 'BASIC' mode that everyone can enjoy without being stressed out. Do you want to know how skillful you are? Do you enjoy a more competitive experience? 'STANDARD' mode has much more strict timing requirements. On top of that, your skill is evaluated via Rating system. 'COURSE' mode is also available where you can play a sequence of songs non-stop. Each course is carefully curated and designed by the devs. ◆ Looking for some 'EZ2'? Glad you're in the right place. We have gathered everything in the franchise and put them into EZ2ON REBOOT : R. Remember the 99's hit 〈Stay〉? The infamous boss song from the 'EZ2ON REBOOT(2013)' 〈KAMUI 〉? Everything you loved is here with remastered audiovisual. Treat yourself to a 16:9 HD visual experience and a newly designed audio mix. You get instant access to the contents without any need for game progression. Buy it and play it. Simple as that. ◆ Is this your first time seeing 'EZ2'? Don't worry if you're not familiar with EZ2ON franchise. All the songs that you love are already here. Such as... 'Brain Power', 'PUPA', 'Air', 'MilK', 'The Formula', 'GOODTEK', 'METATRON', 'The Last Page', and more! ◆ Fully customizable gameplay Tons of game-related options are readily available. Discover your own optimal settings using the 'LIVE CONTROL' feature. Save the gameplay configuration and load it back anytime you want. For advanced players, NVIDIA Reflex and ASIO are also available. ◆ We play this game, make this game, love this game. We are highly experienced rhythm-action game developers from diverse professional backgrounds. But after all, we are just rhythm-action enthusiasts. EZ2ON TEAM plays the game on a daily basis not only for playtest purposes but also to just appreciate the experience. As rhythm-action game veterans with over 20 years of gaming experience, we deliver what we want to see in this game based on your feedback. Our journey has just begun. Join us here, 『EZ2ON REBOOT : R』.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
A rhythm-action game for everyone.


『EZ2ON REBOOT : R』 is a vertical rhythm-action game. Become a live performer of various songs. You have to press the key to complete the sound.

The base game includes over 250 songs, the biggest in terms of volume in the franchise history.
From old-time classics to unconventional twists on the existing genre, EZ2ON covers a broad range of musical tastes.

◆ Rhythm-action for everyone
EZ2ON is designed to be an accessible rhythm-action game to the core. Anyone can easily adapt, groove to the music, and enjoy the gameplay. Why not give it a shot?

Intuitive yet diverse styles of four key modes, 4K · 5K · 6K · 8K, are available. And each key mode provides four different difficulties per song, assisting the players in improving their skills.

Does this kind of game feel a bit overwhelming? Or, are you familiar with other rhythm-action games?
Start with 'BASIC' mode that everyone can enjoy without being stressed out.

Do you want to know how skillful you are? Do you enjoy a more competitive experience?
'STANDARD' mode has much more strict timing requirements. On top of that, your skill is evaluated via Rating system.

'COURSE' mode is also available where you can play a sequence of songs non-stop. Each course is carefully curated and designed by the devs.

◆ Looking for some 'EZ2'? Glad you're in the right place.
We have gathered everything in the franchise and put them into EZ2ON REBOOT : R.
Remember the 99's hit 〈Stay〉? The infamous boss song from the 'EZ2ON REBOOT(2013)' 〈KAMUI 〉? Everything you loved is here with remastered audiovisual. Treat yourself to a 16:9 HD visual experience and a newly designed audio mix.
You get instant access to the contents without any need for game progression. Buy it and play it. Simple as that.

◆ Is this your first time seeing 'EZ2'?
Don't worry if you're not familiar with EZ2ON franchise.
All the songs that you love are already here. Such as...
'Brain Power', 'PUPA', 'Air', 'MilK', 'The Formula', 'GOODTEK', 'METATRON', 'The Last Page', and more!

◆ Fully customizable gameplay
Tons of game-related options are readily available. Discover your own optimal settings using the 'LIVE CONTROL' feature.
Save the gameplay configuration and load it back anytime you want.
For advanced players, NVIDIA Reflex and ASIO are also available.

◆ We play this game, make this game, love this game.
We are highly experienced rhythm-action game developers from diverse professional backgrounds. But after all, we are just rhythm-action enthusiasts. EZ2ON TEAM plays the game on a daily basis not only for playtest purposes but also to just appreciate the experience. As rhythm-action game veterans with over 20 years of gaming experience, we deliver what we want to see in this game based on your feedback.

Our journey has just begun. Join us here, 『EZ2ON REBOOT : R』.

detailed_descriptions.en: Rewrite The Grid with the ultimate evolution in racing: EA SPORTS™ F1® 25: 2026 Season Edition. Get F1® 25 and the 2026 Season Pack in one bundle for the most complete Formula One® experience. Race through the action-packed 2025 season, then step into a new era with the groundbreaking 2026 cars, the next generation of Grand Prix™ racing. All New Teams: Two new teams join the 2026 grid; Audi, taking over Sauber, and Cadillac, marking the arrival of the first major American car manufacturer in Formula 1. New Driver Lineups: Race against the latest driver lineups. Racing Bulls welcomes Arvid Lindblad alongside Liam Lawson, Isack Hadjar joins Max Verstappen at Oracle Red Bull Racing, and fan favorites Valtteri Bottas and Sergio Pérez headline Cadillac’s entry. New Track: Get ready to race at MADRING†, the first new F1® circuit since 2023. Set in Madrid, this hybrid street and purpose-built track will challenge you in high-speed action across 5.4 km and 22 adrenaline-filled corners. New Cars and Regulations††: Feel the thrill of the 2026 F1® grid and get behind the wheel of lighter, smaller cars with cutting-edge active aerodynamics for a more responsive drive, whether you're using a gamepad or a wheel. These next-gen cars, enhanced by F1® 25's improved physics, offer exhilarating racing for both seasoned pros and newcomers ready to conquer the new F1® era. Leave your mark on the world of racing in F1® 25, the official video game of the 2025 FIA Formula One World Championship™ Konnersport's Legacy: For the first time ever, extend your Konnersport experience in Career & My Team Modes Design your own Team: Enhance both My Team and F1® World cars and create liveries that are more reflective of Formula One® as you customize driver numbers and move, scale, or rotate logos Accurate LIDAR Circuits: Experience 5 rebuilt tracks, including fan-favorite Suzuka with laser-scanned models of the real venues New Online Co-op Events: Brand new multiplayer mode in F1® World, where you and your friends race as a squad against AI drivers And more: New cinematics, updated podium scenes, and Reverse Tracks on select circuits This game includes optional in-game purchases of virtual currency that can be used to acquire virtual in-game items. Custom teams and career saves from the 2025 season do not transfer to 2026 season. Konnersport or APXGP teams cannot be added to the 2026 season of Driver Career or My Team. †MADRING circuit can only be driven with 2026 cars. ††Some final car models will release in a post-launch update; internet connection required.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Rewrite The Grid with the ultimate evolution in racing: EA SPORTS™ F1® 25: 2026 Season Edition. Get F1® 25 and the 2026 Season Pack in one bundle for the most complete Formula One® experience. Race through the action-packed 2025 season, then step into a new era with the groundbreaking 2026 cars, the next generation of Grand Prix™ racing.

  • All New Teams: Two new teams join the 2026 grid; Audi, taking over Sauber, and Cadillac, marking the arrival of the first major American car manufacturer in Formula 1.

  • New Driver Lineups: Race against the latest driver lineups. Racing Bulls welcomes Arvid Lindblad alongside Liam Lawson, Isack Hadjar joins Max Verstappen at Oracle Red Bull Racing, and fan favorites Valtteri Bottas and Sergio Pérez headline Cadillac’s entry.

  • New Track: Get ready to race at MADRING†, the first new F1® circuit since 2023. Set in Madrid, this hybrid street and purpose-built track will challenge you in high-speed action across 5.4 km and 22 adrenaline-filled corners.

  • New Cars and Regulations††: Feel the thrill of the 2026 F1® grid and get behind the wheel of lighter, smaller cars with cutting-edge active aerodynamics for a more responsive drive, whether you're using a gamepad or a wheel. These next-gen cars, enhanced by F1® 25's improved physics, offer exhilarating racing for both seasoned pros and newcomers ready to conquer the new F1® era.

Leave your mark on the world of racing in F1® 25, the official video game of the 2025 FIA Formula One World Championship™

  • Konnersport's Legacy: For the first time ever, extend your Konnersport experience in Career & My Team Modes

  • Design your own Team: Enhance both My Team and F1® World cars and create liveries that are more reflective of Formula One® as you customize driver numbers and move, scale, or rotate logos

  • Accurate LIDAR Circuits: Experience 5 rebuilt tracks, including fan-favorite Suzuka with laser-scanned models of the real venues

  • New Online Co-op Events: Brand new multiplayer mode in F1® World, where you and your friends race as a squad against AI drivers

  • And more: New cinematics, updated podium scenes, and Reverse Tracks on select circuits

This game includes optional in-game purchases of virtual currency that can be used to acquire virtual in-game items.

Custom teams and career saves from the 2025 season do not transfer to 2026 season. Konnersport or APXGP teams cannot be added to the 2026 season of Driver Career or My Team.

†MADRING circuit can only be driven with 2026 cars.
††Some final car models will release in a post-launch update; internet connection required.

descriptions.en: This additional content pack contains 11 full outfits, 14 weapons and the Lion's Head Helmet.

detailed_descriptions.en: This additional content pack contains 11 full outfits, 14 weapons and the Lion's Head Helmet. Obsidian Armour After years of using Obsidian for weapons, one entrepreneurial Blacksmith known as Smithy decided to craft armour with the material instead. This is the prototype that he created, and due to an unfortunate encounter with a Rock Troll was never able to see his work finished.
