games.short_description: Face unpredictable dangers, fight perilous fires with your crew, and save lives in Firefighting Simulator: Ignite. Step into the boots of a U.S. firefighter and play with up to 3 friends or with the help of your NPC controlled crew members.

descriptions.en: Face unpredictable dangers, fight perilous fires with your crew, and save lives in Firefighting Simulator: Ignite. Step into the boots of a U.S. firefighter and play with up to 3 friends or with the help of your NPC controlled crew members.
descriptions.zh-Hant: 在《Firefighting Simulator: Ignite》面對難以預料的危險、與隊員一起撲滅險惡的火勢，並拯救人命。化身美國消防員，與最多 3 名好友一起遊玩，或由 NPC 協助控制隊員。
descriptions.ja: 『Firefighting Simulator: Ignite』で、予測不能な危険に対峙し、隊員とともに恐ろしい火災と闘い、命を救いましょう。アメリカの消防士になりきり、最大3名のフレンドと、あるいはNPCの隊員たちの力を借りてプレイできます。
descriptions.ko: Firefighting Simulator: Ignite에서 미국 소방관으로 거듭나 최대 3명의 친구 또는 NPC 대원과 함께 힘을 합쳐 예측 불가능한 위험과 화재에 맞서 싸우며 생명을 구조하세요.

detailed_descriptions.en: UNITED AGAINST FIRE. Face unpredictable dangers head-on, fight perilous fires with your crew, and save lives in Firefighting Simulator: Ignite. Step into the boots of a U.S. firefighter in a sprawling city in the American Midwest, where every mission pushes your skills to the limit. Experience the rush of firefighting in stunning visual quality in an intuitive and cooperative multiplayer mode with 3 friends or with the help of your NPC controlled crew. Battle raging and dynamic flames, heat, and smoke – all simulated in real time. Cutting-edge physics & graphics systems powered by Unreal Engine 5 let you experience firefighting immersion like never before. Over your career, you deal with a range of challenging situations, like trapped civilians, electric fires, flammable liquids, grease fires, backdrafts, flashovers, and explosions. Equip yourself with authentic firefighting tools, including fire hoses, saws, Halligan tools, axes, and extinguishers, and use faithfully recreated fire engines and ladder trucks. Use the right tactics and methods with precision to put out blazing flames. Each mission requires real-life firefighting strategies, such as ventilating to curb fire spread, cooling down overheated objects, sawing through obstacles, reducing air drafts, and selecting the proper extinguishing agent. But stay alert for signs of imminent danger, like thick smoke finding its way through closed doors and presenting the potential for a major disaster. But don’t worry: you can learn how to fight fire and the use your tools properly back at the fire station hub, which serves as your headquarters between emergency operations. Relax between missions, inspect the large vehicle fleet that includes faithfully recreated trucks from Rosenbauer, and choose your next assignment. So, when the emergency call comes in, make sure you get the job done by taking the shortest route to the emergency scene, fighting the fires, and saving lives together. EVERYDAY HERO: Step into the boots of a U.S. firefighter IGNITE YOUR PASSION: fight perilous fires in single- and multiplayer mode TEAMWORK: 4-player coop mode UNITED AGAINST FIRE: Assemble your squad with an NPC crew when in single-player mode AUTHENTICITY: Use equipment from leading U.S. firefighting brands, such as HAIX®, Fire-Dex and STIHL QUICK RESPONSE: Drive faithfully reproduced, licensed Rosenbauer America fire trucks, such as the TP3® Pumper, Viper®, 68' Roadrunner, and more YOUR CAREER: Choose between 8 characters and different outfit sets FIRESTATION: Your hub for learning techniques and choosing your next emergency mission(s). SIMULATION: Realistic fire, heat, water, and smoke simulation with the Unreal Engine 5 physics engine PC MODDING: Create modding missions and share and play them over Mod io CONSOLE MODDING: Download and play new modding missions from the Mod io hub
detailed_descriptions.zh-Hant: 一起團結打火。在《Firefighting Simulator: Ignite》面對難以預料的危險、與隊員一起撲滅險惡的火勢並拯救人命。在美國中西部的繁華城市中化身美國消防員，這裡的每場任務都將充分考驗您的技術。可在操作直觀的多人合作模式中與最多 3 名好友一起遊玩或由 NPC 協助控制隊員，體驗絢麗畫質下十萬火急的打火緊迫感。撲滅瞬息萬變的劇烈火勢、高溫和濃煙，皆由 Unreal Engine 5 支援的頂尖物理與圖像系統即時模擬，讓您以前所未有的方式體驗身歷其境的打火過程。 在職涯中，應對各種棘手情況，例如受困的市民、電器火災、易燃液體、油類火災、復燃、閃燃和爆炸。裝備貨真價實的消防工具，例如滅火水帶、鋸子、三叉撬棒、斧頭或滅火器，使用真實重現的消防車和雲梯車。準確運用適當的策略和方式來撲滅大火。每項任務都需要現實中的滅火策略，例如通風以減少火勢蔓延、冷卻過熱的物體、鋸穿障礙物、減少氣流、選擇適合的滅火劑等等。但仍要隨時警戒迫在眉睫的危險徵兆：例如濃煙穿過緊閉的門有可能引發嚴重災情。 不過別擔心：您可以在消防中心學習滅火和適當使用工具的方式，並且這裡同時也是緊急行動的總部。在非任務期間休息放鬆、仔細觀摩大型車隊，包括真實重現的 Rosenbauer 消防車，並選擇下一項勤務。 當求救電話打來時，就以最短路線前往救災來完成工作，一起撲滅火勢並拯救寶貴性命。 日常生活的英雄：化身美國消防員 燃起您的熱情：在單人和多人模式中對抗無情大火 團隊合作：4 人合作模式 一起團結打火：在單人模式與 NPC 隊員作伙組成隊伍 真實還原：使用美國頂級消防品牌的器材，例如 HAIX®、Fire-Dex、STIHL 迅速應變：駕駛真實重現的 Rosenbauer America 授權消防車，例如 TP3® Pumper、Viper®、68' Roadrunner 等等 個人職涯：有 8 名角色和不同套裝可選擇 消防局：學習技術和選擇下一項緊急任務的中心 模擬：由 Unreal Engine 5 物理引擎呈現的真實火焰、高溫、水和煙霧模擬 PC 模組製作：建立模組任務並透過 Mod io 分享與遊玩 主機模組製作：從 Mod io 中心下載並遊玩新的模組任務
detailed_descriptions.ja: UNITED AGAINST FIRE. 『Firefighting Simulator: Ignite』で、予測不能な危険に真正面から対峙し、隊員とともに恐ろしい火災と闘い、命を救いましょう。アメリカ中西部の広大な都市の消防士になりきって、限界までスキルを要求するあらゆるミッションをこなすのです。3名のフレンドと直感的な協力プレイが楽しめるマルチプレイヤーモードで、またはNPCの隊員たちの力を借りて、圧倒的なクオリティのビジュアルとともに消火活動の醍醐味を味わいましょう。闘わなければならない激しくダイナミックな炎、熱、煙はすべて、Unreal Engine 5の最先端の物理演算およびグラフィックシステムによってリアルタイムでシミュレーションされ、これまでに経験したこのことのない迫真的な消防体験に没入することができます。 消防士の仕事を通じて、逃げ遅れた市民、電気火災、引火性液体、油火災、バックドラフト、フラッシュオーバー、爆発などのさまざまな難しい状況に対処しましょう。消防ホース、ノコギリ、ハリガンツール、斧、消火器などのリアルな消防装備を準備し、忠実に再現された消防車やハシゴ車を使いこなします。燃え盛る炎を鎮火するためには、適切な戦術と手段を選ばなければなりません。どのミッションも、実戦さながらの消火戦術が必要です。延焼を抑えるために換気したり、過熱したものを冷やしたり、ノコギリで障害物を切断したり、空気の流入を減らしたり、適切な消火剤を選んだり…。同時に、差し迫った危険の兆候を見逃さないよう警戒してください。閉ざされたドアから煙が漏れ出ているような場合は、大災害の可能性があります。 でも、心配無用です。緊急作戦の司令部として機能する消防署ハブで消火の方法や装備の適切な使い方を学ぶことができます。ミッションの合間にはリラックスして、忠実に再現されたローゼンバウアー製の消防車を含む大型の消防車両をじっくりと見物したり、次の任務を選んだりしましょう。 そして緊急通報が入ったら、緊急事態の現場まで最短のルートで駆け付け、消火と人命救助を行って仕事を片付けましょう。 暮らしのヒーロー：アメリカの消防士になりきろう 情熱に火をつけろ：シングルプレイヤーまたはマルチプレイヤーモードで恐ろしい火災と闘おう チームワーク：プレイヤー4人の協力モード UNITED AGAINST FIRE：シングルプレイヤーモードではNPCの隊員で自分の部隊を作ろう リアルさを追求：HAIX®、Fire-Dex、STIHL、など、アメリカの消防業界の有名ブランドの装備が使える 素早く対応：TP3®、Pumper、Viper®、68' Roadrunnerなど、忠実に再現されたRosenbauer America公認の消防車を運転しよう キャリアを選択：8人のキャラクターやさまざまな衣装を選択できる 消防署：ハブとなる消防署で技術を学び、次の緊急ミッションを選ぼう シミュレーション：Unreal Engine 5の物理演算システムでリアルな炎、熱、水、煙をシミュレーション PC用MOD：ミッションのMODを作成してMod ioで共有・プレイしよう コンソール用MOD：Mod ioから新しいMODのミッションをダウンロードしてプレイしよう
detailed_descriptions.ko: 힘을 합쳐 화재를 진압하라. Firefighting Simulator: Ignite에서 다양한 미국 중서부 도시의 소방관으로 거듭나 대원들과 함께 힘을 합쳐 자신의 한계를 시험하는 예측 불가능한 위험과 화재에 맞서 싸우며 생명을 구조하세요. 직관적인 협동 멀티플레이어 모드에서 3명의 친구 또는 NPC 대원과 함께 놀라운 그래픽으로 구현된 화재 진압 현장을 경험하세요. Unreal Engine 5 기반의 최첨단 물리 및 그래픽 시스템이 실시간으로 구현하는 맹렬한 불길과 열기, 연기에 맞서며 전에 없는 방식으로 소방 활동에 푹 빠져보세요. 경력을 쌓아가며 고립된 시민, 전기 화재, 가연성 액체, 기름으로 인한 화재, 백드래프트, 섬락, 폭발 등 다양한 상황에 도전하세요. 소방용 호스, 전기톱, 할리건 장비, 도끼, 소화기 등 실제와 같이 구현된 소방 도구로 무장하고 충실한 고증을 바탕으로 구현된 소방차와 사다리차를 활용하세요. 적절한 소방 전략을 정확하게 수행해 격렬한 화마를 제압하세요. 임무마다 환기를 통한 화재 확산 방지, 과열된 물체 냉각, 장애물 제거, 공기 흐름 감소, 올바른 소화 약제 선택 등 실전과 같은 화재 진압 전략이 필요합니다. 그리고 닫힌 문을 뚫고 들어오는 엄청난 양의 연기처럼 대형 참사를 유발할 수 있는 현장의 위험 요소도 항상 주의하세요. 하지만 너무 걱정할 필요는 없습니다. 평상시 소방서에서 올바른 화재 진압 방법과 장비 사용법을 배울 수 있으니까요. 임무가 없을 때는 휴식을 취하며 충실하게 재현된 Rosenbauer 소방차를 둘러보고 다음 임무를 선택하세요. 그러면 긴급 신고가 접수됐을 때 가장 빠른 경로로 현장에 도착해 화재를 진압하고 대원들과 함께 사람들을 구할 수 있습니다. 일상생활 속 영웅: 미국 소방관으로 거듭나세요 불타는 열정: 싱글플레이어 또는 멀티플레이어 모드에서 맹렬한 화재에 맞서 싸우세요 팀워크: 4인 협동 모드 힘을 합쳐 화재를 진압: 싱글플레이어 모드에서는 NPC 대원들과 힘을 합치세요 충실한 고증: HAIX®, Fire-Dex, STIHL, 등 미국을 대표하는 소방 장비를 사용해 보세요 신속 대응: TP3® Pumper, Viper®, 68' Roadrunner 등 라이선스를 받아 현실과 똑같이 구현된 Rosenbauer America 소방차를 운전하세요 소방관 커리어: 8가지 캐릭터와 다양한 소방관복 세트 중에서 선택하세요 소방서: 화재 진압 실력을 키우고 다음 긴급 임무를 선택하세요. 시뮬레이션: Unreal Engine 5 물리 엔진을 기반으로 불길, 열기, 물, 연기가 실제와 같이 구현되었습니다 PC 모딩: 모딩 미션을 만든 후 Mod io를 통해 공유하며 플레이하세요 콘솔 모딩: Mod io 허브에서 새로운 모딩 미션을 다운로드해 플레이하세요

games.short_description: Share your thoughts and discover those shared by others, in Fireside Feelings. Gather around the welcoming warmth of the campfire and take part in conversations between real people separated in space and time. Sometimes, we all need a good talk under the stars.

descriptions.en: Share your thoughts and discover those shared by others, in Fireside Feelings. Gather around the welcoming warmth of the campfire and take part in conversations between real people separated in space and time. Sometimes, we all need a good talk under the stars.

detailed_descriptions.en: Fireside Feelings is a mental wellness experience that promotes empathy, connection, and positivity among players. So grab a blanket, your favourite hoody, and a nice beverage and come chat around the campfire. “Do your childhood dreams still echo in who you’ve become?” “Do you prefer to cook food, or have someone cook food for you?” Share your thoughts on a range of topics - sometimes sweet, sometimes profound - to help create a rich and meaningful tapestry of thoughts and feelings that are personal and authentic. Unlock objects to furnish your campfire, and make it your place to stop and take a breath. Share experiences, express your emotions, and be a part of a caring community. Conversations are with real people, but are not live, and there is no direct interaction with others. Discover their thoughts at your own pace. Answers are moderated and filtered to ensure your safety. Content warnings can be set according to your preferences so certain topics are avoided.

games.name: First Class Trouble
games.short_description: First Class Trouble is a party game where players must work together and against each other to survive a disaster. The goal is to shut down a deadly A.I. Some players are impostors, secretly playing as human-looking killer robots intent on betraying the other players.

descriptions.en: First Class Trouble is a party game where players must work together and against each other to survive a disaster. The goal is to shut down a deadly A.I. Some players are impostors, secretly playing as human-looking killer robots intent on betraying the other players.

detailed_descriptions.en: First Class Trouble is a party game where players must work together and against each other to survive a disaster. Whether you play as one of the human Residents or the rebellious Personoids, you will have to use your wit (and the occasional flying champagne bottle) to stay alive. In First Class Trouble you either deceive or deduce your way to victory in a charming, yet unsettling and often mischievous environment. Whether you do it sober or with a slight buzz, First Class Trouble will serve you a dangerous cocktail of difficult decisions and whacky possibilities. The goal is to shut down the Central Artificial Intelligence Network, also known as CAIN, of the luxurious intergalactic cruise ship ISS Alithea before it and its loyal Personoids take control of the ship. Collect information about the passengers and deduce who you can trust and who to avoid. Collaborate with your fellow residents to eliminate the suspected Personoids before engaging in the shutdown of CAIN. Lie, disrupt and deceive your way through the ship among the residents to either reach CAIN and unleash its full potential or kill off the remaining residents to secure control of the vessel. Use your unique skills to communicate and navigate the ship in the shadows and kill off residents when they pose a threat to your identity. Aboard the ISS Alithea, the customization possibilities are endless. Shop for new clothes and accessories in the onboard mall using your hard-earned Infinity Coins. Use your spare cash to pimp that Vruumba (Trademark not pending) of yours! The ISS Alithea is the ultimate playground for happy accidents. Explore new ways to eliminate both friend and foe in each level. Environmental hazards such as fires, bad wiring and poorly hanging chandeliers can all be used to get rid of your fellow passengers when you find it convenient. Interact with your fellow residents and personoids in unlimited, physicalized ways. Whack your friend to the end of the pool with the racket or simply nudge that foe into the fire and look away for a while. • Enhance social deduction and interactions through in-game proximity based voice chat, ingame text chat and emote wheel functionality • Several levels with unique themes and styles, along with items & interactions specific for them • Play with 4-12 players in custom games and standard games with 6 players

In First Class Trouble you either deceive or deduce your way to victory in a charming, yet unsettling and often mischievous environment. Whether you do it sober or with a slight buzz, First Class Trouble will serve you a dangerous cocktail of difficult decisions and whacky possibilities.

The goal is to shut down the Central Artificial Intelligence Network, also known as CAIN, of the luxurious intergalactic cruise ship ISS Alithea before it and its loyal Personoids take control of the ship.

Collect information about the passengers and deduce who you can trust and who to avoid. Collaborate with your fellow residents to eliminate the suspected Personoids before engaging in the shutdown of CAIN.

Lie, disrupt and deceive your way through the ship among the residents to either reach CAIN and unleash its full potential or kill off the remaining residents to secure control of the vessel. Use your unique skills to communicate and navigate the ship in the shadows and kill off residents when they pose a threat to your identity.

Aboard the ISS Alithea, the customization possibilities are endless. Shop for new clothes and accessories in the onboard mall using your hard-earned Infinity Coins. Use your spare cash to pimp that Vruumba (Trademark not pending) of yours!

The ISS Alithea is the ultimate playground for happy accidents. Explore new ways to eliminate both friend and foe in each level. Environmental hazards such as fires, bad wiring and poorly hanging chandeliers can all be used to get rid of your fellow passengers when you find it convenient.

Interact with your fellow residents and personoids in unlimited, physicalized ways. Whack your friend to the end of the pool with the racket or simply nudge that foe into the fire and look away for a while.

• Enhance social deduction and interactions through in-game proximity based voice chat, ingame text chat and emote wheel functionality

• Several levels with unique themes and styles, along with items & interactions specific for them

• Play with 4-12 players in custom games and standard games with 6 players

games.name: Fishing: North Atlantic - Enhanced Edition
games.short_description: Commercial fishing in North Atlantic! Discover majestic world of Canadian Nova Scotia while admiring the vast diversity of ocean life. Search for the ocean gold with upgradable fishing boats and various fishing gear as you progress in your fisherman career.

descriptions.en: Commercial fishing in North Atlantic! Discover majestic world of Canadian Nova Scotia while admiring the vast diversity of ocean life. Search for the ocean gold with upgradable fishing boats and various fishing gear as you progress in your fisherman career.
descriptions.zh-Hant: 北大西洋商業捕魚！探索加拿大新斯科細亞省的宏偉景觀，讚嘆龐大的海洋生物多樣性。隨著你的漁夫生涯資歷，利用各種可升級的漁船和不同漁具搜尋海洋黃金。
descriptions.ja: 北大西洋での商業漁業！海の生き物の多様性に見惚れながら、カナダ・ノバスコシア州の雄大な世界へ飛び込みましょう。アップグレード可能な漁船や釣り用具を使い、漁師としてのキャリアを積みながら、海の黄金を探しましょう。
descriptions.ko: 북대서양을 무대로 어업을 벌이세요! 다양한 해양 생태계와 함께 캐나다에 위치한 노바스코샤의 아름다운 정경을 감상하세요. 업그레이드할 수 있는 어선과 다양한 어업 장비를 갖추고 어부로서 커리어를 쌓으며 바다 속 금광을 찾아보세요.

detailed_descriptions.en: The sequel to the popular simulation game Fishing: Barents Sea invites you to put on your captain’s hat once again: Explore the large ocean of Nova Scotia, try your hand at entirely new fishing methods and enjoy huge range of highly detailed ships in the commercial fishing simulator Fishing: North Atlantic . Discover majestic world of Canadian Nova Scotia while admiring the vast diversity of ocean life. Explore the fishing zones with upgradable ships and gear as you progress in your career. Like our predecessor game Fishing Barents Sea , Fishing: North Atlantic makes you experience an atmospheric and realistic game world based on real maps, boats and fish species. Get ready to enjoy new weather systems with upgraded atmospheric effects, North American Vessels and fishing techniques like harpoons, deep-line-buoy-fishing and lobster pots. Purchasing larger boats and better gear will increase your fisherman skills. Fishing: North Atlantic offers you 29 ships at your disposal for all types of fishing styles and fishing techniques like the harpooning, which is used to hunt swordfish and tuna. Start with harpooning, then work your way up to setting deep lines, catching snow crabs or lobster. As well as longline, net and trawling. Do you have what it takes to fulfill this challenging task? Plan the course of your fishing career throughout the whole year: Brave rain and snow while looking for the best fishing areas, but make sure that you are not in danger of exceeding your quotas! The new advanced fish-AI will require the use of GPS and sonar to follow the movement of your prey depending on weather and season. Key Features Fishing methods – Harpooning, Deepline, Lobster, Crabbing, Longline, Net, Trawling Fish species – Swordfish, Tuna, Lobster, Snow Crab, Cod, Haddock, Pollack, Redfish, Mackerel, Silver Hake Advanced watershader and weather system, with realistic weather data from the area Dynamic fish prices – Other fishingboats will also fish and deliver fish at the ports, which affects the prices Dynamic fish habitats – Fish will swim around the map through the yearly seasons 29 real handcrafted boats available from fishing industry licensepartners Huge map over Nova Scotia, Canada (200x300km) with six realistic ports Fishing industry license partners - A.F. Theriault & Son, Skipasyn, Scanmar, Hermes, Selfa and Moen Marin RTX support New license partner Pronav, NorSap and Mostein New custom start option New volumetric cloud system
detailed_descriptions.zh-Hant: 熱門模擬遊戲 Fishing：Barents Sea 續集邀你再次戴上船長帽：探索廣袤的新斯科細亞海洋，親自嘗試全新的捕魚手法，在商業捕魚模擬器 Fishing：North Atlantic 中玩遍一系列裝備完善的漁船。 探索 加拿大新斯科細亞省 的宏偉景觀，讚嘆龐大的海洋生物多樣性。隨著你的漁夫資歷，利用各種可升級的漁船和漁具探索漁區。 就像前作 Fishing Barents Sea 一樣， Fishing:North Atlantic 可以讓你根據實際地圖、船隻和魚種，在遊戲世界裡心領神會逼真的氛圍。摩拳擦掌試試全新的天氣系統吧，它附有升級的大氣效果；還有北美漁船和釣魚技術，如突刺漁法、深海一支釣和捕蝦籠等等。購買更大型的船隻、更好的漁具，將有助你提升漁夫技能。 Fishing:North Atlantic 提供29艘漁船供你使用，因應各種類型的捕魚方式和捕魚技術，例如突刺漁法，可以用來捕撈旗魚和鮪魚。從突刺漁法開始，然後逐步進展，讓魚鉤深垂海底，捕捉雪蟹或龍蝦。另外還有延繩釣、魚網和拖網捕魚等方法。你有能力完成這項艱鉅的任務嗎？ 規劃一整年的捕魚路線：頂著風霜雨雪尋找最佳漁場，但是別忘了謹守配額限制喔！新穎先進的智慧機器魚，需要使用全球定位系統與聲納，根據天氣和漁期追蹤獵物行蹤。 重要功能 捕魚法 – 突刺漁法、深海一支釣、龍蝦、捕蟹、延繩釣、魚網、拖網 魚種 – 旗魚、鮪魚、龍蝦、雪蟹、鱈魚、黑線鱈、綠鱈、紅魚、鯖魚、銀無鬚鱈 來自的先進水著色器與天氣系統，具備該區域的真實天氣資料 動態魚價 – 其他漁船也會捕魚並將漁獲送至港口販售，因此會影響魚價 動態魚類棲息地 – 魚群一年四季在地圖中四處巡游 29艘真正手工打造的船隻，由漁撈業授權夥伴提供 完整的 加拿大新斯科細亞省大型地圖 (200x300km)，有六個逼真的港口 漁撈業授權夥伴 - A.F. Theriaul & Son、Skipasyn、Scanmar、Hermes、Selfa and Moen Marin RTX support 新自訂開始選項 新的 授權夥伴 Pronav, NorSap Mostein 二 新船 新的 volumetric cloud system
detailed_descriptions.ja: 人気のシミュレーションゲームである Fishing: Barents Sea の続編で、再び船長の帽子を被る時がやって来ました。ノバスコシア州の大海原を探索し、全く新しい漁獲方法で腕を試し、商業漁業シミュレーターの Fishing: North Atlantic で幅広い種類のディテールにこだわった漁船に乗って楽しみましょう。 海の生き物の多様性に見惚れながら、 カナダ・ノバスコシア州 の雄大な世界へ飛び込みましょう。アップグレード可能な漁船や道具を使って漁業水域を探索し、キャリアを積んでいきましょう。 前作の Fishing Barents Sea と同様に、 Fishing: North Atlantic でも実際の地図、漁船や魚種を基にした、独特の雰囲気を持つリアルなゲーム世界を体験していただくことが可能です。アップグレードされた環境効果が付いた最新気候システム、北米船舶や、銛、深場でのブイ釣り、そして罠かごと言った釣りのテクニックを楽しみましょう。更に大きな船や優良な用具を購入すると、漁師スキルが増加します。 Fishing: North Atlantic では、様々な釣りスタイル、そしてメカジキやマグロ釣りに使用される銛と言った釣りテクニックを実現するために自由に使うことのできる29種類の船が登場します。銛釣りから始めて深場の糸釣りまで進め、ズワイガニまたはロブスターを捕まえましょう。延縄、網や引き網漁にも挑戦できます。この困難な試練を達成させるための準備はいいですか？ 一年のうちにどのような釣りキャリアを形成したいか、しっかりと計画してみましょう：最高の釣りスポットを探しながら雨や雪に立ち向かうことも大切ですが、自分の限界を超えてしまわないように気を付けましょう！最新の上級魚AIは、獲物の動きを追跡するために、天気や季節に応じてGPSやソナーの使用を必要とします。 重要機能 釣り方法 – 銛、深場糸釣り、罠かご、カニ漁、延縄、網漁、引き網漁 魚種 – メカジキ、マグロ、ロブスター、ズワイガニ、タラ、コダラ、ポラック、サケ、サバ、シルバー・ヘイク 上級海洋シェーダやの天候システムで、その土地のリアルな天候データを提供 変動する魚の値段 – 他の漁船も漁をして港へ魚を届けるため、値段に変動が起こります 変動する魚の生息環境 – 魚は一年の季節ごとにマップ中を移動します 釣り産業ライセンスパートナーが29種類の本物の手作り漁船を提供 6つのリアルな港を含む、 カナダ・ノバスコシア州 (200x300km)を見渡す巨大なマップ 釣り産業ライセンスパートナー - A.F. Theriaul & Son、Skipasyn、Scanmar、Hermes、Selfa and Moen Marin RTX support 二 新しい漁船 ライセンスパートナー Pronav, NorSap と Mostein 新カスタム開始オプション 新着 volumetric cloud system
detailed_descriptions.ko: 높은 인기를 자랑하는 시뮬레이션 게임 Fishing: Barents Sea 의 후속작이 선장 여러분의 귀환을 기다립니다. Fishing: North Atlantic 에서 노바스코샤의 넓은 바다를 탐험하며 새로운 조업 방식을 시험하고, 섬세하게 묘사된 다양한 유형의 어선을 다뤄 보세요. 다양한 해양 생태계와 캐나다에 위치한 노바스코샤 의 아름다운 정경을 감상하세요. 업그레이드할 수 있는 어선과 다양한 어업 장비를 갖추고 어부로서 커리어를 쌓으세요. 전작 Fishing Barents Sea 와 마찬가지로, Fishing: North Atlantic 에서도 실제 지도와 어선, 어종에 기반한 현실적인 분위기와 세계를 체험할 수 있습니다. 업그레이드된 대기 효과가 추가된 새로운 기상 시스템과 새롭게 등장하는 북미 지역 어선, 그리고 바닷가재 통발, 작살, 심해 부표 낚시 등 새로운 조업 기술을 즐겨 보세요. 더 큰 어선과 더 좋은 장비를 구매하면 여러분의 어업 능력을 올릴 수 있습니다. Fishing: North Atlantic 에서는 29척의 어선을 선택할 수 있으며, 그 중에는 황새치나 참치를 사냥할 때 사용하는 작살과 같은 특별한 조업 스타일 및 기술에 특화된 선박도 있습니다. 처음에는 작살에서 시작하지만 나중에는 심해 낚시용 어구를 설치해 대게나 바닷가재 등을 낚을 수도 있습니다. 또한 연승, 그물, 저인망도 사용할 수 있게 되죠. 도전에 응할 준비는 되셨나요? 1년 동안 커리어를 어떻게 키울지 미리 설계해 보세요. 악천후를 헤치며 최고의 조업 구역을 찾되, 자신이 정해한진 노획량을 넘지 않게 조심하세요! 새롭게 발전한 물고기의 AI에 대응하려면 날씨와 조업철에 맞춰 목표를 선정하고, GPS와 소나를 사용해 움직임도 탐지할 수 있어야 합니다. 주요 특징 조업 기법 – 작살, 원양 낚싯줄, 바닷가재, 게 낚시, 연승, 그물, 저인망 어종 – 황새치, 참치, 바닷가재, 대게, 대구, 해덕, 명태, 볼락, 고등어, 실버 헤이크 trueSKY 및 실제 지역 날씨 데이터를 활용한 향상된 워터 셰이더 및 날씨 시스템 동적인 판매가 책정 – 다른 어선 역시 잡아온 물고기를 항구로 가져올 수 있으며, 이로 인해 가격이 변동될 수 있습니다. 동적인 어류 자생지 – 물고기는 일 년 내내 지도를 돌며 헤엄칩니다. 실제 낚시 업계 라이선스 파트너사의 허가를 받은 29종의 선박 실제 6곳의 항구가 포함된 광대한 캐나다의 노바스코샤 (200x300km) 지도 업계 라이선스 파트너 - A.F. Theriaul & Son, Skipasyn, Scanmar, Hermes, Selfa, Moen Marin RTX support 이 새 선박 라이선스 파트너 Pronav, NorSap 그리고 Mostein 새 사용자 정의 시작 옵션 새로운volumetric cloud system

games.short_description: Five Nights at Freddy’s: Help Wanted is a collection of classic and original mini-games set in the Five Nights universe. Experience the horror in flat (non-VR) mode or VR. Oculus Rift and HTC Vive are supported. A VR Headset is NOT required to play.

detailed_descriptions.en: Five Nights at Freddy’s: Help Wanted is a collection of classic and original mini-games set in the Five Nights universe. Survive terrifying encounters with your favorite killer animatronics in a collection of new and classic FIVE NIGHTS AT FREDDY’S™ experiences. “Where fantasy and fun come to life!” A VR headset is NOT required to play. YOU’RE HIRED - Time to get your hands dirty. Repair claustrophobic ventilation systems, troubleshoot broken animatronics that could activate at any moment, or spend your evenings cowering in the nighttime security guard office. CELEBRATE - Confront your favorite killer animatronics including; Freddy, Bonnie, Chica, Foxy, Springtrap, The Mangle, Funtime Foxy, and Circus Baby. FUN FUN PRIZES - Toys, Plushies, Bobbleheads, and candy candy candy! Earn super fun prizes you can play with at the interactive Prize Counter! Collect well hidden Faz-Tokens to unlock even more rare collectibles for more SUPER FUN FUN FUN. PIZZA PARTY - Scenes from classic titles have been updated and remade for a fully immersive experience including; Five Nights at Freddy’s, Five Nights at Freddy’s 2, Five Nights at Freddy’s 3, Five Nights at Freddy’s 4, and Five Nights at Freddy’s: Sister Location. TWO WAYS TO PLAY - Experience the horror in flat (non-VR) mode or VR. Oculus Rift and HTC Vive are supported.

names.en: Five Nights at Freddy's: Help Wanted 2

games.short_description: Five Nights at Freddy’s: Help Wanted 2 is the sequel to the terrifying VR experience that brought new life to the iconic horror franchise. As a brand new Fazbear employee you’ll have to prove you have what it takes to excel in all aspects of Pizzeria management and maintenance.

descriptions.en: Five Nights at Freddy’s: Help Wanted 2 is the sequel to the terrifying VR experience that brought new life to the iconic horror franchise. As a brand new Fazbear employee you’ll have to prove you have what it takes to excel in all aspects of Pizzeria management and maintenance.

detailed_descriptions.en: Find out if you have what it takes to be a Fazbear Entertainment Superstar! Five Nights at Freddy’s: Help Wanted 2 is the sequel to the terrifying VR experience that brought new life to the iconic horror franchise. As a brand new Fazbear employee you’ll have to prove you have what it takes to excel in all aspects of Pizzeria management and maintenance. Go Backstage as a VIP to help Roxanne Wolf & the S.T.A.F.F Bots get ready for their performances in the Pizzaplex Salon! Head into the Fazcade and enjoy classic games like Bonk-a-Bon and Fazerblast! See if you can top all the high scores! Take care of things behind the scenes in the Staff Only section of the Pizzeria. Deliver First Aid to patients who aren’t quite feeling themselves, and help animatronics perform routine diagnostics & maintenance. Our Food Prep courses will help you get the federally mandated amount of value preparing food in the Pizzaplex. Experience all the joys of high-speed food service & get ready to feed some hungry bots! Head over to the Ticket Booth to test out our E-ticket attractions, such as Captain Foxy’s Cowboy Adventure! On this lighthearted log ride, you’ll float through the old West as a gunslinger in search of booty! And finally, if you’re short on dread, dive into the world of our Sister Location! These special minigames are VR versions of classic experiences from Five Nights at Freddy’s: Sister Location. These fan-favorites brought to life promise to be as fun as they are terrifying! So what are you waiting for?!? Five Nights at Freddy’s: Help Wanted 2 is now accepting applicants for all positions, effective immediately.

detailed_descriptions.en: Enter the abandoned workshop of Murray’s Costume Manor and unravel the mystery left behind by the reclusive inventor, Edwin Murray. In Five Nights at Freddy’s: Secret of the Mimic, you’ll step into a world where every dark corner holds a secret and every flicker of light hints at an ever-present threat. The Mimic, a prototype endoskeleton, can adapt to any costume and become any character, including what you fear most. Armed with only your wits, a few gadgets, and a heavily redacted corporate briefing, you’ll attempt to retrieve Fazbear’s prized prototype technology while grappling with cryptic clues and a relentless shadow determined to dispatch all unwanted company. Prepare for heart-pounding thrills as you explore the labyrinth of the deserted Costume Manor, discovering remnants of Edwin’s unfinished work and eluding the monster he’s created. Experience Five Nights at Freddy’s: Secret of the Mimic, and survive the mystery and madness. Five Night’s at Freddy’s: Secret of the Mimic will be available on June 13th, 2025. Disclaimer: Fazbear Entertainment is not responsible for whatever you awaken in the dark.

names.en: Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach

games.short_description: In Five Nights at Freddy’s: Security Breach, play as Gregory, a young boy who’s been trapped overnight inside of Freddy Fazbear’s Mega Pizzaplex. With the help of Freddy himself, Gregory must uncover the secrets of the Pizzaplex, learn the truth, and survive until dawn.

descriptions.en: In Five Nights at Freddy’s: Security Breach, play as Gregory, a young boy who’s been trapped overnight inside of Freddy Fazbear’s Mega Pizzaplex. With the help of Freddy himself, Gregory must uncover the secrets of the Pizzaplex, learn the truth, and survive until dawn.

detailed_descriptions.en: THE NEXT CHAPTER IN FEAR Five Nights at Freddy’s: Security Breach is the latest installment of the family-friendly horror games loved by millions of players from all over the globe. Play as Gregory, a young boy trapped overnight in Freddy Fazbear’s Mega Pizzaplex. With the help of Freddy Fazbear himself, Gregory must survive the near-unstoppable hunt of reimagined Five Nights at Freddy’s characters - as well as new, horrific threats. THE HUNTERS AND THE HUNTED - Once nighttime protocols are initiated, the animatronics at Freddy Fazbear’s Mega Pizzaplex will relentlessly pursue all intruders. Glamrock Chica, Roxanne Wolf, Montgomery Gator, and the Pizzaplex’s security guard, Vanessa, will turn over every Cotton Candy Pizza Stand if they have to - it’s not wise to stay in one place for too long. ADAPT TO SURVIVE - Access the building’s security cameras to survey the environment and plan your route through danger. Distract enemies by knocking over paint cans and toys - just slip away before enemies are drawn to your location. Hop into hiding spots and allow danger to pass, or try to outrun your pursuers. Play your way, but be prepared to adapt. EXPLORE AND DISCOVER - Freddy Fazbear’s Mega Pizzaplex offers a variety of attractions for guests to enjoy - Monty Golf, Roxy Raceway, Bonnie Bowl, the sewers, and… Sewers? The Pizzaplex is vast and has no shortage of goodies to discover.

games.name: Flamecraft
games.short_description: Flamecraft is a 1-5 player cozy strategy game filled with magic. Become a Flamekeeper and help adorable dragon artisans find the perfect home. Enchant the town’s stores and fill them with dragon cards as you watch the whimsical shopping district come to life.

descriptions.en: Flamecraft is a 1-5 player cozy strategy game filled with magic. Become a Flamekeeper and help adorable dragon artisans find the perfect home. Enchant the town’s stores and fill them with dragon cards as you watch the whimsical shopping district come to life.

detailed_descriptions.en: Flamecraft is a cozy, turn-based strategy board game for 1 to 5 players. Become a Flamekeeper and help artisan dragons and shopkeepers delight the townspeople with their craft. Gather and manage resources, enchant the shops using artifacts, and magic your way to becoming the best Flamekeeper. Your main task is to thoughtfully place dragon artisans in the town’s bustling shopping district. They will help you gather various resources from the shops, which you can later use to cast enchantments, triggering powerful ability combos. You’ll also befriend the extraordinary Fancy Dragons, with abilities allowing you to boost your reputation. Your main goal is to earn the most reputation points by the time the game ends. If you manage to do that, you’ll earn the Master of Flamecraft title! Become a Flamekeeper and enter a cozy, vibrant world inhabited by dragons Flamecraft is set in a fantasy world, in which dragons and magic are part of the ordinary. Here, you’ll meet the adorable artisan dragons, who will use their extraordinary flamecraft to help the town’s shopkeepers with their seemingly mundane tasks. The sweets are just waiting to be baked in Guilty Treasures, and Scale Mail Post is ready to send enchanted letters all across the town! Play in a variety of gameplay modes, both single and multiplayer Whether you prefer playing solo, with friends or people from around the world, Flamecraft has something in store for you. Test your skills against AI of varying difficulty or set up a relaxing custom game for your family to enjoy together. Each game is full of charming surprises and opportunities to strategize with how many dragons, shops, and enchantments there are. The order they appear in is random, but how you decide to play them is entirely up to you, leading to each play - solo or multiplayer - feeling uniquely different. Master the art of resource management and create powerful combos to increase your reputation You’ll have to strategize and outsmart other Flamekeepers if you want to come out on top. There are countless ways to victory, and it’s up to you to make the most of your skills. On your turn, you’ll visit one of the various shops in town to either gather resources or enchant the shops using magical artifacts. You could visit Gnome Depot to grab some iron, get freshly baked bread from Drake of Cakes, or brew mysterious potions at Draconic Tonic. You’ll need those, among others, to later enchant the shops - this will let you fire up all of the dragons from a shop and combine their abilities to create amazing combos. This, along with the Companion and Fancy Dragon cards, which offer powerful one-time abilities and additional scoring opportunities, will let you get the reputation points needed to win the game. Meet over 70 beautiful animated dragons and visit 30 unique shops while listening to a whimsical score In Flamecraft, we’ve brought the enchanting world created by Sandara Tang to life. The beautifully illustrated dragons come to life as they use their craft in the vibrant 3D town, full of animated shops, booths, and laboratories. Paweł Górniak, the composer behind Wingspan and Quilts and Cats of Calico, is also back, with another spellbinding score. Will you be able to claim the Master of Flamecraft title with the help of your creative little crafter friends?

games.short_description: Play solo or in up to 10-player multiplayer co-op! Flashing Lights is an open world police, firefighting and EMS simulator game with plenty of opportunity for role-play or more relaxed fun with friends. Become the law or save lives! Discover leagues of player-created mods!

descriptions.en: Play solo or in up to 10-player multiplayer co-op! Flashing Lights is an open world police, firefighting and EMS simulator game with plenty of opportunity for role-play or more relaxed fun with friends. Become the law or save lives! Discover leagues of player-created mods!

detailed_descriptions.en: POLICE | FIRE | EMS Either solo, or in up to 10 player online co-op, this immersive sim lets you enrol with the police, fire department or emergency medical services and take on missions unique to each service in an open world. Engage in desperate police car chases, put out lethal fires, and diagnose life-threatening injuries! Each department has its own roster of vehicles and equipment for you to operate while on duty. Police Become the police! Usually the first to respond to a criminal incident, the police are equipped with the fastest vehicle and a variety of life-saving equipment. Police roles vary from handing out parking tickets to chasing down dangerous suspects. Playing as police in Flashing Lights, you'll do everything you can to prevent criminal activity and put a stop to any crimes in progress. Fire Be the fire department! Battling raging flames and freeing trapped civilians involves some heavy-duty gear including spreaders, a fire hose, a fire extinguisher and a fire truck. But your role in the fire department extends far beyond this, as you work closely with medical services out in the field, swiftly cutting open crashed cars so that medical staff can reach the casualty. EMS Be an EMS! As an emergency medical specialist, your job lies in keeping members of the public alive, treating patients’ injuries, diagnosis and more. Lifesaving equipment you’ll utilize includes medical kits, stretchers and ambulances. Help the injured solo, or with friends. MULTIPLAYER Team up with fellow players online and divide your team between police, fire and EMS at will. Race around the open world in various vehicles, to where you are needed, working together to help civilians in accidents (fire and EMS) or catch a fleeing criminal (police). OFFICIAL MOD SUPPORT Expand your experience with a wide variety of player-created mods. From police, fire and EMS vehicle liveries inspired by various worldwide emergency services to alternate police, fire and EMS uniforms, seamlessly browse and install mods in-game. Will you play as the police, fire or EMS? Whether you're ripping up the roads in police car chases, putting out raging fires or tackling life-threatening injuries, whether you're playing as police, fire or EMS, there's tons of single player and multiplayer fun to be had!

Where unforgiving combat, loud electronic music and addictive boosts of adrenaline mix up to separate winners from losers. Where gravitation is nothing more than an empty word. detailed_descriptions.en: FLASHOUT IS BACK! Where high speed meets high stakes. Where unforgiving combat, loud electronic music and addictive boosts of adrenaline mix up to separate winners from losers. Where gravitation is nothing more than an empty word. This is where the world of FLASHOUT 3 will take you and your ride to the absolute limits! FLASHOUT 3 offers you ultra-fast ships, loops, jumps and sudden razor-sharp turns! Test your skills on the most impressive sci-fi racing tracks and try not to fall behind! But if it happens, don't sweat! Unleash the power of rockets, guns, bombs and mines to help you level down your competition! Take part in an exciting, head-to-head fight to the finish! Witness spectacular crashes, the agony of defeat, and the sweet taste of victory! But don't blink! It can all end in a flash! > TWO CHARACTERS TO CHOOSE FROM > SPLIT-SCREEN MODE An option that never got old, but is missing from many games. Play the game with a friend on just one display! FLASHOUT 3 supports both horizontal and vertical split-screen mode. Choose the one that suits you best! > VR SUPPORT FLASHOUT 3 supports all popular VR headsets via OpenXR! The game supports simulators compatible with Sim Racing Studio (latest beta release) and motion simulators from Motion Systems (). > AMAZING ELECTRONIC MUSIC FLASHOUT 3 features high-beat electronic music composed especially for the game by renowned demoscene artists! > AND? A challenging campaign consisting of 10 tournaments; Different race modes, including Standard Race, Elimination Mode, Destruction Mode and more! Eight detailed and ultra-fast AG ships! A powerful arsenal of weapons, boosts and upgrades at your disposal! 10 themed unique circuits in two versions - standard and reversed! Stunning 3D graphics! Full gamepad support! Full Steam Deck support! Air brakes! And more!

games.name: Fleetbreakers
games.short_description: From the creators of Halo Wars and Age of Empires, Fleetbreakers is an action RTS roguelite with satisfying fleet combat in bite-sized sessions. Strategic depth meets cataclysmic space battles in an ever-evolving campaign that keeps you coming back for just. One. More. Run.

descriptions.en: From the creators of Halo Wars and Age of Empires, Fleetbreakers is an action RTS roguelite with satisfying fleet combat in bite-sized sessions. Strategic depth meets cataclysmic space battles in an ever-evolving campaign that keeps you coming back for just. One. More. Run.

detailed_descriptions.en: From the creators behind Halo Wars and Age of Empires, Fleetbreakers is a fast action RTS roguelite where every run throws your fleet into a new fight for survival. Command squadrons in real time, launch mothership abilities, gather resources, choose upgrades, and push deeper into Voltari-controlled space through quick, replayable strategy missions. It is built for players who want the satisfaction of RTS decision-making without the long buildup: readable battles, meaningful choices, and one more run always within reach. You lead from the mothership, but the battle is won through the squadrons you deploy, the abilities you time, and the risks you choose to take. Send agile fighters into the fight, anchor the front line with heavier units, and use special maneuvers to break enemy pressure. When the battle turns against you, mothership support can protect your fleet, punish enemy formations, or open the path forward. Every run gives you a chance to shape a different kind of fleet. Spend resources, unlock new squadron options, and combine units with upgrades that change how you approach each encounter. The goal is not only to survive the next battle, but to create momentum. A small strike force can grow into a powerful armada if you make the right calls at the right time. Fleetbreakers blends real-time tactical combat with roguelite structure. Each run brings generated maps, new encounters, discoveries, allies, and strategic choices that can change your route through the sector. Push forward for greater rewards, adjust your fleet to counter new threats, and learn from every defeat. Persistent upgrades and better decisions bring you closer to breaking through the campaign. The sector is under the grip of the Voltari Empire. As you fight to liberate space from their control, you will uncover more of the sci-fi story behind the invasion and the factions caught inside it. Recruit allies, earn unique bonuses, and prepare for boss battles that test whether your fleet can survive more than just ordinary enemy waves. Fleetbreakers is designed around quick missions that get you into the action fast. Each encounter gives you a clear tactical problem: deploy, adapt, survive, and decide how far you are willing to push before the enemy pushes back. Play with mouse and keyboard or gamepad, and take the fight on the go with Steam Deck-ready sessions built around fast, focused strategy. · Fast action RTS roguelite - quick, replayable missions where every battle and upgrade shapes the campaign. · Tactical squadron combat - deploy fighters, heavy units, and special maneuvers in real-time space battles. · Mothership command abilities - call in powerful support to protect your fleet or break enemy formations. · Persistent progression - spend resources on upgrades that carry your campaign forward. · Dynamic campaign structure - generated maps, encounters, discoveries, allies, boss battles, and route choices. · Multiple factions and allied bonuses - unlock new advantages that change how each run unfolds. · Flexible controls - mouse and keyboard, gamepad support, and Steam Deck-ready play.

games.short_description: Flock Around is a multiplayer bird watching game. Explore a nature sanctuary with friends, snap pictures of birds, and fill out the guide book!

descriptions.en: Flock Around is a multiplayer bird watching game. Explore a nature sanctuary with friends, snap pictures of birds, and fill out the guide book!

detailed_descriptions.en: Flock Around is a co-op birdwatching game where you explore a nature sanctuary. Solo or with friends, snap pictures of funny birds, and fill out the park guide book! Snap them all! Goose Lake Sanctuary is home to numerous bird species, and if you can see it, you can take a picture of it. Fill out the guide book with pictures of each bird in its various poses, from the common Robin, to more rare and exotic birds. Explore a variety of biomes, perform actions and use items to lure in species, and mess with your friends! Flock Together! Flock Around is designed to be a shared social space where you and your friends can work together to get pictures of birds or each other! Birding is best with others, so you can play with up to 10 friends! Customize your birder! Collect cosmetics and make your birder unique, expressing your personality and eagle eyes to your friends. After taking your pictures, develop them for money to spend on outfits so you can go birding in style!

descriptions.ja: 漂流都市ビルダーで船長となって漂流者たちを導き、果てしなく広がるゴミの海の世界を生き延び、航海し、生存者たちを救出しましょう。水没した遺跡や錆びついた工場、洪水前が起きる前の世界の物語を発見できます。

detailed_descriptions.en: Turn ocean garbage into homes, workshops and colorful little gardens. Collect floating plastic and driftwood, salvage scraps of the old world, and recycle them into homes that stay afloat. Desalinate water, gut fish and board up a shelter to keep everyone safe Decorate your town with plants, refurbished furniture and statues that keep your drifters happy. Set sail to explore the flooded world, from soaked ruins to forgotten islands, and discover what still floats beyond the horizon. Explore flooded remnants of the old world Rescue stranded survivors and friendly animals Re-discover old technology to improve your town. But be careful your drifters don’t get sick. The old world is polluted! Your drifters each have their own stories to tell. Recruit specialists who unlock new buildings, quests, and discoveries for your floating community. Find unique drifters like the Birdkeeper, Chemist, and Electrician Unlock new technologies and story quests through their expertise Complete personal storylines to unlock new mechanics Develop cleaner, smarter systems that turn waste into progress and keep your floating town thriving in this feel-good apocalypse. Research new tech to transition from burning firewood to green eel-ectricity generation. Build connected production pipelines that turn your floating town into a self-sustaining ecosystem. Clean food and develop cures for pollution-born diseases and keep your drifters healthy and productive
detailed_descriptions.zh-Hant: 建造你的漂浮家園 將海洋垃圾變成房屋、工坊和色彩繽紛的小花園。 收集漂浮的塑膠和浮木，打撈舊世界的廢料，將它們回收利用，製成可以漂浮的房屋。 將海水脫鹽，清理魚的內臟，用木板搭建一個避難所，以保證大家的安全 用植物、翻新的家具和雕像裝飾你的城鎮，讓你的漂泊者們心情愉悅。 與你的城鎮一起遨遊海洋 揚帆起航，探索被洪水淹沒的世界，從海水浸泡的廢墟到被遺忘的島嶼，探索地平線外還有什麼漂浮在水上。 探索被洪水淹沒的舊世界遺跡 營救被困的倖存者和友好的動物 重新發現舊科技來提升你的城鎮。但要小心，不要讓你的漂泊者感染疾病，因為舊世界已被污染了！ 結識獨特的漂泊者與專業人士 你的每個漂泊者都有自己的故事。招募專業人士，為你的漂浮社群解鎖新的建築、任務和發現。 尋找獨特的漂泊者，例如養鳥人、化學家和電工 利用他們的專業知識，解鎖新技術和劇情任務 完成個人故事線以解鎖新機制 回收、研究和再創新 開發更清潔、更智慧的系統，利用廢料進行生產，讓你的漂浮城鎮在這個感覺還不錯的末日世界中繁榮發展。 研究新技術，從燃燒木柴過渡到鰻魚發電這樣的綠色能源。 建立彼此連結的生產管道，將你的漂浮城鎮變成一個自給自足的生態系統。 清理食物，研究污染病的治療方法，讓你的漂泊者保持健康，提高生產力
detailed_descriptions.ja: 浮かぶ町を築こう 海に浮かぶゴミを集めて、住まいや作業場や色とりどりの小さな庭を設けましょう。 プラスチックや流木を回収し、洪水前の世界の廃材をリサイクルして浮かぶ家を建てましょう。 海水を淡水に変換し、魚を調理しシェルターを補強して、仲間を守りましょう。 植物、修理した家具や像で町を飾り、漂流者たちを笑顔にしましょう。 町で航海しよう 海底に眠る遺跡や未開の島々など水没した世界を探検しながら、水平線の向こうの漂流物を見に行きましょう。 かつての世界の名残を探しましょう。 孤立した生存者や動物を救出しましょう。 かつての技術を再発見して町を発展させましょう。でも水中にあるものはどれも汚染されているので、注意して！ 個性豊かな漂流者たち 漂流者は、それぞれ異なるバックグラウンドを持っています。専門家を迎えて、新たな建物や、クエストや、発見をアンロックしましょう。 鳥の飼育者、化学者、電気技師など、様々な漂流者が登場。 彼らの専門知識を活かして、新たな技術や物語のクエストをアンロックしましょう。 それぞれのストーリーラインを進めると、新しいメカニクスがアンロックされます。 リサイクル、研究、再発明 希望の残る終末の世界で、廃棄物を進歩へと変える、クリーンでスマートな仕組みを築き上げましょう。 木材の燃料から脱却すべく、デンキウナギによる発電などのグリーンエネルギーを研究して持続可能な町づくりをしましょう。 生産施設を連結して、完全自給自足の漂流エコシステムを作り出しましょう。 食材を浄化し、汚染による病を治癒して、漂流者たちの健康と町の活気を守りましょう。
detailed_descriptions.ko: 떠다니는 나만의 집 만들기 바다 위에 떠다니는 쓰레기를 집, 작업장, 그리고 알록달록한 작은 정원으로 바꿔보세요. 떠다니는 플라스틱과 표류목을 모으고, 잊혀진 구세계의 잔해를 수거해 떠다니는 집으로 재활용하세요. 바닷물을 담수화하고, 물고기를 손질하고, 피난처를 지어 모두의 안전을 확보하세요. 식물, 복원된 가구, 조각상으로 드리프터들을 행복하게 해 주세요. 마을을 타고 바다를 여행하자 대홍수 이후의 세계를 항해하며 탐험하세요. 물에 잠긴 폐허부터 잊혀진 섬까지, 지평선 너머에 아직 남은 것들을 발견해 보세요. 물에 잠긴 구세계의 흔적을 탐험하세요. 조난당한 생존자와 친근한 동물들을 구조하세요. 오래된 기술을 다시 발견해 마을을 발전시키세요. 하지만 드리프터들이 아프지 않도록 해야 합니다. 구세계는 오염되었으니까요! 개성 있는 드리프터와 전문가들 만나기 떠도는 이들은 모두 자기만의 이야기가 있습니다. 전문가들을 고용해 새로운 건물, 퀘스트를 잠금 해제하고 떠다니는 마을에 필요한 새로운 기술을 발견하세요. 새 조련사, 화학자, 전기공같은 특별한 드리프터들을 찾아보세요. 이들의 전문 기술을 이용해 새로운 기술과 스토리 퀘스트를 잠금 해제하세요. 사람들의 스토리라인을 완성해 새로운 메커닉을 획득하세요. 재활용하고, 연구하고, 다시 발명하기 쓰레기를 원동력으로 바꾸는 보다 깨끗하고 똑똑한 시스템을 개발하고 떠다니는 마을을 아늑한 아포칼립스의 낙원으로 만들어 보세요. 새로운 기술을 연구해 목탄 발전에서 자연 친화적인 장어전기 발전 시스템으로 진화시키세요. 생산 파이프라인을 연동해 떠다니는 마을을 자급자족 가능한 환경으로 꾸며보세요. 깨끗한 음식과 오염병의 치료제를 만들어 주민들을 건강하고 생산적이게 해주세요.

games.short_description: Flowers and Deities is a strategy deckbuilder roguelite where you command a blood-soaked lizardkin army through escalating arena battles, spending every drop of spilled blood to cast spells, summon creatures, and survive long enough to claim the favor of the Gods

descriptions.en: Flowers and Deities is a strategy deckbuilder roguelite where you command a blood-soaked lizardkin army through escalating arena battles, spending every drop of spilled blood to cast spells, summon creatures, and survive long enough to claim the favor of the Gods

detailed_descriptions.en: Flowers and Deities is a strategy deckbuilder roguelite set in a rainforest world ruled by bloodthirsty gods. Lead your army to battle and spend spilled blood as a resource to cast spells and summon creatures. Die, adapt, and descend into the arena again. Choose from 4 origins and faiths that define your playstyle from the first fight. Battle across multiple grand arenas against 15+ races and 125+ unique unit types. Face noble legions, barbarian tribes, underworld horrors, and alien visitors. Defeat them, and conscript them into your own ranks. The build space is expansive: 12 tactical archetypes, 300+ magical items, 100+ divine blessings, and 50+ status effects. A flexible equipment and slot system lets you experiment freely, counter enemy weaknesses mid-run, and find combinations the gods never intended. Blood is your most precious resource. Every unit lost - no matter yours or theirs - fills the pool. Spend it to turn the tide. Combat arena getting dry? Sacrifice your kin and claw out that victory with the power Gods bestow upon you. Key Features 4 origins and faiths - distinct starting builds that shape your entire run 125+ unique units across 15+ races - recruit enemies you defeat and grow your legion Vast build space - 12 archetypes, 300+ items, 100+ blessings, 50+ status effects Blood is resource - every death fuels your next move 6 grand arenas - escalating enemies including barbarian tribes, underworld horrors, alien visitors, and legendary beasts

games.name: Flux Empyrean
games.short_description: The Flux is not keen on giving away its secrets, and you’re one of them. Sail a vast planet under a blanket of stars and use your tools and wits to remind yourself of what was lost and what could come next. An open world mystery about understanding the end of the world.

descriptions.en: The Flux is not keen on giving away its secrets, and you’re one of them. Sail a vast planet under a blanket of stars and use your tools and wits to remind yourself of what was lost and what could come next. An open world mystery about understanding the end of the world.

detailed_descriptions.en: You’ve been absent. Perhaps you once called this world home, but it moved on without you. Where were you? How long has it been? Alone on a boat in a sea of Flux, you set off without destination to find answers. The entire planet lies before you. No matter where you go, you find a unique trace of the past. Lost journal letters. Remains of a great temple. Derelict research papers. Ancient conversations between peers. Soon you start making connections, and previous discoveries grow in weight. Knowledge is progress. There is no combat, waypoints, or skill trees - just you, your ship, your tools, and the waiting world. Constellations rotate overhead as you glide over the waves. You learn to sail by the stars, using the sky as your guide. Each location you explore offers up new mysteries and answers. You take note of your discoveries in your journal for later. You pause after reviewing your notes. The strange puzzle from a previous location begins to make sense. You know what to do now.

games.name: FluxWerks
games.short_description: Every block of this planet is real, including fluids! Dig it, flood it, process it. FluxWerks is a factory automation game on a fully destructible voxel world with physical fluid and heat simulation. Dig anywhere, automate everything, and survey a world that was supposed to be empty.

descriptions.en: Every block of this planet is real, including fluids! Dig it, flood it, process it. FluxWerks is a factory automation game on a fully destructible voxel world with physical fluid and heat simulation. Dig anywhere, automate everything, and survey a world that was supposed to be empty.

detailed_descriptions.en: The terrain in FluxWerks is not a backdrop. It is a resource and a hazard. Strip-mine a mountain into nothing, then build your factory down into the hole it left. Dig below a lake and the water pours in behind you. Heat crosses from block to block, and storms wear down every machine you leave in the open. The scan said this world was empty A long-range scan found a temperate, oxygen-rich, unoccupied world. You are the preparation unit, sent far ahead to raise an industrial base, survey the planet, and transmit everything home. The orders are simple. But a scan taken from that far away does not catch everything, and the closer you look at this world, the less empty it seems. Key features Total voxel freedom Every block in the world can be mined, moved, or built over. Strip-mine a mountain with excavators, carve a bunker into deep rock, or build a platform across the open ocean and a tunnel underneath it. Dynamic fluid simulation Water, oil, lava and acid flow through the world and react where they meet. Water on lava makes obsidian. Water on hot ground boils away. Volcanoes erupt for real, and lava does not care what you built in its path. Heat is physical Waste heat does not just vanish away. It moves through the blocks around your machines, so how and where you build matters as much as what you build. Pipe the heat away, or turn it back into power. Deep automation and logistics Build dense assembly lines from belts, inserters and pipes, and cover long distances with cargo drones. Copy any working section of your factory as a blueprint and stamp it anywhere. The nanobot swarm You touch the world through a nanobot swarm. Point it at terrain to clear it, at resources to harvest them, at a blueprint to print it. Your exhaust does not just disappear FluxWerks has no enemy factions, but the planet keeps score. Pollute the air heavily enough and something dormant in the soil might awaken... Explore a world with a past Cross deserts, jungles, tundra and volcanic wastes, and dig into cave systems. Scan for ore straight through solid rock. Points of interest are scattered across the world, with story background to uncover. Weather wears things down Rain, blizzards, sandstorms and lightning cross the world on their own schedule, and machines wear out with exposure. Keeping repairs flowing is its own supply chain. Research across eras Climb from your first furnace to industrial chemistry and advanced electronics. Every research era asks for a noticeably bigger factory than the last, and each one unlocks machines that change how you build, not just how fast you build. The computing layer Advanced machines draw on a shared computing reserve produced by your computer clusters. A starved factory slows down, and computers draw real power and put out real heat, so datacenter management becomes a real puzzle to solve. Built for scale FluxWerks is designed for large factories, while still simulating the heat and fluids across the whole map. Fly freely around the world while the factory keeps running. The survey is waiting. Wishlist FluxWerks.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
The terrain in FluxWerks is not a backdrop. It is a resource and a hazard. Strip-mine a mountain into nothing, then build your factory down into the hole it left. Dig below a lake and the water pours in behind you. Heat crosses from block to block, and storms wear down every machine you leave in the open.

The scan said this world was empty

A long-range scan found a temperate, oxygen-rich, unoccupied world. You are the preparation unit, sent far ahead to raise an industrial base, survey the planet, and transmit everything home. The orders are simple. But a scan taken from that far away does not catch everything, and the closer you look at this world, the less empty it seems.

Key features

Total voxel freedom

Every block in the world can be mined, moved, or built over. Strip-mine a mountain with excavators, carve a bunker into deep rock, or build a platform across the open ocean and a tunnel underneath it.

Dynamic fluid simulation

Water, oil, lava and acid flow through the world and react where they meet. Water on lava makes obsidian. Water on hot ground boils away. Volcanoes erupt for real, and lava does not care what you built in its path.

Heat is physical

Waste heat does not just vanish away. It moves through the blocks around your machines, so how and where you build matters as much as what you build. Pipe the heat away, or turn it back into power.

Deep automation and logistics

Build dense assembly lines from belts, inserters and pipes, and cover long distances with cargo drones. Copy any working section of your factory as a blueprint and stamp it anywhere.

The nanobot swarm

You touch the world through a nanobot swarm. Point it at terrain to clear it, at resources to harvest them, at a blueprint to print it.

Your exhaust does not just disappear

FluxWerks has no enemy factions, but the planet keeps score. Pollute the air heavily enough and something dormant in the soil might awaken...

Explore a world with a past

Cross deserts, jungles, tundra and volcanic wastes, and dig into cave systems. Scan for ore straight through solid rock. Points of interest are scattered across the world, with story background to uncover.

Weather wears things down

Rain, blizzards, sandstorms and lightning cross the world on their own schedule, and machines wear out with exposure. Keeping repairs flowing is its own supply chain.

Research across eras

Climb from your first furnace to industrial chemistry and advanced electronics. Every research era asks for a noticeably bigger factory than the last, and each one unlocks machines that change how you build, not just how fast you build.

The computing layer

Advanced machines draw on a shared computing reserve produced by your computer clusters. A starved factory slows down, and computers draw real power and put out real heat, so datacenter management becomes a real puzzle to solve.

Built for scale

FluxWerks is designed for large factories, while still simulating the heat and fluids across the whole map. Fly freely around the world while the factory keeps running.

The survey is waiting. Wishlist FluxWerks.

games.name: FlyKnight Enhanced Edition
games.short_description: Explore, fight, loot and fish! Solo or in co-op mode in this Old School First Person Dungeon Crawler. Earn your knighthood as you oppose the evil witch Lunamoth and stop her curse which prevents everyone from growing wings.

descriptions.en: Explore, fight, loot and fish! Solo or in co-op mode in this Old School First Person Dungeon Crawler. Earn your knighthood as you oppose the evil witch Lunamoth and stop her curse which prevents everyone from growing wings.

detailed_descriptions.en: Flyknight tells the tale of a squire of the order of the Flyknights who is assembled to vanquish the witch Lunamoth and lift her curse, which is preventing the denizens of the realm from growing wings. Now separated after an ambush, the squire arriveth at the village of the swamp folk and pledges to see the mission through, either alone or teaming up with other fighters summoned to help along the way. Do you have what it takes to emerge victorious and claim Knighthood? Arm yourself with an arsenal of weapons and choose what's best for the situation at hand: chop off a foe's arm to prevent aggression, crush their head to deprive them of senses, fight out of their range with long weapons or arrows. Approach each encounter tactically to prevail! Traverse a hand crafted environment with many sidepaths filled with loot and dangerous encounters, survive from checkpoint to checkpoint and prove your skills against fierce bosses that want you dead! Summon a friend and progress through Lunamoth's lair together: divide and conquer, trade items and make gestures. 2 to 4 players can play together and progress is saved for everyone involved! Take a breather at checkpoints and pull out your fishing rod. Fill up your fish bag with nutritious creatures that will give you buffs and advantages in combat should you use them wisely... Thorough exploration of the dungeon will yield great rewards, customize your equipment to your hearts content and build a character that feels your own. The free update, Enhanced Edition version contains: Hard Difficulty which contains redesigned areas, new enemies and redesigned Bossfights New Item types like Wands, Chitin Charms, Battletomes and new Healing Flasks Randomized itemization and enemy spawn optional modes, adjusted with Reasonable and Chaos options A New Game+ system that makes the game harder with each loop

games.name: Foghorns Drown
games.short_description: You're a ferryman in Birchwood, a remote village isolated beyond a lake veiled in thick fog. Mysteries and folklore haunt your dreams in this narrative-driven psychological horror game.

descriptions.en: You're a ferryman in Birchwood, a remote village isolated beyond a lake veiled in thick fog. Mysteries and folklore haunt your dreams in this narrative-driven psychological horror game.

detailed_descriptions.en: The chain is stubborn. The fog is restless. The air smells like tar. The foghorns wake you, violent as ever. Another passenger has come to cross the fog. In the dream you wander through the pines, and come upon a body. Innocent and young, murdered in cold blood. By your hand or another? Makes no difference now. Foghorns Drown is a short psychological thriller, inspired by Silent Hill, Twin Peaks, and Mouthwashing. You play as a ferryman, bringing passengers across a foggy lake to a town drenched in mystery and folklore. The old ferryman has disappeared, and a murder has been committed. How to tell real from dream when the dead speak again? Features: Physics-based interactions to open doors, drag objects, and operate the crank of the ferry to pull it along a rusty old chain. The foghorns have little patience, the ferry must move. A rich, detailed narrative told through environmental clues, dialogue with the townsfolk, and surreal visions woven into your experience. The fog speaks to those who listen. Psychological horror that escalate as truth begins to blur, and strange old tales begin to reveal themselves to you. Something in the water demands its toll. Who is the killer? Why did the old ferryman disappear? Solve the mystery, before it's too late.

games.name: Fogpiercer
games.short_description: Fight through the fog in this sci-fi roguelike deckbuilder where clever positioning, explosive chain-reactions, and the environment itself can make the difference between life and death.

descriptions.en: Fight through the fog in this sci-fi roguelike deckbuilder where clever positioning, explosive chain-reactions, and the environment itself can make the difference between life and death.

detailed_descriptions.en: As a deadly fog descends upon the world, the future of humanity rests in your hands! Assemble your train to determine your starting deck, plot your path through the bandit-infested world, and prepare for high-octane turn-based tactical battles where powerful synergies, clever positioning, and carefully planned chain-reactions determine the victor. Choose from a variety of locomotives, carriages, and drivers to lead your expedition, with each decision adding a different set of cards to your starting deck, impacting the options and abilities you’ll have access to throughout your run. Gather resources to upgrade or purchase additional carriages that add more tactical tools to your deck as you journey through the fog and face off against a growing variety of enemy types with unique weapons, traits, strengths, and weaknesses. Will you rely on the spread and firepower of a minigun to quickly dispatch your enemies, use artillery to violently force chasing vehicles off-course, or hunker down behind shields and ram through your foes instead? From hackers that can deploy decoys and take control of enemy vehicles to cranes that can push them around the battlefield, there are many ways to overcome the danger posed by the bandits and their leaders. Secure unique card upgrades and experiment with unexpected combinations to reveal powerful synergies – each with their own risks and opportunities. With only a limited number of action points to use per turn, meticulous planning and careful execution will level the playing field as you face an enemy that constantly outnumbers and surrounds you. Force the enemy into the path of oncoming environmental dangers, push them off cliffs and into each other, or trick them into attacking one another as they telegraph their moves so you can plan yours. A clever use of Coal combined with a well placed Artillery Shot can force an enemy onto the tracks in front of you, only to be immediately crushed under your wheels. That same Artillery Shot could be used to destroy a leading vehicle and send it tumbling backwards to damage (and possibly destroy) everyone driving behind it, potentially paired with hacking cards that give you a chance to line more vehicles up first. The right order of operations will allow you to devastate the enemy convoys. With over 170 cards featuring various status effects, support capabilities, damage outputs, and more, you’ll want to build a train that matches your preferred playstyle and unlocks powerful opportunities. Collateral damage, chain reactions, and manipulating the battlefield are all critical elements en route to victory. Travel from region to region as you race to the edge of the fog, picking and choosing your path depending on a region’s specific modifiers and special rewards on offer. Branching paths within a region further allow you to finetune your route to the final destination based on the risks and rewards presented by each node along the way, ranging from battlefields to friendly waystations where you can upgrade and repair your train. Every battlefield is different – some will see an ally come to your aid, others will give you less room to navigate and dodge the enemy, while still others might take place along the edge of a cliff creating a constant environmental hazard to use against your enemies. Many battlefields will offer a combination of factors that can help or hinder your advance, rewarding you with additional cards, modifiers, and scrap resources to use on your journey ahead. Chop shops and depots allow you to repair your carriages and locomotive, potentially giving you the opportunity to upgrade them and unlock additional cards, or buy and sell carriages to further modify your deck. Meanwhile, random encounters can provide rare opportunities in an otherwise unforgiving landscape, and boss battles at the end of each region will pit you against special characters on the battlefield, each with their own unique backstories and abilities to go with them. Metaprogression allows you to unlock additional carriages, drivers, and locomotives to seek out new combinations and opportunities for future runs, or focus on upgrading your favorites to unlock even more cards to use in combat – the bandits are relentless and unforgiving, and while your choices during a run will have a significant impact, your choices between runs can unlock entirely new options to explore. Fogpiercer puts you at the head of a rampaging train as it races towards safety and the future of humanity – intense turn-based tactical battles will see you constantly outgunned and outnumbered, but a shrewd tactician will always find a way to keep things on track.

games.name: Folk Emerging
games.short_description: Lead nomadic families through the Stone Age in this turn-based 4X strategy game with in-depth characters, cultures, and ecosystems. Explore the wilderness, hunt megafauna, outsmart competitors in trade & autobattler combat. Discover fire, agriculture, politics... and survive to tell the tale.

descriptions.en: Lead nomadic families through the Stone Age in this turn-based 4X strategy game with in-depth characters, cultures, and ecosystems. Explore the wilderness, hunt megafauna, outsmart competitors in trade & autobattler combat. Discover fire, agriculture, politics... and survive to tell the tale.

detailed_descriptions.en: Lead nomadic families through the Stone Age in this turn-based 4X strategy game with deeply simulated characters, cultures, and ecosystems. Explore the vast wilderness, gather and trade scarce resources, and stand your ground in risky autobattler combat. Discover fire, domestication, politics—and survive to tell the tale. Experience what prehistoric life was like by diving into this exploration of ecology, paleolithic societies, and the origins of culture. Before agriculture and settlements, we spent hundreds of thousands of years as nomadic hunter-gatherers. Guide your people as you migrate through harsh climates, each posing unique challenges. Manage the relationships between individuals, families, and tribes. Watch your collective adapt over countless generations. Beware the unintended consequences current choices can have on your great-great-great-grandchildren. Optimize your strategy before each autobattler skirmish, because a warrior is not just a warrior. When one falls in combat, the tribe loses not only a fighter but also a skilled hunter, family member, and carrier of hard-won wisdom passed down through the ages. Hunt, gather, and extract resources from the ecosystems around you, but tread carefully: nature is ruthless and you are at its mercy. Maintain the natural equilibrium or face sudden and unexpected challenges. Features Technology: a tech tree spanning the Pleistocene up to the start of the Bronze Age, covering skills from controlled fire and cooking, through domestication and agriculture, all the way to megalithic construction and the first cities. Culture: shape your tribe’s unique culture, with evolving cultural norms that differentiate you from your neighbors, affecting trade and war. Economy: resources are finite and their extraction affects the environment. Ecology: 9 unique climates, each with a complex and dynamic food web. Procedurally generated Earth-like maps based on realistic climate simulations. Many generations of deeply simulated individuals with heritable traits, all affecting various game systems. Narrative events that can alter the trajectory of your entire tribe. Social Networks: Dynamic social network visualization, enabling a new way to understand and manage family trees and relationships between members of your band. Diplomacy: trade, fight, or collaborate with other tribes.

games.short_description: Louisiana, 1933. Thirty years ago an entire wedding suddenly & mysteriously vanished on the island of Devil's Rock, and with it went the location of the lost treasure of Bellemore Manor. To find it, you might need to die too. A cozy, story-driven, point & click adventure game of the merry & macabre.

descriptions.en: Louisiana, 1933. Thirty years ago an entire wedding suddenly & mysteriously vanished on the island of Devil's Rock, and with it went the location of the lost treasure of Bellemore Manor. To find it, you might need to die too. A cozy, story-driven, point & click adventure game of the merry & macabre.

detailed_descriptions.en: DEVIL'S ROCK An island off the coast of Louisiana 1933 “Ever since I heard of the treasure inside Bellemore Manor I've been obsessed by it. People said the house was still haunted by the ghosts of the wedding that disappeared there decades ago, but if the ghosts knew where the treasure was hidden, I just had to ask them. But there's more to the treasure than I could have ever expected, and now I've awakened a household of spirits who don't mind that they're dead, and an evil phantom determined to find the treasure before I do. Fixing the situation won't just mean getting to the treasure first, but also figuring out what happened on the island all those years ago. But I have a feeling that in order to do that, I'll have to die too.” – The Diary of Murphy McCallan A merry & macabre mystery puzzle game set on the enigmatic island of Devil's Rock in 1930s Louisiana Spooky not scary - a cozy game with no deaths, dead-ends, or scares Classic-style adventure game puzzles with over 100 items to pick up and use - plus a built-in hint system Piece together the clues to find out what happened in Bellemore Manor thirty years ago More than 75 gorgeous hand-drawn locations at full HD resolution, plus dozens more paintings, documents, and other details to investigate A full-length experience, with a gameplay time equal to Monkey Island and Broken Sword High quality animation from a professional animation studio More than two hours of original music, including an interactive big band song Fully voiced, with more than 35 characters to interact with Starring AJ LoCascio as Murphy McCallan (Marty McFly in Back to the Future: The Game , Han Solo in LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga , Gambit in X-Men ’97, and many more). Foolish Mortals contains no AI-generated content. All characters, backgrounds, graphics, animations, music, and voice acting were created by real human artists. Check out the Foolish Mortals Artbook DLC for a showcase of the making of the game.

An island off the coast of Louisiana
1933

“Ever since I heard of the treasure inside Bellemore Manor I've been obsessed by it. People said the house was still haunted by the ghosts of the wedding that disappeared there decades ago, but if the ghosts knew where the treasure was hidden, I just had to ask them.

But there's more to the treasure than I could have ever expected, and now I've awakened a household of spirits who don't mind that they're dead, and an evil phantom determined to find the treasure before I do.

Fixing the situation won't just mean getting to the treasure first, but also figuring out what happened on the island all those years ago. But I have a feeling that in order to do that, I'll have to die too.”

– The Diary of Murphy McCallan

  • More than 75 gorgeous hand-drawn locations at full HD resolution, plus dozens more paintings, documents, and other details to investigate

games.short_description: Step into the dugout and experience the future of football management.

descriptions.en: Step into the dugout and experience the future of football management.

detailed_descriptions.en: New foundations set the stage for you to define your football destiny. Made with the Unity engine, FM26 is the legacy, redefined and where storytelling evolves. A reimagined interface and more immersive match day experience brings you closer to the action and combine to elevate every match-defining moment. Transform your squad with advanced transfer tools and craft your footballing philosophy like never before with new innovations that deliver unrivalled game-changing tactical realism. Victory in football’s biggest international tournament is within your reach. Explore new tools for managing national teams alongside a competition-specific start date for FIFA World Cup 2026™, now officially licensed with authentic broadcast graphics, tournament branding, match balls and kits. Savour the richest Match Day experience in series history, bringing new levels of depth and drama to every match with enhanced player movement and greater on-pitch detail. Feel the adrenaline of a weaving run, inch-perfect through ball and unforgettable, last-gasp title winner with more personality thanks to fresh motion capture and volumetric animations. Compete at the pinnacle of English football as the Premier League debuts with fully-licensed club badges, kits and official player photos. Authenticity reaches new heights as you pursue the biggest prize in domestic football with the full broadcast experience from the best seat in the house. Exercise unparalleled control over how your team plays across every area of the pitch with the introduction of distinct In and Out of Possession formations. Redefined player roles and a dynamic visualiser that shows how your team shapes up in different scenarios levels up your pre-match prep game in, game out. An overhauled UI primed for the modern manager offers a cleaner look-and-feel, with the new Portal bringing together every aspect of your footballing world. Tailor your game to your priorities with the introduction of quick link Bookmarks and learn more about the beautiful game with an overhauled Search and new FMPedia glossary. Explore a new world of possibilities as the women’s game debuts, seamlessly integrated into FM as one footballing world. With 14 playable leagues from 11 nations, including the Women’s Super League and National Women’s Soccer League, there are fresh challenges and new talents to discover in each career. Harness the power of TransferRoom™ to smartly shape your title-winning squads season after season. Broadcast your recruitment priorities with Requirements and gain direct insight into your rivals’ needs with Pitch Opportunities, giving you more targeted control over every signing and sale. Express more of your personality and style in every career with a revamped manager creation experience. Craft your look with an enhanced character creator before developing a career backstory that’s unique to you and uniquely influential on your life in the dugout. In FM26, football belongs to you and your vision. games.name: Football, Tactics & Glory
games.short_description: XCOM meets Football Manager. Develop your club, earn experience in turn-based matches, learn new skills, achieve new classes, upgrade your facilities, buy and sell footballers, grow your youth academy, make difficult choices. It's a deep strategy game that respects your time.

descriptions.en: XCOM meets Football Manager. Develop your club, earn experience in turn-based matches, learn new skills, achieve new classes, upgrade your facilities, buy and sell footballers, grow your youth academy, make difficult choices. It's a deep strategy game that respects your time.

detailed_descriptions.en: Why choose Football, Tactics & Glory when there are other football managers? If you’ve played traditional football managers, you’re probably familiar with the following feelings: Complex attributes : Footballers have many attributes, and you don’t always understand which ones truly affect the match outcome. Often, the only strategy becomes buying high-level players instead of finding a footballer whose unique attribute perfectly suits your tactics. Unclear results : You never really know why you win or lose. This forces players to search for "winning" formations on forums instead of analysing the opponent and consciously selecting footballers capable of exploiting their weaknesses. Financial complexity : Club funds quickly disappear, and it’s hard to understand how to manage finances and strategically plan expenditures. Football, Tactics & Glory is a game about full control and a complete understanding of what’s happening on the pitch and in the club: Transparency of attributes : You always know exactly how each footballer’s attribute impacts the encounters, allowing you to customise formations for each opponent, defeating even stronger teams with the right player selection and tactical approach. This also makes transfers much more interesting and exciting. Control over tactics : Feel like a real coach, making smart tactical decisions, not just changing formations hoping for luck. Control over luck : Luck plays a big role, as in real football. But you can minimise its impact by understanding your players’ abilities and building the team around your playstyle. Strategic financial planning : The game’s economy is designed so that you always feel in control of your finances. The game demonstrates the importance of strategies like "developing" footballers for sale and finding promising talents who will become your future stars. No micromanagement : This is a game about strategic planning , not micromanagement. Instead of wasting time on increasing an attribute by 0.01%, you make decisions that significantly affect the club’s fate. Therefore, the game lacks the boring elements of football managers: endless spreadsheets, routine tasks, and unimportant mechanics. Great variety : FTG is so deep that even after hundreds of hours, you’ll continue discovering new and interesting things. The game world develops uniquely each time, creating new challenges and exciting emergent stories. This makes each campaign different from the last one. The game values your time : You can complete one football season in a few real hours instead of days, as in other football managers.
