detailed_descriptions.en: WE DID IT AGAIN! If you thought the first chapter was awesome, well, buckle up because we are going to blow you away with incredible new features! MORE WHEELS FOR YOUR FUN First things first: make room on your virtual shelf because you can access more than 130 vehicles, and even more varieties! Yes, not only Hot Wheels™ Originals, but also Hot Wheels™ Monster Trucks and vehicles from the entertainment world. Now you can also ride motorbikes and ATVs, each with their own unique racing style to take on every track in the most strategic way! A brand new system will define the vehicles’ category, which can be upgraded with the dedicated skill tree that will directly affect their performance. Watch your car become unstoppable! NEW PLACES TO CALL HOME Whether it's the backyard of a house in the suburbs or a mini-golf course in a village in the Wild West, your tracks will be surrounded by the most stunning environments! Discover 5 brand new locations, master their secrets, and you'll feel right at home both there and on the podium. New terrains are another fantastic new entry that will make your races even more exciting and challenging. Grass, sand and more will directly affect the handling of the vehicle: something to keep in mind when you’ll choose your ride. Strategy plays an even bigger role now! SHOW OFF YOUR MOVES Before impressing your opponents with a great victory, leave them speechless with new crazy moves! In addition to Drift and Boost, now you can show off your Lateral Dash and Single or Double Jump. Use them wisely and at the right time to bump into your rivals and kick them off the track… or simply to avoid those barriers! And with the new Jumps you can skip the traffic ahead and also find new secret shortcuts! JUST THE WAY YOU LIKE IT Are you a daredevil who turns every race into pure adrenaline? Or maybe you're the type who likes to test their limits? Did you say “fan of huge crashes”? Well, HOT WHEELS UNLEASHED™ 2 - Turbocharged brings to the table all of that and much more. Different game modes for whatever “fun” means to you, off and online. UNLEASH YOUR CREATIVITY! The most acclaimed editors are back! Create the track of your dreams with the powerful Track Editor, or use the best creations from the community! And of course, beautiful tracks call for awesome cars. The new and improved Livery Editor is what you need: with new tools like the Stickers Editor you can design and save patterns and shapes, to create your masterpiece. We are sure the best one will come from your imagination! IT’S A WHOLE NEW STORY Literally. The new campaign mode features a brand new and original story-driven adventure! The city is under attack and only you can save it from the creatures. How? Easy, winning exciting dedicated races and challenges! Ok, it won’t actually be that easy… but it will surely be exciting! So get ready to be not just a winner, but a real hero!

descriptions.en: Step into the shoes of a hotel owner as you design, build, and manage grand hotels around the world. Juggle demanding guests, frantic logistics, and plenty of unexpected surprises in Hotel Architect; the ultimate hotel construction and tycoon management game!
descriptions.zh-Hant: 缔造您的連鎖酒店商業帝國！設計酒店，調度員工，應對賓客，招待挑剔的評論家，從家庭旅館到豪華五星酒店，親手書寫屬於您的商業傳奇。從邊陲小鎮、風景名勝，到繁華都市，讓您的酒店遍布世界上每個值得駐足的地方。現在，邁出第一步，開啟您的酒店大亨人生。
descriptions.ja: ホテルオーナーとなって、世界各地に自分だけのグランドホテルをデザイン・建設して経営しましょう。わがままなゲストへの対応や、カオスな物流、そして次々と降りかかるハプニング。そのすべてを体験できるのが『Hotel Architect』。まさに、究極のホテル建設＆経営シミュレーションゲーム！
descriptions.ko: 갖가지 다양한 호텔을 관리하고 전 세계의 온갖 고객에게 서비스를 제공합니다. 레이아웃을 구축 및 설계하고, 물류를 최적화하며, 원하는 대로 모양을 사용자 지정할 수 있습니다. 말도 안 되는 문제를 해결하고 투숙객의 괴팍한 요구도 받아주어 제 아무리 혹독한 비평가라도 감동시킵니다.

detailed_descriptions.en: Ready to take charge as the new owner of a flourishing hotel empire? Your job? To design, build, and manage grand hotels scattered across the globe. You’ll juggle demanding guests, keep your establishment running smoothly, and face a delightful array of unexpected challenges. All this and more awaits you in Hotel Architect: the ultimate hotel construction and tycoon management game! Demonstrate your managerial prowess and creative talent as you build your hotel from the ground up in Career Mode or let your imagination run wild in Sandbox Mode. Rejuvenate rundown buildings or transform empty plots into five-star destinations that tower above the Empire State Building – figuratively and literally! Design and dress lobbies that are sure to inspire envy in any would-be rival hoteliers! Make each hotel your own with an expansive range of décor and furnishings tailored to the needs of your guests and your establishment’s unique style. Explore endless combinations across multiple floors with numerous zones and amenities available to construct. There are no limits; want to build a prison-style hotel that maximizes how many rooms you offer, regardless of how your guests feel? Or how about a pyramid-shaped building that offers some…strange amenities? Make every hotel your own! In the fast-paced world of hospitality, you’ll need to impress the harshest critics, satisfy the most demanding of guests, and tame logistical chaos behind-the-scenes to earn that coveted 5-star rating. Hire the right staff, balance your finances, and make the tough calls; Will you splash out on a world class chef at the risk of hiring a clumsy receptionist? The choice is yours! Get ready to check-in to Hotel Architect; where your creativity meets clientele challenges, and every great stay begins with a little chaos! Build your Dreams in Career or Sandbox Mode Climb the ranks in Career Campaign Mode by completing a variety of objectives, or play in the Sandbox Mode available for each location. Dynamic Building Meets Careful Planning Design your own hotel from the ground up or breathe new life into a neglected property. Design layouts, hire construction crews, and watch your vision come to life in real time. Plan carefully though. Annoy, disturb, or remove items your guests are using, and your reviews might plummet! Design and Decorate Your Dream Hotel Customize every corner of your hotel! Set up themed zones, install amenities, and choose from a wide selection of furnishings, wallpaper, and flooring to create a five-star atmosphere that’s uniquely yours. Impress and Advance Every detail matters. Hospitality reviewers will scrutinize every room, every meal, every stay. Earn glowing ratings to attract wealthier guests and expand your growing hotel empire. Expand Your Hotel Empire to Global Heights Expand your hotel empire across multiple locations across the globe, each with their own unique character and challenges. Some sites will come with existing structures to build on, while others are blank slates waiting for you to make your mark. Manage Staff and Contractors Recruit and train a capable team to keep your hotel running smoothly. Each employee has unique attributes that influence their performance, and they’ll grow and level up as they gain experience! Balance staff levels with guest needs, and coordinate with contractors to manage supplies, restock pantries, and keep every room spotless. Welcome Your Guests Adapt as demanding guests, special events, and unpredictable situations keep you on your toes. Meet expectations or brace yourself for the reviews!
detailed_descriptions.zh-Hant: 從破敗舊樓改造到空地起高樓，打造比帝國大廈還高的豪華酒店。精準規劃酒店的房間吧！花最少的錢讓你的酒店賺得更多！記住：千萬不要打擾正在使用設施的客人，否則差評分分鐘就會找上門。 你的酒店落成，現在可以開業了——等等！這樣可不能接待賓客！佈置房間、設計功能區——大堂、餐廳、行政酒廊、洗衣房、健身房……每一處細節都決定著客人的入住體驗，從精緻的客房擺件到寬敞的公共空間，由你親手勾勒酒店的專屬風格。 孤軍奮戰可不行，你需要找些得力助手。聘請員工，調度員工特長，把合適的人放在合適的崗位，讓開朗的費歐娜接待高效辦理入住，大廚保爾烹製美味餐食，勤勞的利亞維護酒店整潔。人盡其才，才能實現利潤口碑雙豐收！ 恭喜你，擁有了第一家五星酒店！但是，相信你不會滿足於此。把你的商業版圖拓展到世界各地吧！解鎖全新城市，每個城市都不一樣的全新體驗：都市的繁華、小鎮的惬意、風景名勝的忙碌——在每個城市都留下你的旗幟吧，這才叫連鎖酒店
detailed_descriptions.ja: 急成長するホテル帝国の新たなオーナーとして、第一歩を踏み出しましょう。あなたのミッションは、世界中にさまざまなグランドホテルをデザイン・建設して経営すること。 わがままなゲストをさばき、ホテルを円滑に運営しながら、次々と巻き起こる予想外のハプニングに立ち向かう。そのすべてを体験できるのが『Hotel Architect』。まさに、究極のホテル建設＆経営シミュレーションゲーム！ 「キャリアモード」でゼロからホテルを作り上げ、経営手腕とクリエイティブな才能を発揮しましょう。「サンドボックスモード」では、想像力の赴くままに自由にプレイすることも可能です。 老朽化した建物を生まれ変わらせたり、まっさらな土地から超高層の5つ星ホテルを建築したり。ライバルが嫉妬するような、圧巻のロビーをデザインしてみましょう！ 豊富なインテリアや家具で、世界に一つだけのホテルに仕上げましょう。フロアをまたいだ数々のゾーンとアメニティを自由に組み合わせれば、可能性は無限大！客室数を最優先した"刑務所スタイル"ホテルや、ちょっと奇妙なアメニティが揃うピラミッド型ビルなど思いのまま。すべてのホテルを、あなたの作品に。 変化の激しいホスピタリティの世界で、憧れの5つ星評価を手に入れるには？手厳しい批評家を唸らせ、わがままなゲストを満足させ、舞台裏の物流カオスをねじ伏せること。 ふさわしいスタッフを雇い、財務のバランスを取りながら、時にはタフな決断を下しましょう。不器用なフロント係を雇うリスクを承知で、世界クラスのシェフに大金を投じることも。選択はすべてあなた次第！ さあ、『Hotel Architect』へチェックイン。あなたの創造性とゲスト対応が試される、ワクワクとカオスが詰まった世界が待っています！ ダイナミックな建設と綿密な計画の融合 理想のホテルをゼロから設計するのも、放置された物件を華やかに再生させるのも、すべてはあなた次第。レイアウトを練って建設チームを雇えば、あなたのビジョンがリアルタイムで形になっていく様子を目の当たりにできます。ただし、計画は慎重に！宿泊客の邪魔をしたり、使用中のアイテムをいきなり撤去したりすると、レビューが一気にガタ落ちすることも！ 夢のホテルをデザイン＆デコレーション ホテルのすみずみまでカスタマイズ！テーマゾーンを設置したりアメニティを導入したり、数多くのチョイスから家具や壁紙・床材を選んで、自分だけの5つ星空間を作り上げましょう。 評価を勝ち取って、上を目指そう 細部まで手を抜くことはできません。覆面審査員は、すべての部屋、すべての食事、すべての滞在を細かくチェックします。高評価を獲得して富裕層ゲストを呼び込み、成長するホテル帝国をさらに広げていきましょう。 ホテル帝国を世界規模に 世界各地の複数のロケーションへホテル帝国を拡大しましょう。それぞれ独自の個性と挑戦が待っています。既存の建物を活用できる場所もあれば、一から自分らしさを刻める更地もあります。 スタッフと業者をマネジメント 優秀なチームを採用・育成して、ホテルを円滑に運営しましょう。スタッフそれぞれが独自の特性を持ち、経験を積むごとにレベルアップしていきます！ スタッフの配置とゲストのニーズのバランスを取りながら、業者と連携して物資を管理し、食料庫を補充し、すべての部屋を清潔に保ちましょう。 ゲストを温かく迎えよう わがままなゲストや特別なイベント、次々と降りかかる予測不能な事態をさばいていきましょう。期待に応えるか、手厳しいレビューを覚悟するか。すべてあなた次第です！
detailed_descriptions.ko: 매일이 너무나 바쁘게 돌아가는 호텔 주인이 되어 세계 곳곳에 거대 호텔을 디자인하고 건설하세요. 최고의 호텔 건설 및 타이쿤 매니지먼트 게임 Hotel Architect에서 점점 더 복잡해지는 어지러운 손님들의 요구, 악몽의 물류, 예상치 못한 장애물을 체험하세요. 빈 땅에서 자유롭게 창의력을 발휘하며 호텔을 건설해 숙박업계로 뛰어드세요. 커리어 캠페인 또는 샌드박스 모드에서 낡은 건물을 개조하거나 빈 부지에 엠파이어 스테이트 호텔보다 높은 호텔을 건설한 뒤 리츠의 손님들이 질투할 로비를 만드세요. 손님의 요구에 맞춘 다양한 장식과 가구로 나만의 개성을 더하세요. 호텔 건설 시 제공되는 다양한 층과 구역, 어메니티로 무한한 조합을 실험하세요. 만일 사우나에 바가 있어야 할 거 같다면, 그냥 만들면 됩니다! 가혹한 비평가들을 달래고, 다양한 손님들의 요구를 충족하고, 물류 수송 중 발생하는 예상치 못한 사건들을 해결하며 정신없이 빠르게 진행되는 호텔 업무를 해치우고 5성급 호텔이 되세요. 각자 자신의 능력을 시험하게 될 여러 직원들 중 내게 필요한 사람을 고용하고, 재무도 관리하세요. 세계 최고의 셰프를 고용하기 위해, 조금 덤벙대는 리셉션 직원을 구해야 할 수도 있습니다. 이 상황을 감수하실 수 있나요? 선택은 당신의 몫입니다! Hotel Architect에 체크인할 준비를 하세요! 커리어 캠페인 모드를 진행하세요. 다양한 목표를 달성하고, 곳곳에. 나만의 호텔을 완전히 처음부터 새로 만들거나, 버려진 곳을 개조하여 잘나가는 호텔로 바꾸세요. 구조를 디자인하고, 공사할 사람들을 고용하여 토대를 깐 뒤 여러 층으로 구성된 다양한 시설을 만드세요. 건설 시에는 신중한 설계가 필요합니다. 또한 실시간으로 게임이 진행되니 손님들이 쓰고 있는 물건을 건드리거나 제거하지 마세요. 그러면 나쁜 리뷰 점수를 받을 테니까요! 건물 곳곳에 개성 있는 여러 구역을 마음대로 선택하여 설치하세요. 샌드박스 스타일 게임 플레이에서는 다양한 어메니티와 장식, 벽지를 선택하며 꿈의 호텔을 만들 수 있습니다. 호텔 리뷰어들은 호텔의 모든 면을 평가합니다. 리뷰 점수가 높을수록 더 많은 손님들이 모이며 최고의 호텔 왕국을 만들기 위한 길로 인도합니다. 각자 나름의 개성이 있는 세계 곳곳의 장소로 호텔 왕국을 확장하세요. 이미 건물이나 토대가 이미 건설된 곳도 있을 수 있고, 처음부터 완전히 새로 시작해야 하는 것도 있을 수 있습니다. 호텔 손님에 맞춰 직원을 고용하세요. 각 직원들은 정해진 능력치를 가지고 있으며, 이것은 작업에 긍정적이거나 부정적인 영향을 미칩니다. 이들의 레벨을 높여 더욱 뛰어난 직원으로 만들어주세요! 외부 업체를 불러 물류를 관리하고, 쓰레기를 치우고, 창고를 채우고, 호텔을 깨끗하게 유지하세요. 계속 긴장하며 엄청난 손님들이 점점 더 정교한 요구 사항을 내놓는 새로운 시나리오에 적응하세요.

games.name: Hotel Galactic
games.short_description: Welcome to Imoshima - an island floating in the clouds! Run a cozy intergalactic hotel where everyone wants to return. Build, decorate, cook, and discover the stories of your cosmic guests. It's a game about friendship set in a hand-drawn world inspired by iconic Japanese animation.

descriptions.en: Welcome to Imoshima - an island floating in the clouds! Run a cozy intergalactic hotel where everyone wants to return. Build, decorate, cook, and discover the stories of your cosmic guests. It's a game about friendship set in a hand-drawn world inspired by iconic Japanese animation.

detailed_descriptions.en: Create a Home Away from Home Looking for a place where you can just take a breath? Welcome to Hotel Galactic ! It's a tale of friendship , trust, and creating a space where everyone – no matter what corner of the galaxy they come from – feels safe. Settle on the cloud-drifting Island of Imoshima and build a hotel that will become the true heart of this world , welcoming travelers from across the endless galaxy. Who knows what story the next guest crossing your threshold will bring? Forget about cold spreadsheets or demanding management and immerse yourself in a warm, magical world to take a breath and feel truly friendly warmth. Build and Decorate Your Way With the help of your trusty crew of workers, the island will quickly fill with new rooms. Design everything from scratch: cozy guest bedrooms , spacious dining rooms filled with the smell of delicious food, game rooms with arcades, and even a relaxing spa with massage tables and a sauna! Play with styles and colors - you have a whole host of unique furniture and cozy decorations at your disposal to give the interiors exactly the vibe you want. Meet Guests from Across the Galaxy Wanderers from all kinds of fantastic races will knock on your door. Each of them has their own deep backstory, unique character, and... specific requirements. Win their appreciation by tailoring rooms to their needs. When an object they know so well from their own planet appears in their room, they'll surely feel better right away. Show them heart and hospitality, and they'll share their stories and bonds of friendship with you. The Way to the Heart is Through the Stomach What would a good hotel be without delicious food? Start a garden , take care of it, get a variety of seeds and grow cosmic plants to get ingredients that guarantee the best quality dishes served in the hotel restaurant . Cook dishes that will perfectly hit the cosmic palates of your guests, taking into account their culinary preferences. After all, nothing brings people together like a shared, warm meal! Expand Your Possibilities Discover new technologies that will help you meet hotel challenges. New styles, furniture, decorations, and even staff uniforms - it's all at your fingertips thanks to a network of merchants who are always ready to help you and provide the necessary raw materials or extra hands to work!

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Create a Home Away from Home

Looking for a place where you can just take a breath? Welcome to Hotel Galactic! It's a tale of friendship, trust, and creating a space where everyone – no matter what corner of the galaxy they come from – feels safe.

Settle on the cloud-drifting Island of Imoshima and build a hotel that will become the true heart of this world, welcoming travelers from across the endless galaxy. Who knows what story the next guest crossing your threshold will bring?

Forget about cold spreadsheets or demanding management and immerse yourself in a warm, magical world to take a breath and feel truly friendly warmth.

Build and Decorate Your Way

With the help of your trusty crew of workers, the island will quickly fill with new rooms. Design everything from scratch: cozy guest bedrooms, spacious dining rooms filled with the smell of delicious food, game rooms with arcades, and even a relaxing spa with massage tables and a sauna!

Play with styles and colors - you have a whole host of unique furniture and cozy decorations at your disposal to give the interiors exactly the vibe you want.

Meet Guests from Across the Galaxy

Wanderers from all kinds of fantastic races will knock on your door. Each of them has their own deep backstory, unique character, and... specific requirements. Win their appreciation by tailoring rooms to their needs. When an object they know so well from their own planet appears in their room, they'll surely feel better right away. Show them heart and hospitality, and they'll share their stories and bonds of friendship with you.

The Way to the Heart is Through the Stomach

What would a good hotel be without delicious food? Start a garden, take care of it, get a variety of seeds and grow cosmic plants to get ingredients that guarantee the best quality dishes served in the hotel restaurant. Cook dishes that will perfectly hit the cosmic palates of your guests, taking into account their culinary preferences. After all, nothing brings people together like a shared, warm meal!

Expand Your Possibilities

Discover new technologies that will help you meet hotel challenges. New styles, furniture, decorations, and even staff uniforms - it's all at your fingertips thanks to a network of merchants who are always ready to help you and provide the necessary raw materials or extra hands to work!

games.name: House Builder
games.short_description: Become a one-man construction crew! Travel around the world and through the ages to build iconic designs! Beware of unpleasant temperatures and dangerous fauna!

descriptions.en: Become a one-man construction crew! Travel around the world and through the ages to build iconic designs! Beware of unpleasant temperatures and dangerous fauna!

detailed_descriptions.en: Become one man construction crew and build houses like a simple African mud hut and as complex as a super modern energy-saving architectural marvel. Let us take you on a trip to various spots on the globe and experience true architectural variety. You will try to build a mud hut in Africa, an igloo in the Arctic, a Canadian house, a log cabin in Siberia, a traditional house made of bricks, airbricks, or concrete, and many, many more… Every house consists of hundreds of elements you need to match according to the rules of construction. Learn new technologies See how construction technologies differ from each other. Learn how to apply proper materials and procedures during the building process. Build houses brick by brick, element after element, down from the foundations and up to the roof. Learn different structures of buildings, construction materials, their features, and their properties. Build simple constructions made of primitive materials, but also ultramodern buildings featuring the latest technological discoveries. Use unique mechanics Use various tools depending on the situation and requirements. Improve your skills, and use better equipment to be able to build complex structures quickly and efficiently. Demolition Sometimes there is no way out. Demolish everything in your path and start again! ABOUT HOUSE BUILDER The building is your hobby? Thanks to the House Builder you will become a one-man construction crew! Find a perfect piece of land and create something amazing there! Constructing is only limited by your imagination and bank balance… So control your resources, keep up with construction standards and raise buildings that everyone will love! HOUSE BUILDER – MAIN FEATURES: To build a first-class house, start with choosing the perfect location. You can select every place in the world! Boiling Africa, frosty Siberia, or tropical Amazon Rainforest? It’s up to you! Next, let’s focus on the project - you can create different types of buildings - from miserable little sheds to exclusive mansions. This will depend also on the materials you will use. Each of them has different properties. Using the wrong material will cause unpleasant consequences. Prove your cleverness and knowledge to prevent any glitches in construction. Over time your skill will be better and buildings more advanced. When all the pieces are set, it only takes a moment to finish and give a unique look to your house. The buyers will be delighted! MAIN FEATURES Build all over the world - Learn more about the architectural style of the region and let your imagination run wild! Learn new technologies - With every building your skill improves and new technologies will expedite your work. Demolish! - Some of the houses must be cleaned up and rebuilt from scratches. Go back in time - Travel across many periods in history and try to build all iconic designs Diverse climate - scorching and freezing temperatures can be a challenge to sustain. Be aware of dangerous fauna. Home Builder.

games.name: House Flipper
games.short_description: House Flipper is a unique chance to become a one-man renovation crew. Buy, repair and remodel devastated houses. Give them a second life and sell them at a profit!

descriptions.en: House Flipper is a unique chance to become a one-man renovation crew. Buy, repair and remodel devastated houses. Give them a second life and sell them at a profit!

detailed_descriptions.en: You've got to earn it around here before you purchase your first property. No worries though! Luckily, there's plenty of work at your fingertips! Take job offers from nearby residents - clean up, paint walls, install heaters, showers, and air conditioners, or even furnish their whole property! Once the grateful clients pay you for your solid work, it's time to get your own house. Grab your hammer! It's time to take a bit of a rude approach and knock some walls down! Get rid of broken glass shards, litter, and leftover pieces of furniture, to prepare the place for a complete makeover! It's up to you to either meet every single requirement of specific buyers or make yourself a cozy office to grow your business in. Fortunately, you're not alone. The set of your trustiest tools is here with ya! With the help of your paint roller, window cleaner, plaster tool, mop, hammer, and of course, the mighty tablet, no renovation will scare you! Using those tools also gives you experience, which can be used to upgrade them and polish your skills, making your work even more pleasant. Regardless if you plan to create the house of your dreams, help the residents with their renovations or feel the need to smack some walls - House Flipper is here for You! So just sit comfortably, let go off your usual daily routine, and delve into the world of House Flipper... into your world!

games.name: House Flipper - Dine Out DLC
games.short_description: Bring a breath of fresh air into the restaurant business with Dine Out DLC! Renovate a wide variety of establishments such as restaurants, cafes, and sushi bars. Create appealing interiors for sale and for rent, prepare dishes from all around the world and design restaurant signs.

descriptions.en: Bring a breath of fresh air into the restaurant business with Dine Out DLC! Renovate a wide variety of establishments such as restaurants, cafes, and sushi bars. Create appealing interiors for sale and for rent, prepare dishes from all around the world and design restaurant signs.

detailed_descriptions.en: Dine Out DLC will let you get your foot in the door of the restaurant business. It comes with a set of engaging, immersive quests that will allow you to explore and renovate a variety of restaurants, cafes, sushi bars, wine cellars and pizzerias. The DLC also introduces numerous new items, mechanics and other features that will make your House Flipper experience more fun and comfortable. Let them rent! House Flipper has always enabled you to buy and sell properties, but now we're unlocking the opportunity for long-term profit making! Choose from residential properties, restaurants, cafes, or offices, and lease your freshly renovated spaces. The rental price depends on the number of rooms, furnishings and the type of property – choose a tenant that suits you and sign the contract. Universal Cooker - One Click and Ready! As with previous House Flipper DLCs, Dine Out comes with new tools to play with. One of them is the Universal Cooker – a multifunctional device that will let you spread your wings in the restaurant business both as a flipper and a chef. Have a taste for Thai cuisine? Or maybe you have a soft spot for some Italian classics? Pick and choose from our extensive list of diverse dishes and design the menu of your restaurant. Purchase the ingredients and wait as the magical Universal Cooker does its job! Dishes prepared with the Universal Cooker can be later used as delicious pieces of decor. And if you own our previous add-on (Farm DLC), you can get discounts on some of the dishes depending on the crops you have in your inventory. More precision to stop collision! A well-planned and decorated interior and elegant table setting are all factors when it comes to customer satisfaction. If you feel you might need a little help getting the establishment ready for a steady influx of demanding clientele, we recommend you take a look at our new grid measurement system. Buy in bulk and place items exactly where they need to be. The new tool that comes with Dine Out DLC allows you to keep everything as symmetrical as you'd like. Being a perfectionist has never been easier! Cook up your own style Make sure your establishment becomes an institution thanks to an iconic restaurant sign. Dine Out DLC comes with a tool that allows you to customize the logo of your restaurant with a plethora of shapes, fonts, colors and patterns. Mix it up, experiment, or keep it simple – there is no single recipe for success. Key Features 10 engaging and immersive quests 10 houses to renovate and decorate 30 dishes from around the world to prepare Precise and symmetrical object placement on flat surfaces The ability to rent out restaurants, offices and houses The ability to design and build entresol to maximize space and add a touch of modern style. The ability to decorate kitchen tables with tablecloths The ability to design your own advertising and neon signs Over 1350 new items!

games.name: House Flipper - Pets DLC
games.short_description: It's finally time for finding your perfect renovation partner! Max, Phil, Bella? It's up to you to decide what's the name of your adopted companion. Take in an adorable pet and let him help you on your flipping journey in the friendly area of Cozy Village!

descriptions.en: It's finally time for finding your perfect renovation partner! Max, Phil, Bella? It's up to you to decide what's the name of your adopted companion. Take in an adorable pet and let him help you on your flipping journey in the friendly area of Cozy Village!

detailed_descriptions.en: Will you find a place for someone special in your recently renovated property? Thanks to Pets DLC you'll have a chance to take care of a lovely companion and have a wonderful time together! Your new furry buddy represents one of thirteen popular dog or cat breeds, but that's not the end of great news! The DLC will also allow you to choose between other animal species like rabbits, turtles, parrots, or hamsters! Take in your new pet, look after it and make it feel loved. Be sure to involve plenty of playtime, teach it, and make it feel comfortable in a new home! Create a unique relationship with your adorable housemate! Access an exclusive set of items and decor elements, which will let you design a cozy countryside house for you and your pet. Comfortable sofas, plushy pillows, and tons of decorations will help you on your journey! Don't forget about preparing a nice and warm spot for your sweet companion! A specially designed room and a play zone in the backyard should be wonderful. The new location and large open spaces will bring lots of pleasant memories. Discover new properties, from houses with cozy attics and terraces to huge 2-story countryside homes! Take care of an animal hotel in of the 11 special orders you can stumble upon in the breathtaking region of Cozy Village. Make sure all the requirements like play areas, water feeders, and food dispensers are present, and prepare yourself for more unique jobs! Create and design interiors not only for your clients but also for their beloved pet companions! Pets DLC contains: - 13 popular dog and cat breeds available! - Other domestic animal species like rabbits, turtles, parrots, and guinea pigs. - More than 800 new unique items. - 11 new ranch-themed properties and orders. Were you always dreaming of standing in front of your cozy countryside home with an adorable pet by your side? If the answer is "yes", then this DLC is here for you!

games.name: House Party
games.short_description: House Party is an edgy comedy adventure game inspired by classic comedies of the '90s. Every decision changes your story and every character has something to reveal. There’s also a button to take your pants off.

descriptions.en: House Party is an edgy comedy adventure game inspired by classic comedies of the '90s. Every decision changes your story and every character has something to reveal. There’s also a button to take your pants off.

detailed_descriptions.en: This hysterical, story-rich 3D adventure game is all about player choice and partying the way you want. House Party's unique AI and scripting system allows the game to shape and mold its content around your choices. You'll see something new or different each time you play. To date, there are hundreds of different stories, side-quests, and narratives, and thousands of branching stories and dynamic elements. Content is being added regularly, so it just keeps getting bigger and better! Each new game starts at the door as a blank canvas for your decisions. One big house, packed with choices Sweet news! Your buddy Derek invited you to a rager at Madison's house. Surrounded by a group of eccentric partygoers, you must navigate your way through the night - no matter how wild it gets! Step into a sandbox adventure party game where even your simplest choices can impact the game in a magnificent way. Explore thousands of unique branching narratives with fifteen distinct NPCs that react based on your every remark and action, paving the way for tons of hours of unpredictable and hilarious entertainment. House Party’s gameplay starts with the conversations and grows with the decisions made along the way. With no true ending but dozens of stories to navigate, the night is what you make it. Discover Items & Uncover Wild Interactions Explore a two-story house jam-packed with hundreds of items to discover, where every object has a purpose and some can be used in a variety of ways. Change the party's music with the mp3 player, invite a surprise guest over with the laptop, enjoy as many drinks as you can (without getting caught), and... well, we'll leave the most exciting surprises up to you to uncover. Show items to NPCs and they may react with varying dialogue or relationship fluctuations. Most of these hidden objects are vital for completing an NPC's personal storyline and winning their approval. Sometimes you don’t even need any items to cause a ruckus. Play your cards right and maybe you can win them over with your charm alone. NPCs (Not-Boring Party Comrades) You don't have to thank us, but we invited fifteen of our craziest and funniest acquaintances! A new-to-town sorority girl willing to do crazy things to fit in, the most brahsome brah around, a wild mud-wrestling southern belle, a freakishly buff straight-edge dude hawk-eyeing all the booze, and many more hilarious and unique personalities await. Listen closely and the characters will chat about your actions, conversations, and choices, and also provide hints and insights into cracking their stories open. Throughout the night, you may overhear information about their backstories or catch them gossiping about other guests at the party. Every NPC has favorite bands, personal beliefs, friends and enemies, and party goals for the night. Fully-voiced by amazingly talented voice actors and actresses, the partygoers feel vibrant and alive from the moment you set foot through the door. With fifteen of the most interesting, reactive, and hysterical NPC partygoers to ever exist and a rapidly growing roster, there is always plenty of social variety around the house. All of them have inner motivations and strong personal opinions, making them fun to make various choices around and amusing to see interact with one another! Make Friends, Enemies... or More? As you navigate the party, your words and actions will dictate whether each NPC digs your vibe or is seconds away from knocking your lights out. One bad decision might get you beaten to a pulp, while a good choice might result in making an ally that will have your back for the rest of the night. Every response you choose when speaking to an NPC changes how they feel about you. Keep an eye on your social gauges and watch your gameplay impact whether an NPC is crushing on you, feels so-so about you, sees you as a good friend, or hates your guts. Relationship values, good or bad, may open new doors. And, whether you're into guy love or girl love, it's possible to win most characters' hearts for steamy romantic fun at this party! NPCs will respond differently whether they like you, love you, or hate you, unlocking or blocking off potential party choices and unique interactions. They also see what you do and hear what you say, so be careful because one small choice can change everything. Interact With Celebrity Guests Ever heard of the Game Grumps? Make the right choices and you may find Dan and Arin landing unexpectedly in the middle of the house party! Explore their unique storyline, watch them hilariously navigate the festivities, and choose from one of the multiple paths to help them get back to their show! Looking for a hot Spanish tutor to hop in and shake things up? Your decisions could make Lety Does Stuff come knocking on the front door. Explore her wild and crazy side story if you want a real taste of adventure! As one of the only indie studios to ever integrate real-life celebrities into a video game, it has been a ton of fun connecting the guests to the story and welcoming the iconic humor and personalities of Dan, Arin, and Lety into the party. This fall, Doja Cat joins the cast in an expansive all-new optional DLC story! We're excited to welcome the AMA-winning and Grammy-nominated music star into the game and can't wait for Doja Cat's character to ramp up the party even more! Keep an eye out, because there may be more exciting guests on the way!

games.short_description: How many dudes does it take to beat up a gorilla? A thousand toddlers? A horse-sized duck? A GOD? Enter the Dude Ranch and find out in this roguelike dudebuilder where you recruit an army of dudes to fight ridiculous battles.

descriptions.en: How many dudes does it take to beat up a gorilla? A thousand toddlers? A horse-sized duck? A GOD? Enter the Dude Ranch and find out in this roguelike dudebuilder where you recruit an army of dudes to fight ridiculous battles.

detailed_descriptions.en: How Many Dudes? is a roguelike dudebuilder that's all about game-breaking synergies and simulated chaos. Welcome to the Dude Ranch, where you recruit and manage your ever-expanding army of Dudes Choose from a wild cast of 42 Unique Dudes across 6 Dude Families: Undead Dudes, Employed Dudes, Warrior Dudes, Fantasy Dudes, Sci-Fi Dudes, and Action Dudes. Setup your Team to mix and match Dude Types and form ridiculous synergies - like Zombie Dudes who explode when struck by enemies, Ninja Dudes who throw a barrage of Shurikens, or Cowboy dudes who lasso other Dudes out of danger. More than 850,000 Team compositions means there's tons of strategies and overpowered combos to discover. Create game-breaking synergies with your choice of Dudes, Trinkets, and Relics Collect hundreds of Dude Relics that warp the rules of battle. Make your Wizard Dudes fling a volley of fireballs when they move, your Ninja Dudes enter stealth when in danger, or your Finance Dudes generate cash with a life insurance policy on your other Dudes. Defeat Act Bosses to earn Trinkets - powerful items assigned to a Dude Type that enable game breaking strategies. Should you give your Wizard Dudes ADHD, or give your Samurai Dudes a Taser? It's up to you! Choose your Dudes wisely. Each Dude has their place in battle, from dishing out damage to tanking it to commanding other Dudes. Find the right balance between offense and defense, and see if your team can make it all the way to the final act. Face escalating enemy waves—from toddlers to wolves to gorillas to gods Conquer boss fights that test your team’s synergy (and your sanity). Defeat bosses to earn Silver and Gold stars for each Dude, and see if you can master them all! Strategic roguelike autobattler full of game-breaking synergies 42 Unique Dude Types to recruit and build out your team Hundreds of Relics, Trinkets, and Wandering Dude events that completely reshape each run Three Tiers of Challenge, each with additional unique enemies and epic boss battles Game modes like The Daily Dude and Ensemble Mode, which allows for pre-selecting your dream team Infinite replayability and absurdity

games.name: How To Grow a Black Hole

names.en: How To Grow a Black Hole

games.short_description: How To Grow a Black Hole is about... well... how to grow a black hole. Manage your black hole, feed it to gain mass, and prevent catastrophic collapses. Compete globally or against your friends to achieve the biggest black hole. Maybe you'll be #1.

descriptions.en: How To Grow a Black Hole is about... well... how to grow a black hole. Manage your black hole, feed it to gain mass, and prevent catastrophic collapses. Compete globally or against your friends to achieve the biggest black hole. Maybe you'll be #1.

detailed_descriptions.en: So what is How To Grow a Black Hole is a chill incremental game about feeding, upgrading, researching, and barely controlling the most dangerous cosmic object imaginable. Start small, feed your black hole, increase its mass, unlock new ways to grow, and push the numbers higher and higher until everything starts getting completely unreasonable. Just make sure things do not spiral too far out of control, because catastrophic collapses are very much part of the experience. It is not a hardcore astrophysics simulator. It is a weird, satisfying, slightly stupid game about turning a tiny gravitational problem into an enormous one on purpose. A little absurd. A little terrifying. Oddly hard to stop playing. What you actually do Feed your black hole and watch its mass climb. Unlock upgrades that let you feed it faster, grow it larger, and push the numbers into ridiculous territory. Research new systems to automate growth, improve efficiency, and keep the chaos moving. Prevent catastrophic collapses when your black hole becomes a little too unstable. Compare your black hole’s size and mass to real-world objects, which starts out interesting and gets unsettling fast. Unlock bite-sized black hole facts, including why even a tiny one would be an unbelievable health hazard. Compete globally or against friends to see who can grow the biggest black hole. Why I made it Hi, I’m Noah. I made this game in my free time because black holes are genuinely insane, and the idea of raising one like the world’s worst cosmic pet sounded too fun not to make. I love games with giant numbers, satisfying progression, and simple ideas that slowly get out of hand. This started as one of those ideas that would not leave my brain alone, so I turned it into a real game. I’m also hoping this project helps support the bigger and more ambitious games I want to make in the future. So by playing it, you are not just feeding a black hole. You are also helping me keep making games. Who it’s for If you like incremental games, upgrades, research trees, leaderboards, cosmic horror treated a little too casually, and numbers that eventually stop feeling reasonable, this is probably for you. If you are looking for strict realism and perfectly accurate astrophysics, this probably is not that. It is inspired by real black hole concepts, but mostly it is about making a cosmic problem worse because it feels good to watch the number go up. Bottom line How To Grow a Black Hole is a chill incremental game about feeding a black hole, keeping it stable, and trying to grow it bigger than everyone else’s. It is simple, strange, satisfying, and built around one important question: How big can you make it before everything goes wrong?

names.en: How to Make an Atomic Bomb in Your Garden

games.short_description: An absurd backyard bomb-building simulator. Raise funds, plan your approach, hunt down rare parts, and assemble your atomic masterpiece while staying calm and avoiding suspicion from nosy neighbors and federal agents.

descriptions.en: An absurd backyard bomb-building simulator. Raise funds, plan your approach, hunt down rare parts, and assemble your atomic masterpiece while staying calm and avoiding suspicion from nosy neighbors and federal agents.

detailed_descriptions.en: It’s a quiet Sunday morning. You're relaxing in your backyard when it suddenly hits you: You need to build an atomic bomb. Naturally. In this absurd single-player simulation, your peaceful suburban life takes a wild turn as you attempt the most questionable DIY project imaginable. Building a nuclear bomb in your backyard might not be the hardest thing you’ve done but it’s definitely the weirdest. What You’ll Be Doing To complete your creation, you’ll need to: Raise funds via a chaotic mini-game that tests your charm and hustle. Go shopping: Bid on auctions and scour regular online stores for those oddly specific blueprint parts. Do the math: Turn everyday household objects into actual atomic equations. Extract critical materials from totally unrelated household items. Assemble everything with precision... or at least, something close to it. Handle your nosy neighbors , who are just a bit too curious. Avoid IRS scrutiny , because spending your fundraiser money on plutonium raises red flags. games.short_description: Restore a forgotten neighbourhood through your favourite hobby, one cozy room at a time. In Hozy, clean, paint, and decorate abandoned homes with satisfying mechanics and intuitive controls. descriptions.en: Restore a forgotten neighbourhood through your favourite hobby, one cozy room at a time. In Hozy, clean, paint, and decorate abandoned homes with satisfying mechanics and intuitive controls. Enjoy the little details as you interact with tools, items and furniture to bring each space back to life.

detailed_descriptions.en: After things don’t quite work out in the big city, you return to your small hometown. Once lively, it now feels a little faded and forgotten. In that stillness, you discover something unexpected: a new passion. Room by room, space by space, you clean, paint, and gently restore the sense of community that once filled these streets. Hozy is about slowing down. There are no timers, scores, penalties, and absolutely no stress or pressure. Just you, your tools, and the simple joy of making spaces beautiful again. Whether you're wiping windows, repainting walls, or finding the perfect spot for a sofa, everything is designed to keep you in a calm, satisfying flow. Wrap yourself in a cozy atmosphere where every small action and detail matters. Open a window to let the wind play with floating dust and bring nature's sounds closer. Light candles, arrange books on shelves, paint a portrait on the wall, or switch on a projector. Everything you touch and every choice you make delivers a sense of satisfaction and a gentle “aha!” moment. Hozy features nine unique locations to explore and restore. Each space is filled with its residents' personal stories, as well as unique objects and small details that make every room feel lived in. Begin your journey in your parents’ home, step into an artist’s workshop, then visit an old café full of memories. Explore dreamlike spaces and help fulfil your father’s long-held dream of a peaceful place by the sea. Skip the endless catalogue overwhelm. Hozy offers a carefully curated selection of furniture and décor for each level that work well together. Place items freely, rotate and arrange them however you like – there is no right or wrong and no room is ever the same. Use the tools at your disposal wisely, and you'll create spaces worthy of an interior-design magazine! - A variety of spaces to restore and furnish at your own pace and with no limits - A wide range of cleaning and renovation tools to use, like a mop, squeegee, crowbar, and more - Deeply satisfying physics-based cleaning gameplay - Carefully curated furniture and décor, designed to always look great together - Endless replayability, driven by freedom of creativity and tiny details - A versatile photo mode with filters and advanced camera controls - Original charming soundtrack by the composer of Stray and Seasons After Fall

games.name: Humanica
games.short_description: Humanica is a city-builder game about an ancient settlement, featuring vast technological development. Experience the journey from sticks and stones to iron tools and windmills!

descriptions.en: Humanica is a city-builder game about an ancient settlement, featuring vast technological development. Experience the journey from sticks and stones to iron tools and windmills!

detailed_descriptions.en: Ancient world It all starts in 10,000 B.C. You will have to go through a difficult path of human development - from the Paleolithic to the Iron Age. The game features a massive technology tree, the progression of which will change your play style from time to time, forcing you to adapt to new conditions. Meanwhile, your settlement will grow, becoming larger and more technologically advanced. Everyday life of settlers You will be building, gathering, crafting various items, farming, animal husbandry and smelting bronze and iron. In the beginning you will not have an abundance of resources, so in the first years the main goal will be to survive. After all, the settlers must be fed and clothed. Turn-based gameplay elements The game process is divided into days. Each day is an iteration of a cycle, or turn, within which the settlers will have time to do a limited amount of work. Therefore, you should strive to keep the settlers working as efficiently as possible. As the saying goes - “Just One More Turn!”. World map You will have to explore a turn-based hexagonal world map. You can find useful resources on it: new seeds to grow, new animals to breed and much more. Construction and landscape The game features an unusual construction grid of irregular randomly shaped quadrilaterals. The landscape is editable, and consists of large square squares. If you suddenly dreamed about it, you will be able to dig out a mountain, or on the contrary build it! Settlement Defense Evil wild animals and nomads will want to stop you from prospering. Arm your settlers and build walls with towers to defend your settlement. Other key features The world is procedurally generated. At the beginning of the game you will be able to choose the desired landscape to your taste. A system of laws and annual plans that will add to the game the ability to customize your playthrough style. Available annual plans can drop randomly, adding light rogue-like elements to the game. The quality of tools determines the acceleration of certain jobs for residents. Go ahead and create iron and bronze axes and pickaxes! This game is made by one person with love! I hope you will enjoy it!

detailed_descriptions.en: A zombie outbreak wiped out civilization as we know it. Hordes of zeeks gnawed their way to the top, becoming the world’s apex predator. Regular humans are now an endangered species, with isolated pockets struggling to survive in this new, unforgiving world. Welcome to HumanitZ, an isometric, open-world, sandbox survival game, where you can try to make a difference and put humanity back where it belongs - at the top of the food chain. Will you gamble on cities and scavenge loot, knowing hordes of zeeks might be around the corner? Or do you try to survive off the land in the country, through hunting, fishing, and farming? Survive in an Open Sandbox World A vast, cruel world stretches from untamed wilderness to dense urban cities, with each location offering resources and risk. Exploration is rarely safe and never predictable as you face infected wildlife, zeek hordes, and hostile survivors roaming the landscape. Drivable vehicles become essential tools for survival, allowing you to cross dangerous territory, haul supplies, carry companions, and push farther into hostile environments. Will you find aid and trade at survivor camps, or violent confrontation as you take over enemy bandit bases? If the infected and other survivors aren’t enough, hunger, exposure, and a dynamic weather system constantly threaten your chances of making it through another day. For those willing to keep moving forward when others stop, the path leads to The Island, and the truth behind the outbreak and its terrors left undiscovered. Live off the Land! Pick through the ruins of the old world and scavenge resources to survive, or retreat to the hills to avoid the shambling remnants of humanity. Set up a farm, forage, hunt wildlife, or fish to sustain yourself. Each choice can mean the difference between lasting another day or becoming part of the ruins. Solo, Co-op & Online Play Survive your way. Play solo, cooperatively, or online in PvE and PvP modes with dedicated servers and proximity voice chat. Whether you face the apocalypse alone or with friends watching your back, the choice is yours. In a desolate world, even solo survivors learn quickly that befriending a dog or horse companion can mean the difference between life and death. Robust Character Customization Design your chosen survivor with professions, afflictions, and a skill-tree system. Then outfit your survivor with a plethora of weaponry and gear that shape how you endure the apocalypse. Craft and Build for Survival Use an extensive crafting and building system to create what you need to survive, from gear and consumables to vehicles. Craft and customize weapons with attachments and modifications to survive relentless threats and hunt game. Upgrade vehicles with armor, weapons, and storage capacity to adapt to the risks ahead. Then construct a safe house, fortify your base against threats using defensive structures like electrified fences and concrete barricades, or reclaim a burned-out house as a new place to live. Endure the Zeeks Not all zeeks are slow and stupid. Adapt and improvise against numerous zeek variants, or you'll risk becoming zombie fodder. Customize your game sessions using extensive game-altering settings, or push yourself further by enabling Permadeath Mode if you dare. The apocalypse claims everyone, eventually. If not through a zombie’s maw, then through hunger, exposure, treacherous terrain, or other people. How long will you last?
detailed_descriptions.zh-Hant: 僵尸爆发摧毁了我们所熟知的文明。成群的 zeek 通过啃咬一路爬上顶端，成为世界的顶级掠食者。普通人类如今成了濒危物种，只剩零散的幸存者据点在这片无情的新世界里挣扎求生。 欢迎来到 HumanitZ——等轴视角、开放世界、沙盒生存游戏。在这里，你可以尝试改变局势，把人类重新带回本该属于的位置——食物链顶端。 你会冒险进入城市搜刮战利品，明知 zeek 群可能就在拐角处吗？还是选择在乡野靠狩猎、捕鱼与耕作自给自足，努力活下去？ 在开放沙盒世界中生存 一个广阔而残酷的世界，从原始荒野延伸到密集都市，每个地点都同时提供资源与风险。面对感染的野生动物、zeek 群与四处游荡的敌对幸存者，探索很少安全，也从不按套路出牌。可驾驶载具将成为生存必需：穿越危险地带、搬运物资、载上同伴，并深入更恶劣的环境。你会在幸存者营地获得援助与交易，还是在夺取敌对匪徒据点时迎来暴力冲突？ 如果感染者与其他幸存者还不够麻烦，饥饿、暴露在恶劣环境中，以及动态天气系统也会持续威胁你再撑一天的机会。对那些在别人停下时仍愿继续前进的人来说，道路将通往 The Island，以及隐藏在爆发背后的真相与尚未揭开的恐怖。 靠大地生存！ 在旧世界的废墟中翻找资源以求生存，或退回山丘躲避摇摇晃晃的人类残影。建立农场、采集、狩猎野生动物或捕鱼来维持生计。每一个选择都可能决定你是再多活一天，还是沦为废墟的一部分。 单人、合作与在线游戏 用你的方式生存。可单人、合作或在线游玩 PvE 与 PvP 模式，支持专用服务器与近距离语音聊天。无论你独自面对末日，还是与朋友互相照应，选择权都在你手中。 在荒凉世界里，即便是独行幸存者也会很快明白：与狗或马结为伙伴，可能就是生与死的差别。 丰富的角色自定义 通过职业、负面状态与技能树系统打造你的幸存者。 然后为他装备大量武器与装备，决定你将如何挺过这场末日。 制作与建造以求生存 利用完善的制作与建造系统，打造从装备与消耗品到载具等一切生存所需。为武器制作并加装配件与改装，以抵御无休止的威胁并狩猎取食。升级载具的装甲、武器与储物容量，以适应前方更大的风险。 随后建造安全屋，用电网围栏、混凝土路障等防御结构加固基地，或夺回一栋烧毁的房屋作为新的栖身之所。 挺过 zeek 的威胁 并非所有 zeek 都行动迟缓、头脑简单。面对多种 zeek 变种，你必须适应并随机应变，否则就会成为僵尸口粮。 使用大量可改变玩法的设置自定义游戏局，或在你敢的话开启 Permadeath 模式，把挑战推到极限。 末日终将吞噬所有人。即便不死于僵尸之口，也可能倒在饥饿、恶劣环境、险恶地形或他人手下。你能撑多久？
detailed_descriptions.ja: ゾンビの発生により、人類の文明は崩壊した。zeekの群れは噛みつきながら頂点へとのし上がり、世界の頂点捕食者となった。今や普通の人間は絶滅危惧種であり、孤立した小さな集団が、この容赦ない新世界で必死に生き残ろうとしている。 HumanitZへようこそ。クォータービューのオープンワールド・サンドボックスサバイバルで、あなたは世界を変え、人類を本来あるべき場所――食物連鎖の頂点へ戻すために戦うことになる。 zeekの大群が潜んでいるかもしれないと分かっていながら、都市へ賭けに出て物資を漁るか？ それとも、狩り・釣り・農業で田舎の地に根を張り、生き残りを目指すか？ オープンなサンドボックス世界で生き残れ 未開の荒野から人口密集の都市まで、広大で過酷な世界が広がる。場所ごとに資源と危険が待っている。感染した野生動物、zeekの群れ、そして敵対的な生存者――探索は滅多に安全ではなく、決して予測できない。運転可能な車両は生存の要だ。危険地帯の突破、物資の運搬、仲間の同乗、さらに奥地への進出――すべてを可能にする。生存者キャンプで助けと取引を得るのか、それとも敵対するバンディットの拠点を奪い、血みどろの衝突に挑むのか？ 感染者や他の生存者だけではない。飢え、露出、そしてダイナミックな天候システムが、常に「今日を越えられるか」を脅かす。誰もが立ち止まる地点からさらに先へ進む者には、The Islandへ至る道が開かれ、アウトブレイクの真相と、未だ明かされていない恐怖が待ち受ける。 大地と共に生きろ！ 旧世界の廃墟を漁って資源を集めるか、よろめく“人類の残骸”を避けて丘へ退くか。農場を作り、採集し、狩りをし、釣りをして糧を得よう。どの選択も、もう一日耐えられるか、それとも廃墟の一部になるかを分ける。 ソロ、協力、オンライン 生き残り方はあなた次第。ソロ、協力、またはPvE／PvPのオンラインで、専用サーバーと近接ボイスチャットを活用して戦え。ひとりで終末に挑むのも、背中を預けられる仲間と進むのも自由だ。 荒廃した世界では、孤独な生存者でさえ、犬や馬の相棒と心を通わせることが生死を分けるとすぐに知るだろう。 充実のキャラクターカスタマイズ 職業、状態異常（アフリクション）、スキルツリーで生存者をデザインしよう。 さらに豊富な武器や装備を整え、終末をどう生き抜くかを自分のスタイルで形作れ。 クラフト＆建築で生存 装備や消耗品から車両まで、生き残るために必要なものを作り出す、幅広いクラフト／建築システムを活用しよう。武器はアタッチメントや改造でクラフト＆カスタムし、執拗な脅威を生き延びて獲物を狩れ。車両は装甲、武装、収納力を強化し、次に待つ危険へ備えよう。 そして安全な拠点を建て、防衛設備（電撃フェンスやコンクリートのバリケードなど）で基地を固めるか、焼け落ちた家を取り戻して新しい住処にしよう。 zeekに耐え抜け すべてのzeekが鈍くて間抜けなわけじゃない。多数の亜種に適応し、その場で工夫しなければ、ゾンビの餌になる。 豊富なゲーム設定でセッションを自分好みに変えたり、勇気があるならPermadeathモードを有効にしてさらに限界へ挑め。 アポカリプスは、いずれ誰をも奪う。ゾンビの顎から逃れても、飢え、露出、危険な地形、あるいは他人が命取りになる。あなたはどれだけ生き延びられる？
detailed_descriptions.ko: 좀비가 창궐하면서 우리가 알고 있던 문명은 사라졌습니다. zeek 무리는 물어뜯으며 정상까지 올라, 이 세계의 최상위 포식자가 되었습니다. 이제 평범한 인간은 멸종 위기에 처했고, 고립된 생존자 무리만이 이 냉혹한 신세계에서 버티기 위해 발버둥치고 있습니다. HumanitZ에 오신 것을 환영합니다. 아이소메트릭 오픈 월드 샌드박스 생존 게임에서 여러분은 변화를 만들어내고, 인류를 본래 있어야 할 자리 — 먹이사슬의 정점으로 되돌려 놓아야 합니다. 어느 모퉁이에 zeek 떼가 숨어 있을지 아는 상황에서 도시로 뛰어들어 전리품을 훑어볼 건가요? 아니면 시골에서 사냥, 낚시, 농사로 땅에 기대어 살아남을 방법을 찾을 건가요? 오픈 샌드박스 세계에서 살아남으세요 길들여지지 않은 황야부터 빽빽한 도시까지, 거대하고 잔혹한 세계가 펼쳐집니다. 각 지역은 자원과 위험을 함께 제공합니다. 감염된 야생동물, zeek 무리, 적대적인 생존자들이 배회하는 세상에서 탐험은 거의 안전하지도, 예측 가능하지도 않습니다. 운전 가능한 차량은 생존의 필수 도구가 됩니다. 위험 지대를 가로지르고, 보급품을 운반하며, 동료를 태우고, 더 깊은 적지로 나아가세요. 생존자 캠프에서 도움과 거래를 찾을까요, 아니면 적대적인 도적 기지를 장악하며 폭력적인 충돌을 맞이할까요? 감염자와 다른 생존자만이 위협이 아닙니다. 굶주림, 노출, 그리고 역동적인 기상 시스템이 매일같이 여러분의 생존 가능성을 위협합니다. 남들이 멈출 때도 계속 앞으로 나아갈 의지가 있다면, 길은 The Island로 이어지고, 창궐의 진실과 아직 밝혀지지 않은 공포가 기다립니다. 땅에서 살아남으세요! 구세계의 폐허를 뒤져 자원을 모으거나, 비틀거리는 인류의 잔재를 피해 언덕으로 물러나세요. 농장을 꾸리고, 채집하고, 사냥하고, 낚시하며 스스로를 부양할 수 있습니다. 어떤 선택이든 하루 더 버티느냐, 폐허의 일부가 되느냐를 가를 수 있습니다. 솔로, 협동 & 온라인 플레이 원하는 방식으로 생존하세요. 솔로, 협동, 또는 PvE/PvP 온라인 모드에서 전용 서버와 근접 음성 채팅을 활용할 수 있습니다. 혼자 종말을 마주하든, 등을 맡길 친구들과 함께하든 선택은 여러분의 몫입니다. 황량한 세계에서 홀로 살아남는 사람도, 개나 말 동료와 친해지는 일이 생사에 큰 차이를 만든다는 걸 곧 깨닫게 됩니다. 강력한 캐릭터 커스터마이징 직업, 상태 이상(어플릭션), 스킬 트리 시스템으로 생존자를 설계하세요. 그리고 다양한 무기와 장비로 여러분만의 방식으로 종말을 버텨낼 준비를 갖추세요. 생존을 위한 제작과 건설 장비와 소모품부터 차량까지, 생존에 필요한 것을 만들 수 있는 방대한 제작/건설 시스템을 활용하세요. 부착물과 개조로 무기를 제작하고 커스터마이징해 끊임없는 위협을 이겨내고 사냥을 이어가세요. 차량은 장갑, 무장, 적재 용량을 업그레이드해 앞으로의 위험에 대비할 수 있습니다. 그다음 안전가옥을 세우고, 전기 울타리나 콘크리트 바리케이드 같은 방어 구조물로 기지를 강화하거나, 불타 버린 집을 되찾아 새로운 보금자리로 삼으세요. zeek에 맞서 버텨내세요 모든 zeek가 느리고 멍청한 건 아닙니다. 수많은 변종에 맞춰 적응하고 임기응변하지 못하면 좀비 먹이가 될 뿐입니다. 다양한 게임 변경 설정으로 세션을 커스터마이징하거나, 배짱이 있다면 Permadeath 모드를 켜고 더 큰 도전에 나서 보세요. 종말은 결국 모두를 집어삼킵니다. 좀비의 아가리에서 벗어나도 굶주림, 노출, 험난한 지형, 혹은 다른 사람들이 여러분을 쓰러뜨릴 수 있습니다. 얼마나 오래 버틸 수 있나요?

games.name: HUMANKIND™ - Cultures of Africa Pack
games.short_description: Expand your HUMANKIND™ experience with the Cultures of Africa DLC! Features 6 new cultures spanning all eras, new natural and built wonders, 7 new independent people, and 15 new narrative events.

descriptions.en: Expand your HUMANKIND™ experience with the Cultures of Africa DLC! Features 6 new cultures spanning all eras, new natural and built wonders, 7 new independent people, and 15 new narrative events.

detailed_descriptions.en: FIRST DLC AVAILABLE NOW! Expand your HUMANKIND™ experience with the Cultures of Africa DLC! Experience thousands of years of rich history from the world’s second largest continent, home to over 1 billion people and 1500 languages. The HUMANKIND™ Cultures of Africa DLC includes: - 6 New cultures – Bantu, Garamantes, Swahili, Maasai, Ethiopians and Nigerians - 5 New wonders - 7 Independent Peoples - 15 Narrative events - 18 new in-game themed music tracks composed by Arnaud Roy SIX NEW CULTURES Era 1 – Bantu (Expansionist) The first Bantu speaking peoples began their migration across Central Africa 6,000 years ago, creating many population centers. This phenomenon, referred to as the Bantu Expansion, made their language family one of the most spoken on the continent. Era 2 – Garamantes (Agrarian) Between the 17th and 14th centuries BCE, a major ecological mutation changed the environment of the Sahara. True farmers of the desert, the Garamantes fully adapted to this hostile environment thanks to their mastery of underground waters, ensuring a thriving culture between the 4th century BCE and the 3rd century. Era 3 – Swahili (Merchant) Scattered all along the East African coastline, the Swahili settlements were deeply connected to the trade routes running across the Indian Ocean. These lasting contacts with the world made their cities and culture flourish between the 10th and 15th centuries. Era 4 – Maasai (Agrarian) Between the 16th and 17th centuries, the Maasai established themselves as one of the main groups among the pastoral societies that dominated the land between the Great Lakes, the Great Rift and the coasts adjoining the Indian Ocean. This is where they led their herds on the vast plains of present-day Kenya and Tanzania. Era 5 – Ethiopians (Militarist) From the 19th century onwards, Ethiopia benefited from the reigns of great rulers which allowed a significant territorial expansion. The increase in its military capacities were the basis of the Empire's resounding military successes which guaranteed its independence. Era 6 – Nigerians (Agrarian) Nigeria has the peculiarity of bringing together in the same State an immense diversity of peoples and cultures. Since its independence it has been Africa's largest oil producer, but also one of the biggest agricultural producers, thanks to its diverse and fertile lands. 5 NEW WONDERS Mount Kilimanjaro Victoria Falls Zuma Rock Lake Natron Great Mosque of Djenné PLUS 7 INDEPENDENT PEOPLE & 15 NEW NARRATIVE EVENTS

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
FIRST DLC AVAILABLE NOW!

Expand your HUMANKIND™ experience with the Cultures of Africa DLC! Experience thousands of years of rich history from the world’s second largest continent, home to over 1 billion people and 1500 languages.

The HUMANKIND™ Cultures of Africa DLC includes:
- 6 New cultures – Bantu, Garamantes, Swahili, Maasai, Ethiopians and Nigerians
- 5 New wonders
- 7 Independent Peoples
- 15 Narrative events
- 18 new in-game themed music tracks composed by Arnaud Roy

SIX NEW CULTURES


Era 1 – Bantu (Expansionist)

The first Bantu speaking peoples began their migration across Central Africa 6,000 years ago, creating many population centers.

This phenomenon, referred to as the Bantu Expansion, made their language family one of the most spoken on the continent.

Era 2 – Garamantes (Agrarian)

Between the 17th and 14th centuries BCE, a major ecological mutation changed the environment of the Sahara.

True farmers of the desert, the Garamantes fully adapted to this hostile environment thanks to their mastery of underground waters, ensuring a thriving culture between the 4th century BCE and the 3rd century.

Era 3 – Swahili (Merchant)

Scattered all along the East African coastline, the Swahili settlements were deeply connected to the trade routes running across the Indian Ocean.

These lasting contacts with the world made their cities and culture flourish between the 10th and 15th centuries.

Era 4 – Maasai (Agrarian)

Between the 16th and 17th centuries, the Maasai established themselves as one of the main groups among the pastoral societies that dominated the land between the Great Lakes, the Great Rift and the coasts adjoining the Indian Ocean.

This is where they led their herds on the vast plains of present-day Kenya and Tanzania.

Era 5 – Ethiopians (Militarist)

From the 19th century onwards, Ethiopia benefited from the reigns of great rulers which allowed a significant territorial expansion.

The increase in its military capacities were the basis of the Empire's resounding military successes which guaranteed its independence.

Era 6 – Nigerians (Agrarian)

Nigeria has the peculiarity of bringing together in the same State an immense diversity of peoples and cultures.

Since its independence it has been Africa's largest oil producer, but also one of the biggest agricultural producers, thanks to its diverse and fertile lands.


5 NEW WONDERS
  • Mount Kilimanjaro
  • Victoria Falls
  • Zuma Rock
  • Lake Natron
  • Great Mosque of Djenné

PLUS 7 INDEPENDENT PEOPLE & 15 NEW NARRATIVE EVENTS

Embassy This new Quarter will bring your negotiation tactics to a higher level! Deepen ties and sign agreements beneficial for both your empires. games.name: Hungry Horrors
games.short_description: Hungry Horrors is a story-driven deckbuilder set in the folklore of the British Isles. Cook real traditional dishes, chain flavour synergies, meet mythical characters, and feed legendary Horrors before they feed on you.

descriptions.en: Hungry Horrors is a story-driven deckbuilder set in the folklore of the British Isles. Cook real traditional dishes, chain flavour synergies, meet mythical characters, and feed legendary Horrors before they feed on you.

detailed_descriptions.en: You are a spoilt princess whose favourite hobbies are leisure, rest, and sleep, and who thinks manual labour is an activity for servants. Unfortunately, your kingdom has fallen under a ravenous curse, and every creature of British and Irish folklore has turned into a “Hungry Horrors”. With no prince showing up to save you, you reluctantly take matters into your own hands and set out to break the curse, feeding strange creatures one meal at a time. You are, predictably, not happy about it. Cook traditional dishes, master five tastes, satisfy legendary Horrors, and unlock the secrets of a cursed kingdom. Season your cards, equip cookware, find powerful potions, rescue familiars, fish in mysterious waters, meet folkloric characters, and carve your own path through a kingdom built on old legends. BUILD YOUR CULINARY DECK Craft a deck of authentic British and Irish recipes, from Cranachan and Yorkshire Pudding to Jellied Eels and Toad in the Hole. Collect ingredients on your travels to cook new dishes and grow your deck. Season your cards to change their flavour and unlock powerful abilities. Equip cookware that bends the rules of every encounter, and shape your deck around the flavour chains you want to pull off. FACE MYTHICAL MONSTERS Encounter Jenny Greenteeth, Marool, Dullahan, Y Fad Felen, and other Horrors drawn from English, Irish, Scottish, and Welsh legends. Each one has its own appetite, preferences, and hatreds. Learn about their origins and the folklore behind them. Read them right and they leave full. Read them wrong and the princess becomes the next course. MASTER FLAVOURS AND CRAVING SYNERGIES Every dish carries one of five flavours: salty, sour, savoury, bitter, or sweet. Match each Horror's cravings, chain the right flavours in the right order, and watch hunger snowball. Every Horror has favourites and things they despise. Learn them, exploit them, and serve the perfect meal. EXPLORE THE BRITISH ISLES Travel through dark woods, gloomy meadows, spooky bogs, and the misty loch. Meet legendary characters with quests to complete, trade with merchants, and uncover artefacts and cookware hidden across the kingdom. Unlock fishing to reel in new ingredients and loot. Find a familiar to follow you on your journey and sniff out potions along the way. CHOOSE YOUR WAY TO PLAY Take the long road in the main campaign with persistent progression, where unlocked recipes, abilities, and seasonings carry between runs. Play Vanilla for the standard experience or crank it up with Spicy mode. Stack modifiers like Culinary and Gourmet to twist each run further. Hungry Horrors is a pixel art card game where food and fear collide. Made by two people, shaped by the community, served with a generous helping of folklore.

games.name: Hunt: Showdown 1896
games.short_description: Hunt: Showdown 1896 is the brutally rewarding extraction shooter. Track twisted monsters and overcome ruthless PvP. Take bounties in corrupted backwaters lost to history. With a team, you might survive. Die with nothing or get out with everything.

descriptions.en: Hunt: Showdown 1896 is the brutally rewarding extraction shooter. Track twisted monsters and overcome ruthless PvP. Take bounties in corrupted backwaters lost to history. With a team, you might survive. Die with nothing or get out with everything.

detailed_descriptions.en: Discover the possibilities of our arsenal, with weapons, gear, and abilities that are equal parts authentic and creative. Explore different tactical approaches to any situation, whether you’re setting an ambush or taking back the initiative. Build your own unique loadouts that match your playstyle. From Beetles to Tarot Cards, there’s a tool for every job. Lightweight inventory management keeps you focused on the game rather than your backpack. Survive and level up your Hunter. But don’t get complacent, as even the best gear won’t save you. Combat is balanced so that everyone has a fair chance. The world has teeth. Experience ravaged landscapes and twisted monstrosities deep in the forgotten corners of the American West. With four massive maps, transformative weather conditions, and fresh changes every season, you’ll always have something new to see. Whether you’re outrunning a wildfire or stalking under the cover of heavy rain, make no mistake: From Mammon’s Gulch to Lawson Delta, the Corruption has seeped into everything. Rely on your ears just as much as your eyes. Sound is vital: the warning cries of nearby monsters. Dogs barking in the distance at enemy Hunters on your trail. The metallic clinks of a weapon being reloaded in the other room. From creaking floorboards to snapping twigs, every sound could make the difference between survival and disaster. So, watch where you step. Hold your fire when you can. And if you find your ears are left wanting more, listen to the haunting melodies of Port Sulphur Band, exclusive to Hunt: Showdown 1896. Danger lurks around every corner. The dead have risen and are hungry, but rival players are the deadlier threat. The gunshots will close in from every direction. Every Hunter is competing for the same prize, which turns every match into a deadly showdown. When you finally make contact, ride the adrenaline rush. Every second matters, every bullet counts, and the smallest decisions will seal your fate. The biggest risks for the highest rewards. Trust is survival. Choose your team wisely as another pair of eyes can be the difference between life and death. Share your triumph in duos or trios. When you’re ready, take the challenge hunting solo. Relish your hard-earned victories, it’s taking the bounty that matters. Whether your match ended in a haul of loot or the cold embrace of death, know your fellow Hunters have walked that same line. As they say, Hunt Giveth or Hunt Taketh. Express the way you play. Recruit from a diverse roster of Hunters, including Wild West gunslingers, twisted fanatics, and legendary warriors from further afield. Arm them with an array of distinctive weapons, from exquisite firearms to brutal, improvised hammers. With hundreds of unlocks and customizations beyond your Hunter and gear, no one will Hunt quite like you.

THE JOB

Objective: Hunt animals and meet quota.

You're a contract hunter.

The animals are wrong.
Deer with eyes on same side of head. Rabbits that scream. Goats that speak Latin.

4-PLAYER COOP - Drop-in multiplayer || voice chat || Shared contract progress

CONTRACTS - 15 unique nights - Escalating difficulty - Specific animal requirements - Weight quotas

LOCATIONS - Pine Valley , Granger Farms, Blackmire Swamp

MULTIPLAYER

Works solo. Better with friends, up to 4 players.

Everyone spawns at camp. Everyone extracts together or dies trying.

Hunt. Extract. Repeat. Don't think about what the animals are saying.

detailed_descriptions.en: Hydroneer is a mining sandbox game where you dig for gold and other resources to build massive mining machines and a base of operation. Use primitive tools, hydro-powered machines, and player-built structures to dig and evolve your operation in this tycoon-style progression system. Dig Deep! Discover relics of the past in the depths of Hydroneer, with better rewards the deeper you dig. Forge, Build, and Create! Hydroneer features a dynamic modular system for building structures and hydro powered machinery. Create the base of operations from your own design to optimise your work. Create networks of hydro pipes, control pressure. Craft resources, weaponry, jewellery, grow vegetables, and cook soup for villagers. Hydro Powered Vehicles Large hydro powered machines used for a variety of uses, from digging resources and finding ore veins, to transporting goods. Explore the World of Hydroneer Various parcels of land await you in the world of Hydroneer, each with their own advantages. Deeper pits, attractive scenery, and closer stores. You decide where to build your base of operations.

games.short_description: Explore a beautiful, vast and ruined world riddled with dangers and lost technologies.

descriptions.en: Explore a beautiful, vast and ruined world riddled with dangers and lost technologies.

detailed_descriptions.en: Echoes of a dark and violent past resonate throughout a savage land, steeped in treasure and blood. Hyper Light Drifter is an action adventure RPG in the vein of the best 16­bit classics, with modernized mechanics and designs on a much grander scale. Drifters of this world are the collectors of forgotten knowledge, lost technologies and broken histories. Our Drifter is haunted by an insatiable illness, traveling further into the lands of Buried Time, hoping to discover a way to quiet the vicious disease. • From each character to subtle background elements, everything is lovingly hand-animated. • Easy to pick up, difficult to master; enemies are vicious and numerous, hazards will easily crush your frail body, and friendly faces remain rare. • Upgrade weapons, learn new skills, discover equipment and traverse a dark, detailed world with branching paths and secrets abound.

games.name: HYPERFIGHT 2
games.short_description: Your meter is your life. Use it wisely or risk it all in this brand-new take on 2D fighting. This is the next evolution of HYPERFIGHT!

descriptions.en: Your meter is your life. Use it wisely or risk it all in this brand-new take on 2D fighting. This is the next evolution of HYPERFIGHT!

detailed_descriptions.en: HYPERFIGHT 2 is the sequel to the original HYPERFIGHT, a fast-paced 2D fighting game where your meter is your life . This meter replaces a traditional healthbar - win by filling it completely OR knocking your opponent out of bounds. You'll need to balance risk/reward between using special moves and moving closer to victory. Resource management and space control are critical as the game changes with every interaction. This installment takes everything up to 11 - expanded movesets, more offensive and defensive options, and improved online features - while keeping the beloved accessibility of the original. NEW AND RETURNING CHARACTERS A fully voiced roster of characters, each with their own unique movesets and playstyles! Beloved favorites from the original return alongside some new faces. PLAY ONLINE, WITH FRIENDS OR FOES Featuring rollback netcode and menu-based lobbies. Create your own private lobbies, or join a public Quick Match lobby and instantly find opponents ready to challenge. Easy, seamless, and functional - so you can focus on the fight. PROVE YOUR MASTERY Complete objectives during a match to unlock cosmetics for your online profile! Each character has a wide variety of Challenges ranging from easy to very difficult - can you complete them all? SOLO CONTENT - LEARN, TRAIN, OR TAKE A BREAK Survival Mode : Try to survive an endless gauntlet of opponents Lesson Mode : Interactive tutorials on the game's mechanics, characters, and combos Training Mode : Practice using a multitude of helpful options Gallery : View official + fan art and listen to music from the game ...AND MORE! Funky and energetic soundtrack composed by STEEL_PLUS Full controller and keyboard support with rebinding, plus mouse support for UI Movelist display right on the pause screen, scrollable by P1 and P2 at once READY TO FIGHT?

names.zh-Hant: I am Jesus Christ 我是耶稣基督
names.ja: I am Jesus Christ 私はイエス・キリストです
names.ko: I am Jesus Christ 나는 예수 그리스도다

games.short_description: Walk in the footsteps of Jesus in this immersive first-person retelling of His life, from baptism to resurrection. Perform iconic miracles, meet biblical figures, and explore the Holy Land from Jerusalem to Galilee. Experience the story of the Messiah in I Am Jesus Christ.

descriptions.en: Walk in the footsteps of Jesus in this immersive first-person retelling of His life, from baptism to resurrection. Perform iconic miracles, meet biblical figures, and explore the Holy Land from Jerusalem to Galilee. Experience the story of the Messiah in I Am Jesus Christ.
descriptions.zh-Hant: 在这款沉浸式第一人称叙事游戏中，追随耶稣的脚步，从降生到复活。施行神迹奇事，结识圣经人物，探索圣地——从耶路撒冷到加利利。在《I Am Jesus Christ》中成为弥赛亚。
descriptions.ja: イエスの足跡をたどり、誕生から復活までを描く没入型の一人称視点ストーリーを体験しよう。奇跡を起こし、聖書の人物と出会い、エルサレムからガリラヤまで聖地を巡ろう。『I Am Jesus Christ』でメシアとなれ。
descriptions.ko: 예수님의 발자취를 따라가며, 탄생부터 부활까지를 그린 1인칭 몰입형 이야기 속으로 들어가 보세요. 놀라운 기적을 행하고 성경 속 인물들과 만나며, 예루살렘에서 갈릴리까지 성지를 탐험하세요. 『I Am Jesus Christ』에서 메시아가 되십시오.

detailed_descriptions.en: I Am Jesus Christ is a first-person narrative experience inspired by the Gospels, letting you witness the life, ministry, and trials of Jesus from a new interactive perspective. Relive Defining Moments Experience key events from the life of Jesus and witness moments whose meaning still resonates today. See these scenes unfold from a personal perspective and engage with the story in a way that feels immediate and immersive. Journey Through the Holy Land Travel across diverse locations from Jesus’ ministry, from deserts and mountains to towns brought to life with atmosphere and detail. Discover the Teachings Explore the foundations of the Christian faith through an interactive journey inspired by the life and message of Jesus. Gain a deeper sense of the ideas, values, and events that continue to shape millions of lives around the world. Resist the Tempter Stand firm against Satan’s temptations and face the spiritual trials that lead to the fulfillment of Scripture. Read the Scriptures Encounter selected Bible passages throughout the game and connect each moment of the journey to the words that shaped it. Are you ready to resist temptation in the desert, heal the sick, and uplift those in need? Perform over 30 meaningful miracles - from feeding the 5,000 and healing lepers to calming the storm and restoring sight to the blind. Key Features: Relive the life of Jesus Christ from His baptism to the crucifixion and resurrection Visit faithfully recreated locations in the Holy Land, including Jerusalem and Galilee Perform over 30 iconic miracles, such as feeding the 5,000 and walking on water Be guided by the Holy Spirit and strengthen your spiritual connection through prayer Meet story-driven characters, including Christ's disciples, and reenact key moments such as the Last Supper
detailed_descriptions.zh-Hant: I Am Jesus Christ 是一款受《福音书》启发的第一人称叙事体验游戏，让你从全新的互动视角见证耶稣的生平、传道与试炼。 重温意义深远的关键时刻 体验耶稣生命中的重要事件，见证那些直到今天仍然具有深远意义的瞬间。以更贴近的个人视角进入这些场景，以直接而沉浸的方式感受这段故事。 踏上圣地之旅 穿越耶稣传道途中的多个地点，从荒野与群山，到以浓厚氛围与丰富细节重现的城镇，亲身感受圣地风貌。 探索祂的教诲 通过一段受耶稣生平与信息启发的互动旅程，了解基督信仰的根基。更深入地体会那些持续影响全球数百万人生活的思想、价值观与重要事件。 抵挡试探者 坚定面对撒但的诱惑，经历通向《圣经》应验的属灵考验。 阅读经文 在游戏过程中，你将读到精心挑选的圣经经文，把旅程中的每一个时刻与塑造它的话语联系起来。 你准备好在旷野中抵挡试探、医治病患、扶助有需要的人了吗？亲手施行 30 多个意义非凡的神迹——从喂饱五千人、医治麻风病人，到平静风浪、使盲人重见光明。 主要特色： 重温耶稣基督从受洗到受难与复活的人生历程 探索忠实重现的圣地场景，包括耶路撒冷与加利利 施行 30 多个经典神迹，例如喂饱五千人和在水面上行走 在圣灵的引导下，通过祷告加深你的属灵联结 遇见推动剧情发展的重要人物，包括基督的门徒，并重现最后的晚餐等关键时刻
detailed_descriptions.ja: I Am Jesus Christ は、福音書に着想を得た一人称視点のナラティブ体験です。イエスの生涯、宣教、そして試練の数々を、新たなインタラクティブな視点から体験できます。 心に残る瞬間を追体験しよう イエスの生涯における重要な出来事をたどり、今なお深い意味を持ち続ける瞬間に立ち会いましょう。ひとりの当事者としてその場に身を置き、物語をより身近に、そして没入感たっぷりに味わえます。 聖地を巡る旅へ 荒野や山々から、豊かな空気感と緻密なディテールで再現された町々まで、イエスが歩んださまざまな地を巡りましょう。 教えに触れる イエスの生涯とその言葉に着想を得たインタラクティブな旅を通して、キリスト教信仰の礎に触れましょう。今日まで世界中の何百万もの人々に影響を与え続けている思想や価値観、そして出来事への理解を深めることができます。 誘惑する者に打ち勝て サタンの誘惑に立ち向かい、聖書の成就へとつながる霊的な試練を乗り越えましょう。 聖書の言葉を読む ゲームの各所で厳選された聖書の一節に触れ、旅の一つひとつの場面を、それを形作った言葉と結びつけることができます。 荒野での誘惑に打ち勝ち、病める人々を癒やし、助けを必要とする人々に手を差し伸べる覚悟はありますか？ 5,000人への給食、らい病人の癒やし、嵐を鎮める奇跡、盲人の視力の回復など、30を超える印象的な奇跡を体験しましょう 主な特徴 洗礼から磔刑、そして復活に至るまで、イエス・キリストの生涯を追体験 エルサレムやガリラヤを含む、聖地の数々を忠実に再現したロケーションを訪問 5,000人への給食や水上歩行など、30を超える象徴的な奇跡を体験 聖霊に導かれ、祈りを通して霊的なつながりを深める キリストの弟子たちをはじめとする物語性豊かな登場人物と出会い、最後の晩餐などの重要な場面を追体験
detailed_descriptions.ko: I Am Jesus Christ 는 복음서에서 영감을 받은 1인칭 내러티브 체험으로, 예수의 삶과 사역, 그리고 그분이 겪은 시련을 새로운 인터랙티브 시점에서 경험하게 해줍니다. 가장 중요한 순간들을 다시 경험하세요 예수의 삶을 이루는 핵심적인 사건들을 따라가며, 오늘날까지도 깊은 울림을 전하는 순간들을 직접 마주하세요. 각 장면을 더욱 가까운 시점에서 체험하며, 이야기에 몰입감 있게 빠져들 수 있습니다. 성지를 따라 떠나는 여정 광야와 산지에서부터 분위기와 세밀한 표현으로 생생하게 재현된 마을들에 이르기까지, 예수의 사역이 펼쳐졌던 다양한 장소를 여행하세요. 가르침을 만나보세요 예수의 삶과 말씀에서 영감을 받은 인터랙티브한 여정을 통해 기독교 신앙의 기초를 탐구해 보세요. 오늘날까지도 전 세계 수많은 사람들의 삶에 영향을 주고 있는 사상과 가치, 그리고 사건들에 대해 더욱 깊이 이해할 수 있습니다. 유혹하는 자에 맞서세요 사탄의 유혹 앞에 굴하지 말고, 성경의 성취로 이어지는 영적인 시험을 이겨 내세요. 성경 말씀을 읽으세요 게임 곳곳에서 엄선된 성경 구절을 만나고, 여정의 각 순간을 그 장면을 이루는 말씀과 연결해 보세요. 광야에서의 유혹을 이겨 내고, 병든 자를 치유하며, 도움이 필요한 이들에게 손을 내밀 준비가 되셨나요? 오천 명을 먹이신 기적과 나병 환자를 치유한 일부터 폭풍을 잠잠하게 하고 맹인의 시력을 회복시킨 일까지, 30가지가 넘는 인상적인 기적을 체험해 보세요. 주요 특징 세례부터 십자가형, 그리고 부활에 이르기까지 예수 그리스도의 삶을 따라가는 여정 예루살렘과 갈릴리를 포함한 성지의 다양한 장소를 충실하게 재현한 배경 탐험 오천 명을 먹이신 기적과 물 위를 걸으신 사건 등 30가지가 넘는 상징적인 기적 체험 성령의 인도를 받으며 기도를 통해 영적 연결을 더욱 깊게 하는 경험 그리스도의 제자들을 비롯한 이야기 중심의 인물들을 만나고, 최후의 만찬과 같은 중요한 순간들을 다시 체험

games.name: I Am Your Beast
games.short_description: Hunt the military-industrial complex across stylish comic book micro-sandboxes in this fast-paced covert revenge thriller FPS from the developers of El Paso, Elsewhere.

descriptions.en: Hunt the military-industrial complex across stylish comic book micro-sandboxes in this fast-paced covert revenge thriller FPS from the developers of El Paso, Elsewhere.

detailed_descriptions.en: I Am Your Beast is a shortform covert revenge thriller FPS about getting hunted across the North American wilderness by the military-industrial complex — and turning the tables. You are secret agent Alphonse Harding. Retired for six years, you've been asked to complete ‘one last job’, one too many times. Declining your latest mission sets in motion a furious guerilla war between you and the Covert Operations Initiative (COI) that litters the forest with bodies and bullet casings. Break your opponents. Use their own equipment against them. Duck into your tunnel network before enemy forces zero in on your location. Repeat. Features Lightning-fast "he's-in-the-walls" player fantasy, complete with superhuman tree climbing and head explosions. Fully voiced story campaign with 20+ levels. Lush comic book-inspired art style. Chase side objectives while getting the fastest times possible in replayable micro-sandboxes. Wield pistols, sniper rifles, bear traps, and more. Heart-slamming soundtrack from award-winning composer RJ Lake (Space Warlord Organ Trading Simulator, Unbeatable, El Paso, Elsewhere). Innovative "kinetic typography" cutscene system.
