descriptions.en: Solve puzzles, riddles, and embark on an exciting journey of discovery! Join Toto and Gal as they explore dreamscapes and befriend magical creatures. Lost in their imagination, the brother and sister must stick together and solve puzzles to find their way home.

detailed_descriptions.en: Help a brother and sister on an uplifting epic adventure to find their way home. Solving puzzles, escaping a horned beast and meeting quirky goblins are just part of the journey! Lost in Play is a journey through childhood imagination with thoughtfully crafted puzzles and colorful characters. Play as a brother and sister duo on an adventure to find their way back home. Between reality and fantasy, the siblings explore the enchanted forest of a horned beast, start a rebellion in a goblin village, and help a team of frogs free a sword from a stone. PUZZLES & MYSTERY The bizarre and dreamlike world of Lost in Play is filled with mystery, unique puzzles, and mini-games. Challenge a pirate seagull to a game of clicking crabs, serve magical tea to a royal toad, and collect pieces to build a flying machine. Be a part of this modern point & click game that will reward your curiosity and leave you excited for the next piece of story. IMAGINATION COMES TO LIFE From what seems like a normal morning at home to a typical afternoon at the park, you'll soon find yourself on a whirlwind quest as you sneak into a goblin castle, explore ancient ruins, and soar atop a giant stork. Lost in Play takes you on a nostalgic roller-coaster! AN INTERACTIVE CARTOON With a hand-crafted style similar to animated shows from childhood, Lost in Play is a story meant for all. Whether you’re seeking wholesome delight or just a good time, the family can enjoy this story together. GAME FEATURES: A mysterious animated puzzle adventure. Filled with magical and magnificent creatures. Created with families in mind. Have your children watch you play! No dialogue. Everything is communicated visually in a universal way. Inspired by nostalgic TV shows such as Gravity Falls, Hilda, and Over the Garden Wall. Play cards with goblins, build a dragon, and teach a sheep how to fly. Includes 30+ unique puzzles and mini-games. Catch a derpy chicken. Maybe. ACCESSIBILITY For detailed accessibility report please visit the family gaming database Happy Juice Games previously worked on "The Office Quest" and is a studio that focuses on pushing the boundaries of animated adventure games. We hope you love our game as much as we loved making it.

names.en: Lost in Random: The Eternal Die

games.short_description: Plunge into a living nightmare where every roll counts. Chain fluid combat with dice-fueled attacks, stack relics into ferocious synergies, and build unstoppable momentum. Slash through fate, bend chance to your will, and defeat the Black Die in this board-game inspired roguelite dungeon crawler.

descriptions.en: Plunge into a living nightmare where every roll counts. Chain fluid combat with dice-fueled attacks, stack relics into ferocious synergies, and build unstoppable momentum. Slash through fate, bend chance to your will, and defeat the Black Die in this board-game inspired roguelite dungeon crawler.

detailed_descriptions.en: A GAME OF CHANCE, A TEST OF SKILL Lost in Random: The Eternal Die blends dynamic real-time action, tactical combat, and risk-reward dice mechanics for thrilling second-to-second battles. Unravel an original stand-alone story as Queen Aleksandra, the once great ruler of Random on a mission for vengeance and redemption. Wield an arsenal of four unique weapons, unleash powerful card-based abilities, harness elemental relics and strategically roll your trusted die-companion, Fortune, to shift the tide of battle. Or take on high-stakes wager games where the right roll could lead to incredible rewards… or crushing consequences. Even death isn’t final - return to the Sanctuary to unlock new weapons, buy powerful upgrades, and take on quests from your allies to prepare for your next run. A DARK FANTASY BROUGHT TO LIFE Explore four dynamic biomes, each teeming with danger, secrets, and unpredictable challenges. Lose yourself in a haunting world of gothic whimsy, vivid landscapes, and an enchantingly atmospheric soundtrack. With alternative endings to discover and a fully voiced cast of quirky characters, The Eternal Die invites you back into the world of Random for another unforgettable chapter. KEY FEATURES Fast-paced, second-to-second combat that blends real-time action with tactical decision-making. A unique dice-roll mechanic that shifts battles in unexpected ways. Four diverse and fully upgradeable weapons each with distinct playstyles. 100+ elemental relics and 15 powerful card-based abilities to customise your build. Four randomly-generated biomes filled with secrets, enemies, and high-stakes challenges. 30+ unique enemy types and 4 ruthless world bosses, each demanding skill and strategy. Randomly generated encounters, evolving relic synergies, and adjustable difficulty settings let you play your way. A dark fantasy world brought to life in a Burtonesque style featuring hauntingly beautiful environments and an enchanting soundtrack.

games.name: Lost Judgment
games.short_description: In this action-adventure thriller, detective Takayuki Yagami goes undercover to unravel a string of twisted crimes at a high school in Yokohama, Japan. Crack the case and some skulls with brutal combat featuring three unique fighting styles and an arsenal of private eye tricks.

descriptions.en: In this action-adventure thriller, detective Takayuki Yagami goes undercover to unravel a string of twisted crimes at a high school in Yokohama, Japan. Crack the case and some skulls with brutal combat featuring three unique fighting styles and an arsenal of private eye tricks.

detailed_descriptions.en: When a convicted police officer discloses the murder of the student teacher who bullied his son to suicide, the dark secrets of a Yokohama high school rise to the surface. Fight for the truth as detective Takayuki Yagami and go undercover at a prestigious high school to solve a string of twisted bullying cases. But as victims pile up, caught in a cycle of bullying and revenge, will the scales of justice tip in favor of defending the law or enacting vengeance? Crack skulls to crack the case in this action-packed legal thriller. RGG Studio proudly presents Lost Judgment, the sequel to Judgment that weaves investigative sleuthing, noir narrative, and bone-crushing combat into a story like none other. INVESTIGATIVE ACTION Tap into Yagami’s arsenal of private eye tricks to gather clues. Use hi-tech gadgets like drones and listening devices as well as hardboiled gumshoe methods like scaling buildings and tailing suspects to uncover the truth. No stronger evidence than catching a suspect in the act. FREEFORM COMBAT Master Yagami’s three unique, combo-heavy martial arts styles to overcome any situation from group ambushes to single-target takedowns. Plus, expand your arsenal with street signs, bicycles, and more to pack an even bigger punch. DEEP UNDERCOVER Go undercover as a high school club advisor to get to the root of the mystery, and have some fun along the way. Join the Dance Club and groove to the rhythm with your students. Challenge your ingenuity at the Robotics Club. Test your moves against fierce opponents at the boxing gym. You can even join the biker gang, where underground racing is the only way to earn respect. HIT THE STREETS As you comb the cities of Kamurocho and Ijincho in pursuit of the truth, take a break and get to know the unique culture of each city through bars and other nightlife hotspots. It may be worth taking on a Side Case to lend your detective skills to residents in need—you never know what might come of it.

games.name: Lou's Lagoon
games.short_description: A cozy exploration-and-crafting adventure: fly your seaplane between tropical islands, collect resources with the Swirler, rebuild storm damaged communities, and unravel the mystery surrounding Uncle Lou’s disappearance.

descriptions.en: A cozy exploration-and-crafting adventure: fly your seaplane between tropical islands, collect resources with the Swirler, rebuild storm damaged communities, and unravel the mystery surrounding Uncle Lou’s disappearance.

detailed_descriptions.en: ✈️ A Seaplane, a Storm, and a Missing Uncle Take to the skies in your trusty seaplane on a heartfelt adventure across the tropical Limbo archipelago. After receiving a distress call from Uncle Lou, you arrive only to find the islands in disarray and Lou nowhere to be found. Collect resources, help rebuild a community, and unravel the mystery of your uncle’s disappearance. 🛠️ Collect, Craft, Restore Harness the vacuum power of the Swirler! — a glorious multi-tool — to collect everything from scrap and native plants to materials dropped by Limbo’s unique wildlife. Use your finds to repair buildings, craft goods, and help the communities thrive again. Claim your slice of paradise at Lou’s Lagoon. Build your dream beach hut, add your personal touch, and let the island rhythm take over. 🌴 Meet the islanders of Limbo Discover the archipelago’s vibrant islands, each with their own spirited communities, hidden treasures, and unique problems to solve. Get a warm welcome from the Charneys in Tangle Bloom—the archipelago's liveliest town—then head to Gleam Reef to watch the Vooi move to the music of the tides. Lastly, visit Boulderia, home to the grumpy, sugar-crystal-mining Gorplins! Key Features: 🌴 Explore the Limbo archipelago, home to vibrant communities and ancient secrets. 🛫 Pilot your very own seaplane , master ring challenges, and enjoy the freedom of open skies. 🌀Upgrade your gadgets to expand your adventures. Scoop, build, glide and fish! 🛠️ Personalize your seaplane with vibrant skins and custom configurations. 🎨 Full character customization. Make your avatar uniquely yours, from hairstyle to outfits and accessories. 🛠️ Build your island base, decorate it, and make Lou’s Lagoon feel like home. ❔ A mystery to unravel. Piece together clues, follow Lou’s trail, and uncover the truth behind his disappearance! Whether you’re hot on the trail to solving the mystery of Uncle Lou or just kicking back and enjoying island life, Lou’s Lagoon is your ticket to an exciting adventure. Ready for takeoff? Claim your slice of paradise at Lou’s Lagoon. Build your dream beach hut, add your personal touch, and let the island rhythm take over.

Discover the archipelago’s vibrant islands, each with their own spirited communities, hidden treasures, and unique problems to solve. Get a warm welcome from the Charneys in Tangle Bloom—the archipelago's liveliest town—then head to Gleam Reef to watch the Vooi move to the music of the tides. Lastly, visit Boulderia, home to the grumpy, sugar-crystal-mining Gorplins!

🌴 Explore the Limbo archipelago, home to vibrant communities and ancient secrets. 

🛫 Pilot your very own seaplane, master ring challenges, and enjoy the freedom of open skies. 

🌀Upgrade your gadgets to expand your adventures. Scoop, build, glide and fish! 

🛠️Personalize your seaplane with vibrant skins and custom configurations. 

🎨 Full character customization. Make your avatar uniquely yours, from hairstyle to outfits and accessories. 

🛠️ Build your island base, decorate it, and make Lou’s Lagoon feel like home. 

❔A mystery to unravel. Piece together clues, follow Lou’s trail, and uncover the truth behind his disappearance! 

Whether you’re hot on the trail to solving the mystery of Uncle Lou or just kicking back and enjoying island life, Lou’s Lagoon is your ticket to an exciting adventure.  

Ready for takeoff?

descriptions.en: Love n Life: Happy Student, a unique dating sim, incorporates inventory management for the first time. As a top-scoring third-year student, you are chosen to join the most prestigious college, where you’ll meet gorgeous ladies. Discover intriguing personalities and the school’s mysteries.

detailed_descriptions.en: 💘 Love n Life: Happy Student 💘 At Reborn Entertainment, creativity drives everything we do as we’re committed to delivering fresh experiences. For us, fun isn’t just a goal, it’s the rule. ⭐ Main Features Experience dating through the unique Inventory Management system with over 300 unique items. Complete the 5 main and 3 side girls ' objectives to experience over 40 romantic moments with over 100 beautiful illustrations. Beautiful girls come to life with Live2D animations. Massive story content and secrets to explore, with more than 200 events . Mini-games: Cooking, fishing, Sports, reading, and more. Stay connected using social apps, texting, collections, taking photos, and a music player on your phone. ⭐ Innovative Gameplay For the first time ever , inventory management meets dating-sim in a bold fusion that delivers a truly unique experience. Your items aren’t just for show. They shape how you engage in every conversation and win hearts, offering you a sensational experience like no other. Each person you encounter brings unique skills and persuasive strategies. Be prepared to adapt and respond to every challenge. Master one of the traits, Confidence, Charm, Kindness, or Knowledge, for great replayability. Each unlocks over 300 powerful items with rich stats. Experiment, combine, and create thrilling builds for endless strategic fun. This addictive core gameplay promises countless hours of entertainment. ⭐ Story You're a third-year college student living in the suburbs. After taking a competitive exam, you’re lucky enough to transfer to the prestigious Lingyun University, located on a small island not far from the mainland coast. The university boasts cutting-edge technology and frequently secures major project contracts with powerful corporations. The school itself also holds many secrets and hidden dramas waiting to be uncovered. ⭐ Romance You're here to gain valuable knowledge… right? But don’t be surprised when the ladies can’t resist your charm. With over 40 romantic encounters , each more tempting than the last, you’ll find yourself drawn into sensational moments far more thrilling than textbooks. And if you’re daring enough to dig deeper, you might just uncover some hidden pleasures they don’t teach in class. ⭐ Social Activities Beyond dating, master your lifestyle with activities like sports, fishing, art, and more. Level up your stats and use your new skills to impress the girls and unlock deeper intimacy. ⭐ The ladies: 💘 Liu Yating - College Student You're in the same class as a beautiful, carefree girl who loves to explore new things. She’s destined to become your best friend. 💘 Chen Meiling - Literature Professor The literature teacher at your school and the dorm manager where you live. With her sweet, kind, and playful personality, she’s the teacher every student loves having in class! 💘 Qin Yilin - Student Council President "Only knowledge and discipline create elite students. Without them, you're dust." The Student Council President is cool, elegant, and well-organized. She’s determined to push every student to reach their highest potential—no matter what it takes! 💘 Luna-3X - Virtual Assistant She manages your schedule and informs you of important tasks that need to be done. She also helps with things better left unseen… all with a very glitchy personality. 💘 The Cafe Owner She is your safe haven, offering a space of peace and sanctuary where you don’t have to worry about all the pressure a man is expected to carry on his shoulders. 💘 And Other Mysterious Ladies The island’s full of surprises and the girls are the biggest ones. They’ll charm you, confuse you, maybe even scare you a little... all while dragging you into their delightful mess of mystery and mayhem. Your life’s not just getting turned upside down, but it will get a lot crazier than that...

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
💘Love n Life: Happy Student💘

At Reborn Entertainment, creativity drives everything we do as we’re committed to delivering fresh experiences. For us, fun isn’t just a goal, it’s the rule. 

⭐ Main Features

  • Experience dating through the unique Inventory Management system with over 300 unique items.

  • Complete the 5 main and 3 side girls' objectives to experience over 40 romantic moments with over 100 beautiful illustrations.

  • Beautiful girls come to life with Live2D animations.

  • Massive story content and secrets to explore, with more than 200 events.

  • Mini-games: Cooking, fishing, Sports, reading, and more.

  • Stay connected using social apps, texting, collections, taking photos, and a music player on your phone.

⭐ Innovative Gameplay

For the first time ever, inventory management meets dating-sim in a bold fusion that delivers a truly unique experience. Your items aren’t just for show. They shape how you engage in every conversation and win hearts, offering you a sensational experience like no other. Each person you encounter brings unique skills and persuasive strategies. Be prepared to adapt and respond to every challenge.

Master one of the traits, Confidence, Charm, Kindness, or Knowledge, for great replayability. Each unlocks over 300 powerful items with rich stats. Experiment, combine, and create thrilling builds for endless strategic fun. This addictive core gameplay promises countless hours of entertainment.

⭐ Story

You're a third-year college student living in the suburbs. After taking a competitive exam, you’re lucky enough to transfer to the prestigious Lingyun University, located on a small island not far from the mainland coast. The university boasts cutting-edge technology and frequently secures major project contracts with powerful corporations. The school itself also holds many secrets and hidden dramas waiting to be uncovered.

⭐ Romance

You're here to gain valuable knowledge… right? But don’t be surprised when the ladies can’t resist your charm. With over 40 romantic encounters, each more tempting than the last, you’ll find yourself drawn into sensational moments far more thrilling than textbooks. And if you’re daring enough to dig deeper, you might just uncover some hidden pleasures they don’t teach in class.

⭐ Social Activities

Beyond dating, master your lifestyle with activities like sports, fishing, art, and more. Level up your stats and use your new skills to impress the girls and unlock deeper intimacy.

⭐The ladies:

💘 Liu Yating - College Student

You're in the same class as a beautiful, carefree girl who loves to explore new things. She’s destined to become your best friend.

💘 Chen Meiling - Literature Professor

The literature teacher at your school and the dorm manager where you live. With her sweet, kind, and playful personality, she’s the teacher every student loves having in class!

💘 Qin Yilin - Student Council President

"Only knowledge and discipline create elite students. Without them, you're dust." The Student Council President is cool, elegant, and well-organized. She’s determined to push every student to reach their highest potential—no matter what it takes!

💘 Luna-3X - Virtual Assistant

She manages your schedule and informs you of important tasks that need to be done. She also helps with things better left unseen… all with a very glitchy personality.

💘 The Cafe Owner

She is your safe haven, offering a space of peace and sanctuary where you don’t have to worry about all the pressure a man is expected to carry on his shoulders.

💘 And Other Mysterious Ladies

The island’s full of surprises and the girls are the biggest ones. They’ll charm you, confuse you, maybe even scare you a little... all while dragging you into their delightful mess of mystery and mayhem. Your life’s not just getting turned upside down, but it will get a lot crazier than that...

games.name: Low-Budget Repairs
games.short_description: Manage renovations in 90s apartment blocks! Focus on quick profit and cut costs wherever possible. Client notices defects? Tough luck, the money's already in your pocket. Every day brings new challenges and decisions that can lead to fortune... or trouble!

descriptions.en: Manage renovations in 90s apartment blocks! Focus on quick profit and cut costs wherever possible. Client notices defects? Tough luck, the money's already in your pocket. Every day brings new challenges and decisions that can lead to fortune... or trouble!

detailed_descriptions.en: Imagine yourself as a DIY handyman, running your own small business in a Polish block of flats during the 1990s. Your mission? To make as much money as possible by cutting costs wherever you can! Diluting paint with water to make it last for the entire apartment? Sure, the color might not be as vibrant, but who’s going to notice? Laying tiles without a level? A bit of unevenness adds "character" to the space. After all, what matters is the quick result, not perfection! Don’t worry—if the client spots any flaws after you’ve left, the profit is already yours! Furniture doesn’t fit through the door? No problem—quick thinking, open the window, and… everything flies out into the yard! Clean room and a happy client… as long as they didn’t park under the window. In the hardware store, you’ll be like a seasoned hunter, searching for the cheapest tools that will “sort of” get the job done. A hammer on sale that barely lasts a few hits? Grab two! After the job’s done, take pride in your work—just ignore those little imperfections! Take on various renovation and repair jobs. Fixing a flooded bathroom, or maybe a complete remodel? Every day is a new challenge, and every decision can bring a quick profit… or a cascade of problems.

detailed_descriptions.en: Lucid Cats is an online co-op horror game for up to four players featuring creepy monsters, liminal procedurally generated dream levels, and proximity voice chat. 🐾 Play with friends: Lucid Cats uses invite-only lobbies. FALL ASLEEP Wake together in a shared dream: weird, nostalgic, and full of valuables to take. LOOT THE DREAM Valuables are instantly credited to you. However, you can only keep them if you find the dream exit and meet the quota. PROCEDURAL LEVELS + SECURITY CAMERAS A weirdcore, dreamcore descent into places that are nostalgic, unsettling, and laid out differently every time. FIND THE EXIT Use proximity voice chat to guide each other and stay immersed. Find the exit to keep your haul. If you die in the dream, you wake with nothing.

games.name: Lucky Tower Ultimate
games.short_description: Escape from an incredibly dangerous, randomly generated tower in a slapstick, roguelite adventure that looks like a cartoon and feels like a joke. Slashy slashy!

descriptions.en: Escape from an incredibly dangerous, randomly generated tower in a slapstick, roguelite adventure that looks like a cartoon and feels like a joke. Slashy slashy!

detailed_descriptions.en: Evelius’s Tower awaits you, adventurers. Do you have what it takes to make it out alive? Lucky Tower Ultimate is an absurd adventure that will bamboozle you in its difficulty, while enchanting you with its absurdly funny charm. Be prepared to perish at the hands of the uncompromising Tower's traps and monsters countless times before you can even think about escaping to the local village - and only then can progression be earned. Embark on a quest with the delightfully narcissistic knight, Von Wanst, as he finds himself zapped into the perplexing Tower with no armor, weapons, or clear path to escape. Seek aid (and extra firepower) from a lovable cast of quirky companions. With each death, Von Wanst is transported back to the top of the randomly generated Tower to start again, ensuring that no two journeys are ever the same. Lucky Tower encourages improvisation, mastery, and learning as you play. Experiment with puzzles and enemies, and take your time to learn the twists and tricks of the Tower if you want to survive. Lucky Tower Ultimate is infused with slapstick humor and a hand-drawn aesthetic, making each run feel like an immersive cartoon. As a continuation of the cult classic Flash game series about choosing between three mysterious doors, the Lucky Tower beckons seasoned fans and new players alike to experience the unique pleasure of getting all geared up... just to slip on a banana peel and die. From broccoli to dead enemies, everything in the game can be used as a weapon A village for commerce, meta-progression, and a customizable home awaits you after you escape the tower Companions and enemies react to the way you treat them - friends turn to foes if you step on their toes, and villains can open doors for you if you help them out along the way Journey through the tower to find 200+ items, ranging from Golden Armor to a honk horn, and 40+ traps, like barrels of dynamite and bee hives For those who seek to truly become the ultimate knight, the True Ending and final boss fight will be added for the launch of version 1.0! Randomly generated levels and haircuts keeps every playthrough fresh Hand-drawn 2D graphics that feel like an immersive cartoon Full voice acting makes for kickin’ times and smashing punchlines Multiple ways to exit the tower, including a dark and atmospheric Cave Learn and experiment without limitations (or hand holding) Unlock companion quests by escaping the tower with them by your side Our Discord is the best place to go for insights into the game’s development, and provide feedback during Early Access. Join our Discord via the links section of our Steam page, under the listed Languages!

Play solo, or team up with friends in 1-4 player online co-op. Choose relaxing Cozy, challenging Adventure, or epic Hero mode to match your mood and playstyle.

descriptions.en: Get ready to explore, farm, fish, mine, craft, and raise magical Lumas as you solve puzzles and embark on quests across Luma Island. Play solo, or team up with friends in 1-4 player online co-op. Choose relaxing Cozy, challenging Adventure, or epic Hero mode to match your mood and playstyle.

detailed_descriptions.en: Seeking a fresh start, you've bought Old Man Jeffrey's farm and rustic caravan on Luma Island. Explore, craft, mine, fish, uncover secrets, build your dream farm & collect magical Lumas in an awesome 1-4 player adventure. No stamina bars, no inventory limits, and no checks on your creativity! Play your way: Cozy, Adventure, or Hero mode, solo or with friends. Raise Lumas and Build Your Dream Farm The island is home to magical creatures called Lumas. Track down mysterious eggs, hatch them, and get unique companions with special abilities to help explore and uncover treasure. Turn your rundown farm into a thriving homestead. Grow crops, raise animals, and build decorative items, from quaint cottages to sprawling estates. Explore and Adventure Your Way Venture through lush forests, soaring mountains, dense jungles, and a newly uncovered pirate cove. Outsmart traps, conquer pirate-themed minigames, and uncover ancient secrets buried in the island’s temples. Embrace Island Life Choose your profession and fish in crystal waters, mine for rare materials, cook hearty meals, and craft gear to sell in town. Meet the island’s quirky locals, complete their quests, and uncover their stories. Express yourself with outfits and accessories you can swap anytime via your wardrobe. Raise Lumas and Build Your Dream Farm

Turn your rundown farm into a thriving homestead. Grow crops, raise animals, and build  decorative items, from quaint cottages to sprawling estates.

games.name: LumenTale: Memories of Trey
games.short_description: LumenTale: Memories of Trey is a captivating Monster Collector RPG set in a beautiful and enchanting world. Follow Trey as he embarks on an adventure to recover his missing memories and make new ones with the Animon.

descriptions.en: LumenTale: Memories of Trey is a captivating Monster Collector RPG set in a beautiful and enchanting world. Follow Trey as he embarks on an adventure to recover his missing memories and make new ones with the Animon.

detailed_descriptions.en: Embark on an unforgettable adventure with LumenTale: Memories of Trey, a captivating Monster Collector RPG set in a beautiful and enchanting world. Discover an emotional tale of self-discovery, adventure through captivating regions each as unique as their people. Join Trey as he navigates his way through a land full of mystical creatures to reveal the mystery behind his lost memories. Long ago, in the golden era of Talea, the Emperor kept the lands peaceful, and the people prospered. After passing away without naming a successor between his twin sons, a civil war raged between the North, Logos and the South, Mythos - fighting for who would take control of the throne. The townsfolk lived in fear from the atrocities being carried out in the conflict. In a bid to stop the destruction, a part of the empire’s military became Talea’s dedicated protectors. From the everlasting darkness of war, these people were the beacon of light that brought people hope. The Lumen were born, and as guardians in their provinces, they ensure the safety of the residents of Talea, both the people and the Animon. Since ancient times, people have long studied the Animon. Not much is known of their nature to this day. They’re made of Anivis, an energy that flows through the whole world, and they possess the ability to affect emotions and interact with the very soul of every living being. Catch the Animon and become inseparable partners as you harness their elemental powers and battle alongside each other with your Holoken. Test your skills with the Holoken and catch Animon in the field to recruit them to your party or initiate an incredible and exciting battle against them to prove your mettle! Every Animon can perform their own abilities and skills, and victory is achieved through using the best strategy with your team. There are around 140 known species with 13 elemental types, which are categorized with attributes depending on the emotion they're able to evoke in people. Engage in thrilling 1v1 duels or team up for epic 4v4 showdowns with your party in battle. Level up your Animon and outsmart your opponents by using the best strategy to win. Each Animon has strengths and weaknesses for you to uncover, so use them to your advantage. With up to 3 different ways to trade your Animon, you can effortlessly complete your collection and build the perfect battle team. Connect to the Animon Trade Station to seek the Animon you need, trade directly with friends, or the community. While on your adventure, be sure to take a rest at the Fountain, where you’ll be able to craft useful items and cook delicious food! If you’re feeling adventurous, you’ll be able to experiment with ingredients to help nurture your Animon. The Anispace is a place that exists and doesn’t exist at the same time. A space detached from the world as we know it. Here is where you’ll find your Animon after you capture them and where you’ll be able to train your Animon for battle. Customise their space when they’re not in your battle party and create stronger bonds with them!

games.name: Luminary
games.short_description: "Very Positive" Demo, Luminary is a solo or co-op OpenZone Action RPG that creates a balanced experience for everyone. Using a unique world and character progression system, explore vast hand-crafted lands together, uncover hidden treasures, level up your town, and push back the darkness with light.

descriptions.en: "Very Positive" Demo, Luminary is a solo or co-op OpenZone Action RPG that creates a balanced experience for everyone. Using a unique world and character progression system, explore vast hand-crafted lands together, uncover hidden treasures, level up your town, and push back the darkness with light.

detailed_descriptions.en: Welcome to Luminary, a balanced ARPG-lite that can be played Solo, or with friends . Scope could grow if the Early Access does well and the community grows, but for Day 1 expect : - Forgiving Combat and straight forward game mechanics to bring newbies to the genre - No Fuss Drop In Drop Out Co-op Multiplayer, simple for friends and family - Character Creator with 6 Races, Hair Styles, Beards, Make Up, etc. - Continued Character progression across your solo game OR friend's games and back - Half of 2km sq OpenZone Map to explore with multiple modes of traversal (Larger Map Planned) - Quick Swap Different weapon types for dynamic combat, Sword/Shield, Bow, Magic Glove to start - Enemies to fight and camps / bases to destroy, Large towers to liberate - Mini Bosses, Main Boss fight to "Beat the Game" will come later when we release the map's back half - Experience can be replayed at harder difficulties to continue fun and progression (There is only two of us making this game, so while I know everyone is enthusiastic about the possibilities, please allow us some time to cook. Content is going to take us a little longer than a big team, but we have a plan for success) A dense hand crafted world to explore, with a robust fun locomotion system that allows you to go anywhere. Climb the tallest mountains, brave the deepest waters, glide to distant lands, with many hidden treasure to uncover A real time skill based combat system, where you can switch between fighting styles at the press of a button. Melee, Ranged, Magic, Blocking, Dodging, Enjoy! and swap to different weapons during fights to keep it dynamic Drop in Drop out, 3 players online, with a planned 2 player local couch co-op option. No Hassle and No Problems. The Character you’ve been progressing in your Solo game, is the same one you will use and progress further in Co-op Use a simplified Character Creator to make your unique character from multiple fantasy races to truly stand out Your progression stays with you, from solo, to co-op and back through multiple playthroughs. And even your town upgrades go with you into New Game +. You will Unlock new Tier levels of difficulty every time you beat the maps end boss, and those higher Tiers are where the enemies are tougher but the rewards and XP are even greater. There will be mining, fishing, animal catching, and other things to enjoy. And in Multiplayer you are not tied to your Host’s location, you are free to play your way, even in their game. You can be the team’s miner, searching for the best ores, and trade them to your friends for their precious GOLD! Save the towns people and use gathered resources to help them rebuild to their former glory. The Blacksmith, Armorer, Arcanist and Chef can level up as well, granting the ability to sell and craft better equipment Centuries ago, a primal magic surged from the earth's depths, fueling empires but twisting it's inhabitant and the world into corruption's grasp. Forests blackened, skies bled shadow, and rivers turned to poison. But a less prevalent radiant energy was also born, and hidden within pure warriors, the Luminaries. Armed with the light, their goal is to reclaim the land, hurling back the blight. Yet the Luminary's gift is double-edged, immortality that tempts the soul. Every 80 years, Luminaries must yield their light to a successor, or risk eternal decay. Defiant ones hoard it, swelling into godlike tyrants of darkness, the Ebonarchs As a new Luminary, rise in power. Shatter the Ebonarch's abyssal power source to strip their immortality, and strike them down. Together with your fellow Luminaries, push back the Darkness with Light.

games.name: Luna Abyss
games.short_description: Luna Abyss is a single player story driven action-adventure with fluid platforming and bullet hell combat. Follow the journey of Fawkes, a prisoner of Luna caught between a cryptic prophecy and their prison sentence.

descriptions.en: Luna Abyss is a single player story driven action-adventure with fluid platforming and bullet hell combat. Follow the journey of Fawkes, a prisoner of Luna caught between a cryptic prophecy and their prison sentence.

detailed_descriptions.en: You are a prisoner sentenced to explore a derelict megastructure that sprawls deep beneath the surface of the mimic moon Luna. You are tasked with recovering forgotten technology from within the Abyss and the lost colony it consumed. Every move you make will be overseen by your artificial prison guard named Aylin. These centuries-old ruins are alive with maddening echoes, insinuating secrets of the once prosperous city of Greymont and its terrible fate. The Scourge. The tenets of the All-Father. The choir of the Collective. The voices of the Abyss call to you; they whisper strange missives... "Don’t be afraid, little wanderer. You need only go deeper, the better to be seen by us. The slumbering silent one breathes deep and waits. All we need is the key. All we need is you." Uncover the mysteries of the mimic moon, and the abyss within its depths. Come face to face with remnants of the colony’s downfall & discover your role within this doomed world. Learn all the secrets the abyss has to offer. Sprint, jump & dash your way through this brutalist alien megastructure. Experience fluid first-person platforming as you travel through Luna & the depths of the abyss. Face corrupted souls & twisted cosmic horrors of Luna Abyss with weapon in hand. Master your tools, adjust on the fly and survive in a bullet hell.

detailed_descriptions.en: Lunar Drifter is an arcade first person shooter heavily inspired by The Mercenaries minigame from the Resident Evil series. Tear apart the highest amount of enemies possible while running and gunning to keep yourself alive, while finding clocks and hourglasses to give yourself precious extra seconds and make the most of your limited time. Be the ultimate legion killer. Aim precisely, move fast, heal up, and do not let the combo break! As you progress through the chaos, more dangerous it will be, the enemies will get all kinds of backup varying from infantry, choppers, tanks, and even the undead itself. Each of the 4 playable characters have their own unique play style. Engage at long range with snipers, run and gun with pistols and smgs, or face the enemy in close quarters with sledgehammers and shotguns. You'll get to choose your own route in the main Arcade Mode . DANGER LEVEL will get carried over between Scenarios in your journey and even between different runs! games.name: LUNAR Remastered Collection
games.short_description: Dive into the enchanting worlds of LUNAR: Silver Star Story Complete and LUNAR 2: Eternal Blue Complete! Tag along on Alex and Hiro's quests and challenge enemies like the Magic Emperor and God of Destruction to save the world from dire peril in two adventures set 1000 years apart from each other!

descriptions.en: Dive into the enchanting worlds of LUNAR: Silver Star Story Complete and LUNAR 2: Eternal Blue Complete! Tag along on Alex and Hiro's quests and challenge enemies like the Magic Emperor and God of Destruction to save the world from dire peril in two adventures set 1000 years apart from each other!

detailed_descriptions.en: It’s time to journey back to the stars! Dive into the enchanting worlds of LUNAR: Silver Star Story Complete and LUNAR 2: Eternal Blue Complete, two beloved JRPGs that have captured the hearts of gamers for generations. LUNAR: Silver Star Story LUNAR: Silver Star Story introduces Alex, an aspiring Dragonmaster who bands together with his friends to combat the perilous emergence of the Magic Emperor and stop him from taking over the world. LUNAR 2: Eternal Blue LUNAR 2: Eternal Blue picks up a thousand years later, and follows Hiro and his friends as they set out in search of the Goddess Althena alongside an enigmatic girl named Lucia. On this grand quest, fend off enemies like Borgan and White Knight Leo, who hunt down the group to eradicate what they deem to be the "Destroyer of Lunar." This definitive remastered edition features enhanced graphics, audio, and quality-of-life improvements that will satiate that hunger for 90s nostalgia--better than you remember! Embark on these two adventures with updated language support, now available in English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean, French, and German. Master the Turn-Based Battle System Engage in turn-based combat using your party’s arsenal of magic, skills, and items. Each character possesses defined strengths and unique skills that can be leveled up and learned throughout your journey. In LUNAR 2: Eternal Blue Complete, explore the Crest System, in which characters may acquire benefits such as stat boosts and high-level magic from crest synergies. Remastered Animated Cutscenes As you explore, immerse yourself deeper within the universe with fully voiced in-game scenes and animated cutscenes, now with remastered graphics. Quality of Life Improvements Battle speed can now be adjusted at any point during battle, with three speeds to choose from. In LUNAR: Silver Star Story Complete, enjoy a toggleable inventory management system in which all characters in the party share a combined inventory. Also in LUNAR 1, we've improved the Auto Battle system by making it possible for players to customize the CPU behavior of individual characters. Play the Remastered Mode... or the Classic Mode! Remastered Mode Embark on the iconic adventures of LUNAR 1 and LUNAR 2 with all the remastered features, such as: widescreen (16:9) layout, enhanced sound and graphics, and updated character portrait sprites, menu icons, and bromides! Classic Mode If nostalgia is what you crave, switch it over to the classic mode! Experience retro visuals with a 4:3 screen; original cutscenes, effects, and icons; three CRT filter options; and more.

On this grand quest, fend off enemies like Borgan and White Knight Leo, who hunt down the group to eradicate what they deem to be the "Destroyer of Lunar." 

This definitive remastered edition features enhanced graphics, audio, and quality-of-life improvements that will satiate that hunger for 90s nostalgia--better than you remember! Embark on these two adventures with updated language support, now available in English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean, French, and German.

Engage in turn-based combat using your party’s arsenal of magic, skills, and items. Each character possesses defined strengths and unique skills that can be leveled up and learned throughout your journey. In LUNAR 2: Eternal Blue Complete, explore the Crest System, in which characters may acquire benefits such as stat boosts and high-level magic from crest synergies.

Together, they journey to save a dying world, engaging in challenging battles to retrieve the lost glow of the stars and forsaken memories, unveiling cosmic secrets.

descriptions.en: Lunarium is an atmospheric fantasy A-RPG. Play as Ave, a light-armored knight, who teams up with Lune, a mysterious Starfarer. Together, they journey to save a dying world, engaging in challenging battles to retrieve the lost glow of the stars and forsaken memories, unveiling cosmic secrets.

detailed_descriptions.en: On the brink of collapse in the world of Lunarium, two girls—Ave and Lune step forward. To save their dying homeland, they embark on a perilous journey into the unknown. Across multiple worlds, they must overcome countless trials while piecing together the ancient secrets of this realm—and ultimately uncover the truth hidden within themselves. Play as Ave , a light-armored knight, and journey alongside Lune , a flaxen-haired girl with mysterious powers. Together, they set out to save a world on the brink of collapse. Sword and magic echo between them as they fight side by side, weaving a bond that belongs to them alone. Ave An agile knight skilled in close-quarters sword combat. With precise dodges and well-timed parries, she turns enemy attacks aside and strikes back. She is the party’s blade — and the one who stands at the front when danger closes in. Lune A girl who wields mysterious magic. She can weaken enemies, enhance Ave’s attacks, and break through obstacles in the environment. She is an irreplaceable source of support — and the key to moving forward. Players can adjust Ave’s combat style through Embroidery , the Skill Tree , and Cloaks , building a flexible progression system for different ways to fight. Cloak System Cloaks offer both unique appearances and ability effects. Players can choose different cloaks to match their preferred way of fighting. Embroidery System Embroidery works like charms, each carrying a different power. Equipping them grants Ave passive enhancements that can support different combat styles. Step into unguarded temples, the ruins of fallen kingdoms, and churches shrouded in dark mist. Each area has its own atmosphere, terrain, and combat rhythm. Explore forgotten lands, observe your surroundings, learn the mechanics, and press onward through a journey filled with danger. "Our journey begins with parting, and perhaps it will also face parting in the end. The hardships along the way will surpass your understanding and imagination... You might even feel pain because of this." "Even so, will you still come with me?"

games.name: Lushfoil Photography Sim
games.short_description: A tranquil exploration and photography experience set across a vast selection of faithfully detailed landscapes.

descriptions.en: A tranquil exploration and photography experience set across a vast selection of faithfully detailed landscapes.

detailed_descriptions.en: Experience detailed, true-to-life recreations of beautiful and diverse locations around the world. Trek through and explore environments to capture stunning vistas and landscapes with your fully-featured in-game camera. Each environment is filled with objectives to reward players that have a good eye for angles and perspectives, and hidden secrets for those who are patient and observant. The rich atmosphere of Lushfoil Photography Sim is enhanced by an ambient, ethereal soundtrack featuring licensed music from artists around the world. Capture the Perfect Shot The in-game camera includes an abundance of settings that you'd expect from a real-world professional DSLR camera. The camera simulates settings such as Auto/Manual Focus, Flash, Exposure, Contrast, White Balance, Aperture, Burst Shot and other effects for full creative control over your photography. The game further provides tools that allow for manipulation of the environmental conditions for your photos, such as manual adjustment of light angles, fog, snow, wind, and rain. Off the Beaten Path Dive deeper into the game’s many locations to find unlockable cameras and experience the world from unique perspectives. Find a first-person drone that allows you to soar above the landscape and capture the world from above, or find a hidden rowboat that allows you to traverse still waters in pursuit of the perfect shot. Very Efficiently Optimised Each environment has been created in Unreal Engine 5 and is built from the ground up to be both efficiently optimized and showcase the game’s locations in stunning visual fidelity. There are extensive custom settings that will help the game run on a wide range of PCs, while taking full advantage of high-end graphics cards.

games.name: Machinefall
games.short_description: Machinefall is a post-apocalyptic real time strategy game set on a fully playable global map. Lead humanity’s last survivors as they build bases, gather resources, and wage massive battles against an overwhelming machine swarm. Progress through technological eras from Stone Age to Atomic Age.

descriptions.en: Machinefall is a post-apocalyptic real time strategy game set on a fully playable global map. Lead humanity’s last survivors as they build bases, gather resources, and wage massive battles against an overwhelming machine swarm. Progress through technological eras from Stone Age to Atomic Age.

detailed_descriptions.en: Machinefall is a post-apocalyptic real time strategy game that combines base building, resource management, large-scale battles, and a massive world map. Lead the remnants of mankind in a desperate struggle for survival. The planet has been ravaged by an army of mechanical bugs, leaving cities in ruins and civilization in tatters. Starting with only a handful of survivors, you must rebuild from the ashes, gathering resources, establishing strongholds, and rallying humanity’s last hope against the relentless superiority of the machines. Grand Scale Strategy: A Global Battlefield Earth is your playground, offering unparalleled scale and immersion. Zoom seamlessly from a detailed orbital view of the planet down to street level skirmishes anywhere on the map. Control the action on both micro and macro levels, whether commanding individual units in the heat of battle or making high level strategic decisions to tip the war in your favor. Thousands of Units on Screen: Epic Battles Await Prepare for breathtaking battles as you lead massive armies into combat. Experience the chaos and intensity of thousands of units clashing on the battlefield, with swarms of enemy bugs testing your strategy and resolve. Base Building and Resource Management: Rebuild, Reinforce, Resist Begin with modest settlements and evolve into a network of industrial powerhouses spanning the globe. Construct and upgrade buildings, extract valuable resources, and process them in factories to fuel your war machine. Progress Through Eras: From the Stone Age to the Space Age Advance through distinct technological eras, each bringing unique upgrades and abilities to the battlefield. Begin with primitive tools and basic strategies, then unlock advanced technologies as you progress. The tech tree offers a wealth of possibilities, enabling you to customize your approach to combat and resource management as you rise to meet the challenge. Fight for Humanity’s Survival With a mix of grand scale strategy, intense real time battles, and deep resource management, Machinefall offers an unparalleled gaming experience. Lead humanity in its darkest hour, fight for survival against all odds, and reclaim the Earth from the grip of mechanical dominance.

games.name: Mad Games Tycoon 2
games.short_description: Start your own game development studio in 1976. Build your own offices, production facilities and server rooms. Develop the games of your dreams and produce the next next-gen console. Rise from a small garage company to a huge corporation.

descriptions.en: Start your own game development studio in 1976. Build your own offices, production facilities and server rooms. Develop the games of your dreams and produce the next next-gen console. Rise from a small garage company to a huge corporation.

detailed_descriptions.en: Build and design your own game studio Starting in any year between 1976 and 2020, begin building your dream game company. With every passing year you will need to research new technologies and features, develop or license better game engines, and make the decisions necessary to go from a small garage studio to an industry dominating mega company. Prepare to release your next hit game on home consoles, handhelds, computers or even arcade machines, each having their own unique market. You will need to hire the top talent available, and they will need lounges, bathrooms and amenities that create a comfortable and clean environment to develop in. Expand your studio with new office space, go from a few employees to hundreds, and make moves to grow from just being a developer to being a developer, publisher, and console manufacturer as you begin to control the entire gaming market and owning all the companies in it! Key features include... ▪ Multiplayer for up to 4 players allowing you to work together or against each other. Trade technologies, send each other funds, or sabotage your friends as you compete for the top spots on all the charts. ▪ With "Mad Games Tycoon 2" you can create MMOs, Free to play games, Mobile games, Arcade games, Addons, Spin-offs, GOTY editions, Game Bundles, Budget games, Retro games, Sequels and Remasters or Ports your games. Buy popular licenses from things such as books, toys, movies and sports to give your games a built-in audience. ▪ Every game is a part of a growing IP (Intellectual Property/Franchise), build up the reputation of your IPs into gaming powerhouses that have your fans counting down the days until the next hit. Merchandise these IPs for extra income. Sell IPs you have let become dormant or buy popular IPs from other companies. ▪ Make your own game engines, or license them from competitors. Keep them up to date with the latest technologies to stay ahead of the competition and take a cut of the profits from every game made with it. ▪ Develop games for publishers while working independently, through contract work or sign exclusive publishing contracts for a monetary boost. ▪ Produce and distribute your own games or games from the competition. Choose the right price, how many copies you think you can sell and start your marketing campaigns to increase your chances of success. ▪ Create your own home and handheld consoles. Hire talented technicians to build a reliable console, pick the right parts that fit that era’s technology. Decide what kind of warranty you will offer, provide monetary incentives to attract developers to your console and boost your sales through game releases and exclusives. Make Pro/Slim/Upgraded versions of your existing consoles to extend their sales life and boost their technology. ▪ Determine the best time to release your next hit game, follow the trends, look at the market analysis, if it should be a multiplatform or should you accept financial incentives to develop exclusively for another console. ▪ With up to 100 competing companies, once you begin to get the upper hand on the competition you can buy them and give them specific guidelines on what kind of games you want them to make, or if you choose, just take all their IPs and shut them down completely. ▪ Gaming history to be made – tons of charts and numbers! Track your current and all-time successes. Historical records, current market analysis and market research. Want to see who won game of the year in 1986 when you’re still playing in 2044? It’s a few clicks away. Play for a century and beyond. ▪ Difficulty options ranging from very easy all the way up to a challenging legendary difficulty. These options can be further tweaked with other settings, and if that’s still not enough control for your playstyle there is a full sandbox mode with dozens of options to tailor the challenge exactly to the way you want to play. And much more to discover in Mad Games Tycoon 2!

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Build and design your own game studio


Starting in any year between 1976 and 2020, begin building your dream game company. With every passing year you will need to research new technologies and features, develop or license better game engines, and make the decisions necessary to go from a small garage studio to an industry dominating mega company. Prepare to release your next hit game on home consoles, handhelds, computers or even arcade machines, each having their own unique market.

You will need to hire the top talent available, and they will need lounges, bathrooms and amenities that create a comfortable and clean environment to develop in.

Expand your studio with new office space, go from a few employees to hundreds, and make moves to grow from just being a developer to being a developer, publisher, and console manufacturer as you begin to control the entire gaming market and owning all the companies in it!

Key features include...


▪ Multiplayer for up to 4 players allowing you to work together or against each other. Trade technologies, send each other funds, or sabotage your friends as you compete for the top spots on all the charts.

▪ With "Mad Games Tycoon 2" you can create MMOs, Free to play games, Mobile games, Arcade games, Addons, Spin-offs, GOTY editions, Game Bundles, Budget games, Retro games, Sequels and Remasters or Ports your games. Buy popular licenses from things such as books, toys, movies and sports to give your games a built-in audience.

▪ Every game is a part of a growing IP (Intellectual Property/Franchise), build up the reputation of your IPs into gaming powerhouses that have your fans counting down the days until the next hit. Merchandise these IPs for extra income. Sell IPs you have let become dormant or buy popular IPs from other companies.

▪ Make your own game engines, or license them from competitors. Keep them up to date with the latest technologies to stay ahead of the competition and take a cut of the profits from every game made with it.

▪ Develop games for publishers while working independently, through contract work or sign exclusive publishing contracts for a monetary boost.

▪ Produce and distribute your own games or games from the competition. Choose the right price, how many copies you think you can sell and start your marketing campaigns to increase your chances of success.

▪ Create your own home and handheld consoles. Hire talented technicians to build a reliable console, pick the right parts that fit that era’s technology. Decide what kind of warranty you will offer, provide monetary incentives to attract developers to your console and boost your sales through game releases and exclusives. Make Pro/Slim/Upgraded versions of your existing consoles to extend their sales life and boost their technology.

▪ Determine the best time to release your next hit game, follow the trends, look at the market analysis, if it should be a multiplatform or should you accept financial incentives to develop exclusively for another console.

▪ With up to 100 competing companies, once you begin to get the upper hand on the competition you can buy them and give them specific guidelines on what kind of games you want them to make, or if you choose, just take all their IPs and shut them down completely.

▪ Gaming history to be made – tons of charts and numbers! Track your current and all-time successes. Historical records, current market analysis and market research. Want to see who won game of the year in 1986 when you’re still playing in 2044? It’s a few clicks away. Play for a century and beyond.

▪ Difficulty options ranging from very easy all the way up to a challenging legendary difficulty. These options can be further tweaked with other settings, and if that’s still not enough control for your playstyle there is a full sandbox mode with dozens of options to tailor the challenge exactly to the way you want to play.


And much more to discover in Mad Games Tycoon 2!

games.name: Maestro's Cold War 2
games.short_description: Addictive yet chill. An immersive Cold War sandbox. Revive the Cold War in this classic strategy game—easy to pick up, yet challenging and deep, offering endless replayability.

descriptions.en: Addictive yet chill. An immersive Cold War sandbox. Revive the Cold War in this classic strategy game—easy to pick up, yet challenging and deep, offering endless replayability.

detailed_descriptions.en: Maestro’s Cold War 2 is a replayable grand-strategy sandbox about the world’s tensest standoff of the Cold War. Play as the USA or the USSR , manage Prestige, Budget, and National Policies , and bend history through policies, proxies, diplomacy, and brinkmanship. Easy to pick-up but hard and deep enough to offer a challenge, this is the kind of game you will keep coming back to. How Does the Game Work? The objective is simple: earn more prestige points than your opponent. You gain prestige by improving diplomatic relations and signing treaties with countries across the globe. At the same time, your opponent will work relentlessly to undermine the nations in your bloc and shift the balance of power in their favor. Beyond diplomacy, you must also manage your nation’s internal policies and carefully plan how to exploit the geopolitical landscape to weaken your rival over time. Are you ready to lead your ideology to global dominance—or will history repeat itself? If you're familiar with my work, you know I focus on crafting games you can enjoy in a single evening, yet with enough depth to offer endless replayability. I’m confident the game's simple mechanics paired with historical events that force you to make impactful choices, will provide over 100 hours of entertainment. Now: Have fun! (this is an order, not a wish!) -Maestro Cinetik Is this game for you? You are looking for a deep simulation of the Soviet Politburo: Probably not. This game focuses on Cold War geostrategy rather than the internal politics of a single country. If domestic politics and government management are what you enjoy most, there are better games for that. You love planning military campaigns: Probably not. Military intervention is rarely the objective. If you find yourself putting boots on the ground, something has probably gone wrong. You don't enjoy reading: Probably not. The game expects you to read tooltips, event reports, and occasionally the in-game wiki. Much of its strategic depth comes from understanding the information the game provides. You enjoy making long-term plans: Then this game is probably for you. Success often depends on thinking years ahead rather than reacting to next month's events. You enjoy indirect strategies: Then this game is probably for you. The best move is not always the most obvious one, and achieving your goals often requires patience, subtlety, and careful planning. You enjoy adapting to uncertainty: Then this game is probably for you. There is rarely a perfect solution, and strategies must evolve as the geopolitical situation changes. (If 90% of your actions are economic aid because every other option feels too risky, you're probably missing a large part of what the game has to offer.)

games.short_description: In a world of magic, your mind is your greatest weapon. Learn the ways of magic and design your own spells to fight enemies, navigate treacherous terrain, and right past wrongs in the kingdom of Mystralia.

descriptions.en: In a world of magic, your mind is your greatest weapon. Learn the ways of magic and design your own spells to fight enemies, navigate treacherous terrain, and right past wrongs in the kingdom of Mystralia.

detailed_descriptions.en: In the kingdom of Mystralia, it takes more brains than brawn to succeed. You will face down giant, powerful creatures and navigate treacherous terrain. You will encounter puzzles that confound even the wisest of the old sages. And you must overcome obstacles put in place by people who do not want you to succeed. Your path will not be easy. In Mages of Mystralia , you play as Zia, a young girl who discovers that she has been born with an innate sense of magic. Unfortunately, magic has been banned, so she strikes off to train on her own to gain some control over her powers. On her journey, she meets other exiled mages and, discovers runes with magical properties and realizes that she can combine these runes in millions of different ways to come up with completely new spells. The story was written by bestselling author Ed Greenwood, creator of the Forgotten Realms fantasy world for Dungeons and Dragons , which served as the basis for games like Baldur’s Gate and Neverwinter Nights , as well as about 170 fantasy books. Design spells to fight enemies, solve environmental puzzles and battle epic bosses Powerful yet simple spell crafting system Classic action-adventure with over a dozen of distinct regions to explore Original orchestral score conducted by Shota Nakama and performed by the Video Game Orchestra at SoundtRec Boston of Final Fantasy XV and Kingdom Hearts fame

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
◆Story

"Witches lurk among these girls."

It was supposed to be Ema's first day of high school. But instead of waking up in her bed, she found herself in a dark prison cell.

She found herself suddenly trapped in an island prison, isolated in some unknown, distant sea. In her confusion, an owl informed Ema of her new situation:

"You have been identified as a potential witch — a threat to the world."

"Thus, you will live here as a prisoner for the rest of your life.

The life Ema had taken for granted had suddenly collapsed.

As she began her new life as a prisoner, Ema got to know the other girls in her situation. Her fellow witch candidates.

However, one day, the owl gathered the prisoners for a shocking announcement:

"We will be holding a witch trial."

One by one, the girls would have to single out a witch among the thirteen of them...

In other words, they would have to vote out the next candidate to be executed.

It was the beginning of a cruel game indeed...

■Game Introduction

·The Gothic Mystery Surrounding the Witch Candidates

Locked in the mysterious prison, the protagonist, Ema, must live alongside the other witch candidates.

What is the prison? What are witches? Who is the true culprit?

Shake Intensity can be adjusted across 10 levels. *Turning on Mask Sensitive Words masks sensitive words in the story scenes and mutes the corresponding voice lines. * Detailed Info Mode keeps your inventory and equipment, your stats, and your play time and turn count on screen at all times. Estimated playtime This varies widely depending on your experience with "Mystery Dungeon" style roguelikes. First-time players: approx. 20 hours to clear Experienced roguelike players: approx. 5-10 hours to clear The post-game 99-floor dungeon: approx. 10-20 hours more Monster Tower, puzzles, building the ultimate equipment and other extras: many more hours on top No base-building progression There is no hub-upgrading meta-progression of the kind often found in other roguelikes. Those resources went into the in-dungeon experience instead: Yusya-chan's Live2D charm and the immersion of her voice acting. This is a やぶから堂 (Yabukaradoo) title, but as of 2026/10/09 it is released as an all-ages game. There is no explicit adult content; it is built to be enjoyed as a serious, hardcore roguelike. Don't get your hopes up for anything lewd! It's not lewd! Really! And please don't leave a 👎 just because there is no explicit content! The more support we receive, the better the updates we will be able to deliver — we would be delighted if you would watch over the game like an Early Access title. 【Unique Systems Exclusive to This Game】 Live2D Character Reactions High-quality Live2D Yusya-chan is always on standby on the side of the game screen. Whether she's taking damage or unleashing a powerful special move, her reactions are fully synchronized with the situation via special effects and full voice acting , adding lively color to your dungeon exploration. A New Take on Inventory Strategy! The "Bundling" System Unlike traditional roguelikes, there are no "Shops" or "Jars" in this game. Instead, it features a unique 【Bundling】 system that allows you to freely combine items other than equipment! Bundle spellbooks of the same effect to add up their remaining uses, or combine multiple effects to compress your inventory while building your own ultimate survival strategy. Equipment Enchantments Weapons (Gems) and Armor (Ribbons) found in the dungeon are enchanted with random effects. You can use furnaces found within the dungeon to combine and strengthen your equipment's enchantments. The maximum number of enchantments allowed varies randomly by piece of equipment. Except for certain specific enchants, stacking multiple of the same enchantment increases its effect. Includes a support system where highly enchanted equipment can be recovered even if lost in the dungeon. Thrilling Mind Games with "Unidentified Items" The deeper you go, the more "Unidentified Items" you'll find with their true names hidden. Do you use them blindly to check, or search for an identification item? Watch your step, as some trap items carry negative effects. Depending on Yusya-chan's status, she might even experience an accident where she forgets names she already identified?! Passionate 90s-Style FM Synth BGM Packaged with Retro Love Features a large collection of original 8-bit soundtrack tunes utilizing a nostalgic FM Sound Source , reminiscent of the golden age of PC-88 gaming. This supreme soundtrack will shake the souls of retro PC and indie game fans alike, heightening the tension of your adventure. Tons of Content! Bonus "Puzzle Portal" As a change of pace (or a brain teaser), a massive volume of puzzle games (100 questions in total) is also included! Solving these puzzles, which require bypassing various gimmicks and traps, will naturally help you develop the "wits" and "foresight" needed for main dungeon progression. Some of the later, extremely difficult puzzles are so complex that even the developer forgot how to solve them after doing it once?! Touch and Feel Anytime You can touch and interact with Live2D Yusya-chan at any time during gameplay using mouse drag controls! Dragging different areas like her head, cheeks, or torso triggers various unique reactions, making it a perfect communication break from your adventure. 【The Aesthetic of Subtraction for Veteran Roguelike Players】 This game intentionally excludes the concept of "Hunger (Fullness)" from all stages except for the final one, preventing resource management from becoming overly complex for beginners. It preserves the traditional tactical joy of "not taking the stairs immediately upon finding them, but exploring the floor thoroughly to accumulate resources," while allowing players to focus on the fresh inventory management satisfaction of the "Bundling" system. The final dungeon does feature hunger, letting you enjoy the added tension of managing your survival to avoid starvation. [p></p] *A portion of the PV utilizes VOICEVOX: Zundamon.

games.short_description: Raise your daughter while she attends a magical academy. Choose which classes she attends, jobs she does, training she undergoes, and more in a character raising sim packed full of story and over 50 endings to reach. detailed_descriptions.en: Raise the cutest daughter in all of the land in the ultimate parenting simulation! In Magical Princess , step into the shoes of a single, widowed father as he brings up his only beloved daughter from early childhood all the way to graduation at the magical academy. With her whole life ahead of her across a variety of different paths, how she grows up and matures is entirely your responsibility. Steer her towards an upright academic career as an ace student, a life of excitement on the stage as an idol, the way of the mighty warrior who takes up the sword, or even pure villainy as the demon queen. With every choice and decision you make, her future changes dramatically! Gameplay Features Complete freedom to raise your daughter however you see fit. Whether that means letting her attend classes, do part-time jobs, go out on dates, sneak out at night, or even indulge in the occasional thievery and other such "odd" jobs, the choice is yours! An enormous amount of story content including over 170 date scenes and over 50 endings. Interact with a colorful cast of more than 30 characters brimming with personality as your daughter leads her life at the magical academy. Uncover deep mysteries lurking beneath the surface. On nights when the full moon turns crimson in the strange phenomenon known as the Crimson Moon, monsters strike in a world seemingly chained to its fate. The key to unlocking everything just might rest in the hands of your daughter... A character raising game fit for a princess! Magical Princess is a character raising game where players get to experience the joys of raising a daughter full of potential, bonding with her the more that she grows. What life has in store for her is up to you as you piece together a story of epic proportions! The only question is: are you ready to be a father?

detailed_descriptions.en: Make Way is classic, top-down, multiplayer racing shifted up multiple gears. It's a party game at heart, inspired by the chaotic racing of Mashed and Micro Machines , and the course-building mayhem of Ultimate Chicken Horse . Grab track pieces from a pick n mix menu and snap them together to build your first course. Dodge hazards, unleash weaponry, and avoid falling off the edge in a chaotic rush to the finish line, then bolt on new track pieces for the next round. Scrap across ever-growing courses with increasingly perilous features until a winner is crowned before starting over with a brand-new course. Build your course Work together—or against one another—to quickly build tracks using a range of ridiculous pieces, including loops, seesaws, corkscrews, and even train crossings. Then add obstacles and power-ups. Ruin your friends’ race with a well-placed barrier or jettison them off the side of a curve with a crafty boost-pad. Blow up the competition Six racers jostle and shunt to cross checkpoints and reach the finish line. Obliterate opponents with a range of wacky weapons, including goo cannons and Tesla coils, but beware: each checkpoint acts as a respawn point and revenge is a dish best served via a giant mallet or rooftop-mounted shotgun… Keep on truckin’ The finish line isn’t the finish! Add new track pieces after each round to create monstrously large courses, and score bonus points with your performance to take home the trophy. Add to your collection Unlock new track pieces and hazards for more dangerous course designs. Add new vehicles to your garage to romp to victory in style. Key Features Mix and match unique track pieces and hazards for near-endless course configurations Fight for weapons and power-ups to gain the advantage Unlock new track pieces and vehicles for wackier races Up to six players, on the same screen or online with cross-platform multiplayer Toggle traps and safety barriers on or off to make those twisty turns easier (or more perilous!) using fully customisable rulesets Now includes the World Tour update, adding an additional eight vehicles, three track environments, Team Mode, and more! Make Way's solo developer previously worked on Toybox Turbos and the Micro Machines series.
detailed_descriptions.zh-Hant: 《Make Way》是由上至下、可一次拉高多檔位的經典多人競速遊戲。 您可從混搭選單中挑選賽道零件，組合成第一處賽車場。競賽過程中必須閃避危險、解放武器，避免摔落邊緣，歷經紛亂的猛衝到達終點線，然後再為下一回合組合新的賽道。 一次又一次驚險闖過節節高升的難關，直到出現優勝者，接著再重新用全新賽道開始比拼。 自建賽道 玩家可共同合作，也可相互較量之下，用一系列誇張的零件（包括圈圈、蹺蹺板、開瓶器，甚至列車平交道）迅速地組合成賽道，再增添障礙物和強化物。可精心放置路障，或用狡猾的加速板把朋友拋出彎路，擾亂對方比賽。 炸飛競爭對手 六位賽車手挨挨碰碰地爭相通過關卡，搶先到達終點線。可用一連串奇特的武器除掉對手，包括黏呼呼砲彈和特斯拉線圈，但請注意：每個關卡都是重生點，要想復仇，還是靠巨槌或是架在屋頂的獵槍才算王道… 持續上路 到達終點線還不算結束！每回合結束後緊接著新增賽道零件，建立龐大的賽道，再以突出的表現奪得獎盃，領取紅利點數。 充實收藏內容 解鎖新賽道零件和危險物品，採行更凶險的設計。為車庫增添新車，歡喜雍容地奪冠。 主要特色 混搭獨特的賽道零件和危險物品，可建成的賽車場變化無窮 爭奪武器和強化，取得競爭優勢 解鎖新的賽道零件和車輛，展開特異的競速 支援多達六位玩家共享畫面同樂，或採用線上跨平台多人遊戲模式 利用完全可自訂的規則集，開啟或關閉陷阱和安全屏障，讓刁鑽的拐彎輕鬆些（或是更危險）。 現在加入了環球之旅更新內容、新增額外八款車輛、三個全新場景、團隊模式、還有更多！
detailed_descriptions.ja: "マルチプレイレーシングゲーム『Make Way』は、クラシックなトップダウン視点、かつ複数ギアのシフトチェンジが楽しめる。 メニュー画面でトラックピースを選び、組み合わせて最初のコースを作ろう。障害をかわし、武器を駆使し、コースから脱落しないように気をつけてゴールを目指せ。クリアすれば、次のラウンド用の新たなトラックピースが手に入る。 伸び続ける危険なコースを駆け抜け、勝負を決したら、また新しいコースがレーサー達を待ち受ける。 自分だけのコースを作ろう ループ、シーソー、コークスクリュー、踏切……様々なパーツを使って、みんなで協力＆反発したりしながらコースを作っていこう（コースは簡単にできるのでご心配なく）。コースには障害物やパワーアップアイテムも追加できる。バリアを巧みに配置して対戦相手を妨害したり、カーブからブーストパッドをお見舞いするのだ。 対戦相手をぶっ潰せ レースに参加するのは6人のレーサー。押し合いへし合いしながらチェックポイントを通過し、ゴール目指して突き進む。グーキャノンやテスラコイルなどの豪華な武器で相手をぶっ潰そう！……でも油断は禁物。各チェックポイントはリスポーン（復活）ポイントでもある。巨大な鉄槌をお見舞いされたり、屋上からショットガンが飛んでくることだってある。 ゴールを超えたら フィニッシュラインを超えても安心するべからず。まだ終わりじゃない！各ラウンドの後に新たなトラックピースを追加して出来上がった巨大なコースで素晴らしいパフォーマンスを披露し、ボーナスポイントを獲得すればトロフィーは君のものだ。 コレクションに追加しよう トラックピースや障害物をアンロックして、もっと危険なコースを作ってみよう。ガレージにレースカーを追加して、さらに勝ちまくれ。 主な機能 ユニークなトラックピースや障害物を組み合わせて、コースを作ろう。その組み合わせはほぼ無限大だ。 武器やパワーアップアイテムを上手に使って、対戦相手の先を行こう。 新たなトラックピース＆レースカーをアンロックすれば、より刺激的なレースが楽しめる。 最大6人での対戦が可能（同じ画面共有、またはクロスプラットフォームのマルチプレイでのオンライン対戦）。 トラップやセーフティバリアのオン/オフを切り替えることもできる。右へ左へ伸びる道をより簡単に（逆により危険に）カスタマイズしよう。 「ワールドツアー」アップデートを収録！新たに8台のマシン、3つのコース環境、チームモードなどが追加されています！
detailed_descriptions.ko: Make Way는 클래식한 탑다운 멀티플레이 레이싱 게임으로, 다양한 장비로 색다른 모습을 뽐낼 수 있습니다. 픽 앤 믹스 메뉴에서 트랙 아이템을 고르고 조립해 첫 코스를 만들어 보세요. 결승선까지 달려가는 정신없는 레이싱에서 위험물들을 피하고, 무기를 해제하고, 가장자리에서 떨어지는 것을 피하고 나면, 다음 라운드의 새로운 트랙 아이템을 조립할 수 있답니다. 점점 더 위험해지는 것들로 가득 찬 변화하는 코스에서 싸워 나가세요. 완전히 새로운 코스로 다시 시작하기 전에, 승자가 정해지기 전까지 말이죠. 코스를 직접 만드는 재미 함께 힘을 모으세요. 아님 서로 붙어 볼 수도 있죠. 그리고 고리, 시소, 코르크 따개, 심지어는 기차 건널목처럼 희한한 것들을 이용해 빠르게 트랙을 만들어보는 겁니다. 그리고 장애물과 강화 아이템을 추가하세요. 배리어를 잘 놓고 친구들의 레이스를 망쳐 보세요. 아니면 부스트 패드로 커브 구간에서 밀어 버릴 수도 있죠? 바퀴 터지는 경쟁 체크포인트를 통과하고 결승선에 도달하기 위해 6명의 레이서가 서로를 밀고 넘어뜨리기 위해 고군분투합니다. 점착 대포와 테슬라 코일과 같은 다양한 이상한 무기로 상대를 쓸어버리세요. 하지만 잊지 마세요. 각 체크포인트는 부활 지점이기도 하며, 거대한 망치나 지붕에 장착된 산탄총을 사용하여 복수를 할 수 있습니다! 결승선을 끊어도 레이싱은 계속 결승선은 완전한 끝이 아닙니다! 각 라운드가 끝나고 새로운 트랙 아이템을 추가해 무시무시하게 커다란 코스를 만들고, 놀라운 퍼포먼스를 선보여 보너스 점수를 따내 트로피를 가져가세요. 컬렉션에 더하는 재미 새로운 트랙 아이템과 위험물을 잠금 해제하고 더 위험한 코스를 설계하세요. 차고에 새로운 차량을 추가해서 스타일리시하게 승리를 낚아 보세요. 주요 컨텐츠 유니크한 트랙 아이템과 위험물을 믹스 앤 매치해 거의 무한에 가깝게 다양한 코스를 설계할 수 있습니다 무기와 강화 아이템을 향해 싸우고 유리한 위치를 선점하세요 새로운 트랙 아이템과 차량을 잠금 해제해 괴상한 레이스를 즐겨 보세요 크로스 플랫폼 멀티플레이로 최대 6인까지 같은 화면에서, 또는 온라인에서 플레이할 수 있습니다 사용자 설정 가능한 룰셋으로 트랩 및 안전 배리어를 켜거나 끌 수 있어 정신없는 레이스를 더 쉽게(아니면 더 위험천만하게!) 즐길 수 있습니다 이제 월드 투어 업데이트가 포함되어 8대의 차량, 3개의 트랙 환경, 팀 모드 등이 추가되었습니다!

games.short_description: Build rooms, gardens, and camper vans with 1,100+ objects and the ability to make your own furniture from scratch. Learn with gentle design requests, then relax and create at your own pace.

descriptions.en: Build rooms, gardens, and camper vans with 1,100+ objects and the ability to make your own furniture from scratch. Learn with gentle design requests, then relax and create at your own pace.

detailed_descriptions.en: MakeRoom is an adorable sandbox building game. Start with a few gentle design requests to learn the ropes, or jump straight into freeform building with more than 1,100 objects and the ability to create your own custom furniture. What will you make? Whether it's a cozy room for cats, a moody hideaway for a vampire, or a compact camper van, the choice is yours! Start with a few simple, guided requests Dive right in with gentle design requests to discover MakeRoom 's tools and extensive furniture catalog. Get inspired by the cozy, cute, and weird variety of gentle design requests on MakeRoom Island. Customize everything with powerful design tools Start with four different settings for your diorama: Room, Camper, Boat, or Garden. Use powerful design tools to create your own custom furniture from scratch. Move, rotate, resize, and recolor objects to your heart's content. Add the finishing touches with dozens of backgrounds, environments, and even ambient sound options. Dazzle the MakeRoom community with your creations Snap beautiful photos with filters and visual effects like tilt shift, share your creations with other players via Steam Workshop, and discover secret codes to unlock even more objects. There are 6,000+ creations to explore! Features Learn through gentle guided requests or dive straight into freeform design with 1,100+ objects Create your own custom furniture from scratch Share your creations with beautiful screenshots and Steam Workshop integration Make messes or clean them up with tools like a mop, duster, or vacuum cleaner Add furry friends to your dioramas with the “Pets” category

detailed_descriptions.en: ETERNAL SLEEP… …IS NOT THE END… …AWAKEN LOST FRIENDS. EXPLORE. FIGHT. FEED MAMA.
