games.short_description: Become the Mexican Ninja and fight to take back Nuevo Tokyo, where Narcos and Yakuzas have fused into the ruthless Narkuzas. Master slick combos, unleash outrageous Mexican Jutsus and craft deadly builds in this fast, chaotic 2.5D roguelike beat ’em up.

descriptions.en: Become the Mexican Ninja and fight to take back Nuevo Tokyo, where Narcos and Yakuzas have fused into the ruthless Narkuzas. Master slick combos, unleash outrageous Mexican Jutsus and craft deadly builds in this fast, chaotic 2.5D roguelike beat ’em up.

detailed_descriptions.en: Smash through the streets of Nuevo-Tokyo in a fast chaotic 2.5D roguelike beat ’em up where every run unlocks new powers, builds and ridiculous Mexican Jutsus. Our story takes place in Nuevo-Tokyo, an offspring of chaos that was born when Japan and Mexico collided in fire, power and betrayal. A land where a new feudal regime was forged between Narcos and Yakuzas, forming a new ruling class, The Narkuzas. They are now the law, and the law SUCKS CULO . Now, in the outskirts of Nuevo-Tokyo, a group of rebels is plotting against the five heads of the Narkuza clan. Enter the Mexican Ninja… Pela el oido, I’m going to tell you a story, eh? One full of adrenaline-pumping combat, where the streets never give you a break, no matter how many fall before you. Explore the stylized streets of Nuevo Tokyo, a city where Narcos and Yakuzas joined forces and mi pueblo was never the same. Precise movement, positioning and perfectly timed attacks decide every fight. It’s a pick-up-and-play brawler that’s deceptively simple, yet deeply rewarding once you start mastering combos and builds. Unlock ninja skills by training with el Mero Mero Sensei. Gain the favor of powerful Mexican-Japanese spirits and unleash their powers throughout your runs. Experiment with different builds, discover devastating combos and carve your own fighting style. Customize your character with hidden outfits and swag worthy of a true cabrón. Mexican Ninja is a return to the button-mashing arcade classics, but with roguelike chaos and modern depth. Fight your way through gangs of Narkuzas, master outrageous Mexican Jutsus and leave a trail of broken enemies behind you. Because when we fight… we do it CON HUEVOS CABRON . Customize your fighting style using our Way of the Donkey tree. The Way of the Donkey is our skill tree, except it’s 10x cooler and made for people with peluche en el estuche. There’s an inner cabrón in all of us. Be THE Mexican Ninja and show the Narkuzas the true way of the blade. Testimonials "I couldn’t be prouder of what the whole Amber team has helped us build and bring to life through this video game. In my culture, a HERO was always needed… ****, it still is… Mexican Ninja has always been about that to me - the longing for that idea. Having profound admiration for Japanese culture, its history, and its roots, it naturally seemed like the perfect one to blend and contrast with my own. I hope players can join the fun, explore the world, and embrace all the quirks of this concept. I hope they get their asses kicked and stand up again, and again, and again—and through this dynamic, understand that Mexican Ninja is a vibe, a spirit, a way of being. I wish you a good journey in finding your inner donkey. Stay blazed" Carlos Rincones "No notes. Seems good." Chris Zukowski

games.name: Microcivilization
games.short_description: Incremental clicker strategy, where you expand, construct, research, fight, collect heroes and make choices between good and evil. Ascend through difficulty tiers by playing through challenge campaign going back and forth through history. Mammoths included.

descriptions.en: Incremental clicker strategy, where you expand, construct, research, fight, collect heroes and make choices between good and evil. Ascend through difficulty tiers by playing through challenge campaign going back and forth through history. Mammoths included.

detailed_descriptions.en: In Microcivilization you explore , expand , exploit and exterminate all together in a pixel-art strategy-clicker game blend. Start the growth of your population and economical strength while discovering government combinations, hundreds of unique heroes and experimenting with ability builds for combat and construction. You have many ways to build an obscenely rich and powerful nation. If oppressing your people by furious button smashing is your thing, master the clicker features to your benefit. If faith in your micro-people's good-will and productivity is your style, make use of your workshops and their passive and active abilities. Advancing in technology tree will unlock upgrades, military units, bonuses and new abilities to help you grow and steel yourself for threats to come. Face hundreds of disasters, wars, diseases, social unrests, invasions and independence declarations that threaten your people. Sometimes you will get beaten, descend into dark ages, famine or ideological mayhem. But have no fear, losing is impossible. In fact, the harder the struggle, the more likely a grand hero emerges from the ashes. Every crisis you overcome gives you a chance to gain a hero . For your micro-civilization heroes act as inventory items which boost your power. Though you can only have a handful of them equipped at any time, collecting heroes opens endless new effects on your industry, wealth, strength and stability. As you move forward, you will collect higher tiers of heroes, merge them with recipes and form sets to gain absurd powers. Disasters in this game are no mere random number generator roll. You are in full control of all disaster risks. In fact you know the chance of them happening at any given time so you have chance to mitigate. Uninhabited houses? Chance of fire. Too many people crammed in tight space? Small-pox will probably visit you soon. Whether by bad luck, or your risk neglect, when a crisis occurs it can be overcome by combat . Fire can be extinguished, disease can be withstood or cured, invasion can be repelled. Regardless of what the problem is, it is always a number of brave micro-people willing to give their lives, who defeat the crisis. In every fight, People are your life , Economy is your strength and Heroes are your weapons . Combine these with workshop abilities and master the combat to become a force to be reckoned with. History has too many stories to tell in one go. In order to reach the metaphorical stars, you will need to trace back to ancient ages several times, each with a higher purpose. Your Ascension tree contains many challenges organized into Difficulty Tiers each brining new features into the game, more difficult enemies but also access to more powerful heroes, world wonders and ability modifications.

games.name: Midnight Fight Express
games.short_description: A former member of the criminal underworld is lured back into “the life” by a mysterious drone claiming they have until sunrise to prevent a citywide criminal takeover together.

descriptions.en: A former member of the criminal underworld is lured back into “the life” by a mysterious drone claiming they have until sunrise to prevent a citywide criminal takeover together.

detailed_descriptions.en: An unexpected hero emerges on the city's darkest night. You’re Babyface, a former member of the criminal underworld lured back into “the life” by a mysterious AI drone. Your mission against impossible odds: Fight your way across the city before sunrise, and prevent a citywide criminal takeover together. Engage in a brutal and hyper-kinetic brawling ballet, using every environmental tool and street fighting technique at your disposal. Level up your abilities to take down the mounting onslaught of bozos, cronies, and crime lords. Blockbuster Combat Tangle with waves of foes with the finesse of an action-movie master. Punch, dodge, counter, and finish off enemies in fluid and visceral combat featuring mo-cap animation by motion artist and stunt performer Eric Jacobus. Custom difficulty modes allow any player to direct the action to their preference. Martial Mastery Level up, power up, and tap into a sprawling skill tree to unleash a dizzying array of devastating fighting moves. Develop your own signature style, and master over-the-top combos that leave the criminals wondering what hit ’em. Killer Arsenal Complement your melee moves with knives, axes, and sledgehammers. Wield a wild array of pistol fire, shotgun blasts, and explosives. Weaponize everything from furniture to toilet plungers. Take advantage of the urban world around you to score increasingly outrageous takedowns and clean up the streets. Street Warrior’s Wardrobe Customize your character’s appearance, and unlock a huge variety of cosmetic options ranging from the ultra-suave to the mega-outlandish. Unlock more 150+ pieces of clothing, equip skins for you and your AI ally Droney, and make a lasting impression as you fight to save the streets. Audio Adrenaline Rush Battle across the city’s 41 hand-crafted levels to the beat of a pulsing, infectious soundtrack by artist Noisecream, and channel the nonstop midnight energy of the metropolis. The Fight Never Stops Return to missions to complete challenges, unlock rewards, and show everyone who owns the streets on the leaderboard. Create your own director’s cut of the action with settings that let you customize enemy types, weapons, and more.

games.name: Mimic Party
games.short_description: A 1-5 player online voice party game. You hear a sound, the whole table gets one shot to imitate it all at once, no turns. Your take is scored on pitch and rhythm, then the wheel decides who gets a bonus and whose take becomes a fart.

descriptions.en: A 1-5 player online voice party game. You hear a sound, the whole table gets one shot to imitate it all at once, no turns. Your take is scored on pitch and rhythm, then the wheel decides who gets a bonus and whose take becomes a fart.

detailed_descriptions.en: Mimic Party An online 1-5 player voice party game. You hear a sound. You get one shot to reproduce it with your own voice. A local AI grades how close you got melody, rhythm, attacks and then the wheel decides who walks away with a bonus and whose next take comes back saturated, echoing, or replaced by a fart. FEATURES: 🎤 1-5 player online voice party game 🎧 One-shot takes - no retries, no undo, no mercy 🤖 Local AI scoring: melody, rhythm and attacks, not your voice 🎡A wheel between rounds: bonuses, multipliers, and sabotages to hand out 😈 Sabotages: saturation, echo, pitch shift, chopped audio or your take swapped for a fart 🗣️ In-game voice chat that goes quiet exactly when someone performs 🔊 Themed sound packs - animals, machines, voices, and more 🛠️ Steam Workshop: build and share your own sound packs ⏱️ 10 minutes per game ONE SOUND. ONE SHOT. Every round reveals a reference sound to the whole table at once. Everybody records on the same countdown, then the takes are played back one by one while the room reacts. There is no second attempt and no rehearsal - whatever came out of your mouth is what everyone hears. WE DON'T CARE ABOUT YOUR VOICE Scoring is built around what a human throat can actually reproduce: the shape of the melody, the rhythm, the attacks, whether you barked once or three times. Not your timbre. A deep voice and a high voice doing the same curve score the same, so nobody wins just because they got lucky with their vocal cords. THE WHEEL DECIDES Between rounds the wheel spins for everyone at once. It hands out points, multipliers and sabotages. Draw one and you choose your victim: their next take comes out saturated, echoing, chopped to pieces, or replaced outright by a garbage sound the whole table hears instead of their voice. It costs them points on top. And you find out who aimed at you only when your take plays. THE ROOM GOES QUIET Voice chat is always on except when it shouldn't be. The moment a take starts playing, the whole table is muted so everyone hears the same thing. The second it ends, the mics open again, right in time for the reaction. That half-second is the game. BRING YOUR OWN NOISES Sound packs are just content. Make one, publish it to the Steam Workshop in a couple of clicks, and subscribe to whatever the community comes up with. Everyone at the table needs the pack before a game can start - the lobby tells you exactly who is still downloading.

detailed_descriptions.en: Mind Scanners is a retro-futuristic psychiatry simulation in which you diagnose the citizens of a dystopian metropolis. Locate a host of other-worldly characters and use arcade-style treatment devices to help them. Manage your time and resources to keep The Structure in balance. Remember, you take full responsibility for your patients. Manage your time and resources to aid the citizens of The Structure Diagnose your patients by analyzing their views of the world Operate and master a variation of arcade-style devices to treat your patients Spend your ₭apok and science points to develop new devices Face difficult moral choices and ethical dilemmas Report the resistance group Moonrise or join them to help their cause Gain the trust of The Structure if you want to see your daughter again The meteor came. And from it, the survivors learned to harness the power source known as Zygnoka. In the next forty years, the megacity known as The Structure was erected inside the impact crater. Here, the people isolated themselves, accelerating their dependence on technology and created a society as a machine of its own. In The Structure, order and efficiency is maintained by severe top-down control. In the name of efficiency, new machines and instruments are put to use on the public the instant they are invented. In pursuit of optimisation, a new profession is tasked to maintain the increasingly precarious anomaly levels of the city's inhabitants. These are called Mind Scanners.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Mind Scanners is a retro-futuristic psychiatry simulation in which you diagnose the citizens of a dystopian metropolis. Locate a host of other-worldly characters and use arcade-style treatment devices to help them. Manage your time and resources to keep The Structure in balance. Remember, you take full responsibility for your patients.







  • Manage your time and resources to aid the citizens of The Structure
  • Diagnose your patients by analyzing their views of the world
  • Operate and master a variation of arcade-style devices to treat your patients
  • Spend your ₭apok and science points to develop new devices
  • Face difficult moral choices and ethical dilemmas
  • Report the resistance group Moonrise or join them to help their cause
  • Gain the trust of The Structure if you want to see your daughter again



The meteor came. And from it, the survivors learned to harness the power source known as Zygnoka. In the next forty years, the megacity known as The Structure was erected inside the impact crater. Here, the people isolated themselves, accelerating their dependence on technology and created a society as a machine of its own.

In The Structure, order and efficiency is maintained by severe top-down control. In the name of efficiency, new machines and instruments are put to use on the public the instant they are invented. In pursuit of optimisation, a new profession is tasked to maintain the increasingly precarious anomaly levels of the city's inhabitants. These are called Mind Scanners.

detailed_descriptions.en: MindsEye Campaign MindsEye is a single-player, story-driven action-adventure thriller set in the near-future desert city of Redrock. You play as Jacob Diaz, a former soldier haunted by a mysterious implant and fractured memories. Across a cinematic campaign, you’ll complete missions, uncover your past, and confront a conspiracy involving rogue AI, corrupt corporations, and unchecked military power, a threat that reaches far beyond the city itself. The City of Redrock Redrock is a desert metropolis where advanced technology is everywhere. AI and robotics control daily life, shaping everything from commerce to security. Beneath the surface, the city hides secrets, dangers, and conflict. From gleaming towers to industrial sprawl and remote outposts, every district is part of the story. Combat Combat is responsive and tactical. Outsmart enemies with unique behaviors, use cover and verticality, and fight in third person with a wide arsenal, pistols, SMGs, sniper rifles, energy weapons, and grenades. Your companion drone, DC2, is directly linked to your implant, providing hacking, scouting, and support in battle. Driving and Vehicle Action Missions place you behind the wheel of electric cars, muscle vehicles, buggies, and quadcopters. High-speed chases, desert runs, and industrial zone pursuits are designed to push your skills and keep the action moving. Endless Stream of New Content The campaign is only the beginning. MindsEye offers an endless stream of new playable content delivered regularly. New missions, races, puzzles, and challenges developed and released by the BARB team bring fresh surprises. This evolving world keeps MindsEye alive with new ways to play long after the credits roll. Simple to Use Creation Tools With our simple to use building tools, you’re not just playing, you’re creating. Builder mode provides access to AAA tools, including asset libraries and lighting systems, as well as simple visual scripting, making it easy to design missions, modes, and environments. You can share your creations with the community and explore what others have built, extending MindsEye beyond the main campaign.

games.short_description: Descend into the dangerous depths of PAIMO in this co-op sci-fi roguelite bullet-hell focused on resource gathering. Play solo or with friends as you fight, gather resources, and upgrade together. The deeper you go, the greater the risks, rewards, and secrets waiting beneath the surface.

descriptions.en: Descend into the dangerous depths of PAIMO in this co-op sci-fi roguelite bullet-hell focused on resource gathering. Play solo or with friends as you fight, gather resources, and upgrade together. The deeper you go, the greater the risks, rewards, and secrets waiting beneath the surface.

detailed_descriptions.en: After a failed heist, a group known as the Renegades is forced to flee, crash landing near the mysterious planet Paimo. With no other choice, they descend into its depths in search of help and uncover secrets that should have remained buried. DESCEND WITH FRIENDS Descend solo or with up to two friends into the dangerous depths of PAIMO. Coordinate your abilities, share gadgets, and work together to survive. But watch your back... sometimes you’ll need to unleash your inner Renegade and break away from the group to maximize your rewards. GADGETS, WEAPONS AND ULTIMATES Inside the MineGeon, every run is a chance to grow stronger. Level up to unlock powerful Gadgets that grant a wide variety of upgrades to aid you in battle, equip a variety of weapons to match your playstyle, and choose Ultimates that can completely change how you approach combat. Combining Gadgets, Weapons, and Ultimates creates unique synergies that will shape your descent into PAIMO. BRING OUT YOUR INNER GREED PAIMO is filled with minerals that bring out your inner greed. The deeper you descend, the greater the rewards and the risks. Collect valuable minerals and trade them for permanent upgrades, but choose wisely when to send them back to your ship. FACE ENEMIES DESPERATE TO STOP YOU The biomes of PAIMO are home to a vast array of enemies. Throughout your journey, you’ll encounter the Scavengers, who will do anything to stop your descent. Why are they so determined to keep you from going deeper? Each biome culminates in a boss battle that will push your skills and strategies to the limit. GROW STRONGER EVERY RUN Progression is key to your survival and success. As you explore and gather resources, you can upgrade your skills and equipment to grow stronger with every run. Invest in permanent upgrades for your spaceship and enhance each Renegade’s attributes to prepare for the challenges ahead. CUSTOMIZE YOUR SHIP Access the Galactic Express PC to buy over 200 items, decorations, and themed objects from the biomes you explore, and customize the interior of your ship to your liking. Organize your base, visit other Renegades' ships online, and show off your setup to the community. CHOOSE YOUR RENEGADE Choose from three classes, each with their own ultimate ability and unique stats. From Marshall, the resilient Tank, to Trevor, the deadly DPS Gunslinger, and Ari, the balanced Engineer. Find your role within the team and combine your strengths with other Renegades to maximize your chances of surviving the descent into PAIMO. CHOOSE YOUR DESCENT Deep within PAIMO lie mysterious monoliths pulsing with ancient technology. These relics let the Renegades decide how to continue their descent, vote as a team to choose the path that benefits everyone, or follow your own ambition. Add MineGeon: Renegades to your wishlist and join the adventure!

Clear your aircraft to takeoff & land, direct them to the destination...and most of all don't let them crash!! London, Tokyo, Shanghai... Test your ATC skills in distinctive maps around the globe!

Clear your aircraft to takeoff & land, direct them to the destination...and most of all don't let them crash!! London, Tokyo, Shanghai... Test your ATC skills in distinctive maps around the globe!
descriptions.zh-Hant: 迷你空管是一款極簡主義風格的實時管理遊戲。你將扮演一名忙碌的空中交通管制員。你需要指揮飛機起飛，引導飛機降落，指揮它們飛往目的地......最重要的是，避免相撞事故！倫敦、東京、上海、華盛頓——在世界各地的機場上，巧用獨特的跑道配置和各色道具，盡可能久地管理空域，展現你高超的指揮技巧。
descriptions.ja: Mini Airwaysは、ミニマリスチックなリアルタイムストラテジーゲームです。あなたは忙しい航空管制官となり、飛行機の離陸と着陸を誘導し、衝突を避けます。ロンドン、東京、上海、ワシントン……世界中の空港で、交わる滑走路を利用し、色んなアイテムを使って空域を管理して、プロ級の指揮技術を披露しましょう！
descriptions.ko: Mini Airways는 항공 교통 관제사 역할을 맡아 실시간으로 비행기를 관리하는 게임입니다. 비행기를 이륙하고 착륙시키고, 목적지로 안내하세요... 그리고 무엇보다 중요한 것은, 충돌하지 않도록하세요! 런던, 도쿄, 상하이... 세계 각지의 독특한 지도에서 Mini Airways의 ATC 기술을 테스트해 보세요!

detailed_descriptions.en: Mini Airways is a real-time management game with an air traffic control theme. You will play as a busy air traffic controller in the game: directing planes to take off and land, clearing air traffic, upgrading airspace ...... And most of all, don't let them crash! Each airport can accommodate up to 4 people online and supports the use of the Workshop map. You can work with your friends to jointly manage the same airspace to reduce the impact of mistakes and challenge higher scores! Fast-paced, real-time ATC gameplay: Manage airspace, clear planes for takeoff and landing, and avoid near misses! In addition to the normal arrangement of takeoffs and landings, you also need to face the challenges of mountains, no-fly zones, and peak landing hours, so please concentrate! Every time you finish one day's management, you will be able to pick an upgrade for your airspace and airport: auto holding, accelerating turns, increasing airspace, waypoints ...... upgrade and customize airports to keep flights running more smoothly. As you increase your flight management records, you will gradually unlock a total of 19 airspace maps based on real-world airports—from Beijing Capital, Shanghai Hongqiao, Chengdu Shuangliu in China to Vancouver, New York in North America, and then to London, Amsterdam in Europe... Showcase your air traffic control skills across various global airports! The game triggers random events under certain specific maps and conditions, featuring classic moments in aviation history: the miracle landing on the Hudson River, Air Force One crossing, emergency incidents, high-priority flights, etc. The game offers three modes: Classic, Hardcore, and Sandbox. In Hardcore mode, the airspace simulates real ATC operations without the ability to pause within the session; In Sandbox mode, players have full control over waypoints, props, and landing intensity, allowing you to design their own waypoints and test the maximum flight density they can handle. The game supports creating custom maps and mods. Players can import map assets, freely configure runways, restricted areas, and other terrains for gameplay. For those with more demanding needs in aviation management, they can create MODs for altitude, wind speed, etc., enhancing the strategic depth of the game. Don't Miss Out! As you’ve read this far, you must be a true fan! If you are into ATC (Air Traffic Control), civil aviation, or flight simulation, then Mini Airways is definitely worth trying! Our development and publishing team are enthusiasts of ATC and flight simulation. We have experienced and researched all kinds of air traffic control and flight simulation games available, most of which feature highly abstract graphics like Endless ATC or Air Traffic: Greenlight, or extremely realistic simulations like Global ATC Simulator, I am an Air Traffic Controller 4 (ATC4), Microsoft Flight Simulator, and X-Plane 12, which almost all opt for professional and complex routes. By the way: Mini Airways plays more like 112 Operator and 911 Operator than Mini Metro or Mini Motorways. However, for beginners who are not professionals, they might prefer a simpler entry-level product that doesn’t necessarily strive for realism but focuses on gradual terminology explanations and functional guidance. We believe this approach can help grow the somewhat niche community of ATC enthusiasts. This is why we developed Mini Airways . Since its release half a year ago, Mini Airways has received a lot of positive feedback and suggestions. It even made a small appearance in the East China Air Traffic Management Bureau’s skill competition. Thank you all for your support! Based on feedback from reviews, we are continuously optimizing the game to balance professionalism and gaming enjoyment. In the future, we will work hard to bring more new maps, new events, and even explore new features (such as voice control similar to sim4D ATC). Mobile development is also underway, so stay tuned to our Steam page for updates! See you next time!
detailed_descriptions.zh-Hant: 迷你空管是一款以空中交通管制為主題的實時管理遊戲。 你將在遊戲中扮演一位繁忙的空中交通管制員：指揮飛機起降，疏導空中交通，升級機場…… 最重要的是，別出現撞機事故！ 【最新】多人模式更新！ 每個機場最多可容納4人聯機遊玩，並且支援使用創意工坊地圖。你可以和自己的朋友們一起聯合管理同一片空域，以減少失誤帶來的影響，挑戰更高分數！ 指揮飛機起降 你只需要拖動飛機到跑道一端即可完成起降操作，不同顏色的航班需要將航向箭頭拖動至同色圓點完成引導。 管理空中交通 除了正常安排起降，你還需要面對群山環繞、禁飛區、單向跑道、意外事件、降落高峰時段等挑戰，請時刻保持精神集中！ 升級你的空域 每當你完成一天的管理工作，你將能夠為你的空域和機場選擇一項升級——盤旋、加速轉彎、擴大空域……用好它們將使你的工作事半功倍。 解鎖各地機場 隨著管制航班記錄的增加，你將陸續解鎖總計19張基於真實機場製作的空域地圖，從國內的北京首都、上海虹橋、成都雙流機場到北美大陸的溫哥華、紐約，再到歐洲地區的倫敦、阿姆斯特丹……在世界各地的機場空域中展現你的空管技藝！ 重現歷史事件 遊戲在某些特定地圖和條件下會觸發隨機事件，其中不乏航空史上的經典案例：國產大飛機C919首飛、哈德遜河上的迫降奇蹟、空軍一號過境、航班緊急事件、高優先級航班…… 多種玩法模式 遊戲提供經典、硬核和沙盒三種模式，硬核模式下的空域將模擬真實的空管操作，無法進行局內暫停；沙盒模式下玩家可以自由控制所有的航點道具和降落航班強度，自行設計航點引導並測試其可容納的航班密度上限。 自製地圖&模組 遊戲支援自製地圖製作和模組製作，玩家可以自行匯入地圖素材，自由配置跑道、限制區域等地形進行遊玩，對航空管理有更高需求的玩家可以自製對應的高度、風速等等玩法MOD，讓遊戲的策略深度更上一層。 社交媒體 如果你對遊戲的開發進展感興趣或者有任何意見建議，都歡迎加入我們的Q群或關注我們的社交媒體： 官方Q群1群：693192338 官方Q群2群：450374968 嗶哩嗶哩：@迷你空管 小紅書：@迷你空管 走過路過不要錯過！ 看到這裡的你，想必是真愛了！最後說點兒心裡話，順便做做搜索優化 ≖‿≖✧ 如果你是ATC（Air Traffic Control，空中交通管制）、民航或者模擬飛行愛好者，那麼《迷你空管 Mini Airways》非常值得你體驗！ 我們的開發和發行團隊都是ATC/模擬飛行的愛好者，體驗和調研了市面上所有的空中交通管制類乃至飛行類遊戲，其中大多數畫面高度抽象，比如Endless ATC或者Air Traffic: Greenlight；要不就是擬真度非常高，比如Global ATC Simulator、I am an Air Traffic Controller 4（我是航空管制官4，簡寫ATC4），甚至微軟模擬飛行（Microsoft Flight Simulator）和X-Plane 12，它們幾乎都選擇了專業和複雜路線。 順帶一提：相比前面那些遊戲和《迷你地鐵 Mini Metro》或者《迷你高速公路 Mini Motorways》來說，《迷你空管 Mini Airways》的玩法其實更像是《112 Operator》和《911 Operator》。 但對於初窺門徑的非專業愛好者來說，他們或許更需要一款不一定擬真，但一定要簡單的入門產品，循序漸進的術語說明和功能引導，完善的中文本地化環境，不必去啃英文生肉就能明白的ATC知識，相信這些都能夠壯大ATC這個有點小眾的圈子！這就是我們開發《迷你空管 Mini Airways》的初衷。 《迷你空管 Mini Airways》發布的半年以來，我們收穫了許多的好評和建議，非常感謝大家的支持！同時針對評價區的反饋意見，我們也在嘗試進行優化，努力地達到專業和遊戲樂趣並重！ 未來我們也會努力為大家帶來更多新的地圖、新的事件，甚至新的功能探索（類似sim4D ATC的語音控制），行動端的開發也在進行當中，請大家持續關注我們的steam主頁~我們下次更新見！
detailed_descriptions.ja: Mini Airwaysは、航空管制をテーマにしたリアルタイムストラテジーゲームです。 忙しい航空管制官になり、飛行機の離着陸を誘導し、地上交通を管理して、空港をアップグレードしましょう！……そして一番大事なのは、飛行機同士の衝突を起こさないようにご注意！ 離陸 & 着陸 航空管制 通常の離着陸のスケジュールに加えて、山地、飛行禁止空域、着陸ラッシュなどの挑戦も待ち望んでいます。集中して難関突破しましょう！ 空域のアップグレード 一日の管理業務を完了するたびに、空域や空港のアップグレードを一つ選択できます。旋回から、方向転換加速や空域の拡大まで……様々なアイテムを利用して、目指すのは空港の効率と秩序！ 世界中の空港を探索 ゲームが進むことで、精巧に作られた空域マップは次々と解除されていきます。世界中の空域や空港で、あなたの航空管制官の技術を披露しましょう！
detailed_descriptions.ko: Mini Airways는 실시간 관리 게임으로 항공 교통 관제를 테마로 하고 있습니다. 게임에서 당신은 바쁜 항공 교통 관제사가 되어 비행기의 이착륙을 지시하고, 항공 교통을 정리하며, 공역을 업그레이드하는 등 다양한 업무를 수행하게 됩니다. 그리고 가장 중요한 것은, 절대 충돌이 일어나지 않도록 해야 합니다! 이륙 및 착륙 항공 교통 관제 일반적인 이착륙 관제 외에도, 산악 지형, 비행 금지 구역, 피크 착륙 시간대 등의 도전 과제를 마주하게 됩니다. 그러니 집중하세요! 공역 업그레이드 하루의 관제를 마칠 때마다 공역과 공항을 업그레이드할 수 있는 기회를 얻게 됩니다. 자동 대기, 회전 속도 가속, 공역 확대 등의 업그레이드를 현명하게 활용하면 업무가 훨씬 수월해질 것입니다. 다양한 공항 해제 점차 더 정교한 공역 지도를 해제하고 전 세계의 공역과 공항에서 당신의 ATC 기술을 뽐내세요.

games.name: Mini Metro
games.short_description: Mini Metro is a strategy simulation game about designing a subway map for a growing city. Draw lines between stations and start your trains running. As new stations open, redraw your lines to keep them efficient. Decide where to use your limited resources. How long can you keep the city moving?

descriptions.en: Mini Metro is a strategy simulation game about designing a subway map for a growing city. Draw lines between stations and start your trains running. As new stations open, redraw your lines to keep them efficient. Decide where to use your limited resources. How long can you keep the city moving?

detailed_descriptions.en: In Mini Metro, you take on the task of designing the subway layout for a rapidly expanding city. Your city starts with three stations. Draw routes between these stations to connect them with subway lines. Commuters travel along your lines to get around the city as fast as they can. Each station can only hold a handful of waiting commuters so your subway network will need to be well-designed to avoid delays. The city is growing. More stations are opening, and commuters are appearing faster. The demands on your network are ever-increasing. You'll be constantly redesigning your lines to maximise efficiency. The new assets you earn every week will help immensely — as long as they're used wisely. Eventually your network will fail. Stations will open too quickly. Commuters will crowd the platforms. How long the city keeps moving is up to you. Key Features Compelling, constructive, hectic, relaxed gameplay. If that makes sense. It doesn't though, aye? You just gotta play it. Three game modes: Normal for quick scored games, Endless for stress-free sandbox play, and Extreme for the ultimate challenge. Build your metro exactly how you want to with the all-new Creative mode. Over two dozen real-world cities! Design subways for London, Paris, New York City, Osaka, Saint Petersburg, São Paulo, Istanbul, Auckland and many more! Each has a unique colour theme, set of obstacles, and pace. Random city growth, so each game plays out differently. A strategy that proved successful last game may not help you in the next. Each game's map is a work of art, built by you in the classic abstract subway style of Harry Beck. If you think it's a keeper, save it, tweet it, show it off, or make it your desktop background! Responsive soundtrack created by your metro system, engineered by Disasterpeace. Colorblind and night modes. Trains! Did we mention them yet? Vast library of player-created maps for you to explore in Steam Workshop! "Mini Metro’s clean, stylish interface encourages me over and over again to make the trains run on time, and there’s a deeper amount of strategy to growing a sprawling metro system than meets the eye. I wasn’t just hypnotized by the rhythmic movement of trains from station to station, I was completely absorbed in making them perfect." - IGN

games.name: Mini Motorways
games.short_description: Mini Motorways is a strategy simulation game about designing the road map for a growing city. Build a traffic network, one road at a time, to create a bustling metropolis. Redesign your roads and place your motorways to get everyone where they need to go. How long can you keep the city moving?

descriptions.en: Mini Motorways is a strategy simulation game about designing the road map for a growing city. Build a traffic network, one road at a time, to create a bustling metropolis. Redesign your roads and place your motorways to get everyone where they need to go. How long can you keep the city moving?

detailed_descriptions.en: Have you ever been stuck in traffic and wished you could do something to fix it? In Mini Motorways, the city’s traffic problems are in your hands. From the makers of Mini Metro, Mini Motorways is a game about drawing the roads that drive a growing city. Build a road network, one road at a time, to create a bustling metropolis. Redesign your city to keep the traffic flowing, and carefully manage upgrades to meet the changing demands. How long can you keep the cities of the world moving? Key Features Draw roads in dynamic cities that grow and change—every game is unique! Explore stunning maps inspired by cities all around the world. Choose from a variety of upgrades to meet the demands of your ever-expanding road network: highways, roundabouts, and more! Build without limits in Creative Mode—design your dream city exactly how you want it with unlimited upgrades and editing tools. Stress-free Endless Mode offers you a relaxing gameplay experience, plus you can continue building your city after Game Over. Tackle our Expert Mode, which features twists such as permanent roads and limited upgrades for the ultimate challenge. Select different colour palettes on every map, including Colourblind and Night Modes. Relax to a responsive soundtrack from Disasterpeace that grows along with your city. Unlock new maps and achievements as you achieve mastery. Export GIFs of your city layouts to share with your friends. Compete against other players in Daily and Weekly Challenges.

detailed_descriptions.en: Minos is a maze-building roguelite where you, the fabled Minotaur, must defend your sanctuary from bloodthirsty adventurers. They've heard the stories of a monster in the dark, fame and riches waiting for the one who slays it. What they don't know is that you are the one who built this maze, laid the traps, and now lie in wait. Every run brings new enemies, new traps, and new ways to turn their bravery into a bloody disaster. No two nights are ever the same. Build Your Perfect Trap Drag walls, gates, and corridors into place to shape your maze however you like. Make long, winding paths full of traps or confuse and split them up with rotating passages and shifting gates. It's your labyrinth. Cruel or clever, it's up to you. Chain Reactions of Death Every spike, boulder, blade, and fire trap can be linked into intricate sequences. Set pressure plates to trigger a whole cascade of chaos, fooling heroes into thinking they are making progress, right before everything goes beautifully, horribly wrong. Who's the Real Monster? Uncover the story behind the Minotaur and the man who became it. What drove Daedalus to create such a place? When Theseus finally comes, you'll decide who deserves to walk out alive.

games.name: Minsgon Simulator
games.short_description: Hatch mysterious eggs and discover over 150 Minsgon species! Tame, raise and train wild creatures to make them evolve, then sell them in your shop and garden. Unlock the skill tree and rise to fame in the world of Minsgon!

descriptions.en: Hatch mysterious eggs and discover over 150 Minsgon species! Tame, raise and train wild creatures to make them evolve, then sell them in your shop and garden. Unlock the skill tree and rise to fame in the world of Minsgon!

detailed_descriptions.en: Minsgon Simulator is a first-person shop and creature-management sim where you hatch magical creatures from eggs, tame and train them, and raise them in your own shop. Discover over 150 Minsgon species, love and tame them all, and fill your collection with legends. Incubate the Mysterious Eggs Carefully place your eggs in the incubators. Over time, each one hatches into a Minsgon with its own traits. Rare eggs may yield the most precious creatures of all, the treasures of your collection. Each Egg Hatches a Minsgon All Its Own Every Minsgon that hatches is unique: its species, rarity, and temperament all differ. Some are cute, some are powerful, some are legendary; only time will tell which one appears. Record every species you discover in your catalogue (Dex) and complete your collection. Tame the Wild Minsgons With Love Gentle them little by little by petting, feeding, and cleaning them. The rarer they are, the more coy they become; winning a legendary Minsgon's heart takes patience and care. Your kindness is never wasted: well cared for Minsgons grow happier and sell for far higher prices. Train and Evolve Into Majestic Forms Place your tamed Minsgons on training stands; over time they gather experience. Those that grow strong enough evolve into grander, more enchanting forms. Evolution raises both their power and their value; rare evolved forms are priceless to collectors. Build a Magical Exhibit in Your Garden Sell entry tickets to visitors and earn a bountiful income from your exhibit area. Showcase and Sell Your Minsgons Display the Minsgons you hatch or raise in your garden and your collection. At the sales stand, set your own price on each Minsgon; let the customer who likes it come and buy it. Some Minsgons are so special you cannot bear to sell them, so you keep them for yourself. Open Your Own Shop and Welcome Your Customers Open your own shop and fill your shelves with colorful products. Customers shop according to their hearts and their purses; some stretch their budget, others just browse the window. Step up to the counter, take the payment, and give the correct change; a satisfied customer will knock on your door again. Hire Helpers and Grow Your Business Hire stockers, cashiers, hatchery workers, and caretakers to carry the load of your shop and garden. Set the rules for how each of them works. Watch your helpers handle the daily bustle while you plan the bigger picture. Grow Your Magical Powers As you gain experience, advance through the skill tree and unlock new powers. Float objects through the air, pull them to you from afar with telekinesis, and carry far more at once. Develop your abilities to craft your own magical working style and speed up your work. A Living World Full of Surprises A traveling merchant's special wagon stops by now and then, offering rare eggs and opportunities. Customer demands shift; the savvy trader who follows the market comes out ahead. With Twitch integration, make your viewers a part of the game. Expand Your Shop and Become a Legend Start from a small shop and grow step by step. Add new areas, more shelves, and stronger incubators. Make your shop the biggest and most respected in the city.

games.short_description: 「Maybe one day, I won't have to fight when I fly.」

descriptions.en: 「Maybe one day, I won't have to fight when I fly.」

detailed_descriptions.en: ◆Story Notari had expected one day she would be separated from her best friend. Nothing prepared her for what happened that day. Did the Institute take away Miroita? Did the military, or the Federation itself? The distinction no longer seemed important. All must pay. Notari desperately fought on. Luciolla, the AI created by Miroita, was Notari's only companion. "Miroita lives" said her. Must see her. The thought is germinating, growing more powerful by day. It is a better reason to live each day to the fullest, knowing someone is out there, waiting to see her once more. Must not abandon her. Must not let her down. Fight on, to find one another again, one step at a time. She knows the day will come. And then, the other one showed up. But... ◆Gameplay You are FEATHER Mirage Feathers is an anime themed pseudo-3D rail shooter. You are Notari, a cybernetic air-superiority fighter of the Federation's FEATHER program. You will experience fast tempo combat as you destroy enemy aircrafts wave after wave. Even though the whole world is against you, your ammo is infinite. So fight on, and prove your superiority! Fire! Notari's advanced fire control system automatically locks on a target when it passes your crosshair. Your attacks will then home in on the locked targets. Variable Combat Styles As the story progresses, AI companion Luciolla will acquire weapons specs from stronger opponents, allowing Notari additional main weapon options. They all have different effects, and offer a range of playstyles. Initiating OVERDRIVE! FEATHERs may unleash incredible power by initiating OVERDRIVE, enough to destroy everything in sight. Moreover, when in OVERDRIVE mode, your weapons system will have upgraded performance, all your attacks will be buffed. Game Modes This game includes Story Mode and Endless Mode. Story Mode has scripted levels, and explores the characters outside battle with text-based dialogues and cute character art. Endless Mode gives you access to the full arsenal, and pits you against infinite waves of progressively more challenging enemies that spawn randomly. Cheat Codes Is the game too hard? No problem, we have made um… Oh! Sorry, that's classified. ◆Characters Notari One of the two FEATHERs from the Institute and best friend of Miroita. Outgoing, hot-tempered, fiercely independent. She is often frustrated by the reality that surrounds her, and is willing to act. She really likes to stick with Miroita. Most people always see the two together. Protagonist in the story, player character. Miroita One of the two FEATHERs in the Institute and best friend of Notari. Calm, obedient and reserved, she likes to err on the side of caution. Miroita often requires Notari's support to boost confidence, even though her abilities are Notari's match. Luciolla Notari's companion originated from Miroita's own mind, but with a completely different personality. Her main strengths are intelligence gathering and planning. In combat she invades enemy systems to help Notari. She talks like a real person, and would not make you feel alone. Professor Leader of the Institute, and the creator of both Notari and Miroita. Even though she was hard on the pair, she deeply cared for them. Notari thought otherwise, though. ◆Support Should you experience motion sickness during gameplay, please adjust the setting in the Options menu. This game supports controller and mouse + keyboard. Mouse setting can be enabled in the Options menu.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
◆Story


Notari had expected one day she would be separated from her best friend. Nothing prepared her for what happened that day.
Did the Institute take away Miroita? Did the military, or the Federation itself?
The distinction no longer seemed important. All must pay. Notari desperately fought on.
Luciolla, the AI created by Miroita, was Notari's only companion.
"Miroita lives" said her.
Must see her. The thought is germinating, growing more powerful by day.
It is a better reason to live each day to the fullest, knowing someone is out there, waiting to see her once more.
Must not abandon her.
Must not let her down.
Fight on, to find one another again, one step at a time.
She knows the day will come.
And then, the other one showed up. But...

◆Gameplay



You are FEATHER
Mirage Feathers is an anime themed pseudo-3D rail shooter. You are Notari, a cybernetic air-superiority fighter of the Federation's FEATHER program. You will experience fast tempo combat as you destroy enemy aircrafts wave after wave. Even though the whole world is against you, your ammo is infinite. So fight on, and prove your superiority!

Fire!
Notari's advanced fire control system automatically locks on a target when it passes your crosshair. Your attacks will then home in on the locked targets.

Variable Combat Styles
As the story progresses, AI companion Luciolla will acquire weapons specs from stronger opponents, allowing Notari additional main weapon options. They all have different effects, and offer a range of playstyles.

Initiating OVERDRIVE!
FEATHERs may unleash incredible power by initiating OVERDRIVE, enough to destroy everything in sight. Moreover, when in OVERDRIVE mode, your weapons system will have upgraded performance, all your attacks will be buffed.

Game Modes
This game includes Story Mode and Endless Mode. Story Mode has scripted levels, and explores the characters outside battle with text-based dialogues and cute character art. Endless Mode gives you access to the full arsenal, and pits you against infinite waves of progressively more challenging enemies that spawn randomly.

Cheat Codes
Is the game too hard? No problem, we have made um… Oh! Sorry, that's classified.

◆Characters



Notari
One of the two FEATHERs from the Institute and best friend of Miroita. Outgoing, hot-tempered, fiercely independent. She is often frustrated by the reality that surrounds her, and is willing to act.
She really likes to stick with Miroita. Most people always see the two together.
Protagonist in the story, player character.


Miroita
One of the two FEATHERs in the Institute and best friend of Notari. Calm, obedient and reserved, she likes to err on the side of caution.
Miroita often requires Notari's support to boost confidence, even though her abilities are Notari's match.


Luciolla
Notari's companion originated from Miroita's own mind, but with a completely different personality. Her main strengths are intelligence gathering and planning. In combat she invades enemy systems to help Notari.
She talks like a real person, and would not make you feel alone.


Professor
Leader of the Institute, and the creator of both Notari and Miroita. Even though she was hard on the pair, she deeply cared for them. Notari thought otherwise, though.

◆Support

Should you experience motion sickness during gameplay, please adjust the setting in the Options menu.
This game supports controller and mouse + keyboard. Mouse setting can be enabled in the Options menu.

games.name: Mirror's Edge™ Catalyst
games.short_description: Mirror's Edge™ Catalyst raises the action-adventure bar through fluid, first person action and immerses players in Faith's story as she fights for freedom.

descriptions.en: Mirror's Edge™ Catalyst raises the action-adventure bar through fluid, first person action and immerses players in Faith's story as she fights for freedom.

detailed_descriptions.en: Follow Faith, a daring free runner, as she fights for freedom in the city of Glass. What appears to be an elegant, high-tech city on the outside, has a terrible secret hidden within. Explore every corner from the highest beautifully lit rooftops to the dark and gritty tunnels below. The city is huge, free to roam and Faith is at the center of it all. Through the first-person perspective, combine her fluid movement and advanced combat with the city's surroundings to master the environment and uncover the conspiracy. TRAVERSAL Hit top speed quickly zipping down wire lines. Balance on pipes before smoothly dropping to a hang before climbing, hand over hand, under an obstacle. Run vertically and horizontally on any wall and use your environment to swing around corners or over gaps. FOCUS Fast, light, and agile, Faith must stay focused and use her movement to survive. Focus is gained from free running, and once Faith has Focus enemies cannot hit her. Focus is lost from low speed and being attacked, so it is essential to maintain a balance of out-traversing opponents and engaging them directly. MOMENTUM Build momentum to do daring jumps between rooftops or stylish slides through tight spaces. Use the new Shift move to get a short burst of acceleration in any direction. For a quick change of plan, tweak any move with Quickturn, a rapid 180 or 90 degree turn. COMBAT Deliver devastating full body Heavy Traversal Attacks that throw your opponents stumbling into walls, over railings, and into each other. Use your momentum to flow right through KrugerSec as you string together a series of Light Traversal Attacks, building focus, and keeping speed. Outmaneuver opponents as you Shift behind them for a kick to the back. Or take advantage of a stun with a few rapid punches before Shifting away to avoid retaliation or a counter. GADGETS Faith’s running skills, martial arts knowledge, and determination is expanded on with a few pieces of hardware used to traverse the city and rise against the oppression smothering the citizens of Glass. NOTE: ONLINE FEATURES FOR THIS TITLE HAVE BEEN DISCONTINUED.

games.short_description: Miseria is a dark fantasy idle incremental game in which you lead a party of damned souls through the depths of the world.

descriptions.en: Miseria is a dark fantasy idle incremental game in which you lead a party of damned souls through the depths of the world.

detailed_descriptions.en: Venture deeper into a dark, ever descending abyss in search of your deepest desires. Your party fights automatically as you progress, striking down enemies with relentless attackscharging mana and unleashing powerful abilities. The deeper you go, the greater the danger… and the reward. Your characters gain experience through combat, allowing you to level up their stats and increase their power. Defeat monsters to earn gold, then visit the blacksmith to upgrade and forge stronger equipment. Every decision shapes how far your team can push into the darkness. Embrace the cycle of power through the Reborn system. Reset your progress to gain powerful permanent upgrades and push even further on your next descent. Master the prestige mechanics and break past your previous limits.

games.name: MISERY
games.short_description: MISERY is a 1–10 player co-op survival game set in a nuclear disaster zone. Here, every day is a struggle: search radioactive ruins for resources, build your bunker, craft weapons, and explore a weird, procedurally-generated world with your friends. Beware of anomalies, monsters, and armed bandits.

descriptions.en: MISERY is a 1–10 player co-op survival game set in a nuclear disaster zone. Here, every day is a struggle: search radioactive ruins for resources, build your bunker, craft weapons, and explore a weird, procedurally-generated world with your friends. Beware of anomalies, monsters, and armed bandits.
descriptions.zh-Hant: MISERY 是一款支援 1–10 名玩家的合作生存遊戲，背景設定在核災後的危險禁區。這裡每天都是生存挑戰：在輻射廢墟中搜尋資源、建造你的地堡、製作武器，並與朋友一起探索這個詭譎、隨機生成的世界。小心各種異常現象、怪物，以及全副武裝的強盜。
descriptions.ja: 『MISERY』は、核災害区域を舞台にした1～10人プレイの協力型サバイバルゲーム。ここでは毎日が闘いだ。放射能に汚染された廃墟で資源を探し、バンカーを建設し、武器をクラフトし、仲間と共に自動生成される奇妙な世界を探索しよう。アノマリー、モンスター、そして武装した盗賊には気をつけろ。
descriptions.ko: MISERY는 핵 재앙이 덮친 구역을 배경으로 하는 1~10인용 협동 생존 게임입니다. 이곳에서는 매일이 생존을 위한 투쟁입니다. 방사능 폐허에서 자원을 찾고, 벙커를 짓고, 무기를 제작하며, 친구들과 함께 기묘하게 절차적으로 생성된 세계를 탐험하세요. 변칙과 괴물, 무장한 강도들을 조심하세요.

detailed_descriptions.en: MISERY is a co-op rogue-lite survival game. You play as PMCs guarding a secret research institute in the Republic of Zaslavie. The Scientific Institute for Research of the Zaslavie Exclusion Zone (SIRZEZ) was built before the war to study anomalies and artifacts. Over time, these artifacts became the cause of conflict between international military blocs. Neither side could allow artifacts to fall into enemy hands, ultimately leading to nuclear war. A siren sounds — a nuclear bomb is incoming! You have 60 seconds to grab whatever you can and make it to the bunker. Then, the survival begins. Each day, you venture into the Exclusion Zone to scavenge procedurally generated locations: abandoned military bases and research stations, radioactive wastelands, and ruined cities. The Zone is full of secrets and deadly traps, and radiation is far from the only threat. You’ll encounter other survivors ready to kill for food and resources, weird mutated creatures with unique behaviors, and various anomalies. No one knows how exactly anomalies work or their origin. Some phenomena can help you, others will tear you apart. Anomaly areas often hide artifacts — rare, valuable items distorted by anomalies and charged with unique effects. The bunker is your new home. Expand it room by room: install generators (gas, solar, or gnome-powered), build crafting stations, grow food, cook meals, and decorate your shelter with whatever you drag back from raids: a table, a dresser, a worn-out sofa, or even a cozy rug. Don’t worry, the previous owners won’t be needing them anymore. After each raid, you can unwind and chill at the bar in the basement of the institute: have a drink, talk to other survivors, and trade your loot and rare artifacts with the merchant. Remember, watch your vitals. In the Zone, people can easily die from hunger, thirst, radiation sickness, or lose their minds and turn on their teammates. Go out looting during the day, and return to bunker before nightfall. And one last thing: the Zone plays with your mind. Too much stress and you’ll start hearing whispers, seeing things that aren’t there, and feeling someone watching you. Lose your grip, and not even the bunker will save you. Nothing will. Life in MISERY isn’t easy. But there’s nothing better than going through it all together. Exploring bandos with friends, watching each other’s backs, sitting by the fire, drinking whatever’s left, and exhaling smoke into the cold rain — in moments like these, you can feel alive again!
detailed_descriptions.zh-Hant: 你扮演的是受僱保護扎斯拉維共和國秘密研究機構的傭兵。 扎斯拉維隔離區科學研究院（SIRZEZ）在戰爭爆發前建立，專門研究異常現象與神器。隨著時間過去，這些神器成為國際軍事陣營間衝突的導火線。雙方都無法容忍它們落入敵人手中，最終導致核戰爆發。 警報響起——核彈即將來襲！你有 60 秒時間收集能帶的物資，並衝進地堡避難。 接下來，真正的生存挑戰開始了。每天，你都要前往隔離區，在隨機生成的地點搜集資源：廢棄的軍事基地、研究設施、受輻射污染的荒原和破敗城市。 這片區域充滿了祕密與致命陷阱，而輻射只是其中一種威脅。 你將遭遇其他為了糧食與資源不惜殺人的生還者、行為怪異的變異生物，以及各種神秘異象。 沒有人知道這些異象的起源或運作原理。有些現象能幫助你，有些則會將你撕裂。這些異象地帶常常藏有神器——稀有而珍貴的物品，受到異象扭曲，並帶有特殊效果。 地堡就是你新的家。 一點一滴地擴建它：安裝發電機（油電、太陽能，甚至是由地精驅動的）、建造工作台、種植食物、烹飪料理，並用你在突襲中帶回來的物品裝飾你的避難所：一張桌子、一個抽屜、一張舊沙發，甚至是一塊溫暖的地毯。別擔心，原本的主人不再需要它們了。 每次突襲後，你可以在研究所地下一層的酒吧中放鬆：喝一杯、與其他倖存者聊天，並將你的戰利品或稀有神器與商人交易。 記住：時時關注你的生命狀態。 在這裡，人們會因飢餓、乾渴、輻射病而死亡，甚至因精神崩潰攻擊自己的同伴。白天外出搜尋物資，天黑前務必回到地堡。 最後一點：這片區域會侵蝕你的心智。 壓力過大，你將聽見耳語、看見不存在的東西，感受到某人在暗中窺視。 若你失去理智，就連地堡也救不了你。什麼都救不了你。 在 MISERY 裡生存，絕不容易。 但一起經歷這一切，才是最珍貴的事。 與朋友一同探索廢墟、互相照應、圍坐在營火邊、喝光最後的酒，將煙霧吐入冷雨之中——就在這些時刻，你會重新感受到：自己還活著。
detailed_descriptions.ja: プレイヤーはザスラヴィエ共和国に存在する、秘密の研究施設を警護するPMC（民間軍事会社）の一員となる。 ザスラヴィエ立入禁止区域調査科学研究所（SIRZEZ）は、戦前にアノマリーとアーティファクトの研究を目的として建設された。やがて、これらのアーティファクトは国際的な軍事ブロック間の対立の火種となった。どちらの陣営もアーティファクトが敵の手に渡ることを許さず、その対立はついに核戦争へと発展した。 鳴り響くサイレン——核爆弾が接近中！60秒以内に、ありったけの物資を持ってバンカーへ避難しろ。 そして、生存をかけた戦いが始まる。プレイヤーは毎日、立入禁止区域、通称「ゾーン」へと足を踏み入れ、軍事基地や研究所の廃墟、放射能に汚染された荒地や崩壊した都市など、自動生成されるロケーションを探索し、物資を漁る。 ゾーンは秘密と危険な罠に満ちていて、脅威は放射能だけにとどまらない。 食料と資源のためなら殺しも厭わない他の生存者たち、独自の生態を持つ奇妙なミュータント、そしてさまざまなアノマリーに遭遇することになる。 アノマリーの正確な仕組みや起源については、いまだ誰にもわかっていない。助けとなる現象もあれば、プレイヤーをズタズタに引き裂くものもある。アノマリー地帯にはしばしばアーティファクトが隠されている。アノマリーによって変質し、特殊な効果を帯びた、希少価値の高いアイテムだ。 バンカーが、君の新たな家となる。 部屋を一つずつ拡張していこう。発電機（ガス、ソーラー、あるいはノーム駆動式）を設置し、クラフト台を作り、食料を栽培して料理をしよう。さらに、テーブル、ドレッサー、使い古されたソファ、居心地のよいラグなど、レイドで持ち帰ったものを設置してシェルターを飾ろう。心配はいらない。前の所有者はもうそれらを必要としていないはずだ。 レイドの後には、施設の地下にあるバーでくつろぐことができる。酒を飲み、他の生存者と語らい、商人と戦利品や希少なアーティファクトを取引しよう。 自分のバイタルを常に確認することを忘れるな。 ゾーン内では、飢えや渇き、放射線障害で簡単に命を落としてしまう。さらには正気を失い、仲間に牙を剥くことさえある。日中は外で物資を探し、日が暮れる前にバンカーへ戻ろう。 そして最後に——ゾーンは人の心を弄ぶ。過度のストレスにさらされると、囁き声が聞こえたり、幻覚が見えたり、誰かに見られていると感じ始める。正気を失ってしまえば、もはやバンカーでさえ安全な場所ではなくなる。安全な場所など、どこにもなくなるのだ。 『MISERY』での生活は決して楽ではない。 しかし、仲間と共にすべてを乗り越えることに勝る喜びはないはずだ。 仲間と廃墟を探索し、助け合い、火を囲み、ありったけの酒を飲み、冷たい雨の中で煙を吐く——そんな瞬間にこそ、生の実感はある！
detailed_descriptions.ko: 당신은 자슬라비에 공화국에 있는 비밀 연구소를 지키는 PMC가 되어 플레이하게 됩니다. 자슬라비에 배제 구역 과학 연구소(SIRZEZ)는 변칙 현상과 아티팩트를 연구하기 위해 전쟁 전에 건설된 곳이죠. 시간이 흐르면서 이러한 아티팩트는 국제 군사 연합 간 갈등을 불러왔습니다. 그 어느 쪽도 아티팩트가 적의 손에 들어가는 것을 용납할 수 없었고, 이는 결국 핵전쟁으로 이어졌습니다. 사이렌이 울립니다. 곧 핵폭탄이 떨어집니다! 60초 안에 챙길 수 있는 모든 것을 챙겨 벙커로 피신해야 합니다. 이후부터, 생존을 향한 투쟁이 시작됩니다. 매일 배제 구역으로 들어가 버려진 군사 기지, 연구소, 방사능 황무지, 폐허가 된 도시 등 절차적으로 생성된 장소에서 물자를 수집해야 합니다. 구역은 비밀과 치명적인 함정으로 가득합니다. 이곳에서는 방사능만이 유일한 위협은 아니죠. 식량과 자원을 위해 살인도 마다하지 않는 다른 생존자들, 독특한 행동을 보이는 기이한 돌연변이 생물, 그리고 다양한 변칙 현상을 마주하게 될 것입니다. 구역은 비밀과 치명적인 함정으로 가득합니다. 이곳에서는 방사능만이 유일한 위협은 아니죠. 식량과 자원을 위해 살인도 마다하지 않는 다른 생존자들, 독특한 행동을 보이는 기이한 돌연변이 생물, 그리고 다양한 변칙 현상을 마주하게 될 것입니다. 벙커는 당신의 새로운 안식처입니다. 방을 하나씩 확장하세요. 발전기(가스, 태양열, 혹은 노움 동력)를 설치하고, 제작대를 건설하고, 식량을 재배하고, 음식을 요리하세요. 습격을 통해 획득한 테이블, 옷장, 낡은 소파, 심지어 아늑한 러그 같은 물건들로 안식처를 꾸밀 수도 있습니다. 걱정 마세요. 이전 주인들에게는 더는 필요 없을 테니까요. 습격이 끝나면 연구소 지하 바에서 긴장을 풀고 휴식을 취할 수 있습니다. 술을 마시고, 다른 생존자들과 대화하며, 상인과 전리품 및 희귀 아티팩트를 거래하세요. 본인의 생체 신호에 주의를 기울이세요. 구역 안에서는 굶주림, 갈증, 방사선증으로 쉽게 죽을 수 있으며, 정신을 잃고 팀원을 공격할 수도 있습니다. 낮에는 밖으로 나가 물자를 수색하고, 해가 지기 전에 벙커로 돌아오세요. 마지막으로 알아둬야 할 중요한 사실이 하나 더 있습니다. 구역은 당신의 정신을 뒤흔들 겁니다. 스트레스를 너무 많이 받으면 속삭임이 들리고, 헛것이 보이며, 누군가 자신을 지켜보는 듯한 느낌을 받게 됩니다. 이성을 잃는 순간, 벙커조차 당신을 지켜주지 못합니다. 그 무엇도 말이죠. MISERY에서의 삶은 쉽지 않습니다. 하지만 이 모든 것을 함께 헤쳐나가는 것만큼 값진 경험은 없죠. 친구들과 함께 폐가를 탐험하고, 서로를 지켜주며, 모닥불 주위에 앉아 남은 술을 마시고, 차가운 빗속으로 연기를 내뿜을 때… 바로 이런 순간에 다시 살아있음을 느낄 수 있을 겁니다!

I want to keep you with me every day, and live with you every day~ I know you also want to be with me every day, so I let you to come to our sweet home~ How is that? Are you happy? That way we can stay together all the time! Let's take a selfie first, It will last longer~ Enjoy a wonderful lunch together~ You may feel sudden, but it doesn't matter. I don't care as long as we can be together~ Why does it feel like you are so eager to go back ? Don't you love me anymore? Why are you leaving? Why are you leaving? Why are you leaving? Why are you leaving! Original visual style The authors hope to emphasize the contrast of colorful anime style against the background of the disturbing adventures of the main character. Interesting plot The game has an unexpectedly developing storyline, accompanied by psychological tension. Original musical accompaniment The game experience is accompanied by an authentic warm soundtrack, transitioning into an atmospheric ambient. Unique Characters In the world of MiSide, the player will encounter various characters who play a role in the narrative part of the game to varying degrees. Helping the hero, scaring him, or just messing with him. ※This game contains intense scenes. It is not recommended for those with weak hearts.

games.name: Mistfall Hunter
games.short_description: Mistfall Hunter is a dark fantasy extraction ARPG. Combine skills, talents, and gear for each class in thrilling combat! Whether you team up or go solo, one thing remains certain—only by fighting your way through can you return with a full haul. Good luck, Gyldhunter.

descriptions.en: Mistfall Hunter is a dark fantasy extraction ARPG. Combine skills, talents, and gear for each class in thrilling combat! Whether you team up or go solo, one thing remains certain—only by fighting your way through can you return with a full haul. Good luck, Gyldhunter.

detailed_descriptions.en: Everything is Woven in the Mist. The gods have fallen, and the Gyldenmist is consuming the world. Revived by a mysterious girl named Dew, you are thrust into a bleak world to harvest Gyldenblood and mend the shattered Web of Fate. Scavenge, fight, and extract in a brutal cycle of survival to bring a flicker of hope to this forbidden land. Mistfall Hunter is a third-person PvPvE extraction ARPG blending bleak dark fantasy aesthetics with intense, visceral action. Step into a forbidden realm consumed by the mist. Caught in a ruthless loop of high-stakes looting, deadly combat, and desperate extractions, you must fight for your life in the shadows to experience the ultimate dark fantasy survival test. This intricate dark fantasy world hides precious Gyldenblood and forgotten relics. It also serves as a brutal battleground for melee skirmishes against both horrific, corroded creatures and cunning rival Gyldhunters. Every battle is a deadly gamble where death strips you of all your spoils. To return to the safety of your camp, you must carve a bloody path to a Returner Woodling. Will you secure your hard-earned loot, or risk everything for greater glory? The Web of Fate does not judge. It remembers. Engage in fluid, third-person action where every strike matters. As a Gyldhunter, string together devastating combos to seize the upper hand in high-stakes PvPvE encounters. A precision free-aim system adds profound depth to the battlefield—target your enemies' weak points and immerse yourself in the brutal clash of heavy steel and arcane arts. Deploy a diverse arsenal of tactical items to outsmart your prey, letting split-second reflexes and cunning strategy dictate who survives. Six distinct classes define your path through the mist, each mastering two unique weapon stances. Adapt to the chaos of the mist by seamlessly swapping fighting styles mid-battle to dominate any encounter. Dive into deep customization with expansive talent trees, tailoring your loadout using dozens of rare gem affixes and a vast array of active skills. Break free from rigid class restraints—whether you favor relentless assault, elusive maneuvering, heavy crowd control, or unyielding defense, you define the rules of your hunt. Stalk the mist as a lone wolf, or band together in a three-player squad. In this hazardous realm, fighting back-to-back with your companions is the surest way to crush towering monstrosities, outmaneuver rival hunting parties, and guarantee a safe extraction. The rules of survival shift in every season. The battlefield beneath the Gyldenmist constantly mutates, unleashing new classes, forbidden arcana, uncharted zones, and ancient relics to keep the hunt fresh and fiercely competitive. With zero pay-to-win mechanics and no paid stat boosts, victory is earned in blood—decided solely by your mastery of the hunt.

games.name: Mixed Spirits: Bartender
games.short_description: Run a cozy bar, make cocktails for fun customers! 🍸 Mixed Spirits is a Job Simulator where you work as a bartender. Take orders, mix custom drinks, and discover secret recipes in a chill, creative night-shift experience with no timers or stress, or rush orders in Happy Hour mode!

descriptions.en: Run a cozy bar, make cocktails for fun customers! 🍸 Mixed Spirits is a Job Simulator where you work as a bartender. Take orders, mix custom drinks, and discover secret recipes in a chill, creative night-shift experience with no timers or stress, or rush orders in Happy Hour mode!

detailed_descriptions.en: 🍸 Welcome to Mixed Spirits , A Cozy Bartending Experience 🍸 Step into your evening shift, where the lights are low, the music is mellow, and the drinks are anything but ordinary. Mixed Spirits is a cozy, creative bartending game where you mix custom drinks, charm your customers, and grow your dream bar, one glass at a time. Serve, Mix, Repeat Run your own bar and take orders from colorful customers looking for the perfect drink. Whether they ask for something straight from the menu or give you vague hints (I want something sweet and a little bitter), it’s your job to get it right! Bar Scene: Greet customers, chat a little, and take their drink orders in a cozy, warmly lit setting. Mixing Scene: Head to the mixing station to craft each drink from scratch with a variety of ingredients, ice types, and decorative touches. Ingredient Preparing Scene: Head back to your home to grow your mint, cut lemons and more minigames to prepare for the next day at the bar. Freeform Drink Mixing Create original drinks by combining different ingredients with attributes like Sweet, Bitter, Spicy, or Relaxing. The better you match the customer’s desires, the bigger your tip! Secret Recipes Experiment enough and you’ll unlock hidden drink recipes! These special discoveries can be added to your menu for future orders. Full Drink Customization Customize every aspect of your drink, glass size, type of ice, decorations, and garnish. Want to impress a picky guest who wants a “big, refreshing drink with mint and umbrella”? You can! Creative, Chill Experience No timers. No stress. Just you, your bar, and your creativity. The perfect game to relax with after a long day. End-of-Shift Wind Down After the bar closes, rest at home and prep for the next day. Visit shops to restock your ingredients or upgrade your setup: Liquor Store Glassware Shop Fruit Market Decoration & Garnish Store Recipe Book Merchant Meaningful Interactions Chat with guests before and after their drinks. Build your own little world behind the bar, one story at a time. 🖼️ Aesthetic & Vibes Mixed Spirits captures the magic of cozy night work, golden light, jazzy piano, softly clinking glasses, and beautifully animated drinks that glow with personality. 🎵 Chill. Sip. Stay a While. Mixed Spirits is perfect for players who want a relaxed, sandbox-y, creative gameplay loop. Whether you're here to master the art of mixology or just vibe with your regulars, your bar is always open. 🥃 Discover your signature drink. 🕯️ Decorate your station. 🧊 Serve the perfect nightcap. Welcome to Mixed Spirits !

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
🍸 Welcome to Mixed Spirits, A Cozy Bartending Experience 🍸

Step into your evening shift, where the lights are low, the music is mellow, and the drinks are anything but ordinary. Mixed Spirits is a cozy, creative bartending game where you mix custom drinks, charm your customers, and grow your dream bar, one glass at a time.



Serve, Mix, Repeat
Run your own bar and take orders from colorful customers looking for the perfect drink. Whether they ask for something straight from the menu or give you vague hints (I want something sweet and a little bitter), it’s your job to get it right!

  • Bar Scene: Greet customers, chat a little, and take their drink orders in a cozy, warmly lit setting.
  • Mixing Scene: Head to the mixing station to craft each drink from scratch with a variety of ingredients, ice types, and decorative touches.
  • Ingredient Preparing Scene: Head back to your home to grow your mint, cut lemons and more minigames to prepare for the next day at the bar.



Freeform Drink Mixing
Create original drinks by combining different ingredients with attributes like Sweet, Bitter, Spicy, or Relaxing. The better you match the customer’s desires, the bigger your tip!

Secret Recipes
Experiment enough and you’ll unlock hidden drink recipes! These special discoveries can be added to your menu for future orders.

Full Drink Customization
Customize every aspect of your drink, glass size, type of ice, decorations, and garnish. Want to impress a picky guest who wants a “big, refreshing drink with mint and umbrella”? You can!

Creative, Chill Experience
No timers. No stress. Just you, your bar, and your creativity. The perfect game to relax with after a long day.



End-of-Shift Wind Down
After the bar closes, rest at home and prep for the next day. Visit shops to restock your ingredients or upgrade your setup:
  • Liquor Store
  • Glassware Shop
  • Fruit Market
  • Decoration & Garnish Store

Meaningful Interactions
Chat with guests before and after their drinks. Build your own little world behind the bar, one story at a time.

🖼️ Aesthetic & Vibes
Mixed Spirits captures the magic of cozy night work, golden light, jazzy piano, softly clinking glasses, and beautifully animated drinks that glow with personality.

🎵 Chill. Sip. Stay a While.
Mixed Spirits is perfect for players who want a relaxed, sandbox-y, creative gameplay loop. Whether you're here to master the art of mixology or just vibe with your regulars, your bar is always open.

🥃 Discover your signature drink.
🕯️ Decorate your station.
🧊 Serve the perfect nightcap.
Welcome to Mixed Spirits!

games.name: Mixtape
games.short_description: On their last night together, three friends embark on one final adventure. Play through a mixtape of memories, set to the soundtrack of a generation.

descriptions.en: On their last night together, three friends embark on one final adventure. Play through a mixtape of memories, set to the soundtrack of a generation.
descriptions.zh-Hant: 在三個好朋友相聚的最後一個晚上，他們一起踏上了最後一次冒險之旅。回放充滿回憶的混音帶，重溫一代人的原聲音樂。
descriptions.ja: ハイスクール最後の夜、友達3人で冒険に旅立ちます。時代を象徴するサウンドトラックで、思い出のミックステープを再生しよう。
descriptions.ko: 함께 보내는 마지막 밤, 세 친구가 다시 한번 모험을 떠납니다. 한 세대의 사운드트랙이 가득 담긴 추억의 믹스테이프에 귀를 기울여 보세요.

detailed_descriptions.en: On their last night together, three friends embark on one final adventure. Play through a mixtape of memories, set to the soundtrack of a generation. En route to their final party together, a perfectly curated playlist draws three friends into dreamlike reenactments of their formative memories. Experience a variety of narrative vignettes exploring the pivotal moments that shaped them. Players will immerse themselves in the teenage wasteland by playing through a mixtape of joyful gameplay, from skateboarding and flying to taking photos after hours at an abandoned theme park, hitting baseballs, and putting on a fireworks show from the backseat of a car. It's the greatest hits of the teenage experience, from the first kiss to the last dance. From Beethoven & Dinosaur, developers of BAFTA award-winning game The Artful Escape, Mixtape draws inspiration from classic coming-of-age movies, bringing together nostalgic aimlessness, mischief, music, the highs and lows of adolescence, and the bittersweet feelings brought about by growth, transformation, and moving on. Featuring music from DEVO, Roxy Music, Lush, The Smashing Pumpkins, Iggy Pop, Siouxsie and the Banshees, Joy Division, the Cure and many more. Skate. Party. Avoid the law. Hang out. Sneak out. Make out.
detailed_descriptions.zh-Hant: 在三個好朋友相聚的最後一個晚上，他們一起踏上了最後一次冒險之旅。回放充滿回憶的混音帶，重溫一代人的原聲音樂。 在一起參加最後派對的途中，一組精心挑選的播放曲目把三個好朋友帶入夢境般的場景中，重現他們往日的成長記憶。玩家將體驗各種敘事片段，探索遊戲角色成長歷程中的關鍵時刻。隨著一系列趣味橫生的遊戲沉浸於青春荒原的綺幻世界中，體驗滑板飛馳、漂移競速，深夜探祕廢棄主題公園並拍照留念，揮棒擊打棒球，還能坐在車後座燃放煙火秀。從初吻到最後一支舞，回味少年友情的難忘時刻。 《Mixtape》由遊戲開發工作室 Beethoven&Dinosaur 操刀製作，該工作室曾憑藉遊戲《The Artful Escape》榮獲「英國電影和電視藝術學院獎」(BAFTA)。《Mixtape》從經典的青春成長電影中汲取靈感，融合青春期的迷茫、惡作劇、音樂、跌宕起伏，以及成長、轉變和前行帶來的酸甜苦辣。 遊戲收錄 DEVO、Roxy Music、Lush、The Smashing Pumpkins、Iggy Pop、Siouxsie and the Banshees、Joy Division、the Cure 等眾多樂團的音樂。 滑板飛馳，狂歡派對，躲避執法。 閒逛嬉戲，偷溜撒野，甜蜜親暱。
detailed_descriptions.ja: 明日からはもう離れ離れ。その夜、3人の友達は最後の冒険に旅立つ。時代を象徴するサウンドトラックで、思い出のミックステープを再生しよう。 最後のパーティーに向かう途中、最高の曲を集めたプレイリストを聴いていると、青春の思い出が夢のように蘇ってくる。スケートボード、廃園したテーマパークで写真を撮った放課後、野球、車の後部席で花火を眺めたこと。3人の友情を彩った大切な瞬間を追体験しよう。初めてのキスから最後のダンスまで、10代の青春のベスト盤。 『Mixtape』は往年の青春映画にインスピレーションを受け、若さゆえの無分別、いたずら、音楽、思春期の喜びと悲しみ、成長、変化、旅立ちのほろ苦さをひとつにした作品です。 DEVO、Roxy Music、Lush、The Smashing Pumpkins、Iggy Pop、Siouxsie and the Banshees、Joy Division、The Cureなど、多数の楽曲を収録。 スケート。パーティ。人には言えないいたずら。 みんなで集まって騒ぎ、抜け出し、恋をした。
detailed_descriptions.ko: 함께 보내는 마지막 밤, 세 친구가 다시 한번 모험을 떠납니다. 한 세대의 사운드트랙이 가득 담긴 추억의 믹스테이프에 귀를 기울여 보세요. 고등학교 시절의 끝을 알리는 마지막 파티로 가는 길, 완벽하게 큐레이션된 플레이리스트가 함께한 시절의 추억을 되새기는 꿈결 같은 여정으로 세 친구를 이끕니다. 지금의 그들을 있게 한 결정적인 순간들을 엿보는 다채로운 이야기의 단편들을 경험해 보세요. 스케이트보드로 도로를 달리고, 하늘을 날고, 한밤중에 버려진 테마파크에서 사진을 찍고, 야구공을 담장 너머로 날리고, 자동차 뒷좌석에 앉아 불꽃놀이를 지휘하는 등 유쾌한 게임플레이를 통해 황무지 같았던 십 대 시절의 애틋한 기억 속으로 다시 한번 빠져드세요. 첫 키스부터 마지막 댄스까지, 십 대의 빛나는 우정 속 가장 위대한 히트곡들을 한 아름 선사합니다. 영국 아카데미 영화상(BAFTA) 수상 경력에 빛나는 게임 The Artful Escape의 개발사 Beethoven & Dinosaur에서 개발한 믹스테이프는 클래식 성장 영화에서 영감을 받아 향수를 불러일으키는 방황, 사랑스러운 장난, 가슴 뛰는 음악, 그리고 사춘기의 성장과 변화, 어른이 되며 떠나 보내야 하는 모든 것들에 대한 달곰씁쓸한 감정을 하나로 모았습니다. DEVO, Roxy Music, Lush, The Smashing Pumpkins, Iggy Pop, Siouxsie and the Banshees, Joy Division, the Cure 등의 히트곡이 쉬지 않고 흘러나옵니다. 스케이트와 파티를 즐기고, 경찰을 피해 달아나세요. 친구들과 함께하고, 몰래 빠져나가고, 키스하세요.

games.name: Mnemonimov
games.short_description: Mnemonimov is a fantasy console where you program in ASSEMBLY like in the 80s. Build anything from games to operating systems and understand how computers work at a low level.

descriptions.en: Mnemonimov is a fantasy console where you program in ASSEMBLY like in the 80s. Build anything from games to operating systems and understand how computers work at a low level.

detailed_descriptions.en: Mnemonimov (pronounced nee-mo-ni-move ) is a low-level programming sandbox inspired by early game consoles. In this fantasy console, you program in assembly language with full control over execution, rendering your games and other creations to a retro monochrome screen. Start by building simple games or exploring the included sample projects, then expand into more complex systems as you build everything from scratch. With no tutorials or challenges, you work things out by experimenting. Read the manual, write code, run it, debug it, and repeat as you go. Expressive assembly language with RISC-style memory access, floating-point operations, and vector instructions. 32-bit register-based virtual machine with a rich instruction set. Labels, constants, bookmarks, and related directives for structuring large programs. Support for referencing external assets, including images and binary files. Integrated code editor with syntax highlighting and detailed error reporting. Debugger with step-by-step execution, breakpoints, and inspection of registers and memory. Command-line interface for managing projects and configuration. Retro monochrome screen with 320x240 resolution at 60 Hz. System calls for user input, rendering, terminal output, and system interaction. Persistent memory storage for saving program data across runs. Integrated technical reference covering the architecture, assembly language, and ABI conventions. Large memory limits with no restrictions on code length or execution speed. Mnemonimov is not a guided learning tool. Like a painting program won't teach you how to draw, or a 3D editor won't teach you how to model, Mnemonimov will not teach you programming logic, assembly, or game development. There are no tutorials or levels, and the manual is strictly a technical reference for the console. Mnemonimov is focused entirely on programming and debugging. It does not include a sprite editor, sound editor, map editor, or any asset creation tools. The console currently does not feature sound output or standalone exporting.

Mnemonimov (pronounced nee-mo-ni-move) is a low-level programming sandbox inspired by early game consoles. In this fantasy console, you program in assembly language with full control over execution, rendering your games and other creations to a retro monochrome screen.

  • Retro monochrome screen with 320x240 resolution at 60 Hz.

  • System calls for user input, rendering, terminal output, and system interaction.

  • Persistent memory storage for saving program data across runs.

  • Integrated technical reference covering the architecture, assembly language, and ABI conventions.

  • Large memory limits with no restrictions on code length or execution speed.

Mnemonimov is not a guided learning tool. Like a painting program won't teach you how to draw, or a 3D editor won't teach you how to model, Mnemonimov will not teach you programming logic, assembly, or game development. There are no tutorials or levels, and the manual is strictly a technical reference for the console.

Mnemonimov is focused entirely on programming and debugging. It does not include a sprite editor, sound editor, map editor, or any asset creation tools. The console currently does not feature sound output or standalone exporting.

games.name: Model Kit Shop Simulator
games.short_description: Build and run your own hobby shop in this first-person store management sim. Order stock, fill shelves, set prices, match kits with paints through the Hobby Basket System, and let customers bring their projects to life at Build Tables.

descriptions.en: Build and run your own hobby shop in this first-person store management sim. Order stock, fill shelves, set prices, match kits with paints through the Hobby Basket System, and let customers bring their projects to life at Build Tables.

detailed_descriptions.en: Model Kit Shop Simulator is a first-person store management game where every sale starts with a Model Kit . Build and grow your own hobby shop by ordering master boxes, unpacking deliveries, stocking shelves, setting prices, and serving collectors and enthusiasts. But running a successful model kit shop is not just about selling boxes. To maximize profits, you need to keep the right matching paints in stock, increase basket value through the Hobby Basket System , and give customers a place to bring their projects to life with the Build Table . Core Systems Hobby Basket System Customers do not just buy a single kit — they start a project. When a customer picks a model kit, they may also look for the matching paints needed to complete it. If you keep those paints on your shelves, they can add them to their basket, increasing the total value of each sale. If the paints are missing, they may still buy the kit, but your basket value and profit will be lower. Build Table System Customers who complete the right kit-and-paint combination can pay to use a Build Table after checkout. detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Model Kit Shop Simulator is a first-person store management game where every sale starts with a Model Kit.

Build and grow your own hobby shop by ordering master boxes, unpacking deliveries, stocking shelves, setting prices, and serving collectors and enthusiasts.

But running a successful model kit shop is not just about selling boxes. To maximize profits, you need to keep the right matching paints in stock, increase basket value through the Hobby Basket System, and give customers a place to bring their projects to life with the Build Table.

Core Systems

Hobby Basket System

Customers do not just buy a single kit — they start a project. When a customer picks a model kit, they may also look for the matching paints needed to complete it. If you keep those paints on your shelves, they can add them to their basket, increasing the total value of each sale. If the paints are missing, they may still buy the kit, but your basket value and profit will be lower.

Build Table System

Customers who complete the right kit-and-paint combination can pay to use a Build Table after checkout. There, they sit down, start assembling their kit, and turn a box of parts into a finished model right inside your shop. This makes your store feel more alive and adds a distinctive hobby-shop experience beyond traditional retail management.

Success depends on smart stock planning, efficient shelf management, the right product variety, and creating a store that supports both shopping and building.
