games.name: Parisian Bistro Simulator
games.short_description: Run your Parisian bistro in the heart of Paris, solo or in co-op with up to 8 players! Curate your menu, manage supplies, serve customers, and expand with new floors, a terrace, and a rooftop to become a true Parisian institution.

descriptions.en: Run your Parisian bistro in the heart of Paris, solo or in co-op with up to 8 players! Curate your menu, manage supplies, serve customers, and expand with new floors, a terrace, and a rooftop to become a true Parisian institution.

detailed_descriptions.en: Run your own Parisian bistro in a chaotic mix of service and management, solo or with up to 8 players in online co-op . Serve crowds of hungry customers, optimize your restaurant, and jump into fun hands-on interactions that keep every shift lively. Grow your business while serving mouth-watering dishes inspired by authentic French cuisine. Divide the workload across the restaurant. With up to 8 players in online co-op , everyone can take on a role and work together to keep the bistro running! Serve delicious dishes, serve drinks, and keep your customers happy. From the kitchen to the bar, every role matters when the restaurant gets busy. Get your kitchen ready for the morning rush and prepare breakfast orders. Put your cooking skills to the test with interactive kitchen mini games. Turn the rooftop into a lively nightlife destination. Bring in a DJ, serve cocktails, and keep your guests entertained as the evening comes alive. Customize and expand your restaurant to create a space that feels truly yours. Unlock new areas, upgrades, furniture, and more as your business grows. Run your bistro your way. Manage finances, inventory, suppliers, and staff while balancing expenses and customer satisfaction to build a profitable business. Hide cash, secure your earnings in a personal vault, and take on shady side activities, but watch your Financial Vigilance before unwanted attention finds you.

games.name: Parking Garage Rally Circuit
games.short_description: Retro Arcade Rally Racing... in Parking Garages?!? Precision driving with tight simple controls and arcade physics, all in a Sega Saturn style presentation

descriptions.en: Retro Arcade Rally Racing... in Parking Garages?!? Precision driving with tight simple controls and arcade physics, all in a Sega Saturn style presentation

detailed_descriptions.en: Retro Arcade-style Rally Racing in repurposed Parking Garages in big cities across the USA You said "Parking Garage"? The “Parking Garage Rally Circuit” tour comes into a city, selects a parking garage, and temporarily turns it into an exciting rally course for a week-long competition. Each track in the game is styled as a unique parking garage that has been turned into a race course. Rally... Circuit?!? This is a hybrid of Rally and circuit racing. From rally it draws the jumps and “one racer at a time against the clock” time-trial format. However, the tracks are similar to circuit racing, with each race consisting of multiple laps around the same track (the track may change slightly from lap to lap, however) Controls are very tight, simple and arcadey, similar to Mario Kart (accelerate, reverse, steer, drift), but with a bit more dynamic “smash into things” physics. Seamless Leaderboards After beating the gold trophy for a course, ghosts from other players just barely ahead of you on the leaderboard are automatically downloaded to race against, getting you into that "just one more" flow as you chase down rivals. Limiting the auto-download rivals to Steam friends only is also an option. Realtime Multiplayer Create or join a lobby of up to 8 players for realtime peer-to-peer non-contact racing! Split-screen Multiplayer Connect some controllers and relive the glory days of split-screen multiplayer for 2-4 players with contact and non-contact options. Retro Style Designed to look and feel like a long lost Sega Saturn game that could have been released in ~1998. This includes low-resolution, low-poly, chunky textures of course, but also extends to the audio, simple interface, and streamlined game scope. Oh, and CHEAT CODES too!

Seamless Leaderboards

After beating the gold trophy for a course, ghosts from other players just barely ahead of you on the leaderboard are automatically downloaded to race against, getting you into that "just one more" flow as you chase down rivals. Limiting the auto-download rivals to Steam friends only is also an option.

Retro Style

Designed to look and feel like a long lost Sega Saturn game that could have been released in ~1998. This includes low-resolution, low-poly, chunky textures of course, but also extends to the audio, simple interface, and streamlined game scope. Oh, and CHEAT CODES too!

games.name: Parkitect
games.short_description: Parkitect is a business simulation game that charges you with the construction and management of theme parks! Bringing back the best of classic theme park games with many new features and content on top. Now supports online co-op with up to 8 players!

descriptions.en: Parkitect is a business simulation game that charges you with the construction and management of theme parks! Bringing back the best of classic theme park games with many new features and content on top. Now supports online co-op with up to 8 players!

detailed_descriptions.en: Welcome to Parkitect, a modern take on a classic theme park tycoon where you build and manage the theme parks of your dreams. Construct your own coasters, design an efficiently operating park that fully immerses your guests in its theming and play through the campaign. Both the campaign and the sandbox mode can be played in single player mode or cooperatively by up to 8 players building together online! Build and experiment Create the perfect park for your guests! Deform the terrain, place water, build structures! With a huge selection of decorative objects from various themes you can design your park however you want. And for more you can get custom scenery from the Steam Workshop or mod in your own! Top off that park with your very own roller coaster ! Design it yourself or choose from a number of exciting designs. Spinning, looping, launching, flying - with over 70 of the worlds most popular types of theme park rides you'll always be able to surprise your guests. Great scale - Endless of possibilities Parkitect maps are huge, yet every tile matters. Adventure park or fantasy land? Why not both? The only limit is your imagination. From the smallest details such as placing each flower pot, to designing massive roller coasters, you decide the depth of your journey. Management matters Building is only half of the challenge! You'll need to keep an eye on the finances and guest satisfaction to stay on top, and for the first time in a theme park game the "behind the scenes" parts of your park have a meaning too! Route resources to your various shops without annoying your guests and keep the staff areas out of the public eye for the perfect immersive experience. Play and explore Build your way through a challenging campaign! 26 scenarios with unique settings will put your theme park management and coaster designing skills to the test. And there's always more - download scenarios created by the community from Steam Workshop or design your own with the scenario editor. With the landscape generator you'll create your own unique setting in no time. And if you're more of a creative player there's the sandbox mode !

games.name: PARKSIDE: DECAYED SOUL MANIPULATION
games.short_description: PARKSIDE is an FPS-Immersive Sim that chronicles the future of biomechanical subterfuge and suffering. Shoot, hack, and either save or sour the future of humanity in the dystopian city of Abbotsford, California in the awful year of 2038. Will you serve the Divine Rod?

descriptions.en: PARKSIDE is an FPS-Immersive Sim that chronicles the future of biomechanical subterfuge and suffering. Shoot, hack, and either save or sour the future of humanity in the dystopian city of Abbotsford, California in the awful year of 2038. Will you serve the Divine Rod?

detailed_descriptions.en: In PARKSIDE , the future of biomechanical subterfuge and suffering is revealed through the story of Alexander Petrovich, an unemployed hacker who is kidnapped by a mysterious group known as the Illuminated Brethren of Conclave Automata . Will he bend to the will of the Brethren and aid in realizing their vision for humanity , or will he take the hand of a guardian angel ? Though, no matter his choice, a sinister voice in his head warns that judgement is inevitable . PARKSIDE is a First Person Shooter / Immersive Simulation, with a focus on freedom, choice, and consequences . Set in the fictitious city of Abbotsford, California in the year 2038, the world the player experiences is the result of four years of shrouded meddling by the Illuminated Brethren - the environment is cold and unforgiving, the people are drab and demoralized, narcotics and gangs are rife, and military police walk the streets. How has it come to this? Following his capture by the Brethren , Alexander is interfaced with an experimental combat platform known as POLYPHEMUS . Through a piece of technology called the Remote Combatant Viewer, he is sent to complete illicit, dangerous missions for the Brethren , whose directives come from the mysterious Divine Rod . Many tools are at the player's disposal to tackle problems including a roster of futuristic weapons, armaments such as EMP grenades and frag mines, and abilities that can be used to navigate all manner of obstacles. You can hack or bypass keypads, security cameras, turrets, and robots... or shoot them to bits - pick your poison and run with it as you navigate smoky streets, dark alleys, airy vents, and secret bases. Choices matter - in the secret fight for control of the precious lives of all citizens, there are many powerful stakeholders. There is one important question with many answers and outcomes: are you a servant of the Divine Rod, Alexander?

games.name: Pass the Fear
games.short_description: PASS THE FEAR is a roguelite bullet-hell shooter. A catastrophic Witch’s Disaster strikes without warning, and chaotic magic forms the ancient Wall of Storms. Its corruption spreads relentlessly across the island. As a demon hunter trapped within, you must find a way to escape before dawn breaks.

descriptions.en: PASS THE FEAR is a roguelite bullet-hell shooter. A catastrophic Witch’s Disaster strikes without warning, and chaotic magic forms the ancient Wall of Storms. Its corruption spreads relentlessly across the island. As a demon hunter trapped within, you must find a way to escape before dawn breaks.

detailed_descriptions.en: Scraped together mid-escape, this motley crew consists of the Iron Bucket Knight, the Explosive Cutie, the One-Eyed Codger, the Money Whiz, and a mysterious nun picked up by the roadside... Every single one of them is deathly afraid of kicking the bucket, yet they have no choice but to grab their guns and face the fight head-on! Your mission is to flee the island within 12 hours. But as you reach the coastline,a despair-inducing Storm Wall blocks your path. As the monsters multiply, a dark conspiracy slowly begins to unravel... games.name: Path of Exile 2
games.short_description: Path of Exile 2 is a next generation Action RPG from Grinding Gear Games, featuring co-op for up to six players. Set years after the original Path of Exile, you will return to the dark world of Wraeclast and seek to end the corruption that is spreading.

descriptions.en: Path of Exile 2 is a next generation Action RPG from Grinding Gear Games, featuring co-op for up to six players. Set years after the original Path of Exile, you will return to the dark world of Wraeclast and seek to end the corruption that is spreading.

detailed_descriptions.en: Path of Exile 2 is a next generation Action RPG from Grinding Gear Games, featuring co-op for up to six players. Path of Exile 2 takes place in the land of Wraeclast, a dark continent populated by unique cultures, ancient secrets, and monstrous dangers. A sinister threat, long thought destroyed, has begun creeping back on the edge of civilisation, driving people mad and sickening the land with Corruption. Path of Exile 2 features a brand new campaign with six acts, 100 distinct environments, 600 monsters and 100 bosses. Key Features Twelve Character Classes Path of Exile 2 features twelve character classes, two for every combination of Strength, Dexterity and Intelligence. While each of the class variants focuses on a different playstyle, they're just a starting point. You can combine skills from many classes together to create your ideal character build. Each of the twelve character classes has its own three Ascendancy specialisations, resulting in a total of 36 Ascendancy Classes to pick between. New Skill Gem System Path of Exile 2 features 240 Skill Gems that grant devastating active skills and 200 Support Gems that modify their behaviour. Combine these together to create your perfect build. This is the next generation of Path of Exile's famous skill system. Support Gems are now socketed directly into Skill Gems, removing many of the frustrations present in the old system while maintaining all the previous depth. It's now possible to six-link every skill your character uses. Dual-specialise your Passive Skill Tree Path of Exile's iconic Passive Skill Tree has made a return, with 1,500 skills that allow you to completely customise your gameplay experience. It now features Dual Specialisation, the ability to allocate some passive skill points to two different sets of skills. They engage whenever the appropriate weapon or skill type is used. For example, you can have some points allocated to both daggers and traps, or ice and lightning, and as you swap between attacks, the appropriate skill points will apply. This lets you specialise in multiple areas without opportunity cost. Uncover All-new Items Path of Exile 2 features 700 equipment base types and every single one has its own unique item you can find. You can augment your arsenal with new weapons such as Spears, Crossbows and Flails, as well as supplementary items like Focuses, Traps and redesigned Sceptres. Encounter Unique Bosses In Path of Exile 2, every area of the Campaign contains a boss encounter. There's over a hundred bosses to fight as you make your way through the Acts and they all have unique mechanics to learn. Explore a New Endgame Completing the campaign is just the beginning. The endgame in Path of Exile 2 includes countless areas in different biomes, powerful crafting, challenging bosses, unique encounters and much more. Unlock new paths and explore further into the world. As you progress through the endgame, you will gain access to special passive trees that can boost the rewards of your maps and change the way the various endgame mechanics work. These trees will make your maps more rewarding but also more difficult. Path of Exile 2 introduces sequels to several leagues from Path of Exile. While their mechanics are familiar, the monsters, bosses, rewards and progression are all new. Fair-To-Play. Never Pay-To-Win. Path of Exile 2 is a separate game to the original Path of Exile. We will continue to offer expansions for both games going forward. They will never be "pay to win". Purchases are shared between the two games.

  Awaken their power with the blood of the Old God, transforming them into Godsworn under your command.

  Send the Godsworn to wage war across the world, growing stronger through slaughter and trials.

  At last, step into the Void, defeat the mighty Outer Gods, and reclaim the sealed power.

  • Six Unique Classes

  • Each class boasts an exclusive and one-of-a-kind skill system. Smartly combine skills to unleash devastating combat power.

  • Robust Gear System

  • Inheriting the essence of multiple dark fantasy games, gears of different rarities each serve a distinct purpose, enabling countless build possibilities.

  • Town Construction & Upgrade

  • Each season features unique new content with independent save files. You can embark on any seasonal journey at any time.

games.name: Pathfinder: Kingmaker — Enhanced Plus Edition
games.short_description: Pathfinder: Kingmaker - Enhanced Plus Edition is the first isometric party-based cRPG set in the Pathfinder fantasy universe. Enjoy a classic RPG experience inspired by games like Baldur's Gate, Fallout 1 and 2 and Arcanum. Explore and conquer the Stolen Lands and make them your kingdom!

descriptions.en: Pathfinder: Kingmaker - Enhanced Plus Edition is the first isometric party-based cRPG set in the Pathfinder fantasy universe. Enjoy a classic RPG experience inspired by games like Baldur's Gate, Fallout 1 and 2 and Arcanum. Explore and conquer the Stolen Lands and make them your kingdom!

detailed_descriptions.en: With the help of over 18,000 Kickstarter backers, Narrative Designer Chris Avellone and composer Inon Zur, Owlcat Games is proud to bring you the first isometric computer RPG set in the beloved Pathfinder tabletop universe. Enjoy a classic RPG experience inspired by games like Baldur's Gate, Fallout 1 and 2 and Arcanum. Explore and conquer the Stolen Lands and make them your kingdom! Based on our players' feedback and suggestions, this version of the game improves and builds upon the original. This edition includes: numerous gameplay-enriching content additions and dozens of quality-of-life features new abilities and ways to build your character, including a brand-new class new items and weaponry improved balance, especially in the beginning and last two chapters of the game enhanced kingdom management system, both in terms of balance as well as usability and player comfort increased variety of random encounters on the global map thousands of fixes and improvements made since the game's initial release Explore the Stolen Lands, a region that has been contested territory for centuries: Hundreds of kingdoms have risen and fallen in these lands, and now it is time for you to make your mark—by building your own kingdom! To do so, you’ll need to survive the harsh wilderness and the threat of rival nations… as well as threats within your own court. Customize your character with a wide range of classes and powers including specialized archetypes, powerful arcane and divine spells, choosing from a multitude of class abilities, skills, and feats. Pathfinder allows players to create heroes (or villains) that fit both their individual gameplay styles and their personalities. Meet a diverse cast of companions and NPCs, including iconic characters from the Pathfinder setting itself. You’ll need to decide who to trust and who to watch carefully, as each companion has an agenda, alignment, and goals that may differ from yours. Your journey will become their journey, and you’ll help shape their lives both in the moment and well into the future. Conquer new regions as claim them as your own, carving your kingdom from the wilderness. While classic dungeon crawling and exploration lie at the heart of this adventure, diplomacy, politics, and kingdom development are also part of the challenge. Choose your allies well, and keep them close while exploring ancient tombs and ruins — and while dealing with politics in your own court. Your kingdom is a reflection of your character and your choices throughout the game. It is a living thing shaped by your alignment, your allies, and your ability to lead your people. Not only can your kingdom expand, opening up new territories and allowing you to build new towns and communities, but your capital city will physically change based on your decisions, your policies, and even whom you choose to ally with. As your kingdom grows, a number of factions and neighboring countries will come to you to seek favor—and to test your strength. Explore - Conquer - Rule! The Pathfinder Roleplaying Game is an evolution of the 3.5 rules set of the world's oldest fantasy roleplaying game, designed by Paizo, Inc using the feedback of tens of thousands of gamers just like you. Whether you’re new to the Pathfinder® universe or you’re a seasoned veteran, Pathfinder: Kingmaker is the CRPG you’ve been waiting for.

games.short_description: Embark on a journey to a realm overrun by demons in a new epic RPG from the creators of the critically acclaimed Pathfinder: Kingmaker. Explore the nature of good and evil, learn the true cost of power, and rise as a Mythic Hero capable of deeds beyond mortal expectations.

descriptions.en: Embark on a journey to a realm overrun by demons in a new epic RPG from the creators of the critically acclaimed Pathfinder: Kingmaker. Explore the nature of good and evil, learn the true cost of power, and rise as a Mythic Hero capable of deeds beyond mortal expectations.

detailed_descriptions.en: DISCOVER THE STORY Your path will lead you to the Worldwound, where the opening of a rift to the Abyss has unleashed all-consuming terror across the land. For over a century, the neighboring nations have fought fearlessly, trying to drive the enemy back — but to little avail. Now, you have the chance to put an end to this conflict, but the path to salvation is far from clear-cut. Will you become a shining angel, backed by noble paladins? Or a powerful necromancer with hordes of immortal undead in your thrall? Or something else entirely? Lead your army and challenge mighty demon lords. Your crusade will set in motion a chain of events that will leave you — and the world itself — forever changed. PLAY YOUR HERO, YOUR WAY Create any character imaginable with the flexibility, richness, and depth of the Pathfinder First Edition ruleset. Choose from 25 classes, 12 character races, and more than a thousand spells, feats, and abilities to suit your personal playstyle. FOR EVERY CHOICE, A CONSEQUENCE Your decisions have more weight than ever before. Your goal is clear, but you must forge your own path to it. Who will die, and who will live? Who will stay, and who will go? Make your choices, and watch the world around you change. A NEW WAY TO FIGHT Enjoy two combat modes as you slay your enemies – real-time with pause or turn-based. Switch between them on the fly, so you can always take things as slowly — or as quickly — as you like. The unique Pathfinder ruleset also allows you to perform advanced combat maneuvers, like mounted combat. Use them wisely! detailed_descriptions_html.en:
DISCOVER THE STORY

Your path will lead you to the Worldwound, where the opening of a rift to the Abyss has unleashed all-consuming terror across the land. For over a century, the neighboring nations have fought fearlessly, trying to drive the enemy back — but to little avail. 

Now, you have the chance to put an end to this conflict, but the path to salvation is far from clear-cut. Will you become a shining angel, backed by noble paladins? Or a powerful necromancer with hordes of immortal undead in your thrall? Or something else entirely? Lead your army and challenge mighty demon lords. Your crusade will set in motion a chain of events that will leave you — and the world itself — forever changed.

PLAY YOUR HERO, YOUR WAY

Create any character imaginable with the flexibility, richness, and depth of the Pathfinder First Edition ruleset. Choose from 25 classes, 12 character races, and more than a thousand spells, feats, and abilities to suit your personal playstyle.

Your decisions have more weight than ever before. Your goal is clear, but you must forge your own path to it. Who will die, and who will live? Who will stay, and who will go? Make your choices, and watch the world around you change.

games.name: Patrick's Parabox
games.short_description: A mind-bending recursive puzzle game about boxes within boxes within boxes within boxes. Learn to use infinity to your advantage as you explore a deep and elegant system.

descriptions.en: A mind-bending recursive puzzle game about boxes within boxes within boxes within boxes. Learn to use infinity to your advantage as you explore a deep and elegant system.

detailed_descriptions.en: Patrick's Parabox is an award-winning puzzle game that explores a unique recursive system of boxes within boxes within boxes within boxes. Learn to manipulate the world's structure by pushing boxes into and out of each other. Wrap your head around what happens when a box contains itself, and learn to use infinity to your advantage. Explore many more mechanics and recursive twists as you delve deeper and deeper into the system. It's boxes all the way down. The game has over 350 hand-crafted puzzles, which are designed to make you think, but also to guide you and showcase the beauty of the system. Each puzzle contains a new idea; there is no filler. A soothing, inquisitive soundtrack and sound design by Priscilla Snow reflects new mechanics as they are introduced. Patrick's Parabox won the Excellence in Design award in the Independent Games Festival 2020. The game was also an IndieCade 2019 festival selection and received the IndieCade Developers Choice award.

games.name: Pax Autocratica
games.short_description: Build a grand totalitarian colony then personally storm roguelite battlefields with your soldiers. Shape citizens fears, loyalties, bonds, and feuds. Capture enemies, convert them into true believers. Sacrifice the weak. Feed the strong. Wield absolute power and make every life bend to your will.

descriptions.en: Build a grand totalitarian colony then personally storm roguelite battlefields with your soldiers. Shape citizens fears, loyalties, bonds, and feuds. Capture enemies, convert them into true believers. Sacrifice the weak. Feed the strong. Wield absolute power and make every life bend to your will.

detailed_descriptions.en: Establish the greatest regime in history in this darkly satirical colony sim and FPS roguelite hybrid. Build a prosperous totalitarian state, enforce policies, and lead your troops into first-person battles that grow from desperate skirmishes into large-scale mechanized war. Dictate wisely. Every choice shapes society, for better or worse. Mold your citizens through fear, propaganda, surveillance, punishment or rule as a benevolent leader through comfort and prosperity. While they work for the State, they may grow grateful, afraid, loyal, or quietly rebellious, until dissent becomes revolt. Venture into the fractured territories of the Tyris System to gather resources, conscript new citizens, trade with wandering merchants, and feed the growth of your colony. Fight beside your troops in roguelite FPS battles, from hostile ships to large-scale mechanized battlefields of infantry, tanks, and mechs, spreading your doctrine and eliminating threats to humanity. Weakened foes can be captured and dragged back to your base. Behind prison doors, resistance can be crushed through fear, indoctrination, execution, or conversion, until an enemy becomes a citizen, a warning to would-be rebels, or another tool of the regime. Elite enemies, bosses, and Sector Overlords flood the battlefield with bullets, lasers, missiles, drones, artillery, and overlapping projectile patterns. This is war at scale, but you are not alone. Order your troops to secure victory, or use them as expendable shields to achieve your ends. Turn a handful of survivors into a vast, tightly run, self-sustaining colony. Assign citizens to mine, gather, haul, research, and manufacture weapons, armor, food, and supplies. Watch fragile shelters become the machinery of the State. Collect roguelite cores during each expedition to grow stronger, survive longer, and push deeper into enemy territory. Weapon Cores reshape how your guns handle. Combination Cores create synergies between different core sets. Others strengthen the troops fighting beside you, or turn them into sacrificial shields for your survival. Each run becomes a shifting war machine built around you, your squad, and the chaos you unleash together. Pax Autocratica is a totalitarian colony sim and FPS roguelite hybrid that combines base building, citizen management, and first-person chaotic battlefields filled with infantry, vehicles and bullet hell. It offers a dynamic, accessible, and approachable gameplay experience for all in a sci-fi dystopian world. It’s a game about power. How it’s built, how it corrupts, and how it consumes. You will command armies, dictate laws, and witness consequences in every face that salutes you or fears you. THE STATE OBSERVES ALL How will history remember your reign? detailed_descriptions.en: PLAY PAX DEI NOW! Begin your adventure into the world of Pax Dei. Use the public crafting stations to build your first tools and gear. Explore the wilds, battle enemies for Gold and loot, and trade, or fight, with other players. Accumulate Grace to perform Miracles and claim your own Plot of land inside the game. Welcome to our world. Includes : Game access 2x Character Slots 1 Plot Token* 1 month of Premium Status** *Use Plot Tokens to claim or extend ownership of a plot of land for one month. ** +50 % Grace from Daily Login, +50 % Grace from Gold Offerings, and +50 % XP boost. YOUR GAME, YOUR CHOICE Everything essential for enjoying the world of Pax Dei is included in the Base Game. For those seeking to enhance their journey, our in-game shop offers a choice of Membership plans, unlocking VIP benefits to elevate your experience. The choice is yours. A Membership is not required to play Pax Dei. Additional fees apply. For more details, visit our official website (playpaxdei) — the link is on the right of this page. WHAT WORLD WILL YOU MAKE? Welcome to a vast, social sandbox MMO inspired by the legends of the medieval era. Here, myths are real, ghosts exist, and magic is unquestioned. In this immense, open-world playground, you choose the role you want to play. Immerse yourself along with thousands of other players as you explore the land, build your home, forge your reputation, and craft your own stories. A PLACE TO CALL HOME Travel in the relative safety of the Heartlands and find the perfect plot of land on which to build your home. Protected by the grace of the Divine, your village is a safe harbor where your Clan can grow and prosper. Everything in this world is produced by the players' hands and skills. Your village needs clothes, walls, food, flowers, and prayers. Your Clan, weapons, and armor. Others require tools, materials, or mysterious reagents. Here, you’ll battle evil beings, uncover mysteries of an ancient and wondrous past, and square off against rival Clans as you struggle for power, position, and resources. games.name: PAYDAY 3
games.short_description: PAYDAY 3 is the ultimate co-op FPS crime fantasy. Choose between stealth or loud playstyles, customize your character, and get ready to pull off the perfect heist.

descriptions.en: PAYDAY 3 is the ultimate co-op FPS crime fantasy. Choose between stealth or loud playstyles, customize your character, and get ready to pull off the perfect heist.
descriptions.zh-Hant: 《Payday 3》是究極的 FPS 犯罪幻想。無論是單打獨鬥還是多人合作，自由選擇潛行或強攻，打造致命軍火庫，完成一場完美的劫案。
descriptions.ja: 究極のFPSクライムファンタジー、『PAYDAY 3』。一人で立ち向かうもよし、協力モードでプレイするもよし。ステルスで行くか、ド派手に行くか…自分らしいアプローチを選び抜き、危険な武器をそろえて、完璧に強盗を成功させよ。
descriptions.ko: PAYDAY 3는 궁극적인 FPS 범죄 판타지 게임입니다. 혼자서 작업하거나 코옵 모드로 범죄를 꾸미세요. 스텔스 및 라우드 방식 중에서 선택하고 치명적인 무기고를 만들어 완벽한 하이스트를 행하세요.

detailed_descriptions.en: PAYDAY 3 is a 1-to-4 player FPS where you live out the ultimate heist fantasy. Tackle jobs in stealth to empty vaults without leaving a trace. Or charge in loud, fight off relentless enemies, and escape with the big score. A deep skill tree, extensive weapon selection and unlockable modifications provide near endless variety, no matter your playstyle. Put on the mask and become a legend. After years off the grid, the Payday Gang returns to unleash an epic crime wave across New York City. Join the world’s most infamous crew with your customized look, loadout and skills. In this life of crime, the only limit is your own ambition. Use cash from heists and challenges to fill your armory with powerful new weapons. Unlock specialized skills and gadgets to enhance your favorite tactics. Gotta spend money to make money! Meticulous preparation or raw violence: The choice is yours. PAYDAY gives you the tools to avoid escalation, but if the alarm goes off, the heist must go on. Cops, SWAT and Special Units will combine forces to take you out. What will your strategy be? The perfect heist demands coordination. Bots will always have your back, but nothing beats a well-organized team of players. Whether you split up or stick together, you’ll need to overcome escalating threats as one. In PAYDAY 3, your crew is your greatest weapon.
detailed_descriptions.zh-Hant: 《Payday 3》是一款支援 1 到 4 名玩家的 FPS 遊戲，讓您實現終極劫案夢想。執行潛行任務，神不知鬼不覺地搬空金庫。或是選擇正面硬幹，擊退接踵而來的敵人，帶著巨額贓款揚長而去。深奧的技能樹、多樣化的武器選擇以及可解鎖的改裝配件，為各種遊玩風格提供了近乎無限的可能性。 傳奇劫匪 戴上面具，成就傳奇。在消聲匿跡多年後，「劫薪幫」重出江湖，在紐約市掀起一場史詩般的犯罪浪潮。換上自訂外觀、裝備與技能，加入這支世界上最惡名昭彰的團隊。 屈服於貪婪 在這場犯罪生涯中，唯一的阻礙只有您的野心。利用劫案和挑戰賺取的現金，為您的軍火庫添購強大的新武器。解鎖專門技能與道具，強化您最擅長的戰術。想要有錢入袋，就得先拿錢出來！ 精準或混亂 周密的計畫或是純粹的暴力：選擇權就在您手中。《Payday》提供您控制局勢的工具，但要是警報響起，劫案仍得繼續進行。警力、特勤小組與特殊單位將聯手將您緝捕歸案。您的策略會是什麼？ 齊心協力 完美的劫案需要團隊協作。AI 隊友會隨時支援您，但沒什麼比得上組織嚴密的玩家團隊。無論是分頭行動還是併肩作戰，您都需要與夥伴同心協力應對不斷升級的威脅。在《Payday 3》中，團隊就是您最強大的武器。
detailed_descriptions.ja: 『PAYDAY 3』は1～4人で遊べるFPS。究極の強盗ファンタジーが現実に。こっそりと仕事に取り掛かり、痕跡を一切残さずに金庫の中身を奪い去れ。あるいはド派手に乗り込んで、容赦ない敵と戦い、まんまと逃走するのもまた一興。ディープなスキルツリー、広範囲にわたる武器、アンロック可能なMODで、あなたのプレイスタイルに関係なく、ほぼ無限のバラエティーを提供。 伝説的な強盗 マスクを装着して、伝説となれ。雲隠れから数年…サイコーな犯罪の波をニューヨークにもたらすべく、PAYDAY Gangが帰って来た。カスタマイズしたルック、ロードアウト、スキルで、世界最恐のクルーに仲間入り。 欲に身をゆだねろ 犯罪人生における唯一の限界は、己の野心のみ。強盗とチャレンジで得た金を使い、武器庫を強力な新作武器で埋め尽くせ。特殊スキルとガジェットをアンロックして、お気に入りの戦術を強化。金稼ぎには金が必要！ 精度か混沌か 綿密に準備するのか、むき出しの暴力で対抗するか…決めるのはあなた。PAYDAYは深刻化を回避するためのツールを与えてくれるが、警報器が鳴ったらもう後には引けない。サツ、SWAT、特殊部隊が力を合わせ、あなたを仕留めにかかるだろう。あなたはどんな戦略で挑むのか。 仲間がいてこそ 完璧な強盗作戦には連携が不可欠。ボットは間違いなくサポートしてくれる…だが、うまく連携の取れたチームに勝るものはない。別行動するにしても、チームで行動するにしても、高まりつつある脅威を一丸となって乗り越えなくてはならない。『PAYDAY 3』では、あなたのクルーこそが最大の武器。
detailed_descriptions.ko: PAYDAY 3는 1~4인 FPS 게임으로, 궁극적인 하이스트 판타지를 실현시켜 줍니다. 스텔스 방식으로 작업을 진행해 흔적을 남기지 않고 금고를 터세요. 또는, 라우드 방식으로 돌진하여 끈질긴 적들과 전투를 벌이고 크게 한 몫 챙겨 탈출하세요. 깊이 있는 스킬 트리, 방대한 무기들, 해제 가능한 부품들이 어떤 플레이 스타일에도 알맞은, 거의 끝없는 다양성을 제공해 줍니다. 전설적인 하이스터 마스크를 쓰고 전설이 되어 보세요. 잠적한 후 몇 년 뒤, 페이데이 갱이 뉴욕시에 장대한 범죄의 물결을 일으키기 위해 다시 돌아왔습니다. 세계에서 가장 악명 높은 범죄단에 합류하여 외형, 로드아웃, 스킬을 커스터마이징하세요. 욕망에 순응하다 이 범죄의 삶 속에서, 유일한 한계는 자기 자신의 야망뿐입니다. 하이스트 및 도전 과제에서 얻은 현금을 사용해 강력한 새 무기들로 무기고를 가득 채우세요. 특수 스킬 및 가젯을 해제하여 가장 마음에 드는 전술을 향상하세요. 돈을 벌기 위해선 돈을 더 써야만 합니다! 정밀함 또는 혼돈 세심하게 준비하거나, 있는 그대로 부딪히세요. 선택은 여러분의 몫입니다. PAYDAY는 상황이 악화되는 것을 피할 수 있는 도구를 제공해 줍니다. 하지만 경보가 울려도 하이스트는 계속되어야만 합니다. 경찰, SWAT, 특수 유닛이 여러분을 막기 위해 부대를 꾸립니다. 어떤 전략을 취하실 건가요? 함께일 때 더 강력한 완벽한 하이스트에는 협동이 필요합니다. 봇들이 항상 뒤를 지켜주지만, 잘 형성된 플레이어들의 팀만큼 강한 건 없습니다. 흩어지든, 함께 다니든 상관없이 성장하는 위협을 극복하려면 한 팀이 되어야만 합니다. PAYDAY 3에선, 여러분의 팀이 가장 강력한 무기입니다.

games.name: PEAK
games.short_description: PEAK is a co-op climbing game where the slightest mistake can spell your doom. Either solo or as a group of lost nature scouts, your only hope of rescue from a mysterious island is to scale the mountain at its center. Do you have what it takes to reach the PEAK?

descriptions.en: PEAK is a co-op climbing game where the slightest mistake can spell your doom. Either solo or as a group of lost nature scouts, your only hope of rescue from a mysterious island is to scale the mountain at its center. Do you have what it takes to reach the PEAK?
descriptions.zh-Hant: 《PEAK》是一款需要细致合作的登山游戏，作为流落神秘岛屿的童子军探险家，无论单人独闯抑或团队协力，你们唯一获救的希望便是登上岛中那座巍峨的山峰，自然荒野险途漫漫，稍有不慎便会大难临头。顶峰在望，你有魄力能征服它吗？
descriptions.ja: 『PEAK』は、わずかなミスが命取りになる協力登山ゲームだ。道を失った自然探検隊（ソロまたはマルチ）としてプレイ。この不思議な島から脱出するには、島の中心にある山を登るしかない。君はその山頂に到達できるだろうか？
descriptions.ko: PEAK는 작은 실수 하나가 치명적인 결과를 초래할 수 있는 협동 등반 게임입니다. 혼자서든, 길 잃은 자연 스카우트와 함께든, 신비한 섬에서 구조될 유일한 희망은 중앙에 우뚝 솟은 산을 오르는 것뿐입니다. 당신은 과연 정상에 오를 수 있을까요?

detailed_descriptions.en: PEAK is a co-op climbing game where the slightest mistake can spell your doom. Either solo or as a group of lost nature scouts, your only hope of rescue from a mysterious island is to scale the mountain at its center. Do you have what it takes to reach the PEAK? WORK TOGETHER Need a Hand? You’ll need to rely on your friends to have any hope of scaling the mountain, which changes every single day. Help each other up ledges, or place ropes and climbing spikes to make the way easier for those who come after. CLIMB The Mountain Takes no Prisoners! Climb through 4 biomes on your way to the PEAK, each with their own life-threatening obstacles. You’ll need to scavenge for questionable food to survive, and manage your injuries carefully - every setback limits your stamina, making it harder to climb. SURVIVE Prepare For the Worst: Discover a variety of helpful survival items, from energy drinks to climbing spikes to the mysterious Anti-Rope. You’ve got no hope of making it to the PEAK unless you press every advantage given to you. A NEW ISLAND EACH DAY The game's map rotates out every 24 hours! Try out the new layout each day, or give the same island multiple attempts in a day until you conquer it. EARN BADGES A Well-Seasoned Scout: Show off your survival prowess with dozens of badges to earn and cosmetics to unlock. CLIMBING IS BETTER WITH FRIENDS Multiplayer in PEAK is friends-only - invite up to three other scouts through Steam to climb together, or face the mountain alone if you're really brave! FEATURES Climb with a total of 4 friends Communicate through proximity chat 4 different biomes to ascend through A bunch of questionable foods Lots of different climbing items Campfires and marshmallows Character customization Online co-op and offline single player Ghosts
detailed_descriptions.zh-Hant: 《PEAK》是一款需要细致合作的登山游戏，作为流落神秘岛屿的童子军探险家，无论单人独闯抑或团队协力，你们唯一获救的希望便是登上岛中那座巍峨的山峰，自然荒野险途漫漫，稍有不慎便会大难临头。顶峰在望，你有魄力能征服它吗？ 团队协作 需要搭把手吗？和萍水相逢的朋友患难与共，无论是帮忙登上岩架，抑或是放置绳索岩钉为后来人开路，要想登上日日变换的高山，朋友们的援手是你唯一的依靠。 攀登 大山不讲慈悲！4 种独特的生态地貌横亘在你们前往顶峰的途中，各自有着各自的危险要命套路。寻找一切可疑的食物以求果腹，小心照料身上的伤口——任何不利因素都会限制体能，令你的攀登之途更加险阻。 生存 只做最坏打算：探索多种实用生存道具，能量饮料助你恢复体力，攀岩钢钉助你突破险境，更有神秘的反重绳索等你深挖妙用。唯有善用每一项优势，才能有望征服顶峰。 每天岛屿不重样 游戏地图每 24 小时轮换一次！每天都能体验新的场景布局，或者在一天内盯死同个岛屿重复挑战，直至挑战成功。 赢取奖章 争当老练童军：赢取酷炫外观，用各色奖章向大家证明你才是真正的生存专家！ 与友共攀乐趣多 《PEAK》的多人模式仅限好友协力——邀请至多 3 名 Steam 好友一起共攀高峰吧，若是真的够胆，独闯山巅自然未尝不可！ 本作特色 4 名好友共同攀登 近距聊天保持交流 4 种生态等待探索 各种可疑果腹食物 多种独特登山道具 围着营火烤棉花糖 可自定义个性角色 在线合作离线独闯 死了还能变成鬼魂
detailed_descriptions.ja: 『PEAK』は、わずかなミスが命取りになる協力登山ゲームだ。道を失った自然探検隊（ソロまたはマルチ）としてプレイ。この不思議な島から脱出するには、島の中心にある山を登るしかない。君はその山頂に到達できるだろうか？ 力を合わせよう 助けが必要？山は毎日姿を変え、山頂を目指すにはフレンドの力を借りる必要がある。助け合って岩棚を登り、ロープを張ったり、くさびを打ち込んで、後ろに続くフレンドが楽に進めるように工夫しよう。 山頂を目指せ 山は容赦などしてくれない！4つのバイオームを経て山頂を目指そう。各バイオームには命すら脅かす障壁が待ち受けている。生き残るためには、謎の食べ物を貪り、負傷者をいたわりつつ進まなければならない。失敗するたびにスタミナが失われ、道のりはさらに困難に。 サバイバル 多彩なサバイバルアイテムを見つけて、最悪の事態に備えておこう。エナジードリンクや、急登を進むための不思議なアンチロープなどたくさんのアイテムが君の力になる。与えられたチャンスを活かすことができなければ、山頂を見ることなどできない。 姿を変える島 マップは24時間ごとにローテーション！毎日新しい地形に挑戦したり、同じ島をクリアするまで何度も挑戦することができる。 バッジを獲得 経験豊富なスカウトになろう。さまざまなバッジを手に入れ、装飾アイテムをアンロックし、サバイバル能力を見せつけよう。 フレンドと一緒ならさらに楽しく 『PEAK』でのマルチプレイヤーはフレンドのみ可能。Steamで最大3人までスカウトを招待して一緒に登ろう。君が特大の勇気を持っているなら、1人で挑むことも可能だ！ 主な特徴 フレンドを含めた合計4人で登ろう ゲーム内チャットでコミュニケーションを取ろう 4種類のバイオームを乗り越えて進もう 謎の食べ物がたくさん登場 さまざまな登山アイテムが登場 キャンプファイアやマシュマロが登場 キャラクターのカスタマイズが可能 オンライン協力プレイとオフラインシングルプレイが可能 オバケになることも！
detailed_descriptions.ko: PEAK는 작은 실수 하나가 치명적인 결과를 초래할 수 있는 협동 등반 게임입니다. 혼자서든, 길 잃은 자연 스카우트와 함께든, 신비한 섬에서 구조될 유일한 희망은 중앙에 우뚝 솟은 산을 오르는 것뿐입니다. 당신은 과연 정상에 오를 수 있을까요? 함께 협력 도움이 필요하신가요? 플레이할 때마다 매일 달라지는 산을 오르려면 친구들의 도움이 필요합니다. 서로 암벽 위로 끌어올리거나 밧줄과 등반 스파이크를 설치해, 뒤따라오는 동료들이 더 쉽게 오를 수 있도록 도와주세요. 등반 산은 자비를 베풀지 않습니다! 정상에 오르려면 서로 다른 4개의 생태계를 통과해야 하며, 구역마다 치명적인 장애물이 기다리고 있습니다. 살아남으려면 의심스러운 음식도 주워 먹어야 하고, 부상도 신중히 관리해야 합니다. 작은 실수 하나가 스태미나를 제한해 등반을 점점 더 어렵게 만듭니다. 생존 최악의 상황에 대비하세요. 에너지 드링크, 등반 스파이크, 신비한 반전 밧줄 등 다양한 생존 아이템을 발견할 수 있습니다. 주어진 모든 이점을 최대한 활용하지 않으면 정상에 오를 수 없습니다. 매일 새로운 섬 게임의 맵은 24시간마다 바뀝니다! 매일 새로운 지형에 도전하거나, 하루 동안 같은 섬에 여러 번 도전해서 정복해 보세요. 배지 획득 다양한 배지를 획득하고 꾸미기 아이템을 잠금 해제해, 노련한 스카우트답게 생존 능력을 뽐내 보세요. 친구와 함께 더 즐거운 등반 PEAK의 멀티 플레이는 친구 전용입니다. Steam에서 최대 3명의 스카우트를 초대해 함께 등반하거나, 무서울 게 없는 분이라면 혼자서 산에 도전해 보세요! 특징 최대 3명의 친구와 함께 등반 근접 음성 채팅 지원 서로 다른 4가지 생태계 여러 가지 의심스러운 음식 다양한 등반 아이템 모닥불과 마시멜로 캐릭터 커스터마이징 온라인 협동 및 오프라인 싱글 플레이 유령

games.name: Pegfinity
games.short_description: Launch balls, hit pegs, make numbers go wild. A short pachinko-inspired physics incremental about chaotic upgrades, combos, and ridiculous score-chasing chaos!

descriptions.en: Launch balls, hit pegs, make numbers go wild. A short pachinko-inspired physics incremental about chaotic upgrades, combos, and ridiculous score-chasing chaos!

detailed_descriptions.en: What if one ball could break the entire board? Pegfinity is a colorful, pachinko-inspired physics-based incremental where a single shot can spiral into massive chain reactions, exploding scores, and absurd combos. Launch balls, hit pegs, unlock chaotic upgrades, and turn a simple board into a ridiculous score-chasing machine. You are always one lucky bounce away from your biggest run yet. Between runs, unlock upgrades that push every shot further and make the board more chaotic. Stack multipliers with the Hypemeter Fill the board with explosive, electric, and gold pegs Unlock gadgets that cheat physics: lasers, portals, a gumball machine, even a pinball bumper Launch special balls that shatter, zap, spray watermelon juice, or disco the whole screen Discover pegs that steal the run: chickens, UFOs, mirrors, clowns, and an atomic bomb that hits everything Chase bigger combos, bigger payouts, and bigger score spikes With over 150 upgrades to discover, every run gives you new ways to bend the board in your favor. Every board is randomly generated. Every upgrade sticks. The game keeps handing you new ways to break it. From simple bounces to ridiculous chaos End with a board filled with effects, combos, and massive score spikes. Each run escalates: More hits Bigger numbers More unpredictable outcomes You’re always one lucky bounce away from your biggest run yet. A Satisfying Progression Loop Every hit is a small dopamine boost. Every run builds toward something bigger. Short sessions turn into long ones. You launch one ball… Then another… Then one more to try something new… And suddenly, everything clicks. Permanent Power-Ups Grow stronger over time with upgrades that carry across runs: Multipliers Stronger pegs Bigger payouts Game-changing boosts Each run feeds into the next. Inspired by a 150-year-old game Pegfinity is inspired by a handcrafted pachinko-style board passed down through generations. A simple idea, rebuilt into something faster, bigger, and far more chaotic. Over 150 upgrades Unlock unique pegs, balls, slots and cool gadgets Random generated board - Each run is something new! Permanent unlockable Power Ups! And of course some biiiiiiiiiiig numbers! See you in Pegfinity!

games.name: PengPong
games.short_description: PengPong is a bullet-hell roguelike where pinball meets gambling. Bounce your way through chaos and bet it all to survive.

descriptions.en: PengPong is a bullet-hell roguelike where pinball meets gambling. Bounce your way through chaos and bet it all to survive.

detailed_descriptions.en: PengPong is a bullet-hell roguelike where your only hope for survival is to bounce weapons, items, and... well, pretty much anything that moves. Remember: if it’s not bouncing, you’re doing it wrong. Bounce hard, bounce well, and don’t stop. Key Features: Survive the Chaos: Master an endless array of character and weapon combinations to be the last penguin standing. Physics is Your Weapon: Forget direct hits; momentum and angles are everything. Bounce hockey pucks, guns (yes, you throw them), earphones (this one too), and even pufferfish! If it doesn’t hit them the first time, just keep bouncing it until it does. High Stakes, High Rewards: Every wave ends with a choice. Will you sign a brutal contract, go all-in at the gambling den, or play it safe at the shop? The choice is yours. Infinite Synergy: With over 300+ items , every run creates a unique whirlwind of possibilities and chaotic variables. Rise to the Top: Compete with players worldwide and prove your skills on the global leaderboard. Cute but Creepy: Immerse yourself in a world inspired by vintage animation; where "adorable" meets "disturbing." Hit the jackpot in our gambling mini-games and watch the difficulty melt away! But don’t get us wrong, PengPong isn’t a gambling simulator. It’s just a friendly, neighbourhood bullet-hell roguelike starring a very cute penguin, and its even cuter friends. Mostly.

games.name: Pentiment
games.short_description: Step into a living illustrated world in a time when Europe is at a crossroads of great religious and political change. Walk in the footsteps of Andreas Maler, a master artist who finds himself in the middle of murders, scandals, and intrigue in the Bavarian Alps.

descriptions.en: Step into a living illustrated world in a time when Europe is at a crossroads of great religious and political change. Walk in the footsteps of Andreas Maler, a master artist who finds himself in the middle of murders, scandals, and intrigue in the Bavarian Alps.

detailed_descriptions.en: From Obsidian, this game is a historical narrative-driven game focusing on character development, heavily stylized art, and choice-driven storytelling in early 16th century Bavaria. Players will play as Andreas Maler, a clever illustrator caught up in a series of murders in Tassing and Kiersau Abbey over the course of twenty five years. Players will be responsible for conducting their own investigation to decide the fate of the community, but each decision will have lasting consequences and inexorably draws Andreas closer to the center of an underlying conspiracy. Illustrated world Experience 16th century Europe as the master artists of the time saw them. Art inspired by great illuminated manuscripts and the earliest printed books becomes a living, breathing world in Pentiment. Uncover mysteries Choose different academic and social backgrounds and meet a colorful cast of characters as you discover the stories and secrets that lie within the small Bavarian town of Tassing and nearby Keirsau Abbey. Impact a changing world In an era of great religious and political change, each decision you make can have a profound impact on the community’s future. Find your own way through this turbulent time and see the consequences of your choices play out over generations.

games.name: Perfect Heist 2
games.short_description: Perfect Heist 2 is a round-based online game, where robbers try to hide in plain sight while robbing a bank without being noticed by the cop team!

descriptions.en: Perfect Heist 2 is a round-based online game, where robbers try to hide in plain sight while robbing a bank without being noticed by the cop team!

detailed_descriptions.en: In this game, one robber team tries to steal money and other goods from a bank while trying not to get noticed by the cop team . The cops have a big advantage in fighting, so keeping a low profile and blending in with the crowd is critical for the robbers. Wait for the perfect moment to knock out one of the employees to use his clothes as a disguise while sneaking, drilling, bombing, or hacking your way to the loot ! There are 32 completely different classes to choose from, with different abilities, weapon loadouts, and passive perks. All guns of the first part are included in this game, as well as lots of exciting new weapons like a rocket launcher, different types of grenade launchers, and much more for a total of over 20 unique weapons! Every aspect of the game got reworked from the ground up, with much smoother gunplay , greatly improved net code , more user-friendly UI, and exciting new classes and gameplay aspects like destructible walls. Due to third-person mode allowing for players to look around walls in a stealth-based game, the first-person mode was a big focus in development, with refined weapon animations and smooth movement, but a third-person mode is also included as a server setting! There will also be a level system , unlockable cosmetics , and a level editor with Steam Workshop integration , so you can create your own maps or play on community-made maps which complement the five included maps, with three being completely new, and one being a reworked and polished map from the first part. There will also be more official maps and custom map contests in the future!

games.name: Peripeteia
games.short_description: You are Marie, a cyborg mercenary dropped into the rot of a post-Soviet city of corruption and opportunity. Shoot, sneak, hack, climb or talk your way through alt-history cyberpunk Poland in an immersive sim where every problem has multiple solutions and every rooftop is reachable.

descriptions.en: You are Marie, a cyborg mercenary dropped into the rot of a post-Soviet city of corruption and opportunity. Shoot, sneak, hack, climb or talk your way through alt-history cyberpunk Poland in an immersive sim where every problem has multiple solutions and every rooftop is reachable.

detailed_descriptions.en: Peripeteia is a cyberpunk immersive sim set in alternate-history Poland – a first-and-third-person game mixing shooter, stealth and RPG mechanics with an unexplored setting and original ideas. You are Marie: a cybernetic mercenary in a post-Soviet city full of corruption and opportunity, where nations, factions and ideologies clash. You will use your wits, tact, and raw violent nature to complete tasks shrouded in conspiracy and mystery. Logic, skill and ruthless cunning win the day in an interactive world – but when that fails, a loaded gun and the ability to climb virtually anywhere, will suffice. EXPLORE A CITY THAT GOES DEEPER THAN YOU THINK Levels so vast they take hours to explore. Every tower, sewer, rooftop and basement is real and reachable. No quest markers. No correct path. If you can see a ledge, Marie can grab it. Forge your own routes with a sabre jammed into a wall or a well-placed crate. Get lost. Find something no one else found. That's the point. ARM YOURSELF Over 100 weapons – Cold War surplus, prototype rarities, stolen NATO hardware. Every magazine, every bullet, every attachment exists as a physical object in your inventory. Strip enemy weapons for parts. Transfer your gear between missions. Build your stash in Marie's basement. Plan your loadout or improvise when everything goes wrong. EVERY PROBLEM HAS MULTIPLE SOLUTIONS Hack terminals. Possess enemies. Manipulate factions against each other. Sneak through the vents, talk your way past the guards, or come in loud with a stolen PKM. Every mission is a sandbox. Your choices determine who lives, who dies, and whose flag flies over the city. SURVIVE Marie is living military surplus – powerful but not invincible. Manage your implants, ration your energy, scavenge what you can. The city doesn't care about you. Its factions will use you and discard you. LOSE YOURSELF IN THE EASTERN NIGHT An unforgettable soundtrack featuring Sewerslvt, Ed Harrison (Neotokyo, Deus Ex: Mankind Divided) and a dozen other amazing artists. Drum and bass, atmospheric ambience, breakcore. Post-Soviet brutalism rendered in the grit of the early 2000s with modern lighting. Rain on concrete. Every second of this city sounds and looks exactly as dark as it should. An immersive sim for people who think the genre never got the sequel it deserved.

games.name: Persona 3 Portable
games.short_description: If I say there’s an hour “hidden” between one day and the next... would you believe me? Master the power of the heart, Persona, and uncover the tragic truth of the Dark Hour.

descriptions.en: If I say there’s an hour “hidden” between one day and the next... would you believe me? Master the power of the heart, Persona, and uncover the tragic truth of the Dark Hour.

detailed_descriptions.en: Experience the iconic, critically acclaimed RPG that reinvented the Persona series, Persona 3 Portable, now newly remastered for modern platforms. Shortly after transferring to Gekkoukan High School, the protagonist encounters the "Dark Hour." Unfamiliar stillness swallows the city, people turn into eerie coffins, and otherworldly monsters called Shadows swarm. When they are attacked by one of these Shadows, and all hope seems lost, the power of the heart, their Persona is awakened. With this newfound power, they pursue the truth of the Dark Hour and face the destiny that awaits them. Key Features include: Enjoy Persona 3 Portable now with newly remastered graphics, improved smoothness in gameplay, and quality of life features, including difficulty selection and quick save functionality Climb the looming tower of Tartarus, take down powerful Shadows, and investigate the mysteries of the Dark Hour Live through a full school year packed with daily events as you forge precious bonds with unforgettable characters Experience this dark, emotional journey through two distinct protagonists’ perspectives for twice the social possibilities Choose between Japanese and English VO

games.short_description: Phantom Brigade 2.0 is a cinematic, tactical mech strategy game with a revolutionary timeline-based command system. See the future, predict enemy actions, and plot your counterattack on the timeline! Recruit and level up your squad of rebels to retake war-torn Fyrland from the Kaskad occupation.

descriptions.en: Phantom Brigade 2.0 is a cinematic, tactical mech strategy game with a revolutionary timeline-based command system. See the future, predict enemy actions, and plot your counterattack on the timeline! Recruit and level up your squad of rebels to retake war-torn Fyrland from the Kaskad occupation.

detailed_descriptions.en: The free, major update, Phantom Brigade 2.0, is now available! The 2.0 update is extensive, transforming nearly every aspect of the game, but the highlights include: Fully realized pilots – Recruit pilots with over 100 unique pilot traits and abilities which allow for in-depth buildcrafting and synergies with your mechs. With a new recruitment and class specialization system, expansive leveling with varied progression trees, combined with new visual customisation options, you can build your own flavor of deadly (and stylish) ace pilots. A reworked campaign – New maps, new quests, and new combat scenarios along with fully rebalanced factions ensure you face varied squads with different equipment, armour and unit configurations. You have even more reason to collect new equipment and experiment with different loadouts to take on these new threats. Completely reimagined overworld – Explore new provinces, varied landscapes and overhauled campaign systems. New liberation and overworld mechanics, new points of interest and events, new province modifiers and improved mission generation provide a varied, constantly evolving environment to encourage players to adapt and overcome. A HUGE amount of community driven quality of life updates – New salvage and debriefing menus, new mission previews and reward generation, reworked workshop and crafting, improved damage logic and prediction, new options and difficulty settings, comprehensive weapon balancing, subsystem reworks and much more! Phantom Brigade is a cinematic, tactical mech strategy game with an innovative timeline-based command system. See the future, predict enemy actions, and plot your counterattack on the timeline! Recruit and level up your squad of rebels to retake war-torn Fyrland from the Kaskad occupation. KEY FEATURES: Cinematic spin on the turn-based genre – Predict enemy movements, orchestrate precisely timed countermeasures, and hit “execute” to watch the physics-based action unfold in real time. Extensive customization – Featuring a rich customization system, Phantom Brigade enables you to fine-tune the performance of your mechs, install a wide selection of equipment, and access a wealth of cosmetic options. Prepare your squad for any challenge - in style. An expansive arsenal – Railguns, beam weapons, missiles, energy swords, and more! Rain destruction down upon your homeland’s invaders with weaponry salvaged from each enemy mech you defeat. Strategic tactical combat – Make high-level tactical decisions on the world map, manage your mobile base, and decide how to apply your limited resources. Take command of your squad in varied missions ranging from sabotage of enemy equipment and convoy ambushes to liberation battles and challenging outpost onslaughts. Destructible environments – It's not a proper game about giant mechs without destructible buildings! Phantom Brigade allows every square meter of each battle map to be destroyed. Shatter your enemy’s cover and collapse buildings on top of them!

detailed_descriptions.en: A web of swirling conspiracies. A whirlwind of bullets. Amidst it all, a poignant tale of a boy and a girl unfolds... The neo-noir visual novel Phantom PHANTOM OF INFERNO, originally released in 2000 as Nitroplus's (now NITRO ORIGIN) first title, is now on Steam! The Steam port is available in three languages: Japanese, English and Simplified Chinese. *Voiceover is only available in Japanese. ■ Story A string of assassinations targeting mafia leaders rocks the criminal underworld, giving rise to rumors of a mysterious organization known as Inferno and its deadliest assassin, Phantom. While on a solo trip to the United States, a teenage boy finds himself face-to-face with this so-called Phantom—only to discover that she's a girl roughly his own age. Stripped of his memories, the boy is taken in by Phantom and trained in the art of killing. As he learns, he grows into an assassin capable of standing alongside her, and is gradually drawn into the organization's conspiracies. In this ruthless, lawless world, what will become of the two young assassins...? ■ Characters Zwei (Reiji Azuma) Voiced by: Irino Miyu Ein/Phantom Voiced by: Takagaki Ayahi Claudia McCunnen Voiced by: Hisakawa Aya Cal Devens Voiced by: Sawashiro Miyuki Mio Fujieda Voiced by: Koshimizu Ami Scythe Master Voiced by: Chiba Isshin Lizzie Garland Voiced by: Watanabe Akeno Raymond McGuire Voiced by: Chiba Susumu Isaac Wisemel Voiced by: Ishikawa Hideo ■ Game Details ▼About Phantom PHANTOM OF INFERNO A Japanese tourist visiting the United States is kidnapped by a criminal organization and trained to become an assassin. A string of assassinations targeting mafia leaders rocks the criminal underworld, giving rise to rumors of a mysterious organization known as Inferno and its deadliest assassin, Phantom.

Stripped of his memories, the boy is taken in by Phantom and trained in the art of killing. As he learns, he grows into an assassin capable of standing alongside her, and is gradually drawn into the organization's conspiracies.
In this ruthless, lawless world, what will become of the two young assassins...?

games.short_description: Phasmophobia is a 4 player online co-op psychological horror. Paranormal activity is on the rise and it’s up to you and your team to use all the ghost-hunting equipment at your disposal in order to gather as much evidence as you can.

descriptions.en: Phasmophobia is a 4 player online co-op psychological horror. Paranormal activity is on the rise and it’s up to you and your team to use all the ghost-hunting equipment at your disposal in order to gather as much evidence as you can.

detailed_descriptions.en: Phasmophobia is a 4-player, online co-op, psychological horror game. You and your team of paranormal investigators will enter haunted locations filled with paranormal activity and try to gather as much evidence as you can. Use your ghost-hunting equipment to find and record evidence to sell on to a ghost removal team. Immersive Experience: Realistic graphics and sounds as well as a minimal user interface ensure a totally immersive experience that will keep you on your toes. Unique Ghosts: Identify over 20 different ghost types, each with unique traits, personalities, and abilities to make each investigation feel different from the last. Equipment: Use well-known ghost-hunting equipment such as EMF Readers, Spirit Boxes, Thermometers, and Night Vision Cameras to find clues and gather as much paranormal evidence as you can. Find Cursed Possessions that grant information or abilities in exchange for your sanity. Full Voice Recognition: The Ghosts are listening! Use your actual voice to interact with the Ghosts through Ouija Boards and EVP Sessions using a Spirit Box. Locations: Choose from over 10 different haunted locations, each with unique twists, hiding spots, and layouts. Game Modes: With 5 default difficulties and hand crafted weekly challenges, there are plenty of ways to test your skills. games.name: Phonopolis
games.short_description: Phonopolis is a story-driven puzzle adventure set in a hand-painted 3D world made of cardboard. Solve a wide variety of playful puzzles and help Felix end the Leader's oppressive influence in a resonant dystopian city inspired by avant-garde art.

descriptions.en: Phonopolis is a story-driven puzzle adventure set in a hand-painted 3D world made of cardboard. Solve a wide variety of playful puzzles and help Felix end the Leader's oppressive influence in a resonant dystopian city inspired by avant-garde art.

detailed_descriptions.en: Welcome to Phonopolis , a new puzzle adventure hand-crafted by Amanita Design, the indie collective behind Machinarium, Creaks, Samorost and more. Cardboard Dystopia In the dystopian city of Phonopolis, life is orchestrated by omnipresent loudspeakers that dictate every aspect of people’s existence. Citizens, bound by the authoritarian Leader's commands, work in unison to achieve his grand vision. Soon, the Absolute Tone—a tone so strong that it would strip every citizen of their humanity forever—will be heard… By coincidence or perhaps by fate, young dustman Felix becomes the only person to consciously recognize the threat. Now, he must try to stop the Leader from indefinitely making every citizen a mindless servant. Loosely inspired by the works of Karel Čapek and George Orwell, the story of Phonopolis explores themes of social manipulation and individualism, but keeps the overall experience playful and light-hearted. Play With The City With Felix becoming immune to the commands, you’ll be able to take advantage of the loudspeakers and use them to solve puzzles involving other characters. Other times, you will interact with the cardboard environment in surprising, often unexpected ways—turn walls, shuffle floors, control various machinery or tear paper curtains. Each puzzle is carefully integrated into the world and presents a different challenge. Old Meets New Metaphorically referring to the utopian, totalitarian model of society, Phonopolis is a city built of actual cardboard. Capturing the nostalgic charm of classic stop-motion films, every piece of any building, every character, and every frame of any smoke or flame is hand-painted on a piece of paper, then digitized for use in the game’s 3D world. The art style is strongly influenced by avant-garde artistic trends of the interwar period such as constructivism, futurism, and suprematism, and their societal impact as a tool of propaganda. The distinct visuals come to life with music from Tomáš Dvořák aka Floex, composer of soundtracks for Machinarium and Samorost 3. Story-driven adventure game set in the dystopian city of Phonopolis Hand-painted 3D world made of cardboard Traditional 12 FPS animation reminiscent of classic stop-motion films Wide variety of puzzles integrated into the paper-built setting Music by Tomáš Dvořák aka Floex (Samorost 3, Machinarium)

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Welcome to Phonopolis, a new puzzle adventure hand-crafted by Amanita Design, the indie collective behind Machinarium, Creaks, Samorost and more.

Cardboard Dystopia

In the dystopian city of Phonopolis, life is orchestrated by omnipresent loudspeakers that dictate every aspect of people’s existence. Citizens, bound by the authoritarian Leader's commands, work in unison to achieve his grand vision. Soon, the Absolute Tone—a tone so strong that it would strip every citizen of their humanity forever—will be heard…

By coincidence or perhaps by fate, young dustman Felix becomes the only person to consciously recognize the threat. Now, he must try to stop the Leader from indefinitely making every citizen a mindless servant. Loosely inspired by the works of Karel Čapek and George Orwell, the story of Phonopolis explores themes of social manipulation and individualism, but keeps the overall experience playful and light-hearted.

Play With The City

With Felix becoming immune to the commands, you’ll be able to take advantage of the loudspeakers and use them to solve puzzles involving other characters. Other times, you will interact with the cardboard environment in surprising, often unexpected ways—turn walls, shuffle floors, control various machinery or tear paper curtains. Each puzzle is carefully integrated into the world and presents a different challenge.

Old Meets New

Metaphorically referring to the utopian, totalitarian model of society, Phonopolis is a city built of actual cardboard. Capturing the nostalgic charm of classic stop-motion films, every piece of any building, every character, and every frame of any smoke or flame is hand-painted on a piece of paper, then digitized for use in the game’s 3D world.

The art style is strongly influenced by avant-garde artistic trends of the interwar period such as constructivism, futurism, and suprematism, and their societal impact as a tool of propaganda. The distinct visuals come to life with music from Tomáš Dvořák aka Floex, composer of soundtracks for Machinarium and Samorost 3.

  • Story-driven adventure game set in the dystopian city of Phonopolis

  • Hand-painted 3D world made of cardboard

  • Traditional 12 FPS animation reminiscent of classic stop-motion films

  • Wide variety of puzzles integrated into the paper-built setting

  • Music by Tomáš Dvořák aka Floex (Samorost 3, Machinarium)

games.short_description: The only game in the world that's more anticipated than GTA VI. Pih 2 is a one-hit-kill comedy FPS. Fight various types of enemy pihs and bosses in increasingly ridiculous situations, dodge instant death and try not to rage when everything goes wrong.

descriptions.en: The only game in the world that's more anticipated than GTA VI. Pih 2 is a one-hit-kill comedy FPS. Fight various types of enemy pihs and bosses in increasingly ridiculous situations, dodge instant death and try not to rage when everything goes wrong.

detailed_descriptions.en: The most anticipated game of the century is finally here! Pih 2 is a one-hit-kill comedy FPS. ONE HIT KILLS YOU. ONE HIT KILLS THE PIHS. Learn every enemy, retry instantly, and turn each humiliating death into revenge. THE GOAL: collect all the items in each level while the pihs try to end your life. There's some angry hawgs coming for you. Ever heard of a 🐊 Pihgator? 🦈 Shark-Hawg? 🦝 Hogoon? What about a 🦅 Birdhawg? There's some weird boats and hot air balloons you might need to use in some levels. Are they easy to drive? No. Will you crash them into things? Constantly. The first "Pih" game gave people nightmares where all they hear is "YOU GOT HAMMED". Now it's time for Pih 2 to make you dream about being "BACONATED". Are you ready ?

games.name: Pillars of Eternity
games.short_description: Prepare to be enchanted by a world where the choices you make and the paths you choose shape your destiny. Obsidian Entertainment, the developer of Fallout: New Vegas™ and South Park: The Stick of Truth™, together with Paradox Interactive is proud to present Pillars of Eternity.

descriptions.en: Prepare to be enchanted by a world where the choices you make and the paths you choose shape your destiny. Obsidian Entertainment, the developer of Fallout: New Vegas™ and South Park: The Stick of Truth™, together with Paradox Interactive is proud to present Pillars of Eternity.

detailed_descriptions.en: Prepare to be enchanted by a world where the choices you make and the paths you choose shape your destiny. Obsidian Entertainment, the developer of Fallout: New Vegas™ and South Park: The Stick of Truth™, together with Paradox Interactive is proud to present Pillars of Eternity. Recapture the deep sense of exploration, the joy of a pulsating adventure, and the thrill of leading your own band of companions across a new fantasy realm and into the depths of monster-infested dungeons in search of lost treasures and ancient mysteries. So gather your party, venture forth, and embrace adventure as you delve into a realm of wonder, nostalgia, and the excitement of classic RPGs with Obsidian’s Pillars of Eternity! Play as Any One of Six Races Human, Aumaua, Dwarf, Elf, Godlike and Orlan. Utilize Five Core Skills to Overcome Any Situation Stealth, Athletics, Lore, Mechanics and Survival. Deep Character Customization Build a character as one of eleven classes such as Barbarian, Chanter, Cipher, Druid, Fighter, Monk, Paladin, Priest, Ranger, Rogue and Wizard. Sculpt Your Own Story Side with various factions using a reputation system, where your actions and choices have far-reaching consequences. Explore a Rich and Diverse World Beautiful pre-rendered environments laced with an engaging story and characters bring the world to life. Play Your Way Choose to play with either real-time with pause or turn based mode. You can swap between the two freely during your adventure, giving you full control over every encounter.

So gather your party, venture forth, and embrace adventure as you delve into a realm of wonder, nostalgia, and the excitement of classic RPGs with Obsidian’s Pillars of Eternity!

Human, Aumaua, Dwarf, Elf, Godlike and Orlan.

Stealth, Athletics, Lore, Mechanics and Survival.

Explore a Rich and Diverse World

Beautiful pre-rendered environments laced with an engaging story and characters bring the world to life.

Choose to play with either real-time with pause or turn based mode. You can swap between the two freely during your adventure, giving you full control over every encounter.

games.name: Pioneers of Pagonia
games.short_description: Rebuild hope in a world that was lost in the fog. Lead your Pioneers across the isles of Pagonia, unite scattered tribes, raise thriving communities and discover the history of your people as you reclaim your world in the new story campaign.

descriptions.en: Rebuild hope in a world that was lost in the fog. Lead your Pioneers across the isles of Pagonia, unite scattered tribes, raise thriving communities and discover the history of your people as you reclaim your world in the new story campaign.

detailed_descriptions.en: REBUILDING, HOPE AND CONNECTION As a brave Pioneer you lead your people through a world that was devoured by fog—a world made up of countless islands, in which hope, craftsmanship and community must rise again. Establish settlements, discover lost tribes, unfold new technologies and face the dangers that lie in wait within the fog. Experience the story campaign : You are a navigator in search of the Tower of Visions—the heart of a fragmented world. THE STORY CAMPAIGN A people, cloaked in fog. One mission: Restore hope. The catastrophe saw Pagonia fractured into countless isles. As the navigator, you are chosen to dispel the fog and reunite the world. Journey from island to island, meet unique factions, face dangerous enemies and find out what really happened. Every island promises new adventures and discoveries. Every success is vital for the fate of the world. Play the complete campaign with unique missions and meet a wide range of story characters Discover new factions, artifacts and legends Confront the Hollowed —boss enemies that seem to be born from the fog itself Find the Tower of Visions , symbol of Pagonia’s unity BUILD UP YOUR WORLD Construct a thriving economy with more than 60 building types and more than 100 commodities. Every production step is visible—from Forester to Weaponsmith. Watch as thousands of Pagonians simultaneously work, trade and live, bringing your world to life. Visualized production chains and flow of goods Dynamic logistics with roads, transport routes and bottlenecks Comprehensive simulation of the economy—no simplification, no abstraction EXPLORE AND CONNECT Explore procedurally generated islands with different landscapes, tribes and challenges. Befriend other factions and unite them through actions and trade. Scattered tribes with individual needs Trade and fulfill quests to form alliances Mysterious locations that are hidden in the fog DANGERS AND ADVENTURES Not every encounter is peaceful: Bandits, ruthless Scavs und mythical beings threaten your settlement. Your strength lies not in battle, but in strategy and preparation. Fight tactically with your troops Strengthen your economy to secure your defenses Decrypt artifacts that influence the powers of the fog STRONGER TOGETHER – SHARED CO-OP Experience Pioneers of Pagonia in shared co-op for up to 4 players. Build, plan and raise a settlement together. Everyone can trade, construct buildings or manage resources at the same time—you create your world together. Shared faction, joint responsibility Multiplayer save games, seamless switching between single player and multiplayer Perfect for creative teamwork PAGONIA EDITOR – CREATE YOUR OWN MAPS Use the integrated Pagonia Editor to shape your own islands, adventures and challenges. Create maps, share them with the community and explore how an idea turns into a world: Pagonia grows through you—island by island. »Every island holds a story. Every Pioneer — hope.« FEATURES STORY CAMPAIGN — Experience the story of a brave navigator and rebuild the hope in a broken world. FLOURISHING ECONOMY — Up to 3000 Pagonians, more than 60 building types, more than 100 commodities—everything simulated, everything visible. PROCEDURAL ISLANDS — Endless possibilities with fully generated landscapes and distinct villages, factions and objectives. CHALLENGES — Face enemies, discover treasures, resources and hidden artifacts that alter the world’s equilibrium. SHARED CO-OP — Build a settlement together with up to 4 friends. MAP EDITOR & COMMUNITY — Create and share your own worlds—become one of the Builders of Pagonia. JOIN US ON DISCORD Join our growing community on Discord and become part of the movement that builds, expands and changes Pagonia.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
REBUILDING, HOPE AND CONNECTION

As a brave Pioneer you lead your people through a world that was devoured by fog—a world made up of countless islands, in which hope, craftsmanship and community must rise again. Establish settlements, discover lost tribes, unfold new technologies and face the dangers that lie in wait within the fog. Experience the story campaign: You are a navigator in search of the Tower of Visions—the heart of a fragmented world.

THE STORY CAMPAIGN

A people, cloaked in fog. One mission: Restore hope.

The catastrophe saw Pagonia fractured into countless isles. As the navigator, you are chosen to dispel the fog and reunite the world. Journey from island to island, meet unique factions, face dangerous enemies and find out what really happened.

Every island promises new adventures and discoveries.
Every success is vital for the fate of the world.

  • Play the complete campaign with unique missions and meet a wide range of story characters

  • Discover new factions, artifacts and legends

  • Confront the Hollowed—boss enemies that seem to be born from the fog itself

  • Find the Tower of Visions, symbol of Pagonia’s unity

BUILD UP YOUR WORLD

Construct a thriving economy with more than 60 building types and more than 100 commodities. Every production step is visible—from Forester to Weaponsmith. Watch as thousands of Pagonians simultaneously work, trade and live, bringing your world to life.

  • Visualized production chains and flow of goods

  • Dynamic logistics with roads, transport routes and bottlenecks

  • Comprehensive simulation of the economy—no simplification, no abstraction

EXPLORE AND CONNECT

Explore procedurally generated islands with different landscapes, tribes and challenges. Befriend other factions and unite them through actions and trade.

  • Scattered tribes with individual needs

  • Trade and fulfill quests to form alliances

  • Mysterious locations that are hidden in the fog

DANGERS AND ADVENTURES

Not every encounter is peaceful: Bandits, ruthless Scavs und mythical beings threaten your settlement.

Your strength lies not in battle, but in strategy and preparation.

  • Fight tactically with your troops

  • Strengthen your economy to secure your defenses

  • Decrypt artifacts that influence the powers of the fog

STRONGER TOGETHER – SHARED CO-OP

Experience Pioneers of Pagonia in shared co-op for up to 4 players. Build, plan and raise a settlement together. Everyone can trade, construct buildings or manage resources at the same time—you create your world together.

  • Shared faction, joint responsibility

  • Multiplayer save games, seamless switching between single player and multiplayer

  • Perfect for creative teamwork

PAGONIA EDITOR – CREATE YOUR OWN MAPS

Use the integrated Pagonia Editor to shape your own islands, adventures and challenges. Create maps, share them with the community and explore how an idea turns into a world: Pagonia grows through you—island by island.

»Every island holds a story. Every Pioneer — hope.«

FEATURES

  • STORY CAMPAIGN — Experience the story of a brave navigator and rebuild the hope in a broken world.

  • FLOURISHING ECONOMY — Up to 3000 Pagonians, more than 60 building types, more than 100 commodities—everything simulated, everything visible.

  • PROCEDURAL ISLANDS — Endless possibilities with fully generated landscapes and distinct villages, factions and objectives.

  • CHALLENGES — Face enemies, discover treasures, resources and hidden artifacts that alter the world’s equilibrium.

  • SHARED CO-OP — Build a settlement together with up to 4 friends.

  • MAP EDITOR & COMMUNITY — Create and share your own worlds—become one of the Builders of Pagonia.

JOIN US ON DISCORD

Join our growing community on Discord and become part of the movement that builds, expands and changes Pagonia.
