games.name: SkyShard: City Battler
games.short_description: City Building Auto Battler! Build your kingdom with powerful weapons, walls, houses, and endless synergies, then battle other players in asynchronous multiplayer, or overcome various solo challenges.

descriptions.en: City Building Auto Battler! Build your kingdom with powerful weapons, walls, houses, and endless synergies, then battle other players in asynchronous multiplayer, or overcome various solo challenges.

detailed_descriptions.en: Wizards are waging war among the skies to conquer a shattered world. Lay claim to your skyshard and build a city full of magical buildings and enchanted weapons! Building and Battling SkyShard is a fantasy city-building auto-battler where you’ll need to outsmart your opponents by assembling the most powerful city you can. It will take a combination of careful resource management and planning to acquire the right buildings for your town, along with clever positioning of your buildings to unlock surprising and potent effects. As your town grows, other players will attack with their own skyshards, and you’ll need to survive 16 rounds to win. Sometimes they’ll surprise you with a humbling defeat, but that’s the best way to learn! With asynchronous PVP , there’s absolutely no time pressure. You can take as long as you like to arrange your city perfectly. Only the wisest wizards can achieve a perfect victory or climb the leaderboard and achieve the rank of Archmage! Endless Buildings and Synergies In the world of SkyShard, you’ll encounter buildings from a variety of factions , each with their own special abilities, and embracing them all can give you a big advantage. The Tinker faction uses gnomish technology to make buildings operate at peak efficiency , but it can definitely backfire. Magic harnesses explosive powers that can deal lots of damage to entire neighborhoods. Nature is all about gaining health and staying alive, even against the most aggressive enemies. You’ll encounter even more factions with 170+ unique buildings that have diverse and formidable effects to discover. Truly Independent We made SkyShard to be a game that puts players first. We’re two meager strategy-gaming YouTubers, ItsBen321 and RegisKillbin, who got tired of games always making decisions that were focused on monetization and forced engagement So we decided to put our money and time where our mouths are, and make our own game! We might make some mistakes along the way, this is our first game after all, but we’ll always be around on YouTube and Twitch, listening to players, and working to make the game better and keeping players updated on our thoughts, plans, challenges, and triumphs. Now you get out there and build an amazing city, while we go and build an awesome game!

Wizards are waging war among the skies to conquer a shattered world. Lay claim to your skyshard and build a city full of magical buildings and enchanted weapons!

Building and Battling

SkyShard is a fantasy city-building auto-battler where you’ll need to outsmart your opponents by assembling the most powerful city you can. It will take a combination of careful resource management and planning to acquire the right buildings for your town, along with clever positioning of your buildings to unlock surprising and potent effects.

As your town grows, other players will attack with their own skyshards, and you’ll need to survive 16 rounds to win. Sometimes they’ll surprise you with a humbling defeat, but that’s the best way to learn! With asynchronous PVP, there’s absolutely no time pressure. You can take as long as you like to arrange your city perfectly. 

Only the wisest wizards can achieve a perfect victory or climb the leaderboard and achieve the rank of Archmage!

Endless Buildings and Synergies

In the world of SkyShard, you’ll encounter buildings from a variety of factions, each with their own special abilities, and embracing them all can give you a big advantage.

  • The Tinker faction uses gnomish technology to make buildings operate at peak efficiency, but it can definitely backfire.

  • Magic harnesses explosive powers that can deal lots of damage to entire neighborhoods. 

  • Nature is all about gaining health and staying alive, even against the most aggressive enemies. 

You’ll encounter even more factions with 170+ unique buildings that have diverse and formidable effects to discover. 

Truly Independent

We made SkyShard to be a game that puts players first. We’re two meager strategy-gaming YouTubers, ItsBen321 and RegisKillbin, who got tired of games always making decisions that were focused on monetization and forced engagement

So we decided to put our money and time where our mouths are, and make our own game!

We might make some mistakes along the way, this is our first game after all, but we’ll always be around on YouTube and Twitch, listening to players, and working to make the game better and keeping players updated on our thoughts, plans, challenges, and triumphs.

Now you get out there and build an amazing city, while we go and build an awesome game!

detailed_descriptions.en: When the drinks stop flowing and the city store's closing its doors, who are you gonna call to save the day? Come roll with our crew of laid-back slackers, ready to turn chaos into glory, and possibly not into a disaster!!! Welcome in the wonderful and crazy world of Slackers! Race solo or with your friends in one of the most reckless downhill rides ever! Discover and master the unpredictable and unique movements of a shopping cart , find your shortcuts, collecting drinks along the way to satisfy your thirst, unlock all 16 shopping carts and push yourself to crazy speeds across 32 different tracks to reach the store before it closes! Skateboards? No, shopping carts! The new Freestyle mode is here to remind you that everything a skateboard can do… a shopping cart does worse. But with much more style. Trace your line, use every ramp and rail, perform trick after trick and rack up points. Each cap collected increases the multiplier: more risks, more style, more glory! KEY CONCEPTS Downhill Time Attack - Live the dream of racing on a shopping cart at insane speed (without risks) - If you're afraid to go alone, play with 3 friends online - Collect drinks along the way to recharge your stamina - The store is closing, better hurry! Just do it in style (more or less). THINGS TO REMEMBER ONCE YOU'RE IN THE CART: - First of all: I'ts not a car. - The cart has no brakes. (deal with it) - The cart has no engine. (push and sweat to move). - The cart has no seatbelts. (we all know how it's going to end) - The cart has no steering wheel (good luck in taming the beast) - Last but not least: IT'S NOT A CAR. games.short_description: You're here to slay the princess. Don't believe her lies.

descriptions.en: You're here to slay the princess. Don't believe her lies.
descriptions.zh-Hant: 你的任務是屠殺公主，不要相信她的謊言。
descriptions.ja: 君はプリンセスを倒すためにここにいる。彼女の嘘を信じてはならない。

detailed_descriptions.en: You're on a path in the woods, and at the end of that path is a cabin. And in the basement of that cabin is a Princess. You're here to slay her. If you don't, it will be the end of the world. She will do everything in her power to stop you. She'll charm, and she'll lie, and she'll promise you the world, and if you let her, she'll kill you a dozen times over. You can't let that happen. Don't forget, the fate of the world rests on your shoulders. You're not going to listen to him, are you? We're supposed to save princesses, not slay them... Features Fully voice-acted by the impeccable Jonathan Sims and Nichole Goodnight. Hand-penciled art - every background and sprite is drawn traditionally with pencil and paper by Ignatz-winning graphic novelist Abby Howard. A princess. She's very bad and you have to get rid of her for all our sakes. No, the Princess isn't a “cosmic horror,” whatever that is supposed to mean. She's just an ordinary human Princess , and you can definitely slay her as long as you put your mind to it. Don't even think about trying to romance her. It won't end well for you. Hopefully you won't die. But if you do, you'll die a lot. Be careful and stay focused on the task at hand! A branching narrative where what you say and what you believe determines both who you are and how the story unfolds. Though I wouldn’t recommend taking any paths outside of the one I lay before you. A new roleplaying experience from the creators of Scarlet Hollow. Slay the Princess is a choice-driven psychological horror visual novel/dating sim with dramatic branching, light RPG elements, and hand-penciled art. What’s in the Pristine Cut? 3 brand new chapters replete with mysteries—and consequences. Expansions to familiar routes. The Den, The Apotheosis and The Fury each have each more than doubled in length. Over 35% more content overall—and all of it filled with great opportunities to listen to me and do your job. A new ending. And hopefully one that saves the world rather than damns it. Track Your Progress: Cherish your memories, relive your exploits, and uncover deeply hidden secrets with the new gallery feature. Over 1,200 New Hand-Penciled Frames hand-illustrated by Abby Howard. Over 2,500 New Lines of Dialogue fully voiced dialogue by the impeccable Jonathan Sims and Nichole Goodnight.
detailed_descriptions.zh-Hant: 你在森林裡的一條小徑，這條小徑的盡頭有一間木屋，而小木屋的地窖有一位公主。 你的任務是屠殺公主。如果你不殺她，世界就會滅亡。 公主會竭盡所能阻止你殺她。她會大展魅力、說謊，或許下無法實現的諾言。如果相信她，你會一再死在她手裡。你不能讓她得逞。 你「在乎」世界的命運吧？ 遊戲特色： 全程由不二人選Jonathan Sims和Nichole Goodnight獻聲配音。 手繪風格：所有背景、角色均是伊格納茲獎得主的圖像小說家Abby Howard，以傳統的紙和鉛筆繪製。 公主十分邪惡，所以你要為世人除掉她。 不，公主與「宇宙恐佈」無關，天曉得這個詞是什麼意思。她只是凡人公主，只要你有心殺她，絕對可以得手。 千萬不要妄想和她談戀愛，不會有好下場的。 希望你不要死，但只要起了個頭，你就會死個不停。請多加小心，並專心執行眼前的任務！ 採用分支劇情設計，玩家選擇的對話，及相信的事物會決定扮演角色的本性和劇情發展，但我不建議你選擇預想之外的路徑。 《再見公主》是選擇導向的驚悚視覺小說暨約會模擬遊戲，提供高潮迭起的分支劇情、少許RPG元素與手繪視覺風格。 原始剪輯版內容： 你真的想知道？如果是，或許你會發現有些遊戲最好是直接體驗。 不騙你，回頭是岸。你不會希望提早被劇透。 ... 噢，你還在看？嗯唔，既然你這麼堅持，恐怕無法遏止你的好奇心了。而且最好由我說明，免得你弄錯內容，是吧？ 3個全新章節，充滿謎題和各種結局。 想必你從未見過公主會二話不說要了你的小命吧。 充實玩家熟悉的路線。「巢穴」、「神化」、「怒火」長度增加了不止一倍。 整體內容增加35%以上，並且全程可以聽我鼓吹你完成任務。 全新結局。希望有結局能拯救世界，而不是毀滅世界。 追蹤進度：透過新的資源庫功能，珍藏記憶、重溫冒險事蹟，或揭開深藏的祕密。 超過1,200張Abby Howard親手繪製的圖稿。 超過2,500條由不二人選Jonathan Sims和Nichole Goodnight完整配音的對話台詞。 沒錯，請做好心理準備，踏上更充實的旅程，途中充滿新的危機、艱難的選擇和難忘的境遇。你會堅守屠殺公主的路徑，或你的命運會因新章節改變？如果你真在乎世界的命運，答案已不言而喻。
detailed_descriptions.ja: 君は森の中の小道にいる。その小道の先には小屋がある。小屋の地下室にはプリンセスがいる。 君は彼女を倒すためにここにいる。そうしなければ、世界は終焉を迎えるだろう。 プリンセスを倒しに来た君を、彼女はあらゆる手段を使って阻止してくるだろう。魅力を振りまいたり、嘘をついたり、デタラメな約束をしたりするだろう。そして隙を見せれば、何度でも君を殺す。そんなことをさせてはならない。 君は、世界の運命が心配だろ？ ゲームの特徴： フルボイス展開：声優のJonathan Sims氏とNichole Goodnight氏が声を担当している（音声は英語）。 鉛筆画のイラスト：すべての背景やキャラクターは、イグナッツ賞を受賞したグラフィック·ノベル作家、Abby Howard氏によって描かれている。鉛筆と紙を使った古き良きアナログアートだ。 プリンセス：彼女はとても危険な存在であり、我々全員のために排除しなくてはならない。 いいや、それは正しくない。プリンセスは”宇宙的恐怖”のようなものではない。彼女は人間であり、普通のプリンセスだ。君が本気でやれば、間違いなく彼女を倒すことができる。 間違っても恋心など抱いてはならない。君にとって良い結果にならないだろう。 君に死んでほしくない。だが、もしそうなれば、君は何度も死ぬだろう。気を抜かず、目の前の任務に集中するように！ 君が何を話し、何を信じるかによって、君自身の姿や物語の展開が変わっていく分岐型のストーリー展開。ただし、私が用意した小道以外は進まないほうが身のためだ。 「Slay the Princess ――プリンセスを倒せ」は、選択型の心理ホラービジュアルノベル／恋愛ゲーム。ドラマチックな分岐シナリオや軽いRPG要素、鉛筆画のイラストが特徴。 「プリスティン·カット」には何が含まれるかって？ 本当にそれを知っていいのか？ それだと、直接体験する醍醐味を失う可能性があるが... 悪いことは言わない。これ以上は読まないほうがいい。 … ん？ まだ読んでいるのか!? 好奇心には逆らえないってことだな。そこまで言うなら、私から説明するのが一番だろう。間違った情報を得られても困るし。 さまざまなミステリーと結果が用意された新しい3つのチャプター。 これまでに見たことのないプリンセスたちが、何の迷いもなく襲いかかる！ 「穴倉の乙女」、「神格の乙女」、「憤激の乙女」など既存のチャプターが、それぞれ2倍以上に拡張。 全体で約35%のボリュームアップになる。つまり、私の話をゆっくり聞いて、君の使命を果たすのに最適なお膳立てが完成したというわけだ。 新たな結末も追加。願わくば世界を滅ぼすのではなく、救う結末があればいいが。 進捗状況の確認：新しいギャラリー機能で、思い出を振り返り、過去の冒険を追体験し、隠された秘密を暴こう。 Abby Howard氏による、1,200以上の新しい手描きの静止画を追加。 2,500以上の新しいセリフを追加。もちろん、声優のJonathan Sims氏とNichole Goodnight氏によってフルボイス化されている（音声は英語）。 新たな危険や難しい選択、衝撃の出会いに満ちた旅が再び始まる。そのまま、プリンセスを倒す道を進み続けるのか、あるいは新チャプターによって違う運命をたどるのか。世界の運命が心配なら、答えは明らかだろう。
detailed_descriptions.ko: 당신은 숲길을 걷고 있습니다. 그 숲길의 끝에는 오두막이 있습니다. 그리고 오두막 지하실에는 공주가 있습니다. 당신은 공주를 처치해야 합니다. 당신이 공주를 처치하지 않으면 세상은 종말을 맞이합니다. 공주는 당신을 막기 위해서라면 무슨 짓이든 할 겁니다. 당신을 유혹하고, 속이려 들 겁니다. 세상을 주겠다는 약속도 서슴지 않고 난발할 것입니다. 그리고 속는 순간, 공주는 당신의 목숨을 수십 번이고 앗아갈 것입니다. 있어선 안 될 일이죠. 설마 세상의 운명에 **무관심**한 건 아니겠지요? 특징 완벽한 더빙 - 흠잡을 데 없이 완벽한 조너선 심즈와 니콜 굿나잇의 열연을 감상해 보세요. 직접 그린 아트 - 모든 배경과 스프라이트는 이그나츠 상 수상에 빛나는 그래픽 노블 작가 애비 하워드가 연필과 종이로 손수 그렸습니다. 공주. 공주는 끔찍한 악인이며, 수단과 방법을 가리지 말고 제거해야 합니다. 아니요. 애초에 무슨 소린지도 모르겠지만 공주는 '코스믹 호러'가 아닙니다. 평범한 인간 공주에 지나지 않습니다. 당신이 마음만 먹으면 얼마든지 처치할 수 있습니다. 공주와의 연애 같은 건 꿈도 꾸지 마세요. 끝이 절대 좋지 않을 테니까요. 웬만해서는 죽지 않기를 기원하겠습니다. 그런데 만에 하나 죽게 된다면, 정말 셀 수 없이 죽게 됩니다. 경계를 늦추지 마세요. 오직 임무에만 집중하세요. 이 끝없이 뻗어나가는 내러티브에서는 당신의 말과 행동이 곧 당신을 정의하며, 이야기의 향후 전개를 결정합니다. 다만 제가 정해드린 경로를 벗어나는 건 그리 권장하고 싶지 않군요. Slay the Princess는 극적인 분기와 가벼운 RPG 요소, 손수 그린 아트가 가미된 선택 기반 심리적 공포 비주얼 노벨/연애 시뮬레이션입니다. Pristine Cut에 포함된 콘텐츠 정말 알고 싶으신가요? 직접 경험해야 진정한 묘미를 느낄 수 있는 것들을 알아버리게 될 텐데요. 돌아가세요. 그냥 하는 말이 아닙니다. 지금 알 만한 것들이 아니거든요. … 뭐예요, 아직도 읽고 있나요? 흠. 이렇게나 고집을 부리시는 걸 보면 무슨 말로도 당신의 호기심을 꺾을 순 없을 거 같네요. 하긴 엉뚱한 제삼자한테 들을 바에야 제가 말씀드리는 게 나을 듯합니다. 아니, 혹시라도 오해가 생기면 서로 곤란해질 수도 있으니까요. 풍성한 수수께끼와 결말을 갖춘 3개의 새로운 장. 일말의 망설임 없이 당신의 목숨을 노릴 완전히 새로운 공주들. 기존 루트의 확장. 굴, 신격화, 분노 장은 이전보다 2배 이상 분량이 증가했습니다. 전체적인 콘텐츠 분량 35% 증가. 제 말을 귀담아듣고 임무를 완수할 기회를 꾹꾹 눌러 담았답니다. 새로운 결말. 세상을 나락으로 몰아넣는 게 아니라 구원하는 결말이면 좋겠네요. 공주의 흔적 추적: 새로운 갤러리 기능을 통해 소중한 기억을 간직하고, 업적을 다시 경험하고, 깊이 숨겨진 비밀을 파헤치세요. 애비 하워드가 손수 그린 1,200종 이상의 새로운 연필화 일러스트. 흠잡을 데 없이 완벽한 조너선 심즈와 니콜 굿나잇의 열연이 돋보이는 2,500줄 이상의 새로운 음성 대화 더빙. 자, 이 정도입니다. 새로운 위험과 까다로운 선택, 잊지 못할 만남으로 한층 더 풍성해진 모험을 떠날 준비를 해보세요. 길을 그대로 따라가 공주를 처치하시겠습니까, 아니면 새로운 장에서 달라진 운명을 맞이하시겠습니까? 세상의 운명을 신경 쓰는 분이라면 당연히 정답을 아시리라 믿어 의심치 않습니다.

games.name: Slay the Spire
games.short_description: We fused card games and roguelikes together to make the best single player deckbuilder we could. Craft a unique deck, encounter bizarre creatures, discover relics of immense power, and Slay the Spire!

descriptions.en: We fused card games and roguelikes together to make the best single player deckbuilder we could. Craft a unique deck, encounter bizarre creatures, discover relics of immense power, and Slay the Spire!

detailed_descriptions.en: We fused card games and roguelikes together to make the best single player deckbuilder we could. Craft a unique deck, encounter bizarre creatures, discover relics of immense power, and Slay the Spire! Features Dynamic Deck Building : Choose your cards wisely! Discover hundreds of cards to add to your deck with each attempt at climbing the Spire. Select cards that work together to efficiently dispatch foes and reach the top. An Ever-changing Spire : Whenever you embark on a journey up the Spire, the layout differs each time. Choose a risky or safe path, face different enemies, choose different cards, discover different relics, and even fight different bosses! Powerful Relics to Discover : Powerful items known as relics can be found throughout the Spire. The effects of these relics can greatly enhance your deck through powerful interactions. But beware, obtaining a relic may cost you more than just gold... Slay the Spire left Early Access and comes with: Four characters that each have their own unique set of cards. 350+ fully implemented cards. 200+ different items to be found. 50+ unique combat encounters. 50+ mysterious events that can help or harm you. Daily Climbs allow you to compare yourself with every other player in the world. Custom mode that allows mixing and matching various crazy run modifiers.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
We fused card games and roguelikes together to make the best single player deckbuilder we could. Craft a unique deck, encounter bizarre creatures, discover relics of immense power, and Slay the Spire!

Features

  • Dynamic Deck Building: Choose your cards wisely! Discover hundreds of cards to add to your deck with each attempt at climbing the Spire. Select cards that work together to efficiently dispatch foes and reach the top.
  • An Ever-changing Spire: Whenever you embark on a journey up the Spire, the layout differs each time. Choose a risky or safe path, face different enemies, choose different cards, discover different relics, and even fight different bosses!
  • Powerful Relics to Discover: Powerful items known as relics can be found throughout the Spire. The effects of these relics can greatly enhance your deck through powerful interactions. But beware, obtaining a relic may cost you more than just gold...

Slay the Spire left Early Access and comes with:

  • Four characters that each have their own unique set of cards.
  • 350+ fully implemented cards.
  • 200+ different items to be found.
  • 50+ unique combat encounters.
  • 50+ mysterious events that can help or harm you.
  • Daily Climbs allow you to compare yourself with every other player in the world.
  • Custom mode that allows mixing and matching various crazy run modifiers.

games.short_description: Build your battle-top and become King of the Streets! Collect 60+ parts, Merge their Powers, and Dominate opponents in this Chill Roguelite! Skate around a vibrant Y2K city, winning Cash and Upgrades on your way to the top. And if you Die in the game, you Die in real life.

descriptions.en: Build your battle-top and become King of the Streets! Collect 60+ parts, Merge their Powers, and Dominate opponents in this Chill Roguelite! Skate around a vibrant Y2K city, winning Cash and Upgrades on your way to the top. And if you Die in the game, you Die in real life.

detailed_descriptions.en: Slay the day away in a run-based battle-tops game from the creator of Nanomon Virtual Pet, Kardboard Kings, and Desert Child. Battle your 'blade with SUPREMELY SATISFYING controls! THEN, Spend the Cash you won to buy NEW PARTS! AND THEN, Find INSANE combos with all the parts you Unlock! Features Build your Slayblade Battle your Slayblade Bet your lunch money on your Slayblade Collect over 60+ parts for your Slayblade Break the law with your Slayblade Visit a miniature PS1 city with your Slayblade Save the city from a rich loser with your Slayblade ✅ What Slayblade IS: A snappy experience: Colourful lo-fi visuals, simple/satisfying battles, and fun customization. Intuitive gameplay mechanics: The whole game can be played with a Mouse and left-click. 2000s vibes: Battling 'blades on the street corner, hand-drawn character art, and amazing music! Lots of replay value: Over 60+ Blade Parts to collect, and Loads more Unlockables. ❌ What Slayblade is NOT: No big story mode, just a brief intro+Outro cutscene. Not a multiplayer game. If you read this far, and you leave a Steam review, somehow use the word " Crumpet ". People will be so confused.

Slay the day away in a run-based battle-tops game from the creator of Nanomon Virtual Pet, Kardboard Kings, and Desert Child. 

Battle your 'blade with SUPREMELY SATISFYING controls!

THEN, Spend the Cash you won to buy NEW PARTS!

AND THEN, Find INSANE combos with all the parts you Unlock!

Features

  • Build your Slayblade

  • Battle your Slayblade

  • Bet your lunch money on your Slayblade

  • Collect over 60+ parts for your Slayblade

  • Break the law with your Slayblade

  • Visit a miniature PS1 city with your Slayblade

  • Save the city from a rich loser with your Slayblade

✅ What Slayblade IS:

  • A snappy experience: Colourful lo-fi visuals, simple/satisfying battles, and fun customization.

  • Intuitive gameplay mechanics: The whole game can be played with a Mouse and left-click.

  • 2000s vibes: Battling 'blades on the street corner, hand-drawn character art, and amazing music!

❌ What Slayblade is NOT:

  • No big story mode, just a brief intro+Outro cutscene.

  • Not a multiplayer game.

    If you read this far, and you leave a Steam review, somehow use the word "Crumpet". People will be so confused.

games.name: Sledding Game
games.short_description: A game about sledding and hanging out with friends :)

descriptions.en: A game about sledding and hanging out with friends :)

detailed_descriptions.en: Sledding Game is a multiplayer snowsports hangout game with proximity chat. Go sledding, relax and see what else there is to do. There’s also ragdoll physics so the crashes look terrible really really good. HANG OUT Use proximity voice chat to talk to your friends, or express your feelings by repeatedly crashing into each other. SLED FAST, SLED STUPID Compete to see who can reach the bottom first or get the most points through gnarly tricks, building your own ramps and launching off them. Or you can just sled around and explore, up to you. DO OTHER STUFF Break up the sledding with side activities and minigames, like snowball fights, snowmen making, darts, curling, roasting smores, drinking hot chocolate in the cozy cabin, and more. LOOKIN’ GOOD Choose from a range of fully customizable animal characters and expressions. Earn points to spend on cool cosmetics for your bod and your sled. detailed_descriptions.en: Welcome to the Far, Far Range! Slime Rancher is a charming, first-person, sandbox experience. games.name: Slip & Skid
games.short_description: Race against your friends and alter the track by placing obstacles after each lap. Change the rules mid-game with roguelike modifiers. Shove your opponents off the track, drift, boost and jump. Up to 4 players online and local split-screen.

descriptions.en: Race against your friends and alter the track by placing obstacles after each lap. Change the rules mid-game with roguelike modifiers. Shove your opponents off the track, drift, boost and jump. Up to 4 players online and local split-screen.

detailed_descriptions.en: Slip & Skid through countless obstacles placed by your friends in this physic-based multiplayer racing game! Slip & Skid combines precision driving and methodical planning to create your path to victory. Up to four players can compete. It's up to you to alter the track and create the secrets that will make you finish first: Race, then earn points based on your finishing position. Choose from what the game will offer: a game modifier, an obstacle, a surface change, a trap, etc. Then place it wherever you want. Repeat until a player reaches the required score. To win, they must finish first in the next round . The other players must do everything they can to prevent it: finish before them or team up to destroy them. MAKE EVERY ROUND UNIQUE It's up to you to decide: ruin your opponents' lives, or make your own easier. Choose and place obstacles in between racing rounds, ranging from simple objects to complex animated weapons. Each object can be precisely placed to make it a devastating trap or a narrow shortcut. Simple yet advanced tools for quick and accurate obstacle placement in three dimensions, using a controller or a keyboard and mouse. Several obstacles allow you to transform the surface of the track and objects: asphalt, ice, dirt, mud, concrete, magma, and sand. The environment, scenery and music change during the game depending on the surfaces that make up the track. DRIVE FULL SPEED Will you show honor by trusting your driving skills? Aerial control allowing flips, rolls, and driving on walls. Cars behave differently depending on the surfaces they drive on. Do you prefer more radical methods? Push your friends off the track and into traps with arcade-style, physics-based driving: drifts, accelerations, jumps, flips and more. Use obstacles and their various effects to create insane shortcuts. Driving altered by various modifiers : increasing reverse speed, adding bonuses when doing a flip, etc. Track disrupted by various modifiers : swap the start and finish lines, transform all surfaces, etc. CONTENT A wide selection of tracks, many obstacles and modifiers to choose from. Customize your vehicle with accessories, designs, and paints that you can unlock throughout the game and in different game modes. Game statistics: obstacles placed, and content unlocked. SINGLE PLAYER Time trial mode with a ghost to beat on each track, unlocking an accessory. WITH FRIENDS Editable rules. Up to 4 players online and/or locally in split screen.

games.name: Slots & Daggers

names.ja: スロット＆ダガー | Slots & Daggers

games.short_description: A retro mini-roguelike inside a slot machine. Steady your blade - and spin!

descriptions.en: A retro mini-roguelike inside a slot machine. Steady your blade - and spin!
descriptions.zh-Hant: 这是一款融合复古风格与迷你肉鸽玩法的老虎机游戏。握紧匕首——开始旋转轮盘吧！
descriptions.ja: スロットマシンの中に広がるレトロなミニ・ローグライク。剣を構えて、スピン！
descriptions.ko: 슬롯 머신 안에 레트로 미니 로그라이크 게임을 담았습니다. 칼날을 조준하고, 스핀하세요!

detailed_descriptions.en: Steady your blade - and spin! After my last game SUMMERHOUSE, I wanted to make something radically different. Still small, but faster, with numbers, fights and goblins! The result is SLOTS & DAGGERS, a strange little blend of slot machine and fantasy RPG. To make this game I combined a lot of things I deeply love – weird fantasy worlds, crude drawings of strange little guys, old school crunchy hiphop drum machines and addictive arcade games that go “PLING PLING PLING” as they spit out little coins – with classic roguelike mechanics. The features of this game are: Fun slot machine Weird fantasy world 4-8 hour campaign Crude drawings of strange little guys Retro visuals Crunchy hip hop drum machines ‘Egg arena’ high score mode for the truly determined Addictive arcade gameplay that goes “pling” a lot Numbers! Fights! Goblins! As with SUMMERHOUSE, please keep in mind this game is a solo project - small, focused, and made with care. It’s meant to be short and sweet and doesn’t have the amount of content as games built by bigger teams over years, but I think it’s a fair deal! I hope you have a good time with SLOTS & DAGGERS <3 Cheers, Friedemann
detailed_descriptions.zh-Hant: 握紧匕首—— 开始旋转轮盘吧！ 继推出上部作品《夏日筑梦》之后，我想尝试些截然不同的创作。游戏依旧是小体量作品，但节奏更快，还加入了属性值、战斗机制和地精元素！ 最终，这款结合老虎机玩法和奇幻元素的RPG游戏《命运转轮》诞生了。 为了制作这款游戏，我将众多自己超爱的元素与经典的肉鸽玩法揉合在一起，比如怪诞的奇幻世界、粗犷画风塑造的奇特小角色、带感的老派嘻哈电子鼓，还有那种会“叮铃叮铃叮铃”吐出小硬币的上头街机游戏。 本游戏特色内容如下： 趣味老虎机 怪诞的奇幻世界 4-8小时游戏内容 粗犷画风塑造的奇特小角色 复古视觉风格 带感的嘻哈电子鼓 供硬核玩家挑战的“蛋人竞技场”高分模式，让玩家体验“叮叮当当”停不下来的街机玩法 属性值！战斗！地精！ 请记住，和《夏日筑梦》一样，本作也是我的个人独立作品——体量虽小，却始终聚焦核心玩法，每处都经过精心打磨。游戏在设计上追求“短而精”，自然无法与大型团队多年打造的作品相比，但我认为这是不错的选择！ 希望各位在《命运转轮》中玩得尽兴 <3 祝好， 弗里德曼
detailed_descriptions.ja: 剣を構えて、 スピン！ 前作『Summerhouse』のあと、今度はまったく違うものを作りたいと思った。小規模だけどテンポが速く、数字と、戦いと、ゴブリンが登場する作品を！ その結果生まれたのが、スロットマシンとファンタジーRPGを奇妙に融合させた小さなゲーム『Slots & Daggers』です。 この作品には、私が愛してやまない要素を数多く詰め込みました。奇妙なファンタジー世界、ゆるいタッチのおかしなキャラたち、オールドスクールのザラついた質感のヒップホップ・ドラムマシン、そして「チャリンチャリン」と音を立ててコインを吐き出すアーケードゲーム。そこにクラシックなローグライクの仕組みを掛け合わせました。 本作の主な特徴： 楽しいスロットマシン 奇妙なファンタジー世界 約4〜8時間のプレイボリューム ゆるいタッチのおかしなキャラクター レトロなビジュアル オールドスクールのザラついた質感のヒップホップ・ドラムマシン やり込みたいプレイヤー向けの「エッグアリーナ」ハイスコアモード 「チャリン！」が止まらない中毒性あるアーケードゲーム性 数字！バトル！ゴブリン！ 前作『Summerhouse』と同様に、本作は私が一人で制作した作品です。小規模だけど、集中し、心を込めて作りました。大規模チームが何年もかけて作るほどのボリュームはありませんが、短くも素敵な作品に仕上がっており、十分に楽しんでいただけると思います！ 『Slots & Daggers』で、素敵な時間を過ごしていただけることを願って！ ではまた。 Friedemann
detailed_descriptions.ko: 칼날을 조준하고, 스핀하세요 ! 이전작인 SUMMERHOUSE 이후, 저는 완전히 다른 게임을 만들고 싶었습니다. 여전히 작지만 더 빠르고, 숫자와 싸움, 고블린이 등장하는 게임을요! 그래서 나온 것이 슬롯 머신과 판타지 RPG를 기발하게 버무린 슬롯 앤 대거입니다. 이 게임을 만들기 위해 저는 이상한 판타지 세계, 이상한 아이들의 조잡한 그림, 구식 크런치 힙합 드럼 머신, 작은 동전을 뱉어내며 "짤랑"거리는 중독성 있는 아케이드 게임 등, 제가 좋아하는 많은 것들을 클래식 로그라이크 메커니즘과 결합했습니다. 이 게임의 특징: 재미있는 슬롯 머신 이상한 판타지 세계 4-8시간 분량의 콘텐츠 이상한 아이들의 조잡한 그림 레트로 비주얼 크런치 힙합 드럼 머신 게임에 진심인 플레이어를 위한 "에그 아레나" 고득점 모드 계속해서 "짤랑"거리는 중독성 있는 아케이드 게임 플레이 숫자! 싸움! 고블린! SUMMERHOUSE와 마찬가지로 이 게임도 1인 프로젝트라는 점을 기억해 주세요. 작지만 진심을 담아 만들었습니다. 짧고 간결하고, 대규모 팀이 몇 년에 걸쳐 만든 게임만큼 콘텐츠의 양이 많지는 않지만, 이 정도면 괜찮다고 생각합니다! 슬롯 앤 대거와 함께 즐거운 시간 보내셨으면 합니다 <3 감사합니다 Friedemann

games.name: Slots & Diapers
games.short_description: Absurd incremental game where you turn even liquid assets into financial glory! Spin for jackpots and hire veteran gamblers to automate the madness. Use permanent upgrades and 'mishaps' to accelerate your progress! Simple. Messy. Addictive.

descriptions.en: Absurd incremental game where you turn even liquid assets into financial glory! Spin for jackpots and hire veteran gamblers to automate the madness. Use permanent upgrades and 'mishaps' to accelerate your progress! Simple. Messy. Addictive.

detailed_descriptions.en: Welcome to the most absurd incremental clicker game! In Slots & Diapers , you manage a casino where veteran gamblers dedicated to the spin. It’s not about luck, it’s about scaling your empire and turning every 'accident' into a calculated financial victory. Start with a classic machine and upgrade to high-velocity, industrial-grade slot machines. Every new tier brings bigger multipliers and faster cycles. Invest in better hardware to turn every single spin into a financial landslide. Why spin yourself when you can hire the pros? Recruit a crew of veteran seniors to automate the grind. They don’t need breaks; they just need a seat and a fresh 'under-layer' of protection. Let your crew handle the clicking while you watch the numbers go up! In this economy, everything is a resource. Your machines and seniors don't just pay out cash, they generate Liquid Assets . Don't let it go to waste! Trade your collected 'crapto-currencies' to activate powerful, limited-time boosters that supercharge your earnings! The rarest payout of all. Hit the elusive Mega Jackpot on any machine to extract RAM (Retired Adult Memories) . While cash and liquid assets keep the casino moving, RAM is the high-value data required for true evolution. The cycle of success never ends. Reset your current casino to trigger a Reboot . By closing your casino, you can spend your harvested RAM on a massive Perma-Skill Tree . Lose your machines, keep your power, and build your next empire faster, stronger, and filthier than before. Take your Liquid Assets to a specialized slot machine built directly inside your terminal. Risk your Assets for a chance to win all sorts of game-changing prizes and multipliers. Overhaul your entire financial empire according to your taste. Alter the look of your senior gamblers and change your casino floor to match your exact style. Is everything really as it seems? Look closely beneath the flashing lights and roaring jackpots. There is something deeper hidden behind the reels, waiting to be uncovered by those who keep playing. Track and rank your Liquid Asset holdings against players worldwide. Climb the global leaderboard, flex your wealth, and secure your spot at the absolute top of the financial food chain. Don’t miss out the most absurd 'incremental' game release; wishlist today.

games.name: Slow Roads
games.short_description: Zone out on an endless drive through infinite scenic landscapes. Generate a unique world, set the scene to suit your mood, and just drive...

descriptions.en: Zone out on an endless drive through infinite scenic landscapes. Generate a unique world, set the scene to suit your mood, and just drive...

detailed_descriptions.en: Slow Roads is a casual driving game designed to capture the zen of a long drive on a scenic road. Zone out as you coast along lifelike roads that wind endlessly through procedurally-generated landscapes, with configurable locations, road styles, seasons, weather, and vehicles. Generate a unique world, throw on some music, and just drive. Endless driving zen Simply chase the horizon through endless, ever-unique landscapes, with no objectives, challenges, or distractions. Disconnect from stress while you roll through valleys, fields, forests, and coastlines at your own pace. Infinitely-generated scenic roads A novel procedural engine generates the landscapes and roads organically, meaning every stretch of road is unique and non-repeating. Choose your preferred style, from casual to winding corners, wide or narrow, and paved or off-road. World generation is seeded, allowing you to revisit any especially nice road you find. Settings for location, season, weather, and time-of-day Select a location and instantly switch between scene styles to suit your mood, with options for sun, cloud, snow, and time-of-day. Locations are based on real places - roll through the hills of the Peak District, coast along the California shore, or rove Off-World if you really need an escape. Choose the vehicle that suits your style "Driving zen" means different things to different people, whether that's cruising in the coupe , rallying in the hatch , or kissing each apex with the sports car . Maybe take the coach for a slow tour, or try hitting the perfect lean into every corner with the bike. Vehicle customisation and tuning Optionally customise your vehicle's style and tuning, with controls over colours, wheels, plates, engines, handling, and more. Any vehicle's engine can be electric or combustion, with the latter having options for manual or automatic transmission. Casual or sim-style driving Configure the gameplay to your own comforts with controls for steer assist, camera pose, traffic, and more. You can even let the car drive for you, with options for automatic steering, automatic speed control, or full autodrive. The cockpit view can be configured for sim-style driving, with support for controllers and wheels* *Please note that force feedback is not currently supported by the engine, but is planned for a near-term content update. Check out the demo to verify your device's compatibility. Just drive... Slow Roads is designed for minimalist gameplay, with a lightweight engine that is hyper-optimised for endless, real-time environment generation - less so for crash physics or stunts. Take it slow, stay on the road, and let the simplicity of a mindless drive scratch an itch you didn't know you had. Having said that, nobody will stop you if you prefer to cruise at 300kph or rally on the mountain trails... Steam-exclusive features If you've played the web version, you may wonder what's going to be different on Steam. In the full game you'll find dozens of exclusive upgrades and features, including: Extra locations, starting with the new California coast New road styles, including off-road trails New vehicles, starting with the Hatch and Sports car Vehicle customisation, both for style and physics tuning Options for combustion engines and manual transmissions for all vehicles Configurable traffic modes - set density, speed, and which lane(s) they drive in A music interface for playing from local files or public radio stations Improved scenery detail and high-definition assets Improved controller support Profiles for saving your progress and settings Expanded settings for gameplay and graphics Milestone achievements Lastly, buying on Steam enables the web version to remain free and ad-free for everybody, while supporting ongoing development. Since initial release in 2022, the web version has never featured ads, microtransactions, or paywalls. It will remain this way and will continue to receive small updates into the future, though will represent a more minimal experience of the game. Try the demo! The demo gives a short (distance-limited) sample of the main features in the game, and is the best way to test gameplay and compatibility. Some features are locked or limited in the demo, but all are instantly available in the full game. Post-launch roadmap Slow Roads is a living project, with active development of extra locations, features, and vehicles continuing beyond initial release. The list is long, but the main goals for upcoming updates include: Force feedback support for wheel controllers Rain, dynamic weather effects, and a day/night cycle New locations set elsewhere in the world (see WIP of an Alps location above) Enhanced environmental details like structures and wildlife A world editor allowing you to alter parameters and generate custom locations These are intended to be free updates to the core game, added after the initial version 1 release. There are currently no plans to gate future features behind DLCs, though as the core game grows the base price may rise in alignment. Human-made over 5 years No AI has been used to generate any code or content in or about the game, and never will be. Slow Roads has been a labour of love since the project began in 2021, and has been built with a decade of experience in 3D graphics and creative software development. Textures are hand-drawn, sounds are recorded locally, and all systems are designed and engineered specifically for the unique context of the game. This is a solo-developed project that I take great care over, and I believe AI simply doesn't belong in creative projects like these. Please note that procedural generation is not a form of generative AI; the procedures used to generate the world in the game are mathematical functions that have been derived and defined by hand, with direct creative intent.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Slow Roads is a casual driving game designed to capture the zen of a long drive on a scenic road. Zone out as you coast along lifelike roads that wind endlessly through procedurally-generated landscapes, with configurable locations, road styles, seasons, weather, and vehicles. Generate a unique world, throw on some music, and just drive.

Endless driving zen

Simply chase the horizon through endless, ever-unique landscapes, with no objectives, challenges, or distractions. Disconnect from stress while you roll through valleys, fields, forests, and coastlines at your own pace.

Infinitely-generated scenic roads

A novel procedural engine generates the landscapes and roads organically, meaning every stretch of road is unique and non-repeating. Choose your preferred style, from casual to winding corners, wide or narrow, and paved or off-road. World generation is seeded, allowing you to revisit any especially nice road you find.

Settings for location, season, weather, and time-of-day

Select a location and instantly switch between scene styles to suit your mood, with options for sun, cloud, snow, and time-of-day. Locations are based on real places - roll through the hills of the Peak District, coast along the California shore, or rove Off-World if you really need an escape.

Choose the vehicle that suits your style

"Driving zen" means different things to different people, whether that's cruising in the coupe, rallying in the hatch, or kissing each apex with the sports car. Maybe take the coach for a slow tour, or try hitting the perfect lean into every corner with the bike.

Vehicle customisation and tuning

Optionally customise your vehicle's style and tuning, with controls over colours, wheels, plates, engines, handling, and more. Any vehicle's engine can be electric or combustion, with the latter having options for manual or automatic transmission.

Casual or sim-style driving

Configure the gameplay to your own comforts with controls for steer assist, camera pose, traffic, and more. You can even let the car drive for you, with options for automatic steering, automatic speed control, or full autodrive. The cockpit view can be configured for sim-style driving, with support for controllers and wheels*

*Please note that force feedback is not currently supported by the engine, but is planned for a near-term content update. Check out the demo to verify your device's compatibility.

Just drive...

Slow Roads is designed for minimalist gameplay, with a lightweight engine that is hyper-optimised for endless, real-time environment generation - less so for crash physics or stunts. Take it slow, stay on the road, and let the simplicity of a mindless drive scratch an itch you didn't know you had. Having said that, nobody will stop you if you prefer to cruise at 300kph or rally on the mountain trails...

Steam-exclusive features

If you've played the web version, you may wonder what's going to be different on Steam. In the full game you'll find dozens of exclusive upgrades and features, including:

  • Extra locations, starting with the new California coast

  • New road styles, including off-road trails

  • New vehicles, starting with the Hatch and Sports car

  • Vehicle customisation, both for style and physics tuning

  • Options for combustion engines and manual transmissions for all vehicles

  • Configurable traffic modes - set density, speed, and which lane(s) they drive in

  • A music interface for playing from local files or public radio stations

  • Improved scenery detail and high-definition assets

  • Improved controller support

  • Profiles for saving your progress and settings

  • Expanded settings for gameplay and graphics

  • Milestone achievements

Lastly, buying on Steam enables the web version to remain free and ad-free for everybody, while supporting ongoing development. Since initial release in 2022, the web version has never featured ads, microtransactions, or paywalls. It will remain this way and will continue to receive small updates into the future, though will represent a more minimal experience of the game.

Try the demo!

The demo gives a short (distance-limited) sample of the main features in the game, and is the best way to test gameplay and compatibility. Some features are locked or limited in the demo, but all are instantly available in the full game.

Post-launch roadmap

Slow Roads is a living project, with active development of extra locations, features, and vehicles continuing beyond initial release. The list is long, but the main goals for upcoming updates include:

  • Force feedback support for wheel controllers

  • Rain, dynamic weather effects, and a day/night cycle

  • New locations set elsewhere in the world (see WIP of an Alps location above)

  • Enhanced environmental details like structures and wildlife

  • A world editor allowing you to alter parameters and generate custom locations

These are intended to be free updates to the core game, added after the initial version 1 release. There are currently no plans to gate future features behind DLCs, though as the core game grows the base price may rise in alignment.

Human-made over 5 years

No AI has been used to generate any code or content in or about the game, and never will be. Slow Roads has been a labour of love since the project began in 2021, and has been built with a decade of experience in 3D graphics and creative software development. Textures are hand-drawn, sounds are recorded locally, and all systems are designed and engineered specifically for the unique context of the game. This is a solo-developed project that I take great care over, and I believe AI simply doesn't belong in creative projects like these.

Please note that procedural generation is not a form of generative AI; the procedures used to generate the world in the game are mathematical functions that have been derived and defined by hand, with direct creative intent.

games.name: Small Spaces
games.short_description: Design and decorate beautiful apartments you’d love to live in! Relax and let your creativity flow — organize a simplistic flat in Tokyo, fill a cozy place with flowers in Berlin, or unpack an industrial loft in New York.

descriptions.en: Design and decorate beautiful apartments you’d love to live in! Relax and let your creativity flow — organize a simplistic flat in Tokyo, fill a cozy place with flowers in Berlin, or unpack an industrial loft in New York.
descriptions.zh-Hant: 《小小暖屋》是一款轻松治愈的装修游戏，打造属于你的小巧理想公寓。从东京的极简公寓到纽约的工业风阁楼，发挥你的创造力，让有限的空间也能变得无限精彩。
descriptions.ja: Small Spacesは、美しくデザインされた小さなアパートを作り上げるリラックスゲームです。東京のシンプルなフラットからニューヨークのインダストリアルロフトまで、あなたの創造力を解き放ちましょう。唯一の制限はスペース自体です。
descriptions.ko: Small Spaces는 살고 싶은 아름다운 소형 아파트를 디자인하는 힐링 게임입니다. 도쿄의 심플한 플랫부터 뉴욕의 인더스트리얼 로프트까지, 창의력을 마음껏 발휘하세요. 유일한 한계는 공간 자체입니다.

detailed_descriptions.en: About this game Hi, I’m Niklas – the developer of Small Spaces. My goal is to make a game that puts you into a creative flow without you even noticing. And a lot of the player feedback has been exactly that. So, if you’re looking for a relaxing game to take your mind off stressful thoughts, Small Spaces might be just the creative escape you were looking for :) What can you expect? Shape the space your way Turn the small spaces fully upside down with your creativity! Modular kitchens? Loft apartments? Find smart solutions and design unique spaces that are functional and beautiful. Add indirect lighting, plants and more to decorate and personalize your space down to the smallest detail. Inspired by real places On Early Access start, you’ll design in 3 different locations: New York – raw industrial factories and warehouses turned into gorgeous loft apartments with high ceilings and expansive windows. Berlin – historic apartments with the typical 1900 european charm and beautiful bay windows. Think vintage charm meets quiet elegance. Tokyo – mid-century inspired simplistic apartments with sliding doors and sometimes warm concrete wall finishes. Together, these offer 9 apartments , each with a distinct layout and creative feel. More locations and styles will be added throughout Early Access. Stories that guide Every space has its own objectives, story and people who live there – ranging from a student in a shared flat to a couple sharing their first apartment together. The objectives inspire to design spaces that are not only pretty, but also practical and give you just enough inspiration to get started while not restricting your creativity. Carefully crafted high quality assets The game already features more than 500 furniture and decor items inspired by different styles – including comfy scandinavian beds, unique modern japanese lamps and decoration items from a record player to sewing utensils. I truly care about original art and all of the beautiful illustrations in the game are hand drawn from an illustrator. Walk through your creations in first person Switch to a first-person view to experience your design from the inside – like someone who actually lives there and view your creations as the sunlight shifts from crisp morning to warm golden hour to cozy nighttime with the glow of the indirect lighting you set up. Unlock new content as you play You start out with just a portion of tools and furniture at your hand and unlock new content as you complete objectives. Get new materials from stone terrazzo to various wood types and unlock new tools to build loft apartments, modular kitchens or wall panels. The more you create, the more options you gain. I recommend buying this game if: You play life sims mostly for home design You like relaxing games that spark your creativity You’re a design lover or architecture nerd It might not be for you if: You want to design floor plans from scratch – we’re building a creative mode where you can build your own layouts, but as of now you furnish existing apartments. You’re expecting to import your own models or textures – that kind of freedom isn’t in the game (yet!)
detailed_descriptions.zh-Hant: 你好，我是 Niklas ——《Small Spaces》的开发者。 我的目标是做出一款让你不知不觉进入创作心流的游戏。而许多玩家的反馈也正是如此。所以，如果你正在寻找一款可以放松心情、从压力中暂时抽离的游戏，Small Spaces 或许就是你在找的那个创意出口 :) 你可以期待什么？ 按你的方式塑造空间 用你的创造力彻底改造小空间！模块化厨房？阁楼式公寓？找到巧妙的解决方案，打造独特又实用、优雅又个性的空间。添加间接照明、绿植等装饰元素，从细节处打磨专属于你的理想空间。 灵感源自真实地点 在抢先体验初期，你将能在 3个不同的地点 进行设计： 纽约 – 工厂与仓库改造而成的漂亮 loft 公寓，拥有挑高天花板和大面积窗户。 柏林 – 带有典型 20 世纪初欧洲风格的历史老公寓，配有优雅的凸窗。复古韵味与宁静气质的完美结合。 东京 – 受中世纪现代风格启发的简约公寓，滑门设计与温润混凝土墙面相映成趣。 一共提供 9套公寓 ，每一套都有独特的布局与创意氛围。抢先体验期间将持续加入更多城市和风格。 引导你创作的故事 每个空间都有自己的目标、故事和居住者 —— 从合租的学生到刚同居的情侣。任务目标为你提供灵感，鼓励你设计既美观又实用的空间，在不限制创造力的前提下，引导你轻松上手。 精心打磨的高品质物件 游戏目前已拥有 500 多种家具与装饰，灵感来自各类风格 —— 从舒适的北欧床铺到现代感十足的日式灯具，甚至还有黑胶唱机、缝纫工具等细节装饰。 我非常重视原创美术 —— 游戏中的所有插画均由插画师手工绘制。 以第一人称视角漫步你的设计空间 切换至第一人称视角，亲身体验你打造的空间。感受从清晨日光到傍晚金色，再到夜晚暖光照明的光影流动 —— 全部由你亲自布置。 游戏过程中持续解锁新内容 初始阶段，你只能使用部分工具与家具，随着完成任务将解锁更多内容。解锁新材料 —— 从水磨石到多种木材类型 —— 也会解锁新工具，用来构建 loft、公寓厨房、墙板等结构。创造越多，选择越多。 我推荐这款游戏给以下玩家： 喜欢生活模拟游戏中的室内设计部分 喜欢轻松、放松、能激发创造力的游戏 热爱设计或建筑 可能不太适合以下玩家： 想从零开始自由绘制户型 —— 我们正在开发创作模式，但目前只能布置已有公寓 想导入自己制作的模型或贴图 —— 游戏目前（还）不支持该功能
detailed_descriptions.ja: このゲームについて こんにちは、私はNiklasです。Small Spacesの開発者です。私の目標は、気づかないうちに創造的なフローに入れるようなゲームを作ることです。そして多くのプレイヤーからのフィードバックは、まさにそれを反映しています。ストレスの多い思考から解放されたいなら、Small Spacesはきっとあなたが探していた創造的な逃避先かもしれません :) 本作でできること あなたらしく空間を作る 小さな空間を、あなたのアイデアでまったく新しいものに！モジュール式のキッチン？ロフトアパート？ 賢いレイアウトやスタイリッシュな家具で、機能的かつ美しい部屋を自由にデザインできます。間接照明や植物など、細かいところまでこだわって自分だけの空間を作り上げましょう。 実在の都市から着想を得た3つの舞台 Early Access開始時点では、以下の3都市を舞台にデザインできます： ニューヨーク ：工場や倉庫が改装されたインダストリアルなロフト。高い天井と大きな窓が特徴。 ベルリン ：20世紀初頭のヨーロッパ建築の魅力が詰まった歴史あるアパートメント。クラシックなエレガンスが漂います。 東京 ：ミッドセンチュリー風のシンプルなデザイン。引き戸やあたたかみのあるコンクリート仕上げが印象的。 合計 9つのアパート が収録されており、それぞれ異なる間取りと雰囲気があります。Early Accessの期間中にも、新しいロケーションやスタイルが追加予定です。 ストーリーが創作のヒントに 各アパートには、物語・住人・目標があります。 学生のルームシェアから、新婚カップルの初めての住まいまで、多彩な設定が用意されています。 課題があることで、ただ美しいだけでなく、実用性のある空間づくりを楽しめます。あくまでヒントなので、自由度は損なわれません。 丁寧に作られた500種類以上のアイテム 現在、 500点以上の家具・装飾品 を収録。スタイルもさまざまで、 北欧風のベッド、日本のモダンな照明、レコードプレーヤーや裁縫道具など、生活感のある小物まで用意されています。 私は「手描きのアート」を大切にしており、ゲーム内の美しいイラストはすべてプロのイラストレーターによる手描きです。 一人称視点で、内側から空間を体験 一人称モードに切り替えると、自分が住人になったかのように部屋を歩き回ることができます。 朝の光、夕方のゴールデンアワー、夜の間接照明まで、時間の流れによって変わる雰囲気を楽しんでください。 遊びながら新しい要素をアンロック 最初は限られた家具とツールのみ使えますが、課題をクリアすることで新しい素材・パーツ・機能がどんどん開放されます。 テラゾー素材や木材のバリエーション、ロフトや壁パネル、モジュール式キッチンなど、創作の幅が広がっていきます。 こんな方におすすめ： ライフシミュレーションゲームで、家のデザインを楽しむのが好きな人 創造力を刺激してくれる、リラックスできるゲームを探している人 建築やインテリアデザインが好きな人 向いていないかもしれない場合： 最初から間取りを作りたい方（現在は既存のアパートをデザインする形式で、「クリエイティブモード」は今後のアップデート予定です） 自分で作成した3Dモデルやテクスチャをインポートしたい方（この機能は現時点では非対応です）
detailed_descriptions.ko: 게임 소개 안녕하세요, 저는 Niklas입니다 – Small Spaces의 개발자입니다. 저는 여러분이 모르는 사이에 창의적인 몰입 상태에 빠질 수 있는 게임을 만드는 것이 목표입니다. 그리고 많은 플레이어 피드백이 바로 그걸 이야기해 주고 있어요. 만약 스트레스를 잠시 잊고 싶다면, Small Spaces가 당신이 찾던 바로 그 창의적인 휴식처일 수 있어요 :) 어떤 경험이 기다리고 있을까요? 당신만의 방식으로 공간을 꾸미세요 작은 공간을 창의력으로 새롭게 탈바꿈하세요! 모듈형 주방부터 로프트 스타일 아파트까지 — 기능적이면서도 아름다운 공간을 디자인하세요. 간접 조명, 식물, 다양한 소품들로 공간을 당신의 스타일로 완성해보세요. 현실에서 영감을 받은 도시들 Early Access 초기에는 다음의 3개 도시에서 디자인할 수 있습니다: 뉴욕 – 오래된 공장과 창고가 고천장, 대형 창문을 갖춘 멋진 로프트 아파트로 재탄생 베를린 – 유럽 1900년대 스타일의 클래식한 분위기와 아름다운 베이 윈도우를 갖춘 역사적인 아파트 도쿄 – 미드 센추리에서 영감을 받은 미니멀한 아파트, 슬라이딩 도어와 따뜻한 콘크리트 마감 총 9개의 아파트가 있으며, 각각 독특한 구조와 감성을 담고 있습니다. Early Access 동안 더 많은 도시와 스타일이 추가될 예정입니다. 이야기가 디자인을 이끕니다 각 공간에는 고유한 목표, 스토리, 그리고 거주자가 있습니다 — 예: 셰어하우스에 사는 대학생, 첫 집을 함께 꾸미는 커플 등. 목표는 창의력을 억누르지 않으면서도 디자인에 적절한 영감을 줍니다. 예쁜 것만이 아니라 실용성도 생각해야 하죠. 정성스럽게 제작된 고품질 아이템 게임에는 다양한 스타일에서 영감을 받은 500개 이상의 가구 및 데코 아이템 이 수록되어 있습니다. 포근한 북유럽 침대, 독특한 일본식 조명, 턴테이블부터 재봉 도구까지 — 생활감 넘치는 디테일이 가득합니다. 또한 게임 내 모든 일러스트는 일러스트레이터가 직접 손으로 그린 오리지널 아트입니다. 1인칭 모드로 직접 걸어보세요 1인칭 모드로 전환하면, 실제 그 공간에 거주하는 사람처럼 내부를 자유롭게 걸어다니며 감상할 수 있습니다. 아침 햇살, 황금빛 석양, 간접 조명 아래의 아늑한 밤까지 — 시간에 따라 달라지는 분위기를 직접 체험해보세요. 플레이하면서 콘텐츠를 해금하세요 처음에는 제한된 가구와 도구만 제공되며, 목표를 달성하면 새로운 자재와 툴이 해금됩니다. 테라조, 다양한 목재, 로프트 구조, 벽 패널, 모듈형 키친 등 다양한 콘텐츠가 점차 열립니다. 창조할수록, 더 많은 옵션이 생깁니다! 이런 분들에게 추천합니다: 라이프 시뮬레이션 게임에서 집 꾸미기를 제일 좋아하는 분 창의력을 자극하는 힐링 게임을 찾고 있는 분 인테리어나 건축에 관심이 많은 분 이런 분들에게는 맞지 않을 수 있어요: 바닥 설계를 처음부터 자유롭게 하고 싶은 분 (크리에이티브 모드는 개발 중이며, 현재는 기존 아파트만 꾸밀 수 있습니다) 자신의 3D 모델이나 텍스처를 게임에 가져오고 싶은 분 (현재는 불가능하지만 추후 지원을 검토 중입니다)

games.name: Smalland: Survive the Wilds
games.short_description: Experience a big adventure on a tiny scale! Enjoy multiplayer survival in a vast, hazardous world. Preparation is key when you're this small & at the bottom of the food chain. Craft weapons & armour, tame & ride creatures, build encampments & explore a strange new land.

descriptions.en: Experience a big adventure on a tiny scale! Enjoy multiplayer survival in a vast, hazardous world. Preparation is key when you're this small & at the bottom of the food chain. Craft weapons & armour, tame & ride creatures, build encampments & explore a strange new land.
descriptions.zh-Hant: 小規模地體驗一場大型冒險旅程！在廣闊、充滿危機的世界中，享受多人玩家生存遊戲。身形渺小又位居食物鏈的底層時，做好萬全準備就是關鍵。鍛造武器及盔甲、馴服及騎乘生物、建造營地，並探索一片奇怪的新大地。
descriptions.ja: 小さなスケールのビッグな冒険を体験しよう！広大で危険な世界で繰り広げられる、マルチプレイヤーサバイバル！食物連鎖の底辺にいる小さな存在にとっては、「準備」こそが重要です。武器や防具を作成し、生き物を飼いならして乗りこなし、野営地を建設し、見知らぬ新たな土地を探索しましょう。
descriptions.ko: 소인이 되어 웅장한 모험을 경험하세요! 드넓고 위험천만한 세계에서 멀티플레이어 생존 게임을 즐기세요. 먹이 사슬의 밑바닥에 있는 자그마한 존재에게는 대비가 중요합니다. 무기와 갑옷을 만들고, 생물을 길들인 뒤 올라타고, 야영지를 만들고, 새로운 낯선 땅을 탐험하세요.

detailed_descriptions.en: "Before the time of the giants, we lived freely under the Sun and Moon. Centuries have passed, but those stories of the surface world have been passed down through the generations. Now the giants are gone, and you, Vanguard, must venture out into the wilds once more, on an urgent mission. Be brave, and do not falter…" Explore the vast “Land of the Small" Traverse lake sized puddles, scale skyscraper sized trees, scramble through cavernous cracks in roads, as you experience a huge open world from a new perspective. Explore dense forests, hazardous swamps and strange ruins left over from the time before. Uncover lore and knowledge from hidden NPCs scattered throughout the world and learn to survive in this vast wilderness. Tame and ride creatures Uncover recipes that will let you tame and ride an array of critters. Leap huge distances on the back of a Grasshopper, zoom around on a Damselfly, scurry from place-to-place on a Spider. This world and its inhabitants are yours to conquer. Survive together Play alongside friends with support for up to 10 players in multiplayer. Explore together, fight together, build together and survive the wilds as a team. Build encampments on the ground or amongst the trees Scavenge or refine resources to build your encampment with multiple material tiers, from leaves and twigs to sturdy stone. Pick your favourite spot in the world and build, or scale vast trees and claim your own settlement at the top. Craft powerful armour sets Collect powerful armours that provide you with resistances and abilities and mix them up to personalise your appearance. Glide through the skies in winged armour, swing from tree to tree with the grappling hook and many more. Survive the Wilds Most of the creatures you encounter will see you as lower on the food chain – Ants, Cockroaches, Beetles, Wasps, and Spiders all view you as a potential meal. Weather conditions and seasons are in constant flux so if you want to survive for another day, preparation is key.
detailed_descriptions.zh-Hant: 「在巨人稱霸之前，我們原本在日與月之下自由自在地生活著。數個世紀過去了，不過那些與地表世界有關的故事，仍世世代代地傳承下去。現在，巨人已離去，而你呢先鋒，必須在一場緊急任務中再度於野外冒險犯難。必須英勇向前，且不退縮……」 探索廣闊的「小人國」 透過全新視野來體驗壯闊的開放世界之際，橫越湖泊大小的水窪、攀爬摩天大樓般大小的樹木，並穿越道路上坑坑巴巴的裂縫。快來探索茂密的森林、危險的沼澤地，以及古老時代所留下的奇怪遺跡。從分散在世界各地的隱藏 NPC 口中得知傳說故事及知識，並學習如何在這片廣大的荒野中生存下來。 馴服及騎乘生物 發掘能讓你馴服及騎乘許多動物的配方。騎在蚱蜢的背上大力跳躍、騎乘豆娘奔馳，並騎著蜘蛛四處疾走。這個世界及其居民，皆等著你來征服。 一同生存下來 在多人玩家模式中與朋友一起遊玩，最多可支援 10 名玩家。一起探索、一起作戰、一起建造，並合作無間，以在荒野中生存下來。 在地面或樹木間建造營地 搜索或精煉資源，以利用樹葉及樹枝至堅硬的石頭等不同層級的材料，來建造出你的營地。在遊戲世界中選擇你最喜愛的地點，接著建造或攀登大樹，並在頂端建立屬於你自己的居住地。 鍛造強大的盔甲套組 收集能提供抗性及各種能力的強大盔甲，並相互混合，以個人化自己的外觀。穿戴有翅膀的盔甲以在空中滑翔、使用抓鉤在不同的樹間擺盪，還有更多內容等你發掘。 在荒野中生存下來 你所遇到的大部分生物，皆會認為你居於食物鏈較低的位置——對於螞蟻、蟑螂、甲蟲、黃蜂及蜘蛛等生物而言，你都是那塊秀色可餐的肉。天氣狀況及季節變換萬千，若想繼續生存，最好做足萬全準備。
detailed_descriptions.ja: 「巨人の時代が訪れる前、わたしたちは太陽と月の下で自由に暮らしていました。その後、何世紀もの間にわたって、地表世界の物語は世代を超えて受け継がれてきました。巨人たちがいなくなった今、あなたは先遣隊として、この重要な任務を帯びて再び荒野に出ていかなければなりません。さぁ、勇気を出して、ためらわないで…」 広大な「小さきものたちの国」を探索しよう 湖のように広大な水たまりを渡り、超高層ビルのように高い木々によじ登り、巨大洞窟のような道路の亀裂を進む、まったく新しい視点から巨大なオープンワールドを体験しましょう。うっそうとした森、危険な沼地、古代から残っている奇妙な遺跡を探索してください。世界中に散らばる隠れたNPCから伝承と知識を得て、この広大な荒野で生き残る方法を学んでいきましょう。 クリーチャーを飼いならして乗りこなそう さまざまなクリーチャーを飼いならして、騎乗可能にするレシピを見つけてください。バッタの背中に乗って長距離を一飛びに跳躍し、イトトンボに乗って飛び回り、クモに乗って場所から場所へ縦横無尽に駆け回りましょう。この世界も、その住人も、あなたが支配するのです。 仲間と一緒に生き残れ マルチプレイヤーでは最大10人のプレイヤーをサポートしており、友達と一緒にプレイできます。一緒に探検し、一緒に戦い、一緒に構築し、チームとして荒野を生き延びていきましょう。 地面に、木々の間に野営地を建設しよう リソースを集めて加工して、葉や小枝から頑丈な石まで、複数のタイプのマテリアルで野営地を構築しましょう。世界の中からお気に入りの場所を選んで建設し、巨大な木の頂上に自分の居住地を確立してください。 強力な防具セットを作成しよう 耐性とアビリティを提供する強力な防具を集め、それらを組み合わせて外観をカスタマイズしましょう。翼のある鎧で空を滑空したり、グラップリングフックで木から木へとスイングします。 荒野を生き残ろう あなたが遭遇するクリーチャーのほとんどは、あなたを食物連鎖の下位にいるものと見なしています。さらに気象条件と季節は常に変化し続けており、新たな一日を乗り切るために、日々、準備が重要になります。
detailed_descriptions.ko: “거인의 시대가 도래하기 전에 우리는 태양과 달 아래에서 자유롭게 살았습니다. 이후 수백 년이 흘렀지만, 지상 세계에 관한 이야기는 대대로 전해지고 있습니다. 이제 거인이 사라졌으니, 선봉대 여러분은 다시 한번 야생으로 모험을 떠나는 절박한 임무를 맡게 되었습니다. 흔들리지 말고 용감하게 나아가십시오...“ 광활한 "소인의 땅"을 탐험하세요 호수와 맞먹는 크기의 웅덩이를 횡단하고, 마천루만큼 높은 나무를 오르고, 도로의 동굴 같은 균열을 헤치고 나아가면서 새로운 시각으로 거대하고도 광활한 세계를 경험하세요. 빽빽한 숲, 위험이 도사리는 늪, 과거의 흔적이 숨 쉬는 기이한 폐허를 탐험하세요. 전 세계에 숨은 채로 뿔뿔이 흩어져 있는 NPC로부터 이야기와 지식을 전해 듣고, 이 드넓은 야생에서 생존하는 법을 배우세요. 동물을 길들이고 올라타세요 다양한 동물을 길들이고 탈 수 있는 방법을 알아보세요. 메뚜기의 등에 올라타 엄청난 거리를 도약하고, 잠자리 위에서 주위를 둘러보고, 거미를 타고 총총걸음으로 이곳저곳 다녀보세요. 이 세계와 주민들을 정복하세요. 함께 살아남으세요 최대 10명까지 지원하는 멀티플레이어 기능으로 친구와 함께 플레이하세요. 함께 탐험하고, 함께 싸우고, 함께 건설하고, 힘을 합쳐 야생에서 살아남으세요. 땅 위나 나무 사이에 야영지를 건설하세요 나뭇잎이나 나뭇가지부터 단단한 돌에 이르기까지, 다양한 재료를 긁어모으거나 다듬어 야영지를 건설하세요. 세계 속 가장 좋아하는 장소를 선택하거나 웅장한 나무를 기어올라 꼭대기에서 정착지를 설립하세요. 강력한 방어구 세트를 제작하세요 저항력과 능력을 높여주는 강력한 방어구를 수집하고 조합해 마음대로 외형을 꾸미세요. 날개 달린 갑옷으로 하늘을 날아다니고, 갈고리를 이용해 나무 사이를 이동하는 등 다양하게 즐길 수 있습니다. 야생에서 살아남으세요 개미, 바퀴벌레, 딱정벌레, 말벌, 거미와 같이, 모험 도중 마주치는 생물 대부분은 먹이 사슬 최하위인 여러분을 먹잇감으로 노립니다. 날씨와 계절은 계속해서 변화하니 하루라도 더 살아남으려면 철저히 대비하세요.

games.name: Snacko
games.short_description: Driven away by the cost of living, you and your childhood friend set off with the goal to turn things around and start a new life. Explore, gather, and build up the town from scratch into a place you'll be proud to call "home"!

descriptions.en: Driven away by the cost of living, you and your childhood friend set off with the goal to turn things around and start a new life. Explore, gather, and build up the town from scratch into a place you'll be proud to call "home"!

detailed_descriptions.en: Welcome to Snacko Island! A place once abundant in resources and culture, Snacko Island now sits abandoned by its residents... Driven away by the cost of living, you and your childhood friend set off with the goal to turn things around and start a new life. Explore, gather, and build up the town from scratch into a place you'll be proud to call "home". From picking out shopkeepers to placing down new buildings, the future of the new Snacko Island is in your paws! All packed up and ready to go Explore the island and its four distinct biomes Customize your journey by combining different gems for different tool effects - each tool and gem has a unique combination , allowing you to tailor your upgrades to your playstyle Easily manage your goodies and stamina by utilizing an array of tools and features, from auto-deposit to the Lunchbox for auto stamina restore Never worry about the size of your rucksack when you're out! Craft from storage and the Overflow Storage lets you keep just the essentials on you Get comfortable with these quality-of-life features Running out of time? After a long day out, simply use the Go Home button or camp outside with a Sleeping Box You can purchase items from shops when the shopkeeper is off duty - they trust you! Pick between built in World Themes such as low contrast or dark mode , complete with a dark mode UI and a slider to change the strength Discover higher drop rates of certain items during specific seasons, time of day, or weather. The longer you're looking for an item, the more likely it will appear. How lucky! Is it too dark at night...? Adjust the Night Time Strength to help you see better Dig deep into the world of Snacko Unlock items , learn more about your friends, and learn more about the island and beyond through unique questlines Uncover secrets with your new friends or just relax and fish with them on join quests Work through Guild Quests to learn crafting recipes, cooking recipes, and new crops. You might learn more about each Guild leader, too... Explore the Snacko universe at your own pace to a beautiful soundtrack by Dale North and Camellia Meet someone new Invite shopkeepers and villagers based on personality , or work hard and build housing for everyone! With 26 characters of varying personalities (and species) to get to know, you're bound to find someone who clicks with you Experience romance with 21 characters with no restrictions Learn more about each character through quests, dialogue, and cutscenes Something for everyone Spend your time collecting resources and crafting , cooking , fishing , decorating your house, or using up every square of your farm - how you spend your time and how you'd like to progress is up to you Go through each day slowly and unlock all the items, or simply enjoy the completed main story questline as you naturally progress Donate furniture, cooked foods, fish, and paintings to the Cultural Center and watch it fill up, or simply enjoy a relaxing afternoon in the Music Hall Build up your dream life A flexible build mode means you get to decorate how you like Snap to grid , free rotate , undo and redo , float items, dye objects, no building restrictions, and a search box in your catalog for over 300 items to place Utilize Screenshot Mode and undo/redo to record your own build timelapses Nudging objects while in Lock mode gives you finer control for decorating your surfaces with clutter... Or get creative and combine objects together Expand your house, change the wallpaper and floors , and dye each wall a different color! Get things done quickly With a variety of movement options like double jumping , using the kart , riding on arrows , sword dashing , or bouncing around with your pickaxe , there's always a faster way to get around Snappy animations can get cancelled by actions! detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Welcome to Snacko Island!

A place once abundant in resources and culture, Snacko Island now sits abandoned by its residents...

Driven away by the cost of living, you and your childhood friend set off with the goal to turn things around and start a new life. Explore, gather, and build up the town from scratch into a place you'll be proud to call "home". From picking out shopkeepers to placing down new buildings, the future of the new Snacko Island is in your paws!

All packed up and ready to go

  • Explore the island and its four distinct biomes

  • Customize your journey by combining different gems for different tool effects - each tool and gem has a unique combination, allowing you to tailor your upgrades to your playstyle

  • Easily manage your goodies and stamina by utilizing an array of tools and features, from auto-deposit to the Lunchbox for auto stamina restore

  • Never worry about the size of your rucksack when you're out! Craft from storage and the Overflow Storage lets you keep just the essentials on you

Get comfortable with these quality-of-life features

  • Running out of time? After a long day out, simply use the Go Home button or camp outside with a Sleeping Box

  • You can purchase items from shops when the shopkeeper is off duty - they trust you!

  • Pick between built in World Themes such as low contrast or dark mode, complete with a dark mode UI and a slider to change the strength

  • Discover higher drop rates of certain items during specific seasons, time of day, or weather. The longer you're looking for an item, the more likely it will appear. How lucky!

  • Is it too dark at night...? Adjust the Night Time Strength to help you see better

Dig deep into the world of Snacko

  • Unlock items, learn more about your friends, and learn more about the island and beyond through unique questlines

  • Uncover secrets with your new friends or just relax and fish with them on join quests

  • Work through Guild Quests to learn crafting recipes, cooking recipes, and new crops. You might learn more about each Guild leader, too...

  • Explore the Snacko universe at your own pace to a beautiful soundtrack by Dale North and Camellia

Meet someone new

  • Invite shopkeepers and villagers based on personality, or work hard and build housing for everyone! With 26 characters of varying personalities (and species) to get to know, you're bound to find someone who clicks with you

  • Experience romance with 21 characters with no restrictions

  • Learn more about each character through quests, dialogue, and cutscenes

Something for everyone

  • Spend your time collecting resources and crafting, cooking, fishing, decorating your house, or using up every square of your farm - how you spend your time and how you'd like to progress is up to you

  • Go through each day slowly and unlock all the items, or simply enjoy the completed main story questline as you naturally progress

  • Donate furniture, cooked foods, fish, and paintings to the Cultural Center and watch it fill up, or simply enjoy a relaxing afternoon in the Music Hall

Build up your dream life

  • A flexible build mode means you get to decorate how you like

  • Snap to grid, free rotate, undo and redo, float items, dye objects, no building restrictions, and a search box in your catalog for over 300 items to place

  • Utilize Screenshot Mode and undo/redo to record your own build timelapses

  • Nudging objects while in Lock mode gives you finer control for decorating your surfaces with clutter... Or get creative and combine objects together

  • Expand your house, change the wallpaper and floors, and dye each wall a different color!

Get things done quickly

  • With a variety of movement options like double jumping, using the kart, riding on arrows, sword dashing, or bouncing around with your pickaxe, there's always a faster way to get around

  • Snappy animations can get cancelled by actions! Try watering your farm tile right after sowing a seed... It's super fast!

  • Choose your time or your stamina: speed up your Furnace, Alembic, or Seed Maker by bonking it with your tool. Or, be patient and let it sit while you sleep

games.short_description: Snacktorio is a factory-cooking automation game where you build and scale food production lines to feed the beasts threatening to consume your world. Manage strange ingredients across sprawling cooking factories to keep the monsters fed while you uncover what’s stirring their growing appetites...

descriptions.en: Snacktorio is a factory-cooking automation game where you build and scale food production lines to feed the beasts threatening to consume your world. Manage strange ingredients across sprawling cooking factories to keep the monsters fed while you uncover what’s stirring their growing appetites...

detailed_descriptions.en: Long ago, hungry monsters threatened to consume the world, until their appetites were sated - with delicious food! But now their numbers have grown, and there are more orders than we can keep up with… Joining the kitchen brigade at the request of the Head Chef, you must build and run new cooking factories to keep feeding the beasts. Gather ingredients, set up food production lines, and craft gourmet meals inspired by cuisines from all over the world, each made to meet some very particular tastes. As you travel across the islands to uncover what’s really stirring the beasts’ appetites, you’ll come across new foods, new rules, and unexpected complications that test how well your systems really work. Can you turn the tide of the hungry beasts, while proving your status as a Witchelin Star chef? FEATURES - Level-based factory simulation in a 2D platforming setting - Mass-produce delicious meals through automated cooking machines - Over 55 levels across 6 islands, with difficult challenges and modes to unlock - Handle complex ingredients, dairy, allergens, spicy foods, food poisoning and more - Modding support, plus create and share custom levels to challenge your fellow chefs - Experience all the stress of managing a restaurant without any of the pay! FEED THE MONSTERS TO KEEP THE PEACE Take orders from hungry beasts, and create multiple delicious courses - each with tastes, quirks, and intolerances. Meet their demands to stop the island from, well… becoming lunch. BUILD FOOD FACTORIES Design automated kitchens using mixers, ovens, boilers, fryers, sorters, pipes, and more. Every ingredient is a system; manage timing, contamination, allergens, spoilage and other quirks as production grows. MASTER INGREDIENTS WITH REAL RULES Dairy curdles with heat, nuts spread allergens, meat carries food poisoning and dough rises over time. Learn the rules, exploit them, and build factories that won’t implode... probably. EXPLORE ISLANDS, EACH WITH ITS OWN LOGIC Every island introduces new core ingredients, mechanics, hazards, and layouts. Unlock new dishes, solve strange local problems, build the factories needed to keep the beasts from causing trouble. SOLVE MULTI-STEP COOKING PUZZLES AT SCALE Turn simple recipes into sprawling networks of pipes and machines. Control overpowering ingredients to avoid contamination, prevent curdled catastrophes and keep your production flowing under pressure. LATE-GAME SYSTEMS GET DELICIOUSLY WEIRD Use void-powered machines, infused liquids, steam-based cooking, indigestion relief for spicy dishes, layered dessert conveyor belts and more as you push into stranger territory. --- A portion of the money made will be donated towards hunger, foodbank and food waste prevention charities to help feed those in need in the real world.

detailed_descriptions.en: Warning: This game is not intended for people with photosensitive epilepsy. Sniper Camouflage Orange Spy Warrior I Buried Two Bodies in the Garden and the Police Haven't Figured Out Yet That They're Missing Because They Were a Lonely Old Couple Who Had No Relatives Simulator 2026 Abbreviated as SCOSWIBTBITGATPHFOYTTMBTWALOCWHNRS2026, or simply Sniper Simulator 2026, or it could also be LSD: Sniper Simulator. IIt's a unique sandbox sniper simulator that blends first-person point-and-click with immersive physics-based object manipulation. The game features various side activities and a world full of hidden secrets. Your main task is to kill the designated targets, isn't it? But it won't be easy. Even though the targets aren't particularly dangerous, your main enemies as a sniper are gravity (bullet drop) and wind (sidewind) , just like a sniper in real life, requiring you to carefully interact with your environment and equipment to pull off the perfect shot. Sniper gameplay (Windage and Elevation) One day I was playing Sniper Ghost Warrior 3 and realized the game was way too easy. It occurred to me to make it a little more autistic and retarded, Instead of the bullet flying in the direction the scope is pointing, you have to adjust the scope yourself based on the wind and the distance to the target. SGW shows you the distance and actively displays the crosswind, but my game doesn't do that, you have to figure it out yourself the old-fashioned way, just like snipers do in real life (it's definitely not a 1:1 match). Simply put, the scope doesn't tell you where the bullet will land, and you don't change the bullet's range in any way during the game. On the contrary, thanks to the scope settings, it tells you the exact direction of the bullet's impact if the target is at the distance you've set, and the same goes for crosswinds. Windage is a correction for the wind's drift Elevation is the correction for a bullet's trajectory based on distance Customize your sniper spot as your home base In the game, you can only shoot from certain sniper spots. Since they’re all the same, you can upgrade your sniper spot with decorations and other cool features, including some bonuses. Examples: A radio that plays your music from a folder A cell phone that can play videos A drawing board where you can draw anything A slot machine or other items that let you gamble or get ammo in addition to what’s in the game world Then there are decorations that give you bonuses, like a playground that confuses snipers for a longer period of time Side Activities In addition to the main quests in the game, there are also a number of side activities, such as: time trials, cargo races, and stunts time-based parkour boat races climbing special levels, such as one with a sniper spot mounted on a car (see the gameplay video) Key elements: hand interaction, game requires magazine change bolt movement with mouse etc.. Unique graphics and styling side quests and secrets outside the main quest Editor (not yet) Realistic ballistics: distance, wind drift, and manual scope calibration. Warning: This game is not intended for people with photosensitive epilepsy.

Sniper Camouflage Orange Spy Warrior I Buried Two Bodies in the Garden and the Police Haven't Figured Out Yet That They're Missing Because They Were a Lonely Old Couple Who Had No Relatives Simulator 2026

Abbreviated as SCOSWIBTBITGATPHFOYTTMBTWALOCWHNRS2026, or simply Sniper Simulator 2026, or it could also be LSD: Sniper Simulator. IIt's a unique sandbox sniper simulator that blends first-person point-and-click with immersive physics-based object manipulation.

The game features various side activities and a world full of hidden secrets. Your main task is to kill the designated targets, isn't it? But it won't be easy.

Even though the targets aren't particularly dangerous, your main enemies as a sniper are gravity (bullet drop) and wind (sidewind), just like a sniper in real life, requiring you to carefully interact with your environment and equipment to pull off the perfect shot.

Sniper gameplay (Windage and Elevation)

One day I was playing Sniper Ghost Warrior 3 and realized the game was way too easy. It occurred to me to make it a little more autistic and retarded, Instead of the bullet flying in the direction the scope is pointing, you have to adjust the scope yourself based on the wind and the distance to the target. SGW shows you the distance and actively displays the crosswind, but my game doesn't do that, you have to figure it out yourself the old-fashioned way, just like snipers do in real life (it's definitely not a 1:1 match).

Simply put, the scope doesn't tell you where the bullet will land, and you don't change the bullet's range in any way during the game. On the contrary, thanks to the scope settings, it tells you the exact direction of the bullet's impact if the target is at the distance you've set, and the same goes for crosswinds.

Windage is a correction for the wind's drift

Elevation is the correction for a bullet's trajectory based on distance

Customize your sniper spot as your home base

In the game, you can only shoot from certain sniper spots. Since they’re all the same, you can upgrade your sniper spot with decorations and other cool features, including some bonuses. Examples:

  • A radio that plays your music from a folder

  • A cell phone that can play videos

  • A drawing board where you can draw anything

  • A slot machine or other items that let you gamble or get ammo in addition to what’s in the game world

  • Then there are decorations that give you bonuses, like a playground that confuses snipers for a longer period of time

Side Activities

In addition to the main quests in the game, there are also a number of side activities, such as:

  • time trials, cargo races, and stunts

  • time-based parkour

  • boat races

  • climbing

  • special levels, such as one with a sniper spot mounted on a car (see the gameplay video)

Key elements:

  • side quests and secrets outside the main quest

games.name: Sniper Dan
games.short_description: Sniper Dan is a delightfully funny, family-friendly 3D Hidden Object game with a big twist. Use a sniper rifle to solve hundreds of low-stakes jobs across six packed locations, discover surprising secrets, snap hilarious photo ops, and unlock costumes, upgrades, office décor, collectables and more!

descriptions.en: Sniper Dan is a delightfully funny, family-friendly 3D Hidden Object game with a big twist. Use a sniper rifle to solve hundreds of low-stakes jobs across six packed locations, discover surprising secrets, snap hilarious photo ops, and unlock costumes, upgrades, office décor, collectables and more!

detailed_descriptions.en: Meet Dan. Dan has a sniper rifle. Don’t panic, he’s not here to harm anyone. Dan’s a professional and his job is fixing things. From a distance. With pinpoint accuracy and good intentions. Sniper Dan is a hidden object game unlike any other. Objects aren't always well hidden and the solution involves shooting them. Each job follows a simple and highly respected method. 1) Figure out the problem. Use the clues. HMM… 2) Find the problem. Scope the area. AHA! 3) Fix the problem. Shoot. WHEE! You’re not hunting enemies. You’re hunting problems. Fixing rusty taps, machines behaving badly and even stop a thieving Pelican. Travel far and wide across lively 3D locations packed with visual jokes and silly situations as you help those in need. Can Dan and his trusty tool get the job done? Dan’s business takes him to villages, parks, farms, airports, cities and beyond. Special challenges keep every day fresh. Take on optional work for extra cash, tackle bigger jobs for even bigger rewards and uncover secrets that leave citizens quietly convinced something magical just happened. It did. It was Dan! Between contracts, upgrade your rifle, decorate your office hub and grow your entirely legitimate troubleshooting business. Unlock bonus games and extra modes like Time Attack, Ammo Hunt and Snapshot Mode, all under the judgmental eye of Rank Chook. Funny, colourful and sure to leave you wanting more, Sniper Dan is about finding what’s wrong, fixing it fast and moving on to the next job. Scope the problem. Take the shot. Make everyone happy. Key Features Outrageous tools. Sensible intentions Use a sniper rifle to fix everyday problems. No danger. No drama. Just long-range problem solving. A hidden object game through a sniper scope Scan busy 3D scenes, spot what’s wrong and solve it with one perfectly aimed shot. Over 160 jobs across six lively locations Take on everyday jobs, Answerphone requests, emergency jobs, boss jobs and special challenges, plus bonus games and three dedicated minigames: Bowling, Tennis and Air Hockey . Every job is a tiny mystery Figure out cryptic clues, search the scene and work out what actually needs fixing, with dynamic solutions that mean jobs can change each time you play. A playful 3D world full of shareable moments Explore six packed locations with 100+ secrets, 200+ ambient stories and 45 hilarious photo opportunities waiting to be discovered and shared. Grow your business one job at a time Earn money and reputation from successful jobs, upgrade and customise your rifle, unlock costumes and collectibles, decorate your office hub and expand your operation. Unexpected problems. Serious precision. Zero violence Fix signs, tighten bolts, pop balloons and jump-start fireworks. Nobody gets hurt. Ever.
