games.name: Sun Haven
games.short_description: Build your farm and relationships with townsfolk, or forge ahead on a quest of magic, monsters, and dragons. Level up through a skill tree in 8 person multiplayer, or adventure solo!

descriptions.en: Build your farm and relationships with townsfolk, or forge ahead on a quest of magic, monsters, and dragons. Level up through a skill tree in 8 person multiplayer, or adventure solo!

detailed_descriptions.en: A fantasy farming sim with an RPG twist like you’ve never experienced! Immerse yourself in over 30,000 lines of dialogue, romance any (or all…) 23 characters, embark on side quests, interact with hundreds of unique NPCs, solve riddles, and discover secrets all around you in this lore-rich, story-driven world. Your actions may shape your journey, but your choices will determine your legacy. Where will your adventure take you? Sun Haven, a farming sim with no stamina bar! Every Sun Haven playthrough is fully customizable with tons of in-game settings. Adjust the length of each day to be faster or shorter, make yourself invincible to damage, turn off seasonal pests that eat your crops, toggle weather effects on and off, or just enjoy the vanilla game with default settings! Transform your run-down land into a lively farm! Play through all four seasons, each with its own seasonal weather and effects, and utilize upgradeable farming tools and magic spells to grow fruits, vegetables, and flowers! Manage your time across 3 different farms with their own unique crops, fruit trees, and animals to take care of! Cows, chickens, and silk moths, oh my! Raise classic farming livestock like cows, chickens, sheep, pigs, and other fantastical creatures like silk moths, baby griffons, phoenixes, werewolves, tar slimes, and more! In addition to barn animals, you can also collect a ton of pets and mounts that can accompany you on your adventures. Who doesn’t love adorable companions? Adventure together with friends or progress on your own! Share a farm and play with up to 8 friends online, or keep to yourself and play solo. Your characters keep their inventories and experience levels, even if you use the same character for both singleplayer and multiplayer! Decorate your dream home and farm! Upgrade and customize up to 8 houses with hundreds of exterior decoration options for your house’s roof, walls, windows, doors, and patios, as well as over 30 themed sheds that can be placed anywhere on your farm — and that’s not including the treehouse in Nel’Vari and the Apartment in Withergate! Homes, sheds, and farms can be furnished with hundreds of different furniture and decor items that can be purchased, crafted, received in the mail, or traded in multiplayer. Progress the story in four different areas! Explore the medieval town of Sun Haven, the elven forests of Nel’Vari, the monster city of Withergate, or the mysterious underwater region of The Brinestone Deeps! Go on dates, get married, and even start a family! Experience heartwarming events with 23 available marriage candidates across all four towns through gifts, dialogue, events, quests, dates, and more! After getting married, upgrading your house, and maintaining a good relationship with your spouse, you’ll have the option to have one child through the powerful magic in Sun Haven! One fish, two fish, red fish… sewer fish? Enjoy the easy-to-learn, hard-to-master fishing minigame and catch over 130 fish across the world. These fish can be sold, cooked, donated to the Sun Haven Museum, gifted, or used in various quests! Craft to your heart’s content! Build and utilize over 40 unique crafting tables for cooking, smithing, construction, farming, furniture, and even alchemy! All four towns also have town-specific items and recipes! Fight monsters all over the world of Sun Haven! Fight tons of unique enemies across four towns. With swords, crossbows, staffs, and magic spells, the possibilities for combat are endless. Buy or upgrade your armor, eat food to increase your maximum stats, and unlock perks in the massive skill tree to unleash your full potential! Unlock floors in the mines to gather resources, gems, and ore! If you’re in a pinch, you can temporarily unlock mine floors with rusty keys, or permanently unlock them with smelted keys. Grab the chests on every 10th floor, upgrade your armor and tools with better ore, and fight enemies for loot! Take on tough bosses solo or in multiplayer! Test your strength in the Combat Arena alone or with friends. Fight your way through multiple different types of bosses and win amazing loot if you come out on top! An expansive character customization experience! Customize your character to your heart’s content with seven different races, ten different starting professions, and hundreds of clothing, hair, and other customization options. If you decide you want to change your appearance a few hours in, don’t worry — just take a trip to the Sun Haven Salon! A calendar full of events to celebrate! Enjoy seasonal festivals, holidays, and events, and make merry with all the different townsfolk. You’ll find some exclusive shop items such as pets, furniture, and food to buy at these festivals, so don’t forget your wallet! Fill up the museum and put all your hard work on display! The museum needs your help! Be sure to hang onto all the little trinkets you find when you’re out fishing, mining, foraging, or fighting. One adventurer’s trash is a museum’s treasure! Try out different builds with a massive skill tree full of versatile perks! Utilize the combat, exploration, farming, fishing, and mining skill trees to upgrade your character with tons of different buffs, skills, weapons, and spells. Once you hit level 70 in each skill, you can purchase skill elixirs from the Sun Haven Town Hall or craft skill tomes at an anvil to grow even stronger! Show off your completionist tendencies! Go achievement hunting for all 177 Steam Achievements related to romance, quests, storylines, festivals, skills, magic, advancements, combat, fishing, animals, farming, and so much more!

games.name: Suncraft
games.short_description: Another sun-filled day begins in this cozy pixel-art adventure. Gather, craft, upgrade, and help the villagers revive the land. Can you rebuild the grand Sunspire and bring the village back to its golden days?

descriptions.en: Another sun-filled day begins in this cozy pixel-art adventure. Gather, craft, upgrade, and help the villagers revive the land. Can you rebuild the grand Sunspire and bring the village back to its golden days?

detailed_descriptions.en: Suncraft is a cozy pixel art adventure focused on growth and restoration. Step into a peaceful world where every tool you craft brings a new spark of life to the village. Settle into a relaxing rhythm of progress as you watch the village return to the glory it once had. Do you want to enjoy the atmosphere of Suncraft? Wishlist Suncraft today to be notified at launch! CORE GAMEPLAY Explore and Gather Journey through the land and collect materials while unlocking new biomes. Craft and Rebuild Build workstations, construct machines, and craft components piece by piece to repair the village and revive the land. Upgrade and Automate Unlock new gear, master powerful skills, and recruit loyal companions to help you along the way. QUESTS AND MYSTERIES Complete objectives for villagers to uncover the story of the village.

games.name: Sunderfolk
games.short_description: Rediscover game night in this tactical RPG where shared strategy shapes every turn. Adventure across the Sunderlands with up to four players in online multiplayer using your mouse & keyboard or play couch co-op using phones as controllers. Play the first 4 missions for free!

descriptions.en: Rediscover game night in this tactical RPG where shared strategy shapes every turn. Adventure across the Sunderlands with up to four players in online multiplayer using your mouse & keyboard or play couch co-op using phones as controllers. Play the first 4 missions for free!

detailed_descriptions.en: Rediscover game night with Sunderfolk, a tactical co-op RPG built to bring people together. Whether teaming up across the globe via online multiplayer with a mouse and keyboard or playing couch co-op with phones as controllers, Sunderfolk adapts to your group. It’s your party, your plan, and your story to tell. Playing with phone controls? Only the host needs to own the game! Friends join for free using the free Sunderfolk Controller app as their hand of cards, guidebook, and controller. Just scan a QR code on a shared screen to jump right in. If you prefer a traditional PC experience you can team up with friends seamlessly through native online multiplayer. Control your heroes directly using full mouse and keyboard support, with your skill cards and stats integrated right on your screen (online multiplayer requires each player to own a copy of the game). Start your campaign and take on challenging missions together. Use powerful skill cards, choose your turn order, and plan every move. Outsmart enemies, adapt your tactics, and face down epic bosses. Between battles, unwind in the charming village of Arden. Upgrade shops, discover gear, share hearty meals, and connect with locals—some of whom may spark something more than friendship. The magic of gathering around the table, without the setup. Whether you're passing around snacks on the couch or strategizing over voice chat online, Sunderfolk brings friends and families together through thoughtful strategy and shared laughs. It’s game night exactly the way it should be.

games.name: Sunken Engine
games.short_description: Sunken Engine Lovecraftian Ship Repair Simulation. Restore your father’s old shipyard. Each arriving ship carries a dark mystery to be solved. Keep your customers satisfied while dealing with the strange and eerie happenings on the island.

descriptions.en: Sunken Engine Lovecraftian Ship Repair Simulation. Restore your father’s old shipyard. Each arriving ship carries a dark mystery to be solved. Keep your customers satisfied while dealing with the strange and eerie happenings on the island.
descriptions.zh-Hant: Sunken Engine 洛夫克拉夫特風格船隻修理模擬。重建父親留下的舊造船廠。每一艘到來的船隻都帶著需要解決的黑暗謎團。在滿足顧客的同時，還要應對島上奇怪而詭異的事件。
descriptions.ja: Sunken Engine ラヴクラフト風船舶修理シミュレーション。父が残した古い造船所を再建せよ。到着する船はそれぞれ解決すべき暗い謎を抱えています。顧客を満足させつつ、島で起こる奇妙で不気味な出来事に立ち向かいましょう。
descriptions.ko: Sunken Engine 러브크래프트풍 선박 수리 시뮬레이션. 아버지가 남긴 오래된 조선소를 복원하십시오. 도착하는 각 선박은 해결해야 할 어두운 미스터리를 지니고 있습니다. 고객을 만족시키는 동시에 섬에서 일어나는 기묘하고 으스스한 사건들에 맞서야 합니다.

detailed_descriptions.en: Ship Repair Business, But Lovecraftian Sunken Engine is a ship repair simulation game with a distinctive Lovecraftian atmosphere. After your father’s untimely death, you must keep the business you inherited alive. This means not only repairing ships but also keeping customers satisfied, maintaining the town’s order, and uncovering the mysteries your father left behind. Yet every new ship brings new challenges and ominous secrets. Dark Horror and Sanity The supernatural events you face during daily work will threaten your sanity. Losing your mental balance not only makes your job harder but may also attract the attention of dark entities. To survive, you must find ways to protect your mind, continue your work, and keep your wits if you wish to discover your father’s true legacy. Sunken Ship’s Goods Repairing is not the only way to sustain your business. You can sell valuable loot recovered from the sea at the stall behind your shop. The economy is difficult for everyone in town; you must care for your family while keeping the business alive. Sometimes, this means stepping beyond conventional ways to earn profit. Repair the Ships Your town is located in the middle of a busy sea route. Ships of various sizes and types dock for repairs, and it is your duty to meet the captains’ needs. Fixing damages is vital not just for your business but for the safety of the entire region. Yet some repairs may require more than just your tools… Customization and Progression You can renovate and improve your shop as you wish. By customizing your tools, workspace, and decorations, you can impress customers and bring to life the workshop your father once dreamed of. Ships and Licenses As you progress, you’ll learn to repair more ships and, with new licenses, take on more complex work. Each license opens the door to new types of ships and new challenges. But remember: not every ship is just a repair job—some bring with them dark stories and sinister secrets. Be cautious…
detailed_descriptions.zh-Hant: 造船修理廠，但帶有洛夫克拉夫特風格 Sunken Engine 是一款具有獨特洛夫克拉夫特氛圍的船隻修理模擬遊戲。在父親不幸去世後，你必須維持繼承下來的事業。這不僅意味著修理船隻，還需要讓顧客滿意、維持小鎮秩序，並揭開父親留下的秘密。然而，每一艘新船都會帶來新的挑戰和不祥的秘密。 黑暗恐懼與理智 你在日常工作中遇到的超自然事件將威脅你的理智。失去心理平衡不僅會讓工作變得更困難，還可能吸引黑暗存在的注意。為了生存，你必須找到保護心智的方法，堅持工作，並保持清醒，才能發現父親真正的遺產。 沉船戰利品 維持生意的方式不僅僅是修理。你可以將從海中打撈出的貴重物品在店舖後方的攤位出售。鎮上的經濟對每個人來說都很艱難；你必須照顧家人，同時維持事業。有時，這意味著必須走非常規的道路來獲取利潤。 修理船隻 你的城鎮位於繁忙的航道中央。各種大小和類型的船隻都會靠岸進行維修，而滿足船長們的需求是你的職責。修復損壞不僅對你的事業至關重要，對整個地區的安全也同樣重要。然而，有些故障可能需要的不僅僅是工具…… 自訂與發展 你可以按照自己的意願翻新和提升修理廠。透過自訂工具、工作區和裝飾，你可以打動顧客，並實現父親曾經夢想的工坊。 船隻與執照 隨著進展，你將學會修理更多的船隻，並透過新的執照承接更複雜的工作。每一張執照都為新的船隻類型和新的挑戰打開了大門。但請記住：並不是每艘船只是單純的維修工作 —— 有些還帶來了黑暗的故事和不祥的秘密。請小心……
detailed_descriptions.ja: 造船修理工房、しかしラヴクラフト風 Sunken Engine は独特なラヴクラフト風の雰囲気を持つ船舶修理シミュレーションです。父の早すぎる死の後、あなたは受け継いだ工房を維持しなければなりません。それは単に船を修理するだけでなく、顧客を満足させ、町の秩序を守り、父が残した謎を解き明かすことも意味します。しかし、やって来る新しい船はそれぞれ新たな挑戦と不吉な秘密を運んできます。 闇の恐怖と正気 日常業務の中で遭遇する超自然的な出来事は、あなたの正気を脅かします。精神的な均衡を失うことは仕事を困難にするだけでなく、闇の存在の注意を引くかもしれません。生き残るためには、心を守る方法を見つけ、仕事を続け、父の真の遺産を発見するために正気を保たなければなりません。 沈没船の戦利品 事業を維持する手段は修理だけではありません。海から引き上げた貴重な戦利品を工房裏の屋台で売ることができます。町の経済は誰にとっても厳しく、家族の世話をしつつ事業を続けなければなりません。時には利益を得るために通常とは異なる方法を取らざるを得ないこともあります。 船を修理せよ あなたの町は交通の多い航路の中央に位置しています。様々なサイズや種類の船が修理のために接岸し、船長たちの要望に応えるのはあなたの務めです。損傷を修復することは、あなたの事業にとってだけでなく、地域全体の安全にとっても極めて重要です。しかし、いくつかの修理には単なる道具以上のものが必要となるでしょう… カスタマイズと成長 工房を好きなように改装・改善できます。道具、作業スペース、装飾をカスタマイズすることで顧客を魅了し、父が夢見た工房を実現することができます。 船とライセンス 進行に伴い、より多くの船を修理する方法を学び、新しいライセンスによってより複雑な作業に取り組むことになります。各ライセンスは新たな種類の船と新しい挑戦への扉を開きます。しかし忘れないでください：すべての船が単なる修理作業ではありません — 中には暗い物語や不吉な秘密を抱えているものもあります。用心してください…
detailed_descriptions.ko: 조선소 수리소, 그러나 러브크래프트풍 Sunken Engine 은 독특한 러브크래프트 분위기를 지닌 선박 수리 시뮬레이션입니다. 아버지의 불행한 죽음 이후, 당신은 물려받은 사업을 지켜내야 합니다. 이는 단순히 선박을 수리하는 것만이 아니라, 고객을 만족시키고 마을의 질서를 유지하며 아버지가 남긴 비밀을 밝혀내는 것을 의미합니다. 그러나 새로운 선박은 항상 새로운 도전과 불길한 비밀을 함께 가져옵니다. 어둠의 공포와 정신력 일상 업무 중 마주하게 될 초자연적 사건들은 당신의 정신력을 위협할 것입니다. 정신적 균형을 잃는 것은 단순히 일을 어렵게 만들 뿐만 아니라 어두운 존재들의 주의를 끌 수도 있습니다. 살아남기 위해서는 정신을 지킬 방법을 찾아야 하며, 일을 이어가고 아버지의 진정한 유산을 발견하기 위해 이성을 잃지 말아야 합니다. 침몰선의 전리품 사업을 유지하는 방법은 수리뿐만이 아닙니다. 바다에서 건져 올린 귀중한 전리품을 작업장 뒤쪽의 노점에서 판매할 수 있습니다. 마을의 경제는 모두에게 힘들며, 가족을 부양하면서 사업도 지켜내야 합니다. 때로는 수익을 얻기 위해 관습적인 방식을 벗어나야 할 수도 있습니다. 선박을 수리하라 당신의 마을은 분주한 항로 한가운데에 위치해 있습니다. 다양한 크기와 유형의 선박이 수리를 위해 접안하며, 선장의 요구를 충족시키는 것은 당신의 의무입니다. 피해를 수리하는 것은 당신의 사업뿐만 아니라 지역 전체의 안전을 위해서도 매우 중요합니다. 그러나 일부 수리는 단순한 도구만으로는 해결되지 않을 수도 있습니다… 커스터마이징과 발전 당신은 작업장을 원하는 대로 개조하고 개선할 수 있습니다. 도구, 작업 공간, 장식을 커스터마이징하여 고객을 감동시키고 아버지가 꿈꿨던 작업장을 현실로 만들 수 있습니다. 선박과 면허 진행할수록 더 많은 선박을 수리하는 방법을 배우게 되며, 새로운 면허를 통해 더 복잡한 작업에 도전할 수 있습니다. 각 면허는 새로운 유형의 선박과 새로운 도전의 문을 열어줍니다. 하지만 잊지 마십시오: 모든 선박이 단순한 수리 작업은 아닙니다 — 어떤 선박은 어두운 이야기와 불길한 비밀을 품고 있습니다. 조심하십시오…

detailed_descriptions.en: Alric's father descended into the ruins beneath the city years ago. He never came back. Sunken Realms is a dungeon crawling adventure about a son who goes looking for answers. Descend into an abandoned underground city, battle monsters, collect materials, craft your gear, and master forgotten spells. Grow stronger. Go deeper. Find out what happened down there — and whether the truth is worth what it costs. No open world. No battle pass. Just a sword, a dungeon, and a question that won't let you go Features: • Hand-crafted rooms are procedurally re-arranged every time you enter the dungeon so you'll never play the same layout twice • Fluid Melee and Ranged combat • Learn spells to wield powerful, long-forgotten magic • Collect gold and crafting materials from vanquished foes and treasure chests • Return to camp to craft weapons, cook food, brew potions, trade, and upgrade your character • A heartfelt, personal story that unfolds between two friends around the campfire between runs • Immersive, original score

games.name: Sunkenland
games.short_description: Get ready for a Waterworld-themed survival game with modular base building, sunken city scavenging, crafting, base defense, and invasions of NPC clans for resources and territory. Ready for the water apocalypse?

descriptions.en: Get ready for a Waterworld-themed survival game with modular base building, sunken city scavenging, crafting, base defense, and invasions of NPC clans for resources and territory. Ready for the water apocalypse?

detailed_descriptions.en: Sunkenland is an exciting post-apocalyptic survival and exploration game set in the near future when water covered most of the Earth. Explore sunken cities, scavenge resources and valuable technologies, build your base, trade, fight and survive. Features Diving Explore the sunken skyscrapers, nuclear powerplants and subway tunnel. Gather resources, seek out lost technologies, and collect rare pre-apocalypse items. Build diving devices to assist your underwater journey. And be wary of the unknown danger awaiting you in the depths of this planet. Base Building Build your base anywhere you want. Will it be a water stronghold, an abandoned ship base or an island penthouse? You need it to keep yourself refreshed, craft items, farm, store items, and stay protected. With the modular building system, you can create your ideal enclave and stylize it with decorations found throughout your journey. Base Defense Defend your base against clans of pirates and mutants. Build high walls, barbed wire, traps, surveillance system, and artillery to keep the enemies out of your territory! Crafting Build everything you need, tools, weapons, a jetski, and even a helicopter. You will need different workstations and blueprints in order to craft complex items. Survival Gather food, hunt sharks, grow plants, and manage supplies. Make your base sustainable as resources are scarce in Sunkenland. Vehicles Build and upgrade many types of vehicles including sailboat, jetski and gyrocopters. They will make your exploration much more convenient. Fighting Fight mutants and pirates. Raid enemy atolls and steal their resources. Use melee weapons, firearms and explosives. Fight on ocean and land. Operate mounted heavy weapons to destroy enemy boats. Trading Trade with friendly atolls for supplies, weapons, armor and rare items. There is no universal currency, only item for item. Co-op Cooperate with friends and survive this oceanic apocalypse as a group. Build bases, dive, explore and fight pirates together!

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Sunkenland is an exciting post-apocalyptic survival and exploration game set in the near future when water covered most of the Earth. Explore sunken cities, scavenge resources and valuable technologies, build your base, trade, fight and survive.

Features

Diving

Explore the sunken skyscrapers, nuclear powerplants and subway tunnel. Gather resources, seek out lost technologies, and collect rare pre-apocalypse items. Build diving devices to assist your underwater journey. And be wary of the unknown danger awaiting you in the depths of this planet.

Base Building

Build your base anywhere you want. Will it be a water stronghold, an abandoned ship base or an island penthouse? You need it to keep yourself refreshed, craft items, farm, store items, and stay protected. With the modular building system, you can create your ideal enclave and stylize it with decorations found throughout your journey.

Base Defense

Defend your base against clans of pirates and mutants. Build high walls, barbed wire, traps, surveillance system, and artillery to keep the enemies out of your territory!

Crafting

Build everything you need, tools, weapons, a jetski, and even a helicopter. You will need different workstations and blueprints in order to craft complex items.

Survival

Gather food, hunt sharks, grow plants, and manage supplies. Make your base sustainable as resources are scarce in Sunkenland.

Vehicles

Build and upgrade many types of vehicles including sailboat, jetski and gyrocopters. They will make your exploration much more convenient.

Fighting

Fight mutants and pirates. Raid enemy atolls and steal their resources. Use melee weapons, firearms and explosives. Fight on ocean and land. Operate mounted heavy weapons to destroy enemy boats.

Trading

Trade with friendly atolls for supplies, weapons, armor and rare items. There is no universal currency, only item for item.

Co-op

Cooperate with friends and survive this oceanic apocalypse as a group. Build bases, dive, explore and fight pirates together!

games.name: SUNLESS SEA
games.short_description: LOSE YOUR MIND. EAT YOUR CREW. DIE. Take the helm of your steamship and set sail for the unknown! Sunless Sea is a game of discovery, loneliness and frequent death, set in the award-winning Victorian Gothic universe of Fallen London.

descriptions.en: LOSE YOUR MIND. EAT YOUR CREW. DIE. Take the helm of your steamship and set sail for the unknown! Sunless Sea is a game of discovery, loneliness and frequent death, set in the award-winning Victorian Gothic universe of Fallen London.

detailed_descriptions.en: LOSE YOUR MIND. EAT YOUR CREW. DIE. Sunless Sea is a Gothic Horror RPG with a focus on exploration, exquisite storytelling and frequent death. Captain a Victorian steamship on a vast underground sea If the giant crabs, sentient icebergs and swarms of bats don’t get you, madness and cannibalism certainly will. But that old black ocean beckons, and there’s loot for the brave souls who dare to sail her. Seek out intriguing individuals for your crew Hire unique officers like the Haunted Doctor and the Irrepressible Cannoneer. Each has a story to tell, if you can draw it out of them. Stray from the gas-lamps of civilisation Light and dark, terror and madness: spend too long on the wide, dark sea and your crew will grow fearful and eventually lose their sanity. Carve a life for your captain in a cruel and unique world A deep, compelling world packed with 350,000+ words of stories and secrets. Find your father’s bones. Determine London’s destiny. Defy the gods of the deep sea. Your captain will die. Pass on resources from one generation to the next. Acquire a family home and a hoard of heirlooms. Build a legacy of zailors who braved the sea and lost - or, occasionally, won. Features Beautiful, hand drawn art - castles of sparkling ice, prisons perched on lily pads, fog-shrouded lighthouses and the DAWN MACHINE. Real-time combat against ships and Zee-beasts, spider-crewed dreadnoughts and sentient icebergs. Upgrade your steamship with powerful engines, cannons and pneumatic torpedo guns. (Or buy a bigger, better ship.) Choose a ship’s mascot: the Comatose Ferret, the Wretched Mog, the Elegiac Cockatoo, and more! Trade or smuggle silk and souls, mushroom wine and hallucinogenic honey. Who are Failbetter Games? We’re a boutique games studio based in London, UK. We’ve been making indie games since 2009. If you’ve read this far, this game is almost certainly for you.

games.name: Sunset Overdrive
games.short_description: Sunset Overdrive transforms an open-world apocalypse into your tactical playground. Zip, grind and wall-run across Sunset City with an unconventional arsenal. Hyper-agility, unique weapons, and customizable abilities deliver an explosive and irreverent adventure in the end times.

descriptions.en: Sunset Overdrive transforms an open-world apocalypse into your tactical playground. Zip, grind and wall-run across Sunset City with an unconventional arsenal. Hyper-agility, unique weapons, and customizable abilities deliver an explosive and irreverent adventure in the end times.

detailed_descriptions.en: Don’t miss the single-player campaign from the game that IGN awarded Best Xbox One Game of 2014, the game that Polygon rated 9 out of 10, and the game that Eurogamer calls “a breath of fresh air.” In Sunset Overdrive, the year is 2027 and Sunset City is under siege. A contaminated energy drink has transformed most of the population into toxic mutants. For many it's the end of the world, but for you it’s a dream come true. Your old boss? Dead. Your boring job? Gone. Transform the open-world into your tactical playground by grinding, vaulting and wall-running across the city while using a devastating, unconventional arsenal. With hyper-agility, unique weapons, and customizable special abilities, Sunset Overdrive rewrites the rules of traditional shooters and delivers an explosive, irreverent, stylish, and totally unique adventure. Embrace the chaos of Sunset City through a hyper-colorful, post-apocalyptic single-player campaign and two bonus expansions, Mystery of Mooil Rig and Dawn of the Rise of the Fallen Machines. Outgun crazed mutants, homicidal robots, and villainous thugs on your journeys with the included Weapons Pack. Features: - An Open World with No Rules - Leap off buildings, run along walls, and grind power lines and rails to destroy your foes from every angle. - Over-the-top Weapons - Collect and upgrade an arsenal of unconventional weapons that use items like dynamite, fireworks, harpoons, and acid to destroy your enemies.

For the sake of Earth's peace and his own destiny, he must confront them! ③ SUPER BOMBERMAN 3 [Japanese Version / European Version] The evil Professor Bagura has revived the vicious Bomber Quintet, once defeated by Bomberman, and has begun his march towards cosmic conquest. ④ SUPER BOMBERMAN 4 [Japanese Version (English localised version available)] Bomberman has been transported to different eras by the Four Bomber Kings. Party battle game "SUPER BOMBERMAN" is now available as a collection featuring a total of 7 titles with 12 versions across JP, EUR and USA, including the long-awaited localised versions of the unreleased SUPER BOMBERMAN 4 and 5!

Including Boss Rush mode to time attack against all the bosses in each title, support functions, libraries and more!

Carat Diamond, the evil power-hungry tyrant, and scientist Dr. Mook! Defeat the robot army they command and thwart their ambitions!

Our Bomberman has been captured by the sudden appearance of the vicious Bomber Quintet. For the sake of Earth's peace and his own destiny, he must confront them!

The evil Professor Bagura has revived the vicious Bomber Quintet, once defeated by Bomberman, and has begun his march towards cosmic conquest.

Bomberman has been transported to different eras by the Four Bomber Kings. What is their purpose? And what is the mysterious entity lurking in the shadows?

A mysterious man calling himself the Emperor of another world, ‘Terrorin’. He has freed eight ‘Vicious Bombers’ from prison and begun an invasion with them as his subordinates.

⑥ Bomberman [Japanese Version]

The commemorative work that laid the foundation for the series. Conquer all 50 stages!

⑦ Bomberman II [Japanese Version]

The sequel to Bomberman. The work that implemented versus play.

‘Boss Rush’

A challenge mode where you battle bosses from each game consecutively in a time attack!

games.short_description: A physics-based co-op platformer about a guy in a rabbit costume! Team up with a friend or three (local or online) to beat levels, find hidden carrots and race against the clock. Experience bunny madness. Embrace carrot chaos. Become Super Bunny Man.

descriptions.en: A physics-based co-op platformer about a guy in a rabbit costume! Team up with a friend or three (local or online) to beat levels, find hidden carrots and race against the clock. Experience bunny madness. Embrace carrot chaos. Become Super Bunny Man.
descriptions.zh-Hant: 一款關於一個穿著兔子裝的人的物理性合作平台遊戲！與一或三位朋友（本地或線上）組隊通關，找出隱藏的蘿蔔、與時間競賽。體驗兔子狂熱，擁抱蘿蔔渾沌，成為超級兔子人。
descriptions.ja: あの伝説のおバカゲー！物理エンジンの協力型プラットフォーマーゲーム。ウサギの衣装を身にまとう謎の男！仲間と一緒にレベルをクリアし、隠されたニンジンを見つけて、タイムアタックを制覇しよう！笑が止まらなくなる、クレイジーなゲームを今すぐ楽しもう！ゲームはオンラインも対応可能！
descriptions.ko: 토끼 코스튬을 입은 사람이 나오는 물리 엔진 기반 협동 플랫폼 게임! 친구 한 명 혹은 세 명(로컬 혹은 온라인)과 협력해 레벨을 깨고, 숨겨진 당근을 찾고, 시간과의 싸움을 하세요. 토끼의 광기를 체험해 보세요. 당근의 혼돈을 받아들이세요. Super Bunny Man이 되세요.

detailed_descriptions.en: The best game ever made about a guy in a rabbit costume jumping through wormholes. Embark on a challenging journey through time and space in search of something non-specific that will leave you with intense feelings of [INSERT STIRRING EMOTION HERE]! Super Bunny Man is a chaotic co-op physics-based platformer where you use rolling, jumping, and grabbing to overcome challenges. Bring a friend. Beat levels, time attacks, enter wormholes, and find hidden carrots, all while evading spikes, boulders, pitfalls, and other challenges. Become Super Bunny Man! Story Mode Play solo or get together with a friend (local or online) for some carrot co-op mayhem! Traverse 50 challenging levels across different worlds: Forest, Snow, Cave, Beach and Stadium! Party Mode Multiplayer : up to 4 players! Online & Local! Deathmatch : kick your friends off cliffs, drag them onto spikes, break their necks! (Disclaimer: not recommended for fragile or strained friendships). Basketball : Choose a team, then fight to get the ball into your hoop! Carrot Grab : Strap on a jet pack and collect more carrots than the other team! ... and much, much more! Controller support for up to 4 players! Physics-based character and interactive world. Mind-blowing 2.5D computer-generated graphical images! Evocative musical soundtrack, with grooves so addictive they've been banned in dance clubs across the world! Unbelievable dance moves! Embrace carrot chaos. Become Super Bunny Man today!
detailed_descriptions.zh-Hant: 這是款以穿著兔子裝的人跳過蟲洞為主題有史以來最佳的遊戲。踏上一趟充滿挑戰的旅程，穿越時間與空間找尋各種會為你帶來劇烈的[INSERT STIRRING EMOTION HERE]感覺的非特定物品。 Super Bunny Man是一款混亂的物理性合作平台遊戲，你可以於遊戲中翻滾、跳躍和抓取以克服各種挑戰。帶上朋友吧，通關、與時間競速、進入蟲洞並找出隱藏的蘿蔔，同時躲開尖刺、巨石、陷阱與其他挑戰。成為Super Bunny Man! 劇情模式 單人或是和一位朋友（本地或線上）一起合作度過蘿蔔的混亂！在不同的世界中（森林、雪地、山洞、海灘、體育館）跨越50個充滿挑戰的關卡！ 派對模式 • 多人：最多4位玩家！線上和在地都可！ • Deathmatch：把你的朋友踢下懸崖、拖上尖刺、折斷脖子！（免責聲明：友情脆弱或緊張的話並不推薦）。 • Basketball：選擇一個隊伍，然後對戰把球放進你的籃框！ • Carrot Grab：綁上噴射背包，蒐集比其他隊伍更多的蘿蔔！ ... 還有很多很多！ • 控制器可支援至多4位玩家！ • 具物理性的角色和具互動性的世界。 • 令人大為驚奇的2.5D電腦生成的畫面！ • 餘音繞樑的音樂原聲帶，節奏感有夠上癮，所以全世界的夜店都不能播！ • 神乎其技的舞步！ 擁抱蘿蔔渾沌，現在就成為超級兔子人！
detailed_descriptions.ja: あの伝説のおバカゲー！かつて見たこともないようなクレイジーなゲーム…スーパーバニーマン。うさぎのコスチュームを着た男の正体は未だ誰も知らない。 彼はたくさんの過酷なトラップを乗り越えゴールを目指していく。うさぎのコスチュームを着た謎の男バニーマン！彼が目指しているものとはいるものとはいったい… スーパーバニーマンは物理エンジンのプラットフォーム型ゲームです。転がる、ジャンプする、つかむの操作を使いながら５０のレベルをクリアしていきます。それぞれのレベルには様々な危険がバニーマンとあなたを待っています。さあ！あなたもスーパーバニーマンになり、様々な困難に立ち向かおう！ ストーリーモード（１人〜２人まで）オンライン対応 協力プレイは最大2人までオンライン、ローカルプレイで一緒にプレイできます。 50のレベルをバニーマンのスーパージャンプやスーパーローリングでコインを集めてクリアしていくゲームです。それぞれのレベルでコインは3つあります。 レベルクリア : ゴールまで無事にたどり着こう！ にんじん : にんじんを見つけてゴールまで運ぼう！ タイムアッタク : それぞれのレベルにあるタイムアッタクのタイムを超えよう！ パーティーモード （１人〜４人まで）オンライン対応 最大4人までで同時に遊べます。 デスマッチ: それぞれのワールドで生き残りをかけた熱い戦い！ バスケットボール: これはただのバスケットボールではない…バニーマンのスーパーパワーを使ってポイントを稼げ！ キャロットグラブ: どちらのチームが多くのキャロットを手に入れられるか！？どんな手を使ってでもにんじんを集めまくれ！
detailed_descriptions.ko: 토끼 코스튬을 입은 사람이 웜홀로 점프해 들어가는 게임 중 최고입니다. 시공을 넘은 도전적인 여행을 시작하여 알 수 없는 무언가를 찾으면 극심한 [신나는 감정을 이곳에 삽입하십시오] 기분이 들 겁니다! Super Bunny Man은 구르기, 점프하기, 붙잡기를 사용해 도전에 성공하는 혼돈의 물리엔진 기반 협동 플랫폼 게임입니다. 친구를 데려오세요. 레벨, 시간 제한을 깨고, 웜홀에 들어가고, 숨겨진 당근을 찾고, 이 모든 걸 가시, 바위, 함정, 다른 위험 요소를 피하면서 해내세요. games.name: Super Fantasy Kingdom
games.short_description: Rebuild your kingdom and explore a vibrant fantasy world in this roguelite city builder. Defeat hordes of monsters with a unique team of defenders as you harvest, build, mine, cook, brew, and grow. But if your defenses should fail, be prepared to watch it all burn!

descriptions.en: Rebuild your kingdom and explore a vibrant fantasy world in this roguelite city builder. Defeat hordes of monsters with a unique team of defenders as you harvest, build, mine, cook, brew, and grow. But if your defenses should fail, be prepared to watch it all burn!

detailed_descriptions.en: Returning from a hunting trip to find your lands in ruin, you must rebuild your home while fending off hordes of monsters that attack your gates every night. Should your city fall and the forces of darkness sweep across the land, you will awaken to begin a new run where you carry forward the rewards of prior attempts – more heroes at your disposal, previously unexplored lands already uncovered, and every opportunity to push further as you uncover the mystery that has you trapped in a never-ending cycle of life and death. As night falls, hordes of monsters emerge from the darkness in an attempt to destroy everything you’ve built, charging towards your gates and growing more vicious as the night draws on. Powerful bosses will test your defenses ruthlessly, and the only thing standing in their way is the collection of stalwart warriors, powerful creatures, and magical beings you’ve recruited to defend your lands. Each run you may choose a different powerful guardian to lead your defenses, each with their own strengths, weaknesses, and opportunities for unique strategies and growth through equipment and experience. Will your ice priestess freeze monsters in place for your crossbowmen and halfling to score easy shots from range, or will your knight charge into battle while a trebuchet flings rocks overhead? Explore the world to meet over 50 unique units that you can recruit into your cause to find the best combinations – vampires guarding halfling slingers, dinosaurs charging ahead of genie spellcasters, or crossbowmen supporting brave men-at-arms? Seek them out in the world, using your hard-earned resources to hire them to your cause and upgrade their abilities, or wait for wandering warriors to appear, with each run offering different opportunities for recruitment. Careful planning and strategic choice will define each run as you manage resources, troops, and the kingdom at large. With limited locations for buildings, and more options than you’ll have space for, prepare to make simple but difficult decisions with lasting impact. Resource locations and availability are randomized with each run and you’ll need to make vital decisions on what to prioritize – quick access to raw materials is essential early on, but optimizing production chains is vital as time goes on. Unlock more advanced methods of acquiring resources over time to free up your workforce, but make sure you prioritize what you need for your planned strategy – will you scale up your defenses by focusing on forestry and plank production to build trebuchets and catapults, or will you prioritize the acquisition of stone to build strong walls? Or perhaps you seek optimal gold production to more quickly afford upgrades for your most capable warriors? As your heroes gather at the tavern to celebrate each night’s hard-fought victory, they grow stronger by eating the meals you have prepared. Build fishing huts, farms, mills, and more to feed your warriors and help them prepare for what lies beyond the walls! Explore the world and uncover its secrets – from heroes and resources to quests, challenges, and more! The lands of Super Fantasy Kingdom are vibrant and alive, and you never know who or what you’ll find along the way. These elements mean that strategic choices for city building and combat will keep evolving and changing over time. Earn enough glory in battle to gain access to more strategic options within your kingdom – the longer you survive the further you’ll be able to explore and the more opportunities available for the next run. Your discoveries carry over to future cycles, unlocking entirely new starting options and strategic approaches that were previously several nights of battle away. These include powerful guardians, brave heroes, tricky relics, or even allies to help you out. Super Fantasy Kingdom is designed for replayability with unpredictable opportunities and a variety of game-changing mechanics across worlds and kingdoms. Play endlessly with different strategies and approaches in a game that is easy to learn, but hard to master.

games.name: Super Meat Boy
games.short_description: The infamous, tough-as-nails platformer comes to Steam with a playable Head Crab character (Steam-exclusive)!

descriptions.en: The infamous, tough-as-nails platformer comes to Steam with a playable Head Crab character (Steam-exclusive)!

detailed_descriptions.en: Super Meat Boy is a tough as nails platformer where you play as an animated cube of meat who's trying to save his girlfriend (who happens to be made of bandages) from an evil fetus in a jar wearing a tux. Our meaty hero will leap from walls, over seas of buzz saws, through crumbling caves and pools of old needles. Sacrificing his own well being to save his damsel in distress. Super Meat Boy brings the old school difficulty of classic NES titles like Mega Man 2, Ghost and Goblins and Super Mario Bros. 2 (The Japanese one) and stream lines them down to the essential no BS straight forward twitch reflex platforming. Ramping up in difficulty from hard to soul crushing SMB will drag Meat boy though haunted hospitals, salt factories and even hell itself. And if 300+ single player levels weren't enough SMB also throws in epic boss fights, a level editor and tons of unlock able secrets, warp zones and hidden characters. Story mode, featuring over 300 levels spanning 5+ chapters Play as a Head Crab! (Steam Exclusive) 33 legitimate Achievements Warp zones that will warp you into other games Over 16 unlockable able and playable characters from popular indie titles such as, Minecraft, Bit.Trip, VVVVVV and Machinarium Epic Boss fights Full Level Editor and Level Portal (January 2011) A story so moving you will cry yourself to sleep for the rest of your life

games.name: Super Meat Boy 3D
games.short_description: The infamous, tough-as-nails platformer – now in 3D!

descriptions.en: The infamous, tough-as-nails platformer – now in 3D!
descriptions.zh-Hant: 臭名昭著、難如登天的平台遊戲，現已推出 3D 版！
descriptions.ja: あの悪名高き骨太&硬派プラットフォーマーが3Dになって登場！
descriptions.ko: 어렵기로 소문난 이 플랫폼 게임을 이제 3D로 만나보세요!

detailed_descriptions.en: Super Meat Boy 3D is a tough as nails platformer where you play as an animated cube of meat who's trying to save his girlfriend (who happens to be made of bandages) from an evil fetus in a jar wearing a tux – IN 3D ! Our meaty hero will leap from walls, over seas of buzz saws, through crumbling caves and pools of old trash sacrificing his own well-being to save his damsel in distress – IN 3D! Super Meat Boy 3D brings the old school difficulty of classic retro titles we all know and love and streamlines them down to the essential no bull straight forward twitch reflex platforming. Ramping up in difficulty from hard to soul crushing Meat Boy will brave lush (but also on fire) forests, vast dumps filled with the waste of mankind, and high-tech forges producing the very traps that will inevitably kill Meat Boy over and over and over - IN 3D! And if a bunch of levels weren't enough, we also have epic boss fights and tons of unlockable secrets – IN 3D! Tough-as-nails precision platforming action Brutal, but fair levels designed to break you. Boss. Fights. Dark World levels so tough, you'll scream in the rain at a bus stop. A soundtrack that was once described by a Guitar Center employee as “hey, either buy the guitars or get out. We’re seriously going to call the cops!” 3D!
detailed_descriptions.zh-Hant: 《Super Meat Boy 3D》是一款難度極高的平台遊戲。你要扮演活跳跳的肉塊，從燕尾服罐裝造型的邪惡胎兒手中，拯救女友 (OK 繃化身)；一切均以 3D 呈現！肉塊英雄會奮不顧身地跳下高牆、穿越電鋸海、通過逐漸崩塌的洞穴和舊垃圾池，拯救落難美人；一切均以 3D 呈現。《Super Meat Boy 3D》採用大家熟悉且喜愛的經典復古遊戲難度，然後化繁為簡，變成直接明快的直覺反射式平台遊戲。難度從困難到令人崩潰，Meat Boy 會勇闖著火的茂密森林、堆滿人類廢棄物的大型垃圾場，以及產生致命陷阱的高科技鐵工廠，讓 Meat Boy 一次次慘死；一切均以 3D 呈現！如果大量關卡不過癮，還有史詩級魔王戰和超多待解鎖的謎題；一切均以 3D 呈現！ 難如登天的精準平台動作遊戲。 殘酷但公平的關卡，難到令人崩潰 多回魔王戰 D黑暗世界關卡很難，讓你就算在公車站躲雨時遊玩都會忍不住尖叫。 遊戲原聲帶的音樂吵鬧到，曾讓美國最大樂器零售商 Guitar Center 的員工警告「喂，如果不買吉他就離開，不然我們真的要報警了。」 3D
detailed_descriptions.ja: 『Super Meat Boy 3D』 は骨太&硬派なプラットフォーマー作品だ。3Dになった世界を舞台に動く肉塊のような主人公ミートボーイを操作して、恋人（なぜか身体がバンソーコーでできている）をタキシードを着た邪悪な瓶詰めの胎児から救うのだ！ 3Dの世界で我らの肉々しいヒーローとなって、壁から壁へ飛び移り、丸ノコの海を超え、崩壊する洞窟を潜り抜け、健康を犠牲に古いゴミの山を抜け、囚われの恋人を助け出せ！ 『Super Meat Boy 3D』 は、誰もが愛する昔懐かしいクラシックなレトロゲームの難しさを味わえる、そうした作品群をホンモノかつシンプルな、手に汗にぎるプラットフォーマーへと進化させた作品だ。ミートボーイを操って、心を砕くレべルへと難度が上昇していくステージを抜け、青々とした（ただし炎に包まれている）森、人間の廃棄物で一杯の広大なゴミ捨て場、そしてミートボーイを確実に何度も殺す罠を製造するハイテク加熱炉へと、3Dの世界を勇敢に突き進め！ 大量に用意されたステージでも満足できないプレイヤーのために、壮大なボス戦や大量のアンロック可能なシークレット要素も用意されている！ しかも3Dで！ 骨太&硬派な、精密なプラットフォーム・アクション プレイヤーの心を折りにくる、惨たらしくもフェアなレベルデザイン ボス戦 雨のバス停で泣くほど難しい、ダークな世界のステージ ある楽器屋の従業員に、かつて「おい、ギター買わないなら帰れ。冗談抜きに警察を呼ぶぞ」と評されたサウンドトラック 3D!
detailed_descriptions.ko: 어렵기로 소문난 플랫폼 게임이 3D로 돌아왔습니다. Super Meat Boy 3D에서 살아 움직이는 육면체 고깃덩어리가 되어, 턱시도를 입은 사악한 단지 속 태아에게 납치당한 여자 친구(놀랍게도 반창고로 만들어진 여자 친구죠)를 구하기 위한 여정을 떠납니다. 3D로요! 우리의 고깃덩어리 영웅은 여자친구를 구하기 위해 안락한 인생 따위는 버려두고 벽을 뛰어넘고, 회전톱 바다를 건너고, 무너지는 동굴과 쓰레기 구덩이를 헤치고 나아갑니다. 3D로요! Super Meat Boy 3D는 우리 모두가 잘 아는 고전 레트로 타이틀의 난이도를 그대로 구현하면서도, 불필요한 부분은 모두 덜어내고 오직 반사 신경으로 승부하는 직관적인 플랫폼 게임으로 거듭났습니다. 난이도는 단순히 어려운 수준에서 영혼이 으스러지는 듯한 수준까지 치솟습니다. Meat Boy는 무성하면서도 불에 타고 있는 숲, 인류가 버린 쓰레기로 가득한 거대한 폐기장, 몇 번이고 Meat Boy의 목숨을 앗아갈 수 있는 함정을 생산하는 최첨단 용광로를 용감하게 여행합니다. 3D로요! 이 수많은 레벨만으로는 부족한 분들을 위해 엄청난 보스전과 잠금 해제 가능한 비밀 요소도 마련해 두었죠. 3D로요! 어렵고도 정밀한 플랫폼 액션 좌절감을 안길 목적으로 설계된, 잔혹하지만 공정한 레벨 보스전. 혈투. 엄청나게 어려워서 비 오는 날 버스 정류장에서 절규하게 되는 Dark World 레벨 이걸 연주하는 걸 들은 기타 센터 직원에게 “그 기타 사지 않을 거면 나가세요. 진짜 경찰 부를 거니까.”라는 평을 들은 전설의 사운드트랙 3D

games.short_description: Super Meat Boy is back! This time around Meat Boy is always running, literally it's an auto-runner. You will jump, dive, slide and punch your way through brutal levels and mean boss fights. We designed 5,000+ levels so you can play the game over and over without seeing the same level twice.

You will jump, dive, slide and punch your way through brutal levels and mean boss fights. We designed 5,000+ levels so you can play the game over and over without seeing the same level twice.

detailed_descriptions.en: The challenge of Super Meat Boy returns in Super Meat Boy Forever! This time around Meat Boy is always running, like literally...it's an auto-runner . He can't stop and he won't stop. Levels are brutal, death is inevitable, and players will get that sweet feeling of accomplishment after beating a level. Players will run, jump, punch and kick their way through familiar settings and totally new worlds. What’s better than playing through Super Meat Boy Forever once? The answer is simple: Playing through Super Meat Boy Forever several times and having new levels to play each time. We created over 6000 level chunks and smash them together to create new unique levels and each time the game is completed the option to replay the game appears and generates a whole new experience by presenting different levels with their own unique secret locations. We’ve handcrafted literally thousands of levels for players to enjoy and conquer. You can replay Super Meat Boy Forever from start to finish several times before ever seeing a duplicate level. It is truly a remarkable feat of engineering and a monumental example of ignoring the limits of rational game design and production. Super Meat Boy Forever takes place a few years after the events of Super Meat Boy. Meat Boy and Bandage Girl have been living a happy life free of Dr. Fetus for several years and they now have a wonderful little baby named Nugget. Nugget is joy personified and she is everything to Meat Boy and Bandage Girl. One day while our heroes were on a picnic, Dr. Fetus snuck up on them, beat Meat Boy and Bandage Girl unconscious with a shovel and kidnapped Nugget! When our heroes came to and found that Nugget was missing, they knew who to go after. They cracked their knuckles and decided to never stop until they got Nugget back and taught Dr. Fetus a very important lesson. A lesson that can only be taught with punches and kicks.

detailed_descriptions.en: 30 years on, the battle for our world's future continues. Super Robot Wars is a tactical RPG that brings characters and robots from a variety of mecha anime together to battle their mutual foes. Players follow characters through adventure and battle. Take control of giant robots on a battle map, commanding them to defeat their enemies. The battle switches between ally and enemy phases. Once the player has moved and attacked with their robots, the enemy takes their turn. When all enemies have been defeated, the game proceeds to an Intermission. During Intermission, the player can use resources earned in battle to train pilots, upgrade robots, and earn bonuses for their army. They then can proceed to the next chapter of the adventure. In Super Robot Wars, players can enjoy a unique experience that combines all-star mecha series crossovers, action-packed attack animations, and the chance to upgrade your favorite machines and pilots. descriptions.en: SUPERHOT is the smash-hit FPS where time moves only when you move. No regenerating health bars. No conveniently placed ammo drops. It's you, alone, outnumbered and outgunned. Snatch weapons from fallen enemies to shoot, slice and dodge through a truly cinematic hurricane of slow-motion bullets.

detailed_descriptions.en: Blurring the lines between cautious strategy and unbridled mayhem, SUPERHOT is the smash-hit FPS in which time moves only when you move. No regenerating health bars. No conveniently placed ammo drops. It's you, alone, outnumbered and outgunned. Snatch weapons from fallen enemies to shoot, slice and dodge through a truly cinematic hurricane of slow-motion bullets Do you crave meaning? Acceptance? Decrypt a deep and multi-layered narrative. Find the answers you seek. Mind is software. Let the System set you free. SUPERHOT Features: Innovation - a truly original hybrid puzzle-shooter title like no other. Time only moves when you do. No need to hurry, take your time. Story & Lore - in a way you have never experienced before. Many Extras – delve deeper into SUPERHOT with mini-games, challenges, ASCII art, and [redacted]. Challenge Mode – replay SUPERHOT with no restarts, speed runs, and more. Endless Mode – how long can you last against unyielding waves of enemies? With its unique, stylized graphics SUPERHOT adds something new and disruptive to the FPS genre. SUPERHOT’s polished, minimalist visual language helps you focus on what's most important – the fluid gameplay and the cinematic beauty of the fight. Thirty months in the making. Thousands of hours put into development and design. From its humble origins in the 7 Day FPS game jam, through a hugely successful Kickstarter campaign to a plethora of awards and nominations from industry experts, SUPERHOT is a labor of love by its independent, dedicated team and thousands of backers from all around the globe.

games.short_description: Lose track of what’s real. Commit yourself, body and mind. Confront the evocative, elegantly brutal world of SUPERHOT VR. Enemies pouring into the room from all sides, dozens of bullets coursing through the air... Wait. Something seems different in here...

descriptions.en: Lose track of what’s real. Commit yourself, body and mind. Confront the evocative, elegantly brutal world of SUPERHOT VR. Enemies pouring into the room from all sides, dozens of bullets coursing through the air... Wait. Something seems different in here...
descriptions.zh-Hant: 亦真亦幻，難以分辨。從肉體到靈魂，都要相信自己。迎接 SUPERHOT VR 那久違的、華麗而又殘忍的世界吧。敵人，如潮水，四面八方湧入房間；子彈，幾十枚，尖聲呼嘯穿過空氣……等一下。這兒，好像有什麼不同……

descriptions.ko: 현실 감각 따윈 집어치우십시오. 육체와 정신 모두를 쏟아부으십시오 아련하고 우아하면서 잔혹한, SUPERHOT VR의 세계와 대면하십시오. 사방에서 쏟아지는 적들, 공기를 가르고 날아오는 총알들까지... 잠깐만요. 여기 뭔가 다른 게 있군요...

detailed_descriptions.en: Multi-award winning, smash-hit SUPERHOT VR blurs the lines between cautious strategy and unbridled mayhem. The definitive smash-hit VR action experience. Time moves only when you move. No regenerating health bars. No conveniently placed ammo drops. It's you, alone, outnumbered and outgunned. Snatch weapons from fallen enemies to shoot, slice and dodge through a truly cinematic hurricane of slow-motion bullets. A truly original hybrid puzzle-shooter title like no other. Something is different here. Lose track of what’s real. M░D IS SOFTWAR▒ Decisive winner of dozens of VR Game of the Year awards, SUPERHOT VR is a title reimagined and redesigned from the ground up for VR and hand tracking controllers. The fruit of over three years of close cooperation between the critically acclaimed SUPERHOT Team and Oculus, SUPERHOT VR brings the intensely visceral action of SUPERHOT directly into your head and soul. And now – directly into your VR headset too. 🏆 GDCA Best VR Game 2018 Winner 🏆 SXSW Best VR Game 2018 Winner 🏆 DICE Awards Immersive Reality Game of The Year 2017 winner. 🏆 New York Game Awards Best Virtual Reality Game 2017 winner. 🏆 Unity Vision Summit Virtual Reality Game 2017 winner. 🏆 Pixel.Awards Best Virtual Reality Game 2017 winner. 🏆 Digital Dragons Best Virtual Reality Game 2017 winner. 🏆 GDCA Best VR Game 2017 nominee. 🏆 SXSW Trending Game of the Year 2017 nominee. SUPERHOT VR includes the massive SUPERHOT FOREVER update, bringing hours of new replayable challenges, achievements and hardcore endless levels to SUPERHOT VR's time-bending gameplay, including: Test your aim where only headshots take out enemies. Race against your best scores in bullet-time and real-time. Try to complete the game without shooting. Get hardcore with faster enemies and less reaction time. The game will test your limits. It will bring pain – of the good kind. In the end you will prevail. You will be one with the system.
detailed_descriptions.zh-Hant: "SUPERHOT 這款主視角射擊遊戲，打通了小心謀劃策略與大膽搏殺進擊之間的界限。遊戲中，只有人前進，時間才前進。生命條不會恢復；彈藥也不會隨隨便便投送。敵人，人數比你多，火力比你猛；而你，只是孤身一人，要撿拾死去敵人的武器，去射擊，去砍殺，還要穿行於低速移動的密集子彈之間，艱難前進。 SUPERHOT VR，專為虛擬現實、手勢識別追蹤手柄，重新構思，重新設計。遊戲剛剛推出，即獲諸多虛擬現實遊戲年度獎項。三年多的銳意開拓，使得 SUPERHOT VR，將 SUPERHOT 震人心魄的激烈效果，直接投入到了你的腦海裡，心靈中。現在又 - 直接投入到你 SteamVR 的虛擬現實世界中。 🏆 2017 年 DICE 大獎虛擬現實遊戲獎得主 🏆 2017 年 Unity Vision Summit 虛擬現實遊戲獎得主 🏆 2017 年 Pixel 大獎最佳虛擬現實遊戲獎得主 🏆 2017 年 Digital Dragons 最佳虛擬現實遊戲獎得主 🏆 2017 年 GDCA 最佳虛擬現實遊戲獎提名"
detailed_descriptions.ja: 自分が動くときだけ、時間が進む”、慎重な戦略と大混乱の要素を併せ持つFPSゲーム「SUPERHOT VR」。HP回復や弾薬の補充などの機能は一切登場しない中、武装した赤いヤツらに立ち向かうのは、自分ひとりだけ。スローモーションで迫り来る銃弾の嵐を避けながら、武器を奪い、敵を打ち破れ！ 精神はソフトウェアだ ＶＲゲームオブザイヤー作品に選ばれた「SUPERHOT VR」はバーチャルリアリティー(VR)とVRコントローラー向けの完全新作。このジャンルに先鞭をつけ、3年以上の月日を費やして作られた「SUPERHOT VR」はSUPERHOTの直感的アクションの波をプレイヤーの頭脳と精神に送り込む。そして今度は直に貴方のVR HEADSET ・第20回「D.I.C.E. Awards」Immersive Reality Game of the Year 部門 受賞 ・Unity Vision VR/AR Summit 2017 Best Game 受賞 ・Pixel.Awards Best VR Experience 受賞 ・Digital Dragons 2017 Best Polish VR Game 受賞 ・17th Game Developers Choice Awards(GDC Awards) Best VR/AR Game ノミネート
detailed_descriptions.ko: 신중한 전략과 혼란스러운 전투의 경계를 무너트리는 SUPERHOT VR은 당신이 움직일 때만 시간이 흐르는 형태의 훌륭한 VR FPS입니다. 자동으로 회복되는 체력 게이지 따윈 없습니다. 집기 편리하게 놓인 탄약도 없습니다. 무장한 적들에게 둘러싸인 채 오로지 혼자 힘으로 적들에게서 무기를 빼앗아 쏘고, 베고, 느리게 날아오는 총탄을 헤치며 나아가야 합니다. 정신은 소프트웨어 SUPERHOT VR은 출시된 그해 바로 '올해의 VR 게임' 부문을 당연하다는 듯 거머쥐었습니다. SUPERHOT은 VR 기기와 손의 움직임을 추적하는 컨트롤러까지 모든 것을 고려하여 처음부터 다시 구상하고 기획한 작품입니다. 비평가들의 격한 찬사 속에, SUPERHOT team과 Oculus 사이의 3년이 넘는 긴밀한 협력이 열매를 맺었습니다. SUPERHOT VR은 당신의 본능에 따른 액션을 머리와 영혼 속으로 인도해줄 겁니다. 이번엔 당신의 VR 헤드셋도 함께 말이죠. 🏆 GDCA 2018 최고의 VR 게임 부문 수상 🏆 SXSW 2018 최고의 VR 게임 부문 수상 🏆 DICE Awards 2017 올해의 몰입 현실 게임 부문 수상 🏆 New York Game Awards 2017 최고의 가상현실 게임 부문 수상 🏆 Unity Vision Summit 2017 가상현실 게임 부문 수상 🏆 Pixel.Awards 2017 최고의 가상현실 게임 부문 수상 🏆 Digital Dragons 2017 최고의 가상현실 게임 부문 수상 🏆 GDCA 2017 VR 게임 부문 노미네이트 🏆 SXSW Trending 2017 올해의 게임 부문 노미네이트 SUPERHOT VR에는 SUPERHOT FOREVER라는 대형 콘텐츠 업데이트도 포함됩니다. 수 시간 분량의 반복 플레이가 가능한 챌린지, 도전과제, 하드코어 엔들리스 레벨이 SUPERHOT VR의 실감나는 게임플레이에 포함됩니다. 포함되는 내용은 다음과 같습니다. – 오직 헤드샷만 인정되는 장소에서 조준 실력을 시험해보세요. - 불릿-타임과 리얼-타임 모드에서 본인의 최고 점수를 갱신해 보세요. - 총 한 번 쏘지 않고 게임을 클리어해보세요. - 적들은 더 빨라지고, 반응할 시간은 줄어드는 하드코어 모드를 체험해보세요. 이 게임은 당신의 한계를 시험할 것이며, (좋은 의미의) 고통을 가져다주리라 확신합니다. 결국엔 승리를 손에 쥐고 시스템과 하나가 될 것입니다.

games.short_description: Supermarket Chaos is a cozy organizing simulator where you sort 4,668 products in a messy supermarket. Enjoy the satisfaction of stocking shelves in a calm, relaxing atmosphere.

descriptions.en: Supermarket Chaos is a cozy organizing simulator where you sort 4,668 products in a messy supermarket. Enjoy the satisfaction of stocking shelves in a calm, relaxing atmosphere.

detailed_descriptions.en: Supermarket Chaos is a cozy organizing simulator about calmly putting a chaotic supermarket back in order. Arrange 4,668 products across 16 sections, including fruit, tea, frozen foods, books, wine, ramen, and more, and enjoy the quiet satisfaction of making every shelf feel right. 〖A Relaxing Supermarket Organizing Simulator〗 One day, the store-organizing robot GPT-9000 reached a philosophical conclusion: “All positions are temporary, and all displays are violence.” As a result, every product in the supermarket lost its place. (Fortunately, he was fired immediately.) No need to worry. Now all you have to do is walk through the quiet store and return each scattered product to its proper place. 〖When a Messy Store Falls Into Place〗 At first, the store is a little chaotic. Empty shelves, products left on the floor, sections that still need attention. But as you put each item back where it belongs, the store gradually becomes a clean, comfortable space. 〖Pick Up Products, Find Their Sections, and Put Them in Place〗 Pick up each product, find the right section, and match it to the correct price tag. Instead of rushing, settle into the rhythm of organizing and take your time completing the store. 〖One Completed Section, One Quiet Satisfaction〗 Empty shelves fill up with products, and mixed-up items settle into neat rows. Each completed section brings visible progress and a quiet sense of satisfaction. 〖Skill Upgrades〗 Unlock and upgrade a variety of skills as you play. Carry more products, find the spots you need more easily, and make the whole organizing process smoother and more efficient. 〖Key Features〗 A cozy organizing simulation where you sort more than 4,000 products 16 sections including fruit, tea, frozen foods, books, wine, ramen, and more Gameplay focused on checking item names and locations, then placing them where they belong The visual satisfaction of watching the store become cleaner and cleaner A variety of skill upgrades for movement, carrying, searching, and more No time limits and no game over. A relaxed, low-pressure atmosphere you can enjoy at your own pace

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Supermarket Chaos is a cozy organizing simulator about calmly putting a chaotic supermarket back in order. Arrange 4,668 products across 16 sections, including fruit, tea, frozen foods, books, wine, ramen, and more, and enjoy the quiet satisfaction of making every shelf feel right.

〖A Relaxing Supermarket Organizing Simulator〗

One day, the store-organizing robot GPT-9000 reached a philosophical conclusion: “All positions are temporary, and all displays are violence.” As a result, every product in the supermarket lost its place. (Fortunately, he was fired immediately.)

No need to worry. Now all you have to do is walk through the quiet store and return each scattered product to its proper place.

〖When a Messy Store Falls Into Place〗

At first, the store is a little chaotic.
Empty shelves, products left on the floor, sections that still need attention.
But as you put each item back where it belongs, the store gradually becomes a clean, comfortable space.

〖Pick Up Products, Find Their Sections, and Put Them in Place〗

Pick up each product, find the right section, and match it to the correct price tag.
Instead of rushing, settle into the rhythm of organizing and take your time completing the store.

〖One Completed Section, One Quiet Satisfaction〗

Empty shelves fill up with products, and mixed-up items settle into neat rows.
Each completed section brings visible progress and a quiet sense of satisfaction.

〖Skill Upgrades〗

Unlock and upgrade a variety of skills as you play.
Carry more products, find the spots you need more easily, and make the whole organizing process smoother and more efficient.

〖Key Features〗

  • A cozy organizing simulation where you sort more than 4,000 products

  • 16 sections including fruit, tea, frozen foods, books, wine, ramen, and more

  • Gameplay focused on checking item names and locations, then placing them where they belong

  • The visual satisfaction of watching the store become cleaner and cleaner

  • A variety of skill upgrades for movement, carrying, searching, and more

  • No time limits and no game over. A relaxed, low-pressure atmosphere you can enjoy at your own pace

games.name: Supermarket Simulator
games.short_description: Run your own supermarket! Stock shelves, set your prices, take payments, hire staff, expand your store, handle shoplifters, and design your layout. Purchase goods from online or local markets around town, and personally deliver online orders to your customers.

descriptions.en: Run your own supermarket! Stock shelves, set your prices, take payments, hire staff, expand your store, handle shoplifters, and design your layout. Purchase goods from online or local markets around town, and personally deliver online orders to your customers.

detailed_descriptions.en: "Supermarket Simulator" is a chill first-person simulation where every detail of running a supermarket comes alive. Design your store, optimizing for efficiency and aesthetics. Determine where products are displayed, manage your aisles, and ensure a smooth shopping experience for your customers. Order stock using an in-game computer. Unpack goods, organize them in your storage room and place them on shelves, fridges, and freezers. Scan items, take cash and credit card payments, and ensure customers leave satisfied with their shopping and checkout experience. Navigate the complexities of a real-time market. Buy products when prices dip and determine the best-selling prices to balance customer satisfaction with profit margins. As you accumulate profits, consider reinvesting. Expand your store's physical space, upgrade interiors, and continually adapt to the evolving demands of the retail world. Personalize your shop to make it unique. Customize the floors, paint the walls, put up category signs, and more. Not every customer visits your store in person. Receive online orders, prepare the packages, and deliver them yourself. Tired of paying delivery fees or searching for discounts? Visit local markets to find the best deals. Make your store shine. Clean the floor, take out the trash, and polish the windows to keep everything squeaky clean. Not everyone is a paying customer. Use security tools like cameras and alarm sensors, or hire security guards to protect your store from shoplifters. Supermarket Simulator lets you team up with up to four friends to run your store. Stock shelves, serve customers, fulfill online orders, manage deliveries, and expand your market, all while working together in real time. From driving trucks to cleaning up and setting prices, teamwork is the key to growing a successful supermarket. In "Supermarket Simulator", every decision matters. Will you rise to the occasion, transforming a modest establishment into a retail powerhouse, all while balancing customer satisfaction, and finances?

games.name: Supraland
games.short_description: Try the demo! A mix between Portal, Zelda and Metroid. Exploration, puzzles, terrible combat, secret upgrades and new abilities that help you reach new places. Playtime 12-25h.

descriptions.en: Try the demo! A mix between Portal, Zelda and Metroid. Exploration, puzzles, terrible combat, secret upgrades and new abilities that help you reach new places. Playtime 12-25h.

detailed_descriptions.en: Supraland is a First-Person Metroidvania Puzzle game by David Münnich from Germany. The main sources of inspiration are Zelda, Metroid and Portal. Supraland assumes that you are intelligent and lets you play independently. The story is minimal, gives you an overarching goal to pursue, and then sets you free. Despite child friendly visuals, the game targets experienced players. Playtime: ~12-25h You explore a large interconnected world in which most ways are at first unpassable until you find new abilities to overcome those obstacles. A cornerstone of Supraland's design was to create abilities that are so versatile, they will keep on surprising you by how many different usages they have. If you combine your abilities, the possibilities become even bigger. Most of the game is about exploring the sandbox world to track down secrets. Often you will think you are about to get out of bounds and beat the level designer, but right there is a chest waiting for you with a very rewarding upgrade. Supraland respects your lifetime and doesn't bloat the playtime with unlimited no-brainer collectibles. The deeper you get into the game the more you will be facing creative puzzles you've never seen anywhere before, encouraging you to stop and think about what abilities you have and how you can use them in yet another way. Puzzle types that I already knew from other games were immediately rejected in the design process. And it's important to me that once you understand the idea behind a puzzle, you can pretty much immediately solve it instead of having to go through a cumbersome, frustrating execution. The fighting mechanics are inspired by old-school, fast-paced shooter games like Unreal, Doom and Quake, encouraging high-speed strafing and jumping while throwing shot after shot at hordes of charging enemies without ever having to worry about weapons reloading. In the demo you can play the first big section of the game and decide if it's for you. The demo progress continues into the full version; you don't need to play anything twice!

games.name: Surgeon Simulator 2
games.short_description: It’s time to ‘scrub in’ in this physics-based surgery sim. Unearth the mysteries of the Bossa Labs Medical Facility and save Bob’s life.

descriptions.en: It’s time to ‘scrub in’ in this physics-based surgery sim. Unearth the mysteries of the Bossa Labs Medical Facility and save Bob’s life.

detailed_descriptions.en: Bob’s life is in your hand! It’s time to slip into your scrubs and grab the nearest scalpel (saw or sink plunger), and enter the Bossa Labs Medical Facility in this physics based operating theatre of chaos. Take on the cream of the medical establishment in riotous competitive challenges and play frantically blood-splattered games in Surgeon Simulator 2’s rib-tickling Campaign Mode. In Story Mode you perform operations, opening ribcages, choosing transplant organs, making sure Bob doesn’t bleed out – it’s a barrage of botch jobs which will test every element of your surgical skills. As the pressure to keep the patient alive mounts, you must work like a well oiled machine, choosing to help, or hinder, the life-saving efforts in this unique and pandemonium pumped game. In Campaign Mode Reveal the truth behind the mysterious medical facility with a plot crafted by award winning writer Rhianna Pratchett which has more twists than Bob’s intestines. Nothing is ever straight-forward including head transplants – who would have known? The Bossa Labs Medical Facility is as much a character in this game as your fellow surgeons and seems to be totally trying to sabotage your surgical career with its labyrinthine corridors, devious puzzles and tricky traps. From space stations to discos, bowling alleys to carnivals, your fellow surgeons have been creating some incredible and unlikely scenarios for surgical procedures – and they are all yours to play in with more levels and games being created all the time! Jump in and let the adventure begin! Publishers note: prior to the transfer of Surgeon Simulator 2 from publisher tinyBuild to Infogrames multiplayer functionality was removed from this game. The team at Infogrames is currently evaluating this decision. For the foreseeable future the title remains a fun, irreverently funny romp through the world of high-stakes surgery.

games.name: Survival Log
games.short_description: The apocalypse is here, and you saw it coming. Survival Log is a zombie-apocalypse hoarding survival sim. Hoard supplies, reinforce your home, and optimize every run before zombies flood the city. Every failure becomes experience. You must adapt and survive this time.

descriptions.en: The apocalypse is here, and you saw it coming. Survival Log is a zombie-apocalypse hoarding survival sim. Hoard supplies, reinforce your home, and optimize every run before zombies flood the city. Every failure becomes experience. You must adapt and survive this time.

detailed_descriptions.en: Survival Log fuses two distinct phases of survival: the desperate scramble to hoard before the outbreak and the relentless challenge of managing your stronghold after. Strategy, resource management, and endurance are the name of the game. A single death gave you a glimpse of the future. The apocalypse is coming in just 10 hours. And this time, you're ready. With disaster still hours away, the clock is ticking. Scavenge for resources, fortify your stronghold, and chart your survival strategy... because when the dead rise in force, there's no room for mistakes. The end is near. Stockpile everything you can. Scour the city—supermarkets, hardware stores, farmers' markets. Leave no corner untouched. Before society collapses, grab everything you'll need to stay alive. Every decision carries weight. Do you spend your precious time and money on food and water, or do you fortify your shelter and secure fuel for the long haul? Choose wisely. Your survival depends on it. Keep a close eye on your supplies with a live inventory system. The Loot Spotter lets you see exactly what you've gathered, identify critical gaps, and plug every hole before the clock runs out. Transform your home into an apocalypse-proof fortress. Scavenge or purchase furniture, appliances, and construction materials. Design your safe house layout from scratch, then roll up your sleeves and install, upgrade, and customize every last detail with your own two hands. As your survival demands grow, so does your safe house. Expand it floor by floor. Living quarters, storage rooms, power generation, and even farming areas... everything meticulously planned and in its place. Every resource you invest before the apocalypse becomes the lifeline that keeps you alive after. Manage your stronghold and become self-sufficient. Grow your own crops and cook proper meals because surviving the apocalypse doesn't mean giving up the good life. Power your base with diesel, manual generators, or solar. Every watt is a resource you can't waste. Manage hunger, stamina, and morale. Survival isn't just about staying alive; it's about staying sane. Confront disaster and face the unknown. Rain, the freezing cold, and blackouts... Every disaster pushes your prep to the limit. Hold the line against endless hordes of zombies. Fortify, set traps, and defend your last refuge. Explore abandoned supermarkets, schools, and the city ruins. Scavenge for rare resources, but stay sharp. Not every threat shambles and groans. Stand together and rewrite the ending. Rescue stranded neighbors, trade with survivors via drone, and build a new community. Choose your past—a worker, a student, or a warehouse clerk. Every identity changes the game. Every failure becomes experience. Reborn with your memories, uncover the disaster's truth.

games.name: Survival: Fountain of Youth
games.short_description: Survival: Fountain of Youth is a challenging single-player open-world adventure game set on the Caribbean islands. Survive as a shipwrecked 16th-century explorer, craft tools and shelter, and uncover the secrets of both an ancient civilization and your own fate.

descriptions.en: Survival: Fountain of Youth is a challenging single-player open-world adventure game set on the Caribbean islands. Survive as a shipwrecked 16th-century explorer, craft tools and shelter, and uncover the secrets of both an ancient civilization and your own fate.

detailed_descriptions.en: Survival: Fountain of Youth invites you to embark on a thrilling adventure inspired by the historic Age of Discovery. After a shipwreck, you find yourself stranded on deserted islands, where you must master the art of survival. From crafting tools and building shelters to hunting prey and battling predators, every action counts. Planning and carefully managing your hunger, energy, and thirst is key for any lost survivor. There is only so much you can do in one day: hunting, gathering resources, crafting new tools, and cooking will take precious time. Yet survival is only the beginning… Once you’ve tended to your basic needs it’s time to explore the vast archipelago you ended up on. Explore 11 islands, each with its own challenges: scorching Caribbean heat, relentless storms, malaria infested swamps and poisonous plants… The Bimini archipelago is full of hazards to overcome! Prepare your expeditions, establish outposts on each region and roam the seas on unique vessels: from a primitive raft to a massive 16th century Spanish ship. Dangerous animals, weather, plants, diseases, injuries, hunger, thirst, exhaustion — everything will test your strength and ability to survive. The archipelago is filled with wild dangerous beasts to hunt down and even more challenging animal bosses. You're the hunter here not the prey... With blood and sweat, transform your encampment from a simple tent bivouac to a bustling base: tools workshops, crops field, water collector, smithing machinery… There are hundreds of items that can be crafted and used for survival, from the simplest tools made of sticks and rocks to advanced muskets and armor. While finding clues and traces of your shipmates, you will stumble upon remnants of an ancient civilization that perished for an unknown reason. Search ruins and temples, decipher centuries-old puzzles and unveil the mystery behind the legendary Fountain of Youth.

games.name: Survive the Nights
games.short_description: Hardcore open-world survival where preparation is everything. Scavenge, craft, fortify during the day. When night falls, the infected hunt in numbers. Play solo or with friends in a brutal post-apocalyptic sandbox where survival is earned through smart decisions. How many Nights will you survive?

descriptions.en: Hardcore open-world survival where preparation is everything. Scavenge, craft, fortify during the day. When night falls, the infected hunt in numbers. Play solo or with friends in a brutal post-apocalyptic sandbox where survival is earned through smart decisions. How many Nights will you survive?

detailed_descriptions.en: Prepare during the day. Survive the night. Survive the Nights is a hardcore open-world survival game where preparation is everything. Scavenge, craft, fortify, and plan during the day — because when night falls, the infected hunt in numbers, and mistakes are punished. Play solo or with friends in a brutal post-apocalyptic sandbox where survival is earned through smart decisions, strong fortifications, and cooperation under pressure. Zombies Zombie difficulty comes from numbers, not individual strength. By day they roam slowly — by night they gather into massive hordes drawn to player activity. The longer you survive, the bigger and more dangerous the nights become. Fortify Everything Structures and vehicles are fully fortifiable. Cover windows and add strength to gain the advantage. Mobile Homes Like to be on the move? Take your home on the road. Cook, sleep and store your items in your mobile base. Storage and bases Settle into your new home by using pegboards, player storage and blueprints to put your stamp on the place. Physically place your items in the world to make your perfect survival hideout. Use traps to get the upper hand. Traps can give you the edge when zombies or raiders arrive. Nutrition & Hydration Cook over an open fire or directly on a stove to manage your calorie and hydration needs. Maintaining your player vitals will increase your overall strength and carrying capacity over time. Sick of canned food? Head out into the wilderness to hunt for larger animals. When food stores start to run out, turn to farming for your calorie needs. Protect your crops indoors under light or grow them outside in the warmer months to produce food that will last through winter. Weapon Customization Weapon attachments let you customize your gun and get it just right for your play style. Vehicle Maintenance Every vehicle is repairable. Engine and wheel parts are required to get a vehicle running. Items can be stored in trunks and on truck beds. POIs Explore the different points of interest to find valuable location-specific loot. Weather & Seasons The weather is dynamic including all four seasons along with seasonal vegetation and foliage. Day & Night Objectives Spend your days preparing to survive the onslaught at night. Zombies are more aggressive and alert when the sun goes down. Day Objectives: During the day, focus on resource gathering and fortification. Fell trees, craft planks, engage in hunting and trapping. Collect loot, food, and fortify a structure. Ensure doors and containers are locked, fuel generators, and prepare power systems. Keep your health up by lighting fires, crafting bandages, and gearing up for the night. Night Objectives: At night, prioritize safety and stealth. Team up with friends in a secured structure, favor melee over firearms to stay quiet. Activate generators, power up structures, set traps, and cook meals indoors on wood stoves. The key is to survive until morning. Mental Health System The mental health system discourages the "Kill On Sight" mentality, promoting alliances for better survival against the zombie threat. While PVP is still a factor, players have ways to correct a negative mental state. Your Apocalypse, Your Rules Survival and zombies how you like them! Browse hundreds of scenarios that set the scene for your perfect survival experience. Zombie survival just how you want it. Electrical Systems Powering a structure can provide light to make nighttime activities easier. Some structures also require electricity to power interior and exterior doors. Modding Full Steam Workshop support with the ability to mod all areas of the game. Mods can be browsed and installed directly ingame. Steam Achievements If achievements are your thing, we’ve got you covered. With almost 100 achievements, you’ll be busy for some time. Can you ‘Choke a Chicken’? Server Hosting & Solo Play Simple game hosting that uses steam relays. There’s no need to port forward. Simply choose your settings and start playing. Plans for Future Updates Expand electrical systems - This will include electrical traps, house alarms, heating systems, working stoves, more lighting in towns and roadways, light towers, functioning water pumps (water tied to power). Expanding weapons - New weapons and improved handling. Additional vehicles - Expanding on “mobile survival” such as adding box trucks, trailers and light aircraft. Fishing - Spend your days shore side with a line in the water, if you think it’s safe. Character customization - A full scale character customization feature including the implementation of a female character Expand on STN+ and Workshop - This includes more furniture, structure painting, holiday lights and decorations, proper Steam workshop implementation and working arcade’s with API. Grouping system - Players can join a grouping system with friends. Island wide community missions and events - Come together to clear out larger structures. Band together and share your loot to repair the power station and provide the entire island with power.

Spend your days preparing to survive the onslaught at night. Zombies are more aggressive and alert when the sun goes down.

Day Objectives: During the day, focus on resource gathering and fortification. Fell trees, craft planks, engage in hunting and trapping. Collect loot, food, and fortify a structure. Ensure doors and containers are locked, fuel generators, and prepare power systems. Keep your health up by lighting fires, crafting bandages, and gearing up for the night.

Night Objectives: At night, prioritize safety and stealth. Team up with friends in a secured structure, favor melee over firearms to stay quiet. Activate generators, power up structures, set traps, and cook meals indoors on wood stoves. The key is to survive until morning.

Mental Health System

The mental health system discourages the "Kill On Sight" mentality, promoting alliances for better survival against the zombie threat. While PVP is still a factor, players have ways to correct a negative mental state.

Your Apocalypse, Your Rules

Survival and zombies how you like them! Browse hundreds of scenarios that set the scene for your perfect survival experience. Zombie survival just how you want it.

Electrical Systems

Powering a structure can provide light to make nighttime activities easier. Some structures also require electricity to power interior and exterior doors.

Modding

Full Steam Workshop support with the ability to mod all areas of the game. Mods can be browsed and installed directly ingame.

Steam Achievements

If achievements are your thing, we’ve got you covered. With almost 100 achievements, you’ll be busy for some time. Can you ‘Choke a Chicken’?

Server Hosting & Solo Play

Simple game hosting that uses steam relays. There’s no need to port forward. Simply choose your settings and start playing.

Plans for Future Updates

  • Expand electrical systems - This will include electrical traps, house alarms, heating systems, working stoves, more lighting in towns and roadways, light towers, functioning water pumps (water tied to power).

  • Expanding weapons - New weapons and improved handling.

  • Additional vehicles - Expanding on “mobile survival” such as adding box trucks, trailers and light aircraft.

  • Fishing - Spend your days shore side with a line in the water, if you think it’s safe.

  • Character customization - A full scale character customization feature including the implementation of a female character

  • Expand on STN+ and Workshop - This includes more furniture, structure painting, holiday lights and decorations, proper Steam workshop implementation and working arcade’s with API.

  • Grouping system - Players can join a grouping system with friends.

  • Island wide community missions and events - Come together to clear out larger structures. Band together and share your loot to repair the power station and provide the entire island with power.
